gloss_zh: 得到安慰；接受慰问或吊唁；得到同情

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive comfort, condolences, or sympathy from someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在悲伤或遭遇不幸时，得到别人的安慰、吊唁或同情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi faraġ, kondoljanzi jew simpatija mingħand xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到安慰，悲伤的心情受到抚慰。
在亲友去世后接受别人的吊唁或慰问。
因自己的不幸或困难而得到别人的同情。

collocations.en: was comforted by his friend's words
received condolences after the death of a relative
collocations.zh: 在亲属去世后接受慰问

formal.mt: Wara l-mewt ta' ħuh, Pawlu tgħażża bil-kliem ta' sħabu.
formal.en: After his brother's death, Pawlu was comforted by his friends' words.
formal.zh: 弟弟去世后，保罗从朋友们的话语中得到了安慰。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif inhu Pawlu wara t-telfa ta' ħuh? Rita: Għadu mdejjaq, imma tgħażża biż-żjara ta' sħabu.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is Pawlu after losing his brother? Rita: He is still sad, but his friends' visit comforted him.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗失去弟弟后怎么样了？丽塔：他还是很难过，不过朋友们的探望给了他安慰。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu Pawlu wara t-telfa ta' ħuh?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu Pawlu wara t-telfa ta' ħuh?
messages.zh: 保罗失去弟弟后怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after losing his brother?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mdejjaq, imma tgħażża biż-żjara ta' sħabu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mdejjaq, imma tgħażża biż-żjara ta' sħabu.
messages.zh: 他还是很难过，不过朋友们的探望给了他安慰。
messages.en: He is still sad, but his friends' visit comforted him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一幅朋友前来探望悲伤者的画面：主角是得到安慰的人，也可能正在接受吊唁或同情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For teeth to be ground against one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指牙齿彼此接触并相互磨动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għas-snien meta jitħnu kontra xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be ground together (used of one's teeth)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （指牙齿）被磨在一起，彼此相互磨动。

collocations.en: to be ground together during sleep, referring to teeth
to be ground against one another, referring to teeth

formal.mt: Il-verb 'tgħażżaż' jiddeskrivi s-snien meta jitħnu kontra xulxin.
formal.en: The verb 'tgħażżaż' describes teeth being ground against one another.
formal.zh: 动词 tgħażżaż 描述牙齿相互磨动的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'tgħażżaż' hawn? Simon: Qed jitkellem fuq is-snien meta jitħnu kontra xulxin, bħal meta xi ħadd jorqod.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'tgħażżaż' mean here? Simon: It refers to teeth being ground against one another, as can happen when someone sleeps.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 tgħażżaż 是什么意思？西蒙：说的是牙齿相互磨动，比如人在睡觉时可能出现的情况。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'tgħażżaż' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'tgħażżaż' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 tgħażżaż 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tgħażżaż' mean here?

messages.speaker: Simon (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jitkellem fuq is-snien meta jitħnu kontra xulxin, bħal meta xi ħadd jorqod.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jitkellem fuq is-snien meta jitħnu kontra xulxin, bħal meta xi ħadd jorqod.
messages.zh: 说的是牙齿相互磨动，比如人在睡觉时可能出现的情况。
messages.en: It refers to teeth being ground against one another, as can happen when someone sleeps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时想象上下牙齿贴在一起来回磨动，把整个词与磨牙的动作绑定；这只是情景联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frayed, with threads or fibres coming loose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指绳索或织物等磨损后纤维松散、边缘起毛或散丝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisfilaccia, bil-ħjut jew il-fibri jinħallu, speċjalment mat-truf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （绳索、织物等）磨损起毛，出现松散的纤维或线头。

collocations.en: a rope that has become frayed
fabric that has become frayed at the edges

formal.mt: It-tarf tal-ħabel tgħażżel wara ħafna użu.
formal.en: The end of the rope became frayed after extensive use.
formal.zh: 长时间使用后，绳子的末端磨损起毛了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex trid ħabel ġdid? Mark: Dan tgħażżel mat-tarf; ara kemm hemm ħjut maħlula.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you want a new rope? Mark: This one has frayed at the end; look how many loose threads there are.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么要换一根新绳子？马克：这根绳子的末端散丝了，你看有多少松开的线头。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid ħabel ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid ħabel ġdid?
messages.zh: 你为什么要换一根新绳子？
messages.en: Why do you want a new rope?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan tgħażżel mat-tarf; ara kemm hemm ħjut maħlula.
messages.mt_standard: Dan tgħażżel mat-tarf; ara kemm hemm ħjut maħlula.
messages.zh: 这根绳子的末端散丝了，你看有多少松开的线头。
messages.en: This one has frayed at the end; look how many loose threads there are.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词写在一根末端散开、露出许多细线的旧绳子旁边，用看得见的散丝状态记住这个动词。

gloss_zh: 变得受珍爱；逐渐被珍视

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become cherished or especially valued by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐成为某人珍爱、珍视的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir għażiż jew ta' valur speċjali għal xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得受到某人的珍爱或珍视。

collocations.zh: 随着时间推移而逐渐被珍视

formal.mt: Dan il-ktieb tgħażżeż minn sidu għax kien rigal mingħand missieru.
formal.en: This book became cherished by its owner because it was a gift from his father.
formal.zh: 这本书是父亲送的礼物，因此逐渐成为主人珍爱的物品。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Pawlu għadu jżomm dak il-ktieb qadim? Rita: Kien ta' missieru, u maż-żmien tgħażżeż ħafna minnu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does Pawlu still keep that old book? Rita: It belonged to his father, and over time he came to cherish it deeply.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗为什么还留着那本旧书？丽塔：那是他父亲的书，时间久了，他就格外珍爱它。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu għadu jżomm dak il-ktieb qadim?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu għadu jżomm dak il-ktieb qadim?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么还留着那本旧书？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu still keep that old book?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ta' missieru, u maż-żmien tgħażżeż ħafna minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ta' missieru, u maż-żmien tgħażżeż ħafna minnu.
messages.zh: 那是他父亲的书，时间久了，他就格外珍爱它。
messages.en: It belonged to his father, and over time he came to cherish it deeply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本普通旧书因为承载亲人的回忆，慢慢变成心爱的宝物，借此记住逐渐受到珍爱的含义。

gloss_zh: 互相眨眼示意；彼此使眼色

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exchange winks with another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人互相眨眼示意，强调双方彼此回应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel għajnejh lil xi ħadd u jirċievi l-istess ġest lura.

sense_translations.en_definition: to wink (in the mutual sense of winking to each other)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 互相眨眼示意，指彼此向对方使眼色。

collocations.en: exchanged winks with his companion during the joke
collocations.zh: 在开玩笑时与同伴互相使眼色

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċajta, Mark tgħiemeż ma' sieħbu biex juri li kienu qed jifhmu lil xulxin.
formal.en: During the joke, Mark exchanged winks with his companion to show their shared understanding.
formal.zh: 开玩笑时，马克与同伴互相眨眼，表示彼此心领神会。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt lil Mark u lil Pawlu waqt iċ-ċajta? Lara: Iva! Mark tgħiemeż ma' Pawlu, u t-tnejn bdew jidħku.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see Mark and Pawlu during the joke? Lara: Yes! Mark exchanged winks with Pawlu, and they both started laughing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到马克和保罗听笑话时的样子了吗？拉拉：看到了！马克和保罗互相使了个眼色，两个人就都笑了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil Mark u lil Pawlu waqt iċ-ċajta?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil Mark u lil Pawlu waqt iċ-ċajta?
messages.zh: 你看到马克和保罗听笑话时的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Mark and Pawlu during the joke?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Mark tgħiemeż ma' Pawlu, u t-tnejn bdew jidħku.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Mark tgħiemeż ma' Pawlu, u t-tnejn bdew jidħku.
messages.zh: 看到了！马克和保罗互相使了个眼色，两个人就都笑了。
messages.en: Yes! Mark exchanged winks with Pawlu, and they both started laughing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个人一来一回眨眼的画面记忆，重点放在双方互相回应，而不是只有一个人单独眨眼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scrub one's own body to clean it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用摩擦、搓洗的方式清洁自己的身体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħorok ġismu biex jitnaddaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搓洗或擦洗自己的身体。

collocations.en: scrubbed himself to remove the mud

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol fl-għalqa, Pawlu tgħierek bis-sapun biex ineħħi t-tajn minn fuq ġismu.
formal.en: After working in the field, Pawlu scrubbed himself with soap to remove the mud from his body.
formal.zh: 在田里干完活后，保罗用肥皂搓洗身体，去除身上的泥污。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu għadu mimli tajn? Rita: Le, tgħierek bis-sapun u issa nadif.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is Pawlu still covered in mud? Rita: No, he scrubbed himself with soap and is clean now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗还是满身泥吗？丽塔：不是了，他用肥皂搓洗过身体，现在干净了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għadu mimli tajn?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għadu mimli tajn?
messages.zh: 保罗还是满身泥吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still covered in mud?

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tgħierek bis-sapun u issa nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tgħierek bis-sapun u issa nadif.
messages.zh: 不是了，他用肥皂搓洗过身体，现在干净了。
messages.en: No, he scrubbed himself with soap and is clean now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己满身泥，拿着肥皂反复搓洗手臂和身体；把动作的执行者与被清洗者都设为自己。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Craftiness or cunning in finding clever, indirect ways to achieve an aim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为达到目的而巧妙盘算、采取迂回办法的机巧或狡猾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Makakkerija jew ħila li biha wieħed juża mezzi għaqlin u indiretti biex jilħaq skop.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 善于巧妙盘算、运用计谋的狡黠或机巧。
为达到目的而暗中算计、巧妙行事的狡猾。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-volpi kisbet l-ikel bit-tgħil.
formal.en: In the story, the fox obtained the food through cunning.
formal.zh: 在故事中，狐狸靠狡计得到了食物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif rebħet il-volpi fir-rakkont? Simon: Bit-tgħil! Għamlet pjan u daħqet bl-annimali l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the fox win in the story? Simon: Through cunning! It made a plan and tricked the other animals.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：故事里的狐狸是怎么获胜的？西蒙：靠狡计呀！它想了个计谋，把其他动物骗了。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif rebħet il-volpi fir-rakkont?
messages.mt_standard: Kif rebħet il-volpi fir-rakkont?
messages.zh: 故事里的狐狸是怎么获胜的？
messages.en: How did the fox win in the story?

messages.speaker: Simon (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-tgħil! Għamlet pjan u daħqet bl-annimali l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-tgħil! Għamlet pjan u daħqet bl-annimali l-oħra.
messages.zh: 靠狡计呀！它想了个计谋，把其他动物骗了。
messages.en: Through cunning! It made a plan and tricked the other animals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借用寓言里狐狸动脑筋设圈套的画面，把这个名词与狡黠、巧妙算计联系起来；这是记忆情景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of tasting something, or the sense used to perceive flavours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品尝食物或饮料的行为，也指辨别滋味的味觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iduq xi ħaġa, jew is-sens li bih jagħraf it-togħmiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 品尝，即通过尝试食物或饮料来感受其滋味的行为。
味觉，即感知和辨别滋味的感觉能力。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tgħim tal-inbid, il-parteċipanti qabblu t-togħmiet ta' tliet tipi differenti.
formal.en: During the wine tasting, the participants compared the flavours of three different varieties.
formal.zh: 在葡萄酒品尝活动中，参与者比较了三个不同品种的滋味。

colloquial.mt: Nina: 'Tgħim' ifisser biss li dduq xi ħaġa? Mark: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll is-sens li bih tagħraf jekk xi ħaġa hix ħelwa jew mielħa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does 'tgħim' only mean tasting something? Mark: No, it can also mean the sense that tells you whether something is sweet or salty.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：tgħim 只表示品尝东西吗？马克：不是，它也可以指让你辨别东西是甜还是咸的味觉。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Tgħim' ifisser biss li dduq xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: 'Tgħim' ifisser biss li dduq xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: tgħim 只表示品尝东西吗？
messages.en: Does 'tgħim' only mean tasting something?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll is-sens li bih tagħraf jekk xi ħaġa hix ħelwa jew mielħa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll is-sens li bih tagħraf jekk xi ħaġa hix ħelwa jew mielħa.
messages.zh: 不是，它也可以指让你辨别东西是甜还是咸的味觉。
messages.en: No, it can also mean the sense that tells you whether something is sweet or salty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住舌头尝一口的两个层面：尝的行为叫品尝，分辨甜咸的能力叫味觉；这个词可以表示两者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of stabbing someone with a dagger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用匕首刺击他人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħti daqqa ta' sejf qasir lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用匕首刺击的行为

collocations.en: a case of stabbing with a dagger

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' tgħin b'sejf qasir.
formal.en: The report describes a case of stabbing with a dagger.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起用匕首刺击他人的案件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'tgħin' f'dan it-test? Mark: Hawn ifisser daqqa ta' sejf qasir lil xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tgħin' mean in this text? Mark: Here it means stabbing someone with a dagger.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的 tgħin 是什么意思？马克：这里指用匕首刺击他人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'tgħin' f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'tgħin' f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 tgħin 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tgħin' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser daqqa ta' sejf qasir lil xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser daqqa ta' sejf qasir lil xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 这里指用匕首刺击他人。
messages.en: Here it means stabbing someone with a dagger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本条名词与案件记录中的匕首图标联系起来，记住它表示刺击行为；搭配 b'sejf qasir 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become calm again after feeling upset, frightened, or agitated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在烦躁、害怕或激动之后使自己恢复平静。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jsir kalm wara li jkun imbeżża', imdejjaq jew aġitat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己平静下来；让自己镇定下来

collocations.en: calmed himself down after the fright
collocations.zh: 受惊后让自己平静下来

formal.mt: Wara l-inċident, Pawlu thedda ftit ftit u seta' jispjega x'ġara.
formal.en: After the incident, Pawlu gradually calmed himself down and was able to explain what had happened.
formal.zh: 事件发生后，保罗逐渐平静下来，能够说明发生了什么。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu mħasseb? Mark: Le, thedda wara li tkellimna miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still worried? Mark: No, he calmed himself down after we spoke to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗还在担心吗？马克：没有，我们跟他聊过之后，他就平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għadu mħasseb?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għadu mħasseb?
messages.zh: 保罗还在担心吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still worried?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, thedda wara li tkellimna miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, thedda wara li tkellimna miegħu.
messages.zh: 没有，我们跟他聊过之后，他就平静下来了。
messages.en: No, he calmed himself down after we spoke to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人深呼吸后慢慢放松肩膀，把 thedda 与自己恢复平静的过程连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wasted without useful benefit, or to be destroyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被白白耗费而未产生益处，或遭到毁坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħela bla ma jagħti ġid, jew jinqered.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被浪费；被白白耗费
被毁坏；被毁灭

collocations.en: the wood was destroyed in the fire

formal.mt: L-injam maħżun fil-maħżen theddeb fin-nar.
formal.en: The wood stored in the warehouse was destroyed in the fire.
formal.zh: 存放在仓库里的木材在火灾中被毁了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma lestejtux ix-xogħol? Mark: Il-ħin kollu theddeb f'diskussjoni bla bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you finish the work? Mark: All the time was wasted on an unnecessary discussion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们怎么没把工作做完？马克：时间全浪费在一场没有必要的讨论上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma lestejtux ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma lestejtux ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 你们怎么没把工作做完？
messages.en: Why didn't you finish the work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħin kollu theddeb f'diskussjoni bla bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħin kollu theddeb f'diskussjoni bla bżonn.
messages.zh: 时间全浪费在一场没有必要的讨论上了。
messages.en: All the time was wasted on an unnecessary discussion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记住两个义项：空转的时钟表示被浪费，烧毁的木材表示被毁坏；都突出事物遭受的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be subjected to a threat of harm or other adverse consequences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到他人将施加伤害或其他不利后果的威胁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi theddida li ssirlu ħsara jew li jbati konsegwenzi ħżiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到威胁；遭到恐吓

formal.mt: Ix-xhud thedded bil-vjolenza wara li ta x-xhieda tiegħu.
formal.en: The witness was threatened with violence after giving his testimony.
formal.zh: 证人在作证后受到了暴力威胁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu jinsab imbeżża'? Mark: Thedded bit-tkeċċija jekk jerġa' jilmenta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu frightened? Mark: He was threatened with dismissal if he complains again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么这么害怕？马克：他受到了威胁，说他再投诉就会被解雇。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu jinsab imbeżża'?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu jinsab imbeżża'?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么这么害怕？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu frightened?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Thedded bit-tkeċċija jekk jerġa' jilmenta.
messages.mt_standard: Thedded bit-tkeċċija jekk jerġa' jilmenta.
messages.zh: 他受到了威胁，说他再投诉就会被解雇。
messages.en: He was threatened with dismissal if he complains again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画一支指向人物的警告箭头，提醒自己本条表示人物受到威胁，重点记住受威胁的一方。

gloss_zh: 在火上慢煮；被耗尽或消散

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cooked slowly over a fire, or to be consumed or dissipated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物在火上缓慢煮熟，或事物被消耗、耗尽或消散。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissajjar bil-mod fuq in-nar, jew jiġi kkunsmat jew jinħela.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be slow-cooked over a fire
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在火上被慢慢煮熟；经慢火烹煮
被消耗或耗尽；消散

collocations.en: the meat was slow-cooked over the fire

formal.mt: Il-ġid kollu tal-familja theddem matul is-snin.
formal.en: All the family's wealth was dissipated over the years.
formal.zh: 多年来，这个家庭的财富全部被耗尽了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-laħam lest? Mark: Iva, theddem fuq nar baxx għal sagħtejn u issa hu artab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the meat ready? Mark: Yes, it was slow-cooked over a low fire for two hours and is tender now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：肉做好了吗？马克：做好了，在小火上慢煮了两个小时，现在很软嫩。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-laħam lest?
messages.mt_standard: Il-laħam lest?
messages.zh: 肉做好了吗？
messages.en: Is the meat ready?

messages.speaker: Mark (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, theddem fuq nar baxx għal sagħtejn u issa hu artab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, theddem fuq nar baxx għal sagħtejn u issa hu artab.
messages.zh: 做好了，在小火上慢煮了两个小时，现在很软嫩。
messages.en: Yes, it was slow-cooked over a low fire for two hours and is tender now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项分别放进画面：锅里的肉在火上慢煮，钱罐里的财富逐渐耗尽；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 威胁；恐吓行为；多项威胁

teaching_sense.en_definition: A threat, the act of threatening, or threats considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 威胁这一言行、实施恐吓的行为，或统称多项威胁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Theddida, l-att li wieħed jhedded, jew għadd ta' theddidiet meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 威胁；表示将造成伤害或不利后果的言行
威胁或恐吓他人的行为
多项威胁；多次恐吓

formal.mt: L-iskola ma taċċettax kliem ta' theddid kontra studenti jew għalliema.
formal.en: The school does not accept threatening words directed at students or teachers.
formal.zh: 学校不容许针对学生或教师的威胁性言语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien hemm fil-messaġġi? Mark: Kien hemm theddid, u għalhekk żammejthom bħala prova.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was in the messages? Mark: There were threats, so I kept them as evidence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那些消息里写了什么？马克：里面有威胁，所以我把消息留作证据了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien hemm fil-messaġġi?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien hemm fil-messaġġi?
messages.zh: 那些消息里写了什么？
messages.en: What was in the messages?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm theddid, u għalhekk żammejthom bħala prova.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm theddid, u għalhekk żammejthom bħala prova.
messages.zh: 里面有威胁，所以我把消息留作证据了。
messages.en: There were threats, so I kept them as evidence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个装着警告纸条的文件夹：一张可表示一次威胁，多张可表示多项威胁，写这些话的行为也可称恐吓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of cooking food slowly over a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物放在火上缓慢烹煮的过程或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess tat-tisjir tal-ikel bil-mod fuq in-nar.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of slow cooking over a fire
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在火上慢慢烹煮的行为或过程

collocations.en: the slow cooking of meat over a fire
slow cooking over a low fire

formal.mt: It-theddim tal-laħam fuq nar baxx jeħtieġ ħin u attenzjoni.
formal.en: Slow cooking meat over a low fire requires time and attention.
formal.zh: 用小火慢煮肉需要时间，也需要留心照看。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex bdejt issajjar daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Għax it-theddim jieħu l-ħin, u rrid li l-laħam ikun artab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you start cooking so early? Mark: Because slow cooking over a fire takes time, and I want the meat to be tender.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么这么早就开始做饭？马克：因为在火上慢煮很花时间，而且我想把肉煮得软嫩。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bdejt issajjar daqshekk kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bdejt issajjar daqshekk kmieni?
messages.zh: 你为什么这么早就开始做饭？
messages.en: Why did you start cooking so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax it-theddim jieħu l-ħin, u rrid li l-laħam ikun artab.
messages.mt_standard: Għax it-theddim jieħu l-ħin, u rrid li l-laħam ikun artab.
messages.zh: 因为在火上慢煮很花时间，而且我想把肉煮得软嫩。
messages.en: Because slow cooking over a fire takes time, and I want the meat to be tender.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象炉火上咕嘟作响的锅和旁边的计时器，把 theddim 记作整个慢煮过程，注意本条是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel or express great joy, especially in response to good news or success.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到或表现出强烈的喜悦，尤其是因好消息或成功而欢欣雀跃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss jew juri ferħ kbir, speċjalment minħabba aħbar tajba jew suċċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欢欣雀跃；兴高采烈地表现出喜悦
感到喜悦；欢喜

collocations.en: rejoiced when he heard the news

formal.mt: Il-poplu thellel meta tħabbret il-paċi.
formal.en: The people rejoiced when peace was announced.
formal.zh: 和平的消息宣布时，民众欢欣雀跃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħadha Mario l-aħbar? Mark: Thellel bil-ferħ meta sema' li għadda mill-eżami.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mario take the news? Mark: He exulted with joy when he heard that he had passed the exam.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马里奥听到消息后是什么反应？马克：他听说自己通过了考试，高兴得欢欣雀跃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħadha Mario l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħadha Mario l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 马里奥听到消息后是什么反应？
messages.en: How did Mario take the news?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Thellel bil-ferħ meta sema' li għadda mill-eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Thellel bil-ferħ meta sema' li għadda mill-eżami.
messages.zh: 他听说自己通过了考试，高兴得欢欣雀跃。
messages.en: He exulted with joy when he heard that he had passed the exam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收到考试通过的消息后举手欢呼，把 thellel 与满心欢喜联系起来；exult 更突出强烈而外露的喜悦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Praise or eulogising directed at someone, especially in recognition of their qualities or achievements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人的品格、贡献或成就所作的赞颂，也可指庄重的颂扬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifħir jew kliem ta' ġieħ lil xi ħadd għall-kwalitajiet jew għall-kisbiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到赞扬；因优点、贡献或成就而获得称赞。
受到颂扬；以庄重的言辞被赞颂。

formal.mt: Fid-diskors tiegħu, id-direttur esprima kliem ta' thellil għall-ħidma tal-għalliema.
formal.en: In his speech, the director expressed words of praise for the teachers' work.
formal.zh: 主任在讲话中对教师们的工作表达了赞颂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok id-diskors dwar l-awtur? Mark: Iva, imma kien hemm ħafna thellil u ftit eżempji mix-xogħol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the speech about the author? Mark: Yes, but there was a lot of praise and few examples from his work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢那篇介绍作者的演讲吗？马克：喜欢，不过赞颂很多，引用他作品的例子却很少。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġbok id-diskors dwar l-awtur?
messages.mt_standard: Għoġbok id-diskors dwar l-awtur?
messages.zh: 你喜欢那篇介绍作者的演讲吗？
messages.en: Did you like the speech about the author?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma kien hemm ħafna thellil u ftit eżempji mix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma kien hemm ħafna thellil u ftit eżempji mix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过赞颂很多，引用他作品的例子却很少。
messages.en: Yes, but there was a lot of praise and few examples from his work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象颁奖台上的赞颂之词，把 thellil 与“受到赞扬”的场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel anxious or mentally disturbed because something causes worry or unease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事而感到忧虑、心烦或心神不安。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss tħassib jew inkwiet minħabba xi ħaġa li ttelliflu l-paċi tal-moħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到焦虑或担忧，尤其是为尚未确定的事情忧心。
感到心烦或心神受到扰动，难以保持平静。

collocations.zh: 因那则消息而心神不安

formal.mt: Il-missier themmem dwar is-saħħa ta' ibnu waqt li kien qed jistenna r-riżultati tat-testijiet.
formal.en: The father felt anxious about his son's health while waiting for the test results.
formal.zh: 父亲在等待检查结果时，为儿子的健康感到忧虑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kien daqshekk kwiet Pawlu? Maja: Themmem dwar l-eżami, imma issa jaf li għadda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why was Pawlu so quiet? Maja: He was anxious about the exam, but now he knows he passed.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗刚才为什么那么安静？玛雅：他在为考试担忧，不过现在知道自己通过了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kien daqshekk kwiet Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kien daqshekk kwiet Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗刚才为什么那么安静？
messages.en: Why was Pawlu so quiet?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Themmem dwar l-eżami, imma issa jaf li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Themmem dwar l-eżami, imma issa jaf li għadda.
messages.zh: 他在为考试担忧，不过现在知道自己通过了。
messages.en: He was anxious about the exam, but now he knows he passed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 themmem 放进“等成绩时坐立不安”的画面，联记忧虑与心烦两种感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be fastened to something or attached as an accompanying item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被固定在某物上，或作为附带的材料被附上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitwaħħal ma' xi ħaġa jew jiġi miżjud magħha bħala dokument jew oġġett ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扣紧、固定或附着在某物上；也可指文件等被附上。

formal.mt: Id-dokument meħtieġ themmeż mal-formola qabel ma ntbagħtet l-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The required document was attached to the form before the application was sent.
formal.zh: 申请寄出之前，所需文件已附在表格上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-irċevuta? Sara: Themmeż mal-ittra; ħares wara l-ewwel paġna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the receipt? Sara: It was attached to the letter; look behind the first page.
colloquial.zh: 马克：收据在哪里？萨拉：附在信上了，看看第一页后面。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-irċevuta?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-irċevuta?
messages.zh: 收据在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the receipt?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Themmeż mal-ittra; ħares wara l-ewwel paġna.
messages.mt_standard: Themmeż mal-ittra; ħares wara l-ewwel paġna.
messages.zh: 附在信上了，看看第一页后面。
messages.en: It was attached to the letter; look behind the first page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件被回形针固定在信上，用这个动作记住 themmeż 的“被附上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel happy, pleased or content in a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某种处境中感到快乐、幸福或满足。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss ferħ, hena jew sodisfazzjon f'sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到快乐或幸福；心情愉悦。

collocations.zh: 与家人在一起感到幸福

collocations.en: was happy in the company of his friends
collocations.zh: 因朋友们的陪伴而感到快乐

formal.mt: Wara żmien twil 'il bogħod mid-dar, Ġużeppi thenna mal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: After a long time away from home, Ġużeppi was happy to be with his family.
formal.zh: 离家许久之后，朱塞佩与家人团聚，感到十分幸福。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għadda l-Ħadd in-nannu? Mark: Thenna magħna; kielna flimkien u qgħadna nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Grandpa spend Sunday? Mark: He was happy with us; we ate together and sat chatting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：爷爷星期天过得怎么样？马克：他跟我们在一起很开心，我们一起吃饭，还坐着聊了天。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għadda l-Ħadd in-nannu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għadda l-Ħadd in-nannu?
messages.zh: 爷爷星期天过得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Grandpa spend Sunday?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Thenna magħna; kielna flimkien u qgħadna nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Thenna magħna; kielna flimkien u qgħadna nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 他跟我们在一起很开心，我们一起吃饭，还坐着聊了天。
messages.en: He was happy with us; we ate together and sat chatting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 thenna 和家人围桌吃饭的幸福画面相连，记住内心快乐满足的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become worn through use, weathered by exposure, or exhausted by effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因使用而磨损，因日晒风雨而风化，或因劳累而筋疲力尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintlibes bl-użu, jitmermer bl-effetti tat-temp, jew jispiċċa għajjien ħafna bix-xogħol jew bl-isforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因使用或摩擦而逐渐磨损、变旧。
因长期暴露在日晒、风雨等自然条件下而风化或受损。
因劳累或过度消耗精力而筋疲力尽。

collocations.en: was weathered by sun and rain

formal.mt: Il-ġebel ta' barra therra bix-xemx u x-xita matul is-snin.
formal.en: The exterior stone was weathered by sun and rain over the years.
formal.zh: 外部的石材多年来经受日晒雨淋，逐渐风化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni? Maja: Therra bix-xogħol illum; kellu ġurnata twila ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark go to bed so early? Maja: He was exhausted by work today; he had a very long day.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么这么早就去睡了？玛雅：他今天工作累坏了，忙了很长时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni?
messages.zh: 马克为什么这么早就去睡了？
messages.en: Why did Mark go to bed so early?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Therra bix-xogħol illum; kellu ġurnata twila ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Therra bix-xogħol illum; kellu ġurnata twila ħafna.
messages.zh: 他今天工作累坏了，忙了很长时间。
messages.en: He was exhausted by work today; he had a very long day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画记 therra：衣物磨旧、石头风化、人累瘫；共同点是经消耗而衰疲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be struck repeatedly with a heavy tool, especially to crush something in a mortar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被工具反复捣击，尤指在研钵中被捣碎或舂碎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintlaqat ripetutament b'għodda, speċjalment biex jitfarrak f'mehries.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反复捣击、舂打；可指食材被捣碎。

collocations.en: was pounded until it became powder

formal.mt: Il-bżar therreż fil-mehries sakemm sar trab fin, imbagħad żdied maz-zalza.
formal.en: The pepper was pounded in the mortar until it became a fine powder, then added to the sauce.
formal.zh: 胡椒在研钵中被捣成细粉，随后加入酱汁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-tewm tqatta' biss? Sara: Le, therreż fil-mehries biex jitħallat aħjar maz-zalza.
colloquial.en: Mark: Was this garlic just chopped? Sara: No, it was pounded in the mortar so it would blend better with the sauce.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些蒜只是切过了吗？萨拉：不是，是在研钵里捣碎的，这样更容易与酱汁混合。

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tewm tqatta' biss?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tewm tqatta' biss?
messages.zh: 这些蒜只是切过了吗？
messages.en: Was this garlic just chopped?

messages.speaker: Sara (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, therreż fil-mehries biex jitħallat aħjar maz-zalza.
messages.mt_standard: Le, therreż fil-mehries biex jitħallat aħjar maz-zalza.
messages.zh: 不是，是在研钵里捣碎的，这样更容易与酱汁混合。
messages.en: No, it was pounded in the mortar so it would blend better with the sauce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蒜在研钵中一下下被捣碎，把 therreż 与“被捣”的承受动作连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming worn out or deteriorating through use or exposure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品因使用或暴露于外界条件而逐渐磨损、破旧的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa tintlibes jew tiddeterjora bl-użu jew bl-espożizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐磨损、耗损或变得破旧的过程。

collocations.en: the wearing out of the fabric

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-therrir tad-drapp u jirrakkomanda li jinbidel il-kisi tas-siġġijiet.
formal.en: The report describes the wearing out of the fabric and recommends replacing the chair upholstery.
formal.zh: 报告描述了布料的磨损情况，并建议更换椅子的包覆面料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex trid tibdel dan it-tapit? Mark: Ara s-sinjali ta' therrir ħdejn il-bieb; hemmhekk kważi spiċċa d-drapp.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you want to replace this rug? Mark: Look at the signs of wear near the door; the fabric there is almost gone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么想换掉这块地毯？马克：看看门边的磨损痕迹，那里的织物都快磨没了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid tibdel dan it-tapit?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid tibdel dan it-tapit?
messages.zh: 你为什么想换掉这块地毯？
messages.en: Why do you want to replace this rug?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara s-sinjali ta' therrir ħdejn il-bieb; hemmhekk kważi spiċċa d-drapp.
messages.mt_standard: Ara s-sinjali ta' therrir ħdejn il-bieb; hemmhekk kważi spiċċa d-drapp.
messages.zh: 看看门边的磨损痕迹，那里的织物都快磨没了。
messages.en: Look at the signs of wear near the door; the fabric there is almost gone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看地毯从厚实到磨薄的连续画面，用 therrir 给“逐渐磨损这个过程”命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of repeatedly striking something, especially to crush it with a pestle in a mortar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复捣击某物的动作，尤指用杵在研钵中将材料捣碎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni ta' daqqiet ripetuti fuq xi ħaġa, speċjalment biex titfarrak bil-lasta f'mehries.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复捣击或舂捣的动作；可指将食材捣碎的操作。

collocations.en: the pounding of spices in the mortar

formal.mt: It-therriż tal-ħwawar fil-mehries isir qabel ma jitħalltu maż-żejt.
formal.en: The pounding of the spices in the mortar takes place before they are mixed with the oil.
formal.zh: 香料先在研钵中捣碎，再与油混合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-kċina? Mark: Hu t-therriż tat-tewm; qed nipprepara z-zalza.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that noise in the kitchen? Mark: It's the pounding of garlic; I'm preparing the sauce.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：厨房里是什么声音？马克：是捣蒜的声音，我在准备酱汁。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-kċina?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-kċina?
messages.zh: 厨房里是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu t-therriż tat-tewm; qed nipprepara z-zalza.
messages.mt_standard: Hu t-therriż tat-tewm; qed nipprepara z-zalza.
messages.zh: 是捣蒜的声音，我在准备酱汁。
messages.en: It's the pounding of garlic; I'm preparing the sauce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 听厨房里连续的咚咚捣蒜声，把 therriż 记成“捣击这一动作”的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become mad or lose one's reason.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得精神失常或失去理智。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġġennen jew jitlef ir-raġuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发疯；变得精神失常。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel therwel wara snin ta' biża' u solitudni.
formal.en: In the story, the man went mad after years of fear and loneliness.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那名男子经历多年恐惧与孤独后发疯了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru ma baqax jagħraf lil sħabu? Mark: Għax therwel lejn l-aħħar tar-rakkont.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the character stop recognizing his friends? Mark: Because he went mad towards the end of the story.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个角色为什么认不出朋友们了？马克：因为他在故事快结束时发疯了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru ma baqax jagħraf lil sħabu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru ma baqax jagħraf lil sħabu?
messages.zh: 那个角色为什么认不出朋友们了？
messages.en: Why did the character stop recognizing his friends?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax therwel lejn l-aħħar tar-rakkont.
messages.mt_standard: Għax therwel lejn l-aħħar tar-rakkont.
messages.zh: 因为他在故事快结束时发疯了。
messages.en: Because he went mad towards the end of the story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把故事人物突然失去理智的情节与 therwel 配对，记住它表示“发疯”这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of madness or loss of reason.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精神失常、失去理智或陷入疯狂的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ġenn jew ta' telf tar-raġuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精神失常；疯狂的状态。
疯癫；丧失理智的状态。

formal.mt: L-awtur juri t-therwil tal-karattru permezz ta' kliemu u ta' għemilu.
formal.en: The author reveals the character's madness through his words and actions.
formal.zh: 作者通过这个角色的言语和行为展现他的精神失常。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-karattru ħaraq l-ittri kollha? Toni: Kien mument ta' therwil; wara ddispjaċieh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the character burn all the letters? Toni: It was a moment of madness; he regretted it afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那个角色为什么烧掉了所有信件？托尼：他当时一时疯狂，后来就后悔了。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru ħaraq l-ittri kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru ħaraq l-ittri kollha?
messages.zh: 那个角色为什么烧掉了所有信件？
messages.en: Why did the character burn all the letters?

messages.speaker: Toni (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien mument ta' therwil; wara ddispjaċieh.
messages.mt_standard: Kien mument ta' therwil; wara ddispjaċieh.
messages.zh: 他当时一时疯狂，后来就后悔了。
messages.en: It was a moment of madness; he regretted it afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 therwil 放进“疯狂的状态”这个名词格子，再用“一时疯狂”的场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To think something over at length; in another sense, to go mad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某件事反复思量；另一个义项表示发疯或失去理智。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħseb fit-tul fuq xi ħaġa; f'sens ieħor, jiġġennen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复思考某事；仔细琢磨某事。
发疯；失去理智。

formal.mt: Qabel ħa deċiżjoni, thewden fit-tul fuq il-konsegwenzi.
formal.en: Before making a decision, he spent a long time considering the consequences.
formal.zh: 作决定之前，他长时间反复思量可能的后果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu għadu ma għażilx? Ben: Le, ilbieraħ thewden ħafna fuq iż-żewġ proposti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Pawlu still not chosen? Ben: No, yesterday he spent a lot of time mulling over the two proposals.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗还没有选好吗？本：还没有，他昨天花了很多时间反复考虑那两个提议。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għadu ma għażilx?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għadu ma għażilx?
messages.zh: 保罗还没有选好吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu still not chosen?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ilbieraħ thewden ħafna fuq iż-żewġ proposti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ilbieraħ thewden ħafna fuq iż-żewġ proposti.
messages.zh: 还没有，他昨天花了很多时间反复考虑那两个提议。
messages.en: No, yesterday he spent a lot of time mulling over the two proposals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脑中反复盘旋着两个选择，先记住“反复思量”；遇到“发疯”义时再按上下文区分。

gloss_zh: 受到摇动；心绪激动；受到打击

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be physically shaken, or to become emotionally agitated or upset.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到实际的摇动或震动，也可指情绪受到扰动、心绪不安或难过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq minħabba daqqa jew forza oħra, jew jitħawwad u jinkwieta emozzjonalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到摇动或震动；也可指内心受到震撼。
变得心绪激动或焦躁不安。
感到难过、烦乱或受到情绪上的打击。

collocations.zh: 被消息震动；因消息而心绪不安

formal.mt: Il-pont theżżeż meta għadda t-trakk tqil.
formal.en: The bridge shook when the heavy truck passed over it.
formal.zh: 重型卡车驶过时，桥发生了震动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ħassu Mark wara l-aħbar? David: Theżżeż ħafna, iżda qagħad jitkellem magħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Mark feel after hearing the news? David: He was very shaken, but he stayed and talked with us.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克听到消息后感觉怎么样？戴维：他受到了很大震动，不过留下来和我们聊了聊。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassu Mark wara l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassu Mark wara l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 马克听到消息后感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark feel after hearing the news?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Theżżeż ħafna, iżda qagħad jitkellem magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Theżżeż ħafna, iżda qagħad jitkellem magħna.
messages.zh: 他受到了很大震动，不过留下来和我们聊了聊。
messages.en: He was very shaken, but he stayed and talked with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“桥被震动，心也被震动”串起两个场景，分别记住身体摇动与情绪受扰的用法。

gloss_zh: 受震动的状态；心绪不安

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being shaken or emotionally agitated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到震动或处于情绪激动、心绪不安之中的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' min ikun imħawwad jew aġitat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到震动、震撼或动摇的状态。
情绪激动、焦躁或心绪不安的状态。

collocations.en: a state of being shaken after bad news
collocations.zh: 听到坏消息后的震动与不安

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-theżżiż emozzjonali tal-karattru wara l-inċident.
formal.en: The report describes the character's emotional agitation after the incident.
formal.zh: 这份报告描述了该角色在事件发生后的情绪不安。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex għadha daqshekk kwieta? Rita: Għadha tħoss it-theżżiż wara dak li ġara.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is she still so quiet? Rita: She still feels shaken after what happened.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：她为什么还是这么安静？丽塔：发生了那件事以后，她心里仍然很不安。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadha daqshekk kwieta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadha daqshekk kwieta?
messages.zh: 她为什么还是这么安静？
messages.en: Why is she still so quiet?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadha tħoss it-theżżiż wara dak li ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Għadha tħoss it-theżżiż wara dak li ġara.
messages.zh: 发生了那件事以后，她心里仍然很不安。
messages.en: She still feels shaken after what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 theżżiż 当作可以描述的“震动与不安状态”，记忆时放进名词栏，并配上事后心绪难平的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outpouring of something, or its flowing over the edge of a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物大量倾泻或涌出的过程，也可指液体越过容器边缘而溢出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' xi ħaġa fi kwantità kbira, jew il-ħruġ ta' likwidu minn fuq ix-xifer ta' reċipjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾泻；涌出，指某物大量流出或集中释放。
溢出；满溢，指内容物超过容器容量而流到外面。

formal.mt: It-tibdid tal-ilma mit-tank imla l-art ta' madwaru.
formal.en: The overflowing of water from the tank covered the surrounding ground.
formal.zh: 从水箱溢出的水淹湿了周围的地面。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex hemm dan l-ilma kollu mal-art? Toni: Minħabba t-tibdid mit-tank; insejt nagħlaq il-vit. Marija: Agħlqu issa u nġib il-mopp.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is there all this water on the floor? Toni: Because the tank overflowed; I forgot to turn off the tap. Marija: Turn it off now and I'll get the mop.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：地上怎么这么多水？托尼：水箱溢水了，我忘了关水龙头。玛丽娅：现在关上吧，我去拿拖把。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dan l-ilma kollu mal-art?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dan l-ilma kollu mal-art?
messages.zh: 地上怎么这么多水？
messages.en: Why is there all this water on the floor?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tibdid mit-tank; insejt nagħlaq il-vit.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tibdid mit-tank; insejt nagħlaq il-vit.
messages.zh: 水箱溢水了，我忘了关水龙头。
messages.en: Because the tank overflowed; I forgot to turn off the tap.

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħlqu issa u nġib il-mopp.
messages.mt_standard: Agħlqu issa u nġib il-mopp.
messages.zh: 现在关上吧，我去拿拖把。
messages.en: Turn it off now and I'll get the mop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水先大量涌出，再越过水箱边缘；用这一幅连续画面记住 tibdid 的“倾泻”和“溢出”。

gloss_zh: 变化；换衣；另有枯萎、衰弱义

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of changing, including changing clothes; separately, the process of withering or becoming weaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改变或发生变化的行为与过程，也包括更换衣服；另外还有枯萎或变得衰弱的独立义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li xi ħaġa tinbidel, inkluż il-bdil tal-ħwejjeġ; f'tifsiriet separati, il-proċess li xi ħaġa tidbiel jew tiddgħajjef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 枯萎；萎蔫，指植物等失去水分或生机的过程。
衰弱；减弱，指力量或活力逐渐下降。
改变；变化，指事物变成不同状态或被作出调整。
换衣服；更换自己所穿的衣物。

formal.mt: It-tibdil fil-programm jagħti lill-parteċipanti aktar ħin għat-tibdil tal-ħwejjeġ qabel l-attività sportiva.
formal.en: The changes to the programme give participants more time to change their clothes before the sporting activity.
formal.zh: 日程的调整让参与者在体育活动前有更多时间更换衣服。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Hemm xi tibdil fil-pjan għal-lejla? Ben: Iva, se niltaqgħu fit-tmienja. Anna: Tajjeb, hekk ikolli ħin għat-tibdil tal-ħwejjeġ wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are there any changes to tonight's plan? Ben: Yes, we're meeting at eight. Anna: Good, that gives me time to change my clothes after work.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今晚的计划有变动吗？本：有，我们改成八点见面。安娜：好，这样我下班后就有时间换衣服了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi tibdil fil-pjan għal-lejla?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi tibdil fil-pjan għal-lejla?
messages.zh: 今晚的计划有变动吗？
messages.en: Are there any changes to tonight's plan?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se niltaqgħu fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se niltaqgħu fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 有，我们改成八点见面。
messages.en: Yes, we're meeting at eight.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, hekk ikolli ħin għat-tibdil tal-ħwejjeġ wara x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, hekk ikolli ħin għat-tibdil tal-ħwejjeġ wara x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 好，这样我下班后就有时间换衣服了。
messages.en: Good, that gives me time to change my clothes after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tibdil 做两张记忆卡：一张画改计划和换衣服，另一张画植物枯萎与身体衰弱；同形义项分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grind a substance until it becomes a powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过研磨把某种物质加工成粉末。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Itħan xi sustanza sakemm issir trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨成粉末；将某物充分研磨，直至成为粉状。

collocations.en: he ground the spices to a powder
he ground the pepper to a powder in a mortar
collocations.zh: 他用研钵把胡椒磨成了粉

formal.mt: Il-kok tibek il-ħwawar f'mehrież sakemm saru trab fin.
formal.en: The cook ground the spices in a mortar until they became a fine powder.
formal.zh: 厨师用研钵研磨香料，直到它们变成细粉。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Min ħejja dan it-trab tal-ħwawar? Adam: Missieri tibek il-ħwawar dalgħodu. Lina: Riħithom tassew tajba!
colloquial.en: Lina: Who prepared this spice powder? Adam: My father ground the spices to a powder this morning. Lina: They smell really good!
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这些香料粉是谁做的？亚当：我爸爸今天早上把香料磨成了粉。莉娜：闻起来真香！

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ħejja dan it-trab tal-ħwawar?
messages.mt_standard: Min ħejja dan it-trab tal-ħwawar?
messages.zh: 这些香料粉是谁做的？
messages.en: Who prepared this spice powder?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri tibek il-ħwawar dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri tibek il-ħwawar dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 我爸爸今天早上把香料磨成了粉。
messages.en: My father ground the spices to a powder this morning.

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Riħithom tassew tajba!
messages.mt_standard: Riħithom tassew tajba!
messages.zh: 闻起来真香！
messages.en: They smell really good!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象研钵里的整粒香料逐渐变成细粉，把 tibek 记成“研磨到成粉”这一完整动作。

gloss_zh: 退化；生活质量或举止的恶化

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deterioration in the quality of someone's life, manners, or similar aspects of their condition or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人的生活质量、礼貌举止等方面逐渐变差或退化的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-kwalità tal-ħajja, l-imġiba jew aspetti simili ta' persuna jmorru għall-agħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: degeneration (of one's quality of life, one's manners, etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 退化；恶化，指生活质量、礼貌举止等方面变差。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tibgħil fil-kwalità tal-ħajja tar-residenti wara t-tnaqqis fis-servizzi.
formal.en: The report describes a deterioration in residents' quality of life after services were reduced.
formal.zh: 报告描述了服务削减后居民生活质量的恶化。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Innutajt it-tibgħil fl-imġiba ta' Karl dan l-aħħar? David: Iva, sar jaqta' kliem kulħadd. Rita: Forsi għandna nitkellmu miegħu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you noticed the deterioration in Karl's behaviour lately? David: Yes, he's started interrupting everyone. Rita: Perhaps we should speak to him calmly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你注意到卡尔最近的举止变差了吗？戴维：注意到了，他现在老是打断别人说话。丽塔：也许我们该心平气和地跟他谈谈。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt it-tibgħil fl-imġiba ta' Karl dan l-aħħar?
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt it-tibgħil fl-imġiba ta' Karl dan l-aħħar?
messages.zh: 你注意到卡尔最近的举止变差了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed the deterioration in Karl's behaviour lately?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sar jaqta' kliem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sar jaqta' kliem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 注意到了，他现在老是打断别人说话。
messages.en: Yes, he's started interrupting everyone.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi għandna nitkellmu miegħu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi għandna nitkellmu miegħu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 也许我们该心平气和地跟他谈谈。
messages.en: Perhaps we should speak to him calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一条向下的箭头记 tibgħil：生活质量下降，或原本礼貌的人举止变差，核心都是逐渐恶化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something white, especially by whitewashing or painting walls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变白的过程，尤指刷白或粉刷墙壁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir bajda, speċjalment billi l-ħitan jinksew bil-ġir jew biż-żebgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变白；增白的过程。
刷白或粉刷墙壁；给墙面涂上石灰或油漆。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tibjid tal-ħitan, għandhom jitnaddfu l-uċuħ u jissewwew ix-xquq.
formal.en: Before whitewashing the walls, the surfaces should be cleaned and the cracks repaired.
formal.zh: 刷白墙壁之前，应清洁墙面并修补裂缝。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta nibdew it-tibjid tal-kamra? Rita: Għada; illum irridu ngħattu l-għamara.
colloquial.en: Mark: When do we start painting the room? Rita: Tomorrow; today we need to cover the furniture.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们什么时候开始粉刷房间？丽塔：明天；今天得先把家具盖好。

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta nibdew it-tibjid tal-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Meta nibdew it-tibjid tal-kamra?
messages.zh: 我们什么时候开始粉刷房间？
messages.en: When do we start painting the room?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada; illum irridu ngħattu l-għamara.
messages.mt_standard: Għada; illum irridu ngħattu l-għamara.
messages.zh: 明天；今天得先把家具盖好。
messages.en: Tomorrow; today we need to cover the furniture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tibjid 时想象滚筒把整面墙刷白：先抓住“使变白”，再联想到常见的墙壁粉刷场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of moving or placing someone or something between one thing and another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入两者之间，或把人、物置于两者之间的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jidħol jew iqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bejn ħaġa u oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 介入或插入的行为；使人或物处于两者之间。

sense_translations.en_definition: act of getting between one thing and another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 进入某一事物与另一事物之间的行为。

collocations.mt: tibjin ta' bord bejn żewġ oġġetti
collocations.en: interposing a board between two objects
collocations.zh: 在两个物体之间插入一块板

formal.mt: It-tibjin ta' bord bejn iż-żewġ oġġetti żammhom milli jmissu ma' xulxin.
formal.en: Interposing a board between the two objects prevented them from touching each other.
formal.zh: 在两个物体之间插入一块板，使它们没有相互接触。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif waqqaft il-ġlieda? Toni: Bit-tibjin bejniethom; dħalt fin-nofs u tlabthom jieqfu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you stop the fight? Toni: By stepping between them; I got in the middle and asked them to stop.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么制止那场打斗的？托尼：站到他们之间；我走到中间，叫他们停下来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif waqqaft il-ġlieda?
messages.mt_standard: Kif waqqaft il-ġlieda?
messages.zh: 你怎么制止那场打斗的？
messages.en: How did you stop the fight?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-tibjin bejniethom; dħalt fin-nofs u tlabthom jieqfu.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-tibjin bejniethom; dħalt fin-nofs u tlabthom jieqfu.
messages.zh: 站到他们之间；我走到中间，叫他们停下来。
messages.en: By stepping between them; I got in the middle and asked them to stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibjin 画成“A—板—B”：中间多了一个人或物，就能记住“介入、插到两者之间”的共同意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The making of holes in soil for sowing seeds, or the watering of seeds to encourage germination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为播种而在土中挖穴，或为促进种子发芽而给种子浇水的作业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' ħofor fil-ħamrija għaż-żrigħ, jew it-tisqija taż-żrieragħ biex jinbtu.

sense_translations.en_definition: the making of holes in the soil for sowing seeds
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为播种而在土壤中挖出小穴的作业。

sense_translations.en_definition: the watering of seeds to cause germination
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为促使种子发芽而给种子浇水的作业。

collocations.en: making holes in the soil for sowing
watering seeds to make them germinate
collocations.zh: 给种子浇水以促其发芽

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, it-tibjit jirreferi għall-għemil ta' ħofor żgħar fil-ħamrija biex fihom jitqiegħdu ż-żrieragħ.
formal.en: In this lesson, tibjit refers to making small holes in the soil in which seeds are placed.
formal.zh: 本课中，tibjit 指在土壤中挖出供放入种子的小穴。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Hawnhekk tibjit ifisser li nagħmlu l-ħofor? Ġużeppi: Le, hawnhekk ifisser li nsaqqu ż-żrieragħ biex jinbtu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does tibjit mean making the holes here? Ġużeppi: No, here it means watering the seeds so they germinate.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这里的 tibjit 是指挖播种穴吗？朱塞佩：不是，这里指给种子浇水，让它们发芽。

messages.speaker: Anna (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk tibjit ifisser li nagħmlu l-ħofor?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk tibjit ifisser li nagħmlu l-ħofor?
messages.zh: 这里的 tibjit 是指挖播种穴吗？
messages.en: Does tibjit mean making the holes here?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园艺教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawnhekk ifisser li nsaqqu ż-żrieragħ biex jinbtu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawnhekk ifisser li nsaqqu ż-żrieragħ biex jinbtu.
messages.zh: 不是，这里指给种子浇水，让它们发芽。
messages.en: No, here it means watering the seeds so they germinate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“挖穴放种、浇水催芽”两幅画记 tibjit；它有这两个农业义项，阅读时要由上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of grinding, or a speck or very small quantity of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次研磨的动作；也可指某物的一点点或极少量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' tħin, jew farka jew kwantità żgħira ħafna ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次研磨或磨碎的动作。
一点点；微粒或少量的东西。

collocations.en: an act of grinding at the mill
collocations.zh: 在磨坊里进行的一次研磨

formal.mt: Il-kelma tibka tista' tindika att ta' tħin jew kwantità żgħira ħafna, skont il-kuntest.
formal.en: The word tibka can indicate an act of grinding or a very small quantity, depending on the context.
formal.zh: 根据上下文，tibka 可以表示一次研磨，也可以表示极少量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm inżid melħ fis-soppa? Ninu: Tibka biss; imbagħad erġa' duqha.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much salt should I add to the soup? Ninu: Just a tiny amount; then taste it again.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：汤里该加多少盐？尼努：只加一点点，然后再尝尝。

messages.speaker: Lara (做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm inżid melħ fis-soppa?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm inżid melħ fis-soppa?
messages.zh: 汤里该加多少盐？
messages.en: How much salt should I add to the soup?

messages.speaker: Ninu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tibka biss; imbagħad erġa' duqha.
messages.mt_standard: Tibka biss; imbagħad erġa' duqha.
messages.zh: 只加一点点，然后再尝尝。
messages.en: Just a tiny amount; then taste it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tibka 做一张双面卡：一面画磨坊的一次研磨，另一面画指尖的一点盐；分开记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 使人惊愕无言；使人目瞪口呆

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or effect of astonishing someone so much that they are left speechless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人惊讶到说不出话来的行为或效果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-effett li tħalli lil xi ħadd tant mistagħġeb li jibqa' bla kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人惊愕得说不出话来；使人目瞪口呆。

collocations.zh: 使听众惊讶得说不出话

formal.mt: L-effett tat-tħabbira kien it-tibkim tal-udjenza: għal ftit sekondi ħadd ma qal kelma.
formal.en: The announcement left the audience dumbfounded: for a few seconds, nobody said a word.
formal.zh: 这则宣布使观众惊愕无言：有几秒钟，谁都没有说话。

colloquial.mt: David: Għaliex kulħadd baqa' bla kliem? Elena: Dak kien l-effett tat-tibkim; ħadd ma stenna dik l-aħbar.
colloquial.en: David: Why was everyone speechless? Elena: That was the effect of being dumbfounded; nobody expected that news.
colloquial.zh: 戴维：为什么大家都说不出话了？埃莱娜：那是惊愕无言的反应；谁都没料到那个消息。

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd baqa' bla kliem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd baqa' bla kliem?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都说不出话了？
messages.en: Why was everyone speechless?

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kien l-effett tat-tibkim; ħadd ma stenna dik l-aħbar.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kien l-effett tat-tibkim; ħadd ma stenna dik l-aħbar.
messages.zh: 那是惊愕无言的反应；谁都没料到那个消息。
messages.en: That was the effect of being dumbfounded; nobody expected that news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibkim 联想成“消息一出，全场张嘴无言”的画面，重点记住惊讶强烈到暂时说不出话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Waking up early, or causing another person to wake up early.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己很早醒来，或使别人很早醒来的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed iqum kmieni jew li jqajjem lil xi ħadd kmieni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早醒；早起。

sense_translations.en_definition: causing sb to wake up early
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人很早醒来；提早叫醒某人。

formal.mt: It-tibkir ta' kuljum jagħti lill-bidwi aktar ħin għax-xogħol qabel is-sħana.
formal.en: Waking up early every day gives the farmer more time to work before the heat.
formal.zh: 每天早起使农民能在天气变热之前有更多时间干活。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kif sejjer bit-tibkir għax-xogħol il-ġdid? Marija: Qed nidra; issa nqum fis-sitta mingħajr problema.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: How are you getting on with waking up early for the new job? Marija: I'm getting used to it; now I get up at six without a problem.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：为了新工作早起，你适应得怎么样？玛丽娅：正在习惯；现在六点起床已经没问题了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer bit-tibkir għax-xogħol il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer bit-tibkir għax-xogħol il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 为了新工作早起，你适应得怎么样？
messages.en: How are you getting on with waking up early for the new job?

messages.speaker: Marija (刚换工作的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nidra; issa nqum fis-sitta mingħajr problema.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nidra; issa nqum fis-sitta mingħajr problema.
messages.zh: 正在习惯；现在六点起床已经没问题了。
messages.en: I'm getting used to it; now I get up at six without a problem.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用清晨六点的闹钟记 tibkir：自己醒来是“早起”，把别人叫起来是“使人早醒”，两个义项都抓住“早”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of beating or hitting a person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或物进行殴打、击打的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħti daqqiet lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 殴打；接连施加打击的行为。
击打；用手或物体打击人或物的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tibkit ripetut tal-vittma u l-ġrieħi li ġarrbet.
formal.en: The report describes the repeated beating of the victim and the injuries the victim sustained.
formal.zh: 报告描述了受害者遭到反复殴打的过程及其所受的伤。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'kien dak it-tibkit fuq il-mejda? Mark: Kont qed nagħti daqqiet b'idi; ħsibt li ma kontx qed tismagħni.
colloquial.en: Rita: What was that banging on the table? Mark: I was hitting it with my hand; I thought you couldn't hear me.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：刚才怎么有人在拍桌子？马克：是我用手拍的；我以为你听不见我说话。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak it-tibkit fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak it-tibkit fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 刚才怎么有人在拍桌子？
messages.en: What was that banging on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed nagħti daqqiet b'idi; ħsibt li ma kontx qed tismagħni.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed nagħti daqqiet b'idi; ħsibt li ma kontx qed tismagħni.
messages.zh: 是我用手拍的；我以为你听不见我说话。
messages.en: I was hitting it with my hand; I thought you couldn't hear me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibkit 配上“手落下、发出击打声”的动作卡，记住核心是击打；对象是人时可表示殴打。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of moving food, drink, or another substance from the mouth down the throat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物、饮料或其他物质从口中咽下的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgħaddi ikel, xorb jew sustanza oħra mill-ħalq għal ġol-gerżuma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吞咽；把口中的东西咽下的动作。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega r-rwol tal-ilsien fit-tibligħ tal-ikel.
formal.en: The chapter explains the role of the tongue in swallowing food.
formal.zh: 本章解释舌头在吞咽食物时的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tibligħ? Lara: Meta tgħaddi l-ikel minn ħalqek għal ġol-gerżuma; dak huwa t-tibligħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tibligħ mean? Lara: When you move food from your mouth down your throat; that is swallowing.
colloquial.zh: Maja：tibligħ 是什么意思？Lara：就是把食物从嘴里咽到喉咙里；这就是吞咽。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tibligħ?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tibligħ?
messages.zh: tibligħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tibligħ mean?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħaddi l-ikel minn ħalqek għal ġol-gerżuma; dak huwa t-tibligħ.
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħaddi l-ikel minn ħalqek għal ġol-gerżuma; dak huwa t-tibligħ.
messages.zh: 就是把食物从嘴里咽到喉咙里；这就是吞咽。
messages.en: When you move food from your mouth down your throat; that is swallowing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibligħ 配上喝水后咽下的画面，记住它表示“吞咽这个动作”；特别看清词尾 għ，避免与相近拼写混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of fooling someone by making them believe something that is not true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过使别人相信不真实的事情来愚弄或蒙骗对方的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqarraq b'xi ħadd billi ġġiegħlu jemmen xi ħaġa li mhix vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愚弄；使别人信以为真的蒙骗行为。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddistingwi bejn ċajta li tiddeverti lil kulħadd u t-tiblih ta' persuna li ma tafx bil-pjan.
formal.en: The author distinguishes between a joke that amuses everyone and fooling a person who does not know about the plan.
formal.zh: 作者区分了让大家都开心的玩笑与蒙骗不知情者的行为。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għedtlu li rbaħt karozza, u emminni! Sara: Dan tiblih. Għidlu li kienet ċajta.
colloquial.en: Mark: I told him I had won a car, and he believed me! Sara: That is fooling him. Tell him it was a joke.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我告诉他我赢了一辆汽车，他居然信了！Sara：这是在愚弄他。告诉他那是个玩笑。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtlu li rbaħt karozza, u emminni!
messages.mt_standard: Għedtlu li rbaħt karozza, u emminni!
messages.zh: 我告诉他我赢了一辆汽车，他居然信了！
messages.en: I told him I had won a car, and he believed me!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan tiblih. Għidlu li kienet ċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Dan tiblih. Għidlu li kienet ċajta.
messages.zh: 这是在愚弄他。告诉他那是个玩笑。
messages.en: That is fooling him. Tell him it was a joke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友把编造的故事当真，用这个场景记住 tiblih 的“愚弄”；拼写末尾是 h，不要与表示吞咽的 tibligħ 混记。

gloss_zh: 显露成熟迹象；呈现熟相

teaching_sense.en_definition: The appearance of signs showing that fruit or other produce is becoming ripe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 果实或其他农产品开始显露成熟迹象的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dehra ta' sinjali li juru li l-frott jew prodotti oħra tal-għalqa qegħdin jimmaturaw.

sense_translations.en_definition: display of the signs of ripeness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 显露成熟迹象；呈现出正在成熟的表征。

collocations.en: the appearance of signs of ripeness in fruit
the appearance of signs of ripeness in tomatoes

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tibliq tat-tadam u rreġistraw il-bidliet fil-kulur.
formal.en: The students observed the appearance of signs of ripeness in the tomatoes and recorded the changes in colour.
formal.zh: 学生们观察番茄显露成熟迹象的情况，并记录颜色变化。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara, it-tadam beda jsir aħmar! Pawlu: Iva, dan it-tibliq juri li qiegħed jimmatura.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look, the tomatoes have started turning red! Pawlu: Yes, these emerging signs of ripeness show that they are ripening.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看，番茄开始变红了！Pawlu：对，这些显露出来的熟相说明它们正在成熟。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, it-tadam beda jsir aħmar!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, it-tadam beda jsir aħmar!
messages.zh: 看，番茄开始变红了！
messages.en: Look, the tomatoes have started turning red!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan it-tibliq juri li qiegħed jimmatura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan it-tibliq juri li qiegħed jimmatura.
messages.zh: 对，这些显露出来的熟相说明它们正在成熟。
messages.en: Yes, these emerging signs of ripeness show that they are ripening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用青番茄逐渐泛红的连续画面记 tibliq：重点是“成熟迹象显现”，不要直接把它等同于已经完全成熟。

gloss_zh: 使具有天鹅绒般质感的加工

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving a material or surface a soft texture like velvet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使材料或表面获得天鹅绒般柔软质感的处理过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħti lil materjal jew wiċċ tessut artab bħal dak tal-bellus.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of giving sth. a velvety texture
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物具有天鹅绒般质感的加工或处理。

collocations.zh: 使布料具有天鹅绒般质感

collocations.en: the process of creating a velvety texture
collocations.zh: 形成天鹅绒般质感的加工过程

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tispjega t-tiblis bħala proċess li jagħti lid-drapp tessut bħal tal-bellus.
formal.en: The lesson explains tiblis as a process that gives fabric a texture like velvet.
formal.zh: 本课将 tiblis 解释为使布料获得天鹅绒般质感的加工过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan id-drapp jinħass bħal bellus? Toni: Minħabba t-tiblis; il-proċess jagħtih dak it-tessut.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does this fabric feel like velvet? Toni: Because of the treatment that gives it a velvety texture; the process gives it that feel.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么这块布摸起来像天鹅绒？Toni：因为做了赋予绒感的处理；这个加工过程让它有了这种质感。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan id-drapp jinħass bħal bellus?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan id-drapp jinħass bħal bellus?
messages.zh: 为什么这块布摸起来像天鹅绒？
messages.en: Why does this fabric feel like velvet?

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tiblis; il-proċess jagħtih dak it-tessut.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tiblis; il-proċess jagħtih dak it-tessut.
messages.zh: 因为做了赋予绒感的处理；这个加工过程让它有了这种质感。
messages.en: Because of the treatment that gives it a velvety texture; the process gives it that feel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指摸过处理前后的布面，处理后出现天鹅绒般触感；把“赋予这种触感的过程”连到 tiblis。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dry stalk of a cereal plant, considered as straw.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谷类植物的干茎秆，即用作铺垫等用途的麦秆或秸秆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Zokk niexef ta' pjanta taċ-ċereali, bħal qamħ, li jista' jintuża bħala friex għall-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麦秆；谷类植物的干秸秆。

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju ta' osservazzjoni, kull student poġġa tibna fuq karta bajda u kejjel it-tul tagħha.
formal.en: For the observation exercise, each student placed a piece of straw on white paper and measured its length.
formal.zh: 在观察练习中，每位学生把一根秸秆放在白纸上，并测量它的长度。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Għandek tibna fuq il-kmiem. Maja: Din? Grazzi, issa nneħħiha.
colloquial.en: Ben: You have a piece of straw on your sleeve. Maja: This one? Thanks, I'll take it off now.
colloquial.zh: Ben：你的袖子上有一根秸秆。Maja：这根吗？谢谢，我现在把它拿掉。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek tibna fuq il-kmiem.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek tibna fuq il-kmiem.
messages.zh: 你的袖子上有一根秸秆。
messages.en: You have a piece of straw on your sleeve.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din? Grazzi, issa nneħħiha.
messages.mt_standard: Din? Grazzi, issa nneħħiha.
messages.zh: 这根吗？谢谢，我现在把它拿掉。
messages.en: This one? Thanks, I'll take it off now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibna 写在一根金黄色干麦秆的图旁，记住这里的 straw 是植物秸秆；可连着 tibna niexfa“一根干秸秆”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of adopting a child into a family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将儿童收养为家庭成员的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih tifel jew tifla jsiru parti minn familja permezz tal-adozzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 儿童收养；将儿童收养为家庭成员。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa ta' informazzjoni se tiddiskuti t-tibnija u l-ħtiġijiet tat-tfal u tal-familji.
formal.en: The information meeting will discuss child adoption and the needs of children and families.
formal.zh: 说明会将讨论儿童收养，以及儿童和家庭的需要。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għal xiex sejra l-laqgħa llejla? Rita: Se nitkellmu dwar it-tibnija u kif familja tista' tilqa' tifel jew tifla.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you going to the meeting for tonight? Rita: We are going to talk about child adoption and how a family can welcome a boy or girl.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今晚去参加什么内容的会议？Rita：我们会谈儿童收养，以及家庭如何迎接一个男孩或女孩。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex sejra l-laqgħa llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex sejra l-laqgħa llejla?
messages.zh: 你今晚去参加什么内容的会议？
messages.en: What are you going to the meeting for tonight?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nitkellmu dwar it-tibnija u kif familja tista' tilqa' tifel jew tifla.
messages.mt_standard: Se nitkellmu dwar it-tibnija u kif familja tista' tilqa' tifel jew tifla.
messages.zh: 我们会谈儿童收养，以及家庭如何迎接一个男孩或女孩。
messages.en: We are going to talk about child adoption and how a family can welcome a boy or girl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用家庭迎接孩子成为家人的温暖场景记 tibnija“儿童收养”；学习时与较短的 tibna“秸秆”分开制作词卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of food becoming tasty or developing a more pleasant flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物变得可口、滋味逐渐变好的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-ikel isir bnin jew it-togħma tiegħu ssir aktar pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得可口；此处用名词表示食物滋味变好的过程。

collocations.en: the sauce developing a pleasant flavour

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti jiddeskrivu t-tibnin taz-zalza billi jqabblu t-togħma tagħha f'ħinijiet differenti.
formal.en: In the exercise, the students describe the sauce becoming tastier by comparing its flavour at different times.
formal.zh: 练习中，学生通过比较酱汁在不同时刻的味道，描述它逐渐变得可口的过程。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Iz-zalza issa għandha togħma aħjar. Nina: Iva, dan hu t-tibnin li konna qed nistennew!
colloquial.en: Mark: The sauce tastes better now. Nina: Yes, this is the improvement in flavour we were waiting for!
colloquial.zh: Mark：酱汁现在味道更好了。Nina：对，这就是我们一直期待的滋味变好！

messages.speaker: Mark (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-zalza issa għandha togħma aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iz-zalza issa għandha togħma aħjar.
messages.zh: 酱汁现在味道更好了。
messages.en: The sauce tastes better now.

messages.speaker: Nina (烹饪老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan hu t-tibnin li konna qed nistennew!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan hu t-tibnin li konna qed nistennew!
messages.zh: 对，这就是我们一直期待的滋味变好！
messages.en: Yes, this is the improvement in flavour we were waiting for!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先尝一口、稍后再尝一口，第二次更可口；把这段“滋味变好”的过程记作名词 tibnin，注意中间有两个 n。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a plant produces or develops a stem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物产生或长出茎的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih pjanta tipproduċi jew tiżviluppa zokk.

sense_translations.en_definition: the production of a stem (used of plants)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 长茎；产生茎的过程，用于植物。

collocations.en: the plant's production of a stem

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tibnit tal-pjanta u pinġew iz-zokk il-ġdid fid-djarju tagħhom.
formal.en: The students observed the plant's development of a stem and drew the new stem in their journals.
formal.zh: 学生们观察植物长茎的过程，并在记录本中画出新长的茎。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, ħareġ zokk ġdid! Ben: Iva, illum nistgħu nieħdu ritratt tat-tibnit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, a new stem has appeared! Ben: Yes, today we can take a photograph of the stem development.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看，长出一根新茎了！Ben：对，今天我们可以拍照记录长茎的情况。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, ħareġ zokk ġdid!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, ħareġ zokk ġdid!
messages.zh: 看，长出一根新茎了！
messages.en: Look, a new stem has appeared!

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum nistgħu nieħdu ritratt tat-tibnit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum nistgħu nieħdu ritratt tat-tibnit.
messages.zh: 对，今天我们可以拍照记录长茎的情况。
messages.en: Yes, today we can take a photograph of the stem development.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibnit 配上植物新茎向上长出的图，专记“长茎这个过程”；与 tibnin 对照时，用植物图和食物图区分词尾 t 与 n。

gloss_zh: 虫害；跳蚤、虱子等小害虫的侵扰

teaching_sense.en_definition: An infestation by small vermin, especially fleas or lice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 跳蚤、虱子等小害虫大量滋生并造成侵扰的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infestazzjoni b'parassiti żgħar, speċjalment briegħed jew qamel.

sense_translations.en_definition: an infestation of vermin (especially small bugs such as fleas or lice)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 害虫侵扰，尤其指跳蚤、虱子等小虫造成的虫害。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tibqiq bil-briegħed fil-kamra fejn kienu jinżammu l-annimali.
formal.en: The report describes a flea infestation in the room where the animals were kept.
formal.zh: 报告描述了饲养动物的房间内出现的跳蚤侵扰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed inaddfu din il-kamra kollha? Mark: Sibna tibqiq bil-briegħed ħdejn is-sodda tal-kelb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we cleaning this whole room? Mark: We found a flea infestation near the dog's bed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么要清理整个房间？马克：我们在狗窝旁发现了跳蚤侵扰。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed inaddfu din il-kamra kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed inaddfu din il-kamra kollha?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要清理整个房间？
messages.en: Why are we cleaning this whole room?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibna tibqiq bil-briegħed ħdejn is-sodda tal-kelb.
messages.mt_standard: Sibna tibqiq bil-briegħed ħdejn is-sodda tal-kelb.
messages.zh: 我们在狗窝旁发现了跳蚤侵扰。
messages.en: We found a flea infestation near the dog's bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibqiq 配上狗窝旁跳蚤成群的画面，记住它指虫害侵扰，而不是单独一只小虫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The raising of cattle intended for slaughter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以屠宰为目的饲养牛的畜牧活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trobbija tal-baqar għall-qatla.

sense_translations.en_definition: the raising of bovine animals for slaughter
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为供屠宰而饲养牛类动物。

collocations.en: a farm raising cattle for slaughter

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-ispejjeż tat-tibqir fuq irziezet żgħar.
formal.en: The study examines the costs of raising cattle for slaughter on small farms.
formal.zh: 该研究考察了小型农场饲养屠宰用牛的成本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ir-razzett jipproduċi l-ħalib? Pawlu: Le, hawn jagħmlu t-tibqir; irabbu l-baqar għall-qatla.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this farm produce milk? Pawlu: No, they raise cattle for slaughter here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个农场生产牛奶吗？保罗：不，这里饲养的是供屠宰的牛。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-razzett jipproduċi l-ħalib?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-razzett jipproduċi l-ħalib?
messages.zh: 这个农场生产牛奶吗？
messages.en: Does this farm produce milk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn jagħmlu t-tibqir; irabbu l-baqar għall-qatla.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn jagħmlu t-tibqir; irabbu l-baqar għall-qatla.
messages.zh: 不，这里饲养的是供屠宰的牛。
messages.en: No, they raise cattle for slaughter here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“养牛供屠宰”的农场画面记 tibqir，把饲养过程和最终用途一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process in which milk forms curds instead of remaining a smooth liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牛奶由均匀液体形成凝块的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih il-ħalib jagħqad u jifforma biċċiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛奶的凝结或凝乳过程。

formal.mt: L-esperiment juri t-tibqit tal-ħalib wara ż-żieda tal-meraq tal-lumi.
formal.en: The experiment demonstrates the curdling of milk after lemon juice is added.
formal.zh: 该实验展示了加入柠檬汁后牛奶的凝结过程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-ħalib sar biċċiet wara li żidt il-lumi? Marija: Dak hu t-tibqit tal-ħalib.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did the milk form lumps after I added the lemon? Marija: That's the milk curdling.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么我加了柠檬以后牛奶就结块了？玛丽亚：那就是牛奶凝结。

messages.speaker: Nina (烹饪学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħalib sar biċċiet wara li żidt il-lumi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħalib sar biċċiet wara li żidt il-lumi?
messages.zh: 为什么我加了柠檬以后牛奶就结块了？
messages.en: Why did the milk form lumps after I added the lemon?

messages.speaker: Marija (烹饪老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu t-tibqit tal-ħalib.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu t-tibqit tal-ħalib.
messages.zh: 那就是牛奶凝结。
messages.en: That's the milk curdling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象柠檬汁滴入牛奶后出现小凝块，用这个变化过程记住 tibqit 的“凝乳”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Filing material with a file, polishing a surface, or reducing something's temperature, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境指用锉刀锉削材料、抛光表面，或使物体温度降低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont il-kuntest, xogħol bil-lima, illustrar ta' wiċċ, jew tnaqqis fit-temperatura ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锉削；用锉刀去除材料或修整表面。
抛光；使表面更加光滑或有光泽。
冷却；使温度降低的过程。

collocations.en: polishing to give the surface a shine
collocations.zh: 使表面产生光泽的抛光

formal.mt: Is-sistema tat-tibrid tnaqqas it-temperatura tal-magna waqt it-tħaddim.
formal.en: The cooling system reduces the engine's temperature during operation.
formal.zh: 冷却系统在发动机运行时降低其温度。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-tarf għadu jaqta'. Rita: Jeħtieġ ftit tibrid bil-lima biex isir lixx.
colloquial.en: Mark: This edge is still sharp. Rita: It needs a little filing to make it smooth.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条边还是很锋利。丽塔：需要用锉刀稍微锉一下，让它变光滑。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tarf għadu jaqta'.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tarf għadu jaqta'.
messages.zh: 这条边还是很锋利。
messages.en: This edge is still sharp.

messages.speaker: Rita (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Jeħtieġ ftit tibrid bil-lima biex isir lixx.
messages.mt_standard: Jeħtieġ ftit tibrid bil-lima biex isir lixx.
messages.zh: 需要用锉刀稍微锉一下，让它变光滑。
messages.en: It needs a little filing to make it smooth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tibrid 画三张语境卡：锉刀代表锉削，亮面代表抛光，温度计下降代表冷却；读句子时先看场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of lying down or taking a lying position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体放低而躺下，或采取躺卧姿势的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jimtedd jew jieħu pożizzjoni mimduda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躺下；采取躺卧姿势。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jibda bit-tibrik fuq l-art, bl-idejn maġenb il-ġisem.
formal.en: The exercise begins with lying down on the floor, with the hands beside the body.
formal.zh: 练习开始时先躺在地板上，双手放在身体两侧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-ewwel noqogħdu bilqiegħda? Rita: Le, nibdew bit-tibrik fuq it-tapit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do we sit down first? Rita: No, we start by lying down on the mat.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们先坐下吗？丽塔：不，我们先躺到垫子上。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel noqogħdu bilqiegħda?
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel noqogħdu bilqiegħda?
messages.zh: 我们先坐下吗？
messages.en: Do we sit down first?

messages.speaker: Rita (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nibdew bit-tibrik fuq it-tapit.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nibdew bit-tibrik fuq it-tapit.
messages.zh: 不，我们先躺到垫子上。
messages.en: No, we start by lying down on the mat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象练习开始时身体缓缓放低、躺到垫子上，用这个姿势变化记住 tibrik。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of twisting something, such as a thread or cord.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把线、绳等物体扭转或捻拧的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddawwar ħaġa fuqha nfisha, bħal ħajta jew ħabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭转、捻拧的动作。

formal.mt: It-tibrim taż-żewġ ħjut flimkien joħloq korda waħda.
formal.en: Twisting the two threads together creates a single cord.
formal.zh: 把两根线捻在一起，可以形成一根绳线。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif ngħaqqad dawn iż-żewġ ħjut? Sara: Bit-tibrim; dawwarhom flimkien bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Mark: How do I join these two threads? Sara: By twisting them; turn them together slowly.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我怎么把这两根线合在一起？萨拉：把它们捻起来，慢慢地一起拧。

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ngħaqqad dawn iż-żewġ ħjut?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ngħaqqad dawn iż-żewġ ħjut?
messages.zh: 我怎么把这两根线合在一起？
messages.en: How do I join these two threads?

messages.speaker: Sara (手工课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-tibrim; dawwarhom flimkien bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-tibrim; dawwarhom flimkien bil-mod.
messages.zh: 把它们捻起来，慢慢地一起拧。
messages.en: By twisting them; turn them together slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手指捻两根线的动作记 tibrim：一边转、一边合，让“扭转、捻拧”的含义变成动作记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making a hole with a gimlet, a small hand tool for boring holes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用小型手动钻孔工具钻出孔洞的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel toqba b'għodda żgħira tal-idejn għat-tħaffir.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of boring with a gimlet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用小手钻钻孔的动作。

collocations.en: boring into wood with a gimlet
collocations.zh: 用小手钻在木头上钻孔

collocations.en: boring a small hole with a gimlet

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliem wera t-tibrin ta' toqba żgħira f'biċċa injam.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher demonstrated boring a small hole in a piece of wood with a gimlet.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师演示了如何用小手钻在一块木头上钻一个小孔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu t-tibrin? Pawlu: Meta tagħmel toqba b'din l-għodda żgħira tal-idejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is tibrin? Pawlu: It is when you make a hole with this small hand tool.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：tibrin 是什么意思？保罗：就是用这种小型手动工具钻孔。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu t-tibrin?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu t-tibrin?
messages.zh: tibrin 是什么意思？
messages.en: What is tibrin?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tagħmel toqba b'din l-għodda żgħira tal-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: Meta tagħmel toqba b'din l-għodda żgħira tal-idejn.
messages.zh: 就是用这种小型手动工具钻孔。
