messages.en: It is when you make a hole with this small hand tool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibrin 配上“小手钻转动、木板出现小孔”的画面，记住它指钻孔这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The shining of an intense light or the appearance of brief flashes of light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光线强烈照耀，或短暂闪现光亮的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dija qawwija tad-dawl jew id-dehra ta' dawl li jteptep għal waqtiet qosra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈发光；光芒耀眼地照耀。
闪光；光亮短暂地闪现。

formal.mt: It-tibriq tad-dwal kien jidher mill-bogħod fid-dlam tal-lejl.
formal.en: The flashing of the lights could be seen from far away in the darkness of the night.
formal.zh: 夜色中，从远处也能看见灯光的闪烁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara t-tibriq tad-dwal hemm fuq? Mark: Iva, jidhru sew anke minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see the flashing lights up there? Mark: Yes, they are clearly visible even from here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看见上面那些闪烁的灯光了吗？马克：看见了，就连在这里也看得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara t-tibriq tad-dwal hemm fuq?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara t-tibriq tad-dwal hemm fuq?
messages.zh: 你看见上面那些闪烁的灯光了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the flashing lights up there?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidhru sew anke minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidhru sew anke minn hawn.
messages.zh: 看见了，就连在这里也看得很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, they are clearly visible even from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tibriq 画两幅光景：太阳耀眼地照着、灯光一下下闪着，分别记住强光与闪光两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of scratching a surface or the skin with nails, claws, or another object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用指甲、爪子或其他物体抓挠皮肤或刮擦表面的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li togħrok jew tagħmel marki fuq il-ġilda jew fuq wiċċ ieħor bid-dwiefer jew b'oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓挠或刮擦的动作。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni nstema' ħoss ta' tibrix meta l-qattus mess il-bieb bid-dwiefer.
formal.en: A scratching sound was heard in the recording when the cat touched the door with its claws.
formal.zh: 录音中，猫用爪子碰门时传出了刮擦声。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak il-ħoss ta' tibrix? Samwel: Il-qattus qed jobrox il-bieb biex jidħol.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is that scratching sound? Samwel: The cat is scratching the door to get in.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那是什么抓挠声？萨姆韦尔：猫正在挠门，想进来。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss ta' tibrix?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss ta' tibrix?
messages.zh: 那是什么抓挠声？
messages.en: What is that scratching sound?

messages.speaker: Samwel (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus qed jobrox il-bieb biex jidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus qed jobrox il-bieb biex jidħol.
messages.zh: 猫正在挠门，想进来。
messages.en: The cat is scratching the door to get in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tibrix 时想象猫爪挠门发出的沙沙声，把词与反复抓挠、刮擦的动作连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting things together in a pile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品放到一起形成一堆的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqiegħed affarijiet fuq xulxin biex tifforma munzell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将东西堆在一起或堆叠起来的动作。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tax-xogħol jinkludi t-tibriġ tal-ġebel f'rokna tal-bitħa.
formal.en: The work plan includes piling up the stones in a corner of the yard.
formal.zh: 工作计划包括把石块堆放到院子的一个角落。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għad fadal ħafna xogħol fil-bitħa? Ġanni: It-tibriġ tal-injam biss, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there much work left in the yard? Ġanni: Just piling up the wood, then we'll be done.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：院子里还剩很多活吗？詹尼：只剩把木材堆起来，之后就做完了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal ħafna xogħol fil-bitħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal ħafna xogħol fil-bitħa?
messages.zh: 院子里还剩很多活吗？
messages.en: Is there much work left in the yard?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tibriġ tal-injam biss, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
messages.mt_standard: It-tibriġ tal-injam biss, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
messages.zh: 只剩把木材堆起来，之后就做完了。
messages.en: Just piling up the wood, then we'll be done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块块石头逐渐堆成小山，用正在堆放的动作记 tibriġ，重点记过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of opening windows to let fresh air into an indoor space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打开窗户，让新鲜空气进入室内的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ftuħ tat-twieqi biex tidħol arja friska ġewwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: opening windows to let in air
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打开窗户让空气进入；开窗通风。

collocations.en: airing the room by opening the windows
airing the house by opening the windows

formal.mt: Ir-rutina ta' filgħodu tinkludi t-tibriħ tal-klassijiet qabel il-wasla tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The morning routine includes airing the classrooms by opening the windows before the students arrive.
formal.zh: 早晨的例行工作包括在学生到达之前打开教室窗户通风。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ftaħt it-twieqi kollha? Lara: Għat-tibriħ tal-kamra; hawn bżonn ftit arja friska.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you open all the windows? Lara: To air the room; we need some fresh air in here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把所有窗户都打开了？拉拉：给房间通通风，这里需要一点新鲜空气。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ftaħt it-twieqi kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ftaħt it-twieqi kollha?
messages.zh: 你为什么把所有窗户都打开了？
messages.en: Why did you open all the windows?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tibriħ tal-kamra; hawn bżonn ftit arja friska.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tibriħ tal-kamra; hawn bżonn ftit arja friska.
messages.zh: 给房间通通风，这里需要一点新鲜空气。
messages.en: To air the room; we need some fresh air in here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“打开窗户，空气进屋”的连续画面记 tibriħ，把开窗动作与通风目的一起联想。

gloss_zh: 逗人微笑；使人露出笑容

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of causing someone to smile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人微笑或露出笑容的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitbissem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人微笑、逗某人露出笑容的行为。

formal.mt: L-għan tal-attività kien it-tibsim tat-tfal permezz ta' stejjer qosra u umoristiċi.
formal.en: The aim of the activity was to make the children smile through short, humorous stories.
formal.zh: 这项活动旨在通过简短有趣的故事，让孩子们露出笑容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tibsim? Rita: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitbissem, bħal meta tgħid ċajta ħelwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tibsim mean? Rita: Making someone smile, like when you tell a gentle joke.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：tibsim 是什么意思？丽塔：就是让别人微笑，比如讲个温和有趣的笑话。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tibsim?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tibsim?
messages.zh: tibsim 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tibsim mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitbissem, bħal meta tgħid ċajta ħelwa.
messages.mt_standard: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitbissem, bħal meta tgħid ċajta ħelwa.
messages.zh: 就是让别人微笑，比如讲个温和有趣的笑话。
messages.en: Making someone smile, like when you tell a gentle joke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tibsim 时画一条小箭头：你讲趣事，箭头指向对方扬起的嘴角，突出“使别人微笑”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of predicting what will happen, guessing something uncertain, or foretelling future events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预测将发生的事情、猜测尚不确定的内容，或预言未来事件的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tbassar x'se jiġri, taqta' xi ħaġa li mhix magħrufa, jew tħabbar ġrajjiet tal-futur minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预测；对将发生的事情作出判断。
猜测；在不能确定的情况下推测答案或情况。
预言；预先说出未来会发生的事情。

formal.mt: It-tibsir tar-riżultat sar qabel ma nġabret l-informazzjoni kollha.
formal.en: The prediction of the result was made before all the information had been collected.
formal.zh: 在全部信息收集齐全之前，就已经对结果作出了预测。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Taħseb li se nirbħu? Lara: Forsi, imma dan hu biss tibsir; il-logħba għadha ma bdietx.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you think we will win? Lara: Maybe, but that is only a guess; the game has not started yet.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得我们会赢吗？拉拉：也许吧，不过这只是猜测，比赛还没开始呢。

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li se nirbħu?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li se nirbħu?
messages.zh: 你觉得我们会赢吗？
messages.en: Do you think we will win?

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi, imma dan hu biss tibsir; il-logħba għadha ma bdietx.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi, imma dan hu biss tibsir; il-logħba għadha ma bdietx.
messages.zh: 也许吧，不过这只是猜测，比赛还没开始呢。
messages.en: Maybe, but that is only a guess; the game has not started yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibsir 放在尚未揭晓的答案旁：天气可预测，谜底可猜测，未来可预言，三义分别记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of releasing intestinal gas through the anus; breaking wind or farting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肠道气体经肛门排出的行为，即放屁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li toħroġ gass mill-imsaren minn ġol-anus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排出肠道气体；较委婉地说“放屁”。
放屁；肠道气体从肛门排出。

formal.mt: Fil-kwestjonarju, il-parteċipanti ġew mistoqsija jekk kinux innutaw tibsis frekwenti wara l-ikel.
formal.en: In the questionnaire, participants were asked whether they had noticed frequent breaking of wind after meals.
formal.zh: 问卷询问参与者是否注意到自己饭后经常排气。

colloquial.mt: Ben: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Anna: Ħoss ta' tibsis, naħseb. Ejja ma nidħkux bih.
colloquial.en: Ben: What was that sound? Anna: Someone farting, I think. Let's not laugh at him.
colloquial.zh: 本：刚才那是什么声音？安娜：我想是放屁声。我们别笑话他。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak il-ħoss?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak il-ħoss?
messages.zh: 刚才那是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħoss ta' tibsis, naħseb. Ejja ma nidħkux bih.
messages.mt_standard: Ħoss ta' tibsis, naħseb. Ejja ma nidħkux bih.
messages.zh: 我想是放屁声。我们别笑话他。
messages.en: Someone farting, I think. Let's not laugh at him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tibsis 时联想肚子里的气排出去；英文 breaking wind 和 farting 在这里都指同一生理动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving birth to a litter, used of animals such as rabbits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 兔子等动物一次产下一窝幼崽的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li annimal, bħal fenka, iwelled grupp ta' frieħ f'daqqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of producing a litter (used of animals such as rabbits)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 产下一窝幼崽的行为，用于兔子等动物。

collocations.en: the female rabbit's giving birth to a litter
after giving birth to a litter

formal.mt: Wara t-tibtin tal-fenka, il-ħaddiem irreġistra n-numru tal-frieħ li twieldu.
formal.en: After the female rabbit gave birth to a litter, the worker recorded the number of young born.
formal.zh: 母兔产下一窝幼崽后，工作人员记录了出生幼兔的数量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser tibtin? Pawlu: Meta annimal bħal fenka jwelled grupp ta' frieħ f'daqqa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does tibtin mean? Pawlu: It is when an animal such as a female rabbit gives birth to a group of young at once.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：tibtin 是什么意思？保罗：就是母兔这类动物一次产下一窝幼崽。

messages.speaker: Nina (养殖场学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tibtin?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tibtin?
messages.zh: tibtin 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tibtin mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (饲养员)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta annimal bħal fenka jwelled grupp ta' frieħ f'daqqa.
messages.mt_standard: Meta annimal bħal fenka jwelled grupp ta' frieħ f'daqqa.
messages.zh: 就是母兔这类动物一次产下一窝幼崽。
messages.en: It is when an animal such as a female rabbit gives birth to a group of young at once.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibtin 配上一只母兔和一窝新生幼兔的图，重点记住“一次产下一窝”的动作。

gloss_zh: 动物断尾；截短动物尾巴

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of cutting off part or all of an animal's tail, known as tail docking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切除动物部分或全部尾巴、使尾巴截短的行为，即断尾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li taqta' parti minn denb annimal jew id-denb kollu.

sense_translations.en_definition: the docking of an animal's tail
sense_translations.zh_definition: 截短或切除动物尾巴的行为，即动物断尾。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tibtir tad-denb bħala l-qtugħ ta' parti minn denb annimal jew tad-denb kollu.
formal.en: The report describes tail docking as the removal of part or all of an animal's tail.
formal.zh: 报告将断尾描述为切除动物部分或全部尾巴的行为。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser tibtir f'dan ir-rapport? Rita: Hawnhekk ifisser il-qtugħ ta' parti minn denb annimal jew tad-denb kollu.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does tibtir mean in this report? Rita: Here it means cutting off part or all of an animal's tail.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这份报告里的 tibtir 是什么意思？丽塔：这里指切除动物部分或全部尾巴。

messages.speaker: Mark (兽医学学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tibtir f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tibtir f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 tibtir 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tibtir mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Rita (兽医学教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser il-qtugħ ta' parti minn denb annimal jew tad-denb kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser il-qtugħ ta' parti minn denb annimal jew tad-denb kollu.
messages.zh: 这里指切除动物部分或全部尾巴。
messages.en: Here it means cutting off part or all of an animal's tail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibtir 与动物尾巴被截短的示意图配对，记住它表示断尾这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frequent urination, or the repeated passing of urine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频繁排尿的现象，强调排尿次数多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li wieħed jgħaddi l-awrina ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尿频；频繁排尿。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-pazjent iddeskriva t-tibwil matul il-lejl u kemm-il darba kellu jqum.
formal.en: In the report, the patient described his frequent urination during the night and how many times he had to get up.
formal.zh: 患者在报告中描述了夜间尿频的情况，以及自己需要起床的次数。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'niżżel fuq din il-formola? David: Niżżel it-tibwil u kemm-il darba tmur it-tojlit billejl.
colloquial.en: Rita: What should I write on this form? David: Write down the frequent urination and how many times you go to the toilet at night.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这张表上我该填什么？戴维：写下尿频的情况，以及你夜里上厕所的次数。

messages.speaker: Rita (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'niżżel fuq din il-formola?
messages.mt_standard: X'niżżel fuq din il-formola?
messages.zh: 这张表上我该填什么？
messages.en: What should I write on this form?

messages.speaker: David (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Niżżel it-tibwil u kemm-il darba tmur it-tojlit billejl.
messages.mt_standard: Niżżel it-tibwil u kemm-il darba tmur it-tojlit billejl.
messages.zh: 写下尿频的情况，以及你夜里上厕所的次数。
messages.en: Write down the frequent urination and how many times you go to the toilet at night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibwil 和夜里反复起床上厕所的画面相连，重点记住排尿次数频繁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something hollow by removing material from its inside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去除物体内部材料，使其形成空腔的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitneħħa materjal minn ġewwa oġġett biex dan isir vojt minn ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖空；使物体内部形成空腔。

formal.mt: It-tibwiq tal-biċċa injam ħoloq spazju ġewwa fiha, filwaqt li l-parti ta' barra żammet il-forma tagħha.
formal.en: Hollowing out the piece of wood created a space inside it, while its exterior retained its shape.
formal.zh: 将这块木料挖空后，内部形成了空腔，而外部仍保留原来的形状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-biċċa injam għadha mimlija minn ġewwa? Pawlu: Iva, għadni ma bdejtx it-tibwiq tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this piece of wood still solid inside? Pawlu: Yes, I haven't started hollowing it out yet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块木料里面还是实心的吗？保罗：是的，我还没开始把它挖空。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-biċċa injam għadha mimlija minn ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-biċċa injam għadha mimlija minn ġewwa?
messages.zh: 这块木料里面还是实心的吗？
messages.en: Is this piece of wood still solid inside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni ma bdejtx it-tibwiq tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni ma bdejtx it-tibwiq tagħha.
messages.zh: 是的，我还没开始把它挖空。
messages.en: Yes, I haven't started hollowing it out yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibwiq 想成制作木碗时掏出内部木料的动作，外形还在，里面变空。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of kissing, such as touching someone with the lips to express affection or give a greeting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亲吻的行为，例如用嘴唇轻触他人以表达亲近或问候。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li wieħed jagħti bewsa jew bews lil xi ħadd, pereżempju biex juri mħabba jew isellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲吻；接吻这一行为。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tgħanniq u t-tibwis bejn il-membri tal-familja wrew il-ferħ tagħhom meta reġgħu ltaqgħu.
formal.en: In the story, the hugging and kissing among family members showed their joy at meeting again.
formal.zh: 在故事中，家人之间的拥抱和亲吻表现了他们重逢时的喜悦。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'kien hemm meta waslet in-nanna? Luqa: Kien hemm ħafna tgħanniq u tibwis; kulħadd kien ferħan jaraha.
colloquial.en: Marta: What happened when Grandma arrived? Luqa: There was lots of hugging and kissing; everyone was happy to see her.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：奶奶到的时候是什么情形？卢卡：大家又拥抱又亲吻，都很高兴见到她。

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien hemm meta waslet in-nanna?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien hemm meta waslet in-nanna?
messages.zh: 奶奶到的时候是什么情形？
messages.en: What happened when Grandma arrived?

messages.speaker: Luqa (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna tgħanniq u tibwis; kulħadd kien ferħan jaraha.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna tgħanniq u tibwis; kulħadd kien ferħan jaraha.
messages.zh: 大家又拥抱又亲吻，都很高兴见到她。
messages.en: There was lots of hugging and kissing; everyone was happy to see her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibwis 放进家人重逢时拥抱亲吻的场景，记的是亲吻行为本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of announcing something or giving people news.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宣布某件事，或把消息告知他人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li wieħed iħabbar xi ħaġa jew jagħti aħbar lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣布；将某件事正式或公开告知他人。
传达消息；把新消息告诉他人。

formal.mt: It-tibxir tar-riżultati sar fis-sala wara li l-ġurija temmet ix-xogħol tagħha.
formal.en: The announcing of the results took place in the hall after the jury had finished its work.
formal.zh: 评审团完成工作后，结果在大厅里公布。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm daqshekk nies fis-sala? Mark: Qed jistennew it-tibxir tar-riżultati tal-kompetizzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are there so many people in the hall? Mark: They're waiting for the competition results to be announced.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：大厅里怎么有这么多人？马克：他们在等比赛结果公布。

messages.speaker: Sara (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk nies fis-sala?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk nies fis-sala?
messages.zh: 大厅里怎么有这么多人？
messages.en: Why are there so many people in the hall?

messages.speaker: Mark (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jistennew it-tibxir tar-riżultati tal-kompetizzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jistennew it-tibxir tar-riżultati tal-kompetizzjoni.
messages.zh: 他们在等比赛结果公布。
messages.en: They're waiting for the competition results to be announced.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibxir 想成主持人拿起话筒宣布结果，也可联想到把新消息告诉朋友。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of scattering liquid in small drops or distributing small particles over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体以小水滴的形式洒出，或把细小颗粒撒在表面上的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li wieħed ixerred likwidu fi qtar żgħir jew frak fin fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洒；喷洒；将小水滴或细小颗粒撒布开来。

formal.mt: It-tibxix ħafif tal-ilma xarrab wiċċ il-ħamrija mingħajr ma ħoloq għadajjar.
formal.en: The light sprinkling of water moistened the soil's surface without creating puddles.
formal.zh: 轻轻洒水使土壤表面湿润，同时没有形成积水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kejk lest? Toni: Kważi; jonqos biss tibxix ta' zokkor fuq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the cake ready? Toni: Almost; it just needs a sprinkling of sugar on top.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：蛋糕做好了吗？托尼：差不多了，只差在上面撒一点糖。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kejk lest?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kejk lest?
messages.zh: 蛋糕做好了吗？
messages.en: Is the cake ready?

messages.speaker: Toni (烘焙者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; jonqos biss tibxix ta' zokkor fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; jonqos biss tibxix ta' zokkor fuq.
messages.zh: 差不多了，只差在上面撒一点糖。
messages.en: Almost; it just needs a sprinkling of sugar on top.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibxix 配上水滴或糖粒轻轻散落的画面，记住少量分散洒出的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of slaughtering animals or cutting up their bodies for meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获取肉食而屠宰动物或分割其胴体的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtil tal-bhejjem għal-laħam jew it-tqattigħ ta' ġisimhom biex jitħejja l-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 屠宰；宰割，指宰杀动物或将其分割成肉块。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi t-tibċir tal-bhejjem u t-tħejjija tal-laħam għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The chapter describes the slaughtering of livestock and the preparation of meat for sale.
formal.zh: 这一章介绍牲畜的屠宰，以及供出售肉类的处理过程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-filmat juri t-tibċir tal-bhejjem? Mark: Iva, u mbagħad juri kif jitħejja l-laħam. Sara: Nippreferi naqra d-deskrizzjoni biss.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this video show livestock being butchered? Mark: Yes, and then it shows how the meat is prepared. Sara: I'd prefer just to read the description.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这段视频展示牲畜屠宰吗？马克：是的，接着还展示肉是怎样处理的。萨拉：我还是只看文字介绍吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-filmat juri t-tibċir tal-bhejjem?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-filmat juri t-tibċir tal-bhejjem?
messages.zh: 这段视频展示牲畜屠宰吗？
messages.en: Does this video show livestock being butchered?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u mbagħad juri kif jitħejja l-laħam.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u mbagħad juri kif jitħejja l-laħam.
messages.zh: 是的，接着还展示肉是怎样处理的。
messages.en: Yes, and then it shows how the meat is prepared.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nippreferi naqra d-deskrizzjoni biss.
messages.mt_standard: Nippreferi naqra d-deskrizzjoni biss.
messages.zh: 我还是只看文字介绍吧。
messages.en: I'd prefer just to read the description.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibċir 和肉铺的加工流程联系起来：从屠宰牲畜到宰割肉块，记住它表示活动的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Travelling by boat or ship, or directing a vessel along its route.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乘船在水上航行，或确定航向并引导船只沿路线行进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ivvjaġġar bid-dgħajsa jew bil-vapur, jew it-tmexxija ta' bastiment tul ir-rotta tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 航行；乘船在水上行进。
导航；确定航向、规划路线并引导船只行进。

formal.mt: Il-kors tat-tibħir jgħallem lill-istudenti kif jaqraw il-mapep u jippjanaw rotta fuq il-baħar.
formal.en: The navigation course teaches students how to read charts and plan a route at sea.
formal.zh: 导航课程教授学生如何阅读海图并规划海上路线。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Tħobb it-tibħir? Samwel: Iva, speċjalment meta l-baħar ikun kalm. Elena: Jien ukoll, imma għad irrid nitgħallem naqra l-mapep.
colloquial.en: Elena: Do you like sailing? Samwel: Yes, especially when the sea is calm. Elena: Me too, but I still need to learn to read charts.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你喜欢出海航行吗？萨姆韦尔：喜欢，尤其是风平浪静的时候。埃莱娜：我也喜欢，不过我还得学会看海图。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħobb it-tibħir?
messages.mt_standard: Tħobb it-tibħir?
messages.zh: 你喜欢出海航行吗？
messages.en: Do you like sailing?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta l-baħar ikun kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta l-baħar ikun kalm.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其是风平浪静的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when the sea is calm.

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll, imma għad irrid nitgħallem naqra l-mapep.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll, imma għad irrid nitgħallem naqra l-mapep.
messages.zh: 我也喜欢，不过我还得学会看海图。
messages.en: Me too, but I still need to learn to read charts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己站在船上，一边航行一边看海图；用这个场景同时记住 tibħir 的“航行”和“导航”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of damaging someone's reputation by making false and malicious statements about them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用虚假而恶意的言论损害他人名誉的行为，即诽谤或中伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' xi ħadd bi kliem falz u malizzjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诽谤；以不实言论损害他人名誉的行为。
恶意中伤；捏造损害他人名誉的指控。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn kritika bbażata fuq il-fatti u tibħit li jagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' persuna.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between criticism based on facts and slander that damages a person's reputation.
formal.zh: 该报告区分了基于事实的批评与损害个人名誉的诽谤。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed jgħidu affarijiet foloz dwar Pawlu. Luqa: Dak tibħit; ejja ma nxerrdux dak il-kliem.
colloquial.en: Marija: They're saying false things about Pawlu. Luqa: That's slander; let's not spread those claims.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：他们在说关于保罗的不实之词。卢卡：那是诽谤，我们别传播那些话。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jgħidu affarijiet foloz dwar Pawlu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jgħidu affarijiet foloz dwar Pawlu.
messages.zh: 他们在说关于保罗的不实之词。
messages.en: They're saying false things about Pawlu.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tibħit; ejja ma nxerrdux dak il-kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Dak tibħit; ejja ma nxerrdux dak il-kliem.
messages.zh: 那是诽谤，我们别传播那些话。
messages.en: That's slander; let's not spread those claims.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibħit 配上“虚假言论伤名誉”的画面，记住它强调诽谤行为，可与基于事实的批评作教学对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Steady, hardworking effort and careful attention in carrying out work or study.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在工作或学习中持续努力、认真用心的态度与表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma b'impenn, b'attenzjoni u bi sforz kontinwu fix-xogħol jew fl-istudju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤劳；勤奋工作的品质或表现。
勤勉；做事认真、持续用功的态度。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-għalliema faħħret it-tibżil tal-istudenta u l-attenzjoni li tat lil kull biċċa xogħol.
formal.en: In her report, the teacher praised the student's diligence and the attention she gave to every task.
formal.zh: 教师在评语中称赞了这名学生的勤勉，以及她对每项任务投入的用心。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif spiċċajt dan kollu f'ġimgħa? Marija: Bit-tibżil; ħdimt fuqu ftit kuljum.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did you finish all this in a week? Marija: Through diligence; I worked on it a little every day.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你怎么在一周内把这些全做完了？玛丽娅：靠勤奋，我每天都做一点。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif spiċċajt dan kollu f'ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif spiċċajt dan kollu f'ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 你怎么在一周内把这些全做完了？
messages.en: How did you finish all this in a week?

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-tibżil; ħdimt fuqu ftit kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-tibżil; ħdimt fuqu ftit kuljum.
messages.zh: 靠勤奋，我每天都做一点。
messages.en: Through diligence; I worked on it a little every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibżil 联想到每天认真完成一点功课的日历，持续努力就是勤勉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of spitting repeatedly, with only a small quantity each time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复吐唾沫，并且每次吐出的量很少的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li wieħed jobżoq ta' spiss u fi kwantitajiet żgħar kull darba.

sense_translations.en_definition: spitting frequently and in small quantities
sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁地吐唾沫，且每次吐出的量很少。

collocations.en: repeated spitting of small amounts of saliva
repeated spitting of small amounts onto the ground
collocations.zh: 反复往地上吐少量唾沫

formal.mt: In-nota ddeskriviet it-tibżiq tal-pazjent: kien jobżoq ta' spiss, iżda ftit bżieq kull darba.
formal.en: The note described the patient's repeated spitting: he spat frequently, but only a little saliva each time.
formal.zh: 记录描述了患者频繁少量吐唾沫的情况：他经常吐唾沫，但每次只有一点。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex qed tnaddaf dan il-post? Ġorġ: Minħabba t-tibżiq mal-art; xi ħadd baqa' jobżoq ftit ftit.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why are you cleaning this spot? Ġorġ: Because of the spitting on the ground; someone kept spitting small amounts.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你为什么在清理这个地方？乔治：因为地上有唾沫，有人一直一点一点地往地上吐。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tnaddaf dan il-post?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tnaddaf dan il-post?
messages.zh: 你为什么在清理这个地方？
messages.en: Why are you cleaning this spot?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (清洁员)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tibżiq mal-art; xi ħadd baqa' jobżoq ftit ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tibżiq mal-art; xi ħadd baqa' jobżoq ftit ftit.
messages.zh: 因为地上有唾沫，有人一直一点一点地往地上吐。
messages.en: Because of the spitting on the ground; someone kept spitting small amounts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tibżiq 时同时想两个标签：次数频繁、每次少量；只记吐唾沫还不够。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting pepper on food as a seasoning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把胡椒加在食物上进行调味的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li wieħed iżid il-bżar mal-ikel biex jagħtih it-togħma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 往食物上加胡椒；用胡椒调味。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispeċifika li t-tibżir tal-laħam isir qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: The recipe specifies that the meat should be seasoned with pepper before cooking.
formal.zh: 食谱明确要求在烹调前给肉加胡椒调味。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Is-soppa lesta biex inservuha? Samwel: Kważi; jonqos biss it-tibżir, imbagħad induquha.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is the soup ready to serve? Samwel: Almost; we just need to add pepper, then we'll taste it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：汤可以端上桌了吗？萨姆韦尔：差不多了，只差加胡椒，然后我们尝一尝。

messages.speaker: Lina (厨房助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-soppa lesta biex inservuha?
messages.mt_standard: Is-soppa lesta biex inservuha?
messages.zh: 汤可以端上桌了吗？
messages.en: Is the soup ready to serve?

messages.speaker: Samwel (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; jonqos biss it-tibżir, imbagħad induquha.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; jonqos biss it-tibżir, imbagħad induquha.
messages.zh: 差不多了，只差加胡椒，然后我们尝一尝。
messages.en: Almost; we just need to add pepper, then we'll taste it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tibżir 和拿起胡椒瓶给汤或肉调味的动作相连，明确记住加的是胡椒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ulceration, meaning the formation or development of an ulcer; the word also has separate senses of contusion and negotiation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指溃疡的形成或发展；另有“挫伤”和“协商”两个独立义项，应结合上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-formazzjoni jew l-iżvilupp ta' ulċera; il-kelma għandha wkoll tifsiriet separati ta' kontużjoni u negozjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溃疡形成；组织发生溃疡的过程或状态
挫伤；由撞击等造成的组织损伤
协商；谈判

formal.mt: F'din is-sentenza, it-tidbir bejn iż-żewġ partijiet jirreferi għan-negozjar dwar il-kundizzjonijiet tal-ftehim.
formal.en: In this sentence, 'tidbir' between the two parties refers to negotiation over the terms of the agreement.
formal.zh: 在这个句子中，双方之间的 tidbir 指的是就协议条件进行协商。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawn miktub 'tidbir dwar il-prezz'. Għandu x'jaqsam ma' xi korriment? Mark: Le, hawn ifisser negozjar. Il-kuntest jgħinek tagħżel it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Lara: It says 'tidbir dwar il-prezz' here. Is it about an injury? Mark: No, here it means negotiation. The context helps you choose the meaning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里写着 tidbir dwar il-prezz，和受伤有关吗？马克：没有，这里指协商。上下文能帮你判断词义。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'tidbir dwar il-prezz'. Għandu x'jaqsam ma' xi korriment?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'tidbir dwar il-prezz'. Għandu x'jaqsam ma' xi korriment?
messages.zh: 这里写着 tidbir dwar il-prezz，和受伤有关吗？
messages.en: It says 'tidbir dwar il-prezz' here. Is it about an injury?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn ifisser negozjar. Il-kuntest jgħinek tagħżel it-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn ifisser negozjar. Il-kuntest jgħinek tagħżel it-tifsira.
messages.zh: 没有，这里指协商。上下文能帮你判断词义。
messages.en: No, here it means negotiation. The context helps you choose the meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张独立词义卡：溃疡、挫伤、协商；用皮肤、撞击、价格等上下文分别定位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The slaughter of an animal for a sacrificial purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为献祭而宰杀牲畜的行为，强调其祭祀用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtil ta' annimal bil-għan li jiġi offrut bħala sagrifiċċju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为祭祀献祭而进行的宰牲行为

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi t-tidbiħ ta' annimali bħala parti mir-rit li qed jiġi studjat.
formal.en: The text describes the sacrificial slaughter of animals as part of the rite being studied.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述了所研究仪式中的动物献祭宰杀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'tidbiħ' f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Hawn ifisser il-qtil ta' annimal biex jiġi offrut bħala sagrifiċċju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tidbiħ' mean in this text? Pawlu: Here it means killing an animal to offer it as a sacrifice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的 tidbiħ 是什么意思？保罗：这里指宰杀动物，用来献祭。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'tidbiħ' f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'tidbiħ' f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 tidbiħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tidbiħ' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser il-qtil ta' annimal biex jiġi offrut bħala sagrifiċċju.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser il-qtil ta' annimal biex jiġi offrut bħala sagrifiċċju.
messages.zh: 这里指宰杀动物，用来献祭。
messages.en: Here it means killing an animal to offer it as a sacrifice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“仪式中宰牲献祭”的画面，记住关键是献祭目的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of pushing or driving something forward or into something else with force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物用力向前推送或插入另一物中的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni ta' mbuttar ta' xi ħaġa bil-qawwa 'l quddiem jew għal ġo xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猛推；用力向前推送或插入的动作

collocations.en: thrusting a pole into the ground

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju juri t-tidfis ta' arblu fir-ramel b'moviment wieħed.
formal.en: The exercise demonstrates thrusting a pole into the sand in a single movement.
formal.zh: 这项练习示范了用一个动作把杆子用力插入沙中的过程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'tidfis' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Toni: Ifisser li timbotta l-arblu bil-qawwa fir-ramel.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'tidfis' mean in this exercise? Toni: It means pushing the pole forcefully into the sand.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个练习里的 tidfis 是什么意思？托尼：就是把杆子用力插进沙里。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'tidfis' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'tidfis' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这个练习里的 tidfis 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tidfis' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Toni (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li timbotta l-arblu bil-qawwa fir-ramel.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li timbotta l-arblu bil-qawwa fir-ramel.
messages.zh: 就是把杆子用力插进沙里。
messages.en: It means pushing the pole forcefully into the sand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手握杆向沙里猛地一插，把词义记成一个有力度的推进动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of covering a surface with a thin layer of gold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面覆盖薄金层的工艺或过程，如贴金或镀金装饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wiċċ ta' oġġett jinkesa b'saff irqiq tad-deheb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贴金；在物体表面覆上一层薄金的工艺

formal.mt: Waqt ir-restawr, sar it-tidhib tal-gwarniċ bil-weraq tad-deheb.
formal.en: During the restoration, the frame was gilded with gold leaf.
formal.zh: 修复过程中，画框采用金箔进行了贴金处理。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm jiswa t-tidhib ta' dan il-gwarniċ? Ġużi: Jiddependi mid-daqs tiegħu u mill-materjal li nagħżlu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much does gilding this frame cost? Ġużi: It depends on its size and the material we choose.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：给这个画框贴金要多少钱？朱齐：要看画框的大小和我们选用的材料。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm jiswa t-tidhib ta' dan il-gwarniċ?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm jiswa t-tidhib ta' dan il-gwarniċ?
messages.zh: 给这个画框贴金要多少钱？
messages.en: How much does gilding this frame cost?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiddependi mid-daqs tiegħu u mill-materjal li nagħżlu.
messages.mt_standard: Jiddependi mid-daqs tiegħu u mill-materjal li nagħżlu.
messages.zh: 要看画框的大小和我们选用的材料。
messages.en: It depends on its size and the material we choose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工匠给画框铺上一层薄金箔，用“表面覆金”的画面记住这个工艺名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of working a substance into another material so that it becomes incorporated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过揉、搓或混合等加工动作，把一种物质逐渐掺入另一种材料中的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha sustanza titħallat u tinħadem ma' materjal ieħor sakemm issir parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过加工把某物揉入、搓入或掺入的行为

formal.mt: It-tidhis tal-butir fid-dqiq isir bis-swaba' sakemm it-taħlita tixbah frak fin.
formal.en: The butter is worked into the flour with the fingertips until the mixture resembles fine crumbs.
formal.zh: 用指尖把黄油搓入面粉，直到混合物呈细碎屑状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'tidhis tal-butir' fir-riċetta? Omm: Li taħdem il-butir fid-dqiq b'subgħajk sakemm jitħallat sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'tidhis tal-butir' mean in the recipe? Mum: Working the butter into the flour with your fingers until it is well incorporated.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：食谱里的 tidhis tal-butir 是什么意思？妈妈：就是用手指把黄油搓进面粉里，让它们充分混合。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'tidhis tal-butir' fir-riċetta?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'tidhis tal-butir' fir-riċetta?
messages.zh: 食谱里的 tidhis tal-butir 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tidhis tal-butir' mean in the recipe?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Li taħdem il-butir fid-dqiq b'subgħajk sakemm jitħallat sew.
messages.mt_standard: Li taħdem il-butir fid-dqiq b'subgħajk sakemm jitħallat sew.
messages.zh: 就是用手指把黄油搓进面粉里，让它们充分混合。
messages.en: Working the butter into the flour with your fingers until it is well incorporated.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把黄油一点点搓进面粉的动作当作记忆画面，抓住“加工使其融入”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The continuation of something over time, or the act of keeping it in existence for a long time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物随时间继续存在，或使其长期保持、延续下去的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kontinwazzjoni ta' xi ħaġa maż-żmien, jew l-azzjoni li żżommha teżisti għal żmien twil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继续；延续
使长期存续；使持续流传或延续下去

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu l-għan li jikkontribwixxi għat-tidjim tal-memorja tal-komunità permezz ta' intervisti rrekordjati.
formal.en: The project aims to help perpetuate the community's memory through recorded interviews.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在通过录制访谈，帮助社区记忆长久留存。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tirrekordja dawn il-kanzunetti? Nannu: Għat-tidjim tat-tradizzjoni tagħna, biex intom tkunu tistgħu tgħadduha lil uliedkom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you recording these songs? Grandpa: To keep our tradition alive, so that you can pass it on to your children.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么要录下这些歌？爷爷：为了让我们的传统延续下去，这样你们也能把它传给自己的孩子。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tirrekordja dawn il-kanzunetti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tirrekordja dawn il-kanzunetti?
messages.zh: 你为什么要录下这些歌？
messages.en: Why are you recording these songs?

messages.speaker: Nannu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tidjim tat-tradizzjoni tagħna, biex intom tkunu tistgħu tgħadduha lil uliedkom.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tidjim tat-tradizzjoni tagħna, biex intom tkunu tistgħu tgħadduha lil uliedkom.
messages.zh: 为了让我们的传统延续下去，这样你们也能把它传给自己的孩子。
messages.en: To keep our tradition alive, so that you can pass it on to your children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条不断向前延伸的时间线：继续走是“延续”，让它长久不断是“使存续”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking on debt or becoming financially indebted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过借款等方式承担债务、进入负债状态的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha persuna jew entità tidħol fid-dejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举债；使自己承担债务、进入负债状态的行为

collocations.en: taking on debt to buy equipment

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tidjin tal-kumpanija biex tiffinanzja x-xiri ta' tagħmir ġdid.
formal.en: The report describes the company taking on debt to finance the purchase of new equipment.
formal.zh: 报告描述了公司为筹措购买新设备的资金而举债的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Tidjin' ifisser kemm flus għadni rrid inħallas? Mark: Il-kelma tirreferi għall-att li tidħol fid-dejn, bħal meta tieħu self biex tixtri xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does 'tidjin' mean how much money I still owe? Mark: The word refers to the act of getting into debt, such as taking out a loan to buy something.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：tidjin 指的是我还欠多少钱吗？马克：这个词指开始负债的行为，比如为了买东西而借款。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Tidjin' ifisser kemm flus għadni rrid inħallas?
messages.mt_standard: 'Tidjin' ifisser kemm flus għadni rrid inħallas?
messages.zh: tidjin 指的是我还欠多少钱吗？
messages.en: Does 'tidjin' mean how much money I still owe?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelma tirreferi għall-att li tidħol fid-dejn, bħal meta tieħu self biex tixtri xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelma tirreferi għall-att li tidħol fid-dejn, bħal meta tieħu self biex tixtri xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 这个词指开始负债的行为，比如为了买东西而借款。
messages.en: The word refers to the act of getting into debt, such as taking out a loan to buy something.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象借款到账，同时账本新增一笔债务，用“承担债务的动作”记住举债这个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming narrower or making something narrower.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物变得更窄，或使某物的宽度减小的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir idjaq jew wieħed jagħmilha idjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变窄；使宽度减小的过程。

formal.mt: It-tidjiq tat-triq quddiem l-iskola jħalli inqas spazju għall-vetturi.
formal.en: The narrowing of the road in front of the school leaves less space for vehicles.
formal.zh: 学校前方道路变窄，车辆可用的空间随之减少。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed insuqu daqshekk bil-mod? Mark: Minħabba t-tidjiq tat-triq; hawn ftit spazju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we driving so slowly? Mark: Because of the narrowing of the road; there is little space here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么开得这么慢？马克：因为道路变窄了，这里空间很小。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed insuqu daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed insuqu daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.zh: 我们为什么开得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are we driving so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tidjiq tat-triq; hawn ftit spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tidjiq tat-triq; hawn ftit spazju.
messages.zh: 因为道路变窄了，这里空间很小。
messages.en: Because of the narrowing of the road; there is little space here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两面墙逐渐靠拢，通道越来越窄，用这个画面记住 tidjiq 表示“缩窄的过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of crushing or grinding a solid material into powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把固体材料压碎或研磨成粉末的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih materjal solidu jitfarrak jew jintaħan sakemm isir trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粉碎；将固体研磨或压碎成粉末的过程。

formal.mt: Wara t-tidkik, il-materjal jinġabar f'kontenitur magħluq.
formal.en: After pulverisation, the material is collected in a closed container.
formal.zh: 粉碎后，材料被收集到一个密闭容器中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-magna għal xiex tintuża? Pawlu: Għat-tidkik tal-ġebel; tagħmlu trab fin.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this machine used for? Pawlu: For pulverising stone; it turns it into fine powder.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这台机器是做什么用的？保罗：用来粉碎石料，把它变成细粉。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-magna għal xiex tintuża?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-magna għal xiex tintuża?
messages.zh: 这台机器是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this machine used for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tidkik tal-ġebel; tagħmlu trab fin.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tidkik tal-ġebel; tagħmlu trab fin.
messages.zh: 用来粉碎石料，把它变成细粉。
messages.en: For pulverising stone; it turns it into fine powder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“大石块变成一堆细粉”的连续画面与 tidkik 绑定，重点记住结果是粉末。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The transfer of pollen to a flower with human assistance to enable fertilisation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过人工协助把花粉传到花上，以促成受精的授粉过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trasferiment tal-polline għal fjura bl-għajnuna tal-bniedem biex ikun jista' jseħħ il-proċess tal-fertilizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人工授粉；由人协助完成的花粉传递过程。

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti osservaw it-tidkir tal-fjuri b'pinzell żgħir.
formal.en: During the lesson, the students observed the artificial pollination of flowers with a small brush.
formal.zh: 课堂上，学生们观察了用小刷子给花朵人工授粉的过程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għandek pinzell ħdejn il-fjuri? Toni: Qed nagħmel it-tidkir bl-idejn u nittrasferixxi l-polline minn fjura għal oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you have a brush beside the flowers? Toni: I am pollinating them by hand and transferring pollen from one flower to another.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么在花旁边拿着刷子？托尼：我在手工授粉，把花粉从一朵花传到另一朵花上。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek pinzell ħdejn il-fjuri?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek pinzell ħdejn il-fjuri?
messages.zh: 你为什么在花旁边拿着刷子？
messages.en: Why do you have a brush beside the flowers?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel it-tidkir bl-idejn u nittrasferixxi l-polline minn fjura għal oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel it-tidkir bl-idejn u nittrasferixxi l-polline minn fjura għal oħra.
messages.zh: 我在手工授粉，把花粉从一朵花传到另一朵花上。
messages.en: I am pollinating them by hand and transferring pollen from one flower to another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象园丁拿小刷子替花朵传递花粉，把“人工帮花授粉”的动作记作 tidkir。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of spreading a substance over a surface by rubbing or smearing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过擦抹把某种物质涂到表面上的动作；本词另有黏性和潮湿的义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tifrex sustanza fuq wiċċ billi togħrokha jew tidlikha fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黏性；表面或物质容易黏附的性质。
潮湿；空气中含有水汽的状态。
涂抹；把某种物质擦抹、铺展到表面上的动作。

collocations.en: the smearing of oil over the surface

formal.mt: It-tidlik taż-żejt fuq il-wiċċ tal-injam għandu jsir b'ċarruta nadifa.
formal.en: The spreading of oil over the wooden surface should be done with a clean cloth.
formal.zh: 应使用干净的布在木质表面涂油。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lestejt it-tidlik tal-krema? Maja: Għadni le; għad fadalli ftit krema x'inferrex fuq idejja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you finished applying the cream? Maja: Not yet; I still have a little cream left to spread over my hands.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你涂好乳霜了吗？玛雅：还没有，我还有一点乳霜要涂在手上。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt it-tidlik tal-krema?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt it-tidlik tal-krema?
messages.zh: 你涂好乳霜了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished applying the cream?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le; għad fadalli ftit krema x'inferrex fuq idejja.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le; għad fadalli ftit krema x'inferrex fuq idejja.
messages.zh: 还没有，我还有一点乳霜要涂在手上。
messages.en: Not yet; I still have a little cream left to spread over my hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张学习卡分别记住“黏手的表面、潮湿的空气、涂抹乳霜的动作”，对应 tidlik 的三个义项，读句子时靠上下文选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting something in the shade or providing shade over it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物放到阴处，或为它提供遮阴的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqiegħed xi ħaġa fid-dell jew tipprovdilha dell.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of putting sth. in the shade
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物放到阴处的行为。
遮阴；为某物遮擋直射光、提供阴影的行为。

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi t-tidlil tat-terrazzin permezz ta' tinda kbira.
formal.en: The plan includes shading the terrace with a large awning.
formal.zh: 该方案包括用大型遮阳篷为露台遮阴。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex poġġejt din ix-xibka fuq il-pjanti? Mark: Għat-tidlil tagħhom; hawn ħafna xemx wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you put this net over the plants? Mark: To provide shade for them; there is a lot of sun here in the afternoon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在植物上方放这张网？马克：给它们遮阴，这里下午阳光很强。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejt din ix-xibka fuq il-pjanti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejt din ix-xibka fuq il-pjanti?
messages.zh: 你为什么在植物上方放这张网？
messages.en: Why did you put this net over the plants?

messages.speaker: Mark (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tidlil tagħhom; hawn ħafna xemx wara nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tidlil tagħhom; hawn ħafna xemx wara nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 给它们遮阴，这里下午阳光很强。
messages.en: To provide shade for them; there is a lot of sun here in the afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把花盆搬到树荫下，再给另一盆花撑起遮阳伞：两个画面都能帮助记住 tidlil 的遮阴含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something darker or making it less clear or visible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变暗，或使它变得不清楚、不易看见的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar mudlama jew inqas ċara u viżibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变暗；使光线或颜色变得更暗的过程。
遮蔽；使某物变得模糊、不清楚或难以看见。

formal.mt: It-tidlim tal-immaġni għamel id-dettalji fl-isfond inqas viżibbli.
formal.en: The darkening of the image made the details in the background less visible.
formal.zh: 图像变暗后，背景中的细节更难看清了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għalaqt il-purtieri? Toni: Għat-tidlim tal-kamra; hekk naraw il-film aħjar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you close the curtains? Toni: To darken the room; that way we can see the film better.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么把窗帘拉上了？托尼：为了让房间暗下来，这样看电影更清楚。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għalaqt il-purtieri?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għalaqt il-purtieri?
messages.zh: 你为什么把窗帘拉上了？
messages.en: Why did you close the curtains?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tidlim tal-kamra; hekk naraw il-film aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tidlim tal-kamra; hekk naraw il-film aħjar.
messages.zh: 为了让房间暗下来，这样看电影更清楚。
messages.en: To darken the room; that way we can see the film better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tidlim 想成逐渐调低屏幕亮度：画面越来越暗，细节也越来越难看清，串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The production and release of fluid by the body, as illustrated by the secretion of tears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体产生并释放液体的过程，可用眼睛分泌泪液的情境来理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-produzzjoni u l-ħruġ ta' likwidu mill-ġisem, bħal meta l-għajnejn jipproduċu d-dmugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分泌；身体产生并释放液体等物质的过程。

collocations.en: the secretion of tears by the eyes

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tidmigħ tal-għajnejn juri kemm il-karattru kien imqanqal.
formal.en: In the story, the secretion of tears shows how deeply moved the character was.
formal.zh: 故事中，眼睛流出泪水，表现出人物深受触动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara? Għajnejk mimlijin dmugħ. Pawlu: Qed inqatta' l-basal, u t-tidmigħ ma jridx jieqaf!
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened? Your eyes are full of tears. Pawlu: I am chopping onions, and the tears just will not stop!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：怎么了？你眼里全是泪水。保罗：我在切洋葱，眼泪就是停不下来！

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara? Għajnejk mimlijin dmugħ.
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara? Għajnejk mimlijin dmugħ.
messages.zh: 怎么了？你眼里全是泪水。
messages.en: What happened? Your eyes are full of tears.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inqatta' l-basal, u t-tidmigħ ma jridx jieqaf!
messages.mt_standard: Qed inqatta' l-basal, u t-tidmigħ ma jridx jieqaf!
messages.zh: 我在切洋葱，眼泪就是停不下来！
messages.en: I am chopping onions, and the tears just will not stop!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用切洋葱时眼睛不断分泌泪液的场景记忆 tidmigħ，把注意力放在液体分泌的过程上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spilling of blood through violence, especially when people are injured or killed in conflict.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暴力造成的流血，尤其指冲突中有人受伤或死亡的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tixrid tad-demm minħabba l-vjolenza, speċjalment meta n-nies jindarbu jew jinqatlu f'kunflitt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流血；暴力或冲突造成伤亡、鲜血流出的情况。

formal.mt: L-istqarrija talbet il-waqfien tat-tidmija u l-bidu ta' taħditiet għall-paċi.
formal.en: The statement called for an end to the bloodshed and the start of peace talks.
formal.zh: 声明呼吁停止流血冲突，并启动和平谈判。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed jitolbu n-nies fil-pjazza? Mark: Iridu l-waqfien tat-tidmija u soluzzjoni paċifika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are the people in the square calling for? Mark: They want an end to the bloodshed and a peaceful solution.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：广场上的人们在呼吁什么？马克：他们希望停止流血冲突，并以和平方式解决问题。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed jitolbu n-nies fil-pjazza?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed jitolbu n-nies fil-pjazza?
messages.zh: 广场上的人们在呼吁什么？
messages.en: What are the people in the square calling for?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iridu l-waqfien tat-tidmija u soluzzjoni paċifika.
messages.mt_standard: Iridu l-waqfien tat-tidmija u soluzzjoni paċifika.
messages.zh: 他们希望停止流血冲突，并以和平方式解决问题。
messages.en: They want an end to the bloodshed and a peaceful solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tidmija 放进“停止流血、恢复和平”的新闻句子中记忆，联想到冲突造成的伤亡与流血。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fertilisation of land by applying manure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将厩肥施入土地，以增加土壤肥力的作业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti tad-demel lill-art biex issir aktar fertili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用厩肥给土地施肥；施厩肥。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tax-xogħol jinkludi t-tidmil tal-għalqa qabel iż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The work plan includes fertilising the field with manure before sowing.
formal.zh: 作业计划包括在播种前给田地施厩肥。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ġibt id-demel? Pawlu: Għat-tidmil tal-għalqa; wara nkunu nistgħu niżirgħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you bring the manure? Pawlu: To fertilise the field; afterwards we can sow.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么运来厩肥？保罗：用来给田地施肥，之后我们就可以播种了。

messages.speaker: Marta (农场帮工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ġibt id-demel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ġibt id-demel?
messages.zh: 你为什么运来厩肥？
messages.en: Why did you bring the manure?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tidmil tal-għalqa; wara nkunu nistgħu niżirgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tidmil tal-għalqa; wara nkunu nistgħu niżirgħu.
messages.zh: 用来给田地施肥，之后我们就可以播种了。
messages.en: To fertilise the field; afterwards we can sow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tidmil 配上一幅“厩肥撒进田地”的画面，记住它特指用厩肥施肥的作业。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The shedding of blood, particularly as a result of violence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流血，尤指暴力行为造成的流血。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tixrid tad-demm, speċjalment minħabba l-vjolenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流血；流血事件。
血污；血淋淋的血肉。
将物件穿串起来，尤指串珠。
采棉；采摘棉花的作业。

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkundanna t-tidmim u jappella għal soluzzjoni paċifika.
formal.en: The author condemns the bloodshed and calls for a peaceful solution.
formal.zh: 作者谴责流血行为，并呼吁以和平方式解决问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-film fih ħafna tidmim? Mark: Iva, hemm xeni bid-demm li nippreferi ma narax.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there a lot of gore in this film? Mark: Yes, there are bloody scenes that I would rather not watch.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这部电影有很多血腥画面吗？马克：有，有些血淋淋的场面我宁愿不看。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-film fih ħafna tidmim?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-film fih ħafna tidmim?
messages.zh: 这部电影有很多血腥画面吗？
messages.en: Is there a lot of gore in this film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm xeni bid-demm li nippreferi ma narax.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm xeni bid-demm li nippreferi ma narax.
messages.zh: 有，有些血淋淋的场面我宁愿不看。
messages.en: Yes, there are bloody scenes that I would rather not watch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tidmim 做四张独立语境卡：流血、血污、串珠、采棉；靠上下文选义，不把四义硬连成词源故事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of adding seasoning to food to give it flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向食物中加入调味料，使其产生或增添风味的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żieda ta' ħwawar jew melħ mal-ikel biex jingħata t-togħma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给食物调味；添加调味料的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tinkludi t-tidmis tal-laħam bil-melħ u l-bżar qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: The recipe includes seasoning the meat with salt and pepper before cooking.
formal.zh: 这份食谱包括在烹饪前用盐和胡椒给肉调味的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Lestejt it-tidmis tal-laħam? Ġużeppi: Għadni; jonqosni nżid ftit bżar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you finished seasoning the meat? Ġużeppi: Not yet; I still need to add a little pepper.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：肉调好味了吗？朱塞佩：还没有，还得加一点胡椒。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt it-tidmis tal-laħam?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt it-tidmis tal-laħam?
messages.zh: 肉调好味了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished seasoning the meat?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni; jonqosni nżid ftit bżar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni; jonqosni nżid ftit bżar.
messages.zh: 还没有，还得加一点胡椒。
messages.en: Not yet; I still need to add a little pepper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨师往锅里撒盐和胡椒，把 tidmis 记成“调味这个动作”，区别于调味料本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of attaching or adding a tail to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某个物体装上或添上尾巴的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iżid jew iwaħħal denb ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某物加上尾巴；为某物装尾巴。

collocations.en: adding a tail to the puppet
attaching a tail to the model

formal.mt: Il-proċess tal-bini tal-mudell jintemm bit-tidnib tiegħu.
formal.en: The model-building process ends with the attachment of its tail.
formal.zh: 模型制作过程以安装尾巴作为最后一步。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jonqos biex il-pupazz ikun lest? Toni: It-tidnib biss; id-denb diġà qiegħed hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: What still needs doing before the puppet is ready? Toni: Just adding the tail; the tail is already here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：玩偶还差什么才算做好？托尼：只差装尾巴了，尾巴已经放在这里。

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jonqos biex il-pupazz ikun lest?
messages.mt_standard: X'jonqos biex il-pupazz ikun lest?
messages.zh: 玩偶还差什么才算做好？
messages.en: What still needs doing before the puppet is ready?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tidnib biss; id-denb diġà qiegħed hawn.
messages.mt_standard: It-tidnib biss; id-denb diġà qiegħed hawn.
messages.zh: 只差装尾巴了，尾巴已经放在这里。
messages.en: Just adding the tail; the tail is already here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tidnib 配成手工课最后一步：拿起一条尾巴，装到玩偶身上；重点记“加上尾巴”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formation or discharge of pus in a wound or another affected part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伤口或其他患处形成或排出脓液的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-formazzjoni jew il-ħruġ tal-materja minn ferita jew minn parti oħra milquta tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化脓，指伤口等处形成或排出脓液。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport kliniku jiddeskrivi t-tidnin tal-ferita u l-ħruġ tal-materja minnha.
formal.en: The clinical report describes the suppuration of the wound and the discharge of pus from it.
formal.zh: 临床报告描述了伤口化脓及脓液流出的情况。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi tfisser il-kelma tidnin f'dan ir-rapport? David: Tfisser li qed tifforma jew toħroġ il-materja mill-ferita.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does the word tidnin mean in this report? David: It means that pus is forming in or coming out of the wound.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这份报告里的 tidnin 是什么意思？戴维：意思是伤口正在形成脓液，或者有脓液流出来。

messages.speaker: Marija (患者家属)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma tidnin f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma tidnin f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 tidnin 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word tidnin mean in this report?

messages.speaker: David (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li qed tifforma jew toħroġ il-materja mill-ferita.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li qed tifforma jew toħroġ il-materja mill-ferita.
messages.zh: 意思是伤口正在形成脓液，或者有脓液流出来。
messages.en: It means that pus is forming in or coming out of the wound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tidnin 时，在伤口示意图旁写“化脓过程”；用“出现脓液”的画面固定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something dirty, especially clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变脏的行为，尤其指弄脏衣服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħammeġ xi ħaġa, speċjalment il-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏，尤指弄脏衣物。

formal.mt: L-użu ta' fradal waqt iż-żebgħa jgħin biex jiġi evitat it-tidnis tal-ħwejjeġ.
formal.en: Using aprons while painting helps prevent clothes from getting dirty.
formal.zh: 绘画时使用围裙有助于防止弄脏衣服。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex se nilbsu l-fradal? Rita: Biex nevitaw it-tidnis tal-ħwejjeġ biż-żebgħa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why are we going to wear aprons? Rita: To avoid getting paint on our clothes.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我们为什么要穿围裙？丽塔：为了避免颜料弄脏衣服。

messages.speaker: Elena (绘画课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex se nilbsu l-fradal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex se nilbsu l-fradal?

messages.en: Why are we going to wear aprons?

messages.speaker: Rita (绘画课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nevitaw it-tidnis tal-ħwejjeġ biż-żebgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nevitaw it-tidnis tal-ħwejjeġ biż-żebgħa.
messages.zh: 为了避免颜料弄脏衣服。
messages.en: To avoid getting paint on our clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一滴颜料落在白衬衫上，把 tidnis 记作“弄脏的行为”，而不是那块污渍本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The distribution of something in equal shares.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物分成相等份额并加以分配。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqassim ta' xi ħaġa f'ishma ndaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 均等分配；按相同份额分配。

formal.mt: Il-proċedura tipprovdi għat-tidqis tar-riżorsi bejn l-erba' gruppi, sabiex kull grupp jirċievi l-istess sehem.
formal.en: The procedure provides for equal distribution of resources among the four groups, so that each group receives the same share.
formal.zh: 该程序规定将资源平均分配给四个小组，使每组获得相同份额。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se nagħmlu t-tidqis tal-gallettini? Ben: Hemm tnax u aħna erbgħa, mela tlieta kull wieħed.
colloquial.en: Sara: How are we going to share out the biscuits equally? Ben: There are twelve and four of us, so three each.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们怎么把饼干平均分呢？本：一共有十二块，我们有四个人，所以每人三块。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nagħmlu t-tidqis tal-gallettini?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nagħmlu t-tidqis tal-gallettini?
messages.zh: 我们怎么把饼干平均分呢？
messages.en: How are we going to share out the biscuits equally?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tnax u aħna erbgħa, mela tlieta kull wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tnax u aħna erbgħa, mela tlieta kull wieħed.
messages.zh: 一共有十二块，我们有四个人，所以每人三块。
messages.en: There are twelve and four of us, so three each.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用十二块饼干分给四人、每人三块的画面记 tidqis，核心是每份数量相等。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of striking someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或物实施击打的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħti daqqa lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 击打；打击的行为。
致伤；使人或动物受伤的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-regoli tal-attività jipprojbixxu t-tidrib bil-ponn jew bis-sieq.
formal.en: The rules of the activity prohibit striking with a fist or a foot.
formal.zh: 活动规则禁止拳打脚踢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara waqt il-ġlieda? Mark: Kien hemm tidrib; żewġ persuni kellhom feriti f'idejhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened during the fight? Mark: People were wounded; two people had wounds on their hands.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：打架时发生了什么？马克：有人受伤了，有两个人的手上有伤口。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara waqt il-ġlieda?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara waqt il-ġlieda?
messages.zh: 打架时发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened during the fight?

messages.speaker: Mark (目击者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm tidrib; żewġ persuni kellhom feriti f'idejhom.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm tidrib; żewġ persuni kellhom feriti f'idejhom.
messages.zh: 有人受伤了，有两个人的手上有伤口。
messages.en: People were wounded; two people had wounds on their hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tidrib 画两格记忆图：第一格是挥拳击打，第二格是造成伤口；分别对应“击打”和“致伤”。

gloss_zh: 脱粒；逐渐习惯、适应的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of separating grain from harvested ears; also, the process of becoming accustomed to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把谷粒从收割后的谷穗中分离出来的脱粒作业；也指逐渐习惯某种事物的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jinfired il-qamħ mis-sbul; ukoll, il-proċess li bih wieħed jidra xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次脱粒作业，即把谷粒从谷穗中分离出来。

sense_translations.en_definition: the process of becoming accustomed or habituated
sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐习惯或适应某种环境、活动或情况的过程。

collocations.en: the process of getting used to a new routine

formal.mt: It-test dwar l-agrikoltura jiddeskrivi t-tidrija bħala xogħol li jifred il-qamħ mis-sbul.
formal.en: The text on agriculture describes threshing as work that separates wheat grain from the ears.
formal.zh: 这篇农业文章把脱粒描述为将麦粒从麦穗中分离出来的作业。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sejra t-tidrija għar-rutina l-ġdida? Pawlu: Bil-mod, imma kull jum qed insibha eħfef.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is getting used to the new routine going? Pawlu: Slowly, but I am finding it easier every day.
colloquial.zh: Marija：适应新作息适应得怎么样？Pawlu：慢慢来，不过每天都觉得更容易一些。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejra t-tidrija għar-rutina l-ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejra t-tidrija għar-rutina l-ġdida?
messages.zh: 适应新作息适应得怎么样？
messages.en: How is getting used to the new routine going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-mod, imma kull jum qed insibha eħfef.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-mod, imma kull jum qed insibha eħfef.
messages.zh: 慢慢来，不过每天都觉得更容易一些。
messages.en: Slowly, but I am finding it easier every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡分别记忆：麦穗旁写“脱粒”，新作息表旁写“逐渐适应”；靠语境区分 tidrija 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The habit of starting activities or work early.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 平时习惯早早开始活动或工作，强调经常如此的习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-drawwa li wieħed jibda l-attivitajiet jew ix-xogħol kmieni.

sense_translations.en_definition: the habit of getting an early start
sense_translations.zh_definition: 早早开始做事或动身的习惯。

collocations.en: the habit of making an early start
the habit of starting work early

formal.mt: Fl-intervista, il-bidwi semma t-tidrik bħala drawwa importanti fil-ħajja tiegħu ta' kuljum.
formal.en: In the interview, the farmer mentioned the habit of making an early start as an important part of his daily life.
formal.zh: 在访谈中，这位农民提到，早早开始做事是他日常生活中的一个重要习惯。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dejjem tibda x-xogħol daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Iva, it-tidrik drawwa tiegħi; inħobb nibda qabel ma jkun hemm ħafna nies.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you always start work this early? Mark: Yes, making an early start is a habit of mine; I like to begin before there are many people around.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你总是这么早开始工作吗？Mark：是啊，我习惯早早开始；我喜欢在人还不多的时候开工。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dejjem tibda x-xogħol daqshekk kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Dejjem tibda x-xogħol daqshekk kmieni?
messages.zh: 你总是这么早开始工作吗？
messages.en: Do you always start work this early?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tidrik drawwa tiegħi; inħobb nibda qabel ma jkun hemm ħafna nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tidrik drawwa tiegħi; inħobb nibda qabel ma jkun hemm ħafna nies.
messages.zh: 是啊，我习惯早早开始；我喜欢在人还不多的时候开工。
messages.en: Yes, making an early start is a habit of mine; I like to begin before there are many people around.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上每天清晨都画着一个开工标记：tidrik 记的是反复早早开始的习惯，而非某一次碰巧起早。

gloss_zh: 厌恶、反感、憎恨、深恶痛绝；脱粒

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of disgust, repugnance, repulsion, hatred or abhorrence; in a separate sense, threshing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 厌恶、反感、排斥、憎恨或深恶痛绝的感受；另有农业上的脱粒义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' stmerrija, ripugnanza, repulsjoni, mibegħda jew avversjoni qawwija; f'tifsira oħra, il-firda tal-qamħ mis-sbul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厌恶，觉得某事物令人恶心或难以接受的感受。
强烈反感，对某事物感到抵触或厌弃。
排斥感，因厌恶而想远离某人或某物的感受。
憎恨，对某人或某事抱有强烈敌意或恨意。
深恶痛绝，极其强烈的厌恶或憎恶。
脱粒，把谷粒从谷穗中分离出来的农业作业。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur esprima tidrir għall-moħqrija lejn l-annimali.
formal.en: In his letter, the author expressed abhorrence of cruelty to animals.
formal.zh: 作者在信中表达了对虐待动物行为的深恶痛绝。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt dak l-iskart kollu fil-baħar? David: Ħassejt tidrir; ma nifhimx kif xi ħadd jista' jħallih hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you feel when you saw all that rubbish in the sea? David: I felt disgust; I cannot understand how anyone could leave it there.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看到海里那么多垃圾，你是什么感受？David：我感到厌恶；真不明白怎么会有人把垃圾留在那里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt dak l-iskart kollu fil-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta rajt dak l-iskart kollu fil-baħar?
messages.zh: 看到海里那么多垃圾，你是什么感受？
messages.en: How did you feel when you saw all that rubbish in the sea?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt tidrir; ma nifhimx kif xi ħadd jista' jħallih hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt tidrir; ma nifhimx kif xi ħadd jista' jħallih hemm.
messages.zh: 我感到厌恶；真不明白怎么会有人把垃圾留在那里。
messages.en: I felt disgust; I cannot understand how anyone could leave it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tidrir 的情感义放进“皱眉远离”的画面，再单独画一张麦穗脱粒图；这是分义记忆提示，不把两类意思强行解释成同一来源。

gloss_zh: 脱粒；刺激感或过度敏感

teaching_sense.en_definition: The separation of grain from harvested ears; also, irritation or excessive sensitivity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把谷粒从谷穗中分离出来的脱粒作业；也指刺激感或过度敏感的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-firda tal-qamħ mis-sbul; ukoll, irritazzjoni jew sensittività żejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱粒，将谷粒从谷穗中分离出来。
刺激、不适或过度敏感的状态。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu dwar il-ħsad jispjega kif isir it-tidris tal-qamħ wara li jinġabar mis-sħab.
formal.en: The chapter on harvesting explains how wheat is threshed after it is gathered from the fields.
formal.zh: 关于收割的章节说明了小麦从田里收集起来后如何进行脱粒。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan id-drapp komdu? Marija: Għalija le; inħoss tidris fil-ġilda meta nilbsu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this fabric comfortable? Marija: Not for me; I feel irritation on my skin when I wear it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这种布料穿着舒服吗？Marija：我觉得不舒服；穿上它时，我的皮肤会有刺激感。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp komdu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp komdu?
messages.zh: 这种布料穿着舒服吗？
messages.en: Is this fabric comfortable?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija le; inħoss tidris fil-ġilda meta nilbsu.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija le; inħoss tidris fil-ġilda meta nilbsu.
messages.zh: 我觉得不舒服；穿上它时，我的皮肤会有刺激感。
messages.en: Not for me; I feel irritation on my skin when I wear it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tidris 配两幅互不混淆的小图：麦穗表示“脱粒”，衣料碰到皮肤的不适表示“刺激或过敏感”；读句子时先判断场景。

gloss_zh: 熔化、融化或溶解的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of causing something to melt or dissolve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物熔化、融化，或使其溶解在液体中的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinħall bis-sħana jew f'likwidu.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of melting or dissolving sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物熔化、融化或溶解的行为。

collocations.en: the dissolving of sugar in water

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, l-istudenti osservaw it-tidwib taz-zokkor fl-ilma u rreġistraw kemm dam il-proċess.
formal.en: During the experiment, the students observed sugar dissolving in water and recorded how long the process took.
formal.zh: 实验中，学生们观察了糖在水中的溶解，并记录了这一过程所需的时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Bdejt it-tidwib taċ-ċikkulata? Mark: Iva, qed inħawwadha bil-mod sakemm tinħall kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you started melting the chocolate? Mark: Yes, I am stirring it gently until it has all melted.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你开始融化巧克力了吗？Mark：开始了，我正轻轻搅拌，直到它全部融化。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Bdejt it-tidwib taċ-ċikkulata?
messages.mt_standard: Bdejt it-tidwib taċ-ċikkulata?
messages.zh: 你开始融化巧克力了吗？
messages.en: Have you started melting the chocolate?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed inħawwadha bil-mod sakemm tinħall kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed inħawwadha bil-mod sakemm tinħall kollha.
messages.zh: 开始了，我正轻轻搅拌，直到它全部融化。
messages.en: Yes, I am stirring it gently until it has all melted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象巧克力受热变软、糖粒进入水里逐渐消失的两段动画：tidwib 同时覆盖“融化”和“溶解”，记住它表示过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dressing used for a wound; also, medicine used for treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于覆盖或处理伤口的敷料；也可指用于治疗的药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jintuża biex jgħatti ferita; ukoll, mediċina li tintuża għall-kura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤口敷料，用于覆盖或处理伤口的材料。
药物，用于治疗的药品。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-infermiera nnutat li t-tidwija tal-ferita kienet nadifa u niexfa.
formal.en: In her report, the nurse noted that the wound dressing was clean and dry.
formal.zh: 护士在报告中注明，伤口敷料保持清洁、干燥。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandek tidwija nadifa għall-ferita? Pawlu: Iva, hemm waħda ġdida fil-kaxxa tal-ewwel għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have a clean dressing for the wound? Pawlu: Yes, there is a new one in the first-aid box.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你有干净的伤口敷料吗？Pawlu：有，急救箱里有一份新的。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek tidwija nadifa għall-ferita?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek tidwija nadifa għall-ferita?
messages.zh: 你有干净的伤口敷料吗？
messages.en: Do you have a clean dressing for the wound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda ġdida fil-kaxxa tal-ewwel għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda ġdida fil-kaxxa tal-ewwel għajnuna.
messages.zh: 有，急救箱里有一份新的。
messages.en: Yes, there is a new one in the first-aid box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tidwija 放在急救箱的记忆画面里：一边是覆盖伤口的敷料，一边是药物；结合 ferita“伤口”等上下文判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light, or the illumination provided to make a place or object visible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光，或使某个地方、物体能够被看清的照明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl, jew l-illuminazzjoni li tagħmel post jew oġġett viżibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 光，使人能够看见周围事物的光亮。
照明，使某个空间或物体明亮、可见。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-ħtieġa li jitjieb it-tidwil tat-toroq qrib l-iskola.
formal.en: The report emphasizes the need to improve street lighting near the school.
formal.zh: 报告强调，需要改善学校附近的道路照明。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tidwil hawn biżżejjed biex taqra? David: Le, se nixgħel il-lampa ta' ħdejn is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there enough light here for you to read? David: No, I will switch on the lamp beside the chair.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的光够你看书吗？David：不够，我要把椅子旁边的灯打开。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tidwil hawn biżżejjed biex taqra?
messages.mt_standard: It-tidwil hawn biżżejjed biex taqra?
messages.zh: 这里的光够你看书吗？
messages.en: Is there enough light here for you to read?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nixgħel il-lampa ta' ħdejn is-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nixgħel il-lampa ta' ħdejn is-siġġu.
messages.zh: 不够，我要把椅子旁边的灯打开。
messages.en: No, I will switch on the lamp beside the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个房间从暗变亮：窗外的自然光和打开的台灯都能带来 tidwil；用“看清东西所需的光与照明”把两个义项串起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of causing something to happen or be completed later than intended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某件事比原定时间更晚发生或完成的延迟过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa sseħħ jew titlesta aktar tard milli kien maħsub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延迟或拖延某件事，使其较晚发生或完成的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega li n-nuqqas ta' materjal wassal għat-tidwim tax-xogħol fuq il-bini.
formal.en: The report explains that a shortage of materials led to a delay in the construction work.
formal.zh: 报告说明，材料短缺导致了建筑工程的延误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għadna ma bdejniex? Mark: Qed nistennew iċ-ċavetta; dan it-tidwim se jġegħelna nispiċċaw aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why have we not started yet? Mark: We are waiting for the key; this delay will make us finish later.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们怎么还没开始？Mark：我们在等钥匙；这么一耽搁，我们就得更晚才能完成了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadna ma bdejniex?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadna ma bdejniex?
messages.zh: 我们怎么还没开始？
messages.en: Why have we not started yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistennew iċ-ċavetta; dan it-tidwim se jġegħelna nispiċċaw aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistennew iċ-ċavetta; dan it-tidwim se jġegħelna nispiċċaw aktar tard.
messages.zh: 我们在等钥匙；这么一耽搁，我们就得更晚才能完成了。
messages.en: We are waiting for the key; this delay will make us finish later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象时间表上的任务框被一再向右推移：tidwim 就是让事情拖到更晚的过程；用“原定时间变晚”记住核心含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of tasting food or drink to experience or assess its flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品尝食物或饮料，以感受或判断其味道的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li dduq ikel jew xorb biex tagħraf jew tevalwa t-togħma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 品尝；尝味这一行为。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi sessjoni ta' tidwiq ta' prodotti lokali.
formal.en: The programme includes a tasting session featuring local products.
formal.zh: 活动安排包括一场当地产品品尝会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi għat-tidwiq tal-ġobon is-Sibt? Mark: Iva, nixtieq induq xi ġobon lokali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come to the cheese tasting on Saturday? Mark: Yes, I'd like to try some local cheese.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：星期六你想来参加奶酪品尝活动吗？马克：想啊，我想尝尝当地的奶酪。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi għat-tidwiq tal-ġobon is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi għat-tidwiq tal-ġobon is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六你想来参加奶酪品尝活动吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come to the cheese tasting on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq induq xi ġobon lokali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq induq xi ġobon lokali.
messages.zh: 想啊，我想尝尝当地的奶酪。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to try some local cheese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tidwiq 配上品尝会的画面，重点记住它表示“品尝这个行为”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular instance of tasting food or drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对食物或饮料进行的一次品尝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba waħda li fiha dduq ikel jew xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次品尝；一次试味。

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant ingħata l-opportunità li jagħti tidwiqa lis-soppa qabel jikteb il-kummenti tiegħu.
formal.en: Each participant was given the opportunity to taste the soup before writing their comments.
formal.zh: 每位参与者都有机会先尝一下汤，再写下自己的评价。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Agħti tidwiqa lil din iz-zalza. Pawlu: Tajjeb, ħa nduq ftit.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have a taste of this sauce. Pawlu: All right, let me try a little.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：尝一下这个酱汁。保罗：好，让我尝一点。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħti tidwiqa lil din iz-zalza.
messages.mt_standard: Agħti tidwiqa lil din iz-zalza.
messages.zh: 尝一下这个酱汁。
messages.en: Have a taste of this sauce.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ħa nduq ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ħa nduq ftit.
messages.zh: 好，让我尝一点。
messages.en: All right, let me try a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tidwiqa 想成递来一小勺让你尝一次；与 tidwiq 对照，突出“一次品尝”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of turning or spinning; also indirect talk that avoids getting to the point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 转动或旋转的动作；也指说话拐弯抹角、避开要点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddawwar xi ħaġa jew li xi ħaġa ddur; ukoll diskors li jevita li jasal dritt għall-punt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转动；使方向或位置发生转变的动作。
旋转；围绕轴心转动。
说话拐弯抹角；绕着话题说而不直接切入要点。

formal.mt: It-tidwir tar-rota għandu jkun bil-mod u regolari matul l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The turning of the wheel should be slow and steady during the exercise.
formal.zh: 练习过程中，轮子的转动应当缓慢而平稳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għidli bla tidwir: trid tiġi jew le? Mark: Iva, irrid niġi, imma għadni ma nafx jekk nistax.
colloquial.en: Maja: Tell me straight: do you want to come or not? Mark: Yes, I want to come, but I still don't know whether I can.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：直接告诉我，你到底想不想来？马克：想来，但我还不知道能不能来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għidli bla tidwir: trid tiġi jew le?
messages.mt_standard: Għidli bla tidwir: trid tiġi jew le?
messages.zh: 直接告诉我，你到底想不想来？
messages.en: Tell me straight: do you want to come or not?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid niġi, imma għadni ma nafx jekk nistax.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid niġi, imma għadni ma nafx jekk nistax.
messages.zh: 想来，但我还不知道能不能来。
messages.en: Yes, I want to come, but I still don't know whether I can.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 tidwir：轮子在转圈，话语也在绕圈；分别对应转动和拐弯抹角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of introducing a person or bringing something into a group, setting, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人介绍进某个群体，或把某物引入某种环境、活动中的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha persuna tiġi introdotta fi grupp jew xi ħaġa tiddaħħal f'ambjent jew attività.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of introducing sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 引入某物或介绍某人的行为

collocations.en: introduction of a new member into the group

formal.mt: It-tidħil ta' metodu ġdid fit-tagħlim jeħtieġ spjegazzjoni ċara għall-istudenti.
formal.en: Introducing a new teaching method requires a clear explanation for the students.
formal.zh: 在教学中引入一种新方法，需要向学生作清楚的说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tidħil tal-membru l-ġdid fil-grupp? Mark: Jien. Se nintroduċih lil kulħadd fil-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will take care of introducing the new member to the group? Mark: I will. I'll introduce him to everyone at the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来负责把新成员介绍给大家？马克：我来。我会在会上把他介绍给所有人。

messages.speaker: Maja (团队协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tidħil tal-membru l-ġdid fil-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tidħil tal-membru l-ġdid fil-grupp?
messages.zh: 谁来负责把新成员介绍给大家？
messages.en: Who will take care of introducing the new member to the group?

messages.speaker: Mark (团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Se nintroduċih lil kulħadd fil-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Se nintroduċih lil kulħadd fil-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 我来。我会在会上把他介绍给所有人。
messages.en: I will. I'll introduce him to everyone at the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把新人带到小组面前介绍，再把同一画面扩展到引入新方法或新事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being good, especially kind and well disposed towards others.
