teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为人良善的品质，尤其指待人仁厚、有善心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' persuna li għandha qalb tajba u tittratta lill-oħrajn b'ġentilezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 善良；良善的品质。

formal.mt: It-tieba tagħha dehret fl-għajnuna li tat lill-ġirien mingħajr ma stenniethom jitolbuha.
formal.en: Her goodness showed in the help she gave her neighbours without waiting for them to ask.
formal.zh: 她不等邻居开口便主动提供帮助，体现了她的善良。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Lara reġgħet ġabitli x-xirja llum. Rita: Kemm għandha tieba! Dejjem taħseb fl-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Lara brought my shopping again today. Rita: She's so kind! She's always thinking of others.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：拉拉今天又帮我把买的东西送来了。丽塔：她真善良！总是替别人着想。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Lara reġgħet ġabitli x-xirja llum.
messages.mt_standard: Lara reġgħet ġabitli x-xirja llum.
messages.zh: 拉拉今天又帮我把买的东西送来了。
messages.en: Lara brought my shopping again today.

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandha tieba! Dejjem taħseb fl-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandha tieba! Dejjem taħseb fl-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 她真善良！总是替别人着想。
messages.en: She's so kind! She's always thinking of others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tieba 和主动帮助邻居的画面放在一起，记住它是名词“善良、善心”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To interrupt someone or something; in another sense, to cause someone to hate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打断某人或某事；另一个义项是使某人产生憎恨或厌恶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinterrompi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa; f'sens ieħor, iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jobgħod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打断；使说话或正在进行的事情中断。
使某人憎恨；使产生厌恶。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, 'tiegħeb lill-kelliem' ifisser li interrompa lill-persuna li kienet qed titkellem.
formal.en: In this example, 'tiegħeb lill-kelliem' means that he interrupted the person who was speaking.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，'tiegħeb lill-kelliem' 表示他打断了正在说话的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'tiegħeb' hawn? David: Hawn ifisser 'interrompa'. F'sens ieħor jista' jfisser li ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jobgħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tiegħeb' mean here? David: Here it means 'interrupted'. In another sense, it can mean that he caused someone to hate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 'tiegħeb' 是什么意思？戴维：这里是“打断了”的意思。另一个义项可以表示使某人产生憎恨。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'tiegħeb' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'tiegħeb' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 'tiegħeb' 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tiegħeb' mean here?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser 'interrompa'. F'sens ieħor jista' jfisser li ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jobgħod.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser 'interrompa'. F'sens ieħor jista' jfisser li ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jobgħod.
messages.zh: 这里是“打断了”的意思。另一个义项可以表示使某人产生憎恨。
messages.en: Here it means 'interrupted'. In another sense, it can mean that he caused someone to hate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tiegħeb 做两张独立义项卡：一张画发言被打断，一张写使人产生厌恶，按语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Occupying position three in a sequence, after the second and before the fourth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在顺序中位于第二之后、第四之前的，即第三的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi wara t-tieni u qabel ir-raba' f'sensiela jew f'ordni.

sense_translations.en_definition: third (of a series or order, after second and before fourth)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 第三的，指系列或次序中排在第二之后、第四之前的。

formal.mt: It-tielet kapitlu jippreżenta r-riżultati tal-istudju.
formal.en: The third chapter presents the results of the study.
formal.zh: 第三章介绍该研究的结果。

colloquial.mt: Mark: F'liema sular toqgħod? Sara: Fit-tielet sular. Tista' titla' bil-lift.
colloquial.en: Mark: Which floor do you live on? Sara: On the third floor. You can take the lift up.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你住哪一层？萨拉：第三层，你可以坐电梯上来。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema sular toqgħod?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema sular toqgħod?
messages.zh: 你住哪一层？
messages.en: Which floor do you live on?

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tielet sular. Tista' titla' bil-lift.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tielet sular. Tista' titla' bil-lift.
messages.zh: 第三层，你可以坐电梯上来。
messages.en: On the third floor. You can take the lift up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出四个排队位置，把第三个圈起来标上 tielet；每次看到它就想到“第二之后”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Occupying position two in a sequence, after the first and before the third.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在顺序中位于第一之后、第三之前的，即第二的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi wara l-ewwel u qabel it-tielet f'sensiela jew f'ordni.

sense_translations.en_definition: second (of a series or order, after first and before third)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 第二的，指系列或次序中排在第一之后、第三之前的。
公羊；雄性绵羊。

formal.mt: Fit-tieni jum taż-żjara, l-istudenti osservaw tieni b'qrun kbar fir-razzett.
formal.en: On the second day of the visit, the students observed a ram with large horns on the farm.
formal.zh: 参观的第二天，学生们在农场观察了一只长着大角的公羊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Tieni' dejjem ifisser 'second'? David: Le. F''it-tieni jum' ifisser 'second', imma bħala nom jista' jfisser muntun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'tieni' always mean 'second'? David: No. In 'it-tieni jum' it means 'second', but as a noun it can mean a ram.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：'tieni' 总是表示“第二”吗？戴维：不是。在 'it-tieni jum' 里是“第二”，但作名词时也可以表示公羊。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Tieni' dejjem ifisser 'second'?
messages.mt_standard: 'Tieni' dejjem ifisser 'second'?
messages.zh: 'tieni' 总是表示“第二”吗？
messages.en: Does 'tieni' always mean 'second'?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le. F''it-tieni jum' ifisser 'second', imma bħala nom jista' jfisser muntun.
messages.mt_standard: Le. F''it-tieni jum' ifisser 'second', imma bħala nom jista' jfisser muntun.
messages.zh: 不是。在 'it-tieni jum' 里是“第二”，但作名词时也可以表示公羊。
messages.en: No. In 'it-tieni jum' it means 'second', but as a noun it can mean a ram.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tieni 分开做两张卡：数字二对应形容词“第二”，公羊图片对应名词，避免混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The skin disease called ringworm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称为癣的皮肤疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-marda tal-ġilda magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala ringworm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 癣，一种皮肤疾病。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jsemmi d-dijanjożi ta' tienja u l-kura mogħtija lill-pazjent.
formal.en: The medical report mentions the diagnosis of ringworm and the treatment given to the patient.
formal.zh: 医疗报告提到了癣病诊断以及给予患者的治疗。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tabib qalli li għandi t-tienja. Rita: Spjegalek il-kura? Anna: Iva, u għandi l-istruzzjonijiet miktuba.
colloquial.en: Anna: The doctor told me I have ringworm. Rita: Did he explain the treatment? Anna: Yes, and I have the written instructions.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：医生告诉我，我得了癣。丽塔：他给你解释怎么治疗了吗？安娜：解释了，我也拿到了书面说明。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tabib qalli li għandi t-tienja.
messages.mt_standard: It-tabib qalli li għandi t-tienja.
messages.zh: 医生告诉我，我得了癣。
messages.en: The doctor told me I have ringworm.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Spjegalek il-kura?
messages.mt_standard: Spjegalek il-kura?
messages.zh: 他给你解释怎么治疗了吗？
messages.en: Did he explain the treatment?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandi l-istruzzjonijiet miktuba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandi l-istruzzjonijiet miktuba.
messages.zh: 解释了，我也拿到了书面说明。
messages.en: Yes, and I have the written instructions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tienja 放进“皮肤疾病”词卡，旁边写“癣”；注意结尾是 ja，与 tieni 分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Positioned at the edge of a surface or space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于某个表面或空间的边缘处的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fit-tarf ta' wiċċ jew ta' spazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于边缘的；位于边沿的。

collocations.en: a book positioned on the edge
a block positioned on the edge

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jinsab tieref fuq il-mejda u għandu jitqiegħed aktar lejn iċ-ċentru.
formal.en: The book is on the edge of the table and should be placed closer to the centre.
formal.zh: 书位于桌子边缘，应当往桌子中央挪一些。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ktieb qiegħed tieref fuq il-mejda. Pawlu: Se nressqu lejn in-nofs.
colloquial.en: Maja: The book is on the edge of the table. Pawlu: I'll move it towards the middle.
colloquial.zh: Maja：书放在桌子边缘了。Pawlu：我把它往中间挪。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ktieb qiegħed tieref fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ktieb qiegħed tieref fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 书放在桌子边缘了。
messages.en: The book is on the edge of the table.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nressqu lejn in-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Se nressqu lejn in-nofs.
messages.zh: 我把它往中间挪。
messages.en: I'll move it towards the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tieref 和一本放在桌沿的书联系起来：看到它靠着边，就回想“处于边缘的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling so weak or faint that one seems about to lose consciousness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到十分虚弱、即将失去知觉而昏倒的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħossu dgħajjef ħafna u jkun wasal biex jintilef minn sensih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 快要昏倒的；即将失去知觉的。

collocations.en: a man who is about to faint

formal.mt: Wara li dam bilwieqfa fis-sħana, ir-raġel ħassu tiewi u talab siġġu.
formal.en: After standing in the heat for a long time, the man felt about to faint and asked for a chair.
formal.zh: 在高温下站了很久之后，那名男子觉得自己快要昏倒，便要了一把椅子。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed inħossni tiewi. Rita: Hawn siġġu; oqgħod bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Mark: I feel like I'm about to faint. Rita: Here's a chair; sit down.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我觉得自己快要昏倒了。Rita：这里有把椅子，坐下吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħossni tiewi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħossni tiewi.
messages.zh: 我觉得自己快要昏倒了。
messages.en: I feel like I'm about to faint.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn siġġu; oqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn siġġu; oqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 这里有把椅子，坐下吧。
messages.en: Here's a chair; sit down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 tiewi 的小场景：一个人眼前发黑、赶紧找椅子，表示“快要昏倒”，还没有真正昏倒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question meaning 'of what?', asking what something contains or consists of.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“什么的？”的疑问用语，用来询问某物的内容或构成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' mistoqsija li tfisser 'ta' xiex?' u tistaqsi dwar il-kontenut jew il-materjal ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 什么的？；由什么构成的？

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, il-mistoqsija 'Kaxxa tiex?' titlob lill-istudent jispeċifika l-kontenut tal-kaxxa.
formal.en: In the exercise, the question 'A box of what?' asks the student to specify the contents of the box.
formal.zh: 在练习中，“一盒什么？”这个问题要求学生说明盒子里的内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xtrajt kaxxa. Pawlu: Kaxxa tiex? Maja: Taċ-ċikkulata.
colloquial.en: Maja: I bought a box. Pawlu: A box of what? Maja: Chocolates.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我买了一盒东西。Pawlu：一盒什么？Maja：巧克力。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xtrajt kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Xtrajt kaxxa.
messages.zh: 我买了一盒东西。
messages.en: I bought a box.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kaxxa tiex?
messages.mt_standard: Kaxxa tiex?
messages.zh: 一盒什么？
messages.en: A box of what?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taċ-ċikkulata.
messages.mt_standard: Taċ-ċikkulata.
messages.zh: 巧克力。
messages.en: Chocolates.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiex 放进追问“一盒什么？”里记：别人只说盒子，你用它追问盒子里装的是什么。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of covering an object's surface with a thin layer of silver.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面覆盖一层薄银的工艺或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-wiċċ ta' oġġett jinkesa b'saff irqiq ta' fidda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镀银；在物体表面覆盖薄银层的工艺。

formal.mt: It-tifdid jagħti lill-kuċċarina saff irqiq ta' fidda fuq il-wiċċ tagħha.
formal.en: Silver plating gives the spoon a thin layer of silver on its surface.
formal.zh: 镀银使这把勺子的表面覆盖一层薄银。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-kuċċarina kollha fidda? Toni: Le, għaddiet minn proċess ta' tifdid; il-fidda tinsab fuq il-wiċċ biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this spoon silver all the way through? Toni: No, it has been silver-plated; the silver is only on the surface.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这把勺子整个都是银的吗？Toni：不是，它经过了镀银处理，只有表面是银。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kuċċarina kollha fidda?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kuċċarina kollha fidda?
messages.zh: 这把勺子整个都是银的吗？
messages.en: Is this spoon silver all the way through?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għaddiet minn proċess ta' tifdid; il-fidda tinsab fuq il-wiċċ biss.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għaddiet minn proċess ta' tifdid; il-fidda tinsab fuq il-wiċċ biss.
messages.zh: 不是，它经过了镀银处理，只有表面是银。
messages.en: No, it has been silver-plated; the silver is only on the surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tifdid，就想象给勺子穿上一件薄薄的银外衣：记住是表面“镀银”，不是整件都用银制成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of keeping money instead of spending it, so that it is available for future use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱留存下来而不花掉，以便日后使用的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iżomm il-flus minflok jonfoqhom, biex jużahom fil-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存钱；把金钱留存起来供日后使用的行为。

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' tifdil tal-familja jipprevedi li jitwarrab ammont żgħir kull xahar.
formal.en: The family's savings plan provides for setting aside a small amount each month.
formal.zh: 这个家庭的储蓄计划规定每月存下一小笔钱。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi pjan ta' tifdil għal rota ġdida. Mark: Kemm qed twarrab? Nina: Għaxar ewro kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Nina: I have a savings plan for a new bicycle. Mark: How much are you setting aside? Nina: Ten euros a week.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我有个存钱买新自行车的计划。Mark：你每次存多少？Nina：每周十欧元。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi pjan ta' tifdil għal rota ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi pjan ta' tifdil għal rota ġdida.
messages.zh: 我有个存钱买新自行车的计划。
messages.en: I have a savings plan for a new bicycle.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm qed twarrab?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm qed twarrab?
messages.zh: 你每次存多少？
messages.en: How much are you setting aside?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxar ewro kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għaxar ewro kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 每周十欧元。
messages.en: Ten euros a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用每周往存钱罐放十欧元的画面记 tifdil：重点是持续把钱留下来的“储蓄行为”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of switching off a light, device, or similar thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把灯、设备等关掉，使其停止照明或运行的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha jintfew dawl, apparat jew affarijiet simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关闭灯等事物的行为。

formal.mt: It-tifi tad-dwal wara l-aħħar lezzjoni huwa r-responsabbiltà tal-għalliem.
formal.en: Switching off the lights after the final lesson is the teacher's responsibility.
formal.zh: 最后一节课结束后，关灯是教师的责任。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tifi tad-dwal illejla? Ġanni: Jien. Nitfihom qabel noħroġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will take care of switching off the lights tonight? Ġanni: I will. I'll switch them off before I leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：今晚谁负责关灯？詹尼：我来。我走之前会把灯关掉。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tifi tad-dwal illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tifi tad-dwal illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚谁负责关灯？
messages.en: Who will take care of switching off the lights tonight?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Nitfihom qabel noħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Nitfihom qabel noħroġ.
messages.zh: 我来。我走之前会把灯关掉。
messages.en: I will. I'll switch them off before I leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和离开房间前按下开关的画面绑定，记住它是“关掉”这一行为的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The flowing of liquid over the edge of a container or beyond its usual limits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体超过容器边缘或原有界限而流出的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' likwidu minn fuq ix-xifer ta' kontenitur jew lil hinn mil-limiti tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 液体满溢、漫出或溢出的现象。

formal.mt: It-tifjid tal-ilma mit-tank ikkawża ħsara fis-saqaf.
formal.en: Water overflowing from the tank caused damage to the roof.
formal.zh: 水从水箱中溢出，造成屋顶受损。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm l-ilma mal-art? Mark: Minħabba t-tifjid mit-tank. Diġà għalaqt il-vit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there water on the floor? Mark: Because of the overflow from the tank. I've already turned off the tap.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：地上怎么有水？马克：是水箱溢出来的。我已经关了水龙头。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm l-ilma mal-art?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm l-ilma mal-art?
messages.zh: 地上怎么有水？
messages.en: Why is there water on the floor?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tifjid mit-tank. Diġà għalaqt il-vit.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tifjid mit-tank. Diġà għalaqt il-vit.
messages.zh: 是水箱溢出来的。我已经关了水龙头。
messages.en: Because of the overflow from the tank. I've already turned off the tap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水箱已经装满，水仍越过边缘流出来；用“满到外流”的画面记住溢出。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of curing someone of an illness and restoring their health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某人的疾病治好，使其恢复健康的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha persuna titfejjaq minn marda u terġa' tikseb saħħitha.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of curing sb. of an illness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 治好某人的疾病、使其恢复健康的行为。

formal.mt: L-għan tat-trattament huwa t-tifjiq tal-pazjent mill-marda.
formal.en: The aim of the treatment is to cure the patient of the illness.
formal.zh: 治疗的目标是治好病人的疾病。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu l-għan ta' din il-kura? David: It-tifjiq mill-marda. It-tabib qal li l-kura qed taħdem.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is the aim of this treatment? David: To cure the illness. The doctor said the treatment is working.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这种治疗的目标是什么？戴维：把病治好。医生说治疗正在起作用。

messages.speaker: Anna (家属)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu l-għan ta' din il-kura?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu l-għan ta' din il-kura?
messages.zh: 这种治疗的目标是什么？
messages.en: What is the aim of this treatment?

messages.speaker: David (病人)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifjiq mill-marda. It-tabib qal li l-kura qed taħdem.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifjiq mill-marda. It-tabib qal li l-kura qed taħdem.
messages.zh: 把病治好。医生说治疗正在起作用。
messages.en: To cure the illness. The doctor said the treatment is working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“病人经过医治恢复健康”的完整画面记忆，重点放在把疾病治好的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dishonest conduct used to deceive others or gain an unfair advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过欺骗他人或违反公平规则来获取不正当优势的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' qerq biex wieħed iqarraq b'ħaddieħor jew jikseb vantaġġ inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作弊、欺骗或以不诚实手段获取不正当优势的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-regolamenti tal-iskola jipprojbixxu t-tifjit waqt l-eżamijiet.
formal.en: The school regulations prohibit cheating during examinations.
formal.zh: 学校规章禁止考试期间作弊。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Nista' nħares lejn il-karti tiegħek waqt il-logħba? Toni: Le, dak ikun tifjit. Ejja nilagħbu sew.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can I look at your cards during the game? Toni: No, that would be cheating. Let's play fairly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：玩牌时我能看你的牌吗？托尼：不行，那就是作弊了。我们公平地玩吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nħares lejn il-karti tiegħek waqt il-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nħares lejn il-karti tiegħek waqt il-logħba?
messages.zh: 玩牌时我能看你的牌吗？
messages.en: Can I look at your cards during the game?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak ikun tifjit. Ejja nilagħbu sew.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak ikun tifjit. Ejja nilagħbu sew.
messages.zh: 不行，那就是作弊了。我们公平地玩吧。
messages.en: No, that would be cheating. Let's play fairly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人偷偷看对手的牌来占便宜，把这种不公平的欺骗行为与本词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or occurrence of spraining a joint by twisting it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关节因扭转而受伤的动作或发生过程，如扭伤脚踝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-ġrajja li fiha ġog jitgħawweġ u jweġġa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭伤关节的动作或过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tifkik tal-għaksa li seħħ meta l-atleta waqa'.
formal.en: The report describes the spraining of the ankle that occurred when the athlete fell.
formal.zh: 报告描述了运动员摔倒时扭伤脚踝的情况。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod? Luqa: Minħabba t-tifkik tal-għaksa. Għawwiġtha waqt li kont niġri.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you walking slowly? Luqa: Because I sprained my ankle. I twisted it while I was running.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你怎么走得这么慢？卢卡：因为我扭伤了脚踝。我跑步时把它扭了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod?
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking slowly?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tifkik tal-għaksa. Għawwiġtha waqt li kont niġri.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tifkik tal-għaksa. Għawwiġtha waqt li kont niġri.
messages.zh: 因为我扭伤了脚踝。我跑步时把它扭了。
messages.en: Because I sprained my ankle. I twisted it while I was running.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象跑步落地时脚踝突然一扭，用“关节扭转而受伤”的动作画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of recalling past experiences, remembering something, or keeping someone or something in memory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 回想过去的经历、记起某事，或将某人某事保存在记忆中并加以纪念的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed iġib f'moħħu ġrajjiet tal-imgħoddi, jiftakar xi ħaġa jew iżomm ħajja l-memorja ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对过去经历的追忆或回想。
记起、想起或记住某人某事的行为。
对某人或某事的怀念、铭记或纪念。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċerimonja kienet iddedikata għat-tifkir ta' dawk li tilfu ħajjithom.
formal.en: The ceremony was dedicated to the remembrance of those who had lost their lives.
formal.zh: 这场仪式旨在纪念那些失去生命的人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dawk ir-ritratti qodma? Pietru: Għat-tifkir ta' żmien it-tfulija. Ftit ilu erġajt iltqajt ma' ħabib tal-iskola.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you looking at those old photographs? Pietru: To reminisce about childhood. I recently met a school friend again.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么在看那些老照片？彼得：为了回忆童年。前不久我又见到了一位儿时的同学。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dawk ir-ritratti qodma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dawk ir-ritratti qodma?
messages.zh: 你为什么在看那些老照片？
messages.en: Why are you looking at those old photographs?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tifkir ta' żmien it-tfulija. Ftit ilu erġajt iltqajt ma' ħabib tal-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tifkir ta' żmien it-tfulija. Ftit ilu erġajt iltqajt ma' ħabib tal-iskola.
messages.zh: 为了回忆童年。前不久我又见到了一位儿时的同学。
messages.en: To reminisce about childhood. I recently met a school friend again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把翻看旧照片、突然想起往事、仪式上纪念逝者连成三幅图，分别记住追忆、记起和纪念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object kept or bought as a reminder of a place, event, or experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为留念某个地方、事件或经历而购买或保存的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jinxtara jew jinżamm biex ifakkar f'post, ġrajja jew esperjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为纪念某个地方、事件或经历而购买或保存的纪念品。

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant irċieva tifkira taż-żjara fil-mużew.
formal.en: Each participant received a souvenir of the visit to the museum.
formal.zh: 每位参与者都收到了一件博物馆参观纪念品。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'se tixtri bħala tifkira minn Malta? Karl: Din it-tazza. Se nużaha d-dar u niftakar fil-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Elena: What will you buy as a souvenir from Malta? Karl: This cup. I'll use it at home and remember the trip.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你准备买什么作为马耳他的纪念品？卡尔：这个杯子。我会在家用它，想起这次旅行。

messages.speaker: Elena (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se tixtri bħala tifkira minn Malta?
messages.mt_standard: X'se tixtri bħala tifkira minn Malta?
messages.zh: 你准备买什么作为马耳他的纪念品？
messages.en: What will you buy as a souvenir from Malta?

messages.speaker: Karl (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tazza. Se nużaha d-dar u niftakar fil-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tazza. Se nużaha d-dar u niftakar fil-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 这个杯子。我会在家用它，想起这次旅行。
messages.en: This cup. I'll use it at home and remember the trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旅行结束后带回一个杯子，每次拿起它便想起旅程；把这件留念的实物记作纪念品。

gloss_zh: 女孩；女童；处女座（星座或黄道星座名称）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female child; a girl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 女性儿童，即女孩或女童。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' sess femminili li għadha fl-età tat-tfulija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女孩；女童。
处女座，指天文学中的星座。
处女座，指占星术中的黄道星座。

formal.mt: It-tifla qrat l-istorja quddiem il-klassi u wieġbet il-mistoqsijiet tal-għalliema.
formal.en: The girl read the story in front of the class and answered the teacher's questions.
formal.zh: 这个女孩在全班面前朗读了故事，并回答了老师的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hi dik it-tifla ħdejn il-bieb? Lara: Dik oħti ż-żgħira. Qed tistennieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that girl by the door? Lara: That's my little sister. She's waiting for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门旁边那个女孩是谁？拉拉：那是我妹妹。她正在等我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hi dik it-tifla ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hi dik it-tifla ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门旁边那个女孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is that girl by the door?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik oħti ż-żgħira. Qed tistennieni.
messages.mt_standard: Dik oħti ż-żgħira. Qed tistennieni.
messages.zh: 那是我妹妹。她正在等我。
messages.en: That's my little sister. She's waiting for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“小女孩在班上读故事”的画面记住普通名词义；遇到天文或星座语境，再分别联想到天空中的处女座与占星中的处女座。

gloss_zh: 用围巾或披肩包裹的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wrapping someone or oneself in a scarf or shawl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用围巾或披肩把自己或他人围裹起来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitgeżwer jew igeżwer lil xi ħadd f'xalpa jew f'xalla.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of wrapping up in a scarf of shawl
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用围巾或披肩围裹起来的动作。

formal.mt: L-istampa turi t-tiflif tat-tifla f'xalla qabel ma toħroġ fil-kesħa.
formal.en: The picture shows the girl being wrapped in a shawl before going out into the cold.
formal.zh: 图片展示了女孩在冒寒外出前被披肩围裹起来的情景。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan it-tiflif kollu fix-xalpa? Pawlu: Għax barra hemm riħ kiesaħ ħafna!
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you wrapping yourself up so much in that scarf? Pawlu: Because there's a very cold wind outside!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：怎么用那条围巾把自己裹得这么严实？保罗：因为外面的风特别冷！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tiflif kollu fix-xalpa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tiflif kollu fix-xalpa?
messages.zh: 怎么用那条围巾把自己裹得这么严实？
messages.en: Why are you wrapping yourself up so much in that scarf?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax barra hemm riħ kiesaħ ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Għax barra hemm riħ kiesaħ ħafna!
messages.zh: 因为外面的风特别冷！
messages.en: Because there's a very cold wind outside!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiflif 和“围巾绕好、披肩裹紧”的冬日画面配对记忆；记住它指围裹这个动作，围巾本身可用搭配中的 xalpa 表示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An awkward or clumsy movement made without good control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体控制不够灵活或协调时做出的笨拙动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment goff jew skomdu li jsir mingħajr kontroll tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨拙、不灵活或不协调的动作。

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova taż-żfin, it-tiflik bis-saqajn wera li l-istudent kellu bżonn aktar taħriġ.
formal.en: During the dance rehearsal, the clumsy foot movements showed that the student needed more practice.
formal.zh: 在舞蹈排练中，学生笨拙的脚步动作表明他需要更多练习。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak it-tiflik b'idejk? Mark: Kont qed nipprova naqbad it-tazza qabel taqa'.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that clumsy movement with your hands? Mark: I was trying to catch the cup before it fell.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你刚才双手笨手笨脚地动来动去，是怎么回事？马克：我想在杯子掉下去之前接住它。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak it-tiflik b'idejk?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak it-tiflik b'idejk?
messages.zh: 你刚才双手笨手笨脚地动来动去，是怎么回事？
messages.en: What was that clumsy movement with your hands?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed nipprova naqbad it-tazza qabel taqa'.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed nipprova naqbad it-tazza qabel taqa'.
messages.zh: 我想在杯子掉下去之前接住它。
messages.en: I was trying to catch the cup before it fell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象伸手接杯子时手忙脚乱的样子，把 tiflik 直接对应“笨拙动作”；再用手部和脚部两个搭配巩固动作含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of slicing something or cutting it into pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体切成片或切成块的动作，也可指一般的切割。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li taqta' xi ħaġa fi flieli jew f'biċċiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切片；把东西切成一片片的动作。
切割；把东西切开或切成若干部分的动作。

formal.mt: It-tiflil tal-ħobż fi flieli tal-istess ħxuna jagħmel il-preżentazzjoni aktar pulita.
formal.en: Slicing the bread into slices of equal thickness makes the presentation neater.
formal.zh: 把面包切成厚度一致的片，可以使摆盘更加整齐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lest it-tiflil tal-ħobż? Pawlu: Kważi. Fadal biss żewġ flieli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished slicing the bread? Pawlu: Almost. Just two more slices to cut.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面包切好了吗？保罗：快好了。只剩两片要切了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Lest it-tiflil tal-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Lest it-tiflil tal-ħobż?
messages.zh: 面包切好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished slicing the bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Fadal biss żewġ flieli.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Fadal biss żewġ flieli.
messages.zh: 快好了。只剩两片要切了。
messages.en: Almost. Just two more slices to cut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiflil 想成厨房里连续切面包的动作：看到整齐薄片就想“切片”，看到东西被切开再扩展到较宽泛的“切割”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of going back on an agreement; also, the act of making an error.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 背弃已经达成的协议的行为；也指犯错或出差错的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ma jżommx ma' ftehim; ukoll l-att li wieħed jiżbalja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 背弃协议；不履行已经达成的约定。
犯错；出现错误或偏差。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tifliq mill-ftehim bħala waħda mir-raġunijiet għat-tmiem tal-kollaborazzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes reneging on the agreement as one of the reasons for ending the collaboration.
formal.zh: 报告将背弃协议列为结束合作的原因之一。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex għedt li kien tifliq mill-ftehim? Lara: Għax konna qbilna fuq prezz wieħed, u mbagħad talbu aktar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you say it was reneging on the agreement? Lara: Because we had agreed on one price, and then they asked for more.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么说这是背弃协议？拉拉：因为我们已经谈好了一个价格，后来他们又要求加钱。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għedt li kien tifliq mill-ftehim?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għedt li kien tifliq mill-ftehim?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这是背弃协议？
messages.en: Why did you say it was reneging on the agreement?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax konna qbilna fuq prezz wieħed, u mbagħad talbu aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax konna qbilna fuq prezz wieħed, u mbagħad talbu aktar.
messages.zh: 因为我们已经谈好了一个价格，后来他们又要求加钱。
messages.en: Because we had agreed on one price, and then they asked for more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tifliq 配两张学习卡：一张写“说好的协议没有遵守”，另一张写“判断出了差错”；分别记住两个义项，避免把所有犯错都理解成违约。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of inserting a wedge into a gap or between objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把楔子插入缝隙或物体之间的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddaħħal feles fi spazju dejjaq jew bejn żewġ oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 插入楔子的动作；楔入。

collocations.en: inserting a wedge under the door

formal.mt: L-illustrazzjoni turi t-tiflis taħt il-bieb biex il-bieb jinżamm miftuħ.
formal.en: The illustration shows a wedge being inserted under the door to keep it open.
formal.zh: 插图展示了把楔子塞到门底下，以使门保持敞开的操作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għalxiex iservi t-tiflis taħt il-bieb? Pawlu: Biex il-bieb jibqa' miftuħ waqt li ndaħħlu l-kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is inserting a wedge under the door for? Pawlu: To keep the door open while we bring the boxes in.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：往门底下塞楔子有什么用？保罗：让门保持开着，方便我们把箱子搬进去。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalxiex iservi t-tiflis taħt il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għalxiex iservi t-tiflis taħt il-bieb?
messages.zh: 往门底下塞楔子有什么用？
messages.en: What is inserting a wedge under the door for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex il-bieb jibqa' miftuħ waqt li ndaħħlu l-kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Biex il-bieb jibqa' miftuħ waqt li ndaħħlu l-kaxxi.
messages.zh: 让门保持开着，方便我们把箱子搬进去。
messages.en: To keep the door open while we bring the boxes in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把三角形木楔慢慢塞进门底的动作，用这个具体画面记 tiflis；学习重点是“插入楔子”的过程，搭配中的 feles 表示楔子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making or altering something so that it falsely appears genuine or true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作虚假内容或改动真实内容，使其看起来真实可信的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li toħloq jew tibdel xi ħaġa biex tidher ġenwina jew vera meta mhijiex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伪造；篡改，使内容或物件呈现虚假的真实性。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' tifliz tad-dokumenti li fih inbidlu d-dati oriġinali.
formal.en: The report describes a case of document falsification in which the original dates were altered.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起文件篡改事件，其中文件上的原始日期被改动了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din id-data tidher mibdula. Taħseb li hemm tifliz? Mark: Ejja nqabblu l-kopja mal-oriġinal qabel niddeċiedu.
colloquial.en: Maja: This date looks altered. Do you think there has been falsification? Mark: Let's compare the copy with the original before deciding.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个日期看起来被改过。你觉得有人篡改了吗？马克：我们先把副本和原件比较一下，再下结论。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din id-data tidher mibdula. Taħseb li hemm tifliz?
messages.mt_standard: Din id-data tidher mibdula. Taħseb li hemm tifliz?
messages.zh: 这个日期看起来被改过。你觉得有人篡改了吗？
messages.en: This date looks altered. Do you think there has been falsification?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nqabblu l-kopja mal-oriġinal qabel niddeċiedu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nqabblu l-kopja mal-oriġinal qabel niddeċiedu.
messages.zh: 我们先把副本和原件比较一下，再下结论。
messages.en: Let's compare the copy with the original before deciding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifliz 配上“文件日期被改、签名被冒写”的画面，记住伪造与篡改的共同点是让虚假内容显得真实；再留意词尾 z，与 tiflis 的 s 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Close and careful examination of something to assess its details or accuracy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了解细节或核对准确性而进行的仔细检查和审查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami bir-reqqa ta' xi ħaġa biex jiġu vverifikati d-dettalji jew l-eżattezza tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仔细审查；对细节进行认真检查。

formal.mt: It-tifqid tal-kontijiet żvela differenza bejn l-ammont irreġistrat u l-ammont imħallas.
formal.en: Scrutiny of the accounts revealed a difference between the recorded amount and the amount paid.
formal.zh: 对账目的仔细审核发现，记录金额与实际支付金额之间存在差异。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għadek ma bgħattx ir-rapport? Mark: Għadu għaddej it-tifqid taċ-ċifri. Irridu nkunu ċerti li kollox jaqbel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why haven't you sent the report yet? Mark: The figures are still being scrutinized. We want to be sure everything matches.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么还没把报告发出去？马克：数字还在仔细核查中。我们想确保所有数据都能对上。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadek ma bgħattx ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadek ma bgħattx ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 你怎么还没把报告发出去？
messages.en: Why haven't you sent the report yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu għaddej it-tifqid taċ-ċifri. Irridu nkunu ċerti li kollox jaqbel.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu għaddej it-tifqid taċ-ċifri. Irridu nkunu ċerti li kollox jaqbel.
messages.zh: 数字还在仔细核查中。我们想确保所有数据都能对上。
messages.en: The figures are still being scrutinized. We want to be sure everything matches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着放大镜逐项核对账目，把 tifqid 记成“细看、核对、查出差异”的审查过程；文件与账目两个搭配帮助记住其细致检查的意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Explosions or loud, sudden noises.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爆炸，或突然发出的强烈响声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Splużjonijiet jew ħsejjes qawwija u f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爆炸；物体爆裂时发生的剧烈爆发。
巨响；声音很大的响动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tifqigħ li nstema' qrib il-port matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The report describes the explosions heard near the harbour during the night.
formal.zh: 报告描述了夜间在港口附近听到的爆炸声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak it-tifqigħ? Mark: Iva, ġej mil-logħob tan-nar fil-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear those bangs? Mark: Yes, they are coming from the fireworks in the square.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见那些巨响了吗？马克：听见了，是广场上的烟花声。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dak it-tifqigħ?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dak it-tifqigħ?
messages.zh: 你听见那些巨响了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear those bangs?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mil-logħob tan-nar fil-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mil-logħob tan-nar fil-pjazza.
messages.zh: 听见了，是广场上的烟花声。
messages.en: Yes, they are coming from the fireworks in the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烟花连续砰砰炸响，把 tifqigħ 同时连到“爆炸”和“巨响”两个画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The protrusion of the lower jaw, which projects forwards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 下颌向前突出或前伸的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ 'il quddiem tax-xedaq t'isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下颌前突；下颌向前突出的状态。

collocations.en: slight protrusion of the lower jaw

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-profil issemmi tifqim ħafif tax-xedaq t'isfel.
formal.en: The description of the profile mentions a slight protrusion of the lower jaw.
formal.zh: 这段侧面轮廓描述提到了轻微的下颌前突。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser tifqim f'din id-deskrizzjoni? Pawlu: Ifisser li x-xedaq t'isfel joħroġ 'il quddiem.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does tifqim mean in this description? Pawlu: It means that the lower jaw projects forwards.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这段描述里的 tifqim 是什么意思？保罗：意思是下颌向前突出。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tifqim f'din id-deskrizzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tifqim f'din id-deskrizzjoni?
messages.zh: 这段描述里的 tifqim 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tifqim mean in this description?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li x-xedaq t'isfel joħroġ 'il quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li x-xedaq t'isfel joħroġ 'il quddiem.
messages.zh: 意思是下颌向前突出。
messages.en: It means that the lower jaw projects forwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个人物侧脸，用箭头标出向前突出的下颌，把 tifqim 固定在这个位置上记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a person or community becomes poor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或群体逐渐变穷、陷入贫困的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna jew komunità ssir fqira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变穷的过程；经济状况恶化而逐渐陷入贫困。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza t-tifqir tal-familji li tilfu s-sors ewlieni tad-dħul tagħhom.
formal.en: The study analyses the impoverishment of families that lost their main source of income.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了失去主要收入来源的家庭逐渐陷入贫困的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-artiklu jitkellem dwar it-tifqir tal-familji. Mark: Jiġifieri kif il-familji qed isiru ifqar? Maja: Iva, kif id-dħul tagħhom jonqos u l-ispejjeż jiżdiedu.
colloquial.en: Maja: This article discusses the impoverishment of families. Mark: You mean how families are becoming poorer? Maja: Yes, as their income falls and their expenses rise.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章讲的是家庭贫困化。马克：就是家庭怎样逐渐变穷吗？玛雅：对，收入减少，开支却增加。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-artiklu jitkellem dwar it-tifqir tal-familji.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-artiklu jitkellem dwar it-tifqir tal-familji.
messages.zh: 这篇文章讲的是家庭贫困化。
messages.en: This article discusses the impoverishment of families.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri kif il-familji qed isiru ifqar?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri kif il-familji qed isiru ifqar?
messages.zh: 就是家庭怎样逐渐变穷吗？
messages.en: You mean how families are becoming poorer?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kif id-dħul tagħhom jonqos u l-ispejjeż jiżdiedu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kif id-dħul tagħhom jonqos u l-ispejjeż jiżdiedu.
messages.zh: 对，收入减少，开支却增加。
messages.en: Yes, as their income falls and their expenses rise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钱包里的钱一天天减少，用连续变化的画面记住 tifqir 强调“变穷的过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process in which young animals emerge from their eggs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 幼小动物从卵或蛋中破壳而出的孵化过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih il-frieħ joħorġu mill-bajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孵化；幼体从卵或蛋中破壳而出。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tifqis tal-bajd u rreġistraw il-ħin meta ħareġ kull fellus.
formal.en: The students observed the hatching of the eggs and recorded the time when each chick emerged.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了鸡蛋的孵化，并记录了每只小鸡出壳的时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara, il-bajda qed tinqasam! Omm: Iva, beda t-tifqis. Ejja naraw il-fellus joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look, the egg is cracking! Mum: Yes, hatching has begun. Let's watch the chick come out.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，蛋壳正在裂开！妈妈：对，开始孵化出壳了。我们看看小鸡怎样出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, il-bajda qed tinqasam!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, il-bajda qed tinqasam!
messages.zh: 看，蛋壳正在裂开！
messages.en: Look, the egg is cracking!

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, beda t-tifqis. Ejja naraw il-fellus joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, beda t-tifqis. Ejja naraw il-fellus joħroġ.
messages.zh: 对，开始孵化出壳了。我们看看小鸡怎样出来。
messages.en: Yes, hatching has begun. Let's watch the chick come out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifqis 配上一幅蛋壳裂开、小鸡探头的图，记住它表示孵化出壳这一过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The separation of people or things, or their division into distinct parts or groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或事物分开，或将整体划分成不同部分、群体的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-separazzjoni ta' nies jew affarijiet, jew il-qsim tagħhom f'partijiet jew gruppi distinti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分离；使原本在一起的人或事物彼此分开。
划分；把整体分成不同部分或群体。

formal.mt: It-tifrid tal-materjal f'kategoriji differenti jiffaċilita r-riċiklaġġ.
formal.en: The separation of material into different categories makes recycling easier.
formal.zh: 把材料分类分开有助于回收利用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm tliet kontenituri? Ben: Għat-tifrid tal-iskart: wieħed għall-karta, wieħed għall-ħġieġ u wieħed għall-plastik.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are there three containers? Ben: For waste separation: one for paper, one for glass and one for plastic.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么有三个容器？本：用来给垃圾分类，一个放纸，一个放玻璃，一个放塑料。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tliet kontenituri?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tliet kontenituri?
messages.zh: 为什么有三个容器？
messages.en: Why are there three containers?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tifrid tal-iskart: wieħed għall-karta, wieħed għall-ħġieġ u wieħed għall-plastik.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tifrid tal-iskart: wieħed għall-karta, wieħed għall-ħġieġ u wieħed għall-plastik.
messages.zh: 用来给垃圾分类，一个放纸，一个放玻璃，一个放塑料。
messages.en: For waste separation: one for paper, one for glass and one for plastic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把混在一起的物品分放进几个盒子，用“分开并划分”的动作记住 tifrid。

gloss_zh: 进入；涌入；枝条生长；分枝

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming or flowing in; also the growth of branches or division into branches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入或涌入；也指枝条的生长，或分出枝杈的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dħul jew influss; ukoll it-tkabbir tal-friegħi jew il-qsim f'fergħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进入；从外部到内部的到来过程。
涌入；人或事物大量进入。
枝条生长；植物长出或发展枝条的过程。
分枝；分出枝杈或形成分支的过程。

collocations.en: the growth of branches on trees

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi t-tifrigħ tas-siġra u juri kif il-friegħi l-ġodda jimlew l-ispazju ta' madwarha.
formal.en: The study describes the tree's branching and shows how the new branches fill the space around it.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了树木的分枝，并展示新枝如何伸展到周围空间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu t-tifrigħ li ssemmi din il-paġna dwar is-siġar? Pawlu: Huwa t-tkabbir tal-friegħi. Ara kemm ħarġu friegħi ġodda minn din is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the tifrigħ mentioned on this page about trees? Pawlu: It is the growth of branches. Look how many new branches this tree has grown.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这页讲树木的内容里，tifrigħ 是什么？保罗：就是枝条生长。你看，这棵树长出了多少新枝。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu t-tifrigħ li ssemmi din il-paġna dwar is-siġar?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu t-tifrigħ li ssemmi din il-paġna dwar is-siġar?
messages.zh: 这页讲树木的内容里，tifrigħ 是什么？
messages.en: What is the tifrigħ mentioned on this page about trees?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa t-tkabbir tal-friegħi. Ara kemm ħarġu friegħi ġodda minn din is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa t-tkabbir tal-friegħi. Ara kemm ħarġu friegħi ġodda minn din is-siġra.
messages.zh: 就是枝条生长。你看，这棵树长出了多少新枝。
messages.en: It is the growth of branches. Look how many new branches this tree has grown.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张情景卡记 tifrigħ：一张画人群进入大厅，一张画树木长出分枝；分别对应两组词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Destruction that breaks or ruins things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物破碎、损毁或遭到严重破坏的过程或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerda li tkisser l-affarijiet jew tħallihom fi stat ħażin ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毁坏；破坏；毁灭。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tifrik li ħalla t-terremot fir-raħal.
formal.en: The report describes the destruction that the earthquake left in the village.
formal.zh: 报告描述了地震给村庄造成的破坏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt ir-ritratti ta' wara t-terremot? Pawlu: Iva, kien hemm tifrik kbir. Ħafna djar inqerdu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the photos taken after the earthquake? Pawlu: Yes, there was extensive destruction. Many houses were destroyed.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看了地震后的照片吗？保罗：看了，破坏很严重，很多房屋都被毁了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt ir-ritratti ta' wara t-terremot?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt ir-ritratti ta' wara t-terremot?
messages.zh: 你看了地震后的照片吗？
messages.en: Did you see the photos taken after the earthquake?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien hemm tifrik kbir. Ħafna djar inqerdu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien hemm tifrik kbir. Ħafna djar inqerdu.
messages.zh: 看了，破坏很严重，很多房屋都被毁了。
messages.en: Yes, there was extensive destruction. Many houses were destroyed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifrik 配上一幅房屋破碎的画面，整词记作“毁坏”；再与表示“分离”的 tifriq 对照，留意末尾 k 和 q。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The separation of things or people, or the distribution of things among recipients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事物或人分开的行为，也可指把物品分发或分配给不同对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jiġu mifruda affarijiet jew nies, jew li jitqassmu affarijiet lil diversi persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分离；分开；使原本在一起的人或事物彼此分开。
分发；分配；把物品分给不同的人或地方。

formal.mt: It-tifriq tal-ikel lill-familji fil-bżonn se jsir fiċ-ċentru tal-komunità.
formal.en: The distribution of food to families in need will take place at the community centre.
formal.zh: 向有需要的家庭分发食物的活动将在社区中心进行。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex għandek żewġ boroż? David: Biex nagħmel it-tifriq tal-iskart: waħda għall-karti u l-oħra għall-plastik.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why do you have two bags? David: To separate the waste: one for paper and the other for plastic.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么拿着两个袋子？戴维：用来分类垃圾，一个装纸，另一个装塑料。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek żewġ boroż?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek żewġ boroż?
messages.zh: 你为什么拿着两个袋子？
messages.en: Why do you have two bags?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nagħmel it-tifriq tal-iskart: waħda għall-karti u l-oħra għall-plastik.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nagħmel it-tifriq tal-iskart: waħda għall-karti u l-oħra għall-plastik.
messages.zh: 用来分类垃圾，一个装纸，另一个装塑料。
messages.en: To separate the waste: one for paper and the other for plastic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先分开，再分给别人”串起 tifriq 的两个义项：垃圾分离是 separation，食物分发是 distribution。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spreading of something over an area, or its dispersal in different directions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物铺开或撒到一片区域，也指某物向不同方向散开、扩散。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa tinfirex fuq żona, jew li titferrex f'direzzjonijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺开；铺撒；散布到一定范围。
散开；分散；向不同方向扩散。

collocations.en: the dispersal of seeds by the wind

formal.mt: Ir-riħ jgħin fit-tifrix taż-żrieragħ fuq żona wiesgħa.
formal.en: The wind helps disperse seeds over a wide area.
formal.zh: 风有助于种子在广阔的区域内散播。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se nagħmlu l-ewwel fil-ġnien? Toni: Nibdew bit-tifrix tal-kompost, imbagħad inħawwlu l-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Nina: What shall we do first in the garden? Toni: We'll start by spreading the compost, then plant the flowers.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们在花园里先做什么？托尼：先铺撒堆肥，然后种花。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nagħmlu l-ewwel fil-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nagħmlu l-ewwel fil-ġnien?
messages.zh: 我们在花园里先做什么？
messages.en: What shall we do first in the garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew bit-tifrix tal-kompost, imbagħad inħawwlu l-fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew bit-tifrix tal-kompost, imbagħad inħawwlu l-fjuri.
messages.zh: 先铺撒堆肥，然后种花。
messages.en: We'll start by spreading the compost, then plant the flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象堆肥铺满地面、种子随风散开，用这两个画面记 tifrix 的“铺撒”和“扩散”，共同点是散到更大范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Diversion or recreation that provides enjoyment and a break from everyday concerns.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带来乐趣、让人暂时放下日常烦忧的消遣或娱乐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Divertiment jew rikreazzjoni li jagħtu gost u waqfa mill-ħsibijiet ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消遣；借有趣的活动暂时转移注意力、排遣烦闷。
娱乐；供休息放松和享受乐趣的活动。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-ġurnata jinkludi ħin għat-tifriġ wara s-sessjonijiet ta' studju.
formal.en: The day's programme includes time for recreation after the study sessions.
formal.zh: 当天的安排包括学习活动结束后的娱乐时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ġurnata kollha nistudjaw? Mark: Le, hemm ukoll ħin għat-tifriġ. Wara noħorġu nimxu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we studying all day? Mark: No, there is also time for recreation. Afterwards we'll go out for a walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们要学一整天吗？马克：不用，也有消遣时间。之后我们出去散步。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġurnata kollha nistudjaw?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġurnata kollha nistudjaw?
messages.zh: 我们要学一整天吗？
messages.en: Are we studying all day?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hemm ukoll ħin għat-tifriġ. Wara noħorġu nimxu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hemm ukoll ħin għat-tifriġ. Wara noħorġu nimxu.
messages.zh: 不用，也有消遣时间。之后我们出去散步。
messages.en: No, there is also time for recreation. Afterwards we'll go out for a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象学习结束后合上书、散步放松，把 tifriġ 记成让心情轻松的消遣时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gladness or the expression of joy; also the bearing of fruit by a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜悦的心情或表达喜悦的欢庆；也指植物结出果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ferħ jew espressjoni ta' ferħ; ukoll meta pjanta tagħmel il-frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜悦；内心高兴、欣喜的感受。
欢庆；以言语、行动等表达喜悦。
结果实；植物长出果实的过程。

collocations.zh: 极大的喜悦或热烈的欢庆

collocations.en: the bearing of fruit by trees

formal.mt: Id-djarju tal-ġnien jirreġistra żmien it-tifriħ ta' kull siġra u l-kwantità ta' frott li tagħmel.
formal.en: The garden diary records each tree's fruit-bearing season and the quantity of fruit it produces.
formal.zh: 园艺日记记录每棵树的结果时节以及产果量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaddejt mill-eżami! Mark: X'tifriħ! Illejla niċċelebraw flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I passed the exam! Mark: What joy! Tonight we'll celebrate together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我考试通过了！马克：太高兴了！今晚我们一起庆祝。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddejt mill-eżami!
messages.mt_standard: Għaddejt mill-eżami!
messages.zh: 我考试通过了！
messages.en: I passed the exam!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tifriħ! Illejla niċċelebraw flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: X'tifriħ! Illejla niċċelebraw flimkien.
messages.zh: 太高兴了！今晚我们一起庆祝。
messages.en: What joy! Tonight we'll celebrate together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifriħ 配成两幅图：人们开心欢庆，以及树上结满果实；这是帮助区分词义的情景联想。

gloss_zh: 亲昵地反复爱抚；大量抚摸

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extensive affectionate stroking or caressing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着亲昵和宠爱进行的长时间或反复抚摸、爱抚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħafna tmellis u żegħil biex tintwera l-imħabba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量或反复的亲昵爱抚、抚摸。

formal.mt: Wara ħafna tifsid u tmellis, il-qattus raqad ħdejn sidtu.
formal.en: After plenty of affectionate caressing and stroking, the cat fell asleep beside its owner.
formal.zh: 在被亲昵地反复爱抚后，猫在女主人身旁睡着了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-qattus reġa' ġie fuq ħoġri. Mark: Irid aktar tifsid! Ara kif qed iressaq rasu lejn idek.
colloquial.en: Sara: The cat has climbed onto my lap again. Mark: He wants more caressing! Look how he's moving his head towards your hand.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：猫又爬到我腿上了。马克：它还想让你多摸摸呢！看，它正把头凑向你的手。

messages.speaker: Sara (宠物主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus reġa' ġie fuq ħoġri.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus reġa' ġie fuq ħoġri.
messages.zh: 猫又爬到我腿上了。
messages.en: The cat has climbed onto my lap again.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irid aktar tifsid! Ara kif qed iressaq rasu lejn idek.
messages.mt_standard: Irid aktar tifsid! Ara kif qed iressaq rasu lejn idek.
messages.zh: 它还想让你多摸摸呢！看，它正把头凑向你的手。
messages.en: He wants more caressing! Look how he's moving his head towards your hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象猫不停把头凑到手边，要求摸了又摸，用这个画面记 tifsid 的反复亲昵爱抚；这里不把 heavy 理解为用力粗暴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The design or planning of something, or the plan developed for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某事物进行设计或规划，也指由此形成的计划、方案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tfassil ta' kif għandha tkun jew issir xi ħaġa, jew il-pjan li jirriżulta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某事物所作的设计；设计构思。
计划；规划；拟定的方案。

collocations.en: the design and planning of the project

formal.mt: It-tifsil tal-ġnien jinkludi mogħdija ċentrali u spazju għas-siġar.
formal.en: The design of the garden includes a central path and space for trees.
formal.zh: 花园的设计包括一条中央小径和种树的空间。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Nistgħu nibdew ix-xogħol fil-ġnien? Ġorġ: Għadna rridu nlestu t-tifsil. L-ewwel niddeċiedu fejn se tkun il-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Elena: Can we start work in the garden? Ġorġ: We still need to finish the planning. First we'll decide where the path will go.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我们可以开始做花园里的工程了吗？乔治：还得先完成规划，先决定小径放在哪里。

messages.speaker: Elena (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nibdew ix-xogħol fil-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nibdew ix-xogħol fil-ġnien?
messages.zh: 我们可以开始做花园里的工程了吗？
messages.en: Can we start work in the garden?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (园艺设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna rridu nlestu t-tifsil. L-ewwel niddeċiedu fejn se tkun il-mogħdija.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna rridu nlestu t-tifsil. L-ewwel niddeċiedu fejn se tkun il-mogħdija.
messages.zh: 还得先完成规划，先决定小径放在哪里。
messages.en: We still need to finish the planning. First we'll decide where the path will go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifsil 放在开工前的设计桌上：先画布局、再定方案，由此连记“设计”和“计划”两个意思。

gloss_zh: 用襁褓包裹婴儿；襁褓包裹

teaching_sense.en_definition: The wrapping of a baby in cloth or a blanket as a swaddle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用布或毯子把婴儿包成襁褓的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tarbija titgeżwer fi drapp jew kutra bħala fisqija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用襁褓包裹婴儿；把婴儿裹在布或毯子里的动作。

collocations.zh: 用于包裹婴儿的襁褓毯

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi t-tifsiq tat-trabi u l-użu tal-kutri għal dan il-għan.
formal.en: The chapter describes the swaddling of babies and the use of blankets for this purpose.
formal.zh: 这一章描述了给婴儿裹襁褓以及为此使用毯子的做法。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hi l-kutra għat-tifsiq? Luqa: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq, ħdejn il-ħwejjeġ tat-tarbija.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the swaddling blanket? Luqa: In the top drawer, beside the baby's clothes.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：襁褓毯在哪里？卢卡：在最上面的抽屉里，婴儿衣服旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-kutra għat-tifsiq?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-kutra għat-tifsiq?
messages.zh: 襁褓毯在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the swaddling blanket?

messages.speaker: Luqa (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq, ħdejn il-ħwejjeġ tat-tarbija.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq, ħdejn il-ħwejjeġ tat-tarbija.
messages.zh: 在最上面的抽屉里，婴儿衣服旁边。
messages.en: In the top drawer, beside the baby's clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“婴儿、毯子、包成襁褓”三个画面记 tifsiq；重点记它表示包裹这个动作，而不是毯子本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: What a word, expression, action, or event means, including its significance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词语、表达、行为或事件所传达的含义，也指它所具有的意义或重要性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li tfisser kelma, espressjoni, azzjoni jew ġrajja, jew l-importanza li għandha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含义；意思；词语或表达所传达的内容。
意义；重要性；某事在特定背景下所具有的分量或价值。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina t-tifsir simboliku tal-kuluri fil-poeżija.
formal.en: The study examines the symbolic significance of colours in the poem.
formal.zh: 这项研究探讨了诗中颜色的象征意义。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fhimt it-tifsir ta' din il-frażi? Ben: Mhux sew. Tista' tagħtini eżempju?
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you understand the meaning of this phrase? Ben: Not quite. Can you give me an example?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你明白这个短语的意思了吗？本：还不太明白。你能给我举个例子吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fhimt it-tifsir ta' din il-frażi?
messages.mt_standard: Fhimt it-tifsir ta' din il-frażi?
messages.zh: 你明白这个短语的意思了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand the meaning of this phrase?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux sew. Tista' tagħtini eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: Mhux sew. Tista' tagħtini eżempju?
messages.zh: 还不太明白。你能给我举个例子吗？
messages.en: Not quite. Can you give me an example?

cognitive_memory_aid: 遇到 tifsir，先问“它表达什么”，记 meaning；再问“它有何分量”，记 significance，用两个问题区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A meaning of something, or an explanation or interpretation of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物的一个含义，也指对它所作的解释、理解或诠释。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li tfisser xi ħaġa, jew spjegazzjoni jew interpretazzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个含义；一种意思。
一种解释；对词语、文本、行为或事件的理解、诠释。

collocations.zh: 另一个含义或另一种解释

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tipproponi tifsira ġdida għall-aħħar vers tal-poeżija.
formal.en: The author proposes a new interpretation of the poem's final line.
formal.zh: 作者对这首诗的最后一行提出了一种新的诠释。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-kelma għandha tifsira waħda biss? Daniel: Le, għandha tifsira oħra wkoll. Is-sentenza tgħinna nifhmu liema waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this word have only one meaning? Daniel: No, it has another meaning too. The sentence helps us understand which one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个词只有一个意思吗？丹尼尔：不是，它还有另一个意思。句子能帮助我们判断是哪一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kelma għandha tifsira waħda biss?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kelma għandha tifsira waħda biss?
messages.zh: 这个词只有一个意思吗？
messages.en: Does this word have only one meaning?

messages.speaker: Daniel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandha tifsira oħra wkoll. Is-sentenza tgħinna nifhmu liema waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandha tifsira oħra wkoll. Is-sentenza tgħinna nifhmu liema waħda.
messages.zh: 不是，它还有另一个意思。句子能帮助我们判断是哪一个。
messages.en: No, it has another meaning too. The sentence helps us understand which one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifsira 写在一张释义卡片上：卡片可以记录“一个含义”，也可以记录“一种解释”；搭配 tifsira oħra 记“另一个意思”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of something hot cooling until it becomes lukewarm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 热的东西逐渐降温、变得温热的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa sħuna tibred sakemm issir fietla.

sense_translations.en_definition: becoming tepid (usually used for things with a high temperature, i.e. in the sense of cooling)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得温热，通常指温度较高的东西冷却下来。

formal.mt: It-tiftil tas-soppa jieħu aktar ħin meta l-borma tibqa' mgħottija.
formal.en: The soup takes longer to cool to lukewarm when the pot remains covered.
formal.zh: 锅一直盖着时，汤需要更长时间才能冷却至温热。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ferragħt it-te fil-platt? Mark: Biex inħaffef it-tiftil tiegħu. Għadu jaħraq wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you pour the tea into the saucer? Mark: To help it cool to lukewarm faster. It's still too hot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把茶倒进茶碟里？马克：为了让它快点凉到温热。现在还太烫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ferragħt it-te fil-platt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ferragħt it-te fil-platt?
messages.zh: 你为什么把茶倒进茶碟里？
messages.en: Why did you pour the tea into the saucer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inħaffef it-tiftil tiegħu. Għadu jaħraq wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inħaffef it-tiftil tiegħu. Għadu jaħraq wisq.
messages.zh: 为了让它快点凉到温热。现在还太烫。
messages.en: To help it cool to lukewarm faster. It's still too hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯烫茶慢慢变得温热，用 tiftil 记住从热到温的降温过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of removing stitches to undo a seam in a garment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拆除衣物上的针脚、把缝合处拆开的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih jitneħħew il-ponti biex tinfetaħ ħjata f'biċċa ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of unstitching a garment
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆除衣物缝线的动作；拆开衣物的缝合处。

formal.mt: It-tiftiq tal-ħjata għandu jsir bil-mod biex id-drapp ma jitqattax.
formal.en: The seam should be unpicked slowly so that the fabric does not tear.
formal.zh: 拆缝线时应慢慢操作，以免扯破布料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tneħħi l-ħajt mill-kmiem? Rita: Dan hu t-tiftiq. Imbagħad nerġa' nħit il-kmiem biex ikunu iqsar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you removing the thread from the sleeves? Rita: This is unstitching. Then I'll sew the sleeves again to make them shorter.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在拆袖子上的线？丽塔：这就是拆线。然后我会把袖子重新缝好，改短一些。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tneħħi l-ħajt mill-kmiem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tneħħi l-ħajt mill-kmiem?
messages.zh: 你为什么在拆袖子上的线？
messages.en: Why are you removing the thread from the sleeves?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu t-tiftiq. Imbagħad nerġa' nħit il-kmiem biex ikunu iqsar.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu t-tiftiq. Imbagħad nerġa' nħit il-kmiem biex ikunu iqsar.
messages.zh: 这就是拆线。然后我会把袖子重新缝好，改短一些。
messages.en: This is unstitching. Then I'll sew the sleeves again to make them shorter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiftiq 和裁缝逐针拆开旧缝线的画面绑定，记住它指衣物拆线。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of briefly dipping something into a liquid, such as a biscuit into tea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物短暂浸入液体的动作，例如把饼干浸入茶中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih xi ħaġa titgħaddas għal ftit ħin f'likwidu, bħal gallettina fit-te.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浸蘸；把东西短暂浸入液体的动作。

formal.mt: It-tiftit tal-gallettini fit-te jagħmilhom aktar rotob.
formal.en: Dunking biscuits in tea makes them softer.
formal.zh: 把饼干浸入茶中会使它们变软。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek frak fit-te? Mark: Mit-tiftit tal-gallettini. Waħda baqgħet fit-te wisq u nkisret.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there crumbs in your tea? Mark: From dunking biscuits. One stayed in the tea too long and broke.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的茶里为什么有碎屑？马克：浸饼干弄的。有一块在茶里泡太久，碎了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek frak fit-te?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek frak fit-te?
messages.zh: 你的茶里为什么有碎屑？
messages.en: Why are there crumbs in your tea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mit-tiftit tal-gallettini. Waħda baqgħet fit-te wisq u nkisret.
messages.mt_standard: Mit-tiftit tal-gallettini. Waħda baqgħet fit-te wisq u nkisret.
messages.zh: 浸饼干弄的。有一块在茶里泡太久，碎了。
messages.en: From dunking biscuits. One stayed in the tea too long and broke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着饼干往茶里轻轻一浸再提起，用这个动作记住 tiftit。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of looking for something or investigating a subject to find information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寻找某物的活动，或为获取信息而对某个主题进行查找、研究。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha wieħed jipprova jsib xi ħaġa jew jinvestiga suġġett biex jikseb tagħrif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 研究；围绕某个主题查找资料并进行探究。
搜寻；寻找某人、某物或某项信息。

formal.mt: It-tiftix fl-arkivji għen lill-istudenta ssib dokumenti importanti għall-istudju tagħha.
formal.en: Research in the archives helped the student find important documents for her study.
formal.zh: 在档案中查考资料帮助这名女学生找到了对其研究重要的文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer it-tiftix għaċ-ċwievet? Mark: Għadni ma sibthomx. Se nfittex fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the search for the keys going? Mark: I haven't found them yet. I'll look in the bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：钥匙找得怎么样了？马克：还没找到。我去包里找找。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer it-tiftix għaċ-ċwievet?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer it-tiftix għaċ-ċwievet?
messages.zh: 钥匙找得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the search for the keys going?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma sibthomx. Se nfittex fil-basket.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma sibthomx. Se nfittex fil-basket.
messages.zh: 还没找到。我去包里找找。
messages.en: I haven't found them yet. I'll look in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“找钥匙”和“查档案”两个画面记 tiftix：寻找实物，也可研究资料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of opening something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物打开或开启的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih tinfetaħ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打开；开启的动作或过程。

formal.mt: It-tiftiħ tat-twieqi filgħodu jgħin biex tidħol arja friska fil-klassi.
formal.en: Opening the windows in the morning helps fresh air enter the classroom.
formal.zh: 早晨打开窗户有助于让新鲜空气进入教室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiftiħ tal-bibien għada? Mark: Jien. Niġi qabel ma jaslu t-tfal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will take care of opening the doors tomorrow? Mark: I will. I'll come before the children arrive.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天谁负责开门？马克：我来。我会在孩子们到之前过来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiftiħ tal-bibien għada?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiftiħ tal-bibien għada?
messages.zh: 明天谁负责开门？
messages.en: Who will take care of opening the doors tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Niġi qabel ma jaslu t-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Niġi qabel ma jaslu t-tfal.
messages.zh: 我来。我会在孩子们到之前过来。
messages.en: I will. I'll come before the children arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiftiħ 配上早晨推开门窗的画面，记住它指“打开”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of releasing air or gas from the stomach through the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃里的气体经口排出的动作，即嗳气或打饱嗝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' arja jew gass mill-istonku minn ġol-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗳气；打饱嗝，即胃中气体从口中排出。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ġie nnutat tifwiq wara li t-tarbija xorbot il-ħalib.
formal.en: During the observation, burping was noted after the baby drank milk.
formal.zh: 观察期间，记录到婴儿喝奶后出现嗳气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Mark: Kien tifwiq. Skużani, għadni kemm xrobt xarba bil-gass.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that sound? Mark: It was a burp. Excuse me, I've just had a fizzy drink.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才是什么声音？马克：我打了个饱嗝。不好意思，我刚喝了汽水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak il-ħoss?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak il-ħoss?
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien tifwiq. Skużani, għadni kemm xrobt xarba bil-gass.
messages.mt_standard: Kien tifwiq. Skużani, għadni kemm xrobt xarba bil-gass.
messages.zh: 我打了个饱嗝。不好意思，我刚喝了汽水。
messages.en: It was a burp. Excuse me, I've just had a fizzy drink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifwiq 和喝完汽水后从嘴里排出一口气的画面联系起来，记住“打饱嗝”。

gloss_zh: 溢出；鱼活动造成的水面气泡

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spilling of liquid over an edge, or bubbles on the surface of water caused by fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体越过容器或边界而溢出的现象；也指鱼活动造成的水面气泡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' likwidu minn fuq ix-xifer ta' kontenitur, jew bżieżaq fuq wiċċ l-ilma kkawżati mill-ħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 液体满出并越过边缘的现象；溢出。

sense_translations.en_definition: bubbles on the surface of a body of water, caused by fish
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鱼活动造成的水面气泡。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tifwir tal-ilma mit-tank waqt il-mili.
formal.en: The report describes water overflowing from the tank during filling.
formal.zh: 报告描述了水箱注水时发生的溢水现象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara dawk il-bżieżaq fuq l-ilma? Pawlu: Iva, dak it-tifwir ġej mill-ħut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you see those bubbles on the water? Pawlu: Yes, those surface bubbles are caused by the fish.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见水面上那些气泡了吗？保罗：看见了，那些气泡是鱼造成的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dawk il-bżieżaq fuq l-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dawk il-bżieżaq fuq l-ilma?
messages.zh: 你看见水面上那些气泡了吗？
messages.en: Do you see those bubbles on the water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak it-tifwir ġej mill-ħut.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak it-tifwir ġej mill-ħut.
messages.zh: 看见了，那些气泡是鱼造成的。
messages.en: Yes, those surface bubbles are caused by the fish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个水面画面记忆：杯里的水漫过边缘，以及鱼在水面留下气泡；看到 tifwir 就按语境选择其中一幅。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The gentle blowing of a light breeze.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻柔的微风吹拂的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nfiħ ħafif u ġentili ta' żiffa.

sense_translations.en_definition: the blowing of a gentle breeze
sense_translations.zh_definition: 微风轻轻吹拂。

collocations.en: the gentle blowing of the breeze
the gentle breeze blowing on the face

formal.mt: It-tifwiġ taż-żiffa kien iċaqlaq bil-mod il-weraq tas-siġar.
formal.en: The gentle blowing of the breeze moved the leaves of the trees slowly.
formal.zh: 微风轻拂，树叶随之缓缓摇动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm sabiħ hawn taħt is-siġra! Mark: Iva, inħoss it-tifwiġ fuq wiċċi. Ejja noqogħdu hawn ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's lovely here under the tree! Mark: Yes, I can feel the gentle breeze on my face. Let's stay here for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这树下真舒服！马克：是啊，我能感觉到微风拂面。我们在这里待一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm sabiħ hawn taħt is-siġra!
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm sabiħ hawn taħt is-siġra!
messages.zh: 这树下真舒服！
messages.en: It's lovely here under the tree!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inħoss it-tifwiġ fuq wiċċi. Ejja noqogħdu hawn ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inħoss it-tifwiġ fuq wiċċi. Ejja noqogħdu hawn ftit.
messages.zh: 是啊，我能感觉到微风拂面。我们在这里待一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, I can feel the gentle breeze on my face. Let's stay here for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifwiġ 记成树荫下微风拂面、叶片轻摇的感觉，重点是风吹得轻柔。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something fragrant or giving it a pleasant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物散发香气、带上宜人气味的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tingħata riħa tfuħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of making sth. fragrant
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变香、散发香气的动作；增香。

formal.mt: Għat-tifwiħ tal-ħwejjeġ, tqiegħdu boroż żgħar tal-lavanda fl-armarju.
formal.en: Small bags of lavender were placed in the wardrobe to scent the clothes.
formal.zh: 为了给衣物添香，人们在衣柜里放了小袋薰衣草。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex poġġejt il-lavanda fl-armarju? Rita: Għat-tifwiħ tal-ħwejjeġ. Togħġobni ħafna din ir-riħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you put lavender in the wardrobe? Rita: To scent the clothes. I really like this smell.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把薰衣草放进衣柜？丽塔：给衣服添点香气。我很喜欢这个味道。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejt il-lavanda fl-armarju?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejt il-lavanda fl-armarju?
messages.zh: 你为什么把薰衣草放进衣柜？
messages.en: Why did you put lavender in the wardrobe?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tifwiħ tal-ħwejjeġ. Togħġobni ħafna din ir-riħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tifwiħ tal-ħwejjeġ. Togħġobni ħafna din ir-riħa.
messages.zh: 给衣服添点香气。我很喜欢这个味道。
messages.en: To scent the clothes. I really like this smell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把薰衣草香袋放进衣柜，用 tifwiħ 记住“让东西变香”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of confusion, or an interruption that prevents an activity from continuing normally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 思绪或情况不清楚的混乱状态；也指使活动无法正常继续的扰乱或中断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' konfużjoni, jew interruzzjoni li ma tħallix attività tkompli b'mod normali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 思绪、理解或情况上的混乱。
使正常活动或秩序受到影响的扰乱、中断。

formal.mt: Il-ħsara fis-sistema kkawżat tifxil fil-ħidma tal-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The system fault caused disruption to the office's work.
formal.zh: 系统故障扰乱了办公室的工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi żewġ skedi differenti u dan qed joħloq tifxil. Mark: Ejja naraw liema waħda hija l-ġdida.
colloquial.en: Lara: I have two different schedules, and this is causing confusion. Mark: Let's see which one is the new one.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我有两份不同的时间表，这把我弄糊涂了。马克：我们看看哪一份是新的。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi żewġ skedi differenti u dan qed joħloq tifxil.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi żewġ skedi differenti u dan qed joħloq tifxil.
messages.zh: 我有两份不同的时间表，这把我弄糊涂了。
messages.en: I have two different schedules, and this is causing confusion.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naraw liema waħda hija l-ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naraw liema waħda hija l-ġdida.
messages.zh: 我们看看哪一份是新的。
messages.en: Let's see which one is the new one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两份互相矛盾的时间表：看的人思绪混乱，工作也因此受扰；用这个场景同时记住 tifxil 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The flow of blood out of the body, especially from the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 血液从身体流出的现象，尤其指鼻子出血。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ tad-demm mill-ġisem, speċjalment mill-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出血，尤其指流鼻血。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi episodju ta' tifġir mill-imnieħer li seħħ waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes an episode of nosebleeding that occurred during the lesson.
formal.zh: 报告描述了课堂上发生的一次鼻出血。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kelli tifġir mill-imnieħer dalgħodu. Pawlu: Għadu ħiereġ id-demm? Lara: Le, waqaf.
colloquial.en: Lara: I had a nosebleed this morning. Pawlu: Is it still bleeding? Lara: No, it stopped.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我今天早上流鼻血了。Pawlu：现在还在流吗？Lara：没有，已经止住了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli tifġir mill-imnieħer dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli tifġir mill-imnieħer dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 我今天早上流鼻血了。
messages.en: I had a nosebleed this morning.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu ħiereġ id-demm?
messages.mt_standard: Għadu ħiereġ id-demm?
messages.zh: 现在还在流吗？
messages.en: Is it still bleeding?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, waqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Le, waqaf.
messages.zh: 没有，已经止住了。
messages.en: No, it stopped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifġir 和纸巾上出现鼻血的场景相连，先记“出血”，再加上“尤其常指鼻出血”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of breeding horses so that they produce offspring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让马匹繁殖并产生后代的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tat-tnissil taż-żwiemel biex ikollhom il-frieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马匹的繁育；使马匹繁殖后代的活动。
马匹繁育；以繁殖马匹为内容的活动。

formal.mt: Ir-razzett għandu programm ta' tifħil taż-żwiemel u jżomm rekords tal-frieħ.
formal.en: The farm has a horse-breeding programme and keeps records of the foals.
formal.zh: 这家农场设有马匹繁育计划，并保存幼马记录。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-razzett joffri lezzjonijiet tal-irkib? Toni: Le, hawn naħdmu fit-tifħil taż-żwiemel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this farm offer riding lessons? Toni: No, we work in horse breeding here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这家农场开设骑马课吗？Toni：没有，我们这里从事马匹繁育。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-razzett joffri lezzjonijiet tal-irkib?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-razzett joffri lezzjonijiet tal-irkib?
messages.zh: 这家农场开设骑马课吗？
messages.en: Does this farm offer riding lessons?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn naħdmu fit-tifħil taż-żwiemel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn naħdmu fit-tifħil taż-żwiemel.
messages.zh: 没有，我们这里从事马匹繁育。
messages.en: No, we work in horse breeding here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tifħil 时想象农场里母马身边站着幼马，抓住“繁殖出下一代马匹”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of charring a material through heat, or searing its surface with intense heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使材料受热而炭化、烧焦，或用强热灼烧其表面的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih materjal jiswied bis-sħana jew jinħaraq fil-wiċċ bi sħana qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炭化；材料受热而变黑、烧焦的过程。
灼烧；以强热烧灼表面的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-istudenti osservaw it-tifħim tal-injam u l-bidla fil-kulur tal-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the students observed the charring of the wood and the change in the colour of its surface.
formal.zh: 在演示过程中，学生观察了木材的炭化过程及其表面颜色的变化。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex din il-biċċa injam sewda minn barra? Mark: Minħabba t-tifħim; is-sħana ħarqet il-wiċċ tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is this piece of wood black on the outside? Mark: Because of charring; the heat burned its surface.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这块木头外面为什么是黑的？Mark：因为发生了炭化，高温把它的表面烧焦了。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-biċċa injam sewda minn barra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-biċċa injam sewda minn barra?
messages.zh: 这块木头外面为什么是黑的？
messages.en: Why is this piece of wood black on the outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tifħim; is-sħana ħarqet il-wiċċ tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tifħim; is-sħana ħarqet il-wiċċ tagħha.
messages.zh: 因为发生了炭化，高温把它的表面烧焦了。
messages.en: Because of charring; the heat burned its surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifħim 记成木头受热后表面变黑的过程：由这个画面连接“炭化、烧焦”和“表面灼烧”。

gloss_zh: 使事物变得淫秽或有伤风化

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something obscene or indecent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过改变内容或表达方式，使某事物变得淫秽、下流或有伤风化的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha xi ħaġa ssir oxxena jew indiċenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某事物变得淫秽、下流或有伤风化。

formal.mt: L-editur talab li jitneħħew iż-żidiet li wasslu għat-tifħix tal-istorja.
formal.en: The editor requested the removal of the additions that had made the story indecent.
formal.zh: 编辑要求删去那些使故事变得有伤风化的新增内容。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex neħħejt dawk iċ-ċajtiet mill-istorja? Pawlu: Għax wasslu għat-tifħix tagħha, u rrid naqraha lit-tfal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you remove those jokes from the story? Pawlu: Because they made it indecent, and I want to read it to the children.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把故事里的那些笑话删了？保罗：因为它们让故事变得有伤风化，而我要把故事读给孩子们听。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex neħħejt dawk iċ-ċajtiet mill-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex neħħejt dawk iċ-ċajtiet mill-istorja?
messages.zh: 你为什么把故事里的那些笑话删了？
messages.en: Why did you remove those jokes from the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax wasslu għat-tifħix tagħha, u rrid naqraha lit-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Għax wasslu għat-tifħix tagħha, u rrid naqraha lit-tfal.
messages.zh: 因为它们让故事变得有伤风化，而我要把故事读给孩子们听。
messages.en: Because they made it indecent, and I want to read it to the children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一篇普通故事被加入下流笑话：记住这个词强调“使内容变得淫秽”的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of cutting or making a small notch in an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体上切出或刻出一个小凹口的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha ssir talja żgħira f'oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在物体上刻出或切出凹口。

collocations.en: making a notch at the edge of a board

formal.mt: Il-manwal juri l-proċess tat-tifżir fit-tarf tal-bord biex il-biċċiet joqogħdu flimkien.
formal.en: The manual shows the process of making a notch at the edge of the board so that the pieces fit together.
formal.zh: 手册展示了在木板边缘开缺口的过程，以便各部件能够相互嵌合。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm bżonn tifżir hawn? Ġanni: Biex din il-biċċa tidħol fit-talja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do we need to make a notch here? Ġanni: So that this piece fits into the notch.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里为什么需要开个凹口？詹尼：这样这块部件才能嵌进凹口。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm bżonn tifżir hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm bżonn tifżir hawn?
messages.zh: 这里为什么需要开个凹口？
messages.en: Why do we need to make a notch here?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex din il-biċċa tidħol fit-talja.
messages.mt_standard: Biex din il-biċċa tidħol fit-talja.
messages.zh: 这样这块部件才能嵌进凹口。
messages.en: So that this piece fits into the notch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifżir 记成木工正在刻凹口的动作画面：重点是“开出凹口”这个过程，而成品凹口可在例句中用 talja 表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Biting that happens frequently or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多次发生或持续反复的咬、啃咬行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gdim li jsir ta' spiss jew darba wara l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁或反复发生的咬、啃咬行为。

formal.mt: It-tigdim ripetut tal-ġeru ħalla marki fuq is-saqajn tas-siġġu.
formal.en: The puppy's repeated biting left marks on the chair legs.
formal.zh: 小狗反复啃咬，在椅子腿上留下了痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-tigdim kollu qed jagħmilli ħsara lis-siġġu. | Mark: Agħti ġugarell lill-ġeru biex jigdem fih.
