colloquial.en: Maja: All this biting is damaging my chair. | Mark: Give the puppy a toy to bite.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这样一直咬，我的椅子都被弄坏了。 | Mark：给小狗一个玩具让它咬吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (养狗人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tigdim kollu qed jagħmilli ħsara lis-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tigdim kollu qed jagħmilli ħsara lis-siġġu.
messages.zh: 这样一直咬，我的椅子都被弄坏了。
messages.en: All this biting is damaging my chair.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħti ġugarell lill-ġeru biex jigdem fih.
messages.mt_standard: Agħti ġugarell lill-ġeru biex jigdem fih.
messages.zh: 给小狗一个玩具让它咬吧。
messages.en: Give the puppy a toy to bite.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗对着椅子腿一口接一口地咬，把 tigdim 和“反复啃咬”的连续画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of putting things into piles or heaps, or allowing them to accumulate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西叠放、堆成一堆，或让事物不断积聚的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqegħid ta' affarijiet waħda fuq l-oħra jew il-ġbir tagħhom f'munzell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西一件件叠放起来，形成一堆。
把东西聚拢、堆成一大堆。
事物逐渐增加、积聚的过程。

formal.mt: It-tigdis ta' kaxxi quddiem il-bieb ixekkel id-dħul fil-maħżen.
formal.en: Piling up boxes in front of the door obstructs access to the storeroom.
formal.zh: 在门前堆放箱子会阻碍进入储藏室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-tigdis ta' karti qed jieħu l-mejda kollha. | Pawlu: Għandek raġun; issa nqassamhom f'fajls.
colloquial.en: Sara: This pile-up of papers is taking over the whole table. | Pawlu: You're right; I'll sort them into files now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些纸越堆越多，整张桌子都占满了。 | Pawlu：你说得对，我现在就把它们分类归档。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tigdis ta' karti qed jieħu l-mejda kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tigdis ta' karti qed jieħu l-mejda kollha.
messages.zh: 这些纸越堆越多，整张桌子都占满了。
messages.en: This pile-up of papers is taking over the whole table.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; issa nqassamhom f'fajls.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; issa nqassamhom f'fajls.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我现在就把它们分类归档。
messages.en: You're right; I'll sort them into files now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tigdis 想成桌上的纸一张张增加，最后堆成小山；同一画面串起“堆放、堆成堆、积聚”三个义项。

gloss_zh: 呻吟声；尤指母牛产犊时的呻吟

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moaning, especially the sound made by a cow while giving birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呻吟，尤其指母牛产犊时发出的呻吟声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ta' krib, speċjalment dak li tagħmel baqra waqt li tkun qed tiled.

sense_translations.en_definition: moaning (especially used of the sound made by calving bovines)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟，尤其用于指牛在产犊时发出的呻吟声。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi sema' t-tigriż tal-baqra waqt li kienet qed tiled u sejjaħ lill-veterinarju.
formal.en: The farmer heard the cow moaning while she was giving birth and called the veterinarian.
formal.zh: 农民听到母牛产犊时的呻吟声，便叫来了兽医。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed tisma' t-tigriż tal-baqra? | Ġużeppi: Iva, qed tiled, u l-veterinarju qiegħed ħdejha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you hear the cow moaning? | Ġużeppi: Yes, she's giving birth, and the veterinarian is beside her.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你听到母牛的呻吟声了吗？ | Ġużeppi：听到了，它正在产犊，兽医就在旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' t-tigriż tal-baqra?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' t-tigriż tal-baqra?
messages.zh: 你听到母牛的呻吟声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the cow moaning?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed tiled, u l-veterinarju qiegħed ħdejha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed tiled, u l-veterinarju qiegħed ħdejha.
messages.zh: 听到了，它正在产犊，兽医就在旁边。
messages.en: Yes, she's giving birth, and the veterinarian is beside her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tigriż 时联想产房里的母牛低声呻吟，用“产犊时听见的声音”这个具体场景固定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young tiger that is still growing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年龄尚小、仍在生长的老虎，即幼虎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tigra ta' età żgħira li għadha qed tikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幼小的老虎；幼虎。

collocations.en: a young tiger beside its mother
collocations.zh: 依偎在母亲身旁的幼虎

formal.mt: It-tigrott baqa' qrib ommu waqt li l-persunal tal-park osserva l-imġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: The young tiger stayed close to its mother while the park staff observed its behaviour.
formal.zh: 公园工作人员观察幼虎的行为时，它一直待在母亲身旁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara t-tigrott jilgħab bil-ballun! | Nina: Rajtu! Issa mar jiġri ħdejn ommu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at the young tiger playing with the ball! | Nina: I saw it! Now it's run over to its mother.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看，那只小老虎在玩球！ | Nina：我看到了！它现在跑到妈妈身边去了。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara t-tigrott jilgħab bil-ballun!
messages.mt_standard: Ara t-tigrott jilgħab bil-ballun!
messages.zh: 看，那只小老虎在玩球！
messages.en: Look at the young tiger playing with the ball!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Issa mar jiġri ħdejn ommu.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Issa mar jiġri ħdejn ommu.
messages.zh: 我看到了！它现在跑到妈妈身边去了。
messages.en: I saw it! Now it's run over to its mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tigrott 和“一只追着球跑、又跑回妈妈身边的小老虎”配成词卡，突出它仍是幼虎。

gloss_zh: 动物乳房喷乳；乳汁喷出

teaching_sense.en_definition: The squirting of milk from an animal's udder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乳汁从动物乳房中呈细流或喷射状流出的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ tal-ħalib f'ġettijiet mill-beżżula ta' annimal.

sense_translations.en_definition: squirting of milk from an animal's udders
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乳汁从动物乳房中喷出的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħlib, it-tigżiż tal-ħalib mill-beżżula tal-baqra kien jidher ċar.
formal.en: During milking, the milk could clearly be seen squirting from the cow's udder.
formal.zh: 挤奶时，可以清楚地看见乳汁从母牛乳房中喷出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara t-tigżiż tal-ħalib fil-barmil? | Toni: Iva, il-ħalib qed joħroġ f'ġettijiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see the milk squirting into the bucket? | Toni: Yes, the milk is coming out in little jets.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到乳汁喷进桶里了吗？ | Toni：看到了，乳汁正一小股一小股地喷出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara t-tigżiż tal-ħalib fil-barmil?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara t-tigżiż tal-ħalib fil-barmil?
messages.zh: 你看到乳汁喷进桶里了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the milk squirting into the bucket?

messages.speaker: Toni (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħalib qed joħroġ f'ġettijiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħalib qed joħroġ f'ġettijiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 看到了，乳汁正一小股一小股地喷出来。
messages.en: Yes, the milk is coming out in little jets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象挤奶时乳汁一小股一小股喷进铁桶，把 tigżiż 记成这个喷乳过程，而非桶里的牛奶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of lighting a fire or causing something to begin burning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 点起火焰或使某物开始燃烧的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih jitqabbad nar jew xi ħaġa tibda taqbad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点火、引燃，即使火开始燃烧的行为。

formal.mt: It-tikbis tan-nar kien aktar faċli meta ntuża injam niexef.
formal.en: Kindling the fire was easier when dry wood was used.
formal.zh: 使用干木柴时，点火更容易。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex it-tikbis tan-nar qed jieħu daqshekk fit-tul? | Rita: Għax l-injam għadu mxarrab; ħa nġib ftit injam niexef.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why is lighting the fire taking so long? | Rita: Because the wood is still wet; I'll get some dry wood.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：怎么点个火要这么久？ | Rita：因为木柴还是湿的，我去拿些干木柴。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tikbis tan-nar qed jieħu daqshekk fit-tul?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tikbis tan-nar qed jieħu daqshekk fit-tul?
messages.zh: 怎么点个火要这么久？
messages.en: Why is lighting the fire taking so long?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-injam għadu mxarrab; ħa nġib ftit injam niexef.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-injam għadu mxarrab; ħa nġib ftit injam niexef.
messages.zh: 因为木柴还是湿的，我去拿些干木柴。
messages.en: Because the wood is still wet; I'll get some dry wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tikbis 和“干木柴终于被点着”的瞬间连起来记，重点是引燃这一动作过程。

gloss_zh: 使丈夫因妻子不忠而受婚姻背叛的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making a husband a cuckold through sexual infidelity involving his wife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使丈夫因妻子与他人发生婚外性关系而遭受配偶背叛的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih raġel miżżewweġ jiġi ingannat permezz ta' relazzjoni sesswali bejn martu u persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某男子因妻子与他人发生性关系而遭受婚姻背叛；俗称使其戴绿帽子的行为。

collocations.zh: 关于使丈夫遭受妻子性背叛的指控
涉及妻子不忠、丈夫遭背叛的故事

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, it-tikbix iwassal għal kriżi ta' fiduċja bejn il-miżżewġin.
formal.en: In the novel, the cuckolding leads to a crisis of trust between the spouses.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，妻子不忠、丈夫遭受背叛的事件引发了夫妻间的信任危机。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ifisser tikbix f'dan ir-rakkont? | Daniel: Ifisser li r-raġel jiġi ingannat għax martu jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' persuna oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does tikbix mean in this story? | Daniel: It means the husband is betrayed because his wife has a sexual relationship with someone else.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个故事里的 tikbix 是什么意思？ | Daniel：指妻子与他人发生性关系，使丈夫遭受婚姻背叛。

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser tikbix f'dan ir-rakkont?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser tikbix f'dan ir-rakkont?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 tikbix 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tikbix mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Daniel (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li r-raġel jiġi ingannat għax martu jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' persuna oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li r-raġel jiġi ingannat għax martu jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' persuna oħra.
messages.zh: 指妻子与他人发生性关系，使丈夫遭受婚姻背叛。
messages.en: It means the husband is betrayed because his wife has a sexual relationship with someone else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tikbix 时画出“丈夫、妻子、婚外对象”的关系图，标出妻子的性不忠使丈夫遭受背叛；本条按行为名词学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of folding and sewing the edge of a garment to make a finished hem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣物边缘折起并缝好，使边缘整齐收口的缝制工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih jintlewa u jinħiet it-tarf ta' libsa biex ikun lest u pulit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣物边缘的折边缝制。

formal.mt: Wara li jiġi aġġustat it-tul tal-qalziet, isir it-tikfif biex it-truf ikunu puliti.
formal.en: After the length of the trousers is adjusted, the hems are sewn to give the edges a neat finish.
formal.zh: 调整裤长之后，再缝好裤脚，使边缘整齐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-qalziet twil wisq għalija. Tista' tqassru? Marija: Iva, inqassru u nagħmel it-tikfif bl-idejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: These trousers are too long for me. Can you shorten them? Marija: Yes, I'll shorten them and sew the hems by hand.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这条裤子对我来说太长了。你能改短吗？玛丽亚：可以，我会改短，再手工缝好裤脚。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-qalziet twil wisq għalija. Tista' tqassru?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-qalziet twil wisq għalija. Tista' tqassru?
messages.zh: 这条裤子对我来说太长了。你能改短吗？
messages.en: These trousers are too long for me. Can you shorten them?

messages.speaker: Marija (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inqassru u nagħmel it-tikfif bl-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inqassru u nagħmel it-tikfif bl-idejn.
messages.zh: 可以，我会改短，再手工缝好裤脚。
messages.en: Yes, I'll shorten them and sew the hems by hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tikfif 写在裤脚折边的示意图旁，想象先折起布边、再一针针缝好；用这个动作记住“缝边”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wrapping a dead body in a shroud, or wrapping oneself in material such as a blanket for warmth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用裹尸布包裹遗体的行为；也指用毯子等把自己裹起来，例如为了保暖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġisem ta' mejjet jitgeżwer f'kefen, jew li persuna titgeżwer f'xi ħaġa, bħal kutra, biex tisħon.

sense_translations.en_definition: wrapping of a corpse in a shroud
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用裹尸布包裹遗体；裹殓。

sense_translations.en_definition: wrapping of one's person (e.g. to keep warm)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己的身体裹起来，例如裹上毯子保暖。

collocations.en: wrapping the deceased in a shroud

formal.mt: It-tikfin tal-mejjet sar b'attenzjoni u b'rispett qabel id-difna.
formal.en: The deceased was wrapped in a shroud with care and respect before burial.
formal.zh: 安葬之前，人们细心而恭敬地为逝者裹殓。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadni nħoss il-bard, anki b'din il-kutra. Pawlu: Ipprova t-tikfin f'żewġ kutri sakemm tisħon il-kamra.
colloquial.en: Nina: I'm still cold, even with this blanket. Pawlu: Try wrapping yourself in two blankets until the room warms up.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：即使盖着这条毯子，我还是觉得冷。保罗：试着用两条毯子把自己裹起来，等房间暖和些。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nħoss il-bard, anki b'din il-kutra.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nħoss il-bard, anki b'din il-kutra.
messages.zh: 即使盖着这条毯子，我还是觉得冷。
messages.en: I'm still cold, even with this blanket.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova t-tikfin f'żewġ kutri sakemm tisħon il-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova t-tikfin f'żewġ kutri sakemm tisħon il-kamra.
messages.zh: 试着用两条毯子把自己裹起来，等房间暖和些。
messages.en: Try wrapping yourself in two blankets until the room warms up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“布把身体包裹起来”的画面记 tikfin：裹尸布对应裹殓，毯子对应保暖；看清语境再选中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of uttering curses or speaking offensively about God or things regarded as sacred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说出咒骂之语的行为；也指用冒犯性言语亵渎上帝或被视为神圣的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jingħad kliem ta' saħta jew kliem li jinsulta lil Alla jew lil dak li jitqies sagru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咒骂；说诅咒他人的话。
用言语亵渎上帝或神圣事物。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-djalogu, it-tikfir kontra Alla ġie distint mill-insulti indirizzati lill-karattri l-oħra.
formal.en: In the analysis of the dialogue, blasphemy against God was distinguished from insults directed at the other characters.
formal.zh: 在对这段对话的分析中，亵渎上帝的言语与针对其他人物的辱骂被区分开来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-tikfir kollu qed idejjaqni. Mark: Għandek raġun. Nistgħu nitkellmu mingħajr ma nisħtu.
colloquial.en: Sara: All this cursing is bothering me. Mark: You're right. We can talk without cursing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这样不停地咒骂让我很不舒服。马克：你说得对。我们可以好好说话，不用咒骂。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tikfir kollu qed idejjaqni.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tikfir kollu qed idejjaqni.
messages.zh: 这样不停地咒骂让我很不舒服。
messages.en: All this cursing is bothering me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Nistgħu nitkellmu mingħajr ma nisħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Nistgħu nitkellmu mingħajr ma nisħtu.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我们可以好好说话，不用咒骂。
messages.en: You're right. We can talk without cursing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tikfir 配两张言语卡片：“咒骂他人”和“亵渎神圣”；借说话对象的不同，记牢两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of sadness, emotional anguish, or melancholy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悲伤、内心痛苦或忧郁的情绪状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' niket, tbatija emozzjonali jew dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲伤；难过的情绪。
内心的剧烈痛苦；悲苦。
忧郁；低落而带有愁绪的心情。

formal.mt: Il-poeżija tesprimi t-tikjib ta' persuna li tiftakar fi żmien kuntent li għadda.
formal.en: The poem expresses the melancholy of a person remembering a happy time that has passed.
formal.zh: 这首诗表达了一个人回忆逝去的幸福时光时所怀有的忧郁。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex hemm daqshekk tikjib f'din il-kanzunetta? Daniel: Għax titkellem dwar xi ħadd li tilef lil ħabib għażiż.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is there so much sadness in this song? Daniel: Because it's about someone who lost a dear friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这首歌为什么这么悲伤？丹尼尔：因为它讲的是一个失去挚友的人。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk tikjib f'din il-kanzunetta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk tikjib f'din il-kanzunetta?
messages.zh: 这首歌为什么这么悲伤？
messages.en: Why is there so much sadness in this song?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax titkellem dwar xi ħadd li tilef lil ħabib għażiż.
messages.mt_standard: Għax titkellem dwar xi ħadd li tilef lil ħabib għażiż.
messages.zh: 因为它讲的是一个失去挚友的人。
messages.en: Because it's about someone who lost a dear friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tikjib 放在一首悲伤歌曲旁，依次联想“难过、悲苦、忧郁”；这些都是内心情绪，有别于 tikjid 的欺骗行为。

gloss_zh: 背信出卖；欺骗；暗中使诈

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deceitful or underhand behaviour, including secretly betraying someone who trusts you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欺骗或暗中使诈的行为，包括背地里出卖信任自己的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġir ta' qerq jew manuvri bil-moħbi, inkluż it-tradiment ta' xi ħadd li jafdak.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 背信出卖；欺骗并背叛信任自己或与自己合作的人。
欺骗；故意使人相信不实情况的行为。
暗中使诈；偷偷进行的不诚实活动。

collocations.zh: 合作伙伴之间的背信出卖

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif it-tikjid bejn is-sħab wassal għat-telf tal-fiduċja u għat-tmiem tal-ftehim.
formal.en: The report describes how double-crossing among the partners led to a loss of trust and the end of the agreement.
formal.zh: 报告描述了合作伙伴之间的背信出卖如何导致信任丧失，并使协议终止。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Wegħedni li jgħinni, imbagħad ħadem kontrija bil-moħbi. Karl: Dan tikjid. Nifhem għaliex ma tafdahx aktar.
colloquial.en: Elena: He promised to help me, then secretly worked against me. Karl: That's double-crossing. I understand why you don't trust him anymore.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：他答应帮我，后来却背地里跟我作对。卡尔：这就是背信出卖。我明白你为什么不再信任他。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Wegħedni li jgħinni, imbagħad ħadem kontrija bil-moħbi.
messages.mt_standard: Wegħedni li jgħinni, imbagħad ħadem kontrija bil-moħbi.
messages.zh: 他答应帮我，后来却背地里跟我作对。
messages.en: He promised to help me, then secretly worked against me.

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan tikjid. Nifhem għaliex ma tafdahx aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Dan tikjid. Nifhem għaliex ma tafdahx aktar.
messages.zh: 这就是背信出卖。我明白你为什么不再信任他。
messages.en: That's double-crossing. I understand why you don't trust him anymore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tikjid 配“当面答应、背后使诈”的双格漫画，记住欺骗与背叛；再与表示悲伤的 tikjib 对照辨认末尾字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of bending something pliable, such as a tree branch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使柔韧、可弯曲的物体弯折的动作，例如弯曲树枝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li titgħawweġ xi ħaġa flessibbli, bħal fergħa ta' siġra.

sense_translations.en_definition: bending of sth. pliable (such as the branch of a tree)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 弯曲柔韧物体的动作，例如把树枝弯过来。

formal.mt: It-tikjif tal-fergħa għandu jsir bil-mod biex ma tinkisirx.
formal.en: The branch should be bent slowly so that it does not break.
formal.zh: 弯曲树枝时应缓慢进行，以免折断。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Nista' nagħti forma tonda lil din il-fergħa? Toni: Iva, imma t-tikjif irid isir bil-mod biex ma tiksirhiex.
colloquial.en: Lina: Can I shape this branch into a circle? Toni: Yes, but you need to bend it slowly so you don't break it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我能把这根树枝弯成圆形吗？托尼：可以，但要慢慢弯，免得把它折断。

messages.speaker: Lina (手工课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nagħti forma tonda lil din il-fergħa?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nagħti forma tonda lil din il-fergħa?
messages.zh: 我能把这根树枝弯成圆形吗？
messages.en: Can I shape this branch into a circle?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma t-tikjif irid isir bil-mod biex ma tiksirhiex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma t-tikjif irid isir bil-mod biex ma tiksirhiex.
messages.zh: 可以，但要慢慢弯，免得把它折断。
messages.en: Yes, but you need to bend it slowly so you don't break it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把柔软树枝慢慢弯成弧线，把这个动作标为 tikjif；记的是“弯曲动作”，不是树枝本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of measuring a dimension or quantity, or estimating an amount or value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 测定尺寸或数量的行为；也指对数额、数量或价值作出估计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jittieħed il-kejl ta' xi ħaġa jew li ssir stima ta' ammont jew valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 测量；量取尺寸或数量。
估量；对数量、数额或价值作出估计。

formal.mt: It-tikjil tat-tul u tal-wisa' tal-kamra jsir qabel ma tiġi ordnata l-għamara.
formal.en: The length and width of the room are measured before the furniture is ordered.
formal.zh: 订购家具之前，先测量房间的长度和宽度。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm drapp għandna nixtru għall-purtieri? Mark: L-ewwel nagħmlu t-tikjil tat-twieqi, imbagħad naraw kemm neħtieġu.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much fabric should we buy for the curtains? Mark: Let's measure the windows first, then work out how much we need.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：做窗帘要买多少布？马克：我们先量一下窗户，再看看需要多少。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm drapp għandna nixtru għall-purtieri?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm drapp għandna nixtru għall-purtieri?
messages.zh: 做窗帘要买多少布？
messages.en: How much fabric should we buy for the curtains?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel nagħmlu t-tikjil tat-twieqi, imbagħad naraw kemm neħtieġu.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel nagħmlu t-tikjil tat-twieqi, imbagħad naraw kemm neħtieġu.
messages.zh: 我们先量一下窗户，再看看需要多少。
messages.en: Let's measure the windows first, then work out how much we need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tikjil 配在尺子和费用草算表旁：尺子提醒“测量”，草算表提醒“估量”；根据是否实际量取来区分义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The setting aside of one's own wishes or importance; also, humiliation or being made to feel degraded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 压下自身愿望或降低自身重要性的自我克抑；也指遭到贬低、感到羞辱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twarrib tax-xewqat jew tal-importanza personali; ukoll, umiljazzjoni jew twaqqigħ tad-dinjità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自我克抑；放下自身愿望或个人利益。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-twarrib tax-xewqat jew tal-interessi personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羞辱；尊严受到贬损的经历或感受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Umiljazzjoni jew esperjenza li tnaqqas id-dinjità ta' persuna.

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddistingwi bejn it-tikjin volontarju, meta persuna twarrab ix-xewqat tagħha, u t-tikjin li jiġi minn kliem umiljanti.
formal.en: The author distinguishes between voluntary self-abnegation, when a person sets aside their wishes, and humiliation caused by degrading words.
formal.zh: 作者区分了两种情况：一种是个人主动放下自身愿望的自我克抑，另一种是侮辱性言辞造成的羞辱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk tikjin ifisser li persuna twarrab dak li tixtieq hi? Pawlu: Iva, iżda f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser umiljazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does tikjin here mean that a person sets aside what they want? Pawlu: Yes, but in another sentence it can mean humiliation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 tikjin 是指一个人放下自己的愿望吗？保罗：是的，不过在另一个句子里，它也可以指羞辱。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk tikjin ifisser li persuna twarrab dak li tixtieq hi?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk tikjin ifisser li persuna twarrab dak li tixtieq hi?
messages.zh: 这里的 tikjin 是指一个人放下自己的愿望吗？
messages.en: Does tikjin here mean that a person sets aside what they want?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser umiljazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser umiljazzjoni.
messages.zh: 是的，不过在另一个句子里，它也可以指羞辱。
messages.en: Yes, but in another sentence it can mean humiliation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：主动把自己的愿望放到一旁是自我克抑，被人当众贬低则是受辱；读句子时分清主动与被动。

gloss_zh: 使人慵懒或闲散的作用

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making someone lethargic, inactive, or idle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人变得无精打采、不活跃或无所事事的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li jagħmel lil xi ħadd bla ħeġġa, inattiv jew għażżien.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of rendering lethargic or idle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人陷入倦怠或闲散状态的行为；使人失去活动或做事动力的作用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li jagħmel lil xi ħadd bla ħeġġa jew iwasslu biex joqgħod bla ma jagħmel xejn.

collocations.en: the act of making workers idle
the inducing of lethargy through a lack of activity
collocations.zh: 缺乏活动所造成的倦怠

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tikjit tal-ħaddiema bħala riżultat ta' stennija twila mingħajr kompiti ċari.
formal.en: The report describes the inducing of idleness among workers as a result of long waits without clear tasks.
formal.zh: 报告指出，长时间等待且没有明确任务，使工人逐渐变得闲散。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelma tikjit tfisser sempliċement għażż? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser li xi ħaġa ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd isir bla ħeġġa jew joqgħod bla ma jagħmel xejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does tikjit simply mean laziness? Pawlu: Here it means that something makes someone lethargic or leaves them doing nothing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：tikjit 就是懒惰的意思吗？保罗：这里指的是某种事物让人变得无精打采，或者无所事事。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelma tikjit tfisser sempliċement għażż?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelma tikjit tfisser sempliċement għażż?
messages.zh: tikjit 就是懒惰的意思吗？
messages.en: Does tikjit simply mean laziness?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li xi ħaġa ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd isir bla ħeġġa jew joqgħod bla ma jagħmel xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li xi ħaġa ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd isir bla ħeġġa jew joqgħod bla ma jagħmel xejn.
messages.zh: 这里指的是某种事物让人变得无精打采，或者无所事事。
messages.en: Here it means that something makes someone lethargic or leaves them doing nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人原本忙碌，却因一直没有任务而慢慢瘫坐下来；重点记住使人变懒、变闲散的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put small dots or spots on a surface, picture, or other object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在表面、图画或其他物体上点上小点，或用点作标记。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel tikek żgħar fuq wiċċ, stampa jew oġġett ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点上小点；以小点标记或装饰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel jew iżid tikek fuq xi ħaġa.

collocations.en: to dot the paper with ink
to dot the background of the picture
collocations.zh: 在图画背景上点上小点

formal.mt: L-istudent tikkek l-isfond tal-istampa bil-linka blu biex joħloq effett dekorattiv.
formal.en: The student dotted the background of the picture with blue ink to create a decorative effect.
formal.zh: 学生用蓝色墨水在图画背景上点上小点，营造装饰效果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min tikkek il-karta bil-blu? Mark: Jien! Ridt nagħmel sema mimli stilel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who dotted the paper in blue? Mark: I did! I wanted to make a sky full of stars.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁在纸上点了蓝色的小点？马克：是我！我想画一片满是星星的天空。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min tikkek il-karta bil-blu?
messages.mt_standard: Min tikkek il-karta bil-blu?
messages.zh: 谁在纸上点了蓝色的小点？
messages.en: Who dotted the paper in blue?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Ridt nagħmel sema mimli stilel.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Ridt nagħmel sema mimli stilel.
messages.zh: 是我！我想画一片满是星星的天空。
messages.en: I did! I wanted to make a sky full of stars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上笔尖连续轻点纸面的动作，边点边记：一个点、两个点，就是点上小点。

gloss_zh: 一系列斑点；成组的小点

teaching_sense.en_definition: A series of spots or dots appearing together on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现在同一表面上的一系列斑点或一组小点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' tikek li jidhru flimkien fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一系列斑点；连续出现或聚在一起的一组小点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela jew grupp ta' tikek.

collocations.en: a series of spots on the fabric

formal.mt: Id-disinn jinkludi tikkjatura ħamra li testendi mat-tarf tad-drapp.
formal.en: The design includes a series of red spots extending along the edge of the fabric.
formal.zh: 这一设计包含沿布料边缘延伸的一系列红色斑点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din it-tikkjatura fuq id-drapp hija parti mid-disinn? Nina: Iva, it-tikek kollha qegħdin hemm apposta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this series of spots on the fabric part of the design? Nina: Yes, all the spots are there on purpose.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：布料上的这一组斑点是设计的一部分吗？妮娜：是的，这些小点都是特意加上的。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tikkjatura fuq id-drapp hija parti mid-disinn?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tikkjatura fuq id-drapp hija parti mid-disinn?
messages.zh: 布料上的这一组斑点是设计的一部分吗？
messages.en: Is this series of spots on the fabric part of the design?

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tikek kollha qegħdin hemm apposta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tikek kollha qegħdin hemm apposta.
messages.zh: 是的，这些小点都是特意加上的。
messages.en: Yes, all the spots are there on purpose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象布料上一串连续的小圆点，把整组斑点圈起来记忆；这个名词关注一系列点构成的整体。

gloss_zh: 用花环或枝叶环绕装饰

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of surrounding or adorning someone or something with a wreath or garland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用花环或枝叶环绕、装饰某人或某物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jdawwar jew iżejjen lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa b'girlanda jew kuruna ta' fjuri jew weraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以花环环绕；用花朵或枝叶组成的环形饰物装饰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tiżjin jew it-tidwir b'girlanda jew b'kuruna ta' fjuri jew weraq.

formal.mt: Il-programm taċ-ċerimonja jinkludi t-tiklil tal-istatwa b'girlanda ta' fjuri bojod.
formal.en: The ceremony's programme includes adorning the statue with a garland of white flowers.
formal.zh: 仪式安排包括用白色花环装饰雕像。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lestejna t-tiklil tal-bieb? Nina: Kważi; fadal inwaħħlu l-aħħar parti tal-girlanda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have we finished decorating the door with the garland? Nina: Almost; we still need to attach the last part of the garland.
colloquial.zh: 马克：门上的花环装饰完成了吗？妮娜：快了，还要把花环的最后一段固定好。

messages.speaker: Mark (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejna t-tiklil tal-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejna t-tiklil tal-bieb?
messages.zh: 门上的花环装饰完成了吗？
messages.en: Have we finished decorating the door with the garland?

messages.speaker: Nina (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; fadal inwaħħlu l-aħħar parti tal-girlanda.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; fadal inwaħħlu l-aħħar parti tal-girlanda.
messages.zh: 快了，还要把花环的最后一段固定好。
messages.en: Almost; we still need to attach the last part of the garland.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把一条花环绕到门框或雕像周围；把环绕并装饰的动作作为这个名词的记忆画面。

gloss_zh: 造词；创制新词；文字处理

teaching_sense.en_definition: The creation or coining of words; also, the preparation and editing of text through word processing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创造或拟定词语的活动；也指借助文字处理工具编写、编辑文本。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħolqien ta' kliem ġdid; ukoll, it-tħejjija u l-editjar ta' testi permezz ta' programm tal-kompjuter.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词语的创造；产生词语的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħolqien ta' kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创制新词；为表达概念而拟造新的词语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħolqien ta' kliem ġdid biex jesprimi kunċetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文字处理；使用软件编写、编辑和整理文本。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kitba, l-editjar u l-organizzazzjoni ta' testi permezz ta' programm tal-kompjuter.

formal.mt: L-ewwel taqsima tal-kors tittratta t-tiklim għal kunċetti ġodda, filwaqt li t-tieni taqsima tintroduċi programm tat-tiklim għall-editjar tat-testi.
formal.en: The first part of the course addresses coining words for new concepts, while the second introduces a word-processing program for editing texts.
formal.zh: 课程第一部分讨论如何为新概念创制词语，第二部分则介绍用于编辑文本的文字处理程序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tgħid tiklim, qed titkellem dwar kliem ġdid jew dwar il-kompjuter? Pawlu: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, dwar kliem ġdid; fil-lezzjoni ta' għada nużaw il-kelma għall-ipproċessar tat-test.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you say tiklim, are you talking about new words or about the computer? Pawlu: In this exercise, new words; in tomorrow's lesson we will use the word for word processing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说 tiklim 时，是在说新词，还是在说电脑操作？保罗：这道练习里指新词；明天的课上，我们会用这个词表示文字处理。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid tiklim, qed titkellem dwar kliem ġdid jew dwar il-kompjuter?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid tiklim, qed titkellem dwar kliem ġdid jew dwar il-kompjuter?
messages.zh: 你说 tiklim 时，是在说新词，还是在说电脑操作？
messages.en: When you say tiklim, are you talking about new words or about the computer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, dwar kliem ġdid; fil-lezzjoni ta' għada nużaw il-kelma għall-ipproċessar tat-test.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, dwar kliem ġdid; fil-lezzjoni ta' għada nużaw il-kelma għall-ipproċessar tat-test.
messages.zh: 这道练习里指新词；明天的课上，我们会用这个词表示文字处理。
messages.en: In this exercise, new words; in tomorrow's lesson we will use the word for word processing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两张学习卡：一张写着给新概念造词，另一张画着电脑编辑文字；遇到这个词先看语境属于哪张卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The application of warm water or lotion to an aching area, including the use of warm, moist compresses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为缓解疼痛而在患处敷用温水或药液的做法，包括使用温热湿敷物进行热敷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-applikazzjoni ta' ilma sħun jew lozjoni fuq parti li tweġġa', inkluż l-użu ta' kompressi sħan u niedja.

sense_translations.en_definition: application of warm water or lotion against ache
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为缓解疼痛而敷用温水或药液。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-applikazzjoni ta' ilma sħun jew lozjoni biex ittaffi l-uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热敷；以温热的湿敷物敷在身体部位上。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-applikazzjoni ta' kompressi sħan u niedja fuq parti tal-ġisem.

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi t-tikmid bħala l-applikazzjoni ta' ilma sħun jew lozjoni fuq parti li tweġġa'.
formal.en: The text describes tikmid as the application of warm water or lotion to an aching area.
formal.zh: 文章将 tikmid 描述为在疼痛部位敷用温水或药液。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu t-tikmid f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Ifisser li tapplika ilma sħun jew lozjoni fuq parti li tweġġa', pereżempju permezz ta' kompressa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does tikmid mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means applying warm water or lotion to an aching area, for example with a compress.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个句子里的 tikmid 是什么意思？保罗：意思是在疼痛部位敷用温水或药液，比如借助敷布来敷。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu t-tikmid f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu t-tikmid f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 tikmid 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tikmid mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tapplika ilma sħun jew lozjoni fuq parti li tweġġa', pereżempju permezz ta' kompressa.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tapplika ilma sħun jew lozjoni fuq parti li tweġġa', pereżempju permezz ta' kompressa.
messages.zh: 意思是在疼痛部位敷用温水或药液，比如借助敷布来敷。
messages.en: It means applying warm water or lotion to an aching area, for example with a compress.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用温热湿毛巾覆盖疼痛部位的画面记忆；看到此词就联想到温水、敷布和敷用这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protection or shelter from danger or hardship; also, help given to someone in need.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人免受危险或困苦的庇护；也指向有需要的人提供的援助或救助。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kenn jew ħarsien mill-periklu jew mit-tbatija; ukoll, għajnuna lil min ikun fil-bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 庇护；使人免受风雨、危险或困境影响的保护。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kenn jew ħarsien mill-periklu jew mit-temp ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 救助；向处于困难或危急中的人提供援助。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajnuna lil xi ħadd li jinsab f'diffikultà jew fil-periklu.

formal.mt: Waqt il-maltemp, iċ-ċentru offra tiknin lill-familji, kif ukoll ikel u ħwejjeġ niexfa.
formal.en: During the storm, the centre offered shelter to families, as well as food and dry clothes.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，中心为各个家庭提供庇护，并供应食物和干燥衣物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nsibu tiknin mix-xita hawn? Nina: Iva, idħlu; hawn post fejn tistennew, u nistgħu ngħinukom ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we find shelter from the rain here? Nina: Yes, come in; there is somewhere for you to wait, and we can help you too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们能在这里避雨吗？妮娜：可以，进来吧；这里有地方让你们等候，我们也能提供帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (避雨者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nsibu tiknin mix-xita hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nsibu tiknin mix-xita hawn?
messages.zh: 我们能在这里避雨吗？
messages.en: Can we find shelter from the rain here?

messages.speaker: Nina (中心志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, idħlu; hawn post fejn tistennew, u nistgħu ngħinukom ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, idħlu; hawn post fejn tistennew, u nistgħu ngħinukom ukoll.
messages.zh: 可以，进来吧；这里有地方让你们等候，我们也能提供帮助。
messages.en: Yes, come in; there is somewhere for you to wait, and we can help you too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨中有人打开门让你进去，再递来食物和干衣服；门内避雨对应庇护，伸手相助对应救助。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of sweeping a place regularly to keep it clean.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为保持某个地方清洁而经常进行的扫除活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tnaddaf post bil-ġummar b'mod regolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常扫除；定期用扫帚清扫。

formal.mt: It-tiknis regolari tal-bitħa jgħin biex il-post jibqa' nadif.
formal.en: Regular sweeping of the courtyard helps keep the area clean.
formal.zh: 定期清扫庭院有助于保持场地清洁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiknis tal-bitħa din il-ġimgħa? Pawlu: Jien. Se niknisha kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will take care of sweeping the courtyard this week? Pawlu: I will. I'll sweep it every morning.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这周谁负责清扫庭院？Pawlu：我来。我每天早晨都会扫。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiknis tal-bitħa din il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiknis tal-bitħa din il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 这周谁负责清扫庭院？
messages.en: Who will take care of sweeping the courtyard this week?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Se niknisha kull filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Se niknisha kull filgħodu.
messages.zh: 我来。我每天早晨都会扫。
messages.en: I will. I'll sweep it every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每天早晨拿扫帚扫庭院，把这个词与反复进行的日常清扫联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making sounds of pain or discomfort, or complaining in a whining voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因疼痛或不适而呻吟，或用哼哼唧唧的语气抱怨的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel ħsejjes ta' wġigħ jew skumdità, jew li tilmenta b'leħen ta' dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟；因疼痛或不适而发出低沉的声音。
哼哼唧唧地抱怨；用带有不满或委屈的声音诉说。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, l-infermier sema' t-tikrib tal-pazjent u mar jara jekk kellux bżonn l-għajnuna.
formal.en: During the night, the nurse heard the patient's groaning and went to see whether he needed help.
formal.zh: 夜间，护士听到病人的呻吟，便前去查看他是否需要帮助。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex dan it-tikrib kollu? Pawlu: Ilni nistenna siegħa u ddejjaqt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why all this whining? Pawlu: I've been waiting for an hour and I'm fed up.
colloquial.zh: Marija：怎么一直哼哼唧唧地抱怨？Pawlu：我都等了一个小时，烦透了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tikrib kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tikrib kollu?
messages.zh: 怎么一直哼哼唧唧地抱怨？
messages.en: Why all this whining?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilni nistenna siegħa u ddejjaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Ilni nistenna siegħa u ddejjaqt.
messages.zh: 我都等了一个小时，烦透了。
messages.en: I've been waiting for an hour and I'm fed up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个声音场景记忆：疼痛时低声呻吟，等得不耐烦时哼哼抱怨；具体意思看语境。

gloss_zh: 使变丑；扭曲面容；做鬼脸

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something ugly, or twisting the face into a grimace or funny expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得难看，或通过扭曲面部表情而龇牙咧嘴、做鬼脸的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel xi ħaġa kerha, jew li tgħawweġ wiċċek biex turi skumdità jew iddaħħaq lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变丑；使外观变得难看。
扭曲面容；因不适、厌恶等而龇牙咧嘴。
做鬼脸；故意做出滑稽或夸张的面部表情。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tikrih tal-pajsaġġ ikkawżat mir-rimi tal-iskart.
formal.en: The report describes how dumping waste has made the landscape ugly.
formal.zh: 报告描述了倾倒垃圾如何破坏景观的美观。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Biżżejjed b'dan it-tikrih tal-wiċċ waqt ir-ritratt! Pawlu: Ridt biss indaħħak lil oħti.
colloquial.en: Marija: Enough making faces while we're taking the photo! Pawlu: I just wanted to make my sister laugh.
colloquial.zh: Marija：拍照时别再做鬼脸啦！Pawlu：我只是想逗妹妹笑。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Biżżejjed b'dan it-tikrih tal-wiċċ waqt ir-ritratt!
messages.mt_standard: Biżżejjed b'dan it-tikrih tal-wiċċ waqt ir-ritratt!
messages.zh: 拍照时别再做鬼脸啦！
messages.en: Enough making faces while we're taking the photo!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Ridt biss indaħħak lil oħti.
messages.mt_standard: Ridt biss indaħħak lil oħti.
messages.zh: 我只是想逗妹妹笑。
messages.en: I just wanted to make my sister laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面分成两格：垃圾让风景变丑，孩子把脸扭成鬼脸；借画面区分三个义项。

gloss_zh: 迷恋；心动的爱慕；强烈渴望

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of infatuation or romantic attraction, or an intense desire for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人的强烈迷恋或心动爱慕，也可指对某物的强烈渴望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġibda qawwija ta' mħabba lejn xi ħadd, jew xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迷恋；对某人产生强烈、令人着迷的爱慕。
心动的爱慕；对某人的倾慕之情。
强烈渴望；对某种事物迫切的欲求。

collocations.zh: 特别想吃巧克力的渴望

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, it-tikrim tal-protagonista għal żagħżugħa jinfluwenza d-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist's infatuation with a young woman influences his decisions.
formal.zh: 小说中，主人公对一名年轻女子的迷恋影响了他的决定。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi tikrim għaċ-ċikkulata llum. Pawlu: Għandi biċċa fil-borża. Trid ftit?
colloquial.en: Marija: I'm craving chocolate today. Pawlu: I've got a piece in my bag. Would you like some?
colloquial.zh: Marija：我今天特别想吃巧克力。Pawlu：我包里有一块。你要来一点吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tikrim għaċ-ċikkulata llum.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tikrim għaċ-ċikkulata llum.
messages.zh: 我今天特别想吃巧克力。
messages.en: I'm craving chocolate today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi biċċa fil-borża. Trid ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi biċċa fil-borża. Trid ftit?
messages.zh: 我包里有一块。你要来一点吗？
messages.en: I've got a piece in my bag. Would you like some?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象心里一直惦记着某个人或某种食物：对象是人可表迷恋，对象是食物可表强烈渴望。

gloss_zh: 经过努力而取得；争取获得

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of obtaining something through effort or work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过付出努力或劳动而取得某种成果、能力或事物的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tikseb xi ħaġa permezz tal-isforz jew tax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过努力而取得；通过付出争取获得某物或某种成果。

collocations.en: the acquisition of knowledge through effort

formal.mt: It-tiksib ta' kwalifika professjonali jitlob studju regolari u taħriġ prattiku.
formal.en: Earning a professional qualification requires regular study and practical training.
formal.zh: 取得专业资格需要持续学习和实践训练。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sejjer bit-tiksib tal-liċenzja tas-sewqan? Pawlu: Qed nipprattika kull ġimgħa u dalwaqt nagħmel it-test.
colloquial.en: Marija: How are you getting on with earning your driving licence? Pawlu: I'm practising every week and I'll take the test soon.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你考驾照的进展怎么样？Pawlu：我每周都练，很快就要考试了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer bit-tiksib tal-liċenzja tas-sewqan?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer bit-tiksib tal-liċenzja tas-sewqan?
messages.zh: 你考驾照的进展怎么样？
messages.en: How are you getting on with earning your driving licence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学车的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nipprattika kull ġimgħa u dalwaqt nagħmel it-test.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nipprattika kull ġimgħa u dalwaqt nagħmel it-test.
messages.zh: 我每周都练，很快就要考试了。
messages.en: I'm practising every week and I'll take the test soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进学习、练习、取得证书的连续画面，记住它突出付出努力后有所获得。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of breaking something, such as cracking it or separating it into pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物破裂、折断或碎成若干部分的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li tkisser xi ħaġa, pereżempju billi tagħmilha biċċiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打破、弄碎或折断的行为或过程。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tiksir tal-ġebel, il-ħaddiema għandhom jilbsu nuċċalijiet protettivi.
formal.en: Workers should wear protective glasses while breaking stone.
formal.zh: 工人在破碎石块时应佩戴护目镜。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Smajt ħoss ta' tiksir. X'ġara fil-kċina? Pawlu: Waqagħli tazza u nkisret. Se niġbor il-biċċiet.
colloquial.en: Marija: I heard something breaking. What happened in the kitchen? Pawlu: I dropped a glass and it broke. I'll pick up the pieces.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我听到东西碎了的声音。厨房里怎么了？Pawlu：我把一个玻璃杯掉在地上，摔碎了。我来收拾碎片。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt ħoss ta' tiksir. X'ġara fil-kċina?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt ħoss ta' tiksir. X'ġara fil-kċina?
messages.zh: 我听到东西碎了的声音。厨房里怎么了？
messages.en: I heard something breaking. What happened in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqagħli tazza u nkisret. Se niġbor il-biċċiet.
messages.mt_standard: Waqagħli tazza u nkisret. Se niġbor il-biċċiet.
messages.zh: 我把一个玻璃杯掉在地上，摔碎了。我来收拾碎片。
messages.en: I dropped a glass and it broke. I'll pick up the pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象完整的玻璃杯落地后变成碎片，把这个词与从完整到破裂的动作过程联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something cold or lowering its temperature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变冷或降低其温度的过程，例如冰镇饮料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li tagħmel xi ħaġa kiesħa jew li tnaqqsilha t-temperatura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变冷；对某物进行冷却或冰镇。

formal.mt: It-tiksiħ tax-xorb għandu jsir qabel ma jaslu l-mistednin.
formal.en: The drinks should be chilled before the guests arrive.
formal.zh: 应在宾客到达前将饮料冰镇好。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Hemm ħin għat-tiksiħ tax-xorb? Pawlu: Iva, poġġi l-fliexken fil-friġġ issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is there time to chill the drinks? Pawlu: Yes, put the bottles in the fridge now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：还来得及冰镇饮料吗？Pawlu：来得及，现在把瓶子放进冰箱。

messages.speaker: Marija (聚会主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħin għat-tiksiħ tax-xorb?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħin għat-tiksiħ tax-xorb?
messages.zh: 还来得及冰镇饮料吗？
messages.en: Is there time to chill the drinks?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (帮忙的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, poġġi l-fliexken fil-friġġ issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, poġġi l-fliexken fil-friġġ issa.
messages.zh: 来得及，现在把瓶子放进冰箱。
messages.en: Yes, put the bottles in the fridge now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把常温饮料放进冰箱，温度逐渐下降；用这个过程记住使某物变冷的名词义。

gloss_zh: 衣服穿着紧绷；衣物过紧

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tight fit of a garment that restricts comfortable movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衣物穿在身上过紧、产生束缚感并影响舒适活动的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' libsa li tkun issikkata fuq il-ġisem u tillimita l-moviment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣物穿着过紧、紧绷的状态。

collocations.en: the tight fit of the jacket
the tight fit of the shirt

formal.mt: It-tiktif tal-ġakketta jillimita l-moviment tad-dirgħajn, għalhekk huwa rakkomandat daqs akbar.
formal.en: The tight fit of the jacket restricts arm movement, so a larger size is recommended.
formal.zh: 这件夹克过紧，限制了手臂活动，因此建议选择大一码。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed idejqek it-tiktif tal-ġakketta? Pawlu: Iva, ma nistax ngħolli dirgħajja sew. Se nipprova daqs akbar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the jacket's tight fit bothering you? Pawlu: Yes, I can't raise my arms properly. I'll try a larger size.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这件夹克穿得太紧，让你不舒服吗？Pawlu：是啊，我都没法好好抬胳膊。我试试大一码。

messages.speaker: Marija (服装店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed idejqek it-tiktif tal-ġakketta?
messages.mt_standard: Qed idejqek it-tiktif tal-ġakketta?
messages.zh: 这件夹克穿得太紧，让你不舒服吗？
messages.en: Is the jacket's tight fit bothering you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma nistax ngħolli dirgħajja sew. Se nipprova daqs akbar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma nistax ngħolli dirgħajja sew. Se nipprova daqs akbar.
messages.zh: 是啊，我都没法好好抬胳膊。我试试大一码。
messages.en: Yes, I can't raise my arms properly. I'll try a larger size.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象试穿小一码夹克，肩背绷紧、手臂抬不起来；用这种穿衣感受记住衣物过紧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The production of hemp or flax.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生产大麻或亚麻的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-produzzjoni tal-qanneb jew tal-kittien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大麻或亚麻的生产
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-produzzjoni tal-qanneb jew tal-kittien.

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi t-tiktin tal-kittien u l-użu tiegħu fil-produzzjoni tad-drapp.
formal.en: This chapter describes the production of flax and its use in making cloth.
formal.zh: 本章介绍亚麻的生产及其在织布中的用途。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tiktin? Pawlu: Il-produzzjoni tal-qanneb jew tal-kittien; hawn qed nitkellmu fuq il-kittien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tiktin mean? Pawlu: The production of hemp or flax; here we're talking about flax.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：tiktin是什么意思？保罗：指大麻或亚麻的生产；这里说的是亚麻。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tiktin?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tiktin?
messages.zh: tiktin是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tiktin mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-produzzjoni tal-qanneb jew tal-kittien; hawn qed nitkellmu fuq il-kittien.
messages.mt_standard: Il-produzzjoni tal-qanneb jew tal-kittien; hawn qed nitkellmu fuq il-kittien.
messages.zh: 指大麻或亚麻的生产；这里说的是亚麻。
messages.en: The production of hemp or flax; here we're talking about flax.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把tiktin与一幅麻田生产图联系起来：标签写着大麻和亚麻，提醒自己它表示生产活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to tease, or annoying through persistent troublesome behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容爱逗弄别人，或因不断打扰而令人烦恼的人或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jinki lil ħaddieħor, jew li jdejjaq bl-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱逗弄人的；带有戏弄意味的
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħobb jinki jew jiċċajta ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烦人的；老是打扰人的
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jdejjaq jew jagħti fastidju.

formal.mt: Fil-kitba tiegħu, l-awtur juża ton tikuż biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-qarrej.
formal.en: In his writing, the author uses a teasing tone to catch the reader's attention.
formal.zh: 作者在写作中使用逗弄人的语气来吸引读者的注意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm int tikuż illum! Għaliex qed taħbili l-pinna? Mark: Qed niċċajta biss. Hawn il-pinna tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Sara: You're such a tease today! Why are you hiding my pen? Mark: I'm only joking. Here's your pen.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天真爱捉弄人！干吗把我的笔藏起来？马克：我只是开个玩笑。你的笔在这儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm int tikuż illum! Għaliex qed taħbili l-pinna?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm int tikuż illum! Għaliex qed taħbili l-pinna?
messages.zh: 你今天真爱捉弄人！干吗把我的笔藏起来？
messages.en: You're such a tease today! Why are you hiding my pen?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed niċċajta biss. Hawn il-pinna tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Qed niċċajta biss. Hawn il-pinna tiegħek.
messages.zh: 我只是开个玩笑。你的笔在这儿。
messages.en: I'm only joking. Here's your pen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同学藏起你的笔：觉得好笑时是爱逗弄人，觉得厌烦时是烦人，用同一情景记住tikuż的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Being or existence: the state or fact of existing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存在这一事实或状态，即某物或某人确实存在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew il-fatt li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa teżisti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存在；存在的状态
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istat li wieħed ikun jeżisti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存在；实际存在这一事实
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa teżisti.

formal.mt: L-esej jiddiskuti t-tikwin tal-bniedem u r-relazzjoni tiegħu mad-dinja.
formal.en: The essay discusses human existence and the human relationship with the world.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讨论人的存在以及人与世界的关系。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser tikwin f'din is-sentenza? David: Ifisser eżistenza, il-fatt li xi ħaġa teżisti.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does tikwin mean in this sentence? David: It means existence, the fact that something exists.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这句话里的tikwin是什么意思？戴维：意思是存在，就是某样事物确实存在这一事实。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tikwin f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tikwin f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这句话里的tikwin是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tikwin mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser eżistenza, il-fatt li xi ħaġa teżisti.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser eżistenza, il-fatt li xi ħaġa teżisti.
messages.zh: 意思是存在，就是某样事物确实存在这一事实。
messages.en: It means existence, the fact that something exists.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给tikwin配一张写着“它存在”的卡片，记住它讨论的是存在本身，而不是物体的具体样子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A messy situation or a difficult, complicated predicament.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 混乱难理的局面，或处理起来复杂棘手的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni mħawda jew diffiċli li mhix faċli biex issolviha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一团糟；混乱的局面
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni mimlija taħwid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棘手的局面；难以处理的处境
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni delikata jew diffiċli biex issolviha.

collocations.en: to get out of a tricky situation

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' koordinazzjoni ħoloq tikwis li dewwem it-tlestija tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The lack of coordination created a mess that delayed completion of the work.
formal.zh: 缺乏协调造成了混乱，延误了工作的完成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dħalna f'tikwis: ibbukkjajna żewġ laqgħat fl-istess ħin. Ben: Ċempel lil wieħed mill-gruppi u staqsi jekk nistgħux nibdlu l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: We've got ourselves into a mess: we booked two meetings at the same time. Ben: Call one of the groups and ask whether we can change the time.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这下麻烦了，我们把两场会议订在了同一时间。本：给其中一组打电话，问问能不能改时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dħalna f'tikwis: ibbukkjajna żewġ laqgħat fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Dħalna f'tikwis: ibbukkjajna żewġ laqgħat fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 这下麻烦了，我们把两场会议订在了同一时间。
messages.en: We've got ourselves into a mess: we booked two meetings at the same time.

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel lil wieħed mill-gruppi u staqsi jekk nistgħux nibdlu l-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel lil wieħed mill-gruppi u staqsi jekk nistgħux nibdlu l-ħin.
messages.zh: 给其中一组打电话，问问能不能改时间。
messages.en: Call one of the groups and ask whether we can change the time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上两场会议挤在同一格，把tikwis记成“事情缠在一起，局面混乱又棘手”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of uncovering something or making previously hidden information known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 揭开被遮盖事物的行为，或将原先隐藏的信息公开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tikxef xi ħaġa mgħottija jew li tagħmel magħruf tagħrif li kien moħbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揭开；使被遮盖的事物显露出来
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tneħħija ta' dak li jgħatti xi ħaġa biex din tidher.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 披露；公开原先未公开的信息
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' tagħrif li qabel ma kienx magħruf jew pubbliku.

formal.mt: It-tikxif tal-informazzjoni fir-rapport ippermetta lill-qarrejja jifhmu aħjar il-problema.
formal.en: The disclosure of information in the report allowed readers to understand the problem better.
formal.zh: 报告中信息的披露使读者能够更好地理解这个问题。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'sar wara t-tikxif tas-sigriet? Sam: Kulħadd beda jistaqsi, u kellna nispjegaw kollox.
colloquial.en: Anna: What happened after the secret was disclosed? Sam: Everyone started asking questions, and we had to explain everything.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：秘密公开之后怎么样了？萨姆：大家都开始追问，我们只好把一切解释清楚。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'sar wara t-tikxif tas-sigriet?
messages.mt_standard: X'sar wara t-tikxif tas-sigriet?
messages.zh: 秘密公开之后怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened after the secret was disclosed?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd beda jistaqsi, u kellna nispjegaw kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd beda jistaqsi, u kellna nispjegaw kollox.
messages.zh: 大家都开始追问，我们只好把一切解释清楚。
messages.en: Everyone started asking questions, and we had to explain everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用揭开一块布的画面记tikxif：实物露出来是揭开，隐藏的信息露出来就是披露。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of applying plaster to a surface or filling and finishing the joints between stones in a wall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在表面涂抹灰浆的工作；也指填补并修整石墙石块之间的灰缝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih jinkesa wiċċ bit-tikħila jew jimtlew u jitlestew il-ġonot bejn il-ġebel ta' ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抹灰；在墙面等表面涂抹灰浆。
石墙勾缝；填补并修整石块之间的灰缝。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol ta' restawr jinkludi t-tikħil tal-ġonot bejn il-ġebel tal-ħajt.
formal.en: The restoration work includes pointing the joints between the stones of the wall.
formal.zh: 修复工程包括对墙体石块之间的灰缝进行勾缝。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Meta nistgħu niżbgħu din il-kamra? Ġużeppi: Wara t-tikħil, meta l-wiċċ ikun niexef.
colloquial.en: Rita: When can we paint this room? Ġużeppi: After the plastering, once the surface is dry.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们什么时候能给这个房间刷漆？朱塞佩：抹灰完成、表面干燥之后。

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta nistgħu niżbgħu din il-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Meta nistgħu niżbgħu din il-kamra?
messages.zh: 我们什么时候能给这个房间刷漆？
messages.en: When can we paint this room?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (泥瓦匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara t-tikħil, meta l-wiċċ ikun niexef.
messages.mt_standard: Wara t-tikħil, meta l-wiċċ ikun niexef.
messages.zh: 抹灰完成、表面干燥之后。
messages.en: After the plastering, once the surface is dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 tikħil 的两幅施工图：整面墙上抹灰，石块缝里填灰；用“面”和“缝”区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of dressing by putting on clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣物穿到身上的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li tqiegħed il-ħwejjeġ fuqek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿衣这一行为
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jilbes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把衣物穿到身上的动作
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tqegħid tal-ħwejjeġ fuq il-ġisem.

formal.mt: Il-gwida tispjega kif tingħata għajnuna fit-tilbis b'rispett lejn il-privatezza tal-persuna.
formal.en: The guide explains how to provide help with dressing while respecting the person's privacy.
formal.zh: 这份指南说明如何在尊重个人隐私的情况下协助其穿衣。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek bżonn għajnuna fit-tilbis? Leo: Iva, ma nistax nagħlaq din il-buttuna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you need help getting dressed? Leo: Yes, I can't fasten this button.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：需要帮你穿衣服吗？利奥：需要，这颗扣子我扣不上。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek bżonn għajnuna fit-tilbis?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek bżonn għajnuna fit-tilbis?
messages.zh: 需要帮你穿衣服吗？
messages.en: Do you need help getting dressed?

messages.speaker: Leo (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma nistax nagħlaq din il-buttuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma nistax nagħlaq din il-buttuna.
messages.zh: 需要，这颗扣子我扣不上。
messages.en: Yes, I can't fasten this button.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把tilbis配成穿衣动作连环图：伸袖、套上、扣扣子，借连续动作记住它是穿衣的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cowering in fear, running off, or riding a horse fast, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境可指因害怕而畏缩、跑开，或骑马快速奔驰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tinġibed lura bil-biża', li titlaq tiġri, jew li tirkeb żiemel b'ħeffa, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因恐惧而畏缩或蜷缩
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tinġibed lura jew tinġabar fik innifsek bil-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跑开；跑走
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li titlaq minn post tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑马疾驰；快速骑马
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rkib ta' żiemel b'ħeffa.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tilbit fuq żiemel tul il-mogħdija dejqa juri l-urġenza tal-vjaġġ.
formal.en: In the story, the fast riding of a horse along the narrow path conveys the urgency of the journey.
formal.zh: 故事中沿狭窄小路骑马疾驰的情节，表现了这趟旅程的紧迫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tilbit hawn ifisser li telaq jiġri? Pawlu: Iva. F'din is-sentenza ħarab minn fuq il-post; mhuwiex qed jirkeb żiemel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does tilbit here mean that he ran off? Pawlu: Yes. In this sentence he fled the scene; he isn't riding a horse.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的tilbit是说他跑走了吗？保罗：对。这句话说他从现场逃走了；他没有在骑马。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tilbit hawn ifisser li telaq jiġri?
messages.mt_standard: It-tilbit hawn ifisser li telaq jiġri?
messages.zh: 这里的tilbit是说他跑走了吗？
messages.en: Does tilbit here mean that he ran off?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. F'din is-sentenza ħarab minn fuq il-post; mhuwiex qed jirkeb żiemel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. F'din is-sentenza ħarab minn fuq il-post; mhuwiex qed jirkeb żiemel.
messages.zh: 对。这句话说他从现场逃走了；他没有在骑马。
messages.en: Yes. In this sentence he fled the scene; he isn't riding a horse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为tilbit画三张独立卡片：害怕畏缩、转身跑开、骑马疾驰。读句子时先看情境，再选对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The flow of saliva out of the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 唾液从嘴里流出的现象，即流口水或流涎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ tal-bżieq mill-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流口水；流涎。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie nnotat tilgħib waqt l-irqad.
formal.en: Drooling during sleep was noted in the report.
formal.zh: 报告中记录了睡觉时流口水的现象。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-bavalor tat-tarbija reġa' xxarrab. Pawlu: Iva, bit-tilgħib kollu li għandha, irridu nibdluh.
colloquial.en: Marta: The baby's bib is wet again. Pawlu: Yes, with all her drooling, we need to change it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：宝宝的围嘴又湿了。保罗：是啊，她流了这么多口水，我们得换一个。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bavalor tat-tarbija reġa' xxarrab.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bavalor tat-tarbija reġa' xxarrab.
messages.zh: 宝宝的围嘴又湿了。
messages.en: The baby's bib is wet again.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bit-tilgħib kollu li għandha, irridu nibdluh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bit-tilgħib kollu li għandha, irridu nibdluh.
messages.zh: 是啊，她流了这么多口水，我们得换一个。
messages.en: Yes, with all her drooling, we need to change it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tilgħib 和宝宝湿掉的围嘴一起记：口水流出来，就是这个名词所指的现象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of passing the tongue over something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用舌头接触并掠过某物表面的动作，即舔舐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' min jgħaddi lsienu fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舔；舔舐的动作。

formal.mt: It-tilgħiq ripetut tax-xufftejn ġie deskritt fin-noti tal-osservazzjoni.
formal.en: Repeated licking of the lips was described in the observation notes.
formal.zh: 观察笔记描述了反复舔嘴唇的动作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-kelb għadu ħdejn il-platt vojt? Toni: Għadu bit-tilgħiq; milli jidher, għoġbu l-ikel!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the dog still beside the empty plate? Toni: He's still licking away; apparently, he liked the food!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：狗怎么还待在空盘子旁边？托尼：它还在舔呢；看来它很喜欢这顿饭！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kelb għadu ħdejn il-platt vojt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kelb għadu ħdejn il-platt vojt?
messages.zh: 狗怎么还待在空盘子旁边？
messages.en: Why is the dog still beside the empty plate?

messages.speaker: Toni (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu bit-tilgħiq; milli jidher, għoġbu l-ikel!
messages.mt_standard: Għadu bit-tilgħiq; milli jidher, għoġbu l-ikel!
messages.zh: 它还在舔呢；看来它很喜欢这顿饭！
messages.en: He's still licking away; apparently, he liked the food!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舌头轻轻掠过冰淇淋表面，把 tilgħiq 记作“舔舐这个动作”，而不是食物本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An idea or influence that stimulates creative thought or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 激发创造性思考或行动的想法或启发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb jew influwenza li tqanqal il-kreattività jew tħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd joħloq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灵感；促使人产生创意或采取行动的启发。

formal.mt: Il-pajsaġġ tal-gżira kien sors ta' tilhim għall-pittur.
formal.en: The island's landscape was a source of inspiration for the painter.
formal.zh: 岛上的风景是这位画家的灵感来源。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn ġie t-tilhim għal din il-kanzunetta? Luqa: Minn mixja ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did the inspiration for this song come from? Luqa: From a walk by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这首歌的灵感是从哪里来的？卢卡：来自一次海边散步。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġie t-tilhim għal din il-kanzunetta?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġie t-tilhim għal din il-kanzunetta?
messages.zh: 这首歌的灵感是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did the inspiration for this song come from?

messages.speaker: Luqa (词曲作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn mixja ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Minn mixja ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 来自一次海边散步。
messages.en: From a walk by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象海边散步时突然想到一首歌，把这个创意出现的瞬间与 tilhim“灵感”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Heavy breathing, or breathing accompanied by a whistling sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 粗重的呼吸，或呼吸时伴有哨音的喘鸣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nifs tqil, jew nifs li miegħu jinstema' tisfir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗重呼吸；用力喘气。
喘鸣；呼吸时发出哨音。

formal.mt: Fin-noti ġie deskritt tilhiġ b'tisfir waqt li l-pazjent kien qed jieħu n-nifs.
formal.en: The notes described wheezing with a whistling sound as the patient breathed.
formal.zh: 记录描述了患者呼吸时伴有哨音的喘鸣。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għadni bit-tilhiġ wara dik it-telgħa. Nina: Ejja nieqfu ftit u nistrieħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm still breathing heavily after that climb. Nina: Let's stop for a moment and rest.
colloquial.zh: 马克：爬完那段坡，我还在喘粗气。妮娜：我们停一会儿，休息一下吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni bit-tilhiġ wara dik it-telgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni bit-tilhiġ wara dik it-telgħa.
messages.zh: 爬完那段坡，我还在喘粗气。
messages.en: I'm still breathing heavily after that climb.

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieqfu ftit u nistrieħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieqfu ftit u nistrieħu.
messages.zh: 我们停一会儿，休息一下吧。
messages.en: Let's stop for a moment and rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tilhiġ 配两段声音记忆：爬坡后的粗重喘气，以及呼吸中细细的哨音，分别对应两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of applying varnish to a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面涂上清漆的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jinkesa wiċċ b'verniċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂清漆；上清漆这一过程。

formal.mt: Il-programm tar-restawr jinkludi t-tili tal-bibien tal-injam.
formal.en: The restoration programme includes varnishing the wooden doors.
formal.zh: 修复计划包括给木门上清漆。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lestejt ix-xogħol fuq il-mejda? Rita: Għad baqa' t-tili; nagħmlu għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you finished working on the table? Rita: The varnishing is still left; I'll do it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 马克：桌子的活儿做完了吗？丽塔：还剩上清漆，明天我来做。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt ix-xogħol fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt ix-xogħol fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌子的活儿做完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished working on the table?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad baqa' t-tili; nagħmlu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għad baqa' t-tili; nagħmlu għada.
messages.zh: 还剩上清漆，明天我来做。
messages.en: The varnishing is still left; I'll do it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿刷子给木桌上清漆：tili 记的是涂刷过程，可以和表示一层清漆的 tilja 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substantial quantity of something, or a single coat of varnish on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指数量相当多的一批东西，也可指涂在表面的一层清漆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità mdaqqsa ta' xi ħaġa, jew saff wieħed ta' verniċ fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相当多的量；数量可观的一批。
一层清漆。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, il-wiċċ tal-injam ingħata tilja verniċ.
formal.en: After cleaning, the wooden surface was given a coat of varnish.
formal.zh: 清洁后，木质表面涂上了一层清漆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ħafna karti x'tirranġa? Pawlu: Iva, għandi tilja ta' karti fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have many papers to sort out? Pawlu: Yes, I have quite a lot of papers on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有很多纸张要整理吗？保罗：是啊，我桌上有相当多的纸张。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ħafna karti x'tirranġa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ħafna karti x'tirranġa?
messages.zh: 你有很多纸张要整理吗？
messages.en: Do you have many papers to sort out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi tilja ta' karti fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi tilja ta' karti fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 是啊，我桌上有相当多的纸张。
messages.en: Yes, I have quite a lot of papers on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记义：桌上数量可观的纸张，以及木板上的一层清漆；看到 tilja 时让上下文帮助选义。

gloss_zh: 给鱼钩装饵；使钓线轻轻抽动

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fishing action of putting bait on a hook or making a fishing line twitch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钓鱼时给鱼钩装上鱼饵，或使钓线轻轻抽动的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li titqiegħed lixka fuq sunnara jew li titħarrek lenza b'ġibdiet żgħar waqt is-sajd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to add bait to a hook while fishing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 钓鱼时给鱼钩装上鱼饵这一动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a fishing line twitch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使钓线轻轻抽动这一动作。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tas-sajd tinkludi t-tilkim tas-sunnara u t-tilkim tal-lenza b'ġibdiet żgħar.
formal.en: The fishing lesson includes baiting the hook and making the line twitch with small pulls.
formal.zh: 钓鱼课程包括给鱼钩装饵，以及用小幅拉动使钓线轻轻抽动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nagħmel it-tilkim tal-lenza? Toni: Iġbed il-lenza ftit, imbagħad erħilha.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I make the fishing line twitch? Toni: Pull the line a little, then release it.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：怎样让钓线轻轻抽动？托尼：把钓线稍微拉一下，再松开。

messages.speaker: Lara (钓鱼初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nagħmel it-tilkim tal-lenza?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nagħmel it-tilkim tal-lenza?
messages.zh: 怎样让钓线轻轻抽动？
messages.en: How do I make the fishing line twitch?

messages.speaker: Toni (钓友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iġbed il-lenza ftit, imbagħad erħilha.
messages.mt_standard: Iġbed il-lenza ftit, imbagħad erħilha.
messages.zh: 把钓线稍微拉一下，再松开。
messages.en: Pull the line a little, then release it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tilkim 放进钓鱼场景：先给鱼钩装饵，再让钓线轻抽；用同一场景中的两个动作记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of seeing something, catching a glimpse of it, or becoming aware of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 看见某物、短暂瞥见某物，或察觉到某事的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tara xi ħaġa, taraha għal waqt qasir, jew tinduna biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 看见；看到某物这一过程。
瞥见；短暂看到某物。
察觉；感知到某物或某事。

formal.mt: It-tilmiħ ta' dawl fit-tieqa ġiegħel lill-osservatur iħares aktar mill-qrib.
formal.en: Catching sight of a light in the window made the observer look more closely.
formal.zh: 观察者瞥见窗内有光，便进一步仔细查看。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajtu sew il-qattus? Mark: Le, kien biss tilmiħ; għadda jiġri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you get a good look at the cat? Mark: No, it was only a glimpse; it ran past.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看清那只猫了吗？马克：没有，只瞥见了一眼，它跑过去了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu sew il-qattus?
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu sew il-qattus?
messages.zh: 你看清那只猫了吗？
messages.en: Did you get a good look at the cat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien biss tilmiħ; għadda jiġri.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien biss tilmiħ; għadda jiġri.
messages.zh: 没有，只瞥见了一眼，它跑过去了。
messages.en: No, it was only a glimpse; it ran past.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只猫从眼前跑过：你看见它、瞥见它，也察觉到动静；用这三个角度串起 tilmiħ 的三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of bringing people together in one place or for a shared activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人们召集到一处，或组织人们共同参与活动的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li jinġabru n-nies flimkien f'post wieħed jew għal attività komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把人们召集或组织到一起。

formal.mt: L-organizzaturi ħadu ħsieb it-tilqigħ tal-parteċipanti fis-sala qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The organisers arranged for the participants to be brought together in the hall before the meeting.
formal.zh: 组织者安排在会议开始前将参与者召集到大厅。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tilqigħ tan-nies? Pawlu: Jien; ngħidilhom jiltaqgħu ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who will take care of bringing everyone together? Pawlu: I will; I'll tell them to meet by the door.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：谁来负责把大家召集起来？保罗：我来，我会叫他们在门边集合。

messages.speaker: Rita (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tilqigħ tan-nies?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tilqigħ tan-nies?
messages.zh: 谁来负责把大家召集起来？
messages.en: Who will take care of bringing everyone together?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; ngħidilhom jiltaqgħu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; ngħidilhom jiltaqgħu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 我来，我会叫他们在门边集合。
messages.en: I will; I'll tell them to meet by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象组织者招手，把分散的人召集到大厅：tilqigħ 的记忆重点是让人们聚到一起这一过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vaccine used to help the body develop protection against a disease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于帮助身体建立针对某种疾病的防护能力的疫苗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preparat li jgħin lill-ġisem jiżviluppa protezzjoni kontra marda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疫苗；帮助身体建立针对疾病的防护能力的制剂。

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jagħti informazzjoni dwar it-tilqima kontra l-influwenza.
formal.en: The leaflet provides information about the flu vaccine.
formal.zh: 这份宣传单提供有关流感疫苗的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-fuljett dwar xiex inhu? Lara: Dwar it-tilqima kontra l-influwenza; tista' taqrah hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this leaflet about? Lara: It's about the flu vaccine; you can read it here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份宣传单是讲什么的？劳拉：讲流感疫苗的，你可以在这里读。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-fuljett dwar xiex inhu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-fuljett dwar xiex inhu?
messages.zh: 这份宣传单是讲什么的？
messages.en: What is this leaflet about?

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar it-tilqima kontra l-influwenza; tista' taqrah hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar it-tilqima kontra l-influwenza; tista' taqrah hawn.
messages.zh: 讲流感疫苗的，你可以在这里读。
messages.en: It's about the flu vaccine; you can read it here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tilqima 和疫苗宣传单的画面绑定，再用 doża tat-tilqima 这一短语记住它可以按剂量谈论。

gloss_zh: 拾得的零散收获物；残余碎屑

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small things gathered from what remains, or leftover scraps of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从剩余部分中拾取的零散东西，或留下的少量残余碎屑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Affarijiet żgħar miġbura minn dak li jibqa', jew fdalijiet żgħar ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拾得的零散东西；从剩余部分中得到的少量收获物。
零碎残余；碎屑；少量剩余物。

collocations.zh: 收割后拾得的零散收获物

formal.mt: Wara l-ħsad, inġabar it-tilqit li kien għad fadal fl-għalqa.
formal.en: After the harvest, the pickings still left in the field were gathered.
formal.zh: 收割后，人们拾取了田里剩下的零散收获物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Baqa' xi ikel fil-platt? Toni: Ftit tilqit biss; il-biċċiet il-kbar kilniehom kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any food left on the plate? Toni: Just a few scraps; we ate all the big pieces.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：盘子里还有食物吗？托尼：只剩一点碎屑，大块的我们都吃完了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Baqa' xi ikel fil-platt?
messages.mt_standard: Baqa' xi ikel fil-platt?
messages.zh: 盘子里还有食物吗？
messages.en: Is there any food left on the plate?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit tilqit biss; il-biċċiet il-kbar kilniehom kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit tilqit biss; il-biċċiet il-kbar kilniehom kollha.
messages.zh: 只剩一点碎屑，大块的我们都吃完了。
messages.en: Just a few scraps; we ate all the big pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把田里拾来的零散谷物和盘里剩下的食物碎屑并排想象：tilqit 的两个义项都可用零散剩余物来辅助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of chipping material or cutting it into small pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过凿削去除材料，或把材料切成小块的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitneħħew biċċiet żgħar minn materjal jew jinqata' materjal f'biċċiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凿削；逐小块削除材料的过程。
切碎；把东西切成小块的过程。

collocations.en: chipping or cutting wood into small pieces
collocations.zh: 削木料或把木料切成小块

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tinkludi dimostrazzjoni tat-tilqix tal-injam f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: The lesson includes a demonstration of cutting wood into small pieces.
formal.zh: 这节课包括把木料切成小块的操作示范。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex trid din il-biċċa injam? Rita: Għat-tilqix; irrid naqtagħha f'biċċiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why do you want this piece of wood? Rita: For cutting into small pieces; I want to cut it up.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你要这块木料做什么？丽塔：用来切小块，我想把它切碎。

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid din il-biċċa injam?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid din il-biċċa injam?
messages.zh: 你要这块木料做什么？
messages.en: Why do you want this piece of wood?

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tilqix; irrid naqtagħha f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tilqix; irrid naqtagħha f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 用来切小块，我想把它切碎。
messages.en: For cutting into small pieces; I want to cut it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象完整木料逐渐变成小块：tilqix 表示凿削或切小块的过程；和表示零散残余物的 tilqit 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of speaking or uttering words aloud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话或把词语出声说出的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitkellem jew jgħid il-kliem b'leħen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话；以口头语言表达的行为。
出声说出；把词语说出口的行为。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jinkludi t-tilsin tal-kliem b'leħen ċar, sabiex l-istudenti jipprattikaw il-ħsejjes.
formal.en: The exercise includes uttering words in a clear voice so that students can practise the sounds.
formal.zh: 这项练习包括清晰地出声说出词语，让学生练习语音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan eżerċizzju ta' tilsin? Pawlu: Iva, għid dawn it-tliet kelmiet b'leħen ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this an exercise in speaking aloud? Pawlu: Yes, say these three words in a clear voice.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这是出声说话练习吗？Pawlu：是的，把这三个词清楚地说出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan eżerċizzju ta' tilsin?
messages.mt_standard: Dan eżerċizzju ta' tilsin?
messages.zh: 这是出声说话练习吗？
messages.en: Is this an exercise in speaking aloud?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għid dawn it-tliet kelmiet b'leħen ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għid dawn it-tliet kelmiet b'leħen ċar.
messages.zh: 是的，把这三个词清楚地说出来。
messages.en: Yes, say these three words in a clear voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课堂上把卡片上的词逐个说出声，用“开口说词”的画面记住 tilsin。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Quarrelling or arguing about a disagreement, including the use of reasons to support a position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕分歧进行的争吵或争辩，也可指提出理由支持立场的论辩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġlied bil-kliem jew diskussjoni li fiha jitressqu raġunijiet biex tiġi sostnuta pożizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 争吵；因意见不合而发生的口头冲突。
论辩；通过提出理由来支持或反驳某种观点。

formal.mt: Wara t-tilwim dwar il-ħlas, iż-żewġ naħat laħqu ftehim bil-miktub.
formal.en: After arguing over payment, the two sides reached a written agreement.
formal.zh: 双方就付款问题争辩后，达成了书面协议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma rridx aktar tilwim dwar min se jaħsel il-platti. Toni: Tajjeb, illum naħsilhom jien u għada jkun imissek int.
colloquial.en: Lara: I don't want any more arguing about who will wash the dishes. Toni: All right, I'll wash them today and tomorrow it'll be your turn.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我不想再为谁洗碗争吵了。Toni：好，今天我洗，明天轮到你。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma rridx aktar tilwim dwar min se jaħsel il-platti.
messages.mt_standard: Ma rridx aktar tilwim dwar min se jaħsel il-platti.
messages.zh: 我不想再为谁洗碗争吵了。
messages.en: I don't want any more arguing about who will wash the dishes.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, illum naħsilhom jien u għada jkun imissek int.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, illum naħsilhom jien u għada jkun imissek int.
messages.zh: 好，今天我洗，明天轮到你。
messages.en: All right, I'll wash them today and tomorrow it'll be your turn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人围绕同一问题轮流表达不同意见：情绪激烈是争吵，提出理由则是论辩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of adding colour to something, such as a drawing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给图画等事物添加颜色的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li jingħata kulur lil xi ħaġa, bħal tpinġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 着色；涂色；给事物添加颜色的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività tat-tilwin, l-istudenti għażlu kuluri differenti għall-fjuri u għall-weraq.
formal.en: During the colouring activity, the students chose different colours for the flowers and the leaves.
formal.zh: 在涂色活动中，学生们为花朵和叶子选择了不同的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-ktieb tat-tilwin tiegħi? Marija: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-lapsijiet tal-kulur.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is my colouring book? Marija: On the table, next to the coloured pencils.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我的涂色书在哪里？Marija：在桌子上，彩色铅笔旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-ktieb tat-tilwin tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-ktieb tat-tilwin tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我的涂色书在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my colouring book?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-lapsijiet tal-kulur.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-lapsijiet tal-kulur.
messages.zh: 在桌子上，彩色铅笔旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the coloured pencils.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tilwin 就想象黑白线稿逐渐填满颜色，把词义和涂色动作连在一起。

gloss_zh: 慷慨分发食物及其他必需品

teaching_sense.en_definition: The generous distribution of food and other necessities to people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物和其他生活必需品慷慨地分发给人们的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqassim ġeneruż ta' ikel u affarijiet oħra meħtieġa lin-nies.

sense_translations.en_definition: generous handing out of food and other ncessities
sense_translations.zh_definition: 慷慨分发食物及其他生活必需品。

collocations.en: the generous handing out of food
generous distribution of supplies to families in need
collocations.zh: 向有需要的家庭慷慨分发物资

formal.mt: It-tilwiq tal-ikel u tal-ħwejjeġ għen lill-familji fil-bżonn matul ix-xitwa.
formal.en: The generous distribution of food and clothing helped families in need during the winter.
formal.zh: 冬季慷慨分发食物和衣物，帮助了有需要的家庭。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tgħinni bit-tilwiq tal-ikel illum? Ġużeppi: Iva, inġib il-ħobż u l-frott biex inqassmuhom flimkien.
