colloquial.en: Sara: Will you help me hand out food generously today? Ġużeppi: Yes, I'll bring bread and fruit so we can distribute them together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天你能帮我给大家多分些食物吗？Ġużeppi：能，我带面包和水果来，咱们一起分。

messages.speaker: Sara (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tgħinni bit-tilwiq tal-ikel illum?
messages.mt_standard: Se tgħinni bit-tilwiq tal-ikel illum?
messages.zh: 今天你能帮我给大家多分些食物吗？
messages.en: Will you help me hand out food generously today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inġib il-ħobż u l-frott biex inqassmuhom flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inġib il-ħobż u l-frott biex inqassmuhom flimkien.
messages.zh: 能，我带面包和水果来，咱们一起分。
messages.en: Yes, I'll bring bread and fruit so we can distribute them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象志愿者把足量面包和必需品一份份递出去，用“慷慨分给大家”记住 tilwiq。

gloss_zh: 弄脏自己的衣服，常用于婴幼儿

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of dirtying one's own clothes, often used when speaking about infants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把自己衣服弄脏的行为，常用于描述婴幼儿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħammeġ il-ħwejjeġ tiegħu stess, spiss meta jkun qed jingħad dwar trabi.

sense_translations.en_definition: dirtying of one's clothes (often used of infants)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏自己的衣服，常用于婴幼儿。

collocations.zh: 吃东西时弄脏自己的衣服

formal.mt: Il-vavalor jgħin biex jitnaqqas it-tilwit tal-ħwejjeġ tat-tarbija waqt l-ikel.
formal.en: A bib helps reduce the dirtying of the baby's clothes during meals.
formal.zh: 围嘴有助于减少婴儿进食时弄脏衣服的情况。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif nista' nnaqqas it-tilwit waqt l-ikel? David: Poġġilha vavalor u żomm flokk nadif fil-qrib.
colloquial.en: Anna: How can I reduce her getting her clothes dirty during meals? David: Put a bib on her and keep a clean top nearby.
colloquial.zh: Anna：怎样才能让她吃饭时少弄脏衣服？David：给她戴上围嘴，旁边再备一件干净上衣。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nnaqqas it-tilwit waqt l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nnaqqas it-tilwit waqt l-ikel?
messages.zh: 怎样才能让她吃饭时少弄脏衣服？
messages.en: How can I reduce her getting her clothes dirty during meals?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġilha vavalor u żomm flokk nadif fil-qrib.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġilha vavalor u żomm flokk nadif fil-qrib.
messages.zh: 给她戴上围嘴，旁边再备一件干净上衣。
messages.en: Put a bib on her and keep a clean top nearby.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象宝宝吃饭后衣服上沾满食物，用“把自己的衣服弄脏”这一场景记住 tilwit。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of moving material such as sand or soil with a shovel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用铲子铲动或搬移沙、土等物料的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih wieħed iċaqlaq materjal, bħar-ramel jew il-ħamrija, b'pala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铲运；用铲子铲动或搬移物料。

formal.mt: It-tilwiħ tar-ramel sar b'attenzjoni biex il-mogħdija tibqa' nadifa.
formal.en: The sand was shovelled carefully to keep the path clean.
formal.zh: 铲沙作业进行得很仔细，以保持小路清洁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għejjejt bit-tilwiħ tal-ħamrija. Rita: Strieħ ftit; issa nieħu l-pala jien.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm tired from shovelling the soil. Rita: Rest for a bit; I'll take the shovel now.
colloquial.zh: Mark：铲土铲得我累了。Rita：休息一下，现在换我来拿铲子。

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għejjejt bit-tilwiħ tal-ħamrija.
messages.mt_standard: Għejjejt bit-tilwiħ tal-ħamrija.
messages.zh: 铲土铲得我累了。
messages.en: I'm tired from shovelling the soil.

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Strieħ ftit; issa nieħu l-pala jien.
messages.mt_standard: Strieħ ftit; issa nieħu l-pala jien.
messages.zh: 休息一下，现在换我来拿铲子。
messages.en: Rest for a bit; I'll take the shovel now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tilwiħ 配上一把铲子搬动沙土的画面，记的是铲运这项活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The addition of almonds or almond paste to a food preparation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在制作食物时加入杏仁或杏仁膏的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żieda ta' lewż jew għaġina tal-lewż ma' preparazzjoni tal-ikel.

sense_translations.en_definition: addition of almonds or almond paste
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加入杏仁或杏仁膏。

collocations.en: adding almonds or almond paste to the dough
collocations.zh: 往面团中加入杏仁或杏仁膏

collocations.en: adding almonds or almond paste to the filling
collocations.zh: 往馅料中加入杏仁或杏仁膏

formal.mt: It-tilwiż tal-mili jsir billi jiżdied il-lewż mitħun u jitħallat sew mal-ingredjenti l-oħra.
formal.en: Almonds are incorporated into the filling by adding ground almonds and mixing them thoroughly with the other ingredients.
formal.zh: 给馅料加杏仁时，加入磨碎的杏仁，并与其他配料充分混合。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għat-tilwiż tal-mili, nuża lewż mitħun jew għaġina tal-lewż? Mark: Għal din ir-riċetta, uża lewż mitħun.
colloquial.en: Rita: To add almonds to the filling, should I use ground almonds or almond paste? Mark: For this recipe, use ground almonds.
colloquial.zh: Rita：给馅料加杏仁，用磨碎的杏仁还是杏仁膏？Mark：这份食谱用磨碎的杏仁。

messages.speaker: Rita (烘焙学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tilwiż tal-mili, nuża lewż mitħun jew għaġina tal-lewż?
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tilwiż tal-mili, nuża lewż mitħun jew għaġina tal-lewż?
messages.zh: 给馅料加杏仁，用磨碎的杏仁还是杏仁膏？
messages.en: To add almonds to the filling, should I use ground almonds or almond paste?

messages.speaker: Mark (烘焙老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal din ir-riċetta, uża lewż mitħun.
messages.mt_standard: Għal din ir-riċetta, uża lewż mitħun.
messages.zh: 这份食谱用磨碎的杏仁。
messages.en: For this recipe, use ground almonds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tilwiż 想成烘焙中专门“加杏仁”的一步：一勺杏仁碎或杏仁膏进入碗里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Restraint: the act of holding someone or something back or keeping behaviour under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人、事物或行为加以限制、控制或克制，使其不任意发展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li żżomm lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa taħt kontroll jew li trażżan imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约束；限制；克制
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontroll jew trażżin ta' persuna, ta' xi ħaġa jew ta' mġiba.

formal.mt: It-tilġim tal-impulsi jgħin lill-parteċipanti jiddiskutu l-problema mingħajr ma jinsultaw lil xulxin.
formal.en: Restraint of impulses helps participants discuss the problem without insulting one another.
formal.zh: 克制冲动有助于参与者在不互相侮辱的情况下讨论问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irnexxielek ma tgħajjatx? Ben: Bi ftit tilġim tar-rabja. Ħadt nifs twil qabel weġibt.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you manage not to shout? Ben: With a little restraint of my anger. I took a deep breath before answering.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你怎么忍住没喊出来？本：稍微克制了一下怒气，回答前先深吸了一口气。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielek ma tgħajjatx?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielek ma tgħajjatx?
messages.zh: 你怎么忍住没喊出来？
messages.en: How did you manage not to shout?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bi ftit tilġim tar-rabja. Ħadt nifs twil qabel weġibt.
messages.mt_standard: Bi ftit tilġim tar-rabja. Ħadt nifs twil qabel weġibt.
messages.zh: 稍微克制了一下怒气，回答前先深吸了一口气。
messages.en: With a little restraint of my anger. I took a deep breath before answering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发火前先深呼吸、把冲动按住，用这个暂停动作记住tilġim表示约束或克制。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of gaining flesh, fattening an animal, or figuratively giving something more substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体长肉、使动物增肥的过程，也可比喻为给事物增添实质内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żieda fil-laħam tal-ġisem, it-tismin ta' annimal, jew, b'mod figurattiv, iż-żieda ta' kontenut sostanzjali ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长肉；身体变得丰满。
使增肥；育肥，尤指动物的增肥过程。
给某事物增添实质内容；使其更加充实，比喻用法。

formal.mt: It-tilħim tal-argument jeħtieġ aktar evidenza u eżempji konkreti.
formal.en: Adding substance to the argument requires more evidence and concrete examples.
formal.zh: 要充实这段论证，需要更多证据和具体例子。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi l-punti ewlenin tal-esej, imma għadu qasir wisq. David: Issa hemm bżonn ftit tilħim: żid eżempju ma' kull punt.
colloquial.en: Marija: I have the main points of the essay, but it's still too short. David: Now it needs some fleshing out: add an example to each point.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我已经有了文章的要点，但篇幅还是太短。戴维：现在需要充实一下：每个要点都加一个例子。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-punti ewlenin tal-esej, imma għadu qasir wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-punti ewlenin tal-esej, imma għadu qasir wisq.
messages.zh: 我已经有了文章的要点，但篇幅还是太短。
messages.en: I have the main points of the essay, but it's still too short.

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa hemm bżonn ftit tilħim: żid eżempju ma' kull punt.
messages.mt_standard: Issa hemm bżonn ftit tilħim: żid eżempju ma' kull punt.
messages.zh: 现在需要充实一下：每个要点都加一个例子。
messages.en: Now it needs some fleshing out: add an example to each point.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“给骨架添肉”的教学画面串联 tilħim：身体长肉、牲畜育肥，文章则补充证据和例子。

gloss_zh: 发声；赋予声音；表达出来

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving voice to something, such as expressing thoughts or feelings aloud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赋予某事物声音或使其得到表达的行为，例如把思想或感受说出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih tingħata leħen lil xi ħaġa, bħal meta ħsibijiet jew sentimenti jiġu espressi bil-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发声；赋予声音；使思想、感受等得到表达。

formal.mt: Il-poeżija toffri spazju għat-tilħin tas-sentimenti li diffiċli jiġu espressi fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: Poetry offers a space for giving voice to feelings that are difficult to express in everyday life.
formal.zh: 诗歌为那些在日常生活中难以表达的感受提供了发声的空间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandi ħafna ħsibijiet, imma ma nafx kif ngħidhom. Samwel: Ipprova ikteb poeżija; tista' tgħinek fit-tilħin tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Rita: I have lots of thoughts, but I don't know how to put them into words. Samwel: Try writing a poem; it can help you give voice to them.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我有很多想法，但不知道怎么说出来。萨姆韦尔：试着写首诗吧；这可以帮助你表达它们。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna ħsibijiet, imma ma nafx kif ngħidhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna ħsibijiet, imma ma nafx kif ngħidhom.
messages.zh: 我有很多想法，但不知道怎么说出来。
messages.en: I have lots of thoughts, but I don't know how to put them into words.

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova ikteb poeżija; tista' tgħinek fit-tilħin tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova ikteb poeżija; tista' tgħinek fit-tilħin tagħhom.
messages.zh: 试着写首诗吧；这可以帮助你表达它们。
messages.en: Try writing a poem; it can help you give voice to them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脑中的想法获得了声音，从心里走到话语中；用这个画面记 tilħin“赋声、表达”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of arriving at a place or attaining a target or level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 到达某个地点，或达到某项目标、水平的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' min jasal f'post jew jilħaq mira jew livell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到达或达到的行为。

formal.mt: It-tilħiq tal-mira jiddependi fuq ippjanar ċar u ħidma regolari.
formal.en: Reaching the target depends on clear planning and regular work.
formal.zh: 达到目标有赖于清晰的规划和持续的努力。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għad fadlilna ħafna sal-quċċata? Karl: Ftit ieħor biss; it-tilħiq tagħha se jkun l-isbaħ mument tal-mixja.
colloquial.en: Elena: Do we still have a long way to go to the summit? Karl: Just a little farther; reaching it will be the best moment of the hike.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：到山顶还有很远吗？卡尔：只剩一小段了；到达山顶会是这次徒步最美好的时刻。

messages.speaker: Elena (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadlilna ħafna sal-quċċata?
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadlilna ħafna sal-quċċata?
messages.zh: 到山顶还有很远吗？
messages.en: Do we still have a long way to go to the summit?

messages.speaker: Karl (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit ieħor biss; it-tilħiq tagħha se jkun l-isbaħ mument tal-mixja.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit ieħor biss; it-tilħiq tagħha se jkun l-isbaħ mument tal-mixja.
messages.zh: 只剩一小段了；到达山顶会是这次徒步最美好的时刻。
messages.en: Just a little farther; reaching it will be the best moment of the hike.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tilħiq 配上登顶的一刻：脚步到达山顶，努力达到目标，都突出“到达或达到”的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The flashing of light or the sudden brightening of a flame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光线闪亮，或火焰突然变亮、腾起的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-leħħ ta' dawl jew iż-żieda f'daqqa fid-dawl ta' fjamma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪光，或火焰骤然燃亮、腾起。

formal.mt: It-tilħiħ tal-fjamma dawwal għal mument il-ħitan tal-kamra.
formal.en: The flaring of the flame lit up the room's walls for a moment.
formal.zh: 火焰骤然燃亮，一瞬间照亮了房间的墙壁。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt dak it-tilħiħ tad-dawl fit-tieqa? Ben: Iva, xi ħadd qed jieħu r-ritratti bil-flash.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you see that flashing light in the window? Ben: Yes, someone is taking photos with a flash.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你看到窗户里那阵闪光了吗？本：看到了，有人在用闪光灯拍照。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt dak it-tilħiħ tad-dawl fit-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt dak it-tilħiħ tad-dawl fit-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你看到窗户里那阵闪光了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that flashing light in the window?

messages.speaker: Ben (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xi ħadd qed jieħu r-ritratti bil-flash.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xi ħadd qed jieħu r-ritratti bil-flash.
messages.zh: 看到了，有人在用闪光灯拍照。
messages.en: Yes, someone is taking photos with a flash.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用相机闪光和火苗突然亮起的两个画面记 tilħiħ：共同点是光突然增强或闪现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Diligence, firmness, or sustained application in carrying out a task or pursuing a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成任务或追求目标时表现出的勤勉、坚定或持续不懈的投入。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma bir-reqqa, is-sodezza jew l-impenn kontinwu biex jitwettaq xogħol jew jintlaħaq għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤勉；认真而尽力地投入工作或学习。
坚定；在立场、决定或行动上保持坚决的态度。
勤恳不懈；持续而专注地投入某项活动。

collocations.zh: 他勤恳而坚持不懈地工作

formal.mt: L-istudenta wriet tilżim fl-istudju billi rrevediet il-materjal kuljum u temmet ix-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: The student showed diligence in her studies by reviewing the material daily and completing her work on time.
formal.zh: 这名学生每天复习材料并按时完成作业，表现出学习上的勤勉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irnexxielek tispiċċa dan kollu? Pawlu: B'tilżim; ħdimt ftit kuljum, anki meta kont għajjien.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you manage to finish all this? Pawlu: Through persistence; I worked a little every day, even when I was tired.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你是怎么把这些全做完的？Pawlu：靠坚持，每天做一点，累的时候也坚持做。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielek tispiċċa dan kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielek tispiċċa dan kollu?
messages.zh: 你是怎么把这些全做完的？
messages.en: How did you manage to finish all this?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: B'tilżim; ħdimt ftit kuljum, anki meta kont għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: B'tilżim; ħdimt ftit kuljum, anki meta kont għajjien.
messages.zh: 靠坚持，每天做一点，累的时候也坚持做。
messages.en: Through persistence; I worked a little every day, even when I was tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“认真做、稳稳坚持、天天投入”三个画面，分别记住 tilżim 的勤勉、坚定和不懈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of laying something down or spreading it out over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体放下、铺好，或使其在某个表面上展开的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqiegħed xi ħaġa jew tifrixha fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放下或铺放某物的动作。
把某物铺展在一个表面上的动作。

collocations.en: spreading the cloth over the table

formal.mt: It-timdid tat-tapit għandu jsir fuq art nadifa u niexfa.
formal.en: The carpet should be laid on a clean, dry floor.
formal.zh: 铺设地毯时，地面应保持清洁、干燥。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nibdew bit-timdid tad-drapp fuq il-mejda? Pawlu: Iva, żomm tarf wieħed u jien inżomm l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we start spreading the cloth over the table? Pawlu: Yes, hold one end and I'll hold the other.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们开始把布铺到桌上吧？Pawlu：好，你拿住一头，我拿另一头。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew bit-timdid tad-drapp fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew bit-timdid tad-drapp fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 我们开始把布铺到桌上吧？
messages.en: Shall we start spreading the cloth over the table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żomm tarf wieħed u jien inżomm l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żomm tarf wieħed u jien inżomm l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 好，你拿住一头，我拿另一头。
messages.en: Yes, hold one end and I'll hold the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人拉住布的两端，把布平铺在桌上；用这个画面同时记住“铺放”和“铺展”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of using the teeth to break food or another substance into smaller pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用牙齿把食物或其他东西嚼碎的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tomgħod l-ikel jew xi ħaġa oħra bis-snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咀嚼某物的动作。

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega r-rwol tat-timgħid fil-preparazzjoni tal-ikel biex jinbela'.
formal.en: The leaflet explains the role of chewing in preparing food to be swallowed.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册说明了咀嚼在使食物便于吞咽方面的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tiekol daqshekk bil-mod? Mark: Għax dan il-ħobż huwa iebes u għandu bżonn aktar timgħid.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you eating so slowly? Mark: Because this bread is hard and needs more chewing.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么吃得这么慢？Mark：因为这面包很硬，得多嚼一会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiekol daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiekol daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.zh: 你为什么吃得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you eating so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan il-ħobż huwa iebes u għandu bżonn aktar timgħid.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan il-ħobż huwa iebes u għandu bżonn aktar timgħid.
messages.zh: 因为这面包很硬，得多嚼一会儿。
messages.en: Because this bread is hard and needs more chewing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“硬面包要多嚼几下”的画面，记住它指咀嚼这一动作，而不是吞咽。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The steepness of a slope, or the act of moving something into a slanted position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 斜坡的陡缓程度，或使某物倾斜的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad ta' kemm hi wieqfa inklinazzjoni, jew l-att li tmejjel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坡度，即斜坡的陡缓程度。
倾斜或使某物倾斜的动作。

formal.mt: It-timjil tat-triq ġie kkalkulat qabel ma beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The gradient of the road was calculated before work began.
formal.zh: 工程开始前，已计算道路的坡度。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Oqgħod attent bit-timjil tal-kaxxa; hemm tazzi ġewwa. Mark: Tajjeb, inżommha dritta.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Be careful when tilting the box; there are glasses inside. Mark: All right, I'll keep it upright.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：倾斜箱子时小心点，里面有玻璃杯。Mark：好，我会把它保持直立。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (搬家帮手)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attent bit-timjil tal-kaxxa; hemm tazzi ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attent bit-timjil tal-kaxxa; hemm tazzi ġewwa.
messages.zh: 倾斜箱子时小心点，里面有玻璃杯。
messages.en: Be careful when tilting the box; there are glasses inside.

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inżommha dritta.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inżommha dritta.
messages.zh: 好，我会把它保持直立。
messages.en: All right, I'll keep it upright.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个倾斜画面联记：道路斜着向上是“坡度”，把箱子斜过来是“倾斜动作”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of gently stroking or touching someone or an animal with affection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着亲昵或关爱之情，轻柔地抚摸人或动物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tmiss jew tgħaddi idek bil-ħlewwa fuq persuna jew annimal biex turi mħabba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抚，即温柔而亲昵地抚摸。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-omm turi l-imħabba tagħha lejn bintha permezz ta' kliem ħelu u timlis ġentili.
formal.en: In the story, the mother shows her love for her daughter through kind words and gentle caresses.
formal.zh: 故事中，母亲通过温柔的话语和轻柔的爱抚，表达对女儿的爱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-qattus tiegħek iħobb it-timlis? Sara: Iva, speċjalment fuq rasu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does your cat like being stroked? Sara: Yes, especially on his head.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你的猫喜欢被抚摸吗？Sara：喜欢，尤其喜欢别人摸它的头。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus tiegħek iħobb it-timlis?
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus tiegħek iħobb it-timlis?
messages.zh: 你的猫喜欢被抚摸吗？
messages.en: Does your cat like being stroked?

messages.speaker: Sara (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment fuq rasu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment fuq rasu.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其喜欢别人摸它的头。
messages.en: Yes, especially on his head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手掌轻轻抚过猫头的画面作为记忆提示，重点记住动作里的温柔和亲昵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of adding salt to food or another substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向食物或其他物质中加入盐的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li żżid il-melħ mal-ikel jew ma' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加盐，即向某物中加入盐。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispeċifika li t-timliħ tas-soppa jsir fl-aħħar tat-tisjir.
formal.en: The recipe specifies that salt should be added to the soup at the end of cooking.
formal.zh: 食谱明确说明，应在烹煮结束时给汤加盐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejt it-timliħ tas-soppa? Toni: Għadni le; se nżid ftit melħ issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished adding salt to the soup? Toni: Not yet; I'll add a little salt now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：汤里加好盐了吗？Toni：还没有，我现在加一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt it-timliħ tas-soppa?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt it-timliħ tas-soppa?
messages.zh: 汤里加好盐了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished adding salt to the soup?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le; se nżid ftit melħ issa.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le; se nżid ftit melħ issa.
messages.zh: 还没有，我现在加一点。
messages.en: Not yet; I'll add a little salt now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象盐罐向汤锅里撒盐，把整个“加入盐”的动作记作 timliħ，而不是只记盐这种材料。

gloss_zh: 东帝汶的；东帝汶人（通常指男性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to East Timor, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自东帝汶的，或与东帝汶及其人民、文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu minn Timor tal-Lvant jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-pajjiż, man-nies jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: East Timorese (of, from or relating to East Timor)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 东帝汶的；来自东帝汶或与东帝汶有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: East Timorese (native or inhabitant of East Timor) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 东帝汶人，即东帝汶的本地人或居民，通常指男性。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festival jinkludi film Timoriż dwar il-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The festival programme includes an East Timorese film about everyday life.
formal.zh: 电影节的节目单包括一部讲述日常生活的东帝汶电影。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-film huwa Timoriż? Mark: Iva, u d-direttur huwa Timoriż ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this film East Timorese? Mark: Yes, and the director is an East Timorese man too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这部电影是东帝汶的吗？Mark：是的，导演也是一位东帝汶人。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-film huwa Timoriż?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-film huwa Timoriż?
messages.zh: 这部电影是东帝汶的吗？
messages.en: Is this film East Timorese?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u d-direttur huwa Timoriż ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u d-direttur huwa Timoriż ukoll.
messages.zh: 是的，导演也是一位东帝汶人。
messages.en: Yes, and the director is an East Timorese man too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“东帝汶电影”和“一位东帝汶男子”成对记忆：修饰电影时是形容词，指人时可作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pointed hand tool used by a carpenter to make small holes in wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 木工用来在木材上扎出小孔的尖头手工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-idejn b'ponta li l-mastrudaxxa juża biex jagħmel toqob żgħar fl-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木工锥；用于在木材上扎小孔的尖头工具。

collocations.en: to make a hole with a bradawl

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża timplor biex għamel toqba żgħira fl-injam qabel daħħal il-kamin.
formal.en: The carpenter used a bradawl to make a small hole in the wood before inserting the screw.
formal.zh: 木匠先用木工锥在木材上扎了一个小孔，然后装入螺丝。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Tista' tgħaddili t-timplor? Pawlu: Żgur, qiegħed ħdejn il-martell.
colloquial.en: Toni: Can you pass me the bradawl? Pawlu: Sure, it's next to the hammer.
colloquial.zh: Toni：能把木工锥递给我吗？Pawlu：当然，就在锤子旁边。

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħaddili t-timplor?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħaddili t-timplor?
messages.zh: 能把木工锥递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the bradawl?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, qiegħed ħdejn il-martell.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, qiegħed ħdejn il-martell.
messages.zh: 当然，就在锤子旁边。
messages.en: Sure, it's next to the hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工具台上锤子旁的一把尖头木工锥，再想象它在木板上扎小孔，把物件和用途一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which something develops a bitter taste or becomes more bitter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物逐渐产生苦味或苦味加重的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir morra jew tiżdied fil-morra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变苦的过程；苦味逐渐产生或加重。

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, ġie osservat timrir gradwali tal-likwidu.
formal.en: During the experiment, the liquid was observed to become gradually more bitter.
formal.zh: 实验期间，观察到液体逐渐变苦。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tikteb 'timrir' fin-noti? Mark: Għax it-togħma qed issir aktar morra maż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you writing 'timrir' in the notes? Mark: Because the taste is becoming more bitter over time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么在笔记里写“timrir”？马克：因为味道随着时间变得更苦了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tikteb 'timrir' fin-noti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tikteb 'timrir' fin-noti?
messages.zh: 你为什么在笔记里写“timrir”？
messages.en: Why are you writing 'timrir' in the notes?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax it-togħma qed issir aktar morra maż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Għax it-togħma qed issir aktar morra maż-żmien.
messages.zh: 因为味道随着时间变得更苦了。
messages.en: Because the taste is becoming more bitter over time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象连续品尝同一杯饮料，每次都比上次更苦；用这条变化时间线记住它强调“变苦的过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of walking about or wandering from place to place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 四处走动或从一处漫游到另一处的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività ta' min jimxi 'l hawn u 'l hemm jew idur minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四处走动；来回走走。
漫游；没有固定路线地闲逛。

formal.mt: It-timriħ fil-kampanja jagħti lill-viżitaturi ċans josservaw il-pajsaġġ bil-kalma.
formal.en: Wandering in the countryside gives visitors a chance to observe the landscape at leisure.
formal.zh: 在乡间漫游让游客有机会从容地观察风景。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamilt ilbieraħ wara nofsinhar? Pawlu: Ftit timriħ mal-baħar, mingħajr pjan.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you do yesterday afternoon? Pawlu: A little wandering by the sea, without a plan.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你昨天下午做什么了？保罗：就在海边随意走了走，没什么计划。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamilt ilbieraħ wara nofsinhar?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamilt ilbieraħ wara nofsinhar?
messages.zh: 你昨天下午做什么了？
messages.en: What did you do yesterday afternoon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit timriħ mal-baħar, mingħajr pjan.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit timriħ mal-baħar, mingħajr pjan.
messages.zh: 就在海边随意走了走，没什么计划。
messages.en: A little wandering by the sea, without a plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上沿海边随意走走的画面，记住它指的是“走动、漫游”这项活动，而不是某个行走的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of wiping a surface, for example to remove dirt or moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 擦过物体表面以去除污物、水分等的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tgħaddi ċarruta jew xi ħaġa simili fuq wiċċ biex tneħħi l-ħmieġ jew l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦拭；用布等擦过表面的动作。

formal.mt: Wara t-timsiħ tal-mejda b'ċarruta niedja, ħalli l-wiċċ jinxef.
formal.en: After wiping the table with a damp cloth, let the surface dry.
formal.zh: 用湿布擦拭桌子后，让桌面晾干。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Lest it-timsiħ tal-mejda? Nina: Iva, għadni kemm spiċċajt. Nista' npoġġi l-platti?
colloquial.en: Mum: Have you finished wiping the table? Nina: Yes, I've just finished. Can I put the plates out?
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：桌子擦好了吗？妮娜：好了，我刚擦完。可以摆盘子了吗？

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Lest it-timsiħ tal-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Lest it-timsiħ tal-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌子擦好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished wiping the table?

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm spiċċajt. Nista' npoġġi l-platti?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm spiċċajt. Nista' npoġġi l-platti?
messages.zh: 好了，我刚擦完。可以摆盘子了吗？
messages.en: Yes, I've just finished. Can I put the plates out?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一块湿布在桌面上来回擦的动作当作记忆画面，看到这个词就想到“擦拭”这一动作名词。

gloss_zh: 刀刺；通常用小折刀刺人的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of stabbing someone, usually with a penknife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用刀刺人的行为，通常指使用小折刀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tagħti daqqa ta' sikkina lil xi ħadd, normalment b'sikkina żgħira li tingħalaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刀刺行为，通常指用小折刀刺人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' timwis li seħħ waqt ġlieda.
formal.en: The report describes a case of stabbing that occurred during a fight.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起在打斗中发生的刀刺案件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'timwis' f'din l-aħbar? Toni: Ifisser li xi ħadd ta daqqa ta' sikkina lil persuna oħra, ġeneralment b'sikkina żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'timwis' mean in this news story? Toni: It means someone stabbed another person, usually with a small knife.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条新闻里的“timwis”是什么意思？托尼：指有人用刀刺了另一个人，通常用的是小刀。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'timwis' f'din l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'timwis' f'din l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 这条新闻里的“timwis”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'timwis' mean in this news story?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħadd ta daqqa ta' sikkina lil persuna oħra, ġeneralment b'sikkina żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħadd ta daqqa ta' sikkina lil persuna oħra, ġeneralment b'sikkina żgħira.
messages.zh: 指有人用刀刺了另一个人，通常用的是小刀。
messages.en: It means someone stabbed another person, usually with a small knife.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进新闻标题“刀刺案件”中记忆，并加上一张小折刀的词义卡；它指刀刺行为，不是刀具名称。

gloss_zh: 逐渐减弱；使人畏缩；惊惶沮丧；心灰意冷

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dying down in strength or activity; also a daunting effect, dismay, or despondency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 力量或活动逐渐减弱；也可指使人畏缩的作用、惊惶沮丧或心灰意冷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-qawwa jew fl-attività; ukoll effett li jbeżża' jew jaqta' l-qalb, jew stat ta' skuraġġiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐减弱；渐渐平息。
使人畏缩或望而却步的作用。
因坏消息、困难等产生的惊惶、失望或沮丧。
心灰意冷；失去希望和信心的低落状态。

collocations.en: the dying down of the fire
a feeling of dismay or despondency
collocations.zh: 沮丧或心灰意冷的感觉

formal.mt: It-timwit tan-nar kien gradwali, u l-fjammi saru dejjem iżgħar.
formal.en: The fire died down gradually, and the flames became smaller and smaller.
formal.zh: 火势逐渐减弱，火焰越来越小。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din l-aħbar ħallietni b'sens ta' timwit. Mark: Nifhmek. Ejja naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: This news has left me feeling despondent. Mark: I understand. Let's see what we can do together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这消息让我有点心灰意冷。马克：我理解。我们一起看看能做些什么吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-aħbar ħallietni b'sens ta' timwit.
messages.mt_standard: Din l-aħbar ħallietni b'sens ta' timwit.
messages.zh: 这消息让我有点心灰意冷。
messages.en: This news has left me feeling despondent.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmek. Ejja naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmek. Ejja naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu flimkien.
messages.zh: 我理解。我们一起看看能做些什么吧。
messages.en: I understand. Let's see what we can do together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡分别记：火焰变小对应“渐弱”，人垂下肩膀对应“畏缩、沮丧、心灰意冷”；这是情景联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wavy shape or a movement that rises and falls like waves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈波浪状的形态，或像波浪一样上下起伏的运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma b'mewġ jew moviment li jitla' u jinżel bħall-mewġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波浪状；表面或线条呈波浪形的状态。
波动；如波浪般连续起伏的运动或形态。

collocations.en: the waviness or undulation of the fabric

formal.mt: Id-dawl fuq wiċċ l-għadira jagħmel it-timwiġ tal-ilma aktar viżibbli.
formal.en: The light on the pond's surface makes the undulation of the water more visible.
formal.zh: 池塘表面的光线使水面的波动更加清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara t-timwiġ tad-drapp ħdejn it-tieqa? Ben: Iva, ir-riħ qed iċaqalqu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see the fabric undulating by the window? Ben: Yes, the wind is moving it gently.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到窗边布料的起伏了吗？本：看到了，是风在轻轻吹动它。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara t-timwiġ tad-drapp ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara t-timwiġ tad-drapp ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你看到窗边布料的起伏了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the fabric undulating by the window?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ir-riħ qed iċaqalqu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ir-riħ qed iċaqalqu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 看到了，是风在轻轻吹动它。
messages.en: Yes, the wind is moving it gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条波浪线：静止看是“波浪状”，让它上下移动就是“波动、起伏”，用同一画面区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 梳头；梳理羊毛或棉纤维

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of combing hair, or of carding wool or cotton to separate and arrange the fibres.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 梳理头发的动作；也指梳理羊毛或棉花，使纤维分开并排列的工序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tgħaddi moxt mix-xagħar, jew li tifred u tirranġa l-fibri tas-suf jew tal-qoton b'għodda apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳头；用梳子梳理头发。
梳理羊毛或棉花；使纤维分开并排列的加工工序。

formal.mt: It-timxit tas-suf jgħin biex il-fibri jinfirdu u jkunu lesti għall-għażil.
formal.en: Carding wool helps separate the fibres and prepare them for spinning.
formal.zh: 梳理羊毛有助于分开纤维，为纺纱做好准备。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Lest it-timxit tax-xagħar? Nina: Kważi! Għandi għoqda żgħira fuq wara.
colloquial.en: Mum: Have you finished combing your hair? Nina: Almost! I've got a little tangle at the back.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：头发梳好了吗？妮娜：快好了！后面还有一小处打结。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Lest it-timxit tax-xagħar?
messages.mt_standard: Lest it-timxit tax-xagħar?
messages.zh: 头发梳好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished combing your hair?

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi! Għandi għoqda żgħira fuq wara.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi! Għandi għoqda żgħira fuq wara.
messages.zh: 快好了！后面还有一小处打结。
messages.en: Almost! I've got a little tangle at the back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“梳顺一束纤维”作为共同画面：头上的纤维是头发，工坊里的纤维是羊毛或棉花，由此记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of blowing one's nose, or the production of mucus in the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 擤鼻涕的动作，也可指鼻腔产生鼻涕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jonfoħ imnieħru, jew il-produzzjoni tal-mukus fl-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擤鼻涕，即通过向外呼气清除鼻涕的动作。
鼻涕的产生或分泌。

formal.mt: Wara t-timħit, il-maktur tal-karti użat jintrema fil-kontenitur tal-iskart.
formal.en: After blowing the nose, the used tissue is disposed of in the waste bin.
formal.zh: 擤鼻涕后，将用过的纸巾丢入垃圾桶。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek maktur għat-timħit? Nina: Iva, ħu dan il-maktur tal-karti nadif.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you got a tissue for blowing my nose? Nina: Yes, take this clean tissue.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你有纸巾让我擤一下鼻涕吗？Nina：有，拿这张干净的纸巾吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek maktur għat-timħit?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek maktur għat-timħit?
messages.zh: 你有纸巾让我擤一下鼻涕吗？
messages.en: Have you got a tissue for blowing my nose?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dan il-maktur tal-karti nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dan il-maktur tal-karti nadif.
messages.zh: 有，拿这张干净的纸巾吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this clean tissue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿纸巾擤鼻涕，再把“鼻涕产生”放在同一张记忆卡上，分别记住动作义和分泌义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or process of causing something to become decrepit or rotten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得衰朽、破败或腐烂的作用或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titwassal biex tiddeterjora, titmermer jew titħassar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使衰朽或腐烂；导致某物逐渐破败、腐坏的作用。

collocations.en: causing wood to deteriorate or rot
the deterioration or rotting caused by damp
collocations.zh: 潮湿造成的衰朽或腐烂

formal.mt: L-umdità kontinwa tikkontribwixxi għat-timżiż tal-injam f'bini li ma jinżammx tajjeb.
formal.en: Persistent damp contributes to the deterioration and rotting of wood in poorly maintained buildings.
formal.zh: 在维护不善的建筑中，持续潮湿会促使木材衰朽、腐烂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'timżiż' f'dan ir-rapport dwar il-bieb? Ben: Hawn ifisser li l-umdità qed iġġiegħel l-injam jitmermer.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'timżiż' mean in this report about the door? Ben: Here it means that damp is causing the wood to deteriorate.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份门的检查报告里，“timżiż”是什么意思？本：这里是说潮湿正在使木材腐朽。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'timżiż' f'dan ir-rapport dwar il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'timżiż' f'dan ir-rapport dwar il-bieb?
messages.zh: 这份门的检查报告里，“timżiż”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'timżiż' mean in this report about the door?

messages.speaker: Ben (维修人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li l-umdità qed iġġiegħel l-injam jitmermer.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li l-umdità qed iġġiegħel l-injam jitmermer.
messages.zh: 这里是说潮湿正在使木材腐朽。
messages.en: Here it means that damp is causing the wood to deteriorate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象潮气不断侵蚀一扇旧木门，使它逐渐腐朽；记忆重点放在“使东西衰朽、腐烂”的作用过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Figs considered collectively, or fig used as a food or flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 统称无花果果实，也可指作为食物或口味的无花果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frott tas-siġra tat-tin, meqjus flimkien jew bħala ikel jew togħma.

sense_translations.en_definition: fig, figs: (several fruits; fig as a mass or taste)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 无花果：指多个果实的集合，或作为食材、口味的无花果。
臀部；屁股。

formal.mt: It-tin frisk jista' jintuża biex isir il-ġamm.
formal.en: Fresh figs can be used to make jam.
formal.zh: 新鲜无花果可以用来制作果酱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit tin? Mark: Iva, jekk hu misjur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some figs? Mark: Yes, if they are ripe.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想吃点无花果吗？马克：想，只要熟了就行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit tin?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit tin?
messages.zh: 你想吃点无花果吗？
messages.en: Would you like some figs?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk hu misjur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk hu misjur.
messages.zh: 想，只要熟了就行。
messages.en: Yes, if they are ripe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tin 和一盘无花果联系起来记；遇到身体语境时，再联想到“臀部”这一另义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of claiming to reveal the future, or a prediction presented as a prophecy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声称能揭示未来的占卜活动，或以预言形式表达的预测。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed jippretendi li jikxef il-futur, jew tbassir ippreżentat bħala profezija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 占卜；算命，即声称能够预测个人命运或未来事件的活动。
预言；关于未来事件的预示或宣告。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-prattika tat-tinbija mingħajr ma jippreżentaha bħala metodu xjentifiku.
formal.en: The study describes the practice of fortune telling without presenting it as a scientific method.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了占卜活动，但没有将其视为科学方法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din tinbija jew sempliċi raden? Pawlu: Għalija, sempliċi raden.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a prophecy or just a guess? Pawlu: To me, it is just a guess.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是预言，还是随便猜的？保罗：在我看来，就是猜的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din tinbija jew sempliċi raden?
messages.mt_standard: Din tinbija jew sempliċi raden?
messages.zh: 这是预言，还是随便猜的？
messages.en: Is this a prophecy or just a guess?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija, sempliċi raden.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija, sempliċi raden.
messages.zh: 在我看来，就是猜的。
messages.en: To me, it is just a guess.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅“有人谈论未来”的画面记 tinbija：做这件事是占卜，说出的内容可以是预言。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of keeping watch over something in order to notice changes or possible problems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续留意或看守某物，以发现变化或可能出现的问题的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iżomm għajnejh fuq xi ħaġa biex jinnota bidliet jew problemi possibbli.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of keeping a watch on sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某物保持留意、看守或监视的行为。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tas-sigurtà jipprevedi tindir kontinwu fuq id-daħla tal-maħżen.
formal.en: The security plan provides for a continuous watch over the warehouse entrance.
formal.zh: 安保计划规定对仓库入口进行持续看守。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tindir fuq id-daħla? Ġużeppi: Jien; int tista' tidħol.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who will keep watch over the entrance? Ġużeppi: I will; you can go inside.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：谁来留意入口？朱塞佩：我来，你可以进去。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tindir fuq id-daħla?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tindir fuq id-daħla?
messages.zh: 谁来留意入口？
messages.en: Who will keep watch over the entrance?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; int tista' tidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; int tista' tidħol.
messages.zh: 我来，你可以进去。
messages.en: I will; you can go inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门口有人一直睁眼留意动静，把 tindir 记成“持续看守这件事”，注意它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express dissatisfaction or discomfort, sometimes in a whining manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达不满或不舒服，有时带有哼哼唧唧、反复诉苦的语气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon jew skumdità, xi drabi b'ton ta' tgergir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱怨；表达不满、痛苦或不适。
哼哼唧唧地抱怨；用拖长、带有诉苦意味的声音表达不满。

formal.mt: Il-klijent tines dwar il-ħin twil ta' stennija.
formal.en: The customer complained about the long waiting time.
formal.zh: 顾客抱怨等候时间太长。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tines it-tifel? Mark: Kellu l-ġuħ; issa qed jiekol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the boy whine? Mark: He was hungry; now he is eating.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩刚才为什么哼哼唧唧的？马克：他饿了，现在正在吃东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tines it-tifel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tines it-tifel?
messages.zh: 那个男孩刚才为什么哼哼唧唧的？
messages.en: Why did the boy whine?

messages.speaker: Mark (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu l-ġuħ; issa qed jiekol.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu l-ġuħ; issa qed jiekol.
messages.zh: 他饿了，现在正在吃东西。
messages.en: He was hungry; now he is eating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tines 配上“不满意地出声”的表情记忆：普通表达是抱怨，拖着声音诉苦则是哼哼唧唧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of taking air into the body and letting it out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将空气吸入体内再呼出的过程，即呼吸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-arja tidħol fil-ġisem u terġa' toħroġ minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼吸；吸入和呼出空气的过程。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jibda b'minuta ta' tinfis bil-mod u regolari.
formal.en: The exercise begins with one minute of slow, regular breathing.
formal.zh: 练习先从一分钟缓慢而有规律的呼吸开始。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu t-tinfis tiegħek wara l-ġirja? David: Għadu mgħaġġel, imma qed jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is your breathing after the run? David: It is still fast, but it is settling down.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：跑完以后，你呼吸怎么样？戴维：还挺快，不过正在慢慢平稳下来。

messages.speaker: Sara (跑步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu t-tinfis tiegħek wara l-ġirja?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu t-tinfis tiegħek wara l-ġirja?
messages.zh: 跑完以后，你呼吸怎么样？
messages.en: How is your breathing after the run?

messages.speaker: David (跑步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mgħaġġel, imma qed jikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mgħaġġel, imma qed jikkalma.
messages.zh: 还挺快，不过正在慢慢平稳下来。
messages.en: It is still fast, but it is settling down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 tinfis 时想象胸口一上一下，把“一吸一呼的过程”与这个名词绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of stinging, or a sharp prick or brief piercing sensation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜇刺的动作，或像被尖物扎到一样的短暂刺痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa tniggeż, jew sensazzjoni qasira u qawwija bħal dik ta' labra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜇刺；蜇刺所造成的刺激或疼痛。
刺扎；像被针尖轻扎一下的刺痛。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant iddeskriva sensazzjoni ta' tingiż ħafif f'idu.
formal.en: The participant described a mild stinging sensation in his hand.
formal.zh: 参与者描述说，他的手上有轻微的刺痛感。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi ħassejt meta messejt ix-xewka? Luqa: Tingiż ħafif, bħal ta' labra.
colloquial.en: Marta: What did you feel when you touched the thorn? Luqa: A slight prick, like a needle.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你碰到那根刺时是什么感觉？卢卡：轻轻刺了一下，像针扎一样。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħassejt meta messejt ix-xewka?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħassejt meta messejt ix-xewka?
messages.zh: 你碰到那根刺时是什么感觉？
messages.en: What did you feel when you touched the thorn?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tingiż ħafif, bħal ta' labra.
messages.mt_standard: Tingiż ħafif, bħal ta' labra.
messages.zh: 轻轻刺了一下，像针扎一样。
messages.en: A slight prick, like a needle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tingiż 配上手指被针尖轻扎后缩回的画面，记住“蜇一下、刺一下”的动作或感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of feeling sleepy or the act of sleeping lightly for a short time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到困倦的状态，或短时间浅睡、打瞌睡的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' min ikun bi ngħas, jew irqad ħafif għal ħin qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困倦、昏昏欲睡的状态。
打瞌睡；短时间浅睡。

formal.mt: It-tingħis waqt il-lezzjoni jista' jagħmilha diffiċli għall-istudent biex isegwi l-ispjegazzjoni.
formal.en: Drowsiness during the lesson can make it difficult for the student to follow the explanation.
formal.zh: 上课时困倦可能使学生难以跟上讲解。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajtek tagħlaq għajnejk waqt il-film. Pawlu: Kien ftit tingħis biss; ilbieraħ ma rqadtx biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Lara: I saw you closing your eyes during the film. Pawlu: I was only dozing a little; I didn't get enough sleep yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我看见你看电影时闭上了眼睛。Pawlu：只是打了个小盹；我昨天没睡够。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtek tagħlaq għajnejk waqt il-film.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtek tagħlaq għajnejk waqt il-film.
messages.zh: 我看见你看电影时闭上了眼睛。
messages.en: I saw you closing your eyes during the film.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ftit tingħis biss; ilbieraħ ma rqadtx biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ftit tingħis biss; ilbieraħ ma rqadtx biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 只是打了个小盹；我昨天没睡够。
messages.en: I was only dozing a little; I didn't get enough sleep yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饭后眼皮慢慢合上的过程：还没睡着时是困倦，短暂睡过去就是打瞌睡，两者都可联系这个词。

gloss_zh: 愚蠢举动；愚笨；盲从行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: Silly or foolish behaviour, including behaving like sheep by following others without thinking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愚蠢、不明智的行为，也可指像羊群一样不加思考地跟随他人的表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba iblah jew bla għaqal, inkluż li wieħed jimxi wara l-oħrajn mingħajr ma jaħseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 傻气、愚蠢或不明智的行为。
极度愚笨或愚钝。
羊群般的行为，尤其指不加思考地跟随他人。

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkritika t-tingħiġ ta' dawk li jimxu wara l-folla mingħajr ma jaħsbu.
formal.en: The author criticizes the sheep-like behaviour of those who follow the crowd without thinking.
formal.zh: 作者批评了那些不加思考便随大流的盲从行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tagħmel bħall-oħrajn jekk taf li hu ħażin? Toni: Għandek raġun. Dan kollu tingħiġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you doing what the others are doing if you know it is wrong? Toni: You're right. This is all foolish behaviour.
colloquial.zh: Maja：既然知道不对，你为什么还跟着别人做？Toni：你说得对。这完全是在犯傻。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tagħmel bħall-oħrajn jekk taf li hu ħażin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tagħmel bħall-oħrajn jekk taf li hu ħażin?
messages.zh: 既然知道不对，你为什么还跟着别人做？
messages.en: Why are you doing what the others are doing if you know it is wrong?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Dan kollu tingħiġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Dan kollu tingħiġ.
messages.zh: 你说得对。这完全是在犯傻。
messages.en: You're right. This is all foolish behaviour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一幅学习画面：大家不动脑筋跟着羊群走，用来联想愚蠢和盲从两层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of folding something, especially clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物折叠起来的动作，通常指叠衣服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitwi xi ħaġa, speċjalment il-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 折叠某物的动作，通常指叠衣服。

formal.mt: It-tini tal-ħwejjeġ qabel ma jitqiegħdu fil-kexxun jgħin biex jinżammu puliti.
formal.en: Folding clothes before placing them in the drawer helps keep them tidy.
formal.zh: 把衣服叠好再放进抽屉，有助于保持整齐。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għad fadal ħafna xogħol bil-ħwejjeġ? David: Il-ħasil lest; fadal biss it-tini.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is there still much work left with the clothes? David: The washing is done; only the folding is left.
colloquial.zh: Marija：衣服还有很多活儿没做完吗？David：已经洗好了，只剩叠衣服了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal ħafna xogħol bil-ħwejjeġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal ħafna xogħol bil-ħwejjeġ?
messages.zh: 衣服还有很多活儿没做完吗？
messages.en: Is there still much work left with the clothes?

messages.speaker: David (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħasil lest; fadal biss it-tini.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħasil lest; fadal biss it-tini.
messages.zh: 已经洗好了，只剩叠衣服了。
messages.en: The washing is done; only the folding is left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用双手把衬衫叠好的连续动作来记 tini：这里强调折叠这件事，再与表示折痕的 tinja 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A line or mark left on fabric, paper, or another surface where it has been folded or pressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料、纸张等因折叠或受压而留下的线状痕迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linja jew marka fid-drapp, fil-karta jew fuq wiċċ ieħor fejn ikun intlewa jew ingħafas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 折痕；布料、纸张等折叠或受压后留下的褶痕。

collocations.en: remove a crease with an iron

formal.mt: Wara li nfetħet il-folja, it-tinja fin-nofs baqgħet tidher.
formal.en: After the sheet was unfolded, the crease in the middle remained visible.
formal.zh: 纸张展开后，中间的折痕仍然清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm tinja fil-qmis tiegħi. Luqa: Għaddiha bil-ħadida tal-mogħdija qabel ma tilbesha.
colloquial.en: Sara: There's a crease in my shirt. Luqa: Iron it before you put it on.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我的衬衫上有一道褶痕。Luqa：穿之前用熨斗熨一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tinja fil-qmis tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tinja fil-qmis tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我的衬衫上有一道褶痕。
messages.en: There's a crease in my shirt.

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddiha bil-ħadida tal-mogħdija qabel ma tilbesha.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddiha bil-ħadida tal-mogħdija qabel ma tilbesha.
messages.zh: 穿之前用熨斗熨一下。
messages.en: Iron it before you put it on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张纸展开后还留着中间那条线：tinja 记作可看见的折痕，与 tini 所指的折叠动作分开。

gloss_zh: 獠牙或犬齿的磨动；磨獠牙声

teaching_sense.en_definition: The grinding of tusks or canine teeth against one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 獠牙或犬齿相互磨动的行为，也可指由此产生的磨擦声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tħakkik tan-nejbiet ma' xulxin, jew il-ħoss li jagħmlu waqt dan it-tħakkik.

sense_translations.en_definition: grinding of tusks or eye teeth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 獠牙或犬齿的磨动；其中 eye teeth 指犬齿。

collocations.en: the wild boar's grinding of its tusks
the sound of tusks or canine teeth grinding
collocations.zh: 磨动獠牙或犬齿的声音

formal.mt: Fl-osservazzjoni tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur irreġistra l-ħoss tat-tinjib tal-ħanżir selvaġġ.
formal.en: During his observation, the researcher recorded the sound of the wild boar grinding its tusks.
formal.zh: 研究人员在观察过程中录下了野猪磨动獠牙的声音。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fir-reġistrazzjoni? Ruben: Dak it-tinjib tal-ħanżir selvaġġ; qed iħokk in-nejbiet ma' xulxin.
colloquial.en: Elena: What is that sound in the recording? Ruben: That's the wild boar grinding its tusks; it is rubbing them against one another.
colloquial.zh: Elena：录音里的那个声音是什么？Ruben：那是野猪磨动獠牙的声音；它正在让獠牙相互磨擦。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fir-reġistrazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fir-reġistrazzjoni?
messages.zh: 录音里的那个声音是什么？
messages.en: What is that sound in the recording?

messages.speaker: Ruben (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tinjib tal-ħanżir selvaġġ; qed iħokk in-nejbiet ma' xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tinjib tal-ħanżir selvaġġ; qed iħokk in-nejbiet ma' xulxin.
messages.zh: 那是野猪磨动獠牙的声音；它正在让獠牙相互磨擦。
messages.en: That's the wild boar grinding its tusks; it is rubbing them against one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头拉近到两枚相互磨动的獠牙，用动作和声音一起记 tinjib；英文 eye teeth 在这里是犬齿。

gloss_zh: 轻浮；轻佻；不严肃的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of seriousness shown in light-minded or frivolous behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现为轻浮、轻佻或缺乏应有严肃态度的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' serjetà li jidher f'imġiba ħafifa jew frivola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻浮；轻佻；缺乏严肃态度的言行。

formal.mt: Il-president talab serjetà u qal li ma kienx hemm lok għat-tinjik waqt id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: The chair called for seriousness and said there was no place for frivolity during the discussion.
formal.zh: 会议主席要求大家认真对待，并表示讨论期间不应有轻浮的言行。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ejja nieqfu mit-tinjik; irridu nispiċċaw dan ix-xogħol. Ben: Sewwa, issa nikkonċentra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Let's stop fooling around; we need to finish this work. Ben: All right, I'll concentrate now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：别再嬉闹了，我们得把这项工作做完。Ben：好，我现在专心做。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieqfu mit-tinjik; irridu nispiċċaw dan ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieqfu mit-tinjik; irridu nispiċċaw dan ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 别再嬉闹了，我们得把这项工作做完。
messages.en: Let's stop fooling around; we need to finish this work.

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, issa nikkonċentra.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, issa nikkonċentra.
messages.zh: 好，我现在专心做。
messages.en: All right, I'll concentrate now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象严肃会议中有人一直嬉笑打闹，把这种缺少认真态度的表现贴上 tinjik 标签，记住轻浮这一核心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of starting a fire, or of cooking food over a flame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 点起火来的行为，也指把食物放在火焰上烹煮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqabbad in-nar, jew li ssajjar l-ikel fuq fjamma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生火；点起火来的行为。
用明火烹煮；在火焰上烹调食物。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliem wera t-tinjir tan-nar u mbagħad it-tinjir tal-ikel fuq il-fjamma.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher demonstrated starting a fire and then cooking food over the flame.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师先示范生火，然后示范在火焰上烹煮食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tinjir tan-nar se tieħu ħsiebu int? Mark: Iva, u mbagħad insajru fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will you take care of starting the fire? Mark: Yes, and then we'll cook over it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：生火的事你来负责吗？马克：好，然后我们就在火上做饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tinjir tan-nar se tieħu ħsiebu int?
messages.mt_standard: It-tinjir tan-nar se tieħu ħsiebu int?
messages.zh: 生火的事你来负责吗？
messages.en: Will you take care of starting the fire?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u mbagħad insajru fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u mbagħad insajru fuqu.
messages.zh: 好，然后我们就在火上做饭。
messages.en: Yes, and then we'll cook over it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把营火旁的动作连成画面：先点火，再架锅烹煮；用这两个相连场景记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of changing direction by taking a turn, for example around a corner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行进时改变方向、转过弯角的动作，例如在街角拐弯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tibdel id-direzzjoni billi ddur, pereżempju ma' kantuniera.

sense_translations.en_definition: taking a turn (e.g. round a corner)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 转弯；拐过弯角等改变行进方向的动作。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tinkib mal-kantuniera, is-sewwieq naqqas il-veloċità biex iżomm il-kontroll tal-vettura.
formal.en: While turning around the corner, the driver reduced speed to maintain control of the vehicle.
formal.zh: 司机在街角转弯时降低了车速，以保持对车辆的控制。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed issuq daqshekk bil-mod? Mark: Hawn ftit spazju għat-tinkib mal-kantuniera.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you driving so slowly? Mark: There's little room here to turn around the corner.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么开得这么慢？马克：这里拐弯的空间很小。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed issuq daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed issuq daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.zh: 你为什么开得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you driving so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ftit spazju għat-tinkib mal-kantuniera.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ftit spazju għat-tinkib mal-kantuniera.
messages.zh: 这里拐弯的空间很小。
messages.en: There's little room here to turn around the corner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上的路线在街角折向右边，把这个词与实际转弯的动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of remaining somewhere longer than necessary, or spending time there without a clear purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某处迟迟不离开的逗留，也指没有明确目的地闲待或游荡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tibqa' f'post aktar milli jkun meħtieġ, jew li tqatta' l-ħin hemm bla skop ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗留；停留较久而迟迟不离开。
闲逛；游荡；没有明确目的地在某处闲待。

formal.mt: It-tinkir ħdejn il-bieb wara t-tmiem tal-laqgħa dewwem l-għeluq tas-sala.
formal.en: Lingering by the door after the meeting ended delayed the closing of the hall.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，人们在门边迟迟不走，延误了会场的关闭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Biżżejjed tinkir ħdejn il-bieb! Se nitilqu? Mark: Iva, kont qed nistenna lil Pawlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Enough lingering by the door! Shall we leave? Mark: Yes, I was waiting for Pawlu.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：别再在门边磨蹭啦！我们走吗？马克：走吧，我刚才在等保罗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biżżejjed tinkir ħdejn il-bieb! Se nitilqu?
messages.mt_standard: Biżżejjed tinkir ħdejn il-bieb! Se nitilqu?
messages.zh: 别再在门边磨蹭啦！我们走吗？
messages.en: Enough lingering by the door! Shall we leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kont qed nistenna lil Pawlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kont qed nistenna lil Pawlu.
messages.zh: 走吧，我刚才在等保罗。
messages.en: Yes, I was waiting for Pawlu.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用门口迟迟不走的人记逗留，用街头无事闲待的人记游荡；共同画面都是停着不离开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making dots, adding punctuation to writing, or causing someone grief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作出点状记号、给文字加标点的行为，也指使人悲伤或痛苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel tikek, li żżid sinjali tal-punteġġjatura f'test, jew li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitnikket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点点；作出一个个点状记号。
加标点；在文字中加入标点符号。
使人悲伤；给人带来伤心或痛苦。

formal.mt: It-tinkit tat-test sar b'attenzjoni sabiex il-qarrej seta' jifhem fejn tintemm kull sentenza.
formal.en: The text was punctuated carefully so that the reader could understand where each sentence ended.
formal.zh: 文本经过仔细的标点处理，使读者能够看清每个句子在哪里结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejt il-kitba? Mark: Kważi; baqagħli t-tinkit tat-test, għax insejt xi virgoli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished the writing? Mark: Almost; I still need to punctuate the text because I forgot some commas.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你写完了吗？马克：快了，还要给文本补标点，因为我漏了几个逗号。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt il-kitba?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt il-kitba?
messages.zh: 你写完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the writing?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; baqagħli t-tinkit tat-test, għax insejt xi virgoli.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; baqagħli t-tinkit tat-test, għax insejt xi virgoli.
messages.zh: 快了，还要给文本补标点，因为我漏了几个逗号。
messages.en: Almost; I still need to punctuate the text because I forgot some commas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成三张记忆卡：纸上的小点、句中的标点、令人伤心的事情；第三义单独记，避免只记书写用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to whimper, or easily annoyed and likely to show displeasure over small things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易低声呜咽的，或容易因小事不高兴而闹脾气的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jibki b'leħen baxx, jew li jiddejjaq u juri dwejjaq malajr minħabba affarijiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱呜咽的；容易低声哼哭的。
爱闹脾气的；容易因小事而表现出不耐烦或不高兴的。

formal.mt: It-tifel kien tinniesi wara l-vjaġġ twil u beda jibki kull darba li kellu jistenna.
formal.en: The boy was petulant after the long journey and began to cry whenever he had to wait.
formal.zh: 长途旅行后，男孩有些爱闹脾气，每次需要等待就开始哭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Leo daqshekk tinniesi llum? Mark: Ma raqadx biżżejjed u kollox qed idejqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Leo so petulant today? Mark: He didn't get enough sleep, and everything is bothering him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：莱奥今天怎么这么爱闹脾气？马克：他没睡够，什么都让他烦。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Leo daqshekk tinniesi llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Leo daqshekk tinniesi llum?
messages.zh: 莱奥今天怎么这么爱闹脾气？
messages.en: Why is Leo so petulant today?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma raqadx biżżejjed u kollox qed idejqu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma raqadx biżżejjed u kollox qed idejqu.
messages.zh: 他没睡够，什么都让他烦。
messages.en: He didn't get enough sleep, and everything is bothering him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个困倦的孩子，先低声哼哭，再因小事闹脾气；这两个表现分别帮助记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making a hole in something with a pointed object, or passing a pointed object through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用尖物在物体上刺出孔洞，或用尖物将其穿透的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel toqba f'xi ħaġa b'oġġett bil-ponta, jew li tgħaddi oġġett bil-ponta minn ġo fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺孔；用尖物刺出孔洞。
穿孔；刺穿；用尖物穿透某物。

formal.mt: It-tinqib tal-karta b'labra ħoloq toqob żgħar tul il-linja mmarkata.
formal.en: Piercing the paper with a needle created small holes along the marked line.
formal.zh: 用针给纸穿孔后，标记线上出现了一排小孔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek labra fuq il-mejda? Mark: Għat-tinqib tal-karta; irrid ngħaddi ħajta minnha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have a needle on the table? Mark: To pierce the paper; I want to pass a thread through it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你桌上为什么放着一根针？马克：用来给纸穿孔，我想把线穿过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek labra fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek labra fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 你桌上为什么放着一根针？
messages.en: Why do you have a needle on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tinqib tal-karta; irrid ngħaddi ħajta minnha.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tinqib tal-karta; irrid ngħaddi ħajta minnha.
messages.zh: 用来给纸穿孔，我想把线穿过去。
messages.en: To pierce the paper; I want to pass a thread through it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 盯住针尖刺入纸面、留下小孔的画面：重点是刺出孔或穿透这一动作，而不是孔本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of removing weeds, or pulling out something such as feathers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清除杂草的行为，也指将羽毛等东西拔下或拔出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin, jew li taqla' affarijiet bħar-rix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 除草；清除不需要的杂草的行为。
拔取；将羽毛等东西拔下或拔出的行为。

formal.mt: It-tinqija tal-ħaxix ħażin saret bl-idejn biex il-pjanti żgħar ma jiġrilhomx ħsara.
formal.en: The weeds were removed by hand so that the young plants would not be damaged.
formal.zh: 为避免损伤幼苗，杂草由人工拔除。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nagħmlu fil-ġnien illum? Mark: Nibdew bit-tinqija tal-ħaxix ħażin, imbagħad insaqqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are we going to do in the garden today? Mark: We'll start with weeding, then we'll water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天我们在花园里做些什么？马克：先除草，然后浇水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nagħmlu fil-ġnien illum?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nagħmlu fil-ġnien illum?
messages.zh: 今天我们在花园里做些什么？
messages.en: What are we going to do in the garden today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew bit-tinqija tal-ħaxix ħażin, imbagħad insaqqu.
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew bit-tinqija tal-ħaxix ħażin, imbagħad insaqqu.
messages.zh: 先除草，然后浇水。
messages.en: We'll start with weeding, then we'll water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手指捏住并拔出的动作作为记忆线索：花园里拔的是杂草，另一场景拔的是羽毛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of pecking or eating in small bites, or food intended to be eaten a little at a time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类啄食或人小口啃食的行为，也指供人一点点吃的零嘴、小食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li għasfur jaqbad l-ikel bil-munqar jew li xi ħadd jiekol ftit ftit; ukoll ikel biex jittiekel ftit ftit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啄食；用喙一下下地啄取食物。
小口啃食；一点一点地咬着吃。
零嘴；供人小口慢吃的小食。

formal.mt: Qabel l-ikla, ġew offruti xorb u ftit tinqir lill-mistednin li kienu qed jistennew fis-sala.
formal.en: Before the meal, drinks and some nibbles were offered to the guests waiting in the hall.
formal.zh: 开餐前，工作人员为在大厅等候的客人提供了饮料和一些小食。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek xi tinqir? Għadni ma rridx ikla sħiħa. Mark: Iva, hemm lewż u gallettini fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you got any nibbles? I don't want a full meal yet. Mark: Yes, there are almonds and biscuits on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有点零嘴吗？我现在还不想吃一整顿饭。马克：有，桌上有杏仁和饼干。

messages.speaker: Maja (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi tinqir? Għadni ma rridx ikla sħiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi tinqir? Għadni ma rridx ikla sħiħa.
messages.zh: 有点零嘴吗？我现在还不想吃一整顿饭。
messages.en: Have you got any nibbles? I don't want a full meal yet.

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm lewż u gallettini fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm lewż u gallettini fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 有，桌上有杏仁和饼干。
messages.en: Yes, there are almonds and biscuits on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 连看三个画面：鸟啄谷粒、人小口啃饼干、桌上一碟零嘴；前两个是动作，最后一个是食物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in amount, extent, or duration, including the curtailment of an activity or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量、范围或持续时间的减少，也指活动或服务受到削减。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fl-ammont, fil-firxa jew fit-tul ta' xi ħaġa, inkluż it-tqassir ta' attività jew servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减少；数量或程度的降低。
削减；对活动、服务或持续时间的缩减。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi tinqis fl-ispejjeż mingħajr ma tonqos il-kwalità tas-servizz.
formal.en: The report proposes a reduction in expenses without a decline in service quality.
formal.zh: 报告建议减少开支，同时保持服务质量。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex il-librerija tagħlaq qabel illum? Pawlu: Hemm tinqis fil-ħin tas-servizz din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why does the library close earlier today? Pawlu: Service hours have been reduced this week.
colloquial.zh: Marta：图书馆今天为什么提前关门？Pawlu：这周缩短了服务时间。

messages.speaker: Marta (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-librerija tagħlaq qabel illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-librerija tagħlaq qabel illum?
messages.zh: 图书馆今天为什么提前关门？
messages.en: Why does the library close earlier today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tinqis fil-ħin tas-servizz din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tinqis fil-ħin tas-servizz din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 这周缩短了服务时间。
messages.en: Service hours have been reduced this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把预算表上变短的金额条和营业时间表上缩短的时段放在一起记：tinqis 表示减少或缩减。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of shaping material by chiselling, whittling, or sculpting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过凿刻、削刻或雕塑制作来改变材料形状的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih tingħata forma lil materjal permezz ta' skarpell, sikkina jew għodod oħra tal-iskultura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凿刻；使用凿子切削或刻出形状。
削刻；用刀逐片削去木料以制成形状。
雕塑制作；将材料加工成具有立体形态的作品。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħriġ fit-tinqix fl-injam u fil-ġebel.
formal.en: The course includes training in wood and stone carving.
formal.zh: 这门课程包括木雕和石雕训练。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tagħmel b'dik il-biċċa injam? Toni: Qed nitgħallem it-tinqix u qed nagħmel mgħarfa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you doing with that piece of wood? Toni: I'm learning to carve and making a small spoon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你拿那块木头做什么？Toni：我在学雕刻，正在做一把小勺子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tagħmel b'dik il-biċċa injam?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tagħmel b'dik il-biċċa injam?
messages.zh: 你拿那块木头做什么？
messages.en: What are you doing with that piece of wood?

messages.speaker: Toni (雕刻初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitgħallem it-tinqix u qed nagħmel mgħarfa żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitgħallem it-tinqix u qed nagħmel mgħarfa żgħira.
messages.zh: 我在学雕刻，正在做一把小勺子。
messages.en: I'm learning to carve and making a small spoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象凿子刻石、刀片削木、雕塑逐渐成形的连续画面，用同一个 tinqix 串起三种加工活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A low, weak cry expressing pain, distress, or unhappiness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因疼痛、难受或不快而发出的一声低弱哭声或哀鸣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karba baxxa u dgħajfa li tesprimi wġigħ, dwejjaq jew skumdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一声呜咽；因疼痛或难受而发出的低弱哀鸣。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, il-kelb ħareġ tinsa ta' wġigħ meta l-veterinarja messitlu saqajh.
formal.en: During the examination, the dog let out a whimper of pain when the vet touched his legs.
formal.zh: 检查时，兽医碰到狗的腿，它疼得呜咽了一声。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajt dik it-tinsa? Mark: Iva, il-ġeru qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb. Ħa mmur narah.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear that whimper? Mark: Yes, the puppy is by the door. I'll go and check on him.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你听到那声呜咽了吗？Mark：听到了，小狗在门边。我去看看它。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dik it-tinsa?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dik it-tinsa?
messages.zh: 你听到那声呜咽了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that whimper?

messages.speaker: Mark (小狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ġeru qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb. Ħa mmur narah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ġeru qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb. Ħa mmur narah.
messages.zh: 听到了，小狗在门边。我去看看它。
messages.en: Yes, the puppy is by the door. I'll go and check on him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tinsa 这张名词卡配上一只小狗轻轻呜咽的画面，记住它在本词条中表示一声低弱的哀鸣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of catching birds using traps or nets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用陷阱或捕鸟网捕捉鸟类的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tal-qbid tal-għasafar permezz ta' nases jew xbieki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设陷阱或张网捕鸟的活动。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi t-tinsib bħala l-qbid tal-għasafar permezz ta' nases jew xbieki.
formal.en: The text describes bird trapping as catching birds using traps or nets.
formal.zh: 课文将设陷阱捕鸟描述为利用陷阱或网捕捉鸟类。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ifisser tinsib? Ġanni: Il-qbid tal-għasafar bin-nases jew bix-xbieki.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does tinsib mean? Ġanni: Catching birds with traps or nets.
colloquial.zh: Sara：tinsib 是什么意思？Ġanni：用陷阱或网捕鸟。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser tinsib?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser tinsib?
messages.zh: tinsib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tinsib mean?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qbid tal-għasafar bin-nases jew bix-xbieki.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qbid tal-għasafar bin-nases jew bix-xbieki.
messages.zh: 用陷阱或网捕鸟。
messages.en: Catching birds with traps or nets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画一张捕鸟网，并把整个捕捉活动标为 tinsib；重点记住对象是鸟，方式是陷阱或网。

gloss_zh: 健忘；遗忘；被淡忘的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tendency to forget things, or the state of no longer being remembered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易忘事的倾向，也指人或事物不再被记得的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tendenza li wieħed jinsa l-affarijiet, jew l-istat ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li ma jibqgħux imfakkra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 健忘；容易忘记事情的倾向或状态。
遗忘；人或事物被淡忘、不再被记起的状态。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jiġbor l-istejjer tar-raħal biex ma jaqgħux fit-tinsija.
formal.en: The project collects the village's stories so that they do not fall into oblivion.
formal.zh: 这个项目收集村里的故事，以免它们被遗忘。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Erġajt insejt il-lista tax-xiri? David: Iva, it-tinsija tiegħi! Id-darba li jmiss inżommha fuq il-mowbajl.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you forget the shopping list again? David: Yes, how forgetful I am! Next time I'll keep it on my phone.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你又忘带购物清单了？David：是啊，我这记性！下次我把它存在手机里。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Erġajt insejt il-lista tax-xiri?
messages.mt_standard: Erġajt insejt il-lista tax-xiri?
messages.zh: 你又忘带购物清单了？
messages.en: Did you forget the shopping list again?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tinsija tiegħi! Id-darba li jmiss inżommha fuq il-mowbajl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tinsija tiegħi! Id-darba li jmiss inżommha fuq il-mowbajl.
messages.zh: 是啊，我这记性！下次我把它存在手机里。
messages.en: Yes, how forgetful I am! Next time I'll keep it on my phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 tinsija：忘带购物清单表示健忘，旧故事渐渐无人记得表示被遗忘；两义都围绕记忆消退。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or act of producing offspring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生后代的过程或行为，即生育或繁衍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-att li bih jitwieldu jew jiġu prodotti wlied jew frieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生育后代；产生子女或幼崽的过程或行为。

collocations.en: the production of offspring by animals

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega t-tinsil tal-annimali u l-kura tal-frieħ.
formal.en: The chapter explains how animals produce offspring and care for their young.
formal.zh: 这一章讲解动物如何繁衍后代以及照顾幼崽。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-lezzjoni llum? Marija: It-tinsil tal-annimali. Se nitkellmu dwar kif ikollhom il-frieħ.
colloquial.en: Lina: What's today's lesson about? Marija: Animals producing offspring. We'll talk about how they have young.
colloquial.zh: Lina：今天这节课讲什么？Marija：动物繁衍。我们会讲它们如何产生幼崽。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-lezzjoni llum?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-lezzjoni llum?
messages.zh: 今天这节课讲什么？
messages.en: What's today's lesson about?

messages.speaker: Marija (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tinsil tal-annimali. Se nitkellmu dwar kif ikollhom il-frieħ.
messages.mt_standard: It-tinsil tal-annimali. Se nitkellmu dwar kif ikollhom il-frieħ.
messages.zh: 动物繁衍。我们会讲它们如何产生幼崽。
messages.en: Animals producing offspring. We'll talk about how they have young.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把成年动物与新生幼崽画在同一张卡上，中间用箭头标出 tinsil，记住它强调产生后代的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of interlacing threads or other strands to make fabric or another woven object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把纱线或其他条状材料交错穿接，制成织物或编织物的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li fih ħjut jew materjali oħra jiddaħħlu f'xulxin biex isir drapp jew oġġett minsuġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编织；使纱线或其他条状材料交错结合的织造活动。

formal.mt: Il-workshop jintroduċi t-tekniki bażiċi tat-tinsiġ bl-idejn.
formal.en: The workshop introduces the basic techniques of weaving by hand.
formal.zh: 这场工作坊介绍手工编织的基本技法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-drapp għamiltu int? Rita: Iva, qed nitgħallem it-tinsiġ. Għażilt ħjut blu u bojod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you make this fabric yourself? Rita: Yes, I'm learning to weave. I chose blue and white threads.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块布是你自己织的吗？Rita：是的，我在学编织。我选了蓝色和白色的线。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp għamiltu int?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp għamiltu int?
messages.zh: 这块布是你自己织的吗？
messages.en: Did you make this fabric yourself?

messages.speaker: Rita (编织学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nitgħallem it-tinsiġ. Għażilt ħjut blu u bojod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nitgħallem it-tinsiġ. Għażilt ħjut blu u bojod.
messages.zh: 是的，我在学编织。我选了蓝色和白色的线。
messages.en: Yes, I'm learning to weave. I chose blue and white threads.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蓝线与白线一上一下交错成布，把这个反复穿织的动作过程记为 tinsiġ，帮助联想编织与织造。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of pulling out or removing things such as feathers or hairs by plucking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过拉拔来拔出或去除羽毛、毛发等物的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li fih jitneħħew rix, xagħar jew affarijiet simili billi jinġibdu 'l barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拔除；用拉拔的方式去除羽毛或毛发等物。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-proċess tinkludi t-tintif tar-rix bl-idejn.
formal.en: The description of the process includes plucking the feathers by hand.
formal.zh: 这份流程说明包括用手拔除羽毛的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tintif tar-rix lest? Rosa: Kważi. Fadal biss ftit rix żgħir.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you finished plucking the feathers? Rosa: Almost. There are just a few small feathers left.
colloquial.zh: Mark：羽毛拔完了吗？Rosa：快了，只剩几根小羽毛。

messages.speaker: Mark (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tintif tar-rix lest?
messages.mt_standard: It-tintif tar-rix lest?
messages.zh: 羽毛拔完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished plucking the feathers?

messages.speaker: Rosa (厨房助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Fadal biss ftit rix żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Fadal biss ftit rix żgħir.
messages.zh: 快了，只剩几根小羽毛。
messages.en: Almost. There are just a few small feathers left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指夹住一根羽毛再向外拔出的动作，把反复进行的拔除过程记为 tintif，并搭配 tar-rix 记忆拔羽毛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of alternating things in a planned sequence, especially growing different crops on the same land in successive seasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照一定次序交替安排事物，尤指在同一块土地上按季节或年份种植不同作物的轮作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li affarijiet jinbidlu ma' xulxin skont ordni, speċjalment meta jitkabbru għelejjel differenti fl-istess għalqa minn staġun għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮换；轮作，例如在同一块土地上依次种植不同作物。

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' tinwib tal-għelejjel jindika x'se jitkabbar f'kull għalqa kull sena.
formal.en: The crop rotation plan specifies what will be grown in each field each year.
formal.zh: 作物轮作计划列明了每块田地每年将种植什么。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex din is-sena se niżirgħu l-ful hawn? Pawlu: Għax il-pjan ta' tinwib jgħid li nibdlu l-għalla kull sena.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are we going to sow broad beans here this year? Pawlu: Because the rotation plan says we should change the crop each year.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：为什么今年我们要在这里播种蚕豆？保罗：因为轮作计划要求我们每年更换作物。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din is-sena se niżirgħu l-ful hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din is-sena se niżirgħu l-ful hawn?
messages.zh: 为什么今年我们要在这里播种蚕豆？
messages.en: Why are we going to sow broad beans here this year?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-pjan ta' tinwib jgħid li nibdlu l-għalla kull sena.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-pjan ta' tinwib jgħid li nibdlu l-għalla kull sena.
messages.zh: 因为轮作计划要求我们每年更换作物。
messages.en: Because the rotation plan says we should change the crop each year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把同一块田按年份画成轮换表：今年一种、明年换种，用交替种植的画面记住 tinwib。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of handing something over, passing it on, delivering it, or conveying it to another person or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将物品递给、转交或送达他人或另一地点的行为，也可指传达信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa tingħata, titgħadda jew titwassal lil persuna oħra jew f'post ieħor, jew li jitwassal messaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 递交；把物品交到他人手中。
传递；把收到的东西继续转交给别人。
交付；把物品送达接收人或指定地点。
传送；传达，使物品或信息到达接收方。

formal.mt: It-tinwil tad-dokumenti lill-applikant sar fl-uffiċċju prinċipali.
formal.en: The handing over of the documents to the applicant took place at the main office.
formal.zh: 向申请人递交文件的手续在总办公室办理。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tinwil tal-pakkett? Mark: Jien. Se nagħtih lil Sara meta tiġi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will take care of handing over the parcel? Mark: I will. I'll give it to Sara when she comes.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁来负责把包裹交出去？马克：我来。萨拉来了，我就交给她。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tinwil tal-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tinwil tal-pakkett?
messages.zh: 谁来负责把包裹交出去？
messages.en: Who will take care of handing over the parcel?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Se nagħtih lil Sara meta tiġi.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Se nagħtih lil Sara meta tiġi.
messages.zh: 我来。萨拉来了，我就交给她。
messages.en: I will. I'll give it to Sara when she comes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件从一双手递到另一双手，再联想到包裹送达和信息传达；共同动作就是 tinwil。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or state of drooping, languishing, or subsiding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低垂、萎靡不振或逐渐消退的过程或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-istat ta' xi ħaġa li titbaxxa, titlef il-ħajja jew il-qawwa, jew tonqos bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低垂、耷拉的过程或状态。
萎靡、衰弱或失去活力的过程或状态。
逐渐减弱、平息或消退的过程。

formal.mt: L-osservazzjonijiet jiddeskrivu t-tinwin tal-weraq matul l-aktar sigħat sħan tal-ġurnata.
formal.en: The observations describe the drooping of the leaves during the hottest hours of the day.
formal.zh: 观察记录描述了叶片在一天中最炎热的时段低垂的情况。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt it-tinwin tal-weraq? Toni: Iva, il-weraq kollu mdendel. Ejja naraw jekk il-ħamrija hijiex niexfa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you noticed the drooping of the leaves? Toni: Yes, all the leaves are hanging down. Let's see whether the soil is dry.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你注意到叶子低垂了吗？托尼：是啊，叶子全都耷拉着。我们看看土是不是干了。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt it-tinwin tal-weraq?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt it-tinwin tal-weraq?
messages.zh: 你注意到叶子低垂了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed the drooping of the leaves?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-weraq kollu mdendel. Ejja naraw jekk il-ħamrija hijiex niexfa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-weraq kollu mdendel. Ejja naraw jekk il-ħamrija hijiex niexfa.
messages.zh: 是啊，叶子全都耷拉着。我们看看土是不是干了。
messages.en: Yes, all the leaves are hanging down. Let's see whether the soil is dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用向下的箭头串起叶片低垂、活力衰减和动静消退；本词条按名词记这些过程或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mould or mustiness; in a separate sense, the budding of blossoms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 霉或霉味；另一个独立义项指花蕾的萌发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moffa jew ir-riħa tagħha; f'tifsira oħra, il-ħruġ tal-blanzuni tal-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 霉；物品表面生长的霉菌或霉斑。
霉味；潮湿、久闭或发霉物品散发的气味。
花蕾的萌发；植物开始长出花蕾的过程。

collocations.en: the budding of blossoms on the trees
