formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tinwir tas-siġar fir-rebbiegħa u d-dehra tal-ewwel blanzuni.
formal.en: The report describes the budding of blossoms on the trees in spring and the appearance of the first flower buds.
formal.zh: 报告描述了春季树木花蕾的萌发，以及首批花蕾出现的情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed ixxomm din ir-riħa ta' tinwir? Luqa: Iva, ġejja minn dan l-armarju l-qadim.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you smell this mustiness? Luqa: Yes, it's coming from this old cupboard.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你闻到这股霉味了吗？卢卡：闻到了，是从这个旧柜子里传出来的。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed ixxomm din ir-riħa ta' tinwir?
messages.mt_standard: Qed ixxomm din ir-riħa ta' tinwir?
messages.zh: 你闻到这股霉味了吗？
messages.en: Can you smell this mustiness?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġejja minn dan l-armarju l-qadim.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġejja minn dan l-armarju l-qadim.
messages.zh: 闻到了，是从这个旧柜子里传出来的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from this old cupboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张独立图卡：一张画霉斑并标霉味，一张画初生花蕾；用上下文区分 tinwir 的不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexual intercourse between people who are not married to each other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彼此没有婚姻关系的人之间发生的性交。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非婚性行为；彼此没有婚姻关系的人之间发生的性交。

collocations.zh: 非婚性行为一词的含义

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, it-terminu tinwix ifisser rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.
formal.en: In this lesson, the term tinwix means sexual intercourse between people who are not married to each other.
formal.zh: 在本课中，tinwix 一词指彼此没有婚姻关系的人之间发生的性交。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser tinwix f'din is-sentenza? David: Tfisser rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tinwix mean in this sentence? David: It means sexual intercourse between people who are not married to each other.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个句子里的 tinwix 是什么意思？戴维：指彼此没有婚姻关系的人之间发生的性交。

messages.speaker: Maja (成年学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser tinwix f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser tinwix f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 tinwix 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tinwix mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: David (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 指彼此没有婚姻关系的人之间发生的性交。
messages.en: It means sexual intercourse between people who are not married to each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“双方没有婚姻关系＋性行为”两项组合记忆 tinwix，抓住定义中的关系条件与行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or sound of complaining, whining, or sobbing, expressing dissatisfaction or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达不满或痛苦时的抱怨、哼唧或抽泣行为，也可指这些行为发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-ħoss ta' tgergir, ilment jew biki bis-sulluzzu li jesprimi nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon jew dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱怨；因不满而发牢骚。
哼唧；用拖长、带哭腔的声音表示不满。
抽泣；哭泣时断断续续地哽咽。

formal.mt: Wara li semgħet it-tinwiħ tat-tifel, l-għalliema resqet lejh biex tara x'ġara.
formal.en: After hearing the boy's sobbing, the teacher approached him to see what had happened.
formal.zh: 听到男孩的抽泣声后，老师走到他身边，了解发生了什么。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan it-tinwiħ kollu? Ben: Ħija qed jibki għax tilef il-ġugarell tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's all this sobbing? Ben: My brother is crying because he lost his toy.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：怎么一直有抽泣声？本：我弟弟弄丢了玩具，正在哭。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tinwiħ kollu?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tinwiħ kollu?
messages.zh: 怎么一直有抽泣声？
messages.en: What's all this sobbing?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija qed jibki għax tilef il-ġugarell tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija qed jibki għax tilef il-ġugarell tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我弟弟弄丢了玩具，正在哭。
messages.en: My brother is crying because he lost his toy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一段声音从抱怨变成哼唧，再变成抽泣；用这三个相邻场景记住 tinwiħ 的不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of things becoming dry or being dried, especially clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品变干或被弄干的过程，尤其指衣物的晾干或烘干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih affarijiet, speċjalment ħwejjeġ, jinxfu jew jitnixxfu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物品的干燥过程，尤其指衣物的晾干或烘干。

formal.mt: Il-ħin tat-tinxif tal-ħwejjeġ jiddependi mit-tip ta' drapp u mill-kundizzjonijiet tat-temp.
formal.en: The drying time of clothes depends on the type of fabric and the weather conditions.
formal.zh: 衣物干燥所需的时间取决于面料种类和天气条件。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm għad fadal għat-tinxif tal-ħwejjeġ? Sam: Ftit ieħor. Ix-xugamani għadhom niedja.
colloquial.en: Rita: How much longer until the clothes finish drying? Sam: A little longer. The towels are still damp.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：衣服还要多久才能干？萨姆：还要一会儿。毛巾还是潮的。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għad fadal għat-tinxif tal-ħwejjeġ?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għad fadal għat-tinxif tal-ħwejjeġ?
messages.zh: 衣服还要多久才能干？
messages.en: How much longer until the clothes finish drying?

messages.speaker: Sam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit ieħor. Ix-xugamani għadhom niedja.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit ieħor. Ix-xugamani għadhom niedja.
messages.zh: 还要一会儿。毛巾还是潮的。
messages.en: A little longer. The towels are still damp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象湿衣服挂上晾衣绳，水分逐渐消失；把从湿到干的整个过程标成 tinxif。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The slow seepage or emergence of a liquid through a small opening or a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体通过细小开口或物体表面缓慢渗出的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ bil-mod ta' likwidu minn fetħa żgħira jew minn wiċċ ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渗出；液体从小孔、缝隙或表面缓慢流出的现象。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni ġiet osservata tinxija ta' żejt minn qasma żgħira fil-kontenitur.
formal.en: During the inspection, oil was observed oozing from a small crack in the container.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，油正从容器的一条细小裂缝中缓慢渗出。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Qed tara din it-tinxija ta' ilma ħdejn il-vit? Ġużi: Iva, l-ilma qed joħroġ bil-mod minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Elena: Can you see this water oozing near the tap? Ġużi: Yes, the water is slowly coming out here.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你看到水龙头旁边这里在渗水吗？朱齐：看到了，水正从这里慢慢渗出来。

messages.speaker: Elena (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara din it-tinxija ta' ilma ħdejn il-vit?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara din it-tinxija ta' ilma ħdejn il-vit?
messages.zh: 你看到水龙头旁边这里在渗水吗？
messages.en: Can you see this water oozing near the tap?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (水管工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-ilma qed joħroġ bil-mod minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-ilma qed joħroġ bil-mod minn hawn.
messages.zh: 看到了，水正从这里慢慢渗出来。
messages.en: Yes, the water is slowly coming out here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象细小裂缝边慢慢冒出一层液体，用“小开口、慢渗出”的画面记住 tinxija。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of grass growing or spreading over an area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 青草生长或逐渐蔓延覆盖一片地方的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-ħaxix jikber jew jinfirex fuq medda ta' art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 青草的生长；土地上长草的过程。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, ġie osservat tinġim mgħaġġel fl-għalqa.
formal.en: After the rain, rapid grass growth was observed in the field.
formal.zh: 雨后，观察到田地里的青草生长迅速。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt it-tinġim wara x-xita? Toni: Iva, il-ġnien kollu sar aħdar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see the grass growth after the rain? Toni: Yes, the whole garden has turned green.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看到雨后草长起来了吗？托尼：看到了，整个花园都变绿了。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt it-tinġim wara x-xita?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt it-tinġim wara x-xita?
messages.zh: 你看到雨后草长起来了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the grass growth after the rain?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ġnien kollu sar aħdar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ġnien kollu sar aħdar.
messages.zh: 看到了，整个花园都变绿了。
messages.en: Yes, the whole garden has turned green.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tinġim 记成一段雨后草地逐渐变绿的快放画面，重点是“草在生长”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making something dirty, impure, or contaminated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变脏、不洁或受到污染的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir maħmuġa, impura jew ikkontaminata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污染；有害物质进入空气、水或其他环境介质，使其质量下降。
玷污；使清洁、纯洁的事物变得不洁，也可指损害名誉。
弄脏；使物体、地方或水体沾上污物。
沾染；因混入不需要的杂质、微生物或其他物质而受到污染。

formal.mt: Il-kampjuni ġew eżaminati biex jiġi identifikat kull sinjal ta' tinġis tal-ilma.
formal.en: The samples were examined to identify any sign of water contamination.
formal.zh: 对样本进行了检测，以识别水受到污染的任何迹象。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex qed tgħatti l-ikel? Marija: Biex nevita t-tinġis mit-trab.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why are you covering the food? Marija: To prevent contamination from dust.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你为什么把食物盖起来？玛丽亚：防止灰尘把食物弄脏。

messages.speaker: Elena (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħatti l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħatti l-ikel?
messages.zh: 你为什么把食物盖起来？
messages.en: Why are you covering the food?

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nevita t-tinġis mit-trab.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nevita t-tinġis mit-trab.
messages.zh: 防止灰尘把食物弄脏。
messages.en: To prevent contamination from dust.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一滴脏水落入清水，把 tinġis 与“清洁被破坏”联系起来，再按语境区分污染、玷污和沾染。

gloss_zh: 无法加工、不能用于建筑的碎石（用于 ġebel bit-tinħil）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unworkable broken stone that is unsuitable for building, used in the expression ġebel bit-tinħil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指无法加工且不适合用于建筑的破碎石料，见于表达 ġebel bit-tinħil。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebel miksur li ma jistax jinħadem u mhuwiex tajjeb għall-bini, fl-espressjoni 'ġebel bit-tinħil'.

sense_translations.en_definition: Occuring in (ġebel bit-tinħil), unworkable broken stone unusable for building purposes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表达 ġebel bit-tinħil，指无法加工、不能用于建筑的破碎石料。

collocations.en: unworkable broken stone unsuitable for building
collocations.zh: 无法加工、不适合建筑的碎石

collocations.en: set aside the unworkable broken stone
collocations.zh: 把无法加工的碎石另行放置

formal.mt: Il-bennej warrab il-ġebel bit-tinħil għax ma setax jużah għall-bini tal-ħajt.
formal.en: The builder set aside the unworkable broken stone because he could not use it to build the wall.
formal.zh: 建筑工人把这些无法加工的碎石放到一边，因为它们不能用于砌墙。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nistgħu nużaw dan il-ġebel għall-ħajt? Ġużeppi: Le, dan ġebel bit-tinħil. Poġġih fil-ġenb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can we use this stone for the wall? Ġużeppi: No, this is unworkable broken stone. Put it to one side.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这些石料能用来砌墙吗？Ġużeppi：不能，这是无法加工的碎石。把它放到一边。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nużaw dan il-ġebel għall-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nużaw dan il-ġebel għall-ħajt?
messages.zh: 这些石料能用来砌墙吗？
messages.en: Can we use this stone for the wall?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (建筑工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan ġebel bit-tinħil. Poġġih fil-ġenb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan ġebel bit-tinħil. Poġġih fil-ġenb.
messages.zh: 不能，这是无法加工的碎石。把它放到一边。
messages.en: No, this is unworkable broken stone. Put it to one side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 整块记住 ġebel bit-tinħil，想象工人把不能加工、不能砌墙的碎石挑到一旁，不把它泛记成所有石头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The loud, characteristic cry made by a donkey, or the act of making that cry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 驴发出的特有响亮叫声，或发出这种叫声的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għajta qawwija u karatteristika ta' ħmar, jew l-att li jagħmel din l-għajta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驴叫；驴发出嘶鸣声的行为或声音。

formal.mt: It-tinħiq tal-ħmar instema' mill-għalqa qrib ir-razzett.
formal.en: The donkey's braying could be heard from the field near the farm.
formal.zh: 从农场附近的田地里传来了驴叫声。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak il-ħoss qawwi? Karmenu: Dak it-tinħiq tal-ħmar li hemm fl-għalqa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is that loud noise? Karmenu: That's the braying of the donkey in the field.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那是什么响亮的声音？Karmenu：那是田里那头驴的叫声。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss qawwi?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss qawwi?
messages.zh: 那是什么响亮的声音？
messages.en: What is that loud noise?

messages.speaker: Karmenu (农夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tinħiq tal-ħmar li hemm fl-għalqa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tinħiq tal-ħmar li hemm fl-għalqa.
messages.zh: 那是田里那头驴的叫声。
messages.en: That's the braying of the donkey in the field.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词配上农场里驴子昂头大叫的画面，把声音与 tinħiq 直接联系，避免混成一般的动物叫声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking off clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把穿在身上的衣物脱下来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ineħħi l-ħwejjeġ minn fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱衣；脱下身上衣物的动作。

collocations.en: the taking off of a coat

formal.mt: Qabel l-eżami mediku, it-tinżigħ tal-ħwejjeġ għandu jsir fil-kamra privata.
formal.en: Before the medical examination, clothes should be taken off in the private room.
formal.zh: 体检前，应在独立房间内脱下衣物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tinżigħ ta' dan il-kowt mhux faċli! Lara: Stenna, ħa ngħinek bil-kmiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Taking this coat off isn't easy! Lara: Wait, let me help you with the sleeves.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这件外套真不好脱！Lara：等一下，我帮你把袖子脱下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tinżigħ ta' dan il-kowt mhux faċli!
messages.mt_standard: It-tinżigħ ta' dan il-kowt mhux faċli!
messages.zh: 这件外套真不好脱！
messages.en: Taking this coat off isn't easy!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna, ħa ngħinek bil-kmiem.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna, ħa ngħinek bil-kmiem.
messages.zh: 等一下，我帮你把袖子脱下来。
messages.en: Wait, let me help you with the sleeves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进更衣室后把外套脱下：用 tinżigħ 给整个脱衣动作贴标签，记住它是动作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of moving something to a lower position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物从较高位置降到较低位置的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa titmexxa minn pożizzjoni ogħla għal waħda aktar baxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放低；使某物的位置下降。

formal.mt: It-tinżil tal-bandiera se jsir fi tmiem iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The lowering of the flag will take place at the end of the ceremony.
formal.zh: 降旗将在仪式结束时进行。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tgħinni bit-tinżil ta' din il-kaxxa mill-ixkaffa? Pawlu: Iva, żommha minn dik in-naħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you help me lower this box from the shelf? Pawlu: Yes, hold it on that side.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你能帮我把这个箱子从架子上放下来吗？Pawlu：可以，你扶住那一边。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinni bit-tinżil ta' din il-kaxxa mill-ixkaffa?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinni bit-tinżil ta' din il-kaxxa mill-ixkaffa?
messages.zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子从架子上放下来吗？
messages.en: Can you help me lower this box from the shelf?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żommha minn dik in-naħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żommha minn dik in-naħa.
messages.zh: 可以，你扶住那一边。
messages.en: Yes, hold it on that side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一面旗帜沿旗杆向下移动，把 tinżil 写在向下箭头旁，联想把东西降下的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of smoking cigarettes, cigars, or similar tobacco products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吸食香烟、雪茄等烟草制品的活动或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ipejjep sigaretti, sigarri jew prodotti simili tat-tabakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸烟，指抽香烟、雪茄等。

formal.mt: Ir-regoli tal-bini jipprojbixxu t-tipjip fil-kmamar kollha.
formal.en: The building rules prohibit smoking in all rooms.
formal.zh: 楼宇规定禁止在所有房间内吸烟。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tipjip permess hawn? Sara: Le, hawn ġew projbit.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is smoking allowed here? Sara: No, it's prohibited indoors here.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这里允许吸烟吗？Sara：不允许，这里的室内禁止吸烟。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tipjip permess hawn?
messages.mt_standard: It-tipjip permess hawn?
messages.zh: 这里允许吸烟吗？
messages.en: Is smoking allowed here?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn ġew projbit.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn ġew projbit.
messages.zh: 不允许，这里的室内禁止吸烟。
messages.en: No, it's prohibited indoors here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到禁烟标志时默念 tipjip，把图中抽烟的行为与这个名词绑定，再用 waqfien mit-tipjip 记戒烟。

gloss_zh: 小鸟的啁啾声；鸟儿啾鸣

teaching_sense.en_definition: The short, light calls made by small birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小鸟发出的短促、轻细的啾啾声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħsejjes qosra u rqaq li jagħmlu l-għasafar iż-żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小鸟的啁啾声；小型鸟类发出的啾鸣。

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, instema' t-tipjiz ta' għasafar żgħar fis-siġar.
formal.en: During the observation, the chirping of small birds was heard in the trees.
formal.zh: 观察期间，树上传来了小鸟的啁啾声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tisma' dak it-tipjiz? Mark: Iva, hemm għasfur żgħir ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that chirping? Mark: Yes, there's a small bird by the window.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你听见那啾啾声了吗？Mark：听见了，窗边有只小鸟。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tisma' dak it-tipjiz?
messages.mt_standard: Tisma' dak it-tipjiz?
messages.zh: 你听见那啾啾声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that chirping?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm għasfur żgħir ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm għasfur żgħir ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 听见了，窗边有只小鸟。
messages.en: Yes, there's a small bird by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗边小鸟连续啾啾叫，把 tipjiz 写在声音气泡里；用小鸟画面记住它指鸟鸣声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the design, arrangement, or printing of letters and text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与文字的字体设计、编排或排印有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-disinn, it-tqassim jew l-istampar tal-ittri u tat-test.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排印的；与文字字体及其编排有关的。

formal.mt: Qabel il-pubblikazzjoni, ġie kkoreġut żball tipografiku fit-titlu.
formal.en: Before publication, a typographical error in the title was corrected.
formal.zh: 出版前，标题中的一处排印错误得到了更正。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn żball tipografiku f'ismek. Pawlu: Veru, hemm ittra nieqsa. Tista' tirranġah?
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a typo in your name here. Pawlu: You're right, a letter is missing. Can you fix it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里你的名字打错了。Pawlu：确实，少了一个字母。你能改一下吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn żball tipografiku f'ismek.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn żball tipografiku f'ismek.
messages.zh: 这里你的名字打错了。
messages.en: There's a typo in your name here.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, hemm ittra nieqsa. Tista' tirranġah?
messages.mt_standard: Veru, hemm ittra nieqsa. Tista' tirranġah?
messages.zh: 确实，少了一个字母。你能改一下吗？
messages.en: You're right, a letter is missing. Can you fix it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tipografiku 与英文 typographical 对照着记，再圈出标题中的错字，用 żball tipografiku 巩固搭配。

gloss_zh: 表土下的水分；土壤下层湿气

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moisture present beneath the top layer of soil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存在于土壤表层以下的水分或湿气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-umdità li tinsab taħt is-saff ta' fuq tal-ħamrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表土以下的水分或湿气。

collocations.en: the moisture beneath the soil surface
the retention of moisture beneath the topsoil

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-għalqa, ġiet iċċekkjata t-tira taħt is-saff niexef tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: During the field inspection, the moisture beneath the dry layer of soil was checked.
formal.zh: 检查田地时，查看了干燥土层下的水分情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ħamrija tidher niexfa. Għad hemm tira taħtha? Pawlu: Iva, ħaffer ftit u tħoss l-umdità.
colloquial.en: Sara: The soil looks dry. Is there still moisture underneath? Pawlu: Yes, dig a little and you'll feel the moisture.
colloquial.zh: Sara：土看起来干了，下面还有水分吗？Pawlu：有，稍微挖一下就能摸到湿气。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħamrija tidher niexfa. Għad hemm tira taħtha?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħamrija tidher niexfa. Għad hemm tira taħtha?
messages.zh: 土看起来干了，下面还有水分吗？
messages.en: The soil looks dry. Is there still moisture underneath?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħaffer ftit u tħoss l-umdità.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħaffer ftit u tħoss l-umdità.
messages.zh: 有，稍微挖一下就能摸到湿气。
messages.en: Yes, dig a little and you'll feel the moisture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张土壤剖面图：表面干燥，下面画水滴并标 tira，重点记住水分的位置在表土以下。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of playing the musical instrument called the rabbaba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 演奏名为 rabbaba 的拉巴巴琴这一活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed idoqq l-istrument mużikali msejjaħ rabbaba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉巴巴琴（rabbaba）的演奏。

collocations.en: a lesson in playing the rabbaba

formal.mt: Il-workshop jinkludi introduzzjoni għat-tirbib u ħin għall-prattika.
formal.en: The workshop includes an introduction to playing the rabbaba and time for practice.
formal.zh: 工作坊包括拉巴巴琴演奏入门和练习时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum għandek lezzjoni tat-tirbib? Mark: Iva, u wara rrid nipprattika ftit id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a rabbaba lesson today? Mark: Yes, and afterward I want to practise a little at home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天有拉巴巴琴演奏课吗？Mark：有，上完课我还想回家练一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandek lezzjoni tat-tirbib?
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandek lezzjoni tat-tirbib?
messages.zh: 你今天有拉巴巴琴演奏课吗？
messages.en: Do you have a rabbaba lesson today?

messages.speaker: Mark (音乐学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u wara rrid nipprattika ftit id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u wara rrid nipprattika ftit id-dar.
messages.zh: 有，上完课我还想回家练一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, and afterward I want to practise a little at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rabbaba 写在乐器图片下，把 tirbib 写在演奏者动作旁，区分乐器名称与演奏活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Squaring a number, or multiplying a quantity by four, depending on the sense intended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指求一个数的平方，也可指把一个量乘以四，须根据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li numru jiġi mmultiplikat bih innifsu, jew li kwantità tiġi mmultiplikata b'erbgħa, skont is-sens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平方运算；把一个数乘以它自身。
乘以四；使数量变成原来的四倍。

collocations.en: the multiplication of a quantity by four

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, it-tirbigħ ifisser li n-numru jiġi mmultiplikat bih innifsu: it-tirbigħ ta' tlieta jagħti disgħa.
formal.en: In this exercise, squaring means multiplying the number by itself: squaring three gives nine.
formal.zh: 在本题中，tirbigħ 指把一个数乘以它自身：三的平方是九。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawn it-tirbigħ ifisser li tlieta nagħmilha disa'? Mark: Le, f'din il-mistoqsija jfisser li timmultiplika b'erbgħa, allura t-tweġiba hi tnax.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does tirbigħ here mean turning three into nine? Mark: No, in this question it means multiplying by four, so the answer is twelve.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 tirbigħ 是说把三算成九吗？Mark：不是，这道题里指乘以四，所以答案是十二。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn it-tirbigħ ifisser li tlieta nagħmilha disa'?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn it-tirbigħ ifisser li tlieta nagħmilha disa'?
messages.zh: 这里的 tirbigħ 是说把三算成九吗？
messages.en: Does tirbigħ here mean turning three into nine?

messages.speaker: Mark (数学教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din il-mistoqsija jfisser li timmultiplika b'erbgħa, allura t-tweġiba hi tnax.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din il-mistoqsija jfisser li timmultiplika b'erbgħa, allura t-tweġiba hi tnax.
messages.zh: 不是，这道题里指乘以四，所以答案是十二。
messages.en: No, in this question it means multiplying by four, so the answer is twelve.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tirbigħ 做两张算式卡：平方是三乘三得九，乘四是三乘四得十二；读题先判断采用哪个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unwillingness to spend money or share what one has.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不愿花钱或与别人分享自己所有之物的吝啬态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' rieda li tonfoq il-flus jew taqsam dak li għandek ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吝啬；舍不得花钱或分享财物。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tirgħib tal-karattru jwasslu biex jirrifjuta li jgħin lill-ġirien tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the character's miserliness leads him to refuse to help his neighbours.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物因吝啬而拒绝帮助邻居。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma jrid jixtri xejn, lanqas meta jkollu bżonn? Pawlu: Minħabba t-tirgħib; dejjem isib skuża biex ma jonfoqx.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why won't he buy anything, even when he needs it? Pawlu: Because of his miserliness; he always finds an excuse not to spend.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：他为什么什么都不肯买，连需要的东西也不买？保罗：因为他吝啬，总能找到不花钱的借口。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma jrid jixtri xejn, lanqas meta jkollu bżonn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma jrid jixtri xejn, lanqas meta jkollu bżonn?
messages.zh: 他为什么什么都不肯买，连需要的东西也不买？
messages.en: Why won't he buy anything, even when he needs it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tirgħib; dejjem isib skuża biex ma jonfoqx.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tirgħib; dejjem isib skuża biex ma jonfoqx.
messages.zh: 因为他吝啬，总能找到不花钱的借口。
messages.en: Because of his miserliness; he always finds an excuse not to spend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上紧握钱包的画面，记住它表示不肯花钱或分享的吝啬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The low, rough growling sound made by an animal such as a bear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 熊等动物发出的低沉、粗哑的吼声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss baxx u aħrax li jagħmel annimal bħal ors.

sense_translations.en_definition: growling (used of animals such as bears)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 低吼；咆哮，指熊等动物发出的声音。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni jinstema' t-tirgħin ta' ors, segwit minn ftit mumenti ta' silenzju.
formal.en: The recording contains the growling of a bear, followed by a few moments of silence.
formal.zh: 录音中可以听见熊的低吼声，随后是片刻的寂静。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-filmat? Mark: Dak hu t-tirgħin tal-ors. Isma' kemm hu baxx!
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that sound in the video? Mark: That's the bear's growling. Listen to how deep it is!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：视频里那是什么声音？马克：那是熊的低吼声。听，多低沉啊！

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-filmat?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-filmat?
messages.zh: 视频里那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound in the video?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu t-tirgħin tal-ors. Isma' kemm hu baxx!
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu t-tirgħin tal-ors. Isma' kemm hu baxx!
messages.zh: 那是熊的低吼声。听，多低沉啊！
messages.en: That's the bear's growling. Listen to how deep it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象熊张嘴发出低沉吼声，把声音画面与这个名词一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming red, including blushing in the face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色变红的过程，也可指脸部泛红或因害羞等情绪而脸红。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir ħamra, inkluż meta l-wiċċ jiħmar bil-mistħija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变红；泛红，指颜色转为红色的过程。
脸红，尤指因害羞或其他情绪而面部泛红。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, it-tirgħix ta' wiċċ il-karattru juri l-mistħija tiegħu meta jirċievi tifħir quddiem kulħadd.
formal.en: In the novel, the reddening of the character's face shows his embarrassment when he receives praise in front of everyone.
formal.zh: 在小说中，这个人物受到当众表扬时脸部泛红，表现出他的羞涩。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Wiċċi sar aħmar meta faħħruni! Nina: Innutajt it-tirgħix, imma ma ġara xejn. Kulħadd kien kuntent għalik.
colloquial.en: Sara: My face went red when they praised me! Nina: I noticed the blushing, but it was fine. Everyone was happy for you.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他们表扬我的时候，我脸都红了！妮娜：我注意到你脸红了，不过没关系。大家都为你高兴。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wiċċi sar aħmar meta faħħruni!
messages.mt_standard: Wiċċi sar aħmar meta faħħruni!
messages.zh: 他们表扬我的时候，我脸都红了！
messages.en: My face went red when they praised me!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt it-tirgħix, imma ma ġara xejn. Kulħadd kien kuntent għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt it-tirgħix, imma ma ġara xejn. Kulħadd kien kuntent għalik.
messages.zh: 我注意到你脸红了，不过没关系。大家都为你高兴。
messages.en: I noticed the blushing, but it was fine. Everyone was happy for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记颜色逐渐变红，再联想到害羞脸红，用同一幅红色画面串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of entering a religious order as a member.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为某个宗教修会成员的行为，即加入修会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dħul ta' persuna f'ordni reliġjuża bħala membru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加入修会；成为某个宗教修会的成员。

formal.mt: Il-bijografija tiddeskrivi d-deċiżjoni tal-persuna u t-tirhib tagħha f'ordni reliġjuża.
formal.en: The biography describes the person's decision and entry into a religious order.
formal.zh: 这部传记描述了传主作出的决定及其加入宗教修会的经历。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser tirhib f'din il-bijografija? David: Ifisser li persuna tidħol f'ordni reliġjuża.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does tirhib mean in this biography? David: It means that a person enters a religious order.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这部传记里的 tirhib 是什么意思？戴维：意思是一个人加入宗教修会。

messages.speaker: Anna (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tirhib f'din il-bijografija?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tirhib f'din il-bijografija?
messages.zh: 这部传记里的 tirhib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tirhib mean in this biography?

messages.speaker: David (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li persuna tidħol f'ordni reliġjuża.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li persuna tidħol f'ordni reliġjuża.
messages.zh: 意思是一个人加入宗教修会。
messages.en: It means that a person enters a religious order.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个人走入修会并成为成员的画面，记住这是加入修会这一行为的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which saliva is produced in the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 口腔内产生唾液的过程，即唾液分泌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiġi prodott ir-rieq fil-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唾液的产生或分泌。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jispjegaw li t-tirjiq huwa l-produzzjoni tar-rieq fil-ħalq.
formal.en: In the exercise, students should explain that tirjiq is the production of saliva in the mouth.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生应说明 tirjiq 指口腔内唾液的产生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tirjiq? Ben: Meta ħalqek jipproduċi r-rieq; il-kelma ssemmi dak il-proċess.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tirjiq mean? Ben: It's when your mouth produces saliva; the word names that process.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：tirjiq 是什么意思？本：就是嘴里产生唾液；这个词指的就是那个过程。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tirjiq?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tirjiq?
messages.zh: tirjiq 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tirjiq mean?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ħalqek jipproduċi r-rieq; il-kelma ssemmi dak il-proċess.
messages.mt_standard: Meta ħalqek jipproduċi r-rieq; il-kelma ssemmi dak il-proċess.
messages.zh: 就是嘴里产生唾液；这个词指的就是那个过程。
messages.en: It's when your mouth produces saliva; the word names that process.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把口腔中出现小水滴画成记忆图，提醒自己这个名词表示唾液产生的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of fishing with a fishing line and a feather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用钓线和羽毛捕鱼的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tas-sajd permezz ta' lenza u rixa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to fish using a fishing line and feather
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用钓线和羽毛进行捕鱼的活动。

collocations.en: fishing with a line and a feather
equipment for fishing with a line and a feather
collocations.zh: 用钓线和羽毛捕鱼的装备

formal.mt: Il-gwida tiddeskrivi t-tirjix bħala attività tas-sajd li fiha jintużaw lenza u rixa.
formal.en: The guide describes tirjix as a fishing activity in which a line and a feather are used.
formal.zh: 指南将 tirjix 描述为一种使用钓线和羽毛的捕鱼活动。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex għandek rixa mat-tagħmir tas-sajd? Ġużeppi: Se nużaha għat-tirjix, flimkien mal-lenza.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why do you have a feather with your fishing equipment? Ġużeppi: I'll use it for tirjix, together with the line.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你的捕鱼装备里为什么有一根羽毛？朱塞佩：我要把它和钓线一起用来捕鱼，这种活动叫 tirjix。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek rixa mat-tagħmir tas-sajd?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek rixa mat-tagħmir tas-sajd?
messages.zh: 你的捕鱼装备里为什么有一根羽毛？
messages.en: Why do you have a feather with your fishing equipment?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (钓鱼者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nużaha għat-tirjix, flimkien mal-lenza.
messages.mt_standard: Se nużaha għat-tirjix, flimkien mal-lenza.
messages.zh: 我要把它和钓线一起用来捕鱼，这种活动叫 tirjix。
messages.en: I'll use it for tirjix, together with the line.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆卡上并排画出钓线和羽毛，两件工具一起提示这种捕鱼活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or process of giving off an unpleasant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散发难闻气味的状态或过程，即发臭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa toħroġ riħa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发臭；散发难闻的气味。

collocations.en: the bad smell given off by rubbish
the bad smell given off by spoiled food

formal.mt: Ir-rapport isemmi t-tirjiħ taż-żibel bħala waħda mill-problemi li lmentaw dwarhom ir-residenti.
formal.en: The report mentions the bad smell from the rubbish as one of the problems residents complained about.
formal.zh: 报告将垃圾发臭列为居民投诉的问题之一。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Minn fejn ġej dan it-tirjiħ? Toni: Hemm ikel imħassar fil-borża. Se noħroġha issa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is this bad smell coming from? Toni: There's spoiled food in the bag. I'll take it out now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这股臭味是从哪里来的？托尼：袋子里有变质的食物。我现在就把它拿出去。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġej dan it-tirjiħ?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġej dan it-tirjiħ?
messages.zh: 这股臭味是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this bad smell coming from?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ikel imħassar fil-borża. Se noħroġha issa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ikel imħassar fil-borża. Se noħroġha issa.
messages.zh: 袋子里有变质的食物。我现在就把它拿出去。
messages.en: There's spoiled food in the bag. I'll take it out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开垃圾袋后捂住鼻子的动作，把这个词与散发臭味的状态相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of repairing holes or damaged areas by applying patches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用补片或补充材料修复破洞、破损部位的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tiswija ta' toqob jew partijiet bil-ħsara billi jitqiegħdu rqajja'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修补；通过补上破损部位或打补丁使东西恢复可用。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħriġ fit-tirqigħ tal-ħwejjeġ sabiex l-istudenti jitgħallmu jsewwu toqob żgħar.
formal.en: The course includes training in patching clothes so that students learn to repair small holes.
formal.zh: 课程包含衣物修补训练，让学生学习如何补好小破洞。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-qalziet għandu toqba. Nista' nsewwih? Elena: Iva, bit-tirqigħ. Għandi biċċa drapp tal-istess kulur.
colloquial.en: Mark: These trousers have a hole. Can I repair them? Elena: Yes, by patching them. I have a piece of fabric in the same colour.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条裤子有个洞，能补好吗？埃琳娜：能，打个补丁就行。我有一块同色的布。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-qalziet għandu toqba. Nista' nsewwih?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-qalziet għandu toqba. Nista' nsewwih?
messages.zh: 这条裤子有个洞，能补好吗？
messages.en: These trousers have a hole. Can I repair them?

messages.speaker: Elena (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bit-tirqigħ. Għandi biċċa drapp tal-istess kulur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bit-tirqigħ. Għandi biċċa drapp tal-istess kulur.
messages.zh: 能，打个补丁就行。我有一块同色的布。
messages.en: Yes, by patching them. I have a piece of fabric in the same colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一小块布缝在裤子的破洞上，用补洞的动作记住修补这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something softer or allowing it to become softer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得柔软，或某物逐渐变软的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar ratba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 软化；变软的过程。

formal.mt: It-tirtib tal-ħobż fil-ħalib jagħmilha aktar faċli biex jitħallat mal-ingredjenti l-oħra.
formal.en: Softening the bread in milk makes it easier to mix with the other ingredients.
formal.zh: 将面包浸在牛奶中使其变软，更方便与其他配料混合。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex poġġejt il-ħobż fil-ħalib? Rita: Għat-tirtib, biex ikun aktar faċli nħalltu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you put the bread in milk? Rita: To soften it, so it will be easier to mix.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把面包放进牛奶里？丽塔：为了让它变软，这样更容易拌匀。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejt il-ħobż fil-ħalib?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejt il-ħobż fil-ħalib?
messages.zh: 你为什么把面包放进牛奶里？
messages.en: Why did you put the bread in milk?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tirtib, biex ikun aktar faċli nħalltu.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tirtib, biex ikun aktar faċli nħalltu.
messages.zh: 为了让它变软，这样更容易拌匀。
messages.en: To soften it, so it will be easier to mix.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象硬面包泡进牛奶后逐渐变软，用这个画面记住 tirtib 表示软化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a living organism removes waste substances from its body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生物将体内废物排出身体的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih organiżmu ħaj joħroġ sustanzi ta' skart minn ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排泄；生物将体内废物排出的过程。

formal.mt: It-tirwit ineħħi mill-ġisem sustanzi ta' skart li jinħolqu waqt il-metaboliżmu.
formal.en: Excretion removes from the body waste substances produced during metabolism.
formal.zh: 排泄将新陈代谢过程中产生的废物排出体外。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Xi jfisser tirwit f'dan il-ktieb? Sara: Meta l-ġisem joħroġ is-sustanzi ta' skart, pereżempju fl-awrina.
colloquial.en: Ben: What does tirwit mean in this book? Sara: It's when the body gets rid of waste substances, for example in urine.
colloquial.zh: 本：这本书里的 tirwit 是什么意思？萨拉：就是身体排出废物，比如通过尿液排出。

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tirwit f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tirwit f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书里的 tirwit 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tirwit mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta l-ġisem joħroġ is-sustanzi ta' skart, pereżempju fl-awrina.
messages.mt_standard: Meta l-ġisem joħroġ is-sustanzi ta' skart, pereżempju fl-awrina.
messages.zh: 就是身体排出废物，比如通过尿液排出。
messages.en: It's when the body gets rid of waste substances, for example in urine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人体简图旁画一支朝外的箭头，标注废物排出，把 tirwit 与排泄过程联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of fanning oneself, or the movement of air through a place to ventilate it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给自己扇风的动作，也指让空气在某处流通以实现通风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħmel ir-riħ għalih innifsu, jew iċ-ċirkolazzjoni tal-arja f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给自己扇风的动作。
通风；让空气流通。

formal.mt: It-twieqi għandhom jinfetħu regolarment biex jiżguraw it-tirwiħ tal-kamra.
formal.en: The windows should be opened regularly to ensure the ventilation of the room.
formal.zh: 应定期开窗，确保房间通风。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi sħana! Għandek imrewħa? Nina: Iva, ħudha. It-tirwiħ jgħinek tiffriska ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's so hot! Have you got a fan? Nina: Yes, take it. Fanning yourself will help you cool down a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：好热啊！你有扇子吗？妮娜：有，拿去吧。给自己扇扇风会凉快一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi sħana! Għandek imrewħa?
messages.mt_standard: Xi sħana! Għandek imrewħa?
messages.zh: 好热啊！你有扇子吗？
messages.en: It's so hot! Have you got a fan?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħudha. It-tirwiħ jgħinek tiffriska ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħudha. It-tirwiħ jgħinek tiffriska ftit.
messages.zh: 有，拿去吧。给自己扇扇风会凉快一点。
messages.en: Yes, take it. Fanning yourself will help you cool down a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手中扇子和打开的窗户并排想象：一个给自己扇风，一个让房间通风，都是 tirwiħ。

gloss_zh: 去叶；摘除树木或植物的叶片

teaching_sense.en_definition: The removal of leaves from trees or other plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从树木或其他植物上摘除叶片的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija tal-weraq minn fuq is-siġar jew pjanti oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: removal of leaves from trees or plants
sense_translations.zh_definition: 去叶；从树木或植物上摘除叶片。

collocations.en: the removal of leaves from trees
the removal of leaves from plants

formal.mt: Waqt it-tisbik, il-ħaddiema neħħew il-weraq magħżul mingħajr ma qatgħu l-friegħi.
formal.en: During leaf removal, the workers removed the selected leaves without cutting the branches.
formal.zh: 去叶时，工人摘除了选定的叶片，没有剪断枝条。

colloquial.mt: Luca: It-tisbik ifisser li nneħħu l-weraq? Marija: Iva, illum neħħi biss il-weraq li mmarkajtlek.
colloquial.en: Luca: Does tisbik mean removing the leaves? Marija: Yes, today remove only the leaves I marked for you.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：tisbik 是指摘除叶子吗？玛丽亚：是的，今天只摘我给你标出来的那些叶子。

messages.speaker: Luca (园艺学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tisbik ifisser li nneħħu l-weraq?
messages.mt_standard: It-tisbik ifisser li nneħħu l-weraq?
messages.zh: tisbik 是指摘除叶子吗？
messages.en: Does tisbik mean removing the leaves?

messages.speaker: Marija (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum neħħi biss il-weraq li mmarkajtlek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum neħħi biss il-weraq li mmarkajtlek.
messages.zh: 是的，今天只摘我给你标出来的那些叶子。
messages.en: Yes, today remove only the leaves I marked for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指从枝条上摘下叶片，枝条仍然保留，用这个动作记住 tisbik 是去叶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The growth of an ear on a cereal plant, such as wheat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小麦等谷类植物长出谷穗、谷穗逐渐生长的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jikber is-sbul f'pjanta taċ-ċereali, bħall-qamħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: growth of an ear of corn
sense_translations.zh_definition: 谷穗的生长；谷类植物长穗的过程。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi osserva t-tisbil tal-qamħ u rreġistra l-bidliet fit-tkabbir tas-sbul.
formal.en: The farmer observed the growth of the wheat ears and recorded changes in their development.
formal.zh: 农民观察了小麦长穗的情况，并记录了麦穗生长的变化。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'qed tikteb dwar il-qamħ? Ġużeppi: Qed nieħu noti dwar it-tisbil. Ara kif qed jikber is-sbul.
colloquial.en: Elena: What are you writing about the wheat? Ġużeppi: I'm taking notes on ear growth. Look at how the ears are growing.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：你在写小麦的什么情况？朱塞佩：我在记录长穗的情况。看，麦穗正在长大。

messages.speaker: Elena (农业学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tikteb dwar il-qamħ?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tikteb dwar il-qamħ?
messages.zh: 你在写小麦的什么情况？
messages.en: What are you writing about the wheat?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nieħu noti dwar it-tisbil. Ara kif qed jikber is-sbul.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nieħu noti dwar it-tisbil. Ara kif qed jikber is-sbul.
messages.zh: 我在记录长穗的情况。看，麦穗正在长大。
messages.en: I'm taking notes on ear growth. Look at how the ears are growing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把麦田里逐渐长大的麦穗画成连续三幅图，用生长的过程记住 tisbil 表示长穗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of doing better than other people or surpassing their achievements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现优于他人，或超越他人成就的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħmel aħjar minn ħaddieħor jew jaqbeż il-kisbiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of outdoing or surpassing others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 胜过或超越他人的行为。

formal.mt: It-tisbiq tal-kompetituri kien wieħed mill-għanijiet tat-tim, flimkien mat-titjib tal-prestazzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: Outdoing the competitors was one of the team's goals, alongside improving its own performance.
formal.zh: 胜过竞争者是团队的目标之一，团队也希望提升自身表现。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għalik, l-għan hu dejjem it-tisbiq ta' ħaddieħor? David: Le, irrid ukoll intejjeb il-ħin tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is your goal always to outdo other people? David: No, I also want to improve my own time.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你的目标总是超越别人吗？戴维：不是，我也想提高自己的计时成绩。

messages.speaker: Mark (跑步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalik, l-għan hu dejjem it-tisbiq ta' ħaddieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Għalik, l-għan hu dejjem it-tisbiq ta' ħaddieħor?
messages.zh: 你的目标总是超越别人吗？
messages.en: Is your goal always to outdo other people?

messages.speaker: David (跑步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irrid ukoll intejjeb il-ħin tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irrid ukoll intejjeb il-ħin tiegħi.
messages.zh: 不是，我也想提高自己的计时成绩。
messages.en: No, I also want to improve my own time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象成绩榜上自己的名字超过其他人，用名次向上移动的画面记住 tisbiq 表示超越。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Consolation or the act of comforting someone; also, the postponement of a payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予人慰藉或安慰的行为；也指将付款推迟到以后。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-faraġ jew l-att li wieħed ifarraġ lil xi ħadd; ukoll, il-posponiment ta' ħlas għal aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慰藉；使悲伤或失望得到缓解的安慰。
安慰；给予他人情感支持的行为。
延期付款；将付款时间推迟。

formal.mt: It-tisbir tal-ħlas sal-aħħar tax-xahar ġie miftiehem bejn il-klijent u l-fornitur.
formal.en: The postponement of payment until the end of the month was agreed between the customer and the supplier.
formal.zh: 客户与供应商商定，将付款推迟至月底。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadni mnikkta għax ma għaddejtx mill-eżami. Nina: Nifhem. Ninsab hawn jekk trid titkellem. Maja: Grazzi tal-kliem ta' tisbir.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm still upset because I didn't pass the exam. Nina: I understand. I'm here if you want to talk. Maja: Thank you for your words of consolation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我还在为没通过考试而难过。妮娜：我理解。如果你想聊聊，我就在这里。玛雅：谢谢你的安慰。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni mnikkta għax ma għaddejtx mill-eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni mnikkta għax ma għaddejtx mill-eżami.
messages.zh: 我还在为没通过考试而难过。
messages.en: I'm still upset because I didn't pass the exam.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhem. Ninsab hawn jekk trid titkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhem. Ninsab hawn jekk trid titkellem.
messages.zh: 我理解。如果你想聊聊，我就在这里。
messages.en: I understand. I'm here if you want to talk.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi tal-kliem ta' tisbir.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi tal-kliem ta' tisbir.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的安慰。
messages.en: Thank you for your words of consolation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tisbir 做两张情境卡：一张是朋友说安慰的话，另一张是账单付款日期后移，分别记住慰藉与延期付款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forceful banging, slamming, or thumping, especially against a door or another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力敲打、砰地关上或重重撞击的动作，尤其指对门或其他表面的撞击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqiet qawwija, għeluq bil-qawwa, jew taħbit fuq bieb jew wiċċ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力敲打；发出砰砰声的撞击
猛地关上；砰地摔关
沉重敲击；咚咚捶打

formal.mt: It-tisbit tal-bibien għandu jiġi evitat waqt l-eżamijiet sabiex ma jfixkilx lill-istudenti.
formal.en: Slamming doors should be avoided during examinations so as not to disturb the students.
formal.zh: 考试期间应避免猛摔门，以免打扰学生。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Qed tisma' dak it-tisbit fuq il-bieb? Pawlu: Iva, sejjer niftaħ.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can you hear that banging on the door? Pawlu: Yes, I'm going to open it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你听见那阵砰砰敲门声了吗？保罗：听见了，我去开门。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dak it-tisbit fuq il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dak it-tisbit fuq il-bieb?
messages.zh: 你听见那阵砰砰敲门声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that banging on the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sejjer niftaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sejjer niftaħ.
messages.zh: 听见了，我去开门。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to open it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisbit 配上“砰、砰、咚”的声音画面：敲门、摔门和重捶都强调用力撞击。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of adding decorative details or making something more beautiful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 添加装饰细节，或使某物变得更加美观的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jiżdiedu dettalji dekorattivi jew li xi ħaġa ssir aktar sabiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修饰；添加装饰性细节。
美化；使事物或环境更加美观。

formal.mt: Il-proġett ta' tisbiħ tal-pjazza jinkludi t-tħawwil ta' siġar u fjuri.
formal.en: The square beautification project includes planting trees and flowers.
formal.zh: 广场美化项目包括栽种树木和花卉。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex xtrajt dawn il-fjuri kollha? Pawlu: Għat-tisbiħ tal-gallarija. Ejja npoġġuhom ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you buy all these flowers? Pawlu: To make the balcony prettier. Let's put them by the door.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么买了这么多花？保罗：为了美化阳台。我们把它们放在门边吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex xtrajt dawn il-fjuri kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex xtrajt dawn il-fjuri kollha?
messages.zh: 你为什么买了这么多花？
messages.en: Why did you buy all these flowers?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tisbiħ tal-gallarija. Ejja npoġġuhom ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tisbiħ tal-gallarija. Ejja npoġġuhom ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 为了美化阳台。我们把它们放在门边吧。
messages.en: To make the balcony prettier. Let's put them by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给文章添上优美修饰、给广场添上鲜花，两个画面都体现 tisbiħ 的修饰与美化。

gloss_zh: 使人向善；肯定某人的德行

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making someone virtuous or affirming that someone possesses virtue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人具有良好德行的过程，或肯定、认可某人德行的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' xi ħadd aktar virtuż, jew l-affermazzjoni tal-virtù tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人具有德行；使人向善
肯定某人的德行；认可某人的品德

collocations.en: the making of a person virtuous

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddistingwi bejn it-tisdiq bħala għemil li jagħmel lill-bniedem aktar virtuż u t-tisdiq bħala affermazzjoni tal-virtù tiegħu.
formal.en: The author distinguishes between making a person more virtuous and affirming that person's virtue as two senses of tisdiq.
formal.zh: 作者区分了 tisdiq 的两个义项：使人更有德行，以及肯定此人的德行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk, tisdiq ifisser li qed jgħidu li għandha virtù? Mark: Iva, qed jaffermaw il-virtù tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Here, does tisdiq mean that they are saying she has virtue? Mark: Yes, they are affirming her virtue.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 tisdiq 是说他们肯定她有德行吗？马克：对，他们在肯定她的德行。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, tisdiq ifisser li qed jgħidu li għandha virtù?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, tisdiq ifisser li qed jgħidu li għandha virtù?
messages.zh: 这里的 tisdiq 是说他们肯定她有德行吗？
messages.en: Here, does tisdiq mean that they are saying she has virtue?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jaffermaw il-virtù tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jaffermaw il-virtù tagħha.
messages.zh: 对，他们在肯定她的德行。
messages.en: Yes, they are affirming her virtue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tisdiq 时并排放两张卡：“让人向善”和“肯定其善”；先辨认是改变品德还是认可品德。

gloss_zh: 穿叉烤制；插入孔中；清除孔内堵塞

teaching_sense.en_definition: Roasting food on a spit, thrusting something into a hole, or removing an obstruction from a hole, according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境指将食物穿在烤叉上烤制、把东西用力插入孔中，或清除孔内的堵塞物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xiwi fuq sfiż, id-dħul ta' xi ħaġa ġo toqba bil-qawwa, jew it-tneħħija ta' dak li jkun qed jimblokka toqba, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把食物穿在烤叉上烤制
把东西用力插入孔中

sense_translations.en_definition: removal of an obstruction from a hole
sense_translations.zh_definition: 清除孔中的堵塞物；疏通孔洞

collocations.en: thrusting a rod into a hole

formal.mt: Waqt it-tisfid tal-laħam, is-sfiż għandu jiddawwar regolarment sabiex il-laħam jissajjar b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: When roasting meat on a spit, the spit should be turned regularly so that the meat cooks evenly.
formal.zh: 穿叉烤肉时，应定时转动烤叉，使肉受热均匀。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ifisser tisfid f'din ir-riċetta? Toni: Ifisser li ssajjar il-laħam fuq sfiż u ddawru fuq in-nar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does tisfid mean in this recipe? Toni: It means cooking the meat on a spit and turning it over the fire.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这份食谱里的 tisfid 是什么意思？托尼：就是把肉穿在烤叉上，放在火上转着烤。

messages.speaker: Nina (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser tisfid f'din ir-riċetta?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser tisfid f'din ir-riċetta?
messages.zh: 这份食谱里的 tisfid 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tisfid mean in this recipe?

messages.speaker: Toni (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ssajjar il-laħam fuq sfiż u ddawru fuq in-nar.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ssajjar il-laħam fuq sfiż u ddawru fuq in-nar.
messages.zh: 就是把肉穿在烤叉上，放在火上转着烤。
messages.en: It means cooking the meat on a spit and turning it over the fire.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tisfid 画三幅独立提示图：烤叉上的肉、插入孔中的杆、被疏通的孔；用语境选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of arranging material in layers, or the act of sucking, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境指把材料逐层铺放的动作，或用嘴吮吸的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqegħid ta' materjal f'saffi, jew il-ġbid ta' xi ħaġa bil-ħalq permezz tal-irdigħ, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分层铺放；逐层叠置
吮吸；用嘴吸取

formal.mt: It-tisfif tal-materjal għandu jsir b'attenzjoni sabiex kull saff ikollu l-istess ħxuna.
formal.en: The material should be layered carefully so that every layer has the same thickness.
formal.zh: 铺放材料时应仔细操作，使每层厚度一致。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tisfif hawnhekk għandu x'jaqsam mas-saffi? Rita: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser l-irdigħ tal-ħalib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does tisfif here have something to do with layers? Rita: No, in this sentence it means sucking milk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 tisfif 跟分层有关吗？丽塔：没有，这句话里指吮吸乳汁。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tisfif hawnhekk għandu x'jaqsam mas-saffi?
messages.mt_standard: It-tisfif hawnhekk għandu x'jaqsam mas-saffi?
messages.zh: 这里的 tisfif 跟分层有关吗？
messages.en: Does tisfif here have something to do with layers?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser l-irdigħ tal-ħalib.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser l-irdigħ tal-ħalib.
messages.zh: 没有，这句话里指吮吸乳汁。
messages.en: No, in this sentence it means sucking milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisfif 的两义分成两张画卡：一张逐层铺材料，一张婴儿吸奶；不要强行把两义串成词源故事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Purification or the removal of unwanted matter by sifting or filtration; in a moral or religious context, atonement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 净化，或通过筛分、过滤去除杂质的过程；在道德或宗教语境中也指赎罪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-purifikazzjoni jew it-tneħħija ta' materjal mhux mixtieq permezz tal-għarbiel jew tal-filtrazzjoni; f'kuntest morali jew reliġjuż, it-tpattija għall-ħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 净化；使之纯净
筛分；过筛
赎罪；为过错作出补偿
过滤；借助滤材分离杂质

formal.mt: Is-sistema ta' tisfija tal-ilma tuża filtru biex tneħħi l-partiċelli sospiżi.
formal.en: The water purification system uses a filter to remove suspended particles.
formal.zh: 这套水净化系统使用过滤器去除悬浮颗粒。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex qed tgħaddi d-dqiq mill-għarbiel? Omm: Qed nagħmel it-tisfija tad-dqiq biex inneħħi ċ-ċapep.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why are you passing the flour through the sieve? Mum: I'm sifting the flour to remove the lumps.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你为什么把面粉倒进筛子里筛？妈妈：我在给面粉过筛，把结块去掉。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħaddi d-dqiq mill-għarbiel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħaddi d-dqiq mill-għarbiel?
messages.zh: 你为什么把面粉倒进筛子里筛？
messages.en: Why are you passing the flour through the sieve?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel it-tisfija tad-dqiq biex inneħħi ċ-ċapep.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel it-tisfija tad-dqiq biex inneħħi ċ-ċapep.
messages.zh: 我在给面粉过筛，把结块去掉。
messages.en: I'm sifting the flour to remove the lumps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格图记 tisfija：净化水、筛面粉、为过错赎罪、滤去颗粒；物质处理与赎罪要按语境分清。

gloss_zh: 卑微；使人谦卑或降低其骄气

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of lowliness, or the act or experience of being humbled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于卑微地位或状态，或使人、使自己变得谦卑、降低骄气的行为或经历。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ċokon jew ta' pożizzjoni baxxa, jew l-għemil jew l-esperjenza li bihom tonqos il-kburija ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卑微；低微的地位或状态
使人谦卑；挫低驕气；使人感到自身渺小

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-telfa twassal għat-tisfil tal-kburija tal-protagonist u ġġiegħlu jagħraf il-limiti tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, defeat humbles the protagonist's pride and makes him recognize his limitations.
formal.zh: 故事中，失败挫低了主人公的骄气，使他认识到自身的局限。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Għaliex issejjaħ dik it-telfa esperjenza ta' tisfil? Elena: Għax wara li tlift, fhimt li kelli ħafna x'nitgħallem.
colloquial.en: Daniel: Why do you call that defeat a humbling experience? Elena: Because after I lost, I realized I had a lot to learn.
colloquial.zh: 丹尼尔：你为什么说那次失败是一次让人变谦卑的经历？埃莱娜：因为输了之后，我才明白自己还有很多要学。

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex issejjaħ dik it-telfa esperjenza ta' tisfil?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex issejjaħ dik it-telfa esperjenza ta' tisfil?
messages.zh: 你为什么说那次失败是一次让人变谦卑的经历？
messages.en: Why do you call that defeat a humbling experience?

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax wara li tlift, fhimt li kelli ħafna x'nitgħallem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax wara li tlift, fhimt li kelli ħafna x'nitgħallem.
messages.zh: 因为输了之后，我才明白自己还有很多要学。
messages.en: Because after I lost, I realized I had a lot to learn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tisfil 时想象把高高抬起的下巴放低：既可提示卑微状态，也可提示骄气下降、变得谦卑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Density or compactness, or the process of becoming thicker or denser.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 稠密、紧密的状态，或变得更稠、更密的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-densità jew il-kumpattezza ta' xi ħaġa, jew il-proċess li bih issir aktar magħquda jew densa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 稠密程度；紧密程度；密度
变稠；变密；使之更稠密

formal.mt: It-tisfiq tal-veġetazzjoni tul il-mogħdija naqqas l-ispazju disponibbli għall-mixi.
formal.en: The thickening of vegetation along the path reduced the space available for walking.
formal.zh: 小路沿线的植被变得更加稠密，减少了可供行走的空间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nneħħi z-zalza minn fuq in-nar issa? Rita: Stenna ftit; it-tisfiq tagħha jieħu ftit minuti oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall I take the sauce off the heat now? Rita: Wait a little; it needs a few more minutes to thicken.
colloquial.zh: 马克：现在把酱汁从火上端下来吗？丽塔：再等一会儿，还得几分钟才会变稠。

messages.speaker: Mark (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nneħħi z-zalza minn fuq in-nar issa?
messages.mt_standard: Nneħħi z-zalza minn fuq in-nar issa?
messages.zh: 现在把酱汁从火上端下来吗？
messages.en: Shall I take the sauce off the heat now?

messages.speaker: Rita (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; it-tisfiq tagħha jieħu ftit minuti oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; it-tisfiq tagħha jieħu ftit minuti oħra.
messages.zh: 再等一会儿，还得几分钟才会变稠。
messages.en: Wait a little; it needs a few more minutes to thicken.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“树叶更密、酱汁更稠”两幅图记 tisfiq；静态看稠密程度，动态看变密或变稠的过程。

gloss_zh: 吹口哨；嗡鸣声；嘶嘶声；哨声

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of whistling or the sound produced by it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吹口哨的行为，或吹口哨时发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed isaffar jew il-ħoss li joħroġ meta jsaffar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹口哨的行为或持续的口哨声。
嗡嗡声或嘶嘶声。
一声口哨；哨声。

formal.mt: Waqt ir-reġistrazzjoni nstema' tisfir qawwi barra l-bini.
formal.en: During the recording, loud whistling was heard outside the building.
formal.zh: 录音期间，楼外传来了响亮的口哨声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak it-tisfir? Mark: Iva, Pawlu qed isaffar biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that whistling? Mark: Yes, Pawlu is whistling to get our attention.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听见那阵口哨声了吗？Mark：听见了，Pawlu 正吹口哨引起我们的注意。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dak it-tisfir?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dak it-tisfir?
messages.zh: 你听见那阵口哨声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that whistling?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu qed isaffar biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu qed isaffar biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tagħna.
messages.zh: 听见了，Pawlu 正吹口哨引起我们的注意。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu is whistling to get our attention.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisfir 放进听觉画面：朋友吹口哨、蒸汽嘶嘶响；用不同声源帮助区分各个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The preparation and arrangement of warp threads before weaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织造前准备并排列经线的工序，即整经。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tħejjija u l-arranġament tal-ħjut tal-medd qabel l-insiġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: preparation of the warp for weaving
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为织造准备经线；织前整经

formal.mt: It-tisfiħ għandu jitlesta qabel jibda l-insiġ, u l-ħjut tal-medd għandhom jiġu rranġati b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: Warp preparation must be completed before weaving begins, and the warp threads must be arranged carefully.
formal.zh: 织造开始前必须完成整经，并仔细排列经线。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nistgħu nibdew l-insiġ issa? Marija: Għad le, irridu nlestu t-tisfiħ l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can we start weaving now? Marija: Not yet, we need to finish preparing the warp first.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：现在可以开始织了吗？玛丽亚：还不行，我们得先完成整经。

messages.speaker: Sara (织造学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nibdew l-insiġ issa?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nibdew l-insiġ issa?
messages.zh: 现在可以开始织了吗？
messages.en: Can we start weaving now?

messages.speaker: Marija (织造教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad le, irridu nlestu t-tisfiħ l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Għad le, irridu nlestu t-tisfiħ l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 还不行，我们得先完成整经。
messages.en: Not yet, we need to finish preparing the warp first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象织布前先把一根根经线排整齐：tisfiħ 记作“先整经，再织布”的准备步骤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of leaning against a wall for support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体倚靠墙壁、让墙壁提供支撑的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iserraħ ġismu ma' ħajt biex isib appoġġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of leaning against a wall
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倚靠墙壁的动作。

formal.mt: It-tisgħin mal-ħajt għen lir-raġel iżomm il-bilanċ waqt li kien qed jistenna.
formal.en: Leaning against the wall helped the man keep his balance while he was waiting.
formal.zh: 那名男子等候时，靠墙的动作帮助他保持了平衡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed isserraħ dahrek mal-ħajt? Toni: Għax għejjejt; it-tisgħin mal-ħajt jagħtini ftit mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you resting your back against the wall? Toni: Because I'm tired; leaning against the wall gives me a little rest.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把背靠在墙上？Toni：因为我累了；靠墙能让我稍微歇一歇。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed isserraħ dahrek mal-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed isserraħ dahrek mal-ħajt?
messages.zh: 你为什么把背靠在墙上？
messages.en: Why are you resting your back against the wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għejjejt; it-tisgħin mal-ħajt jagħtini ftit mistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għejjejt; it-tisgħin mal-ħajt jagħtini ftit mistrieħ.
messages.zh: 因为我累了；靠墙能让我稍微歇一歇。
messages.en: Because I'm tired; leaning against the wall gives me a little rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tisgħin 时想象等车累了，把背贴向墙壁；将整个词与靠墙借力的动作绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Staying awake at night to keep a vigil or to work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了守候或工作而在夜间保持清醒、不睡觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed jibqa' mqajjem bil-lejl biex jagħmel velja jew biex jaħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 守夜；在夜间保持清醒以守候。

sense_translations.en_definition: passing the night awake to work
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了工作而整夜不眠；通宵工作。

collocations.en: keeping vigil beside the sick person
staying awake at night to work

formal.mt: It-tishir biex jitlesta r-rapport ħalla lill-ħaddiema għajjenin ħafna l-għada.
formal.en: Staying awake at night to finish the report left the workers very tired the next day.
formal.zh: 为了完成报告而熬夜，使工作人员第二天十分疲倦。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex int daqshekk għajjien illum? David: Minħabba t-tishir; bqajt naħdem fuq il-proġett il-lejl kollu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you so tired today? David: Because of staying up all night; I worked on the project the whole night.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天怎么这么累？David：因为熬夜了；我整晚都在做那个项目。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex int daqshekk għajjien illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex int daqshekk għajjien illum?
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么累？
messages.en: Why are you so tired today?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tishir; bqajt naħdem fuq il-proġett il-lejl kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tishir; bqajt naħdem fuq il-proġett il-lejl kollu.
messages.zh: 因为熬夜了；我整晚都在做那个项目。
messages.en: Because of staying up all night; I worked on the project the whole night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tishir 记成深夜仍亮着的灯：有人守夜，有人赶工。注意这里是 h，与表示施法的 tisħir 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Consumption, weathering, or wearing out: processes in which something is used up or gradually deteriorates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物被消耗、受到风化或逐渐磨损的过程，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-konsum, it-taħsir minħabba t-temp, jew it-tkagħbir minħabba l-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消耗；耗损。
风化；材料因天气作用而逐渐变坏。
磨损；因使用而逐渐损耗。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tisjif tal-ġebel ikkawżat mix-xita u mir-riħ.
formal.en: The report describes the weathering of the stone caused by rain and wind.
formal.zh: 报告描述了雨水和风造成的石材风化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-wiċċ ta' din il-ġebla nbidel daqshekk? Mark: Minħabba t-tisjif; ilha snin esposta għax-xita u għar-riħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has the surface of this stone changed so much? Mark: Because of weathering; it has been exposed to rain and wind for years.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块石头的表面怎么变化这么大？马克：是风化造成的；它已经风吹雨淋好多年了。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-wiċċ ta' din il-ġebla nbidel daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-wiċċ ta' din il-ġebla nbidel daqshekk?
messages.zh: 这块石头的表面怎么变化这么大？
messages.en: Why has the surface of this stone changed so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tisjif; ilha snin esposta għax-xita u għar-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tisjif; ilha snin esposta għax-xita u għar-riħ.
messages.zh: 是风化造成的；它已经风吹雨淋好多年了。
messages.en: Because of weathering; it has been exposed to rain and wind for years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 tisjif：东西被耗掉、石头被风雨侵蚀、物件被用旧；再靠上下文选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of preparing food by cooking it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加热等烹调方法制作食物的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha wieħed jipprepara l-ikel billi jsajru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烹饪；做饭。

formal.mt: Il-kors tat-tisjir jgħallem lill-parteċipanti kif jippreparaw ikliet sempliċi b'ingredjenti friski.
formal.en: The cooking course teaches participants how to prepare simple meals with fresh ingredients.
formal.zh: 这门烹饪课程教参与者用新鲜食材制作简单的饭菜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tħobb it-tisjir? Pawlu: Iva, speċjalment meta jkolli ħin nipprova riċetta ġdida.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like cooking? Pawlu: Yes, especially when I have time to try a new recipe.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢做饭吗？保罗：喜欢，尤其是有时间试新食谱的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħobb it-tisjir?
messages.mt_standard: Tħobb it-tisjir?
messages.zh: 你喜欢做饭吗？
messages.en: Do you like cooking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta jkolli ħin nipprova riċetta ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta jkolli ħin nipprova riċetta ġdida.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其是有时间试新食谱的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when I have time to try a new recipe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisjir 贴在厨房的食谱旁，连着记“烹饪课程”和“烹饪时间”，就能把做饭这项活动记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of laying the foundations that support a building or other structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为建筑物或其他构筑物铺设承重基础的施工活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol tat-tqegħid tal-pedamenti li fuqhom jinbena bini jew struttura oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺设地基；打基础的施工过程。

collocations.en: laying the foundations of a new house

formal.mt: It-tisjis tal-bini għandu jitlesta qabel ma jibda x-xogħol fuq il-ħitan.
formal.en: The laying of the building's foundations must be completed before work on the walls begins.
formal.zh: 建筑物的地基施工必须在墙体施工开始前完成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Bdejtu tibnu d-dar? Mark: Iva, bħalissa qed nagħmlu x-xogħol ta' tisjis.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you started building the house? Mark: Yes, we're doing the foundation work at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们开始建房了吗？马克：开始了，现在正在打地基。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Bdejtu tibnu d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Bdejtu tibnu d-dar?
messages.zh: 你们开始建房了吗？
messages.en: Have you started building the house?

messages.speaker: Mark (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bħalissa qed nagħmlu x-xogħol ta' tisjis.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bħalissa qed nagħmlu x-xogħol ta' tisjis.
messages.zh: 开始了，现在正在打地基。
messages.en: Yes, we're doing the foundation work at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象房屋还没有墙，工人先把地基做好：tisjis 记的是“铺设基础”的施工过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pain caused by suppuration, the formation or accumulation of pus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因形成或积聚脓液，也就是化脓，而产生的疼痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-uġigħ li jinħass minħabba l-formazzjoni jew il-ġbir tal-materja f'ferita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化脓所引起的疼痛。

collocations.en: pain from suppuration in the wound

formal.mt: Il-pazjent iddeskriva tisjit fil-ferita, u t-tabib irreġistra dan is-sintomu.
formal.en: The patient described pain from suppuration in the wound, and the doctor recorded this symptom.
formal.zh: 患者描述了伤口化脓引起的疼痛，医生记录了这一症状。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għedt lit-tabib dwar il-ferita? Ben: Għedtlu li qed inħoss tisjit u li l-uġigħ qed jiżdied.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did you tell the doctor about the wound? Ben: I told him that I'm feeling pain from suppuration and that the pain is getting worse.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你怎么向医生描述伤口的情况？本：我告诉他，我有化脓引起的疼痛，而且越来越疼。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għedt lit-tabib dwar il-ferita?
messages.mt_standard: X'għedt lit-tabib dwar il-ferita?
messages.zh: 你怎么向医生描述伤口的情况？
messages.en: What did you tell the doctor about the wound?

messages.speaker: Ben (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtlu li qed inħoss tisjit u li l-uġigħ qed jiżdied.
messages.mt_standard: Għedtlu li qed inħoss tisjit u li l-uġigħ qed jiżdied.
messages.zh: 我告诉他，我有化脓引起的疼痛，而且越来越疼。
messages.en: I told him that I'm feeling pain from suppuration and that the pain is getting worse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisjit 记成“化脓带来的疼痛”，将原因和感觉连在一起，避免把它泛记为所有疼痛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of calling out to someone to attract their attention or ask them to come.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出声叫某人，以引起对方注意或让对方过来的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed isejjaħ lil xi ħadd biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tiegħu jew biex jiġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼叫；呼唤某人的行为。

formal.mt: It-tisjiħ tal-ismijiet tal-parteċipanti sar qabel il-bidu tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The participants' names were called before the meeting began.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，工作人员点了与会者的名字。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajt it-tisjiħ minn barra? Ben: Iva, ommok qed issejjaħlek. Mur ara xi trid.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you hear the calling from outside? Ben: Yes, your mother is calling you. Go and see what she wants.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你听见外面的呼叫声了吗？本：听见了，你妈妈在叫你。去看看她有什么事吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt it-tisjiħ minn barra?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt it-tisjiħ minn barra?
messages.zh: 你听见外面的呼叫声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the calling from outside?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ommok qed issejjaħlek. Mur ara xi trid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ommok qed issejjaħlek. Mur ara xi trid.
messages.zh: 听见了，你妈妈在叫你。去看看她有什么事吧。
messages.en: Yes, your mother is calling you. Go and see what she wants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人在门外叫你的名字，把 tisjiħ 与“呼唤这个动作”相连；它在这里是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of ploughing land; also the act of prying something open or moving it with leverage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用犁翻耕土地的活动；也指借助杠杆力量撬开或撬动物体的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħrit tal-art; ukoll il-ftuħ jew iċ-ċaqliq ta' xi ħaġa permezz ta' lieva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犁地；翻耕土地。
撬动；用杠杆力量撬开。

formal.mt: It-tiskik tal-għalqa tlesta qabel iż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The ploughing of the field was completed before sowing.
formal.zh: 田地的翻耕在播种前完成了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irnexxielek tiftaħ il-kaxxa? Pawlu: Iva, imma t-tiskik tal-għatu ħa aktar ħin milli ħsibt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you manage to open the box? Pawlu: Yes, but prying the lid open took longer than I thought.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把箱子打开了吗？保罗：打开了，不过撬开盖子花的时间比我想的长。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irnexxielek tiftaħ il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Irnexxielek tiftaħ il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你把箱子打开了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to open the box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma t-tiskik tal-għatu ħa aktar ħin milli ħsibt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma t-tiskik tal-għatu ħa aktar ħin milli ħsibt.
messages.zh: 打开了，不过撬开盖子花的时间比我想的长。
messages.en: Yes, but prying the lid open took longer than I thought.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tiskik 配两张学习卡：一张是犁翻土地，一张是工具撬盖；用场景分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of being very thin and gaunt, or the process of becoming severely thin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体十分瘦削、外表憔悴的状态，或明显消瘦的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' rqaq kbir fil-ġisem, jew il-proċess li bih wieħed jitlef ħafna piż u jsir irqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 憔悴瘦削的样子或状态。
严重消瘦；身体变得极为瘦弱。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tiskim tal-ġisem u t-telf fil-piż matul dak il-perjodu.
formal.en: The report describes the emaciation of the body and the weight loss during that period.
formal.zh: 报告描述了那段时期身体严重消瘦及体重下降的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Innutajt it-tiskim f'wiċċ Toni? Mark: Iva, wiċċu jidher ħafna aktar irqiq milli kien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you noticed the gauntness in Toni's face? Mark: Yes, his face looks much thinner than it used to.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你注意到托尼脸上那种憔悴瘦削的样子了吗？马克：注意到了，他的脸看起来比以前瘦多了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt it-tiskim f'wiċċ Toni?
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt it-tiskim f'wiċċ Toni?
messages.zh: 你注意到托尼脸上那种憔悴瘦削的样子了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed the gauntness in Toni's face?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wiċċu jidher ħafna aktar irqiq milli kien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wiċċu jidher ħafna aktar irqiq milli kien.
messages.zh: 注意到了，他的脸看起来比以前瘦多了。
messages.en: Yes, his face looks much thinner than it used to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用面部和全身两个画面记 tiskim：面部突出憔悴瘦削，全身突出严重消瘦；词本身不说明消瘦原因。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of cutting something with a knife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用刀切开或切分某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni ta' qtugħ ta' xi ħaġa b'sikkina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用刀切割的动作
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qtugħ b'sikkina.

formal.mt: It-tiskin tal-laħam għandu jsir b'attenzjoni fuq bord tat-tqattigħ nadif.
formal.en: Cutting meat with a knife should be done carefully on a clean cutting board.
formal.zh: 用刀切肉时，应在干净的砧板上小心操作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għat-tiskin tal-ħaxix, uża din is-sikkina. Mark: Tajjeb, se nuża l-bord ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Use this knife to cut the vegetables. Mark: All right, I'll use the cutting board too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：切蔬菜用这把刀。Mark：好，我也会用砧板。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tiskin tal-ħaxix, uża din is-sikkina.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tiskin tal-ħaxix, uża din is-sikkina.
messages.zh: 切蔬菜用这把刀。
messages.en: Use this knife to cut the vegetables.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nuża l-bord ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nuża l-bord ukoll.
messages.zh: 好，我也会用砧板。
messages.en: All right, I'll use the cutting board too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiskin 和“刀在砧板上切菜”的画面配对记忆：它是名词，表示用刀切割这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming drunk after drinking alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饮酒后逐渐进入醉酒状态的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih persuna tixrob l-alkoħol sakemm tisker.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因饮酒而喝醉的过程
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih persuna tisker.

formal.mt: Il-kampanja tispjega r-riskji tat-tiskir u tħeġġeġ lin-nies jagħżlu xorb bla alkoħol.
formal.en: The campaign explains the risks of getting drunk and encourages people to choose alcohol-free drinks.
formal.zh: 这项宣传活动说明喝醉的风险，并鼓励人们选择无酒精饮品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma rridx nixrob iżżejjed; it-tiskir ma jogħġobnix. Mark: Mela nieħdu xarba bla alkoħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: I don't want to drink too much; I don't like getting drunk. Mark: Then let's have an alcohol-free drink.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我不想喝太多，我不喜欢喝醉。Mark：那我们喝点无酒精饮料吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma rridx nixrob iżżejjed; it-tiskir ma jogħġobnix.
messages.mt_standard: Ma rridx nixrob iżżejjed; it-tiskir ma jogħġobnix.
messages.zh: 我不想喝太多，我不喜欢喝醉。
messages.en: I don't want to drink too much; I don't like getting drunk.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nieħdu xarba bla alkoħol.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nieħdu xarba bla alkoħol.
messages.zh: 那我们喝点无酒精饮料吧。
messages.en: Then let's have an alcohol-free drink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiskir 和“饮酒后逐渐醉了”的连续画面配对记忆：它是名词，重点是喝醉这个过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making someone stop speaking or preventing their views from being heard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人停止说话，或阻止其表达意见、让其声音无法被听见的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jieqaf jitkellem jew twaqqfu milli jsemma' l-fehmiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人沉默；阻止某人发声或表达意见。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li twaqqaf lil xi ħadd milli jitkellem jew jesprimi ruħu.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkundanna t-tiskit tal-kritiċi u jitlob li kulħadd ikun jista' jesprimi l-fehmiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The report condemns the silencing of critics and calls for everyone to be able to express their views.
formal.zh: 报告谴责压制批评者发声的行为，并呼吁让每个人都能表达自己的意见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma jridux iħalluna nitkellmu fil-laqgħa. Pawlu: Dan hu tentattiv ta' tiskit; għandna dritt ngħidu x'naħsbu.
colloquial.en: Lara: They don't want to let us speak at the meeting. Pawlu: This is an attempt to silence us; we have a right to say what we think.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们不想让我们在会上发言。保罗：这是想让我们闭嘴；我们有权说出自己的想法。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma jridux iħalluna nitkellmu fil-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ma jridux iħalluna nitkellmu fil-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 他们不想让我们在会上发言。
messages.en: They don't want to let us speak at the meeting.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu tentattiv ta' tiskit; għandna dritt ngħidu x'naħsbu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu tentattiv ta' tiskit; għandna dritt ngħidu x'naħsbu.
messages.zh: 这是想让我们闭嘴；我们有权说出自己的想法。
messages.en: This is an attempt to silence us; we have a right to say what we think.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiskit 联想成有人正要发言，麦克风却被关掉的画面；重点记住它表示“使人沉默的行为”，而不只是安静的状态。

gloss_zh: 钉十字架；交叉穿行、交错

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of crucifying someone; also, the crossing of lines or movements in different directions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人钉在十字架上的行为；也指线条或不同方向的移动相互交叉、交错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ssallab lil xi ħadd; ukoll, il-qsim ta' linji jew movimenti f'direzzjonijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钉十字架；把人钉在十字架上的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li ssallab lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交叉穿行；线条或不同方向的移动相互交错。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qsim ta' linji jew movimenti f'direzzjonijiet differenti.

formal.mt: Il-pittura turi t-tislib ta' Kristu, b'diversi persuni miġbura ħdejn is-salib.
formal.en: The painting depicts the crucifixion of Christ, with several people gathered beside the cross.
formal.zh: 这幅画描绘了基督被钉十字架的场景，十字架旁聚集着几个人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm daqshekk linji f'dan it-tpinġija? Mark: It-tislib tal-linji joħloq disinn sabiħ. Ara kif jaqsmu lil xulxin fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there so many lines in this drawing? Mark: The criss-crossing of the lines creates a lovely design. Look at how they cross one another in the middle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画里为什么有这么多线条？马克：线条交错形成了漂亮的图案。你看，它们在中间相互交叉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk linji f'dan it-tpinġija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk linji f'dan it-tpinġija?
messages.zh: 这幅画里为什么有这么多线条？
messages.en: Why are there so many lines in this drawing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tislib tal-linji joħloq disinn sabiħ. Ara kif jaqsmu lil xulxin fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: It-tislib tal-linji joħloq disinn sabiħ. Ara kif jaqsmu lil xulxin fin-nofs.
messages.zh: 线条交错形成了漂亮的图案。你看，它们在中间相互交叉。
messages.en: The criss-crossing of the lines creates a lovely design. Look at how they cross one another in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 tislib 时并排想象两幅图：一幅是钉十字架的画面，一幅是线条交错的图案；用这两幅图分别记住两个义项，再根据上下文选择。

gloss_zh: 填字游戏；施行钉十字架之刑

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word puzzle in which answers to clues are written into intersecting rows of squares; also, the act of crucifying someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据提示把答案填入横竖交叉方格的文字游戏；也指把人钉在十字架上的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba li fiha timla kliem f'kaxxi li jiltaqgħu orizzontalment u vertikalment skont ħjiel mogħti; ukoll, l-att li ssallab persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 填字游戏：根据提示，在横竖交叉的方格中填入词语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Logħba li fiha ssib kliem minn ħjiel u timlieh f'kaxxi li jiltaqgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把人钉在十字架上的行为；施行钉十字架之刑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li ssallab persuna.

formal.mt: L-għalliem ħejja tisliba biex l-istudenti jirrevedu l-kliem il-ġdid.
formal.en: The teacher prepared a crossword puzzle so that the students could review the new vocabulary.
formal.zh: 老师准备了一道填字游戏，让学生复习新词。
