colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed insolvi tisliba. Tista' tgħinni b'din il-kelma? Mark: Iva. Kemm għandha ittri?
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm doing a crossword. Can you help me with this word? Mark: Yes. How many letters does it have?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我正在做填字游戏。你能帮我看看这个词吗？马克：可以。它有几个字母？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed insolvi tisliba. Tista' tgħinni b'din il-kelma?
messages.mt_standard: Qed insolvi tisliba. Tista' tgħinni b'din il-kelma?
messages.zh: 我正在做填字游戏。你能帮我看看这个词吗？
messages.en: I'm doing a crossword. Can you help me with this word?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Kemm għandha ittri?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Kemm għandha ittri?
messages.zh: 可以。它有几个字母？
messages.en: Yes. How many letters does it have?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisliba 和报纸上的交叉方格一起记：看到“提示、字母、解题”就想到填字游戏；遇到钉十字架的语境时，再切换到另一义项。

gloss_zh: 借出；出借；借贷中的贷出行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or practice of letting someone use money or another item temporarily, with the expectation that it will be returned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱或其他物品暂时交给别人使用，并预期对方归还的行为，即出借。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħti flus jew oġġett lil xi ħadd biex jużahom għal xi żmien u mbagħad jagħtihom lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出借：把钱或物品暂时借给别人使用，并预期获得归还。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' flus jew oġġetti lil ħaddieħor għal żmien, bil-ħsieb li jingħataw lura.

formal.mt: Is-servizz tat-tislif tal-kotba jippermetti lill-qarrejja jieħdu kotba d-dar għal ġimagħtejn.
formal.en: The book-lending service allows readers to take books home for two weeks.
formal.zh: 图书外借服务允许读者把书带回家，借期为两周。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jaħdem it-tislif tal-kotba hawn? Pawlu: Tista' tieħu żewġ kotba għal ġimagħtejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How does book lending work here? Pawlu: You can take two books for two weeks.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的图书外借是怎么办理的？保罗：你可以借两本书，借期是两周。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jaħdem it-tislif tal-kotba hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jaħdem it-tislif tal-kotba hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的图书外借是怎么办理的？
messages.en: How does book lending work here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tieħu żewġ kotba għal ġimagħtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tieħu żewġ kotba għal ġimagħtejn.
messages.zh: 你可以借两本书，借期是两周。
messages.en: You can take two books for two weeks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tislif 时画一支从自己指向别人的箭头，再画一支归还箭头：先借出去，之后收回来。用图书馆把书借给读者的画面，记牢它表示出借。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of slipping away quietly or getting away from a place or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指悄悄离开某处，或从某个场所、处境中脱身的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed jitlaq bil-kwiet jew jirnexxilu jitbiegħed minn post jew minn sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷偷溜走；不引人注意地悄悄离开。
脱身；成功离开某处或摆脱某种处境。

formal.mt: It-tislik tiegħu mil-laqgħa qabel it-tmiem ma għaddiex inosservat.
formal.en: His slipping away from the meeting before it ended did not go unnoticed.
formal.zh: 他在会议结束前悄悄离开，这件事还是被人注意到了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Mark telaq mingħajr ma qal xejn? Pawlu: Iva, dak kien tislik bil-kwiet! Lanqas indunajt meta ħareġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did Mark leave without saying anything? Pawlu: Yes, that was a quiet getaway! I didn't even notice when he went out.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：马克什么也没说就走了？保罗：对，他悄悄溜走了！我连他什么时候出去的都没注意到。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark telaq mingħajr ma qal xejn?
messages.mt_standard: Mark telaq mingħajr ma qal xejn?
messages.zh: 马克什么也没说就走了？
messages.en: Did Mark leave without saying anything?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak kien tislik bil-kwiet! Lanqas indunajt meta ħareġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak kien tislik bil-kwiet! Lanqas indunajt meta ħareġ.
messages.zh: 对，他悄悄溜走了！我连他什么时候出去的都没注意到。
messages.en: Yes, that was a quiet getaway! I didn't even notice when he went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tislik 配上一幅会议中有人轻轻关门离开的画面：强调没被察觉时记“偷偷溜走”，强调成功离开时记“脱身”；它是表示行为的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of greeting or taking leave, or a bow made as a sign of respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示问候或告别的致意行为，也可指表达敬意的鞠躬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' merħba jew ta' firda, jew inklinazzjoni tar-ras jew tal-ġisem bħala sinjal ta' rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞠躬；通过低头或俯身表达敬意的动作。
问候；见面时向对方致意。
告别致意；分别时说的话或作出的致意。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iċ-ċerimonja, ir-rappreżentant għamel tislim b'rispett lill-mistednin.
formal.en: At the end of the ceremony, the representative offered a respectful salutation to the guests.
formal.zh: 仪式结束时，代表向来宾恭敬致意。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'kien ifisser dak it-tislim b'rasu? Pawlu: Kien qed isellmilna qabel telaq.
colloquial.en: Marta: What did that bow of his head mean? Pawlu: He was saying goodbye to us before leaving.
colloquial.zh: Marta：他刚才低头致意是什么意思？Pawlu：他是在离开前向我们告别。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien ifisser dak it-tislim b'rasu?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien ifisser dak it-tislim b'rasu?
messages.zh: 他刚才低头致意是什么意思？
messages.en: What did that bow of his head mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qed isellmilna qabel telaq.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qed isellmilna qabel telaq.
messages.zh: 他是在离开前向我们告别。
messages.en: He was saying goodbye to us before leaving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tislim 放进见面与离别的画面：见面问候、离别致意，弯腰低头也能表达敬意；用场景串起三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting or salutation addressed to someone, including words of farewell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人表达的问候或致意，也包括分别时的告别语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma jew espressjoni li biha wieħed isellem lil xi ħadd meta jiltaqa' miegħu jew jinfired minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 问候、致意或告别语；用于见面、向人表达心意或分别时。

formal.mt: L-ittra tibda bi tislima ta' merħba u tintemm bi tislima mill-qalb.
formal.en: The letter begins with a welcoming salutation and ends with a heartfelt greeting.
formal.zh: 这封信以欢迎的致意开头，以衷心的问候结尾。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta tara lil oħtok, agħtiha tislima mingħandi. Mark: Żgur, se naraha llejla.
colloquial.en: Nina: When you see your sister, give her my regards. Mark: Of course, I'll see her this evening.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你见到你姐姐或妹妹时，替我向她问好。Mark：当然，我今晚会见到她。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tara lil oħtok, agħtiha tislima mingħandi.
messages.mt_standard: Meta tara lil oħtok, agħtiha tislima mingħandi.
messages.zh: 你见到你姐姐或妹妹时，替我向她问好。
messages.en: When you see your sister, give her my regards.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, se naraha llejla.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, se naraha llejla.
messages.zh: 当然，我今晚会见到她。
messages.en: Of course, I'll see her this evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住整句 agħtiha tislima mingħandi，即“替我向她问好”；把 tislima 想成一份可以托人转达的问候。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fraying of fabric or similar material; also an imperious manner of ordering others about.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织物等材料磨损后散线的过程或状态；也指专横、盛气凌人的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih it-truf ta' drapp jinfetħu f'ħjut; ukoll imġiba ta' min jikkmanda lill-oħrajn b'mod arroganti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨损散线；织物或类似材料的边缘松散、绽出线头的过程或状态。
专横；以高高在上、强硬命令他人的方式行事的态度。

collocations.en: fraying at the edges of the fabric
imperiousness in his manner of speaking
collocations.zh: 他说话方式中的专横态度

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni ġie osservat tislit fit-truf tad-drapp.
formal.en: During the inspection, fraying was observed at the edges of the fabric.
formal.zh: 检查时发现布料边缘有磨损散线现象。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma nħobbx it-tislit fil-mod kif ikellimna. David: Lanqas jien; jista' jitlob l-affarijiet b'aktar rispett.
colloquial.en: Lara: I don't like the imperious way he speaks to us. David: Neither do I; he could ask for things more respectfully.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我不喜欢他跟我们说话时那种专横的态度。David：我也不喜欢；他可以更尊重地提出要求。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nħobbx it-tislit fil-mod kif ikellimna.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nħobbx it-tislit fil-mod kif ikellimna.
messages.zh: 我不喜欢他跟我们说话时那种专横的态度。
messages.en: I don't like the imperious way he speaks to us.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lanqas jien; jista' jitlob l-affarijiet b'aktar rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Lanqas jien; jista' jitlob l-affarijiet b'aktar rispett.
messages.zh: 我也不喜欢；他可以更尊重地提出要求。
messages.en: Neither do I; he could ask for things more respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tislit 做两张场景卡：一张画布边散出的线头，一张画盛气凌人的说话者；分别记忆，避免把两个义项混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of removing skin from an animal; in other contexts, bruising or diarrhoea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指剥去动物皮肤的行为或过程；在其他语境中也可指瘀伤或腹泻，须结合上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li titneħħa l-ġilda minn annimal; f'kuntesti oħra jista' jfisser tbenġil jew dijarea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥皮；去除动物皮肤的过程。
瘀伤；皮下受损而出现青紫的情况。
剥皮；将皮肤剥离的行为，尤其强调剥除这一动作。
腹泻；排便频繁且粪便稀薄的情况。

formal.mt: Il-manwal jiddeskrivi l-proċess tat-tisliħ tal-annimal u l-għodod meħtieġa għal dan ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The manual describes the process of skinning the animal and the tools needed for this work.
formal.zh: 手册介绍了给动物剥皮的过程，以及这项工作所需的工具。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jispjega dan il-kapitlu? Pawlu: Jispjega t-tisliħ tal-annimal, jiġifieri kif titneħħa l-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does this chapter explain? Pawlu: It explains skinning an animal, meaning how the skin is removed.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这一章讲什么？保罗：讲给动物剥皮，也就是怎样去除动物的皮肤。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jispjega dan il-kapitlu?
messages.mt_standard: X'jispjega dan il-kapitlu?
messages.zh: 这一章讲什么？
messages.en: What does this chapter explain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jispjega t-tisliħ tal-annimal, jiġifieri kif titneħħa l-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Jispjega t-tisliħ tal-annimal, jiġifieri kif titneħħa l-ġilda.
messages.zh: 讲给动物剥皮，也就是怎样去除动物的皮肤。
messages.en: It explains skinning an animal, meaning how the skin is removed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用语境卡片记忆 tisliħ：动物加工图旁写“剥皮”，碰伤图旁写“瘀伤”，肠胃不适图旁写“腹泻”；同一词形要靠场景辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a liquid forms a clot or a semisolid mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体形成凝块或半固体团块的过程，即凝结或凝固。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih likwidu jagħqad u jifforma massa semisolida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝结；液体形成凝块或半固体团块的过程。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega t-tismid tad-demm u l-formazzjoni ta' embolu.
formal.en: The chapter explains blood coagulation and the formation of a clot.
formal.zh: 本章讲解血液凝固及凝块的形成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu t-tismid f'din l-istampa? Toni: Huwa l-proċess li fih il-likwidu jagħqad.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does coagulation mean in this picture? Toni: It's the process in which the liquid forms a clot or semisolid mass.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这张图里的凝结是什么意思？Toni：就是液体凝成块或半固体团块的过程。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu t-tismid f'din l-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu t-tismid f'din l-istampa?
messages.zh: 这张图里的凝结是什么意思？
messages.en: What does coagulation mean in this picture?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-proċess li fih il-likwidu jagħqad.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-proċess li fih il-likwidu jagħqad.
messages.zh: 就是液体凝成块或半固体团块的过程。
messages.en: It's the process in which the liquid forms a clot or semisolid mass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tismid，就想象原本流动的液体逐渐形成凝块；再用 tismid tad-demm“血液凝固”固定这个画面。

gloss_zh: 听；使人听到；播放供人听

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hearing something or causing someone else to hear it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 听到某种声音的行为，或通过播放、发声等方式使别人听到某事物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jisma' xi ħaġa jew li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd ieħor jismagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of hearing or making someone hear something
sense_translations.zh_definition: 听某事物，或使某人听到某事物的行为。

collocations.en: listening to or playing a recording for someone
collocations.zh: 听录音或播放录音供人听

collocations.en: listening to or playing music for someone
collocations.zh: 听音乐或播放音乐供人听

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tinkludi t-tismigħ ta' reġistrazzjoni qasira, segwit minn diskussjoni dwar il-kontenut tagħha.
formal.en: The lesson includes listening to a short recording, followed by a discussion of its content.
formal.zh: 这节课包括听一段简短录音，随后讨论录音内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se jkun hemm tismigħ ta' reġistrazzjoni fil-lezzjoni? Ben: Iva, u wara nitkellmu dwar dak li smajna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will we listen to a recording in the lesson? Ben: Yes, and afterwards we'll talk about what we heard.
colloquial.zh: Maja：课上会听录音吗？Ben：会，然后我们会讨论听到的内容。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jkun hemm tismigħ ta' reġistrazzjoni fil-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Se jkun hemm tismigħ ta' reġistrazzjoni fil-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 课上会听录音吗？
messages.en: Will we listen to a recording in the lesson?

messages.speaker: Ben (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u wara nitkellmu dwar dak li smajna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u wara nitkellmu dwar dak li smajna.
messages.zh: 会，然后我们会讨论听到的内容。
messages.en: Yes, and afterwards we'll talk about what we heard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tismigħ 画成一段录音连接两个人：一人播放让别人听，另一人接收声音；两个方向都围绕“听”的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving something a name, or of referring to someone or something in speech or writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或事物取名字的行为；也指在说话或写作中提到某人或某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jingħata isem lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa, jew li wieħed jirreferi għalihom fid-diskors jew fil-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 命名；给某人或某事物取名。
提及；在说话或文字中谈到某人或某事。

collocations.en: the mention of a name in the report
collocations.zh: 在报告中提及一个名字

formal.mt: It-tismija ta' ismu fir-rapport ma tfissirx li huwa responsabbli għad-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The mention of his name in the report does not mean that he is responsible for the decision.
formal.zh: 报告中提到他的名字，并不意味着他要为这项决定负责。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed niddiskutu t-tismija tat-triq? Luqa: Għax irridu nagħżlu isem għaliha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are we discussing the naming of the street? Luqa: Because we need to choose a name for it.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们为什么在讨论这条街的命名？Luqa：因为我们需要给它选个名字。

messages.speaker: Anna (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed niddiskutu t-tismija tat-triq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed niddiskutu t-tismija tat-triq?
messages.zh: 我们为什么在讨论这条街的命名？
messages.en: Why are we discussing the naming of the street?

messages.speaker: Luqa (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irridu nagħżlu isem għaliha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irridu nagħżlu isem għaliha.
messages.zh: 因为我们需要给它选个名字。
messages.en: Because we need to choose a name for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 tismija：给新街道挂名字是“命名”，在报告里写到某人名字是“提及”；根据上下文选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making or becoming hard; also the act or process of poisoning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变硬或某物逐渐变硬的过程；也指投毒、毒害或中毒的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir jew titħalla ssir iebsa; ukoll l-att jew il-proċess ta' avvelenament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硬化；使某物变硬或某物变硬的过程。
投毒、毒害或中毒；毒物造成有害作用的行为或过程。

formal.mt: L-esperiment juri t-tismim tal-materjal, li gradwalment isir aktar iebes.
formal.en: The experiment demonstrates the hardening of the material, which gradually becomes harder.
formal.zh: 这项实验展示材料的硬化过程，材料会逐渐变硬。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-preżentazzjoni tiegħek? Samwel: It-tismim mill-ikel; għadni qed niġbor l-informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Rita: What's the topic of your presentation? Samwel: Food poisoning; I'm still gathering information.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你的报告主题是什么？Samwel：食物中毒；我还在收集资料。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-preżentazzjoni tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-preżentazzjoni tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的报告主题是什么？
messages.en: What's the topic of your presentation?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tismim mill-ikel; għadni qed niġbor l-informazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: It-tismim mill-ikel; għadni qed niġbor l-informazzjoni.
messages.zh: 食物中毒；我还在收集资料。
messages.en: Food poisoning; I'm still gathering information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tismim 分开建立“材料变硬”和“毒物致害”两张记忆卡；再留意它以 m 结尾，与以 n 结尾的 tismin 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making a person or animal fatter, especially by feeding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物变胖、增加体重的过程，尤指通过喂养使动物育肥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna jew annimal jiżdied fil-piż u jsir eħxen, speċjalment permezz tal-ikel jew tal-għalf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增肥；使人或动物变胖的过程，尤指通过喂养对动物进行催肥、育肥。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi rreġistra l-piż tal-annimali matul il-perjodu tat-tismin.
formal.en: The farmer recorded the animals' weight during the fattening period.
formal.zh: 农民在育肥期间记录了动物的体重。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn poġġejt l-għalf għat-tismin? Ġużeppi: Fil-maħżen, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did you put the fattening feed? Ġużeppi: In the storeroom, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你把育肥饲料放在哪里了？Ġużeppi：在储藏室里，门旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt l-għalf għat-tismin?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt l-għalf għat-tismin?
messages.zh: 你把育肥饲料放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the fattening feed?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-maħżen, ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-maħżen, ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 在储藏室里，门旁边。
messages.en: In the storeroom, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tismin 与一袋标有“育肥”的饲料和逐渐上升的体重记录放在一起记；特别看清末尾是 n，别与 tismim 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming darker, or the action of driving in nails or striking with a hammer, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指颜色变暗的过程，也可指钉入钉子或用锤子敲打的动作，须根据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tiskura, jew l-azzjoni li ddaħħal imsiemer jew tolqot bil-martell, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变暗；颜色加深。
钉钉子；用钉子固定。
锤打；用锤子敲击。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tismir tal-imsiemer, il-ħaddiem żamm il-bord sod fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: While driving in the nails, the worker held the board firmly on the table.
formal.zh: 钉钉子时，工人把木板稳稳地按在桌上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Qed nagħmel ftit tismir bil-martell biex inwaħħal dan il-bord. Lara: Sewwa, żommu sod.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that noise? Pawlu: I'm doing a little hammering to attach this board. Lara: All right, hold it steady.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那是什么声音？保罗：我在用锤子敲几下，把这块木板固定好。拉拉：好，把它扶稳。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss?
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel ftit tismir bil-martell biex inwaħħal dan il-bord.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel ftit tismir bil-martell biex inwaħħal dan il-bord.
messages.zh: 我在用锤子敲几下，把这块木板固定好。
messages.en: I'm doing a little hammering to attach this board.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, żommu sod.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, żommu sod.
messages.zh: 好，把它扶稳。
messages.en: All right, hold it steady.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张画面卡记忆：颜色变暗、钉子入木、锤子敲击；看到 tismir 时先看周围是在谈颜色还是工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The baking of bread until it becomes hard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将面包烘烤至质地变硬的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħami tal-ħobż sakemm isir iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把面包烘烤至硬的过程。

collocations.en: the baking of bread until hard
baking until hard in the oven

formal.mt: Matul it-tisniġ tal-ħobż, il-furnar jiċċekkja kemm sar iebes qabel joħorġu mill-forn.
formal.en: During the baking of bread until hard, the baker checks how hard it has become before taking it out of the oven.
formal.zh: 将面包烤硬的过程中，面包师会在出炉前检查面包的硬度。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ħallejt il-ħobż fil-forn daqshekk? Toni: Qed nagħmel it-tisniġ tal-ħobż; irridu jsir iebes. Rita: Mela ċċekkjah qabel toħorġu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why have you left the bread in the oven so long? Toni: I'm baking the bread until hard; we want it to become hard. Rita: Then check it before taking it out.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么把面包放在烤箱里这么久？托尼：我在把面包烤硬；我们要让它变硬。丽塔：那出炉前检查一下。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallejt il-ħobż fil-forn daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallejt il-ħobż fil-forn daqshekk?
messages.zh: 你为什么把面包放在烤箱里这么久？
messages.en: Why have you left the bread in the oven so long?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel it-tisniġ tal-ħobż; irridu jsir iebes.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel it-tisniġ tal-ħobż; irridu jsir iebes.
messages.zh: 我在把面包烤硬；我们要让它变硬。
messages.en: I'm baking the bread until hard; we want it to become hard.

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ċċekkjah qabel toħorġu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ċċekkjah qabel toħorġu.
messages.zh: 那出炉前检查一下。
messages.en: Then check it before taking it out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包在烤箱里继续烘烤，最后变得硬硬的；用“烤到硬”这个终点记住 tisniġ 的范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of putting a roof on a structure, or the action of covering something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给建筑物铺设屋顶的工作，也可指给某物加上覆盖层的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih struttura tingħata saqaf, jew l-azzjoni li xi ħaġa titgħatta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺设屋顶；屋顶施工。
覆盖；加上覆盖层。

collocations.zh: 屋顶铺设或覆盖用的材料

formal.mt: It-tisqif tad-dar għandu jitlesta qabel jibda x-xogħol fuq il-ħitan ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: The roofing of the house should be completed before work begins on the interior walls.
formal.zh: 房屋的屋顶施工应在内墙工程开始前完成。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Lesti bix-xogħol tad-dar? Ġużeppi: Għad fadal it-tisqif. Marija: Mela għad tridu tagħmlu s-saqaf.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you finished the work on the house? Ġużeppi: The roofing still remains. Marija: So you still need to put the roof on.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：房子的工程做完了吗？朱塞佩：还剩屋顶施工。玛丽亚：那你们还得把屋顶做好。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Lesti bix-xogħol tad-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Lesti bix-xogħol tad-dar?
messages.zh: 房子的工程做完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the work on the house?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal it-tisqif.
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal it-tisqif.
messages.zh: 还剩屋顶施工。
messages.en: The roofing still remains.

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għad tridu tagħmlu s-saqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Mela għad tridu tagħmlu s-saqaf.
messages.zh: 那你们还得把屋顶做好。
messages.en: So you still need to put the roof on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给房子盖上一顶大帽子：建筑语境记“铺屋顶”，一般语境记“覆盖”，用同一个覆盖画面串联两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplying of water to land or plants through irrigation or watering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向土地或植物供水的过程，包括农田灌溉和日常浇水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti tal-ilma lill-art jew lill-pjanti, kemm fl-għelieqi kif ukoll fil-ġonna u fil-qsari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌溉；向农田等土地供水。
浇水；给植物等补充水分。

formal.mt: Is-sistema ta' tisqija tqassam l-ilma bejn l-għelieqi skont il-ħtiġijiet tal-pjanti.
formal.en: The irrigation system distributes water among the fields according to the plants' needs.
formal.zh: 灌溉系统根据植物的需求向各块农田分配水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tisqija tal-pjanti waqt li nkun barra? Samwel: Jien. Għidli biss kemm-il darba nsaqqihom.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who will take care of watering the plants while I'm away? Samwel: I will. Just tell me how often to water them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我不在的时候，谁来负责给植物浇水？萨姆韦尔：我来。你只要告诉我多久浇一次。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tisqija tal-pjanti waqt li nkun barra?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tisqija tal-pjanti waqt li nkun barra?
messages.zh: 我不在的时候，谁来负责给植物浇水？
messages.en: Who will take care of watering the plants while I'm away?

messages.speaker: Samwel (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Għidli biss kemm-il darba nsaqqihom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Għidli biss kemm-il darba nsaqqihom.
messages.zh: 我来。你只要告诉我多久浇一次。
messages.en: I will. Just tell me how often to water them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一壶水浇花与一条水渠灌田并排想象：规模不同，核心都是供水，这两种场景都可帮助记住 tisqija。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of remaining nearly stationary in the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在空中保持位置基本不变的动作，即悬停。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tibqa' kważi fl-istess post fl-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在空中悬停；停留在空中而位置基本不变。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ġie rreġistrat it-tisqir tal-għasfur fuq l-għalqa.
formal.en: During the observation, the bird's hovering above the field was recorded.
formal.zh: 观察期间，记录了那只鸟在田地上方悬停的情况。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Ara dak l-għasfur! Qisu baqa' fl-istess post fl-arja. David: Iva, dak hu tisqir. Elena: Issa qed jimxi 'l quddiem.
colloquial.en: Elena: Look at that bird! It seems to be staying in the same place in the air. David: Yes, that's hovering. Elena: Now it's moving forward.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：看那只鸟！它好像停在空中的同一个位置。戴维：对，那就是悬停。埃莱娜：现在它向前飞了。

messages.speaker: Elena (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur! Qisu baqa' fl-istess post fl-arja.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur! Qisu baqa' fl-istess post fl-arja.
messages.zh: 看那只鸟！它好像停在空中的同一个位置。
messages.en: Look at that bird! It seems to be staying in the same place in the air.

messages.speaker: David (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak hu tisqir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak hu tisqir.
messages.zh: 对，那就是悬停。
messages.en: Yes, that's hovering.

messages.speaker: Elena (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa qed jimxi 'l quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Issa qed jimxi 'l quddiem.
messages.zh: 现在它向前飞了。
messages.en: Now it's moving forward.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给空中的鸟按下位置暂停键：翅膀仍可活动，位置却基本不变；用这个悬停画面记住 tisqir。

gloss_zh: 暴露于潮湿或湿热环境

teaching_sense.en_definition: Exposure to damp conditions or to heat combined with humidity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于潮湿环境，或暴露在又热又湿的环境之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-espożizzjoni għall-umdità jew għal sħana flimkien ma' umdità.

sense_translations.en_definition: exposure to dampness or humid heat
sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴露于潮湿或湿热环境；受潮湿或湿热环境影响。

collocations.en: prolonged exposure to dampness or humid heat
collocations.zh: 长时间暴露于潮湿或湿热环境

collocations.en: exposure to dampness in a humid environment

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tisrid tal-ħaddiema waqt ix-xogħol f'ambjent sħun u umdu.
formal.en: The report describes the workers' exposure to humid heat while working in a hot, damp environment.
formal.zh: 报告描述了工人在炎热潮湿的环境中工作时所经历的湿热暴露。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ħriġt mill-kamra? Mark: Minħabba t-tisrid; hemm sħana u umdità kbira ġewwa. Anna: Ejja noqogħdu hawn barra ftit.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you leave the room? Mark: Because of the exposure to humid heat; it's hot and very humid inside. Anna: Let's stay out here for a while.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么从房间里出来了？马克：因为一直受湿热影响；里面又热又潮。安娜：我们在外面待一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħriġt mill-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħriġt mill-kamra?
messages.zh: 你为什么从房间里出来了？
messages.en: Why did you leave the room?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tisrid; hemm sħana u umdità kbira ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tisrid; hemm sħana u umdità kbira ġewwa.
messages.zh: 因为一直受湿热影响；里面又热又潮。
messages.en: Because of the exposure to humid heat; it's hot and very humid inside.

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu hawn barra ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu hawn barra ftit.
messages.zh: 我们在外面待一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's stay out here for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人一直待在潮湿房间，或又闷又热的空间里；记住 tisrid 着重于置身这种环境的经历。

gloss_zh: 兑换；把纸币换成小面额

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exchange, especially changing banknotes into money of smaller denominations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 兑换或交换，尤其指将纸币换成较小面额的钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bdil, speċjalment meta karti tal-flus jinbidlu fi flus ta' valur iżgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交换；兑换。

sense_translations.en_definition: exchange of notes into smaller denominations
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把纸币兑换成较小面额的钱；换零。

collocations.en: changing a banknote into smaller denominations
collocations.zh: 把一张纸币换成小面额

formal.mt: Il-klijent talab it-tisrif ta' karta ta' ħamsin ewro f'karti ta' għaxar ewro.
formal.en: The customer requested that a fifty-euro note be changed into ten-euro notes.
formal.zh: 顾客要求把一张五十欧元纸币换成十欧元纸币。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Tista' ssarrifli din il-karta ta' għoxrin ewro? Sara: Iva, għat-tisrif għandi żewġ karti ta' għaxra. Luca: Tajjeb, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Luca: Can you change this twenty-euro note for me? Sara: Yes, I have two ten-euro notes for the exchange. Luca: Great, thank you.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：你能帮我把这张二十欧元换开吗？萨拉：可以，我有两张十欧元可以换给你。卢卡：好，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Luca (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' ssarrifli din il-karta ta' għoxrin ewro?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' ssarrifli din il-karta ta' għoxrin ewro?
messages.zh: 你能帮我把这张二十欧元换开吗？
messages.en: Can you change this twenty-euro note for me?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għat-tisrif għandi żewġ karti ta' għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għat-tisrif għandi żewġ karti ta' għaxra.
messages.zh: 可以，我有两张十欧元可以换给你。
messages.en: Yes, I have two ten-euro notes for the exchange.

messages.speaker: Luca (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, grazzi.
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。
messages.en: Great, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张二十欧元纸币换成两张十欧元纸币：总金额不变、面额变小，用换零动作记住 tisrif 的具体义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of winding something around an object or twining things together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物绕在物体上，或使物体相互缠绕的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa titkebbeb madwar oġġett jew li affarijiet jitħabblu ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷绕；把线等绕在某物上的动作
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tkebbib ta' xi ħaġa madwar oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠绕；物体相互盘绕或攀绕的过程
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tħabbil jew it-tkebbib ta' affarijiet ma' xulxin.

collocations.en: the winding of thread around the spool
the twining of stems around one another

formal.mt: Waqt it-tisrik tal-ħajt madwar ir-rukkell, żomm il-ħajt miġbud b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: While winding the thread around the spool, keep an even tension on the thread.
formal.zh: 把线绕在线轴上时，应保持线的张力均匀。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tgħinni bit-tisrik ta' dan il-ħajt? Pawlu: Iva, inti żomm ir-rukkell u jien indawwar il-ħajt miegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you help me wind this thread? Pawlu: Yes, you hold the spool and I'll wind the thread around it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能帮我绕这根线吗？保罗：可以，你拿着线轴，我把线绕上去。

messages.speaker: Sara (手工课学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinni bit-tisrik ta' dan il-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinni bit-tisrik ta' dan il-ħajt?
messages.zh: 你能帮我绕这根线吗？
messages.en: Can you help me wind this thread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inti żomm ir-rukkell u jien indawwar il-ħajt miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inti żomm ir-rukkell u jien indawwar il-ħajt miegħu.
messages.zh: 可以，你拿着线轴，我把线绕上去。
messages.en: Yes, you hold the spool and I'll wind the thread around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tisrik 时想象两个动作：线绕上线轴是卷绕，两根茎彼此盘绕是缠绕。

gloss_zh: 混乱；麻烦；给动物戴嘴套

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of confusion or trouble; also, the act of putting a muzzle on an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 混乱或麻烦的状态；也可指给动物戴上嘴套的行为，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' taħwid jew inkwiet; ukoll l-att li titqiegħed sarima fuq annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混乱；事情或思路不清楚的状态
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' taħwid jew nuqqas ta' ċarezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麻烦；困扰；使人费心的困难
sense_translations.mt_definition: Inkwiet jew diffikultà li toħloq problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给动物戴上嘴套的行为
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li titqiegħed sarima fuq annimal.

formal.mt: Struzzjonijiet ċari jgħinu biex jiġi evitat tisrim bla bżonn waqt l-organizzazzjoni tal-avveniment.
formal.en: Clear instructions help prevent unnecessary trouble when organising the event.
formal.zh: 清楚的指示有助于避免活动组织过程中不必要的麻烦。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan it-tisrim kollu bil-biljetti? Mark: Żewġ persuni għandhom l-istess numru; ejja niċċekkjaw il-lista.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's all this confusion with the tickets? Mark: Two people have the same number; let's check the list.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些票怎么弄得这么混乱？马克：有两个人拿到了同一个号码，我们查一下名单吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tisrim kollu bil-biljetti?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tisrim kollu bil-biljetti?
messages.zh: 这些票怎么弄得这么混乱？
messages.en: What's all this confusion with the tickets?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ persuni għandhom l-istess numru; ejja niċċekkjaw il-lista.
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ persuni għandhom l-istess numru; ejja niċċekkjaw il-lista.
messages.zh: 有两个人拿到了同一个号码，我们查一下名单吧。
messages.en: Two people have the same number; let's check the list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tisrim 分设两张情境卡：票务出错对应混乱和麻烦，动物戴嘴套对应另一个具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The winding or meandering of a course, with repeated bends rather than a straight direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 路线或水流等不断转弯、曲折延伸的形态或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mixja jew il-medda ta' xi ħaġa li ssegwi ħafna liwjiet minflok linja dritta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜿蜒；路线等弯曲延伸的形态
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-medda ta' xi ħaġa f'sensiela ta' liwjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迂回蜿蜒；水流或路线曲折前行的过程
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mixja li ddur minn naħa għal oħra b'ħafna liwjiet.

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi t-tisrip tax-xmara tul il-wied.
formal.en: The map shows the meandering of the river along the valley.
formal.zh: 地图展示了河流沿山谷蜿蜒延伸的走向。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħares lejn it-tisrip ta' dik il-mogħdija! Adam: Iva, iddur ħafna qabel tasal sal-bajja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at how that path winds! Adam: Yes, it makes lots of turns before reaching the bay.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，那条小径多曲折啊！亚当：是啊，要拐好多弯才到海湾。

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn it-tisrip ta' dik il-mogħdija!
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn it-tisrip ta' dik il-mogħdija!
messages.zh: 看，那条小径多曲折啊！
messages.en: Look at how that path winds!

messages.speaker: Adam (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iddur ħafna qabel tasal sal-bajja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iddur ħafna qabel tasal sal-bajja.
messages.zh: 是啊，要拐好多弯才到海湾。
messages.en: Yes, it makes lots of turns before reaching the bay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisrip 想成地图上一条反复转弯的河流，用弯曲路线的画面记住蜿蜒这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of gathering things together and tying or wrapping them into a bundle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品集中起来，用绳子捆住或包成一包的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li affarijiet jinġabru flimkien u jintrabtu jew jitgeżwru f'gozz jew f'sorra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捆扎；把物品扎成一束或包成一包
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġbir u l-irbit ta' affarijiet f'gozz jew f'sorra.

formal.mt: It-tisrir tal-friegħi fi gzuz żgħar jagħmilhom aktar faċli biex jinġarru.
formal.en: Bundling the branches into small bundles makes them easier to carry.
formal.zh: 把树枝捆成小束会使它们更便于搬运。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għad fadlilna t-tisrir ta' dawn il-ħwejjeġ. Ben: Ġib biċċa drapp kbira, u nagħmluhom sorra waħda.
colloquial.en: Rita: We still need to bundle up these clothes. Ben: Bring a large piece of cloth, and we'll make them into one bundle.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们还得把这些衣服打成包。本：拿一大块布来，我们把它们包成一包。

messages.speaker: Rita (搬家的室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadlilna t-tisrir ta' dawn il-ħwejjeġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadlilna t-tisrir ta' dawn il-ħwejjeġ.
messages.zh: 我们还得把这些衣服打成包。
messages.en: We still need to bundle up these clothes.

messages.speaker: Ben (帮忙的室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġib biċċa drapp kbira, u nagħmluhom sorra waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Ġib biċċa drapp kbira, u nagħmluhom sorra waħda.
messages.zh: 拿一大块布来，我们把它们包成一包。
messages.en: Bring a large piece of cloth, and we'll make them into one bundle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tisrir 就想象散开的衣物被大布包拢并扎紧，从零散物品变成一包就是捆扎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shining or dazzling; in another sense, the interwoven structure or texture of a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指发亮或耀眼的现象；另一个义项指材料交织形成的组织结构或纹理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dija jew id-dija li tgħammex; f'sens ieħor, l-istruttura jew in-nisġa ta' materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发光；发亮，指呈现光亮的现象。
使眼花；耀眼，指光亮令人目眩的现象。
组织构造；各部分交织形成的结构或纹理。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-drapp, it-tisriġ ġie deskritt skont il-mod kif il-ħjut kienu minsuġa flimkien.
formal.en: In the analysis of the fabric, its contexture was described according to how the threads were woven together.
formal.zh: 分析布料时，根据纱线相互交织的方式描述了它的组织结构。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħatti għajnejk? Daniel: It-tisriġ ta' dik il-lampa qed jgħammixni. Maja: Mela ndawwarha ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you covering your eyes? Daniel: The shining of that lamp is dazzling me. Maja: Then I'll turn it a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么遮着眼睛？丹尼尔：那盏灯的光晃得我眼花。玛雅：那我把它转一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħatti għajnejk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħatti għajnejk?
messages.zh: 你为什么遮着眼睛？
messages.en: Why are you covering your eyes?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tisriġ ta' dik il-lampa qed jgħammixni.
messages.mt_standard: It-tisriġ ta' dik il-lampa qed jgħammixni.
messages.zh: 那盏灯的光晃得我眼花。
messages.en: The shining of that lamp is dazzling me.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ndawwarha ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ndawwarha ftit.
messages.zh: 那我把它转一点。
messages.en: Then I'll turn it a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两组画面记忆：灯光从发亮到耀眼是一组，纱线交织成纹理是另一组；遇到 tisriġ 时用光线或材料语境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or period of resting, especially after effort or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 休息或休养的行为或时段，尤指劳累或活动之后的休息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-perjodu ta' mistrieħ, speċjalment wara sforz jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 休息；休养
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jistrieħ.

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi perjodu ta' tisriħ wara kull attività fiżika.
formal.en: The programme includes a period of rest after each physical activity.
formal.zh: 该计划在每项体力活动之后都安排了一段休息时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Wara din il-mixja, għandi bżonn ftit tisriħ. Mark: Ejja noqogħdu fuq dak il-bank għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: After this walk, I need a little rest. Mark: Let's sit on that bench for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：走完这一程，我需要休息一下。马克：我们在那张长椅上坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara din il-mixja, għandi bżonn ftit tisriħ.
messages.mt_standard: Wara din il-mixja, għandi bżonn ftit tisriħ.
messages.zh: 走完这一程，我需要休息一下。
messages.en: After this walk, I need a little rest.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu fuq dak il-bank għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu fuq dak il-bank għal ftit.
messages.zh: 我们在那张长椅上坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's sit on that bench for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisriħ 配上走累后坐在长椅上的画面，记住它表示休息这一行为或时段。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question used to ask one person whether they can help the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向一个人询问能否帮助自己的问句，可用于请求协助。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mistoqsija lil persuna waħda biex tara jekk tistax tagħti għajnuna lil min qed jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你能帮我吗？
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mistoqsija biex titlob l-għajnuna ta' persuna waħda.

collocations.en: Can you help me fill in this form?
collocations.zh: 你能帮我填写这张表格吗？

formal.mt: Għażiża Marija, tista' tgħinni niċċekkja d-dettalji tar-rapport qabel nibagħtu?
formal.en: Dear Marija, can you help me check the details of the report before I send it?
formal.zh: 亲爱的玛丽亚，你能帮我在发送报告之前核对一下其中的细节吗？

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tgħinni nġorr din il-kaxxa? Mark: Żgur! Aqbad minn dik in-naħa u jien naqbad minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you help me carry this box? Mark: Sure! Hold it on that side and I'll hold it here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？马克：当然！你抓住那一边，我抓住这边。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinni nġorr din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinni nġorr din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？
messages.en: Can you help me carry this box?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur! Aqbad minn dik in-naħa u jien naqbad minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur! Aqbad minn dik in-naħa u jien naqbad minn hawn.
messages.zh: 当然！你抓住那一边，我抓住这边。
messages.en: Sure! Hold it on that side and I'll hold it here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tista' tgħinni 整句配上搬箱子时向朋友求助的画面，先熟记为你能帮我吗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming larger in size or volume.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸或体积变大的过程；膨胀或扩张。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tikber fid-daqs jew fil-volum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 膨胀；扩张；尺寸或体积的增大
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żieda fid-daqs jew fil-volum ta' xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, l-istudenti kejlu t-tistiħ tal-metall meta żdiedet it-temperatura.
formal.en: In the experiment, the students measured the expansion of the metal as the temperature increased.
formal.zh: 实验中，学生们测量了金属在温度升高时的膨胀。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex inħallu spazju bejn dawn il-biċċiet tal-metall? Pawlu: Biex ikun hemm lok għat-tistiħ tagħhom meta jisħnu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do we leave a gap between these pieces of metal? Pawlu: To allow room for their expansion when they get hot.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么这些金属件之间要留缝隙？保罗：为了给它们受热膨胀留出空间。

messages.speaker: Nina (工艺课学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex inħallu spazju bejn dawn il-biċċiet tal-metall?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex inħallu spazju bejn dawn il-biċċiet tal-metall?
messages.zh: 为什么这些金属件之间要留缝隙？
messages.en: Why do we leave a gap between these pieces of metal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工艺课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ikun hemm lok għat-tistiħ tagħhom meta jisħnu.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ikun hemm lok għat-tistiħ tagħhom meta jisħnu.
messages.zh: 为了给它们受热膨胀留出空间。
messages.en: To allow room for their expansion when they get hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tistiħ 时画两个大小不同的金属棒轮廓，并加上向外箭头，用体积变大的画面记膨胀。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making a liquid flow out of a container, often into another container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使液体从容器中流出的行为，常指将液体倒入另一个容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li likwidu jitħalla joħroġ minn reċipjent, spiss għal ġo reċipjent ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾倒；倒出或倒入液体的动作
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li jitferra' likwidu.

formal.mt: Waqt it-tiswib tal-ilma fil-flixkun, uża lembut biex tevita t-tixrid.
formal.en: When pouring water into the bottle, use a funnel to avoid spills.
formal.zh: 往瓶中倒水时，应使用漏斗以免洒出。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tista' żżommli l-lembut waqt it-tiswib tal-meraq? Ben: Iva, se nżommu sew; ferra' bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you hold the funnel for me while I pour the juice? Ben: Yes, I'll hold it steady; pour slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我倒果汁的时候，你能帮我扶住漏斗吗？本：可以，我会扶稳，你慢慢倒。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' żżommli l-lembut waqt it-tiswib tal-meraq?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' żżommli l-lembut waqt it-tiswib tal-meraq?
messages.zh: 我倒果汁的时候，你能帮我扶住漏斗吗？
messages.en: Can you hold the funnel for me while I pour the juice?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nżommu sew; ferra' bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nżommu sew; ferra' bil-mod.
messages.zh: 可以，我会扶稳，你慢慢倒。
messages.en: Yes, I'll hold it steady; pour slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiswib 配上一只倾斜的水壶和连续水流，记住它指倒液体这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming black or darker, or of making something black or darker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物变黑、变暗，或使某物变黑、变暗的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir sewda jew aktar skura, jew li bih wieħed jagħmilha hekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变黑或使某物变黑的过程。
颜色或明暗程度变深、变暗的过程，不一定完全变黑。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tiswid tal-ħitan ikkawżat mid-duħħan tax-xemgħat.
formal.en: The report describes the blackening of the walls caused by candle smoke.
formal.zh: 报告描述了蜡烛烟雾造成的墙壁熏黑现象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara dan it-tiswid fuq il-ħajt? Mark: Iva, jidher li ġej mid-duħħan tax-xemgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you see this blackening on the wall? Mark: Yes, it seems to come from the candle smoke.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到墙上这片发黑的地方了吗？马克：看到了，好像是蜡烛的烟熏出来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dan it-tiswid fuq il-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dan it-tiswid fuq il-ħajt?
messages.zh: 你看到墙上这片发黑的地方了吗？
messages.en: Do you see this blackening on the wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher li ġej mid-duħħan tax-xemgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher li ġej mid-duħħan tax-xemgħa.
messages.zh: 看到了，好像是蜡烛的烟熏出来的。
messages.en: Yes, it seems to come from the candle smoke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiswid 和白墙被烟逐渐熏黑的画面联系起来：重点是颜色变黑或变暗的过程，而不是黑色本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming woolly or hairy as wool or hair grows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随着羊毛或毛发生长而变得毛茸茸、多毛的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih annimal jew parti tal-ġisem jinkesa bis-suf jew bix-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐长出羊毛或绒毛，变得毛茸茸的过程。
逐渐长出毛发或变得多毛的过程。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tiswif tal-ħrief u qabblu r-ritratti tagħhom minn ġimgħa għal oħra.
formal.en: The students observed the lambs becoming woolly and compared their photographs from one week to the next.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了小羊逐渐长出羊毛的过程，并逐周比较它们的照片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara t-tiswif ta' dan il-ħaruf? Pawlu: Iva, issa għandu ħafna aktar suf milli kellu fir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see how this lamb is becoming woolly? Pawlu: Yes, it has much more wool now than it had in the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看出这只小羊正在变得毛茸茸了吗？保罗：看出来了，它现在的羊毛比照片里多多了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara t-tiswif ta' dan il-ħaruf?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara t-tiswif ta' dan il-ħaruf?
messages.zh: 你看出这只小羊正在变得毛茸茸了吗？
messages.en: Can you see how this lamb is becoming woolly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandu ħafna aktar suf milli kellu fir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandu ħafna aktar suf milli kellu fir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 看出来了，它现在的羊毛比照片里多多了。
messages.en: Yes, it has much more wool now than it had in the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张先后拍摄的小羊照片记 tiswif：后一张的毛更蓬松。这个词指长毛、变得多毛的过程，不是剪毛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of repairing something damaged or correcting something that is wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把损坏的东西修好，或把错误之处改正的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tirranġa xi ħaġa bil-ħsara jew tikkoreġi xi ħaġa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修理；修复损坏或不能正常使用的东西。
改正；纠正文字、内容或其他方面的错误。

formal.mt: Il-verżjoni finali tad-dokument tinkludi t-tiswija ta' żball fid-data tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The final version of the document includes the correction of an error in the meeting date.
formal.zh: 文件的最终版本包含了对会议日期错误的更正。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm se tiswa t-tiswija tal-karozza? Rita: Nagħtik il-prezz wara li niċċekkja l-ħsara.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much will the car repair cost? Rita: I'll give you the price after I check the damage.
colloquial.zh: 马克：修车要多少钱？丽塔：我检查损坏情况后再给你报价。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm se tiswa t-tiswija tal-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm se tiswa t-tiswija tal-karozza?
messages.zh: 修车要多少钱？
messages.en: How much will the car repair cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (修车师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħtik il-prezz wara li niċċekkja l-ħsara.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħtik il-prezz wara li niċċekkja l-ħsara.
messages.zh: 我检查损坏情况后再给你报价。
messages.en: I'll give you the price after I check the damage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiswija 想成两种“修好”：车坏了要修理，日期写错了要改正。物品和错误都能成为它的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of going without food for a period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一段时间内不进食的行为或做法，可用于斋戒等语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed jibqa' mingħajr ikel għal perjodu ta' żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁食；在一定时间内不进食，也可指宗教斋戒。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi perjodu ta' tiswim osservat mill-komunità għal raġunijiet reliġjużi.
formal.en: The text describes a period of fasting observed by the community for religious reasons.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述了该群体出于宗教原因遵守的一段斋戒期。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex m'intix tiekol magħna llum? Marija: Qed nagħmel ġurnata ta' tiswim għal raġunijiet reliġjużi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why aren't you eating with us today? Marija: I'm observing a day of fasting for religious reasons.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你今天为什么不和我们一起吃饭？玛丽亚：我出于宗教原因，今天斋戒一天。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex m'intix tiekol magħna llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex m'intix tiekol magħna llum?
messages.zh: 你今天为什么不和我们一起吃饭？
messages.en: Why aren't you eating with us today?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel ġurnata ta' tiswim għal raġunijiet reliġjużi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel ġurnata ta' tiswim għal raġunijiet reliġjużi.
messages.zh: 我出于宗教原因，今天斋戒一天。
messages.en: I'm observing a day of fasting for religious reasons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tiswim 时想象日历上圈出一段暂不进食的时间：它表示禁食或斋戒这项行为，不能只理解成肚子饿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting a mark or marks on something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某物上添加标记或做记号的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel marka jew marki fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标记；在物体或材料上做记号。

formal.mt: It-tiswin tad-drapp għandu jsir qabel il-qtugħ biex il-biċċiet ikunu tad-daqs mixtieq.
formal.en: The fabric should be marked before cutting so that the pieces are the desired size.
formal.zh: 应在裁剪前给布料做标记，以确保各块布料达到所需尺寸。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lest it-tiswin tad-drapp? Nina: Kważi; għadni rrid nagħmel marka waħda bil-ġibs.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the fabric marking finished? Nina: Almost; I still need to make one mark with chalk.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：布料上的标记做好了吗？妮娜：快了，还要用粉笔做一个记号。

messages.speaker: Sara (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Lest it-tiswin tad-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Lest it-tiswin tad-drapp?
messages.zh: 布料上的标记做好了吗？
messages.en: Is the fabric marking finished?

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għadni rrid nagħmel marka waħda bil-ġibs.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għadni rrid nagħmel marka waħda bil-ġibs.
messages.zh: 快了，还要用粉笔做一个记号。
messages.en: Almost; I still need to make one mark with chalk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiswin 与裁布前用粉笔画记号的动作绑定：先标记，再裁剪。这里记的是做标记的行为，而不是标记工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of controlling and operating a vehicle as it moves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 操纵车辆并使其行驶的行为，即驾驶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed isuq vettura u jikkontrolla l-moviment tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驾驶这一行为；操纵车辆行驶。

formal.mt: It-tiswiq bil-lejl jeħtieġ attenzjoni għad-dawl, għat-traffiku u għall-kundizzjoni tat-triq.
formal.en: Driving at night requires attention to the lighting, the traffic and the condition of the road.
formal.zh: 夜间驾驶需要留意照明、交通和道路状况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif sibt it-tiswiq bil-lejl? Lara: Għall-ewwel kont nervuża, imma ħadt kollox bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did you find driving at night? Lara: At first I was nervous, but I took everything calmly.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得夜间开车怎么样？拉拉：起初我有点紧张，不过一直沉着应对。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sibt it-tiswiq bil-lejl?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sibt it-tiswiq bil-lejl?
messages.zh: 你觉得夜间开车怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find driving at night?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ewwel kont nervuża, imma ħadt kollox bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ewwel kont nervuża, imma ħadt kollox bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 起初我有点紧张，不过一直沉着应对。
messages.en: At first I was nervous, but I took everything calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tiswiq 时想象双手控制方向盘、车辆向前行驶：这个名词指驾驶的行为，不是汽车本身，也不是坐车。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of giving something a form or bringing something into being.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物获得形态、逐渐形成，或将某物创造出来的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li tagħti forma lil xi ħaġa jew li toħloq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形成；使事物获得形态或逐渐成形的过程。
创造；把某种事物构思并制作出来的过程。

formal.mt: L-edukazzjoni għandha rwol importanti fit-tiswir tal-karattru u fl-iżvilupp tar-responsabbiltà.
formal.en: Education plays an important role in the formation of character and the development of responsibility.
formal.zh: 教育在性格塑造和责任感培养方面发挥着重要作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm ilek taħdem fuq it-tiswir ta' din l-iskultura? Pawlu: Ġimagħtejn, u għadni qed nirranġa l-forma.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long have you been working on creating this sculpture? Pawlu: Two weeks, and I'm still adjusting the shape.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你创作这座雕塑有多久了？保罗：两周了，我还在调整它的形状。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm ilek taħdem fuq it-tiswir ta' din l-iskultura?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm ilek taħdem fuq it-tiswir ta' din l-iskultura?
messages.zh: 你创作这座雕塑有多久了？
messages.en: How long have you been working on creating this sculpture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (雕塑创作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġimagħtejn, u għadni qed nirranġa l-forma.
messages.mt_standard: Ġimagħtejn, u għadni qed nirranġa l-forma.
messages.zh: 两周了，我还在调整它的形状。
messages.en: Two weeks, and I'm still adjusting the shape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一团材料逐渐成为雕塑的画面记 tiswir：既能想到形态的形成，也能想到作品的创造，还可联想到性格的塑造。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process in which woodworm eats into wood and makes numerous small holes or tunnels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 木蛀虫蛀食木材，使其中出现许多小孔或蛀道的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih is-susa tiekol l-injam u tagħmel fih ħafna toqob żgħar jew passaġġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木材遭木蛀虫蛀蚀而形成许多小孔或蛀道的过程。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni tal-armarju wriet sinjali ta' tiswis, fosthom toqob żgħar fl-injam.
formal.en: The inspection of the cupboard revealed signs of woodworm damage, including small holes in the wood.
formal.zh: 对柜子的检查发现了虫蛀迹象，包括木材上的小孔。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dawn it-toqob fis-siġġu huma sinjali ta' tiswis? Mark: Jista' jkun; ejja nitolbu lil mastrudaxxa jiċċekkjah.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are these holes in the chair signs of woodworm damage? Mark: They might be; let's ask a carpenter to check it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：椅子上的这些孔是虫蛀的迹象吗？马克：有可能，我们请木匠检查一下吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn it-toqob fis-siġġu huma sinjali ta' tiswis?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn it-toqob fis-siġġu huma sinjali ta' tiswis?
messages.zh: 椅子上的这些孔是虫蛀的迹象吗？
messages.en: Are these holes in the chair signs of woodworm damage?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun; ejja nitolbu lil mastrudaxxa jiċċekkjah.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun; ejja nitolbu lil mastrudaxxa jiċċekkjah.
messages.zh: 有可能，我们请木匠检查一下吧。
messages.en: They might be; let's ask a carpenter to check it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiswis 和旧木椅上密密的小蛀孔联系起来：记住木蛀虫把木材蛀出孔道的过程，并与一般的木材破损区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hitting a person, especially repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打人的行为，尤其指反复击打或殴打。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jolqot lil persuna, speċjalment għal diversi drabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 殴打；反复击打某人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' tiswit u l-għajnuna li rċeviet il-vittma.
formal.en: The report describes a case of beating and the help the victim received.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起殴打事件，以及受害者得到的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil dak ir-raġel? Mark: Kien vittma ta' tiswit, u issa qed jirċievi l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to that man? Mark: He was the victim of a beating, and he is receiving help now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男人怎么了？马克：他遭人殴打，现在正在接受帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 那个男人怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to that man?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien vittma ta' tiswit, u issa qed jirċievi l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Kien vittma ta' tiswit, u issa qed jirċievi l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 他遭人殴打，现在正在接受帮助。
messages.en: He was the victim of a beating, and he is receiving help now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiswit 放进“遭受殴打的人”这一完整情境记忆：vittma ta' tiswit，看到这个搭配就联想打人事件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of the sky becoming covered with clouds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天空逐渐被云覆盖、天气转阴的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih is-sema jimtela bis-sħab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天空被云层遮盖；天气转阴。
报名；登记加入。
入会；取得会员资格。

collocations.en: joining the club as a member

formal.mt: It-tisħib fil-kors għandu jitlesta qabel il-bidu tal-lezzjonijiet.
formal.en: Enrolment in the course must be completed before lessons begin.
formal.zh: 课程报名必须在开课前完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm jiswa t-tisħib fil-klabb? Mark: Għoxrin ewro fis-sena; tista' timla l-formola hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much does membership in the club cost? Mark: Twenty euros a year; you can fill in the form here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：加入这个俱乐部要多少钱？Mark：每年二十欧元；你可以在这里填写表格。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm jiswa t-tisħib fil-klabb?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm jiswa t-tisħib fil-klabb?
messages.zh: 加入这个俱乐部要多少钱？
messages.en: How much does membership in the club cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoxrin ewro fis-sena; tista' timla l-formola hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Għoxrin ewro fis-sena; tista' timla l-formola hawn.
messages.zh: 每年二十欧元；你可以在这里填写表格。
messages.en: Twenty euros a year; you can fill in the form here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tisħib 配两张学习卡：一张画云层遮住天空，一张画报名入会表；依上下文分别提取词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of warming up, especially through exercise before physical activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使身体逐渐热起来的过程，尤其指正式运动前的热身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-ġisem jisħon, speċjalment permezz ta' eżerċizzji qabel attività fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热身；使身体或事物逐渐热起来。
唤起；激起兴奋或欲望的过程，可指性唤起。
兴奋；情绪激动。

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' taħriġ jibda b'għaxar minuti ta' tisħin qabel l-eżerċizzji ewlenin.
formal.en: The training programme begins with ten minutes of warming up before the main exercises.
formal.zh: 训练计划先安排十分钟热身，再进行主要练习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nibdew niġru issa? David: L-ewwel nagħmlu ftit tisħin, imbagħad nibdew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we start running now? David: Let's do a little warm-up first, then we'll start.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们现在开始跑步吗？David：先稍微热热身，然后再开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (跑步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew niġru issa?
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew niġru issa?
messages.zh: 我们现在开始跑步吗？
messages.en: Shall we start running now?

messages.speaker: David (跑步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel nagħmlu ftit tisħin, imbagħad nibdew.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel nagħmlu ftit tisħin, imbagħad nibdew.
messages.zh: 先稍微热热身，然后再开始。
messages.en: Let's do a little warm-up first, then we'll start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 以身体热起来记 tisħin：运动前是热身，涉及情绪或欲望时则联系兴奋与唤起；靠语境判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of pounding or crushing something into smaller pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过反复捣击或施压，使东西变成较小碎块的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ikisser xi ħaġa f'biċċiet iżgħar billi jsawwatha jew jagħfas fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复捣击；用力捶打。
压碎；碾碎；捣碎。

formal.mt: It-tisħiq tal-ħwawar fil-mehrież jgħin biex joħorġu l-aromi tagħhom.
formal.en: Pounding the spices in a mortar helps release their aromas.
formal.zh: 在研钵中捣碎香料，有助于释放它们的香气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tewm inqattgħu jew nisħquh? Mark: Għal din iz-zalza, it-tisħiq fil-mehrież aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we chop the garlic or crush it? Mark: For this sauce, crushing it in a mortar is better.
colloquial.zh: Maja：大蒜要切碎还是捣碎？Mark：做这款酱汁，用研钵捣碎更好。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tewm inqattgħu jew nisħquh?
messages.mt_standard: It-tewm inqattgħu jew nisħquh?
messages.zh: 大蒜要切碎还是捣碎？
messages.en: Shall we chop the garlic or crush it?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal din iz-zalza, it-tisħiq fil-mehrież aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Għal din iz-zalza, it-tisħiq fil-mehrież aħjar.
messages.zh: 做这款酱汁，用研钵捣碎更好。
messages.en: For this sauce, crushing it in a mortar is better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tisħiq 时想象研钵里的蒜瓣：一下下捣击是动作，最终压成碎末是结果，两义可以一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The casting of spells or the use of magic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 施放咒语或使用魔法的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitfa' s-seħer jew juża l-maġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 施咒；施放魔法咒语的行为。
魔法；巫术。

formal.mt: F'din il-ħrafa, it-tisħir tas-saħħara jibdel lill-prinċep f'għasfur.
formal.en: In this fairy tale, the witch's spellcasting turns the prince into a bird.
formal.zh: 在这则童话中，女巫施法把王子变成了一只鸟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inbidel il-prinċep f'għasfur? Toni: Bit-tisħir tas-saħħara; hekk tgħid il-ħrafa.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the prince turn into a bird? Toni: Through the witch's magic; that's what the fairy tale says.
colloquial.zh: Lara：王子怎么变成鸟了？Toni：是女巫施了魔法；童话里是这么说的。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inbidel il-prinċep f'għasfur?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inbidel il-prinċep f'għasfur?
messages.zh: 王子怎么变成鸟了？
messages.en: How did the prince turn into a bird?

messages.speaker: Toni (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-tisħir tas-saħħara; hekk tgħid il-ħrafa.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-tisħir tas-saħħara; hekk tgħid il-ħrafa.
messages.zh: 是女巫施了魔法；童话里是这么说的。
messages.en: Through the witch's magic; that's what the fairy tale says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisħir 放进女巫施咒的童话画面；特别看清 ħ，和表示守夜的 tishir 分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wishing harm or bad luck on someone, especially through spoken words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用言语希望别人遭受不幸、厄运或伤害的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li bih wieħed jixtieq li jiġri d-deni lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to wish for bad luck for sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 诅咒他人；希望某人倒霉。

formal.mt: L-ittra kien fiha kliem ta' tisħit kontra l-ġar, u dan kompla jħarrax il-kunflitt.
formal.en: The letter contained words wishing harm on the neighbour, which further intensified the conflict.
formal.zh: 信中有诅咒邻居的话，这进一步激化了冲突。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt it-tisħit li qal dwar il-ġar? Pawlu: Iva, imma aħjar nitkellmu bil-kalma milli nawguraw id-deni lil ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear him wishing harm on the neighbour? Pawlu: Yes, but we should speak calmly instead of wishing harm on others.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见他诅咒邻居了吗？保罗：听见了，但我们还是心平气和地说话吧，别盼着别人遭殃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt it-tisħit li qal dwar il-ġar?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt it-tisħit li qal dwar il-ġar?
messages.zh: 你听见他诅咒邻居了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear him wishing harm on the neighbour?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma aħjar nitkellmu bil-kalma milli nawguraw id-deni lil ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma aħjar nitkellmu bil-kalma milli nawguraw id-deni lil ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 听见了，但我们还是心平气和地说话吧，别盼着别人遭殃。
messages.en: Yes, but we should speak calmly instead of wishing harm on others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisħit 放进“盼别人倒霉”的场景来记：重点是诅咒别人遭殃，不只是表达生气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something stronger or more effective.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物更加坚固、有力或有效的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar b'saħħitha jew aktar effettiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加强；增强；使更加稳固或有力。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim għandu l-għan li jwassal għat-tisħiħ tal-kooperazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ skejjel.
formal.en: The agreement aims to strengthen cooperation between the two schools.
formal.zh: 这项协议旨在加强两所学校之间的合作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tagħmel dawn l-eżerċizzji? Toni: Għat-tisħiħ tal-muskoli ta' saqajja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you do these exercises? Toni: To strengthen the muscles in my legs.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么做这些练习？Toni：为了增强腿部肌肉的力量。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tagħmel dawn l-eżerċizzji?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tagħmel dawn l-eżerċizzji?
messages.zh: 你为什么做这些练习？
messages.en: Why do you do these exercises?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tisħiħ tal-muskoli ta' saqajja.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tisħiħ tal-muskoli ta' saqajja.
messages.zh: 为了增强腿部肌肉的力量。
messages.en: To strengthen the muscles in my legs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tisħiħ 和变得更强联系起来：肌肉练得更有力，合作变得更牢固；两个场景共享加强这一核心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element titanium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钛的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala titanju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钛，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispeċifika li l-qafas għandu jkun magħmul minn liga tat-titanju.
formal.en: The document specifies that the frame must be made of a titanium alloy.
formal.zh: 文件规定，该框架必须由钛合金制成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn xiex hu magħmul dan iċ-ċirku? Pawlu: Mit-titanju; hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this ring made of? Pawlu: Titanium; that is what the label says.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这枚戒指是什么材料做的？保罗：钛，标签上是这样写的。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn xiex hu magħmul dan iċ-ċirku?
messages.mt_standard: Minn xiex hu magħmul dan iċ-ċirku?
messages.zh: 这枚戒指是什么材料做的？
messages.en: What is this ring made of?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mit-titanju; hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Mit-titanju; hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 钛，标签上是这样写的。
messages.en: Titanium; that is what the label says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 titanju 与英语 titanium 和中文“钛”并排做成三语卡片，再用“钛戒指”的具体画面巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 频繁接受医疗；反复治疗

teaching_sense.en_definition: Medical treatment received frequently or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频繁或反复接受医疗处理、诊治的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kura medika li persuna tirċievi ta' spiss jew għal diversi drabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁接受医疗；经常或反复进行的治疗。

collocations.en: the need for frequent medical treatment
the costs of frequent medical treatment

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-ħtieġa ta' titbib u l-ispejjeż marbuta ma' din il-kura.
formal.en: The report explains the need for frequent medical treatment and the costs associated with this care.
formal.zh: 报告说明了频繁接受治疗的需要，以及这类医疗照护的相关费用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tmur il-klinika daqshekk ta' spiss? Ġużi: Għandi bżonn ħafna titbib bħalissa, u qed insegwi l-parir tat-tabib.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you going to the clinic so often? Ġużi: I need a lot of medical treatment at the moment, and I am following the doctor's advice.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么这么频繁地去诊所？朱齐：我最近需要经常接受治疗，正在遵照医生的建议。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tmur il-klinika daqshekk ta' spiss?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tmur il-klinika daqshekk ta' spiss?
messages.zh: 你为什么这么频繁地去诊所？
messages.en: Why are you going to the clinic so often?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn ħafna titbib bħalissa, u qed insegwi l-parir tat-tabib.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn ħafna titbib bħalissa, u qed insegwi l-parir tat-tabib.
messages.zh: 我最近需要经常接受治疗，正在遵照医生的建议。
messages.en: I need a lot of medical treatment at the moment, and I am following the doctor's advice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上连续标着多次就诊：titbib 的记忆重点是“经常、反复治疗”，不要只记成一次看病。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something stained or covering it with stains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物品沾上污渍，或使其表面布满污渍的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titħammeġ bit-tbajja' jew tinkesa bihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沾污；使物品留下污渍的过程。
使表面布满污渍；以污斑覆盖。

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività ntużaw għata protettivi biex jiġi evitat it-titbigħ tad-drapp.
formal.en: Protective covers were used during the activity to prevent staining of the fabric.
formal.zh: 活动期间使用了防护罩，以防布料沾上污渍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ngħattu l-mejda qabel nibdew inpinġu? Ben: Iva, biex nevitaw it-titbigħ tat-tvalja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we cover the table before we start painting? Ben: Yes, to avoid staining the tablecloth.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：开始画画前，我们把桌子盖起来好吗？本：好，免得把桌布弄上污渍。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħattu l-mejda qabel nibdew inpinġu?
messages.mt_standard: Ngħattu l-mejda qabel nibdew inpinġu?
messages.zh: 开始画画前，我们把桌子盖起来好吗？
messages.en: Shall we cover the table before we start painting?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biex nevitaw it-titbigħ tat-tvalja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biex nevitaw it-titbigħ tat-tvalja.
messages.zh: 好，免得把桌布弄上污渍。
messages.en: Yes, to avoid staining the tablecloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象白桌布先沾上一点酒渍，再出现许多污斑；用这个连续画面记住 titbigħ 的“沾污”和“布满污渍”两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The production of straw or grain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 秸秆或谷物的生产，具体所指由上下文确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-produzzjoni tat-tiben jew tal-qamħ, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秸秆的生产。
谷物的生产。

collocations.en: the costs of straw or grain production
collocations.zh: 秸秆或谷物生产的成本

collocations.en: an increase in straw or grain production
collocations.zh: 秸秆或谷物生产的增加

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rapport, it-terminu titbin jintuża fis-sens ta' produzzjoni tat-tiben.
formal.en: In this report, the term titbin is used in the sense of straw production.
formal.zh: 在本报告中，titbin 一词用于表示秸秆生产。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta tgħid titbin hawn, qed tirreferi għat-tiben jew għall-qamħ? Toni: Għall-qamħ; qed nitkellmu dwar il-produzzjoni tal-qamħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: When you say titbin here, are you referring to straw or grain? Toni: Grain; we are talking about grain production.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你这里说 titbin，指的是秸秆还是谷物？托尼：谷物，我们说的是谷物生产。

messages.speaker: Marija (农业课程学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid titbin hawn, qed tirreferi għat-tiben jew għall-qamħ?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid titbin hawn, qed tirreferi għat-tiben jew għall-qamħ?
messages.zh: 你这里说 titbin，指的是秸秆还是谷物？
messages.en: When you say titbin here, are you referring to straw or grain?

messages.speaker: Toni (农业课程教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-qamħ; qed nitkellmu dwar il-produzzjoni tal-qamħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-qamħ; qed nitkellmu dwar il-produzzjoni tal-qamħ.
messages.zh: 谷物，我们说的是谷物生产。
messages.en: Grain; we are talking about grain production.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 titbin 的学习卡分成“秸秆生产”和“谷物生产”两栏；每次阅读先找上下文，判断当前使用哪一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of dividing something into two parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物分成两部分的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinqasam f'żewġ partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一分为二；划分成两部分。

collocations.en: division of an area into two
collocations.zh: 把一个区域分成两部分
分成大小相等的两部分

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipproponi t-titbiq taż-żona f'żewġ partijiet, waħda għall-qari u l-oħra għal-laqgħat.
formal.en: The plan proposes dividing the area into two parts, one for reading and the other for meetings.
formal.zh: 该方案提议将区域分成两部分，一部分用于阅读，另一部分用于开会。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'taħseb dwar it-titbiq tal-kamra? Adam: Jidhirli tajjeb; nofs għall-istudju u nofs għal-logħob.
colloquial.en: Rita: What do you think about dividing the room into two? Adam: It seems good to me; half for studying and half for playing.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你觉得把房间分成两部分怎么样？亚当：我觉得不错，一半用来学习，一半用来玩。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'taħseb dwar it-titbiq tal-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: X'taħseb dwar it-titbiq tal-kamra?
messages.zh: 你觉得把房间分成两部分怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think about dividing the room into two?

messages.speaker: Adam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidhirli tajjeb; nofs għall-istudju u nofs għal-logħob.
messages.mt_standard: Jidhirli tajjeb; nofs għall-istudju u nofs għal-logħob.
messages.zh: 我觉得不错，一半用来学习，一半用来玩。
messages.en: It seems good to me; half for studying and half for playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个长方形，再用一条线分成两块，并标上 titbiq；核心是“分成两部分”，是否等大要看额外说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An easing of something such as pain, or a feeling that one is about to faint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疼痛等不适的减轻；也可指感觉快要晕倒的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis ta' xi ħaġa bħall-uġigħ, jew sensazzjoni li wieħed se jħossu ħażin u jintilef minn sensih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减轻；缓解，例如疼痛的缓解。
感觉快要晕倒；晕厥感。

formal.mt: Il-pazjenta rrappurtat titfija tal-uġigħ wara t-trattament.
formal.en: The patient reported an easing of the pain after the treatment.
formal.zh: 这位女患者表示，治疗后疼痛有所缓解。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Qed inħoss titfija; nista' noqgħod bilqiegħda? David: Dażgur, hawn siġġu. Nibqa' ħdejk.
colloquial.en: Elena: I feel faint; can I sit down? David: Of course, here is a chair. I will stay beside you.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我感觉快要晕倒了，可以坐下吗？戴维：当然，这里有把椅子。我会陪在你身边。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss titfija; nista' noqgħod bilqiegħda?
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss titfija; nista' noqgħod bilqiegħda?
messages.zh: 我感觉快要晕倒了，可以坐下吗？
messages.en: I feel faint; can I sit down?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dażgur, hawn siġġu. Nibqa' ħdejk.
messages.mt_standard: Dażgur, hawn siġġu. Nibqa' ħdejk.
messages.zh: 当然，这里有把椅子。我会陪在你身边。
messages.en: Of course, here is a chair. I will stay beside you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情境卡分别记忆 titfija：一张写“疼痛减轻”，另一张画“头晕想坐下”；两个义项要分别结合语境识别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having children; becoming a parent through having children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生育子女，即通过生儿育女成为父母。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed ikollu t-tfal u jsir ġenitur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生育子女；生儿育女。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif il-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol jinfluwenzaw id-deċiżjonijiet dwar it-titfil.
formal.en: The study examines how working conditions influence decisions about having children.
formal.zh: 该研究考察工作条件如何影响人们关于生育子女的决定。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tkellimtu dwar it-titfil? Simon: Iva, imma għadna ma ddeċidejniex jekk irridux tfal.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you talked about having children? Simon: Yes, but we have not yet decided whether we want children.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你们谈过生孩子的事了吗？西蒙：谈过，但我们还没决定是否想要孩子。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkellimtu dwar it-titfil?
messages.mt_standard: Tkellimtu dwar it-titfil?
messages.zh: 你们谈过生孩子的事了吗？
messages.en: Have you talked about having children?

messages.speaker: Simon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadna ma ddeċidejniex jekk irridux tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadna ma ddeċidejniex jekk irridux tfal.
messages.zh: 谈过，但我们还没决定是否想要孩子。
messages.en: Yes, but we have not yet decided whether we want children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 titfil 放进“讨论是否生育子女”的生活场景，整组记忆 dwar it-titfil，帮助把这个名词与具体话题连接起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change that makes something better, or the process of improving its quality, condition, or performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物变得更好的变化，或提升其质量、状况、表现的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla li tagħmel xi ħaġa aħjar, jew il-proċess li bih il-kwalità, il-kundizzjoni jew il-prestazzjoni tagħha ssir aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 改善；进步，指质量、状况或表现变得更好。
提升；改善，尤指使生活或整体处境变得更好。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri titjib fil-kwalità tas-servizz wara t-taħriġ tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The report shows an improvement in service quality after the staff training.
formal.zh: 报告显示，员工培训后服务质量有所提升。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara xi titjib fil-Malti tiegħek? Pawlu: Iva, issa nifhem ħafna aktar meta nisma' r-radju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you seeing any improvement in your Maltese? Pawlu: Yes, now I understand much more when I listen to the radio.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得自己的马耳他语有进步吗？保罗：有，现在听广播时我能听懂更多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara xi titjib fil-Malti tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara xi titjib fil-Malti tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你觉得自己的马耳他语有进步吗？
messages.en: Are you seeing any improvement in your Maltese?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nifhem ħafna aktar meta nisma' r-radju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nifhem ħafna aktar meta nisma' r-radju.
messages.zh: 有，现在听广播时我能听懂更多了。
messages.en: Yes, now I understand much more when I listen to the radio.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 titjib 写在学习进度表向上的箭头旁：昨天听懂一点，今天听懂更多，就是进步和改善。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Movement through the air, including travel by aeroplane; also the scattering of droplets of a substance such as blood or paint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在空中飞行，包括乘飞机出行；也指血液、油漆等以液滴形式四处飞溅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment fl-ajru, inkluż l-ivvjaġġar bl-ajruplan; ukoll it-tixrid ta' qtar ta' sustanza bħad-demm jew iż-żebgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飞行；在空中移动的活动或过程。
乘飞机飞行；搭乘飞机的空中旅程。
飞溅；血液、油漆等以液滴形式溅散。

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żebgħa, l-art għandha titgħatta biex tkun protetta mit-titjir taż-żebgħa.
formal.en: Before painting, the floor should be covered to protect it from paint spattering.
formal.zh: 刷漆前应覆盖地板，以免飞溅的油漆弄脏地面。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tħobb it-titjir bl-ajruplan? Mark: Iva, speċjalment meta noqgħod ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you like flying by aeroplane? Mark: Yes, especially when I sit by the window.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你喜欢坐飞机吗？马克：喜欢，尤其是坐在靠窗位置的时候。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħobb it-titjir bl-ajruplan?
messages.mt_standard: Tħobb it-titjir bl-ajruplan?
messages.zh: 你喜欢坐飞机吗？
messages.en: Do you like flying by aeroplane?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta noqgħod ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta noqgħod ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其是坐在靠窗位置的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when I sit by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格画面记 titjir：鸟在飞、人在飞机里、油漆点飞散；分别对应飞行、乘机和飞溅。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ceremony at which two people marry, together with the celebration associated with it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两人缔结婚姻的仪式及与之相关的庆祝活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċerimonja li fiha żewġ persuni jiżżewġu, flimkien maċ-ċelebrazzjoni marbuta magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婚礼；结婚仪式及相关庆祝活动。

formal.mt: L-istedina tgħid li ċ-ċerimonja tat-titjiġ tibda fl-erbgħa ta' waranofsinhar.
formal.en: The invitation states that the wedding ceremony begins at four in the afternoon.
formal.zh: 请柬上写明，结婚仪式于下午四点开始。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Waslitlek l-istedina għat-titjiġ ta' Anna u Mark? Ben: Iva, u se mmur magħkom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you received the invitation to Anna and Mark's wedding? Ben: Yes, and I'll go with you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你收到安娜和马克的婚礼请柬了吗？本：收到了，我会和你们一起去。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslitlek l-istedina għat-titjiġ ta' Anna u Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Waslitlek l-istedina għat-titjiġ ta' Anna u Mark?
messages.zh: 你收到安娜和马克的婚礼请柬了吗？
messages.en: Have you received the invitation to Anna and Mark's wedding?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u se mmur magħkom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u se mmur magħkom.
messages.zh: 收到了，我会和你们一起去。
messages.en: Yes, and I'll go with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 titjiġ 与写着新人姓名的婚礼请柬放在同一张记忆卡上，用邀请参加婚礼的场景记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question used to ask whether the person you are addressing can speak Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问对方是否会说马耳他语的问句。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mistoqsija li tistaqsi lill-persuna li qed tkellem jekk tafx titkellem bil-Malti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你会说马耳他语吗？

collocations.en: Excuse me, do you speak Maltese?
collocations.zh: 打扰一下，你会说马耳他语吗？

collocations.en: Do you speak Maltese or English?
collocations.zh: 你会说马耳他语还是英语？

formal.mt: Fil-kwestjonarju, il-mistoqsija 'Titkellem bil-Malti?' tintuża biex jiġi stabbilit jekk il-parteċipant jistax jagħmel l-intervista b'din il-lingwa.
formal.en: In the questionnaire, the question 'Do you speak Maltese?' is used to establish whether the participant can do the interview in that language.
formal.zh: 问卷使用“你会说马耳他语吗？”这一问题，确定参与者能否用该语言接受访谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Skużi, titkellem bil-Malti? Pawlu: Iva, ftit. Tista' titkellem bil-mod, jekk jogħġbok?
colloquial.en: Maja: Excuse me, do you speak Maltese? Pawlu: Yes, a little. Could you speak slowly, please?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：打扰一下，你会说马耳他语吗？保罗：会一点。请你说慢一点，好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużi, titkellem bil-Malti?
messages.mt_standard: Skużi, titkellem bil-Malti?
messages.zh: 打扰一下，你会说马耳他语吗？
messages.en: Excuse me, do you speak Maltese?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit. Tista' titkellem bil-mod, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit. Tista' titkellem bil-mod, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 会一点。请你说慢一点，好吗？
messages.en: Yes, a little. Could you speak slowly, please?
