cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Titkellem bil-Malti? 整句当作见面时的语言确认问句记住，再配上 Iva, ftit“会一点”一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question used to ask whether the person you are addressing can speak English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问对方是否会说英语的问句。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mistoqsija li tistaqsi lill-persuna li qed tkellem jekk tafx titkellem bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你会说英语吗？

collocations.en: Excuse me, do you speak English?
collocations.zh: 打扰一下，你会说英语吗？

collocations.en: Do you speak English or Maltese?
collocations.zh: 你会说英语还是马耳他语？

formal.mt: Fil-gwida għar-receptionists, il-mistoqsija 'Titkellem bl-Ingliż?' tingħata bħala eżempju ta' kif wieħed jistaqsi jekk mistieden jafx jitkellem b'din il-lingwa.
formal.en: In the guide for receptionists, the question 'Do you speak English?' is given as an example of how to ask whether a guest can speak that language.
formal.zh: 接待员指南以“你会说英语吗？”为例，说明如何询问客人是否会说该语言。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Skużi, titkellem bl-Ingliż? Ben: Iva. Kif nista' ngħinek?
colloquial.en: Lara: Excuse me, do you speak English? Ben: Yes. How can I help you?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：打扰一下，你会说英语吗？本：会。有什么可以帮你的吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużi, titkellem bl-Ingliż?
messages.mt_standard: Skużi, titkellem bl-Ingliż?
messages.zh: 打扰一下，你会说英语吗？
messages.en: Excuse me, do you speak English?

messages.speaker: Ben (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Kif nista' ngħinek?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Kif nista' ngħinek?
messages.zh: 会。有什么可以帮你的吗？
messages.en: Yes. How can I help you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象到酒店前台先说 Skużi，再问 Titkellem bl-Ingliż?；把整句与“确认对方会说英语”的情境绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The loss of something that someone had or wanted to keep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原本拥有或希望保留的东西发生遗失或损失。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-telf ta' xi ħaġa li persuna kellha jew xtaqet iżżomm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗失；失去；损失。

formal.mt: Biex jiġi evitat it-titlif ta' dokumenti importanti, għandha tinżamm kopja ta' kull wieħed.
formal.en: To prevent the loss of important documents, a copy of each should be kept.
formal.zh: 为防止重要文件遗失，应为每份文件保留副本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dejjem inpoġġi ċ-ċwievet fl-istess post biex nevita t-titlif tagħhom. Pawlu: Idea tajba! Jien se nibda nagħmel hekk ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: I always put my keys in the same place to avoid losing them. Pawlu: Good idea! I'll start doing that too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我总把钥匙放在同一个地方，免得弄丢。保罗：好主意！我也要开始这样做。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dejjem inpoġġi ċ-ċwievet fl-istess post biex nevita t-titlif tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Dejjem inpoġġi ċ-ċwievet fl-istess post biex nevita t-titlif tagħhom.
messages.zh: 我总把钥匙放在同一个地方，免得弄丢。
messages.en: I always put my keys in the same place to avoid losing them.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Idea tajba! Jien se nibda nagħmel hekk ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Idea tajba! Jien se nibda nagħmel hekk ukoll.
messages.zh: 好主意！我也要开始这样做。
messages.en: Good idea! I'll start doing that too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钥匙从口袋里掉落，把 titlif 与“原本有、后来失去”的画面联系起来；再用文件和时间各造一句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process in which a baby's teeth begin to emerge through the gums.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 婴儿的牙齿开始从牙龈中长出的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih is-snien ta' tarbija jibdew joħorġu mill-ħanek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出牙；婴儿开始长牙的过程。

formal.mt: Il-ġenituri kitbu fid-djarju tat-tarbija meta beda t-titligħ tas-snien.
formal.en: The parents recorded in the baby's diary when teething began.
formal.zh: 父母在宝宝日记中记下了开始出牙的时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Beda t-titligħ tas-snien ta' Nina? Mark: Iva, diġà tidher l-ewwel sinna!
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Nina started teething? Mark: Yes, you can already see her first tooth!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：妮娜开始长牙了吗？马克：是啊，已经能看见第一颗牙了！

messages.speaker: Lara (姑姑)
messages.mt_spoken: Beda t-titligħ tas-snien ta' Nina?
messages.mt_standard: Beda t-titligħ tas-snien ta' Nina?
messages.zh: 妮娜开始长牙了吗？
messages.en: Has Nina started teething?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà tidher l-ewwel sinna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà tidher l-ewwel sinna!
messages.zh: 是啊，已经能看见第一颗牙了！
messages.en: Yes, you can already see her first tooth!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象宝宝露出第一颗小牙，把 titligħ 放进 titligħ tas-snien 整组记忆，见到这组词就想到“出牙”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making something threefold or producing three copies of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物变为三重，或将其制作成三份的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir tlieta jew jiġu prodotti tliet kopji tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三重化；将某物制作成三份。

formal.mt: It-titlija tal-formola tipprovdi kopja għall-uffiċċju, kopja għall-applikant u kopja għall-arkivju.
formal.en: Triplication of the form provides one copy for the office, one for the applicant and one for the archive.
formal.zh: 将表格制作成三份，可分别供办公室、申请人和档案室留存。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-titlija ta' din il-formola? Toni: Biex ikollna tliet kopji, waħda għal kull persuna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does this form need to be made in triplicate? Toni: So we have three copies, one for each person.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张表格为什么要做成三份？托尼：这样就有三份，每人一份。

messages.speaker: Sara (新职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-titlija ta' din il-formola?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-titlija ta' din il-formola?
messages.zh: 这张表格为什么要做成三份？
messages.en: Why does this form need to be made in triplicate?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ikollna tliet kopji, waħda għal kull persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ikollna tliet kopji, waħda għal kull persuna.
messages.zh: 这样就有三份，每人一份。
messages.en: So we have three copies, one for each person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张表格变成三张的示意图，将 titlija 记作“结果成为三份”；与强调动作做三遍的 titlit 对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of having little energy or willingness to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精力不足、缺乏行动意愿的倦怠状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' enerġija jew ta' ħeġġa biex wieħed jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 离去；离开某处。
倦怠；精神不振；缺乏活力的状态。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi t-titliq mid-dar u l-bidu ta' ħajja ġdida.
formal.en: In his letter, the author describes his departure from home and the beginning of a new life.
formal.zh: 作者在信中描述了自己离家以及开始新生活的经历。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Illum għandi sens ta' titliq u ma rrid nagħmel xejn. Luka: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit u nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Nina: I feel lethargic today and don't want to do anything. Luka: Let's sit down for a while and talk.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我今天觉得很倦怠，什么都不想做。卢卡：我们坐一会儿，聊聊天吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandi sens ta' titliq u ma rrid nagħmel xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandi sens ta' titliq u ma rrid nagħmel xejn.
messages.zh: 我今天觉得很倦怠，什么都不想做。
messages.en: I feel lethargic today and don't want to do anything.

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit u nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit u nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 我们坐一会儿，聊聊天吧。
messages.en: Let's sit down for a while and talk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 titliq 做两张情景卡：一张画人提包离家，一张画人没精神地坐着；分别配“离去”和“倦怠”，用上下文辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of doing the same thing three times.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将同一件事做三遍的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħmel l-istess ħaġa tliet darbiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把事情做三遍；将同一动作重复三次。

formal.mt: F'din l-attività, it-titlit tal-istess eżerċizzju jfisser li l-istudent jagħmlu tliet darbiet.
formal.en: In this activity, doing the same exercise thrice means that the student performs it three times.
formal.zh: 在这项活动中，同一练习做三遍，指的是学生将它完成三次。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jiġifieri t-titlit tal-eżerċizzju? Ben: Tagħmlu tliet darbiet: darba, darbtejn, tliet darbiet!
colloquial.en: Marija: What does doing the exercise thrice mean? Ben: You do it three times: once, twice, three times!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：练习做三遍是什么意思？本：就是做三次：一次、两次、三次！

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri t-titlit tal-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri t-titlit tal-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 练习做三遍是什么意思？
messages.en: What does doing the exercise thrice mean?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tagħmlu tliet darbiet: darba, darbtejn, tliet darbiet!
messages.mt_standard: Tagħmlu tliet darbiet: darba, darbtejn, tliet darbiet!
messages.zh: 就是做三次：一次、两次、三次！
messages.en: You do it three times: once, twice, three times!

cognitive_memory_aid: 边拍手三下边念 titlit，重点记住“动作发生三遍”；与 titlija 的“制成三份”分别用动作和纸张来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of improving something until it is complete or as good as intended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不断改进某物，使其完整或达到预期完善程度的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tittejjeb sakemm tkun sħiħa jew tajba daqs kemm kien maħsub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完善；使某物达到更完整、更理想状态的过程。
履行；实现；使承诺或预期成为事实。

formal.mt: It-titmim tal-wegħda sar meta l-għaqda fetħet il-librerija għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: The promise was fulfilled when the association opened the library to the public.
formal.zh: 协会向公众开放图书馆时，便履行了这项承诺。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadek taħdem fuq it-titmim ta' din it-teknika? Daniel: Iva, qed nipprova nagħmel kull moviment aħjar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you still working on perfecting this technique? Daniel: Yes, I'm trying to improve every movement.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你还在努力完善这套技法吗？丹尼尔：是啊，我想把每个动作都做得更好。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek taħdem fuq it-titmim ta' din it-teknika?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek taħdem fuq it-titmim ta' din it-teknika?
messages.zh: 你还在努力完善这套技法吗？
messages.en: Are you still working on perfecting this technique?

messages.speaker: Daniel (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nipprova nagħmel kull moviment aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nipprova nagħmel kull moviment aħjar.
messages.zh: 是啊，我想把每个动作都做得更好。
messages.en: Yes, I'm trying to improve every movement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 titmim 配上两个完成画面：动作练得更好是“完善”，答应的事做到是“履行”；用搭配中的对象帮助分辨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a plant or tree produces fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物或树木结出果实的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih pjanta jew siġra tagħti l-frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结果；植物结出果实。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-titmir tas-siġar fil-ġnien u kitbu meta deher l-ewwel frott.
formal.en: The students observed the trees bearing fruit in the garden and recorded when the first fruit appeared.
formal.zh: 学生观察了花园中树木结果的过程，并记下最早出现果实的时间。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Beda t-titmir tas-siġra tagħna? Ġużeppi: Iva, ara kemm għandha frott żgħir!
colloquial.en: Anna: Has our tree started bearing fruit? Ġużeppi: Yes, look how much little fruit it has!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们的树开始结果了吗？朱塞佩：是啊，你看，已经结了这么多小果子！

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Beda t-titmir tas-siġra tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Beda t-titmir tas-siġra tagħna?
messages.zh: 我们的树开始结果了吗？
messages.en: Has our tree started bearing fruit?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm għandha frott żgħir!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm għandha frott żgħir!
messages.zh: 是啊，你看，已经结了这么多小果子！
messages.en: Yes, look how much little fruit it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象光秃的树枝慢慢挂上小果子，把 titmir 与“树木正在结果”的过程绑定，避免只记成某一颗果实。

gloss_zh: 凝结，通常指牛奶；洗涤不当造成衣物污渍

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process in which a liquid, usually milk, forms curds or lumps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体形成凝块的过程，通常指牛奶的凝结。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih likwidu, ġeneralment ħalib, jifforma għoqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝结成块，通常指牛奶形成凝块。

sense_translations.en_definition: staining of clothes due to incompetent washing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因洗涤操作不当而使衣物留下污渍或染上颜色。

collocations.en: the staining of clothes due to improper washing
collocations.zh: 洗涤不当导致衣物染污

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, l-istudenti osservaw it-titmis tal-ħalib wara li żiedu l-meraq tal-lumi.
formal.en: During the experiment, the students observed the curdling of milk after adding lemon juice.
formal.zh: 实验中，学生观察了加入柠檬汁后牛奶凝结的现象。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ara t-titmis tal-qmis! Ħsiltha ma' xugaman aħmar u issa għandha tbajja' roża. Karl: Id-darba li jmiss aħsel il-ħwejjeġ bojod għalihom.
colloquial.en: Marija: Look at the staining on the shirt! I washed it with a red towel, and now it has pink stains. Karl: Next time, wash the white clothes separately.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：看这衬衫都洗染色了！我把它和红毛巾一起洗，现在有了粉红色污渍。卡尔：下次把白色衣物分开洗吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara t-titmis tal-qmis! Ħsiltha ma' xugaman aħmar u issa għandha tbajja' roża.
messages.mt_standard: Ara t-titmis tal-qmis! Ħsiltha ma' xugaman aħmar u issa għandha tbajja' roża.
messages.zh: 看这衬衫都洗染色了！我把它和红毛巾一起洗，现在有了粉红色污渍。
messages.en: Look at the staining on the shirt! I washed it with a red towel, and now it has pink stains.

messages.speaker: Karl (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-darba li jmiss aħsel il-ħwejjeġ bojod għalihom.
messages.mt_standard: Id-darba li jmiss aħsel il-ħwejjeġ bojod għalihom.
messages.zh: 下次把白色衣物分开洗吧。
messages.en: Next time, wash the white clothes separately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记 titmis：杯中牛奶结块，白衬衫洗后染色；遇到 ħalib 想凝结，遇到衣物和洗涤语境想洗坏染污。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something twice as much, or of saying or doing something again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使数量变为原来两倍，或再次说出、做出同样内容的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih xi ħaġa ssir id-doppju, jew li bih kliem jew azzjoni jerġgħu jiġu ripetuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加倍；使数量或程度增加到原来的两倍。
重复；再次说出或做出相同的内容。

collocations.en: the repetition of the same words

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega t-titnija tal-ammont minn għaxart elef ewro għal għoxrin elf ewro.
formal.en: The report explains the doubling of the amount from ten thousand euros to twenty thousand euros.
formal.zh: 报告解释了金额从一万欧元增至两万欧元的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed terġa' tgħid l-istess sentenza? Mark: Din it-titnija tgħinni niftakar il-kliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you saying the same sentence again? Mark: This repetition helps me remember the words.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么又说一遍同样的句子？Mark：这样重复能帮我记住这些词。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed terġa' tgħid l-istess sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed terġa' tgħid l-istess sentenza?
messages.zh: 你为什么又说一遍同样的句子？
messages.en: Why are you saying the same sentence again?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-titnija tgħinni niftakar il-kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Din it-titnija tgħinni niftakar il-kliem.
messages.zh: 这样重复能帮我记住这些词。
messages.en: This repetition helps me remember the words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：一枚硬币变两枚表示加倍，同一句话再说一次表示重复。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Whining, crying, or expressing dissatisfaction through complaints.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出哼唧声、哭泣，或以抱怨表达不满的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karba, il-biki, jew l-ilmenti li bihom persuna tesprimi dwejjaq jew nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哼唧；以拖长、带委屈或不满的声音哀诉。
哭泣；因难过、不适等而哭的行为。
抱怨；用言语表达不满。

formal.mt: L-osservazzjoni tiddeskrivi t-titnis tat-tarbija qabel l-irqad u l-mod kif ikkalmat meta semgħet leħen ommha.
formal.en: The observation describes the baby's crying before sleep and how she calmed down when she heard her mother's voice.
formal.zh: 观察记录描述了婴儿入睡前的哭泣，以及她听见母亲声音后如何平静下来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan it-titnis kollu dwar ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Għandi wisq x'nagħmel illum u ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's all this complaining about work? Pawlu: I have too much to do today and don't know where to start.
colloquial.zh: Lara：怎么一直在抱怨工作？Pawlu：我今天要做的事太多了，都不知道从哪里开始。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-titnis kollu dwar ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-titnis kollu dwar ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 怎么一直在抱怨工作？
messages.en: What's all this complaining about work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi wisq x'nagħmel illum u ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi wisq x'nagħmel illum u ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
messages.zh: 我今天要做的事太多了，都不知道从哪里开始。
messages.en: I have too much to do today and don't know where to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一段声音的三种情境：拖声哼唧、难过哭泣、开口抱怨，结合语境判断词义。

gloss_zh: 通风不良；玻璃因内外温差起雾

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of ventilation, or mist forming on glass because the temperatures inside and outside differ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 空气流通不足的状态，或玻璃因室内外温度不同而出现雾气的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ventilazzjoni, jew ċpar fuq il-ħġieġ minħabba differenza bejn it-temperatura ta' ġewwa u dik ta' barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通风不足；空气不能充分流通的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: mistiness on a pane of glass due to different temperatures outside and inside
sense_translations.zh_definition: 玻璃因室内外温度不同而蒙上雾气的现象。

collocations.en: the lack of ventilation in the room

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinnota t-titpin fuq il-ħġieġ minħabba d-differenza fit-temperatura bejn ġewwa u barra.
formal.en: The report notes misting on the glass because of the temperature difference between inside and outside.
formal.zh: 报告指出，玻璃因室内外温差而出现了雾气。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma nistax nara sew barra minħabba t-titpin fuq il-ħġieġ. David: Imsaħ il-ħġieġ b'din iċ-ċarruta.
colloquial.en: Nina: I can't see outside clearly because of the mist on the glass. David: Wipe the glass with this cloth.
colloquial.zh: Nina：玻璃上有雾，我看不清外面。David：用这块布擦一下玻璃。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax nara sew barra minħabba t-titpin fuq il-ħġieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax nara sew barra minħabba t-titpin fuq il-ħġieġ.
messages.zh: 玻璃上有雾，我看不清外面。
messages.en: I can't see outside clearly because of the mist on the glass.

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Imsaħ il-ħġieġ b'din iċ-ċarruta.
messages.mt_standard: Imsaħ il-ħġieġ b'din iċ-ċarruta.
messages.zh: 用这块布擦一下玻璃。
messages.en: Wipe the glass with this cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进房间画面：先记空气不流通，再记内外温差使窗玻璃蒙雾的另一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of closing an opening with a plug, including sealing a bottle with a cork.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用塞子堵住开口的行为，也指用软木塞封住瓶口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għeluq ta' fetħa b'tapp, inkluż l-għeluq ta' flixkun b'tapp tas-sufra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞住；用塞子或其他材料堵住孔口。
用软木塞封口，尤其指封住瓶口。

formal.mt: Wara l-mili jsir it-titpip tal-fliexken b'tappijiet tas-sufra.
formal.en: After filling, the bottles are sealed with corks.
formal.zh: 灌装完成后，瓶子会用软木塞封口。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lestejt it-titpip tal-fliexken? Sara: Għad fadal tnejn; agħtini żewġ tappijiet oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you finished corking the bottles? Sara: There are still two left; pass me two more corks.
colloquial.zh: Mark：瓶子的软木塞都塞好了吗？Sara：还剩两个，再递给我两个软木塞。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt it-titpip tal-fliexken?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt it-titpip tal-fliexken?
messages.zh: 瓶子的软木塞都塞好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished corking the bottles?

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal tnejn; agħtini żewġ tappijiet oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal tnejn; agħtini żewġ tappijiet oħra.
messages.zh: 还剩两个，再递给我两个软木塞。
messages.en: There are still two left; pass me two more corks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手把塞子按进开口：堵住孔洞是一般义，塞住酒瓶则帮助记住软木塞封口义。

gloss_zh: 穿刺；穿孔；用皮下注射针注射

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of piercing something to make a hole, or of giving an injection with a hypodermic needle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刺穿某物形成孔洞的行为，或使用皮下注射针进行注射。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' toqba billi tittaqqab xi ħaġa, jew l-għoti ta' injezzjoni permezz ta' labra ipodermika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿刺；刺穿物体或身体部位，形成孔洞。
使用皮下注射针进行的注射。

collocations.en: an injection with a hypodermic needle

formal.mt: Il-pazjent ħass tingiża waqt it-titqib b'labra ipodermika.
formal.en: The patient felt a brief sting during the injection with a hypodermic needle.
formal.zh: 患者在接受皮下注射针注射时感到了一下刺痛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed taħseb fit-titqib tal-widnejn? Lara: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid inkun naf aktar dwaru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you thinking about getting your ears pierced? Lara: Yes, but first I want to know more about it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在考虑穿耳洞吗？Lara：是的，不过我想先多了解一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed taħseb fit-titqib tal-widnejn?
messages.mt_standard: Qed taħseb fit-titqib tal-widnejn?
messages.zh: 你在考虑穿耳洞吗？
messages.en: Are you thinking about getting your ears pierced?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid inkun naf aktar dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid inkun naf aktar dwaru.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我想先多了解一下。
messages.en: Yes, but first I want to know more about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用针尖穿过表面的画面记忆：穿耳洞对应穿孔，注射针进入身体对应注射义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of increasing the weight of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 增加某物重量、使其变得更重的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żieda fil-piż ta' xi ħaġa biex issir itqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加重；使某物的重量增加。

formal.mt: Iż-żieda ta' kotba oħra wasslet għat-titqil tal-bagalja minn tmien kilogrammi għal għaxra.
formal.en: Adding more books made the suitcase heavier, increasing its weight from eight kilograms to ten.
formal.zh: 增加书本使行李箱变重，重量从八公斤增至十公斤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-titqil tal-bagalja kollu minħabba l-kotba? Mark: Iva, poġġejt tliet kotba oħra ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this whole increase in the suitcase's weight because of the books? Mark: Yes, I put three more books inside.
colloquial.zh: Sara：行李箱重了这么多，都是因为这些书吗？Mark：对，我又往里面放了三本书。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-titqil tal-bagalja kollu minħabba l-kotba?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-titqil tal-bagalja kollu minħabba l-kotba?
messages.zh: 行李箱重了这么多，都是因为这些书吗？
messages.en: Is this whole increase in the suitcase's weight because of the books?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, poġġejt tliet kotba oħra ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, poġġejt tliet kotba oħra ġewwa.
messages.zh: 对，我又往里面放了三本书。
messages.en: Yes, I put three more books inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往行李箱里不断放书，秤上的数字上升；记住这个词强调使重量增加的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of chasing someone or something, or of moving along behind them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某人或某物后面追赶，或沿其行进方向跟随的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġiri wara xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew il-mixi warajhom biex issegwihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 追赶；向某人或某物追去，试图赶上。
跟随；在某人或某物后面行进。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi t-titrid tal-lupu wara l-priża fil-foresta.
formal.en: The account describes the wolf's pursuit of its prey through the forest.
formal.zh: 这篇记述描写了狼在森林中追逐猎物的情景。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Dan it-titrid wara l-ballun għajjieni! Nina: Ejja nistrieħu ftit qabel nerġgħu nilagħbu.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: All this chasing after the ball has worn me out! Nina: Let's rest a little before we play again.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：这样一直追球，我都累坏了！Nina：我们休息一会儿再玩吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-titrid wara l-ballun għajjieni!
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-titrid wara l-ballun għajjieni!
messages.zh: 这样一直追球，我都累坏了！
messages.en: All this chasing after the ball has worn me out!

messages.speaker: Nina (球友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nistrieħu ftit qabel nerġgħu nilagħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nistrieħu ftit qabel nerġgħu nilagħbu.
messages.zh: 我们休息一会儿再玩吧。
messages.en: Let's rest a little before we play again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把自己放在目标后面：目标跑、你追就是追赶；目标走、你随后走就是跟随。

gloss_zh: 嫩化；使肉质变嫩的处理

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making meat softer and easier to chew.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使肉质变软、变嫩，从而更容易咀嚼的处理过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jagħmel il-laħam aktar tari u aktar faċli biex jintmagħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嫩化的动作或过程，尤指使肉质变嫩。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tinkludi pass għat-titrija tal-laħam qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: The recipe includes a step for tenderising the meat before cooking.
formal.zh: 这份食谱包含一个烹饪前使肉质变嫩的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għat-titrija tal-laħam, nuża dan il-martell? Toni: Iva, ħabbat il-laħam bil-mod qabel issajru.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should I use this mallet to tenderise the meat? Toni: Yes, pound the meat gently before cooking it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：要把肉弄嫩，是用这把肉锤吗？托尼：对，烹饪前轻轻敲打肉块。

messages.speaker: Lara (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-titrija tal-laħam, nuża dan il-martell?
messages.mt_standard: Għat-titrija tal-laħam, nuża dan il-martell?
messages.zh: 要把肉弄嫩，是用这把肉锤吗？
messages.en: Should I use this mallet to tenderise the meat?

messages.speaker: Toni (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħabbat il-laħam bil-mod qabel issajru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħabbat il-laħam bil-mod qabel issajru.
messages.zh: 对，烹饪前轻轻敲打肉块。
messages.en: Yes, pound the meat gently before cooking it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进厨房画面：肉锤轻敲，肉质变嫩；记住它指“嫩化过程”，不是肉本身。

gloss_zh: 压碎；制浆；寻路或开路前行

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of crushing something, reducing it to pulp, or making one's way and finding a route.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体压碎或加工成浆的动作；也指寻找路线或设法开路前行的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tfarrak xi ħaġa, tagħmilha polpa, jew issib triq u tgħaddi minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压碎；把物体挤压或碾压成碎块的过程。
制浆；把材料加工成浆状物的过程。

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of making one's way or finding one's route
sense_translations.zh_definition: 设法前行或寻找路线的过程；寻路、开路前行。

collocations.en: making one's way through tall grass

formal.mt: Wara t-titriq tal-frott, il-polpa tinġabar f'kontenitur nadif.
formal.en: After the fruit is pulped, the pulp is collected in a clean container.
formal.zh: 水果制浆后，果浆被收集到干净的容器中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif mar it-titriq minn qalb il-ħaxix għoli? Mark: Domna ftit, imma fl-aħħar sibna l-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did making your way through the tall grass go? Mark: It took us a while, but we finally found the path.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你们从高草丛中找路走出来，情况怎么样？马克：花了点时间，不过最后找到了小路。

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar it-titriq minn qalb il-ħaxix għoli?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar it-titriq minn qalb il-ħaxix għoli?
messages.zh: 你们从高草丛中找路走出来，情况怎么样？
messages.en: How did making your way through the tall grass go?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步者)
messages.mt_spoken: Domna ftit, imma fl-aħħar sibna l-mogħdija.
messages.mt_standard: Domna ftit, imma fl-aħħar sibna l-mogħdija.
messages.zh: 花了点时间，不过最后找到了小路。
messages.en: It took us a while, but we finally found the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三张卡记忆：石头压成碎块、水果打成果浆、人在草丛找路；根据宾语和场景判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of giving birth or laying eggs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生下幼体的分娩过程，或产下卵的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess tat-twelid tal-frieħ jew tat-tqegħid tal-bajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分娩；生下幼体的过程。
产卵；把卵产出的过程。

collocations.en: the laying of eggs by hens

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tar-razzett jiddeskrivi t-titrir tan-nagħaġ u l-kura tal-ħrief wara t-twelid.
formal.en: The farm report describes the birthing of the sheep and the care of the lambs after birth.
formal.zh: 农场报告描述了绵羊产羔的过程，以及羔羊出生后的护理。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejjer it-titrir tat-tiġieġ din il-ġimgħa? Ġużeppi: Sejjer tajjeb; illum ġbart sitt bajdiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is the hens' egg laying going this week? Ġużeppi: It's going well; I collected six eggs today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这星期母鸡下蛋的情况怎么样？朱塞佩：挺好，今天我收了六个蛋。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场帮工)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer it-titrir tat-tiġieġ din il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer it-titrir tat-tiġieġ din il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 这星期母鸡下蛋的情况怎么样？
messages.en: How is the hens' egg laying going this week?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer tajjeb; illum ġbart sitt bajdiet.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer tajjeb; illum ġbart sitt bajdiet.
messages.zh: 挺好，今天我收了六个蛋。
messages.en: It's going well; I collected six eggs today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想农场里的两种出生场景：羊生下小羊，母鸡产下鸡蛋；这个名词强调生产过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The loosening or softening of soil by watering it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过浇水使土壤变得松软、疏松的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-ħamrija tinħall u tirtab meta tissaqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过浇水使土壤松软、疏松。

collocations.en: the loosening of soil by watering
loosening the soil by watering before planting
collocations.zh: 种植前浇水使土壤松软

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar wettaq it-titrit tal-ħamrija billi saqqa l-wiċċ iebes qabel it-tħawwil.
formal.en: The gardener loosened the soil by watering its hard surface before planting.
formal.zh: 园丁在种植前给坚硬的土壤表面浇水，使土壤松软。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed issaqqi qabel tħawwel? Frans: Għat-titrit tal-ħamrija; hekk tkun aktar ratba.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you watering before planting? Frans: To loosen the soil; that way it will be softer.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么在种植前先浇水？弗兰斯：为了让土壤松软，这样土就会软一些。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed issaqqi qabel tħawwel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed issaqqi qabel tħawwel?
messages.zh: 你为什么在种植前先浇水？
messages.en: Why are you watering before planting?

messages.speaker: Frans (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-titrit tal-ħamrija; hekk tkun aktar ratba.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-titrit tal-ħamrija; hekk tkun aktar ratba.
messages.zh: 为了让土壤松软，这样土就会软一些。
messages.en: To loosen the soil; that way it will be softer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象干硬土块吸水后变松软：记忆时把“水”和“松土”绑在一起，突出浇水这个方式。

gloss_zh: 修筑梯田；频繁爬楼梯；层次渐变

teaching_sense.en_definition: The making of terraces, frequent climbing of stairs, or an arrangement or change in successive degrees.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把土地修整成梯田的过程、频繁爬楼梯的活动，或按连续等级形成层次或渐变的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħolqien ta' terrazzi fl-art, it-tlugħ frekwenti tat-taraġ, jew tqassim jew bidla gradwali minn livell għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修筑梯田；把坡地整修成逐级排列的平台。
频繁爬楼梯；反复沿楼梯向上走的活动。
分级；按程度逐级排列，或形成连续的层次渐变。

formal.mt: Il-pjan agrikolu jinkludi t-titriġ tal-għelieqi fuq l-għolja biex jinħolqu livelli adattati għall-kultivazzjoni.
formal.en: The agricultural plan includes terracing the fields on the hill to create levels suitable for cultivation.
formal.zh: 农业规划包括把山坡上的田地修整成梯田，形成适合耕种的各级平台。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-titriġ ta' kuljum sa dan is-sular qed jgħajjini. David: Nifhmek; illum tlajt it-taraġ erba' darbiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Climbing the stairs to this floor so often every day is tiring me out. David: I understand; I've climbed the stairs four times today.
colloquial.zh: Lara：每天老是爬楼梯到这一层，真让我累。David：我理解，今天我已经爬了四次楼梯了。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: It-titriġ ta' kuljum sa dan is-sular qed jgħajjini.
messages.mt_standard: It-titriġ ta' kuljum sa dan is-sular qed jgħajjini.
messages.zh: 每天老是爬楼梯到这一层，真让我累。
messages.en: Climbing the stairs to this floor so often every day is tiring me out.

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmek; illum tlajt it-taraġ erba' darbiet.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmek; illum tlajt it-taraġ erba' darbiet.
messages.zh: 我理解，今天我已经爬了四次楼梯了。
messages.en: I understand; I've climbed the stairs four times today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用阶梯画面串联三个词义：山坡修成梯田、人反复爬楼梯、色卡逐级渐变；这只是记忆联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of scattering grain or similar material, or of spreading out a net.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把谷粒等分散撒开的动作，或把网具展开铺开的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xxerred il-qamħ jew materjal simili, jew li tifrex xibka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谷粒等的撒布；把谷粒等分散撒开的动作。
网具的铺展；把网展开的动作。

formal.mt: Matul it-titriħ tal-qamħ, il-ħaddiem qassam il-ħbub fuq wiċċ wiesa'.
formal.en: During the scattering of the grain, the worker distributed the grains over a broad surface.
formal.zh: 撒布谷粒时，工人把谷粒分散撒在一大片表面上。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Tista' tgħinni fit-titriħ tax-xibka? Pawlu: Iva, żomm tarf u jien nieħu t-tarf l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can you help me spread out the net? Pawlu: Yes, hold one end and I'll take the other.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你能帮我把网铺开吗？保罗：可以，你拿住一端，我拿另一端。

messages.speaker: Marta (渔民)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinni fit-titriħ tax-xibka?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinni fit-titriħ tax-xibka?
messages.zh: 你能帮我把网铺开吗？
messages.en: Can you help me spread out the net?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żomm tarf u jien nieħu t-tarf l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żomm tarf u jien nieħu t-tarf l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 可以，你拿住一端，我拿另一端。
messages.en: Yes, hold one end and I'll take the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个展开的画面记忆：一把谷粒撒开，一张渔网铺开；共同抓住“向外分散、展开”的动作。

gloss_zh: 杂色变化；条纹的形成或添加

teaching_sense.en_definition: Variation in colour across a surface, or the formation or addition of stripes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面呈现不同颜色的杂色变化，或条纹的形成、添加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-varjazzjoni tal-kuluri fuq wiċċ, jew il-ħolqien jew iż-żieda ta' strixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂色变化；呈现多种颜色相间的现象或效果。
条纹的形成或添加；条纹装饰。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi t-titriż tal-weraq, b'żoni ħodor u bojod fuq l-istess werqa.
formal.en: The study describes leaf variegation, with green and white areas on the same leaf.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了叶片的杂色现象，同一片叶子上有绿色和白色区域。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Jogħġbok it-titriż ta' dan id-drapp? Elena: Iva, l-istrixxi blu u bojod jidhru sbieħ flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you like the striping on this fabric? Elena: Yes, the blue and white stripes look lovely together.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你喜欢这块布的条纹吗？埃莱娜：喜欢，蓝白条纹搭配起来很好看。

messages.speaker: Marija (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġbok it-titriż ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġbok it-titriż ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.zh: 你喜欢这块布的条纹吗？
messages.en: Do you like the striping on this fabric?

messages.speaker: Elena (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-istrixxi blu u bojod jidhru sbieħ flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-istrixxi blu u bojod jidhru sbieħ flimkien.
messages.zh: 喜欢，蓝白条纹搭配起来很好看。
messages.en: Yes, the blue and white stripes look lovely together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用视觉配对记忆：一片绿白相间的叶子，一块蓝白条纹布；分别对应杂色和条纹两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of opening the mouth wide and taking a deep breath, often when tired or bored.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 张大嘴并深吸气的打哈欠动作，常发生在疲倦或无聊时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiftaħ ħalqek beraħ u tieħu nifs fil-fond, spiss meta tkun għajjien jew imdejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打哈欠；张大嘴并深吸气的动作。

formal.mt: L-għalliem innota titwib frekwenti fost l-istudenti lejn tmiem il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher noticed frequent yawning among the students towards the end of the lesson.
formal.zh: 临近下课时，老师注意到学生们频繁打哈欠。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan it-titwib kollu! Ma rqadtx sew? Ben: Le, ilbieraħ dħalt norqod tard ħafna.
colloquial.en: Anna: All this yawning! Didn't you sleep well? Ben: No, I went to bed very late yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你一直打哈欠！没睡好吗？本：没有，我昨天很晚才上床睡觉。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-titwib kollu! Ma rqadtx sew?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-titwib kollu! Ma rqadtx sew?
messages.zh: 你一直打哈欠！没睡好吗？
messages.en: All this yawning! Didn't you sleep well?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ilbieraħ dħalt norqod tard ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ilbieraħ dħalt norqod tard ħafna.
messages.zh: 没有，我昨天很晚才上床睡觉。
messages.en: No, I went to bed very late yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 边张大嘴模拟哈欠边记这个词，再联想熬夜后的课堂；把词与具体动作连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The easing of pain or other distress, including palliation that reduces suffering without necessarily curing its cause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减轻疼痛或其他不适；也指以减轻痛苦为目的、未必消除病因为特点的姑息性缓解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tnaqqis tal-uġigħ jew ta' tbatija oħra, inkluż serħan li mhux bilfors ifejjaq il-kawża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓解、减轻，例如减轻疼痛。
姑息；以减轻症状和痛苦为目的、未必治愈病因的缓解。

formal.mt: L-għan tal-kura deskritta fir-rapport huwa t-titwija tas-sintomi u t-titjib tal-kumdità tal-pazjent.
formal.en: The aim of the care described in the report is to palliate symptoms and improve the patient's comfort.
formal.zh: 报告中所述护理的目标是缓解症状，并提高患者的舒适程度。

colloquial.mt: Ruth: Ħassejt xi titwija tal-uġigħ? David: Iva, naqas ftit, imma għadu ma għaddiex.
colloquial.en: Ruth: Have you felt any relief from the pain? David: Yes, it has eased a little, but it hasn't gone away yet.
colloquial.zh: 露丝：你觉得疼痛有缓解吗？戴维：有，减轻了一点，不过还没消失。

messages.speaker: Ruth (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt xi titwija tal-uġigħ?
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt xi titwija tal-uġigħ?
messages.zh: 你觉得疼痛有缓解吗？
messages.en: Have you felt any relief from the pain?

messages.speaker: David (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naqas ftit, imma għadu ma għaddiex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naqas ftit, imma għadu ma għaddiex.
messages.zh: 有，减轻了一点，不过还没消失。
messages.en: Yes, it has eased a little, but it hasn't gone away yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象疼痛刻度从八降到四：重点是痛苦减轻；记住“得到缓解”并不必然表示病因已经治愈。

gloss_zh: 已播种田地空缺处的补播

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sowing of seeds in bare spaces left within a field that has already been sown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在已经播种的田地中，对尚未播到种子的空缺地块进行补播。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żrigħ taż-żerriegħa fi spazji li baqgħu mhux miżrugħa f'għalqa li diġà nżergħet.

sense_translations.en_definition: Sowing seeds in unsown spaces of a field already sown
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在已播种田地中尚未播种的空缺处补播种子。

collocations.en: filling the unsown spaces in the field with seed
collocations.zh: 对田地中的漏播处进行补播

collocations.en: seed for sowing in the gaps
collocations.zh: 用于空缺处补播的种子

formal.mt: Wara l-ewwel żrigħ, il-bidwi għamel it-titwik fl-ispazji tal-għalqa li kienu baqgħu mingħajr żerriegħa.
formal.en: After the initial sowing, the farmer sowed seed in the spaces in the field that had been left without any.
formal.zh: 首次播种后，农民对田里尚未播到种子的空缺处进行了补播。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex żammejt ftit żerriegħa? Marija: Għat-titwik. Hemm xi spazji fl-għalqa li għadhom mhux miżrugħa.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why did you keep some seed? Marija: To sow in the gaps. Some spaces in the field are still unsown.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你为什么留了一些种子？玛丽亚：用来补播。田里还有几处没有播到。

messages.speaker: Pawlu（农民）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex żammejt ftit żerriegħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex żammejt ftit żerriegħa?
messages.zh: 你为什么留了一些种子？
messages.en: Why did you keep some seed?

messages.speaker: Marija（农民）
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-titwik. Hemm xi spazji fl-għalqa li għadhom mhux miżrugħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-titwik. Hemm xi spazji fl-għalqa li għadhom mhux miżrugħa.
messages.zh: 用来补播。田里还有几处没有播到。
messages.en: To sow in the gaps. Some spaces in the field are still unsown.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象播过种的田像一张有空格的棋盘：titwik 就是把种子补进空格，重点是已播田里的漏播处。

gloss_zh: 延长；从窗口或边缘向外探看

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something longer; also, the act of looking out of a window or over an edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物长度增加的行为；也指从窗口向外看，或探头越过边缘向外看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih xi ħaġa ssir itwal; ukoll, il-ħars minn tieqa jew minn fuq xifer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延长；使长度增加。

sense_translations.en_definition: looking out of a window or over an edge
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从窗口向外看，或探头越过边缘向外看。

formal.mt: It-titwil tal-kmiem sar bl-użu ta' drapp tal-istess kulur.
formal.en: The sleeves were lengthened using fabric of the same colour.
formal.zh: 袖子使用同色布料进行了加长。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tagħmel ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Qed nara min wasal. Lara: Oqgħod attent bit-titwil minn hemm; it-tieqa baxxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you doing by the window? Mark: I'm seeing who has arrived. Lara: Be careful looking out from there; the window is low.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在窗边干什么？马克：我看看谁来了。拉拉：从那里探头看要小心，窗户很低。

messages.speaker: Lara（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tagħmel ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tagħmel ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你在窗边干什么？
messages.en: What are you doing by the window?

messages.speaker: Mark（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nara min wasal.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nara min wasal.
messages.zh: 我看看谁来了。
messages.en: I'm seeing who has arrived.

messages.speaker: Lara（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attent bit-titwil minn hemm; it-tieqa baxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attent bit-titwil minn hemm; it-tieqa baxxa.
messages.zh: 从那里探头看要小心，窗户很低。
messages.en: Be careful looking out from there; the window is low.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分开记忆：裁缝把袖子加长，朋友在窗口探看。titwil 的具体意思由衣物或窗口等语境决定。

gloss_zh: 结对；缔结双边伙伴关系

teaching_sense.en_definition: The pairing of two entities, such as towns or schools, in a partnership.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将两个单位结成一对或建立伙伴关系的行为，例如城市或学校之间的结对。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twaqqif ta' rabta ta' sħubija bejn żewġ entitajiet, bħal bliet jew skejjel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结对；将两个单位联系起来并建立伙伴关系。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim ta' titwim bejn iż-żewġ bliet jinkludi skambji kulturali u żjarat tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The twinning agreement between the two towns includes cultural exchanges and student visits.
formal.zh: 两座城市的结对协议包括文化交流和学生互访。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex se jiġu dawk l-istudenti għandna? David: Minħabba t-titwim bejn l-iskejjel tagħna. Wara mmorru nżuruhom aħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are those students coming to visit us? David: Because our schools are twinned. Afterwards, we'll go and visit them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那些学生为什么要来我们这里？戴维：因为我们的学校建立了结对关系。之后我们也会去拜访他们。

messages.speaker: Sara（学生）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex se jiġu dawk l-istudenti għandna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex se jiġu dawk l-istudenti għandna?
messages.zh: 那些学生为什么要来我们这里？
messages.en: Why are those students coming to visit us?

messages.speaker: David（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-titwim bejn l-iskejjel tagħna. Wara mmorru nżuruhom aħna.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-titwim bejn l-iskejjel tagħna. Wara mmorru nżuruhom aħna.
messages.zh: 因为我们的学校建立了结对关系。之后我们也会去拜访他们。
messages.en: Because our schools are twinned. Afterwards, we'll go and visit them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两所学校各伸出一只手，握手后互相访问：用这个结成一对的画面记 titwim。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ploughing land so that large furrows are formed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 翻耕土地并犁出较大犁沟的耕作方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħrit tal-art b'mod li jsiru raddiet kbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以犁出大犁沟的方式耕地。

collocations.en: ploughing the land in large furrows

collocations.zh: 大沟耕作后形成的犁沟

formal.mt: Wara t-titwir, fl-għalqa dehru raddiet kbar paralleli.
formal.en: After the land was ploughed in large furrows, large parallel furrows were visible in the field.
formal.zh: 经过大犁沟耕作后，田里出现了一道道平行的大犁沟。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex hemm dawn ir-raddiet kbar? Ġużeppi: Għamilt it-titwir dalgħodu. Għaddejt bil-moħriet minn tarf għall-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Toni: Why are there these large furrows? Ġużeppi: I ploughed in large furrows this morning. I took the plough from one end to the other.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：这里怎么有这些大犁沟？朱塞佩：我今天早上进行了大沟耕作，拉着犁从这一头耕到了另一头。

messages.speaker: Toni（农场帮工）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawn ir-raddiet kbar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawn ir-raddiet kbar?
messages.zh: 这里怎么有这些大犁沟？
messages.en: Why are there these large furrows?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi（农民）
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt it-titwir dalgħodu. Għaddejt bil-moħriet minn tarf għall-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt it-titwir dalgħodu. Għaddejt bil-moħriet minn tarf għall-ieħor.
messages.zh: 我今天早上进行了大沟耕作，拉着犁从这一头耕到了另一头。
messages.en: I ploughed in large furrows this morning. I took the plough from one end to the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把田地想成被犁划出一道道大沟的画面：titwir 要连同大犁沟一起记，才能抓住这个耕作词的特点。

gloss_zh: 废话；含混杂乱的喋喋声

teaching_sense.en_definition: Talk that is foolish, pointless, confused, or difficult to make sense of.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏意义、没有重点，或杂乱含混而难以听懂的话语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem bla siwi jew bla sens, jew diskors imħawwad li diffiċli tifhmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冗长而无聊的废话；没有实质内容的絮叨。
杂乱含混、难以听懂的喋喋话语。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jippreżenta fatti ċari u jevita t-titwit li ma jżid l-ebda informazzjoni.
formal.en: The report should present clear facts and avoid blather that adds no information.
formal.zh: 报告应当陈述清楚的事实，避免加入没有任何信息价值的废话。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qalilkom meta se jibda x-xogħol? Karl: Le, ħafna titwit u ebda data. Nina: Mela għadna ma nafu xejn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did he tell you when the work will start? Karl: No, lots of blather and no date. Nina: So we still don't know anything.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他告诉你们什么时候开工了吗？卡尔：没有，说了一大堆废话，也没给日期。妮娜：那我们还是一无所知。

messages.speaker: Nina（同事）
messages.mt_spoken: Qalilkom meta se jibda x-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Qalilkom meta se jibda x-xogħol?
messages.zh: 他告诉你们什么时候开工了吗？
messages.en: Did he tell you when the work will start?

messages.speaker: Karl（同事）
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħafna titwit u ebda data.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħafna titwit u ebda data.
messages.zh: 没有，说了一大堆废话，也没给日期。
messages.en: No, lots of blather and no date.

messages.speaker: Nina（同事）
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għadna ma nafu xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Mela għadna ma nafu xejn.
messages.zh: 那我们还是一无所知。
messages.en: So we still don't know anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人说了半天，你的笔记本却仍然空白：titwit 可记成听得到很多话，却抓不到有用内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of crushing a material, such as grain or coffee beans, into smaller particles or powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把谷物、咖啡豆等材料磨成细小颗粒或粉末的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih materjal, bħall-qamħ jew il-kafè, jitfarrak fi frak żgħir jew fi trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 研磨；把材料磨碎或磨成粉的过程。

formal.mt: It-titħin tal-qamħ huwa stadju importanti fil-produzzjoni tad-dqiq.
formal.en: The grinding of wheat is an important stage in the production of flour.
formal.zh: 小麦研磨是面粉生产中的一个重要阶段。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek ma lestejtx it-titħin tal-kafè? Pawlu: Kważi lest; imbagħad nagħmel żewġ kikkri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Haven't you finished grinding the coffee yet? Pawlu: Almost done; then I'll make two cups.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还没磨完咖啡豆吗？保罗：快好了，然后我就冲两杯。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek ma lestejtx it-titħin tal-kafè?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek ma lestejtx it-titħin tal-kafè?
messages.zh: 你还没磨完咖啡豆吗？
messages.en: Haven't you finished grinding the coffee yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi lest; imbagħad nagħmel żewġ kikkri.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi lest; imbagħad nagħmel żewġ kikkri.
messages.zh: 快好了，然后我就冲两杯。
messages.en: Almost done; then I'll make two cups.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象磨豆机把整粒咖啡豆磨成粉，把 titħin 与连续研磨的动作画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The removal of the foreskin of the penis, performed as a medical procedure or as part of a religious or cultural practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切除阴茎包皮的操作，可作为医疗程序，也可属于宗教或文化习俗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija tal-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene, għal raġunijiet mediċi, reliġjużi jew kulturali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 割礼；包皮环切，即切除阴茎包皮的操作。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi r-rit tat-titħir fil-komunità u jispjega t-tifsira tiegħu għall-membri tagħha.
formal.en: The text describes the rite of circumcision in the community and explains its meaning for its members.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了该社群的割礼仪式，并解释了它对社群成员的意义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser titħir f'dan it-test? Mark: Ifisser ċirkonċiżjoni; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar rit reliġjuż.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does titħir mean in this text? Mark: It means circumcision; here they're talking about a religious rite.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这篇文章里的 titħir 是什么意思？马克：意思是割礼；这里谈的是一种宗教仪式。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser titħir f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser titħir f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 titħir 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does titħir mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser ċirkonċiżjoni; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar rit reliġjuż.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser ċirkonċiżjoni; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar rit reliġjuż.
messages.zh: 意思是割礼；这里谈的是一种宗教仪式。
messages.en: It means circumcision; here they're talking about a religious rite.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 titħir 放进“阅读割礼仪式介绍”的场景中记忆，同时联系医疗语境中的包皮环切。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Oppressive treatment or control; also the act or state of submitting to another person's power or authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人施加压制或控制；也指向他人的权力或权威屈服的行为或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament jew kontroll li jgħakkes lil ħaddieħor; ukoll l-att jew l-istat li wieħed iċedi għall-poter jew għall-awtorità ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫；以权力或强制手段压制他人。
屈服；向他人的权力或权威低头、顺从。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddistingwi bejn it-titħit tal-poplu mir-reġim u t-titħit taċ-ċittadini quddiem l-awtorità.
formal.en: The author distinguishes between the regime's oppression of the people and the citizens' submission to authority.
formal.zh: 作者区分了政权对人民的压迫与公民向权威的屈服。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hawn titħit ifisser li xi ħadd qed jgħakkes lil ħaddieħor? David: Iva, iżda f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser li xi ħadd iċedi għall-awtorità.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does titħit here mean that someone is oppressing someone else? David: Yes, but in another sentence it can mean that someone submits to authority.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里的 titħit 是指有人在压迫别人吗？戴维：是的，但在另一句话里，它也可以指某人向权威屈服。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn titħit ifisser li xi ħadd qed jgħakkes lil ħaddieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn titħit ifisser li xi ħadd qed jgħakkes lil ħaddieħor?
messages.zh: 这里的 titħit 是指有人在压迫别人吗？
messages.en: Does titħit here mean that someone is oppressing someone else?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser li xi ħadd iċedi għall-awtorità.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser li xi ħadd iċedi għall-awtorità.
messages.zh: 是的，但在另一句话里，它也可以指某人向权威屈服。
messages.en: Yes, but in another sentence it can mean that someone submits to authority.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅双向画面记 titħit：上方的人施加“压迫”，下方的人选择“屈服”；读句子时辨认是哪一面。

gloss_zh: 折叠；渴求；欲望；念念不忘的向往

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of folding something; also, a craving, desire, or persistent longing for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西折起来的行为；也指对某物的渴求、欲望或持续的向往。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih xi ħaġa tintewa; ukoll, xewqa jew ħerqa għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 折叠；把某物的一部分折向另一部分的动作。
渴求；对某物十分强烈的想要。
欲望；希望得到某物或实现某事的愿望。
持续的向往；对某物念念不忘的渴望。

formal.mt: It-tiwi tal-karta għandu jsir tul il-linji mmarkati sabiex jinkiseb il-mudell mixtieq.
formal.en: The paper should be folded along the marked lines to produce the desired model.
formal.zh: 应沿标出的线折叠纸张，以做出所需的模型。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandi tiwi għal xi ħaġa ħelwa. Luqa: Hemm biċċa kejk fil-kċina. Tridha? Marta: Iva, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Marta: I'm craving something sweet. Luqa: There's a piece of cake in the kitchen. Would you like it? Marta: Yes, thanks!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我特别想吃点甜的。卢卡：厨房里有一块蛋糕，你要吗？玛尔塔：要，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Marta（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tiwi għal xi ħaġa ħelwa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tiwi għal xi ħaġa ħelwa.
messages.zh: 我特别想吃点甜的。
messages.en: I'm craving something sweet.

messages.speaker: Luqa（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm biċċa kejk fil-kċina. Tridha?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm biċċa kejk fil-kċina. Tridha?
messages.zh: 厨房里有一块蛋糕，你要吗？
messages.en: There's a piece of cake in the kitchen. Would you like it?

messages.speaker: Marta（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi!
messages.zh: 要，谢谢！
messages.en: Yes, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tiwi 画两张独立的记忆卡：一张是双手折纸，另一张是心里惦记蛋糕；分别记住折叠与渴望两组意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fold in material, or a line or mark made where something has been folded or creased.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料折起来形成的一道褶，或纸张、布料等被折压后留下的一道折痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti ta' materjal li tkun mitwija, jew linja jew marka li tibqa' fejn xi ħaġa tkun intwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一道折叠；材料折起来形成的一道褶。
一道折痕或皱痕；折压后留下的线状痕迹。

formal.mt: It-tiwja fin-nofs tal-folja tindika fejn il-karta għandha tintlewa.
formal.en: The crease in the middle of the sheet indicates where the paper should be folded.
formal.zh: 纸张中间的折痕标明了应当折叠的位置。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Hemm tiwja fil-qmis tiegħi. Ben: Għaddiha bil-ħadida qabel toħroġ. Elena: Tajjeb, għad għandi ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Elena: There's a crease in my shirt. Ben: Iron it before you go out. Elena: All right, I still have a little time.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我的衬衫上有一道皱痕。本：出门前熨一下吧。埃莱娜：好，我还有一点时间。

messages.speaker: Elena（室友）
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tiwja fil-qmis tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tiwja fil-qmis tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我的衬衫上有一道皱痕。
messages.en: There's a crease in my shirt.

messages.speaker: Ben（室友）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddiha bil-ħadida qabel toħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddiha bil-ħadida qabel toħroġ.
messages.zh: 出门前熨一下吧。
messages.en: Iron it before you go out.

messages.speaker: Elena（室友）
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, għad għandi ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, għad għandi ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 好，我还有一点时间。
messages.en: All right, I still have a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把纸对折后再展开，手指沿着留下的那一道线划过：这条看得见、摸得到的折痕就是 tiwja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The stage of development during which a child's body changes towards sexual maturity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 儿童身体逐渐发生变化并走向性成熟的发育阶段，即青春期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu ta' żvilupp li fih il-ġisem tat-tfal jinbidel u jersaq lejn il-maturità sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 青春期；身体逐渐达到性成熟的发育阶段。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tispjega l-bidliet fil-ġisem li jseħħu waqt it-tixbib.
formal.en: The lesson explains the bodily changes that occur during puberty.
formal.zh: 这节课讲解青春期中发生的身体变化。

colloquial.mt: Adam: X'ifisser tixbib? Rita: Huwa ż-żmien meta l-ġisem jibda jinbidel lejn il-maturità sesswali. Adam: Mela l-lezzjoni tal-lum hija dwar dawn il-bidliet? Rita: Iva, eżatt.
colloquial.en: Adam: What does puberty mean? Rita: It's the time when the body starts changing towards sexual maturity. Adam: So today's lesson is about those changes? Rita: Yes, exactly.
colloquial.zh: 亚当：青春期是什么意思？丽塔：就是身体开始发生变化、逐渐走向性成熟的时期。亚当：那今天这节课就是讲这些变化吗？丽塔：对，正是。

messages.speaker: Adam（学生）
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser tixbib?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser tixbib?
messages.zh: 青春期是什么意思？
messages.en: What does puberty mean?

messages.speaker: Rita（教师）
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa ż-żmien meta l-ġisem jibda jinbidel lejn il-maturità sesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa ż-żmien meta l-ġisem jibda jinbidel lejn il-maturità sesswali.
messages.zh: 就是身体开始发生变化、逐渐走向性成熟的时期。
messages.en: It's the time when the body starts changing towards sexual maturity.

messages.speaker: Adam（学生）
messages.mt_spoken: Mela l-lezzjoni tal-lum hija dwar dawn il-bidliet?
messages.mt_standard: Mela l-lezzjoni tal-lum hija dwar dawn il-bidliet?
messages.zh: 那今天这节课就是讲这些变化吗？
messages.en: So today's lesson is about those changes?

messages.speaker: Rita（教师）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, eżatt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, eżatt.
messages.zh: 对，正是。
messages.en: Yes, exactly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tixbib 写在成长时间轴上身体开始走向性成熟的那一段，用发育阶段的画面记住青春期这个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A literary device that presents or explains something by comparing it with something else, including analogy, metaphor, allegory, and parable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过把某事物与另一事物相比较来表达或说明意义的文学手法，统称类比、隐喻、寓意表达、寓言等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mezz letterarju li jqabbel ħaġa ma' oħra biex jesprimi jew jispjega tifsira, bħal analoġija, metafora, allegorija jew parabbola.

sense_translations.en_definition: general term for a literary device where something is compared to something else: allegory, analogy, metaphor, parable
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某事物与另一事物相比较的文学手法的统称，包括寓意表达、类比、隐喻和寓言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terminu ġenerali għal mezz letterarju li jqabbel ħaġa ma' oħra, bħal allegorija, analoġija, metafora jew parabbola.

collocations.en: a comparison between life and a journey
collocations.zh: 将人生比作旅程的比喻

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, it-tixbiha bejn il-ħajja u vjaġġ tgħin lill-qarrej jifhem l-esperjenzi tal-personaġġ.
formal.en: In this text, the comparison between life and a journey helps the reader understand the character's experiences.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，将人生比作旅程的比喻帮助读者理解人物的经历。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-awtur iqabbel il-ħajja ma' vjaġġ? David: Din it-tixbiha turina li l-ħajja għandha stadji differenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the author compare life to a journey? David: This comparison shows us that life has different stages.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：作者为什么把人生比作旅程？戴维：这个比喻让我们看到，人生有不同的阶段。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-awtur iqabbel il-ħajja ma' vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-awtur iqabbel il-ħajja ma' vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 作者为什么把人生比作旅程？
messages.en: Why does the author compare life to a journey?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tixbiha turina li l-ħajja għandha stadji differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tixbiha turina li l-ħajja għandha stadji differenti.
messages.zh: 这个比喻让我们看到，人生有不同的阶段。
messages.en: This comparison shows us that life has different stages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“人生”和“旅程”画在两边，中间连一条比较线；看到这条线，就联想 tixbiha 所指的比喻或类比表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of making nets, or the process by which a net forms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作网的活动，也指网逐渐形成的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha jsiru x-xbieki, jew il-proċess li fih tifforma xibka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 织网；制作网的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li biha jsiru x-xbieki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网的形成；线或丝逐渐构成网的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih tifforma xibka.

collocations.en: the formation of a spider's web

formal.mt: Matul il-workshop, il-parteċipanti osservaw it-tixbik tax-xbieki tas-sajd u ppruvaw jagħmlu xibka żgħira.
formal.en: During the workshop, participants observed the making of fishing nets and tried to make a small net.
formal.zh: 在工作坊期间，参与者观看了渔网的编织过程，并尝试制作一张小网。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed titgħallem tagħmel illum? Toni: Qed nitgħallem it-tixbik; irrid nagħmel xibka żgħira għas-sajd.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you learning to do today? Toni: I'm learning net-making; I want to make a small fishing net.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天在学做什么？托尼：我在学织网，想做一张小渔网。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed titgħallem tagħmel illum?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed titgħallem tagħmel illum?
messages.zh: 你今天在学做什么？
messages.en: What are you learning to do today?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitgħallem it-tixbik; irrid nagħmel xibka żgħira għas-sajd.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitgħallem it-tixbik; irrid nagħmel xibka żgħira għas-sajd.
messages.zh: 我在学织网，想做一张小渔网。
messages.en: I'm learning net-making; I want to make a small fishing net.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把一根根线连成网：手在制作时是“织网”，网逐渐出现时是“网的形成”，两个画面都对应 tixbik。

gloss_zh: 沿竖直表面攀爬；从边缘探头张望

teaching_sense.en_definition: Climbing along a vertical surface, or looking over an edge to see what is beyond or below it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿竖直表面攀爬的动作，也指从边缘探头查看另一侧或下方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li titla' ma' wiċċ wieqaf, jew li tittawwal minn fuq xifer biex tara x'hemm warajh jew taħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿竖直表面攀爬。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li titla' ma' wiċċ wieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从边缘探头张望；越过边沿仔细查看。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tittawwal minn fuq xifer biex tara x'hemm fuq in-naħa l-oħra jew taħtu.

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni kienet tinkludi tixbit mal-ħajt taħt is-superviżjoni tal-għalliem u bl-użu ta' ħabel tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: The lesson included climbing up a wall under the teacher's supervision and with the use of a safety rope.
formal.zh: 这节课包括在教师监督下使用安全绳沿墙攀爬的练习。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid tipprova tixbit mal-ħajt? Mark: Iva, imma l-ewwel urini kif nuża l-ħabel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you want to try wall climbing? Mark: Yes, but first show me how to use the rope.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你想试试沿墙攀爬吗？马克：想，不过先教我怎么用绳子。

messages.speaker: Nina (攀爬教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tipprova tixbit mal-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tipprova tixbit mal-ħajt?
messages.zh: 你想试试沿墙攀爬吗？
messages.en: Do you want to try wall climbing?

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel urini kif nuża l-ħabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel urini kif nuża l-ħabel.
messages.zh: 想，不过先教我怎么用绳子。
messages.en: Yes, but first show me how to use the rope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作记 tixbit：先想象身体贴着竖墙向上爬，再想象头从边缘探出去看；分别对应攀爬和探头张望。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting on clothes, or of fitting a working animal with a harness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿上衣物的动作，也指给役用动物套上挽具的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jintlibsu l-ħwejjeġ, jew li jitqiegħed ix-xedd fuq annimal biex ikun jista' jiġbed tagħbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿衣；把衣服穿到身上的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li jintlibsu l-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 套挽具；给动物装上牵引车辆或负载用的挽具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li jitqiegħed ix-xedd fuq annimal.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq tal-karettun, il-bidwi temm it-tixdid taż-żiemel u ċċekkja li x-xedd kien imqiegħed sew.
formal.en: Before the cart set off, the farmer finished harnessing the horse and checked that the harness was properly fitted.
formal.zh: 马车出发前，农夫给马套好了挽具，并检查挽具是否安装妥当。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek qed tilbes? Pawlu: Iva, it-tixdid ta' dawn il-ħwejjeġ jieħu ftit ħin; hemm ħafna buttuni!
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you still getting dressed? Pawlu: Yes, putting on these clothes takes a little time; there are so many buttons!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你还在穿衣服吗？保罗：是啊，穿这些衣服要花点时间，纽扣太多了！

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek qed tilbes?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek qed tilbes?
messages.zh: 你还在穿衣服吗？
messages.en: Are you still getting dressed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tixdid ta' dawn il-ħwejjeġ jieħu ftit ħin; hemm ħafna buttuni!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tixdid ta' dawn il-ħwejjeġ jieħu ftit ħin; hemm ħafna buttuni!
messages.zh: 是啊，穿这些衣服要花点时间，纽扣太多了！
messages.en: Yes, putting on these clothes takes a little time; there are so many buttons!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tixdid 配成两幅学习图：人把衣服穿上身，马被套上挽具；记住它指这些动作的过程，而不是衣服或挽具本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pouting, or movement of the lips, often seen in animals such as horses when they smell something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 噘嘴的动作，也指嘴唇的活动，常见于马等动物闻嗅某物时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed joħroġ xufftejh 'il barra, jew il-moviment tax-xufftejn, spiss f'annimali bħaż-żwiemel meta jxommu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 噘嘴；把嘴唇向前突出的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed joħroġ xufftejh 'il barra.

sense_translations.en_definition: movement of the lips (often made by animals such as horses while smelling sth.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘴唇的活动，常指马等动物闻嗅某物时做出的唇部动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moviment tax-xufftejn, spiss magħmul minn annimali bħaż-żwiemel waqt li jxommu xi ħaġa.

collocations.en: the horse's lip movements while sniffing

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti nnutaw it-tixfif tax-xufftejn taż-żiemel meta xamm oġġett ġdid.
formal.en: During the observation, the students noticed the movement of the horse's lips when it smelled a new object.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，学生们注意到马闻到一个新物体时嘴唇的活动。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex qed tagħmel hekk b'xufftejk? Ben: Qed nuri t-tixfif; ara kif noħroġ xufftejja 'l barra.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why are you doing that with your lips? Ben: I'm demonstrating pouting; look how I push my lips out.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你为什么那样动嘴唇？本：我在示范噘嘴，看我怎样把嘴唇向前突出。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tagħmel hekk b'xufftejk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tagħmel hekk b'xufftejk?
messages.zh: 你为什么那样动嘴唇？
messages.en: Why are you doing that with your lips?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nuri t-tixfif; ara kif noħroġ xufftejja 'l barra.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nuri t-tixfif; ara kif noħroġ xufftejja 'l barra.
messages.zh: 我在示范噘嘴，看我怎样把嘴唇向前突出。
messages.en: I'm demonstrating pouting; look how I push my lips out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tixfif 时把注意力放在嘴唇：人的噘嘴是一幅图，马闻东西时嘴唇活动是另一幅图；不要只记成某一种情绪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making the cutting edge of a tool or blade sharp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使工具或刀片的刃口变锋利的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih ix-xifer ta' sikkina jew ta' għodda li taqta' jsir jaqta' aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨利；把刀刃或工具刃口磨锋利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xifer isir jaqta' aktar.

formal.mt: Wara t-tixfir tas-sikkina, il-kok seta' jqatta' l-ħaxix b'aktar preċiżjoni.
formal.en: After the knife was sharpened, the cook could cut the vegetables more precisely.
formal.zh: 刀磨利之后，厨师能够把蔬菜切得更精准。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Din is-sikkina ma taqtax sew. Karl: Għandha bżonn it-tixfir; ħalliha hawn u nieħu ħsiebha.
colloquial.en: Rita: This knife doesn't cut well. Karl: It needs sharpening; leave it here and I'll take care of it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这把刀不好切。卡尔：它需要磨一磨，放在这里，我来处理。

messages.speaker: Rita (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-sikkina ma taqtax sew.
messages.mt_standard: Din is-sikkina ma taqtax sew.
messages.zh: 这把刀不好切。
messages.en: This knife doesn't cut well.

messages.speaker: Karl (厨房同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha bżonn it-tixfir; ħalliha hawn u nieħu ħsiebha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha bżonn it-tixfir; ħalliha hawn u nieħu ħsiebha.
messages.zh: 它需要磨一磨，放在这里，我来处理。
messages.en: It needs sharpening; leave it here and I'll take care of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一把钝刀经过打磨，终于能顺畅切开蔬菜；把这个“由钝变利”的过程与 tixfir 绑定，而不是只记刀的样子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Conflict or bitter disagreement between people or groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人或群体之间的冲突、激烈争执或不和。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġlied jew tilwim qawwi bejn persuni jew gruppi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纷争；争斗；人与人或群体之间的冲突不和。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġlied jew tilwim bejn persuni jew gruppi.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa kellha l-għan li tnaqqas it-tixgħib bejn iż-żewġ gruppi u tiftaħ it-triq għad-djalogu.
formal.en: The meeting aimed to reduce strife between the two groups and open the way for dialogue.
formal.zh: 这次会议旨在减少两个群体之间的纷争，并为对话创造条件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għadu għaddej it-tixgħib bejn il-ġirien? Ġużeppi: Le, fl-aħħar tkellmu bil-kalma u ftiehmu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the strife between the neighbours still going on? Ġużeppi: No, they finally talked calmly and reached an agreement.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：邻居之间的纷争还在继续吗？朱塞佩：没有，他们终于平静地谈了谈，达成了一致。

messages.speaker: Marija (社区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu għaddej it-tixgħib bejn il-ġirien?
messages.mt_standard: Għadu għaddej it-tixgħib bejn il-ġirien?
messages.zh: 邻居之间的纷争还在继续吗？
messages.en: Is the strife between the neighbours still going on?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fl-aħħar tkellmu bil-kalma u ftiehmu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fl-aħħar tkellmu bil-kalma u ftiehmu.
messages.zh: 没有，他们终于平静地谈了谈，达成了一致。
messages.en: No, they finally talked calmly and reached an agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tixgħib 放进一幅双方争执、关系紧张的画面，再配一句“通过对话化解纷争”，用冲突与和解的场景记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming grey, especially the gradual greying of hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐变成灰白色的过程，尤其指头发逐渐变灰白。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir griża, speċjalment meta x-xagħar jibda jsir griż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变灰白的过程，尤指头发逐渐变灰白。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir griża, speċjalment ix-xagħar.

formal.mt: Ir-ritratti meħuda matul is-snin juru t-tixhib gradwali tax-xagħar tiegħu.
formal.en: The photographs taken over the years show the gradual greying of his hair.
formal.zh: 这些多年来拍摄的照片显示出他的头发逐渐变灰白的过程。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Qed nara ftit xagħar griż f'daqnek. Daniel: Iva, innutajt it-tixhib tad-daqna dan l-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Anna: I can see a few grey hairs in your beard. Daniel: Yes, I've noticed my beard greying lately.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我看见你的胡须里有几根灰白的了。丹尼尔：是啊，我最近注意到胡须开始变灰白了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nara ftit xagħar griż f'daqnek.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nara ftit xagħar griż f'daqnek.
messages.zh: 我看见你的胡须里有几根灰白的了。
messages.en: I can see a few grey hairs in your beard.

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, innutajt it-tixhib tad-daqna dan l-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, innutajt it-tixhib tad-daqna dan l-aħħar.
messages.zh: 是啊，我最近注意到胡须开始变灰白了。
messages.en: Yes, I've noticed my beard greying lately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象三张照片：深色头发、夹杂灰白、灰白增多；把照片之间逐渐变化的过程记作 tixhib，突出“变灰白”的动态意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process in which a person's hair becomes grey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人的头发逐渐变成灰白色的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih ix-xagħar ta' persuna jibda jsir griż jew abjad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头发变灰白；指人的头发逐渐变白的过程。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi t-tixjib tax-xagħar f'persuni ta' etajiet differenti.
formal.en: The study describes the greying of hair in people of different ages.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了不同年龄人群头发变灰白的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed nara aktar xagħar abjad ħdejn widnejja. Mark: Jien ukoll; it-tixjib tiegħi beda hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm noticing more white hairs near my ears. Mark: Me too; my greying started there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我发现耳朵旁边的白头发越来越多了。Mark：我也是；我的头发就是从那里开始变白的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nara aktar xagħar abjad ħdejn widnejja.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nara aktar xagħar abjad ħdejn widnejja.
messages.zh: 我发现耳朵旁边的白头发越来越多了。
messages.en: I'm noticing more white hairs near my ears.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll; it-tixjib tiegħi beda hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll; it-tixjib tiegħi beda hemm.
messages.zh: 我也是；我的头发就是从那里开始变白的。
messages.en: Me too; my greying started there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词贴在一张黑发逐渐夹杂白发的图片旁，专记头发颜色变化，并与表示整体衰老的 tixjiħ 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The making of a hole, usually with an awl or a similar pointed tool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常使用锥子或类似尖头工具打出孔洞的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih issir toqba, ġeneralment b'għodda bil-ponta.

sense_translations.en_definition: the boring of a hole (usually with an awl or similar implement)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打孔；通常指用锥子或类似工具穿出孔洞。

collocations.en: the boring of holes in leather

formal.mt: Qabel il-ħjata, l-artiġjan jagħmel it-tixjif tal-ġilda b'għodda bil-ponta.
formal.en: Before stitching, the craftsperson makes holes in the leather with a pointed tool.
formal.zh: 缝制前，工匠用尖头工具在皮革上穿孔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se tgħaddi l-ħajta minn din il-ġilda ħoxna? Mark: L-ewwel nagħmel it-tixjif b'din l-għodda bil-ponta, imbagħad ngħaddi l-ħajta.
colloquial.en: Maja: How will you get the thread through this thick leather? Mark: First I'll make the holes with this pointed tool, then pass the thread through.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么把线穿过这块厚皮革？Mark：我先用这件尖头工具打孔，然后再穿线。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se tgħaddi l-ħajta minn din il-ġilda ħoxna?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se tgħaddi l-ħajta minn din il-ġilda ħoxna?
messages.zh: 你怎么把线穿过这块厚皮革？
messages.en: How will you get the thread through this thick leather?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel nagħmel it-tixjif b'din l-għodda bil-ponta, imbagħad ngħaddi l-ħajta.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel nagħmel it-tixjif b'din l-għodda bil-ponta, imbagħad ngħaddi l-ħajta.
messages.zh: 我先用这件尖头工具打孔，然后再穿线。
messages.en: First I'll make the holes with this pointed tool, then pass the thread through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住皮革缝制的先后画面：尖头工具先穿出小孔，针线随后通过；这个词对应前面的打孔过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of reducing something to nothing or making it come to nothing; also, the act of lowering or demeaning oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物化为乌有或使努力等归于无效；也指贬低自身、自我卑下的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih xi ħaġa titwassal fix-xejn, jew li bih persuna tbaxxi lilha nnifisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使化为乌有；使计划、努力或成果等归于无效。
自我贬抑；使自己显得卑下或贬低自身价值。

collocations.en: the bringing of efforts to nought

formal.mt: L-awtur iwissi li n-nuqqas ta' kooperazzjoni jista' jwassal għat-tixjin tal-isforzi kollha tal-grupp.
formal.en: The author warns that a lack of cooperation can bring all the group's efforts to nought.
formal.zh: 作者提醒，缺乏合作可能使整个小组的努力付诸东流。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Biex inkun umli, irrid ngħid li ma niswa għal xejn? Mark: Le, dak tixjin tiegħek innifsek; tista' tkun umli u tagħraf il-valur tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: To be humble, do I have to say I'm worthless? Mark: No, that's self-abasement; you can be humble and recognize your own worth.
colloquial.zh: Maja：要谦虚，我就必须说自己一无是处吗？Mark：不用，那是自我贬抑；你可以既谦虚，又承认自己的价值。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inkun umli, irrid ngħid li ma niswa għal xejn?
messages.mt_standard: Biex inkun umli, irrid ngħid li ma niswa għal xejn?
messages.zh: 要谦虚，我就必须说自己一无是处吗？
messages.en: To be humble, do I have to say I'm worthless?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak tixjin tiegħek innifsek; tista' tkun umli u tagħraf il-valur tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak tixjin tiegħek innifsek; tista' tkun umli u tagħraf il-valur tiegħek.
messages.zh: 不用，那是自我贬抑；你可以既谦虚，又承认自己的价值。
messages.en: No, that's self-abasement; you can be humble and recognize your own worth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅归零画面记义：努力成果被抹成零对应化为乌有，把自己的价值说成零对应自我贬抑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of moving a hand or an object back and forth, often to greet someone or give a signal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将手或物体来回挥动的动作，常用于打招呼或发出信号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment tal-id jew ta' oġġett minn naħa għal oħra, spiss biex wieħed isellem jew jagħti sinjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挥动；挥手；将手或物体来回摆动的动作。

formal.mt: It-tixjir tal-bnadar mill-folla kompla sakemm il-parata għaddiet mill-pjazza.
formal.en: The crowd continued waving flags until the parade had passed through the square.
formal.zh: 人群持续挥动旗帜，直到游行队伍穿过广场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irnexxielek issibni f'dik il-folla? Mark: Bit-tixjir ta' idejk! Rajtek mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you manage to find me in that crowd? Mark: By your waving! I spotted you straight away.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那么多人，你怎么找到我的？Mark：靠你挥手呀！我一下就看到你了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielek issibni f'dik il-folla?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielek issibni f'dik il-folla?
messages.zh: 那么多人，你怎么找到我的？
messages.en: How did you manage to find me in that crowd?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-tixjir ta' idejk! Rajtek mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-tixjir ta' idejk! Rajtek mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 靠你挥手呀！我一下就看到你了。
messages.en: By your waving! I spotted you straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象车站里挥手告别，再把手换成旗帜：共同动作都是来回挥动，用这个画面记住名词所指的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of carding flax or similar materials to separate and align their fibres.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 梳理亚麻等材料，使纤维分开并排列整齐的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-fibri tal-kittien jew ta' materjal simili jinfirdu u jitqiegħdu fl-istess direzzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: carding (used of flax and such materials)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳理纤维，尤指梳理亚麻等材料。

formal.mt: Waqt il-wirja, l-artiġjana spjegat kif it-tixjit tal-kittien jifred il-fibri u jqegħedhom fl-istess direzzjoni.
formal.en: During the exhibition, the craftswoman explained how carding flax separates the fibres and aligns them in the same direction.
formal.zh: 展览期间，女工艺师讲解了梳麻如何将纤维分开，并使它们朝同一方向排列。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħaddi l-kittien minn din l-għodda? Rita: Dan huwa t-tixjit; bih nifred il-fibri u nġibhom fl-istess direzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you passing the flax through this tool? Rita: This is carding; I use it to separate the fibres and align them in the same direction.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把亚麻从这个工具里梳过去？丽塔：这是梳麻，用来把纤维分开，并让它们排列整齐。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħaddi l-kittien minn din l-għodda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħaddi l-kittien minn din l-għodda?
messages.zh: 你为什么把亚麻从这个工具里梳过去？
messages.en: Why are you passing the flax through this tool?

messages.speaker: Rita (工艺师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa t-tixjit; bih nifred il-fibri u nġibhom fl-istess direzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa t-tixjit; bih nifred il-fibri u nġibhom fl-istess direzzjoni.
messages.zh: 这是梳麻，用来把纤维分开，并让它们排列整齐。
messages.en: This is carding; I use it to separate the fibres and align them in the same direction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tixjit 配上一幅梳麻图：杂乱纤维经过梳理，变成同向排列的细丝；用这个画面记住“梳理纤维”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of growing older or developing changes associated with age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年龄增长或出现与年龄相关变化的过程，常指人的衰老。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih persuna tikber fl-età u tgħaddi minn bidliet marbuta mal-età.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衰老；老化；随年龄或时间增长而发生变化的过程。

formal.mt: Il-programm jippromwovi t-tixjiħ attiv permezz ta' attivitajiet soċjali u fiżiċi.
formal.en: The program promotes active aging through social and physical activities.
formal.zh: 该项目通过社交活动和身体活动促进积极老龄化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-nannu għadu jmur jiżfen kull ġimgħa! Mark: Sabiħ! It-tixjiħ ma jfissirx li wieħed irid jieqaf jagħmel dak li jħobb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Grandpa still goes dancing every week! Mark: Lovely! Aging doesn't mean you have to stop doing what you enjoy.
colloquial.zh: Maja：爷爷现在还每周去跳舞呢！Mark：真好！变老并不意味着必须停止做自己喜欢的事。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu għadu jmur jiżfen kull ġimgħa!
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu għadu jmur jiżfen kull ġimgħa!
messages.zh: 爷爷现在还每周去跳舞呢！
messages.en: Grandpa still goes dancing every week!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sabiħ! It-tixjiħ ma jfissirx li wieħed irid jieqaf jagħmel dak li jħobb.
messages.mt_standard: Sabiħ! It-tixjiħ ma jfissirx li wieħed irid jieqaf jagħmel dak li jħobb.
messages.zh: 真好！变老并不意味着必须停止做自己喜欢的事。
messages.en: Lovely! Aging doesn't mean you have to stop doing what you enjoy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用逐年翻动的生日相册记年龄增长的过程；tixjiħ 指整体变老，tixjib 则聚焦头发变灰白。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of piercing a material or making holes through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用尖物刺穿材料，或在材料上形成孔洞的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih materjal jittaqqab jew isirulu toqob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺穿；用尖物穿透材料的动作。
穿孔；在材料上打孔或形成孔洞。

formal.mt: It-tixkik tal-karta għandu jsir tul il-linja mmarkata, b'toqob żgħar u regolari.
formal.en: The paper should be perforated along the marked line, with small, evenly spaced holes.
formal.zh: 纸张应沿标记线打孔，孔洞要小，间距要均匀。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nuża din il-labra għat-tixkik tal-karta? Pawlu: Iva, imma poġġi biċċa kartun taħtha biex ma tagħmilx ħsara lill-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I use this needle to pierce the paper? Pawlu: Yes, but put a piece of cardboard underneath it so you don't damage the table.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我可以用这根针给纸打孔吗？保罗：可以，不过在纸下面垫块硬纸板，免得弄坏桌子。

messages.speaker: Lara (手工课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża din il-labra għat-tixkik tal-karta?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża din il-labra għat-tixkik tal-karta?
messages.zh: 我可以用这根针给纸打孔吗？
messages.en: Can I use this needle to pierce the paper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (手工课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma poġġi biċċa kartun taħtha biex ma tagħmilx ħsara lill-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma poġġi biċċa kartun taħtha biex ma tagħmilx ħsara lill-mejda.
messages.zh: 可以，不过在纸下面垫块硬纸板，免得弄坏桌子。
messages.en: Yes, but put a piece of cardboard underneath it so you don't damage the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tixkik 想成针尖穿过纸张的动作：先记“刺穿”，再看留下的小孔，连到“穿孔、打孔”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that obstructs an action or makes progress more difficult, or the interference it causes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使行动或进展变得困难的阻碍、妨碍，或造成这种困难的障碍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jfixkel azzjoni jew jagħmilha aktar diffiċli biex wieħed jimxi 'l quddiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阻碍；使行动或进展受限的因素。
妨碍；使事情难以顺利进行的干扰或阻力。
障碍；挡住去路或妨碍目标实现的事物。

collocations.en: to create an obstacle or hindrance

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' informazzjoni ħoloq tixkil fit-twettiq tal-proġett.
formal.en: The lack of information created an obstacle to carrying out the project.
formal.zh: 信息不足给项目的实施造成了阻碍。
