colloquial.mt: Mark: Dawn il-kaxxi qed joħolqu tixkil fil-kuritur. Sara: Se nċaqlaqhom issa biex kulħadd ikun jista' jgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Mark: These boxes are obstructing the corridor. Sara: I'll move them now so everyone can get through.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些箱子挡住走廊了。萨拉：我现在就把它们移开，让大家都能过去。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-kaxxi qed joħolqu tixkil fil-kuritur.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-kaxxi qed joħolqu tixkil fil-kuritur.
messages.zh: 这些箱子挡住走廊了。
messages.en: These boxes are obstructing the corridor.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nċaqlaqhom issa biex kulħadd ikun jista' jgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Se nċaqlaqhom issa biex kulħadd ikun jista' jgħaddi.
messages.zh: 我现在就把它们移开，让大家都能过去。
messages.en: I'll move them now so everyone can get through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“走廊里挡路的箱子”记 tixkil：它是眼前的障碍，也会给通行造成妨碍，再推广到工作中的阻力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The removal or breaking away of small pieces from the surface or edge of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体表面或边缘的小片被削下、碰掉或自行崩落的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija jew il-qlugħ ta' biċċiet żgħar minn wiċċ jew minn tarf ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小片的削落、崩落或剥落；如瓷器边缘崩缺。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni ġie nnutat tixlif fit-truf ta' diversi madumiet.
formal.en: During the inspection, chipping was noted along the edges of several tiles.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，几块瓷砖的边缘出现了崩缺。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dan it-tixlif fit-tarf tal-platt. Toni: Iva, biċċa żgħira nqalgħet meta ħabat mal-mejda.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at this chipping on the edge of the plate. Toni: Yes, a small piece broke off when it hit the table.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看看盘子边缘这个崩口。托尼：是啊，盘子撞到桌子时掉了一小片。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan it-tixlif fit-tarf tal-platt.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan it-tixlif fit-tarf tal-platt.
messages.zh: 看看盘子边缘这个崩口。
messages.en: Look at this chipping on the edge of the plate.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biċċa żgħira nqalgħet meta ħabat mal-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biċċa żgħira nqalgħet meta ħabat mal-mejda.
messages.zh: 是啊，盘子撞到桌子时掉了一小片。
messages.en: Yes, a small piece broke off when it hit the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tixlif 时想象盘沿碰掉一小片：重点是“小片脱落”的画面，瓷砖崩边和漆层剥落都能帮助联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of one's left hand to perform an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用自己的左手完成某个动作或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu tal-id ix-xellugija biex wieħed jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用左手；以左手进行操作或活动。

collocations.en: use of the left hand when writing
use of the left hand when eating

formal.mt: L-osservazzjoni kienet tiffoka fuq it-tixlig waqt il-kitba u waqt attivitajiet oħra ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The observation focused on the use of the left hand during writing and other everyday activities.
formal.zh: 这项观察重点关注写字及其他日常活动中使用左手的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tixlig? Ben: Ifisser li tuża l-id ix-xellugija, bħal meta nikteb jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tixlig mean? Ben: It means using your left hand, like I do when I write.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：tixlig 是什么意思？本：就是使用左手，比如我写字时就是这样。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tixlig?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tixlig?
messages.zh: tixlig 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tixlig mean?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tuża l-id ix-xellugija, bħal meta nikteb jien.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tuża l-id ix-xellugija, bħal meta nikteb jien.
messages.zh: 就是使用左手，比如我写字时就是这样。
messages.en: It means using your left hand, like I do when I write.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tixlig 配上“左手握笔”的图片，把词义固定为使用左手这一行为；再用左手拿勺子的场景巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Temporary stitching used to hold pieces of garment fabric in place before the final sewing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作衣服时，为固定布片位置而在正式缝合前进行的临时缝合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħjata temporanja li żżomm biċċiet tad-drapp f'posthom qabel il-ħjata finali ta' libsa.

sense_translations.en_definition: tacking (used in the context of sewing garments)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 疏缝；假缝，指制作衣服时用于暂时固定布片的缝合。

formal.mt: Qabel il-ħjata finali, it-tixlil iżomm il-biċċiet tad-drapp f'posthom waqt il-prova tal-libsa.
formal.en: Before the final sewing, tacking holds the fabric pieces in place during the garment fitting.
formal.zh: 正式缝合之前，疏缝可以在试衣时将各块布片固定在原位。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-ħjata se tibqa' fil-libsa? Rita: Le, dan huwa tixlil; ineħħuh wara li nagħmlu l-ħjata finali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Will this stitching stay in the garment? Rita: No, this is tacking; we'll remove it after we do the final sewing.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这些针脚会留在衣服上吗？丽塔：不会，这是临时疏缝，正式缝好后就拆掉。

messages.speaker: Lara (裁缝学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-ħjata se tibqa' fil-libsa?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-ħjata se tibqa' fil-libsa?
messages.zh: 这些针脚会留在衣服上吗？
messages.en: Will this stitching stay in the garment?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan huwa tixlil; ineħħuh wara li nagħmlu l-ħjata finali.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan huwa tixlil; ineħħuh wara li nagħmlu l-ħjata finali.
messages.zh: 不会，这是临时疏缝，正式缝好后就拆掉。
messages.en: No, this is tacking; we'll remove it after we do the final sewing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tixlil 记成衣服上的“临时定位线”：先把布片粗略缝住，试好位置再正式缝合，临时线随后拆除。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The application of wax to a surface, or the covering of something with a layer of wax.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面涂上蜡，或用一层蜡覆盖物体的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wiċċ jinkesa b'saff ta' xama'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给物体表面上蜡；在表面涂蜡的处理过程。
用蜡覆盖；在物体上形成一层蜡。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tixmigħ tal-għamara, il-wiċċ għandu jkun nadif u niexef.
formal.en: Before the furniture is waxed, its surface should be clean and dry.
formal.zh: 给家具上蜡之前，表面应保持清洁、干燥。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se tagħmel wara li tnaddaf il-mejda? Sara: Se nibda t-tixmigħ; se ngħatti l-wiċċ b'saff irqiq ta' xama'.
colloquial.en: Mark: What will you do after cleaning the table? Sara: I'll start waxing it; I'll cover the surface with a thin layer of wax.
colloquial.zh: 马克：擦干净桌子后，你准备做什么？萨拉：开始上蜡，给桌面涂一层薄蜡。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se tagħmel wara li tnaddaf il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: X'se tagħmel wara li tnaddaf il-mejda?
messages.zh: 擦干净桌子后，你准备做什么？
messages.en: What will you do after cleaning the table?

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nibda t-tixmigħ; se ngħatti l-wiċċ b'saff irqiq ta' xama'.
messages.mt_standard: Se nibda t-tixmigħ; se ngħatti l-wiċċ b'saff irqiq ta' xama'.
messages.zh: 开始上蜡，给桌面涂一层薄蜡。
messages.en: I'll start waxing it; I'll cover the surface with a thin layer of wax.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“给木桌涂一层薄蜡”的动作记 tixmigħ：动手涂是上蜡，涂后表面有蜡层是覆蜡，两个义项连成同一画面。

gloss_zh: 蹭取东西；揩油；依赖别人供养

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of getting things from others without paying, or relying on them for support without contributing fairly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向别人蹭取免费物品，或自己不作相应付出而依赖别人提供生活所需的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed jikseb affarijiet mingħand ħaddieħor mingħajr ma jħallas, jew jgħix fuq ħaddieħor mingħajr ma jagħti sehmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹭取东西；向别人讨要或设法获取免费物品、钱财等。
揩油；自己不作相应付出而依赖别人供养或承担费用。

collocations.zh: 向朋友蹭东西或占便宜

collocations.en: to live by sponging off others

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont juri kif it-tixmiq kontinwu tal-karattru prinċipali jagħmel ħsara lir-relazzjonijiet tiegħu mal-ħbieb.
formal.en: The story shows how the main character's constant sponging damages his relationships with his friends.
formal.zh: 这个故事展现了主人公不断占朋友便宜的行为如何损害彼此的关系。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Terġa' tħallasli l-kafè llum? Nina: Dan it-tixmiq kuljum ma jistax jibqa' sejjer; illum imiss lilek tħallas.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Will you pay for my coffee again today? Nina: This daily sponging can't go on; today it's your turn to pay.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：今天再替我付咖啡钱好吗？妮娜：不能天天这样蹭下去，今天轮到你付钱了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Terġa' tħallasli l-kafè llum?
messages.mt_standard: Terġa' tħallasli l-kafè llum?
messages.zh: 今天再替我付咖啡钱好吗？
messages.en: Will you pay for my coffee again today?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tixmiq kuljum ma jistax jibqa' sejjer; illum imiss lilek tħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tixmiq kuljum ma jistax jibqa' sejjer; illum imiss lilek tħallas.
messages.zh: 不能天天这样蹭下去，今天轮到你付钱了。
messages.en: This daily sponging can't go on; today it's your turn to pay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“每天喝咖啡都等朋友付钱”的情景记 tixmiq：蹭一次东西对应蹭取，长期靠别人承担开销对应揩油度日。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of rolling up one's sleeves, especially before doing practical work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣袖向上卷起的动作，尤其指动手干活前挽起袖子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed ixammar il-kmiem, speċjalment qabel jibda xi xogħol bl-idejn.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of rolling up one's sleeves
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷起自己衣袖的动作；挽袖。

collocations.en: rolling up one's sleeves before work

formal.mt: It-tixmir tal-kmiem qabel il-ħasil tal-platti jgħin biex il-kmiem ma jixxarrbux.
formal.en: Rolling up one's sleeves before washing the dishes helps keep the sleeves dry.
formal.zh: 洗碗前卷起衣袖，有助于避免袖子弄湿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dejjem inxarrab il-kmiem meta naħsel il-platti. Mark: Ibda bit-tixmir tal-kmiem, u mbagħad aħsel il-platti.
colloquial.en: Maja: I always get my sleeves wet when I wash the dishes. Mark: Start by rolling up your sleeves, then wash the dishes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我洗碗时总会弄湿袖子。马克：先把袖子卷起来，再洗碗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dejjem inxarrab il-kmiem meta naħsel il-platti.
messages.mt_standard: Dejjem inxarrab il-kmiem meta naħsel il-platti.
messages.zh: 我洗碗时总会弄湿袖子。
messages.en: I always get my sleeves wet when I wash the dishes.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibda bit-tixmir tal-kmiem, u mbagħad aħsel il-platti.
messages.mt_standard: Ibda bit-tixmir tal-kmiem, u mbagħad aħsel il-platti.
messages.zh: 先把袖子卷起来，再洗碗。
messages.en: Start by rolling up your sleeves, then wash the dishes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和洗碗前卷袖子的画面绑定：先挽袖，再动手，记住它表示动作。

gloss_zh: 日光浴；把东西放在太阳下晒

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sunbathing, or the act of putting something out in the sun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人在太阳下晒日光浴，或把物品放到太阳下晾晒的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed joqgħod fix-xemx jew iqiegħed xi ħaġa fix-xemx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日光浴；让身体晒太阳。

sense_translations.en_definition: letting sth. out in the sun
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物放在太阳下晒；晾晒。

collocations.en: putting bedding out in the sun

formal.mt: It-tixmix tal-friex sar fil-bitħa, fejn kien hemm biżżejjed spazju biex jinfirex kollox.
formal.en: The bedding was put out in the sun in the courtyard, where there was enough space to spread everything out.
formal.zh: 被褥放在院子里晾晒，那里有足够的空间把所有东西铺开。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tmur il-bajja għat-tixmix? Nina: Iva, imma nippreferi noqgħod ftit biss fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to go to the beach to sunbathe? Nina: Yes, but I prefer to spend only a little time in the sun.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：想去海滩晒日光浴吗？妮娜：想，不过我只想晒一小会儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tmur il-bajja għat-tixmix?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tmur il-bajja għat-tixmix?
messages.zh: 想去海滩晒日光浴吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to the beach to sunbathe?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nippreferi noqgħod ftit biss fix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nippreferi noqgħod ftit biss fix-xemx.
messages.zh: 想，不过我只想晒一小会儿。
messages.en: Yes, but I prefer to spend only a little time in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一束阳光串起两个场景：人躺着晒是日光浴，被褥铺着晒是晾晒。

gloss_zh: 响亮的吸气；有明显声响的吸气动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of breathing in with a loud, clearly audible sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吸入空气时发出明显而响亮声音的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed jieħu n-nifs 'il ġewwa b'ħoss qawwi li jinstema' ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 响亮的吸气；吸气时发出明显的声音。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni jinstema' tixniq qawwi eżatt qabel ma l-attur jibda jitkellem.
formal.en: A loud inhalation can be heard in the recording just before the actor starts speaking.
formal.zh: 录音中可以听到演员开口说话前发出的一声明显吸气声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak it-tixniq kien tiegħek? Mark: Iva, ħadt nifs b'ħoss qawwi meta rajt il-brimba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was that loud inhalation yours? Mark: Yes, I breathed in loudly when I saw the spider.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才那声响亮的吸气是你发出的吗？马克：是啊，我看见蜘蛛时猛地吸了一口气，声音很大。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tixniq kien tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tixniq kien tiegħek?
messages.zh: 刚才那声响亮的吸气是你发出的吗？
messages.en: Was that loud inhalation yours?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadt nifs b'ħoss qawwi meta rajt il-brimba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadt nifs b'ħoss qawwi meta rajt il-brimba.
messages.zh: 是啊，我看见蜘蛛时猛地吸了一口气，声音很大。
messages.en: Yes, I breathed in loudly when I saw the spider.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看见蜘蛛时发出的吸气声，把注意力放在空气向内吸和声音响亮这两点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of dipping or dunking something into a liquid, or leaving it in the liquid to soak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品蘸入或浸入液体的动作，也可指让物品留在液体中浸泡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed idaħħal xi ħaġa f'likwidu għal ftit ħin jew iħalliha fih biex tixxarrab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蘸；把物品短暂地浸入液体。
把物品按入或浸入液体，如把饼干浸进饮料。
浸泡；让物品留在液体中吸收水分。

formal.mt: It-tixpip tal-ħobż fil-ħalib huwa l-ewwel pass f'din ir-riċetta; wara, il-ħobż jitħallat mal-bqija tal-ingredjenti.
formal.en: Soaking the bread in milk is the first step in this recipe; afterwards, the bread is mixed with the remaining ingredients.
formal.zh: 这份食谱的第一步是把面包浸泡在牛奶里，随后再将面包与其余食材混合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-gallettina tiegħek waqgħet fit-te? Pawlu: Ħallejtha wisq; it-tixpip irattabha malajr!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did your biscuit fall into the tea? Pawlu: I left it in too long; dunking softens it quickly!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的饼干怎么掉进茶里了？保罗：我泡得太久了，浸一下很快就软了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-gallettina tiegħek waqgħet fit-te?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-gallettina tiegħek waqgħet fit-te?
messages.zh: 你的饼干怎么掉进茶里了？
messages.en: Why did your biscuit fall into the tea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejtha wisq; it-tixpip irattabha malajr!
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejtha wisq; it-tixpip irattabha malajr!
messages.zh: 我泡得太久了，浸一下很快就软了！
messages.en: I left it in too long; dunking softens it quickly!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用饼干入茶的时间轴记忆：碰一下是蘸，浸进去是浸入，留久一点就是浸泡。

gloss_zh: 制作陶片；把陶土制品弄成碎片

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making clay shards, for example by breaking a clay object into pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作陶土碎片的行为，例如把陶土制品打碎，使其成为陶片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li jsiru biċċiet miksura tat-tafal, pereżempju billi jitkisser oġġett tat-tafal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作陶土碎片；使陶土制品形成碎陶片。

collocations.zh: 把陶土花盆弄成碎陶片
把陶土盘子弄成碎陶片

formal.mt: It-tixqif ta' qsari qodma tat-tafal sar biex jitħejjew biċċiet għal proġett tal-arti.
formal.en: Old clay pots were broken into shards to prepare pieces for an art project.
formal.zh: 旧陶土花盆被弄成碎陶片，为一个艺术项目准备材料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn ġibt dawn il-biċċiet tat-tafal? Toni: Mit-tixqif ta' borma qadima; se nużahom fil-mużajk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you get these clay pieces? Toni: From breaking an old clay pot into shards; I'm going to use them in the mosaic.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些陶片是从哪里来的？托尼：是把一个旧陶罐弄碎得到的，我打算用它们做马赛克。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġibt dawn il-biċċiet tat-tafal?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġibt dawn il-biċċiet tat-tafal?
messages.zh: 这些陶片是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did you get these clay pieces?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mit-tixqif ta' borma qadima; se nużahom fil-mużajk.
messages.mt_standard: Mit-tixqif ta' borma qadima; se nużahom fil-mużajk.
messages.zh: 是把一个旧陶罐弄碎得到的，我打算用它们做马赛克。
messages.en: From breaking an old clay pot into shards; I'm going to use them in the mosaic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整只陶罐变成一片片陶片的画面当作记忆卡，重点记住制造碎陶片的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formation or making of cracks, or the act of slitting something open.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 裂缝的形成或造成裂缝的行为，也可指把物品割开一道口子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-formazzjoni ta' xquq jew l-azzjoni li jsiru xquq f'xi ħaġa, jew li tinfetaħ b'qatgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开裂；产生或造成裂缝。
割开；切开一道狭长的口子。

collocations.en: slitting a bag open with a knife

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tixqiq tal-ħajt ħdejn it-tieqa u jinkludi ritratti tax-xquq.
formal.en: The report describes the cracking of the wall near the window and includes photographs of the cracks.
formal.zh: 报告描述了窗户附近墙体的开裂情况，并附有裂缝照片。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed tieħu ritratt tal-ħajt? Maja: Biex nuri t-tixqiq lis-sid; ara dawn ix-xquq ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you taking a photo of the wall? Maja: To show the landlord the cracking; look at these cracks near the window.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么拍这面墙？玛雅：我要把开裂情况给房东看，你看窗户旁边这些裂缝。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tieħu ritratt tal-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tieħu ritratt tal-ħajt?
messages.zh: 你为什么拍这面墙？
messages.en: Why are you taking a photo of the wall?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nuri t-tixqiq lis-sid; ara dawn ix-xquq ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nuri t-tixqiq lis-sid; ara dawn ix-xquq ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 我要把开裂情况给房东看，你看窗户旁边这些裂缝。
messages.en: To show the landlord the cracking; look at these cracks near the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一道细长的口子串联两义：墙上出现的是裂缝，袋上用刀划出的是割口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making something wet, thoroughly drenching it, or soaking it in liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物品变湿、完全湿透，或让物品浸泡在液体中的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li xi ħaġa tixxarrab, tixxarrab għalkollox jew titħalla f'likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浸透；使物品完全湿透。
弄湿；使物品沾上水分。
浸泡；让物品在液体中充分吸收水分。

formal.mt: It-tixrib tal-ħwejjeġ fl-ilma qabel il-ħasil jgħin biex jinħall il-ħmieġ.
formal.en: Soaking clothes in water before washing helps loosen the dirt.
formal.zh: 洗涤前把衣物浸泡在水中，有助于使污垢松脱。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ħallejt il-qmis fl-ilma? Sara: Għat-tixrib; se naħsilha wara ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you leave the shirt in the water? Sara: To soak it; I'll wash it in a little while.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么把衬衫留在水里？萨拉：让它泡一泡，我过一会儿再洗。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallejt il-qmis fl-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallejt il-qmis fl-ilma?
messages.zh: 你为什么把衬衫留在水里？
messages.en: Why did you leave the shirt in the water?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tixrib; se naħsilha wara ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tixrib; se naħsilha wara ftit.
messages.zh: 让它泡一泡，我过一会儿再洗。
messages.en: To soak it; I'll wash it in a little while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衣服从沾水到湿透，再到留在盆里浸泡，用水分增加的画面记住三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of scattering things over an area, or of people or things dispersing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品撒布到一片区域的行为，或人、物从一处散开、分散的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li affarijiet jitqassmu fuq żona, jew il-proċess li nies jew affarijiet jinfirxu minn post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撒布；把物品分散撒到各处。
散开；人或物从一处向不同地方分散。

formal.mt: It-tixrid taż-żerriegħa sar b'mod uniformi fuq il-wiċċ tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: The seeds were scattered evenly over the surface of the soil.
formal.zh: 种子被均匀地撒在土壤表面。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex qed timxi madwar il-ġnien b'dik il-borża? Lara: Qed nagħmel it-tixrid taż-żerriegħa; irrid il-fjuri f'kull rokna.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why are you walking around the garden with that bag? Lara: I'm scattering the seeds; I want flowers in every corner.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你为什么提着那个袋子在花园里走来走去？拉拉：我在撒种子，我希望每个角落都有花。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed timxi madwar il-ġnien b'dik il-borża?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed timxi madwar il-ġnien b'dik il-borża?
messages.zh: 你为什么提着那个袋子在花园里走来走去？
messages.en: Why are you walking around the garden with that bag?

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel it-tixrid taż-żerriegħa; irrid il-fjuri f'kull rokna.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel it-tixrid taż-żerriegħa; irrid il-fjuri f'kull rokna.
messages.zh: 我在撒种子，我希望每个角落都有花。
messages.en: I'm scattering the seeds; I want flowers in every corner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象种子从一只手撒向四周，再联想到人群向四方散开，抓住从集中到分散的画面。

gloss_zh: 与人或组织建立联系；加入交往

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of associating oneself with another person or with an organisation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使自己与某个人或某个组织建立联系、参与其交往的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jissieħeb jew jidħol f'relazzjoni ma' persuna jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: association of oneself with a person or organisation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己与某个人或组织建立联系或交往。

formal.mt: It-tixrik ma' organizzazzjoni lokali jista' jgħin lill-istudenti jieħdu sehem fil-ħajja tal-komunità.
formal.en: Association with a local organisation can help students participate in community life.
formal.zh: 与当地组织建立联系，可以帮助学生参与社区生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jista' jagħtini t-tixrik ma' dan il-grupp? Pawlu: Tista' ssir taf nies ġodda u taħdem magħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What could associating with this group offer me? Pawlu: You could meet new people and work with them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：与这个团体建立联系能给我带来什么？保罗：你可以认识新朋友，并和他们一起做事。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jista' jagħtini t-tixrik ma' dan il-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: X'jista' jagħtini t-tixrik ma' dan il-grupp?
messages.zh: 与这个团体建立联系能给我带来什么？
messages.en: What could associating with this group offer me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' ssir taf nies ġodda u taħdem magħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' ssir taf nies ġodda u taħdem magħhom.
messages.zh: 你可以认识新朋友，并和他们一起做事。
messages.en: You could meet new people and work with them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己走进一个社团，与成员握手建立联系；用这个参与交往的画面记住 tixrik。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of producing whey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生或制取乳清这一液体的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih jiġi prodott ix-xorrox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生或制取乳清。

collocations.en: the production of whey during cheesemaking
collocations.zh: 制作奶酪时乳清的产生

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudenta ddeskriviet it-tixrix li osservat waqt il-produzzjoni tal-ġobon.
formal.en: In the report, the student described the production of whey that she observed during cheesemaking.
formal.zh: 这名学生在报告中描述了她在制作奶酪时观察到的乳清产生过程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta nistgħu naraw it-tixrix? Toni: Ejja eqreb, u nurik ix-xorrox li qed jinġabar.
colloquial.en: Sara: When can we see whey being produced? Toni: Come closer, and I will show you the whey that is collecting.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：什么时候能看到乳清产生？托尼：走近一点，我给你看看正在积聚的乳清。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta nistgħu naraw it-tixrix?
messages.mt_standard: Meta nistgħu naraw it-tixrix?
messages.zh: 什么时候能看到乳清产生？
messages.en: When can we see whey being produced?

messages.speaker: Toni (奶酪制作师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja eqreb, u nurik ix-xorrox li qed jinġabar.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja eqreb, u nurik ix-xorrox li qed jinġabar.
messages.zh: 走近一点，我给你看看正在积聚的乳清。
messages.en: Come closer, and I will show you the whey that is collecting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tixrix 配上奶酪制作旁收集乳清的画面，重点记住它表示产生乳清的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An excessive amount of work that places a heavy burden on someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 超出适当程度、使人负担沉重的工作或劳作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol żejjed li jgħabbi u jgħejji lil min jagħmlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过多的工作；过度劳作。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li t-tixtib bla waqfien ħalla lill-ħaddiema għajjenin ħafna.
formal.en: The report indicates that relentless overwork left the workers extremely tired.
formal.zh: 报告指出，持续不断的过度劳作使工人们极其疲惫。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-tixtib kollu qed jgħajjini. Lara: Poġġi ftit; jien inkompli b'din il-biċċa.
colloquial.en: Mark: All this overwork is wearing me out. Lara: Sit down for a bit; I will carry on with this part.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这么多工作快把我累垮了。拉拉：坐下歇一会儿，这部分我来接着做。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tixtib kollu qed jgħajjini.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tixtib kollu qed jgħajjini.
messages.zh: 这么多工作快把我累垮了。
messages.en: All this overwork is wearing me out.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġi ftit; jien inkompli b'din il-biċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġi ftit; jien inkompli b'din il-biċċa.
messages.zh: 坐下歇一会儿，这部分我来接着做。
messages.en: Sit down for a bit; I will carry on with this part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上工作越堆越高，人累得趴下；用工作多到吃不消的画面记住 tixtib。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of putting plants into the ground so that they can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把植物栽入土中，让其生长的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha jitqiegħdu pjanti fil-ħamrija biex jikbru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种植；把植物栽入土中的活动。

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera lestew it-tixtil tas-siġar fil-ġnien tal-iskola.
formal.en: The volunteers completed the planting of trees in the school garden.
formal.zh: 志愿者们完成了学校花园里的植树工作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nibdew it-tixtil tat-tadam illum? Ġużi: Iva, il-pjanti lesti u l-ħamrija wkoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we start planting the tomatoes today? Ġużi: Yes, the plants are ready, and so is the soil.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们今天开始栽番茄吗？朱齐：好，番茄苗准备好了，土也准备好了。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew it-tixtil tat-tadam illum?
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew it-tixtil tat-tadam illum?
messages.zh: 我们今天开始栽番茄吗？
messages.en: Shall we start planting the tomatoes today?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-pjanti lesti u l-ħamrija wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-pjanti lesti u l-ħamrija wkoll.
messages.zh: 好，番茄苗准备好了，土也准备好了。
messages.en: Yes, the plants are ready, and so is the soil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用双手把小苗栽进土里的动作记住 tixtil，再搭配树木和蔬菜两个种植场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition of being skewed, asymmetrical, or uneven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状、位置或表面歪斜、不对称或不平整的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa li tkun mgħawġa, mhux simmetrika jew mhux invellata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 歪斜；偏离端正位置或方向的状态。
不对称；两侧或对应部分不相称的状态。
不平整；表面或高度不均匀的状态。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni żvelat tixtir fil-qafas tat-tieqa, li ma kienx allinjat sew mal-ħajt.
formal.en: The inspection revealed skewness in the window frame, which was not properly aligned with the wall.
formal.zh: 检查发现窗框歪斜，没有与墙体正确对齐。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Qed tara t-tixtir f'dan il-qafas? David: Iva, in-naħa tax-xellug hija ogħla. Ejja niddrittawh.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can you see the skewness in this frame? David: Yes, the left side is higher. Let's straighten it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你看出这个框歪了吗？戴维：看出来了，左边高一些。我们把它摆正吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara t-tixtir f'dan il-qafas?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara t-tixtir f'dan il-qafas?
messages.zh: 你看出这个框歪了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the skewness in this frame?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, in-naħa tax-xellug hija ogħla. Ejja niddrittawh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, in-naħa tax-xellug hija ogħla. Ejja niddrittawh.
messages.zh: 看出来了，左边高一些。我们把它摆正吧。
messages.en: Yes, the left side is higher. Let's straighten it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三个小图来记 tixtir：歪掉的画框、左右不对称的图形、凹凸不平的表面。

gloss_zh: 多刺；粗糙织物引起的刺肤感

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being thorny, or an uncomfortable prickling sensation caused by coarse fabric against the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有许多刺的性质，或粗糙织物接触皮肤时造成的不适刺扎感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa mimlija xewk, jew is-sensazzjoni skomda ta' drapp aħrax li jniggeż il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多刺的性质或状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: unpleasant sensation of prickling against the skin caused by coarse fabric
sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗糙织物接触皮肤时引起的不舒服的刺扎感。

collocations.en: the prickling caused by the fabric

formal.mt: Minħabba t-tixwik tad-drapp, il-klijenta talbet kisja aktar ratba għall-ġakketta.
formal.en: Because of the prickling caused by the fabric, the customer requested a softer lining for the jacket.
formal.zh: 由于布料扎皮肤，顾客要求给夹克换上更柔软的衬里。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ma niflaħx it-tixwik ta' dan il-ġerż. Anna: Ipprova ilbes flokk artab taħtu.
colloquial.en: Rita: I can't stand the prickling from this sweater. Anna: Try wearing a soft shirt underneath it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这件毛衣扎得我受不了。安娜：试试在里面穿件柔软的上衣。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma niflaħx it-tixwik ta' dan il-ġerż.
messages.mt_standard: Ma niflaħx it-tixwik ta' dan il-ġerż.
messages.zh: 这件毛衣扎得我受不了。
messages.en: I can't stand the prickling from this sweater.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova ilbes flokk artab taħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova ilbes flokk artab taħtu.
messages.zh: 试试在里面穿件柔软的上衣。
messages.en: Try wearing a soft shirt underneath it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把灌木上的刺和毛衣扎皮肤的感觉连在一起，帮助记住 tixwik 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or feeling of wishing for or desiring something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希望某事发生或渴望得到某物的行为与心情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew is-sentiment li wieħed jixtieq xi ħaġa jew jixtieq li jiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；心中盼望某事发生。
渴望；想要得到某物或实现某事。

collocations.en: a desire for a better life

formal.mt: Il-poeżija tesprimi tixwiq qawwi għall-paċi u għal ħajja aħjar.
formal.en: The poem expresses a strong longing for peace and a better life.
formal.zh: 这首诗表达了对和平与更好生活的强烈向往。

colloquial.mt: Luca: It-tixwiq tiegħi għal vaganza qed jikber kuljum. Marija: Mela ejja nippjanaw ftit jiem ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Luca: My longing for a holiday is growing every day. Marija: Then let's plan a few days by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我一天比一天更想去度假。玛丽娅：那我们就计划去海边待几天吧。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tixwiq tiegħi għal vaganza qed jikber kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: It-tixwiq tiegħi għal vaganza qed jikber kuljum.
messages.zh: 我一天比一天更想去度假。
messages.en: My longing for a holiday is growing every day.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja nippjanaw ftit jiem ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja nippjanaw ftit jiem ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 那我们就计划去海边待几天吧。
messages.en: Then let's plan a few days by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象心里装着一个愿望气泡，里面是和平、假期或更好的生活，用它记住 tixwiq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of singeing or scorching something through exposure to flame or strong heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体接触火焰或强热后，表面被燎烧或灼焦的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa tinħaraq ħafif jew tinxtorob fil-wiċċ minħabba fjamma jew sħana qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燎烧；使毛发、纤维或物体表面受到轻微烧灼。
灼焦；使物体表面因高温而焦黄或烧焦。

formal.mt: L-istudenta osservat it-tixwit tad-drapp meta l-ħadida tal-mogħdija kienet sħuna wisq.
formal.en: The student observed the scorching of the fabric when the iron was too hot.
formal.zh: 熨斗温度过高时，这名学生观察到了布料被灼焦的现象。

colloquial.mt: Ben: X'inhi din ir-riħa? Elena: Ġejja mit-tixwit tal-flokk; il-ħadida kienet sħuna wisq.
colloquial.en: Ben: What's that smell? Elena: It's from the shirt getting scorched; the iron was too hot.
colloquial.zh: 本：这是什么味道？埃莱娜：是上衣被烫焦的味道，熨斗太热了。

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din ir-riħa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din ir-riħa?
messages.zh: 这是什么味道？
messages.en: What's that smell?

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġejja mit-tixwit tal-flokk; il-ħadida kienet sħuna wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Ġejja mit-tixwit tal-flokk; il-ħadida kienet sħuna wisq.
messages.zh: 是上衣被烫焦的味道，熨斗太热了。
messages.en: It's from the shirt getting scorched; the iron was too hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象熨斗太热，在衣服表面留下焦痕；再联想火焰燎到毛发，用两个画面记住 tixwit。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of urging or provoking someone to do something, especially something harmful or wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼓动或刺激别人采取某种行动的行为，尤指煽动或唆使他人做有害或不当的事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħeġġeġ jew jipprovoka lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel xi ħaġa, speċjalment xi ħaġa ħażina jew ta' ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煽动；鼓动别人采取某种行动，尤指有害或不当行为。
唆使；挑动或促使别人发起某种行动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkundanna t-tixwix għall-vjolenza u jħeġġeġ diskussjoni paċifika.
formal.en: The report condemns incitement to violence and encourages peaceful discussion.
formal.zh: 报告谴责煽动暴力的行为，并鼓励和平讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħidlu biex jibda ġlieda? Dan tixwix. Mark: Għandek raġun. Se ngħidlu biex jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you telling him to start a fight? That's incitement. Mark: You're right. I'll tell him to calm down.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么叫他挑起打斗？这是煽动。马克：你说得对。我会叫他冷静下来。

messages.speaker: 玛雅（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħidlu biex jibda ġlieda? Dan tixwix.
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħidlu biex jibda ġlieda? Dan tixwix.
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他挑起打斗？这是煽动。
messages.en: Why are you telling him to start a fight? That's incitement.

messages.speaker: 马克（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Se ngħidlu biex jikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Se ngħidlu biex jikkalma.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我会叫他冷静下来。
messages.en: You're right. I'll tell him to calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tixwix 放进“有人在旁边不断怂恿”的画面中，记住它指煽动或唆使这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of fattening an animal, or of offering money or other benefits to improperly influence someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使动物增肥的过程；也指用金钱或其他好处不正当地影响他人的行贿行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih annimal jitkabbar fix-xaħam, jew l-għoti ta' flus jew vantaġġi biex persuna tiġi influwenzata b'mod mhux xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 育肥；通过喂养使动物增加脂肪和体重。
行贿；给予金钱或其他好处，以不正当地影响某人的行为或决定。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-għalf użat għat-tixħim tal-annimali fir-razzett.
formal.en: The report describes the feed used for fattening the animals on the farm.
formal.zh: 报告描述了农场用于动物育肥的饲料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Offrielu l-flus biex jagħżel il-kumpanija tiegħu? Mark: Iva, dak tixħim, u ma għandux jaċċettahom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did he offer him money to choose his company? Mark: Yes, that's bribing, and he shouldn't accept it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他给那个人钱，让对方选他的公司吗？Mark：是的，那是行贿，对方不应该收这笔钱。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Offrielu l-flus biex jagħżel il-kumpanija tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Offrielu l-flus biex jagħżel il-kumpanija tiegħu?
messages.zh: 他给那个人钱，让对方选他的公司吗？
messages.en: Did he offer him money to choose his company?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak tixħim, u ma għandux jaċċettahom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak tixħim, u ma għandux jaċċettahom.
messages.zh: 是的，那是行贿，对方不应该收这笔钱。
messages.en: Yes, that's bribing, and he shouldn't accept it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分场景记忆：农场里喂养动物想到育肥，交易中送钱换取偏袒想到行贿；这是记义画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of depriving someone of something, or the condition of lacking something needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人失去某种事物的剥夺，或缺少所需事物的匮乏状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija ta' xi ħaġa minn għand persuna, jew il-qagħda ta' min ikun nieqes minn xi ħaġa meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥夺；被剥夺或缺少所需事物的状态。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-effetti tat-tixħit tal-ikel fuq il-benesseri tal-persuna.
formal.en: The study examines the effects of food deprivation on a person's well-being.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察食物匮乏对个人身心状况的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tixħit f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ifisser li xi ħadd ikun imċaħħad minn xi ħaġa li għandu bżonn, bħall-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tixħit mean in this sentence? Mark: It means that someone is deprived of something they need, such as food.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个句子里的 tixħit 是什么意思？Mark：意思是有人被剥夺了所需的东西，比如食物。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tixħit f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tixħit f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 tixħit 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tixħit mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħadd ikun imċaħħad minn xi ħaġa li għandu bżonn, bħall-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħadd ikun imċaħħad minn xi ħaġa li għandu bżonn, bħall-ikel.
messages.zh: 意思是有人被剥夺了所需的东西，比如食物。
messages.en: It means that someone is deprived of something they need, such as food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人面前必需的食物被拿走：从拿走的动作记剥夺，从空盘子的状态记匮乏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Greed for possessions or money, or an unwillingness to spend or share what one has.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对财物的贪求，或不愿花费、分享已有财物的吝啬态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa eċċessiva għall-flus jew għall-ġid, jew nuqqas ta' rieda li wieħed jonfoq jew jaqsam dak li għandu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪婪；对财物等过度的占有欲。
吝啬；即使有能力，也不愿花钱或与人分享。

formal.mt: It-tixħiħ għall-flus jista' jwassal lil persuna biex tinjora l-bżonnijiet tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: Greed for money can lead a person to ignore the needs of others.
formal.zh: 对金钱的贪婪可能使人忽视他人的需要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandu biżżejjed flus, imma qatt ma jrid iħallas sehmu. Mark: Dak tixħiħ; ilkoll għandna nagħtu sehemna.
colloquial.en: Maja: He has enough money, but he never wants to pay his share. Mark: That's miserliness; we should all contribute.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他有足够的钱，却从来不愿付自己那一份。Mark：那是吝啬；我们都应该出自己的一份。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu biżżejjed flus, imma qatt ma jrid iħallas sehmu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu biżżejjed flus, imma qatt ma jrid iħallas sehmu.
messages.zh: 他有足够的钱，却从来不愿付自己那一份。
messages.en: He has enough money, but he never wants to pay his share.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tixħiħ; ilkoll għandna nagħtu sehemna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak tixħiħ; ilkoll għandna nagħtu sehemna.
messages.zh: 那是吝啬；我们都应该出自己的一份。
messages.en: That's miserliness; we should all contribute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记双义：拼命往口袋里装钱是贪婪，捂紧口袋不肯出钱是吝啬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The small, high-pitched cheeping sounds made by fledgling birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刚长羽毛、开始学飞的幼鸟发出的细小而尖的啾啾叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħsejjes irqaq u qosra li jagħmlu l-għasafar żgħar li jkunu qed jitgħallmu jtiru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啾啾叫；指刚长羽毛、开始学飞的幼鸟发出的细小叫声。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti semgħu t-tizjiz tal-għasafar żgħar li kienu qed jitgħallmu jtiru.
formal.en: During the observation, the students heard the cheeping of fledgling birds that were learning to fly.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，学生们听到了正在学飞的幼鸟发出的啾啾叫声。

colloquial.mt: Lija: Qed tisma' t-tizjiz? Ben: Iva, ġej minn dawk l-għasafar żgħar fuq il-fergħa.
colloquial.en: Lija: Can you hear the cheeping? Ben: Yes, it's coming from those young birds on the branch.
colloquial.zh: Lija：你听见啾啾叫声了吗？Ben：听见了，是树枝上那几只幼鸟发出来的。

messages.speaker: Lija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' t-tizjiz?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' t-tizjiz?
messages.zh: 你听见啾啾叫声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the cheeping?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej minn dawk l-għasafar żgħar fuq il-fergħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej minn dawk l-għasafar żgħar fuq il-fergħa.
messages.zh: 听见了，是树枝上那几只幼鸟发出来的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from those young birds on the branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 tizjiz 时想象学飞幼鸟细细地啾啾叫，用声音和画面共同记忆；拼写中的 z 没有上方的小点。

gloss_zh: 拖脚行走；某些鸟的鸣叫声，尤指雀鸟和知更鸟

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dragging one's feet while walking; also, the sound made by certain birds, especially finches and robins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时拖着脚的动作；也指某些鸟发出的鸣叫声，尤指雀鸟和知更鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mixi bit-tkaxkir tas-saqajn; ukoll il-ħoss li jagħmlu ċerti għasafar, speċjalment l-għasafar tal-għana u l-pitirrossi.

sense_translations.en_definition: to drag one's feet while walking
sense_translations.zh_definition: 行走时拖着脚的动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: the sound made by certain birds (especially finches and robins)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某些鸟发出的鸣叫声，尤指雀鸟和知更鸟。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tizkik tas-saqajn tal-vjaġġatur juri kemm kien għajjien wara l-mixja twila.
formal.en: In the story, the traveller's dragging feet show how tired he was after the long walk.
formal.zh: 在故事中，旅人拖着脚行走，表现出他长途步行后的疲惫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tisma' t-tizkik tal-pitirross? Luqa: Iva, ġej mis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear the robin's call? Luqa: Yes, it's coming from the tree beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见知更鸟的叫声了吗？卢卡：听见了，是从窗边那棵树上传来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tisma' t-tizkik tal-pitirross?
messages.mt_standard: Tisma' t-tizkik tal-pitirross?
messages.zh: 你听见知更鸟的叫声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the robin's call?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 听见了，是从窗边那棵树上传来的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the tree beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项分别配图：走廊里拖着脚的人，窗外正在鸣叫的鸟；靠场景区分同一个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of working the soil with a hoe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用锄头翻弄、整理土壤的劳作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol tal-ħamrija bl-użu ta' mgħażqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锄头进行的劳作，指锄地这一活动。

collocations.en: working the soil with a hoe

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni fil-ġnien, l-għalliem wera lill-istudenti kif isir it-tizpin tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: During the lesson in the garden, the teacher showed the students how to work the soil with a hoe.
formal.zh: 在花园里的实践课上，老师向学生示范了如何用锄头锄土。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għamilt ħafna tizpin illum? Pawlu: Iva, ħdimt bil-mgħażqa għal siegħa u issa għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you do much hoeing today? Pawlu: Yes, I worked with the hoe for an hour, and now I need a rest.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天锄了很多地吗？保罗：是啊，我用锄头干了一个小时，现在得歇一歇。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt ħafna tizpin illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt ħafna tizpin illum?
messages.zh: 你今天锄了很多地吗？
messages.en: Did you do much hoeing today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħdimt bil-mgħażqa għal siegħa u issa għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħdimt bil-mgħażqa għal siegħa u issa għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，我用锄头干了一个小时，现在得歇一歇。
messages.en: Yes, I worked with the hoe for an hour, and now I need a rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象园丁握着锄头一下一下锄土；这个词记的是整项劳作，而不是锄头这件工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of walking with a limp, with an uneven step.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时步态不均衡、一瘸一拐的动作或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mixi b'pass mhux regolari, meta persuna ma timxix bl-istess mod fuq iż-żewġ saqajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跛行，即一瘸一拐地行走。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tizpip tal-karattru jsir aktar evidenti meta jaqsam il-bitħa.
formal.en: In the story, the character's limp becomes more noticeable as he crosses the courtyard.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物穿过院子时，跛行的步态变得更加明显。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tizpip tiegħek għadu jidher ftit. Mark: Iva, ejja nimxu bil-mod sal-karozza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your limp is still a little noticeable. Mark: Yes, let's walk slowly to the car.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你走路还是有一点瘸。马克：是啊，咱们慢慢走到车子那儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tizpip tiegħek għadu jidher ftit.
messages.mt_standard: It-tizpip tiegħek għadu jidher ftit.
messages.zh: 你走路还是有一点瘸。
messages.en: Your limp is still a little noticeable.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nimxu bil-mod sal-karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nimxu bil-mod sal-karozza.
messages.zh: 是啊，咱们慢慢走到车子那儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's walk slowly to the car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放一段左右脚落步不均的慢镜头，把这个名词与一瘸一拐的步态连起来记。

gloss_zh: 系在捕鸟装置上的绿金翅雀发出的特有叫声

teaching_sense.en_definition: The distinctive sound made by a greenfinch attached to a bird-trap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专指系在捕鸟装置上的绿金翅雀所发出的特有叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss partikolari li jagħmel verdun marbut ma' nassa tal-għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: Peculiar sound uttered by a greenfinch attached to a bird-trap
sense_translations.zh_definition: 系在捕鸟装置上的绿金翅雀所发出的特有叫声。

collocations.en: the distinctive call of the greenfinch attached to a bird-trap
collocations.zh: 系在捕鸟装置上的绿金翅雀的特有叫声

collocations.en: a description of that distinctive greenfinch call
collocations.zh: 对这种绿金翅雀特有叫声的描述

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma tizwiq tindika l-ħoss partikolari ta' verdun marbut ma' nassa tal-għasafar.
formal.en: In the text, the word tizwiq denotes the distinctive sound of a greenfinch attached to a bird-trap.
formal.zh: 在这篇文字中，tizwiq 一词表示系在捕鸟装置上的绿金翅雀所发出的特有叫声。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu t-tizwiq f'din is-sentenza? Toni: Huwa l-ħoss ta' verdun marbut ma' nassa tal-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does tizwiq mean in this sentence? Toni: It's the sound of a greenfinch attached to a bird-trap.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这句话里的 tizwiq 是什么意思？托尼：指系在捕鸟装置上的绿金翅雀发出的叫声。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu t-tizwiq f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu t-tizwiq f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这句话里的 tizwiq 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tizwiq mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-ħoss ta' verdun marbut ma' nassa tal-għasafar.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-ħoss ta' verdun marbut ma' nassa tal-għasafar.
messages.zh: 指系在捕鸟装置上的绿金翅雀发出的叫声。
messages.en: It's the sound of a greenfinch attached to a bird-trap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面标签来记：绿金翅雀、捕鸟装置、特有叫声；三个条件一起记，避免泛指所有鸟鸣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in size or importance; also the act of making someone humble or putting aside one's own interests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使尺寸或重要性减小；也可指使人谦卑，或放下自身利益的克己行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fid-daqs jew fl-importanza; ukoll l-att li wieħed jitgħallem ikun umli jew iwarrab l-interessi tiegħu stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尺寸的缩小；使某物变小。
重要性的降低；贬低或弱化某事物的分量。
使人谦卑；使人放下骄傲或自大的过程。
克己；舍弃自身的利益或欲望。

formal.mt: It-tiċkin tad-daqs tal-immaġni għamilha aktar adattata għall-paġna.
formal.en: Reducing the size of the image made it more suitable for the page.
formal.zh: 缩小图像尺寸后，它更适合放在这一页上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-tiċkin tar-ritratt biżżejjed? Pawlu: Iva, issa jidħol kollu fil-qafas.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this reduction in the photo's size enough? Pawlu: Yes, now the whole thing fits in the frame.
colloquial.zh: Sara：照片缩小到这样够了吗？Pawlu：够了，现在整张都能放进相框。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tiċkin tar-ritratt biżżejjed?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tiċkin tar-ritratt biżżejjed?
messages.zh: 照片缩小到这样够了吗？
messages.en: Is this reduction in the photo's size enough?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jidħol kollu fil-qafas.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jidħol kollu fil-qafas.
messages.zh: 够了，现在整张都能放进相框。
messages.en: Yes, now the whole thing fits in the frame.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把几个义项连成教学画面：图片变小、事情分量变小、骄傲变小，以及主动放下自己的利益。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slow, sluggish movement that shows little energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缓慢、拖沓而缺乏活力的移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment kajman li juri ftit enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迟缓、拖沓的移动。

formal.mt: It-tiċlim tal-annimal kien jidher fil-mod kif kien jimxi bil-mod lejn l-ilma.
formal.en: The animal's sluggish movement was evident in the way it walked slowly toward the water.
formal.zh: 这只动物慢慢走向水边，动作显得迟缓无力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara dak it-tiċlim tal-kelb? Toni: Iva, illum qed jimxi bil-mod ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you see how sluggishly the dog is moving? Toni: Yes, it's walking very slowly today.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看见狗那慢吞吞的动作了吗？Toni：看见了，它今天走得特别慢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dak it-tiċlim tal-kelb?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dak it-tiċlim tal-kelb?
messages.zh: 你看见狗那慢吞吞的动作了吗？
messages.en: Do you see how sluggishly the dog is moving?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum qed jimxi bil-mod ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum qed jimxi bil-mod ħafna.
messages.zh: 看见了，它今天走得特别慢。
messages.en: Yes, it's walking very slowly today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只狗慢吞吞地挪动脚步，用这段迟缓动作记住这个表示移动的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of spreading a substance over something, often making it dirty, or of damaging someone's good name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种物质涂抹在表面、常使其变脏的行为；也可指玷污他人名声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ixerred sustanza fuq wiċċ u jħammġu, jew li jħammeġ ir-reputazzjoni ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹；把物质抹开而弄脏表面。
玷污；弄脏某物或损害他人的名声。

formal.mt: L-artiklu kkritika t-tiċliq tar-reputazzjoni tal-għalliem permezz ta' akkużi bla provi.
formal.en: The article criticized the besmirching of the teacher's reputation through accusations without evidence.
formal.zh: 文章批评了以毫无证据的指控玷污这位教师名声的行为。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif nista' nevita t-tiċliq taż-żebgħa? Ben: Stenna sakemm tinxef qabel tmissha.
colloquial.en: Nina: How can I avoid smearing the paint? Ben: Wait until it dries before touching it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：怎样才能避免把油漆抹花？Ben：等它干了再碰。

messages.speaker: Nina (绘画学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nevita t-tiċliq taż-żebgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nevita t-tiċliq taż-żebgħa?
messages.zh: 怎样才能避免把油漆抹花？
messages.en: How can I avoid smearing the paint?

messages.speaker: Ben (绘画老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna sakemm tinxef qabel tmissha.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna sakemm tinxef qabel tmissha.
messages.zh: 等它干了再碰。
messages.en: Wait until it dries before touching it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象把油漆抹开弄脏表面，再联想到给名声抹黑；用具体画面连接抽象义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The smearing of a substance such as paint; also wet mud or mire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 油漆等物质的涂抹；也指湿泥或泥泞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tixrid ta' sustanza bħal żebgħa fuq wiċċ; ukoll tajn imxarrab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹，例如把油漆抹开。

sense_translations.en_definition: mire or mud (e.g. on a wet day)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 泥泞或湿泥，例如雨天路面上的烂泥。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, it-tiċlis fit-triq għamel il-mixi diffiċli.
formal.en: After the rain, the mud in the road made walking difficult.
formal.zh: 雨后，道路泥泞，行走困难。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Hemm ħafna tiċlis barra? Samwel: Iva, ilbes l-istvali biex ma tħammiġx iż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is there a lot of mud outside? Samwel: Yes, wear your boots so you don't get your shoes dirty.
colloquial.zh: Rita：外面泥多吗？Samwel：多，穿靴子吧，免得把鞋弄脏。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħafna tiċlis barra?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħafna tiċlis barra?
messages.zh: 外面泥多吗？
messages.en: Is there a lot of mud outside?

messages.speaker: Samwel (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilbes l-istvali biex ma tħammiġx iż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilbes l-istvali biex ma tħammiġx iż-żraben.
messages.zh: 多，穿靴子吧，免得把鞋弄脏。
messages.en: Yes, wear your boots so you don't get your shoes dirty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：刷子抹开湿油漆，靴子踩进湿泥地；分别对应涂抹和泥泞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of smearing or staining a surface, or a dirty mark left on it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂抹、沾污表面的行为，或留在表面上的污痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħammeġ wiċċ billi jxerred sustanza fuqu jew iħalli tebgħa; ukoll il-marka maħmuġa li tibqa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹弄脏；把某种物质抹开。
沾污；使表面留下污渍。
污痕；涂抹或接触后留下的一块脏印。

formal.mt: It-tiċpis tal-linka fuq il-paġna għamel xi kliem diffiċli biex jinqara.
formal.en: The smearing of ink on the page made some words difficult to read.
formal.zh: 纸上的墨迹被抹花，导致有些词难以辨认。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Hemm tiċpis fuq il-ħġieġ, qed tarah? Ġanni: Iva, se nimsaħ il-ħġieġ b'ċarruta nadifa.
colloquial.en: Eva: There's a smudge on the glass; can you see it? Ġanni: Yes, I'll wipe the glass with a clean cloth.
colloquial.zh: Eva：玻璃上有块污痕，你看见了吗？Ġanni：看见了，我用干净的布擦一下玻璃。

messages.speaker: Eva (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tiċpis fuq il-ħġieġ, qed tarah?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tiċpis fuq il-ħġieġ, qed tarah?
messages.zh: 玻璃上有块污痕，你看见了吗？
messages.en: There's a smudge on the glass; can you see it?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nimsaħ il-ħġieġ b'ċarruta nadifa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nimsaħ il-ħġieġ b'ċarruta nadifa.
messages.zh: 看见了，我用干净的布擦一下玻璃。
messages.en: Yes, I'll wipe the glass with a clean cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住手指擦过墨迹的过程：先抹开，再沾污，最后留下污痕；一个画面串起三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of tearing or ripping material, or a rip, slit, or tear in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 撕扯、撕裂材料的行为，或材料上形成的破口、狭长裂口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iqatta' materjal billi jiġbdu; ukoll fetħa jew qasma fil-materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕扯；把材料扯开的行为。
撕裂；用力把材料扯破。
撕破处；材料被扯开后形成的破口。
狭长的裂口或开口。
裂口；纸张、布料等被撕破的地方。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, instab tiċrit fid-drapp tas-siġġu.
formal.en: During the inspection, tearing was found in the chair's fabric.
formal.zh: 检查时发现椅子的布面有撕裂破损。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ara dan it-tiċrit fil-qmis tiegħi. Luqa: Rajtu. Nista' nsewwih bil-labra u l-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Marta: Look at this tear in my shirt. Luqa: I see it. I can mend it with a needle and thread.
colloquial.zh: Marta：看看我衬衫上这个裂口。Luqa：看到了，我可以用针线把它补好。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan it-tiċrit fil-qmis tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan it-tiċrit fil-qmis tiegħi.
messages.zh: 看看我衬衫上这个裂口。
messages.en: Look at this tear in my shirt.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu. Nista' nsewwih bil-labra u l-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu. Nista' nsewwih bil-labra u l-ħajt.
messages.zh: 看到了，我可以用针线把它补好。
messages.en: I see it. I can mend it with a needle and thread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把纸扯开：动作是撕裂，留下的是裂口；这里英文 tear 对应破口，不是眼泪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The provision or supply of material, usually rock or stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供或供应材料的行为，通常用于岩石或石料的供给。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti jew il-provvista ta' materjal, ġeneralment blat jew ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供；供给所需物资。

sense_translations.en_definition: supply (usually used for rock or stone)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供应；通常指岩石或石料的供给。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet għat-tiċwil tal-ġebel meħtieġ għall-bini tal-ħajt.
formal.en: The contract sets out the conditions for supplying the stone needed to build the wall.
formal.zh: 合同规定了供应砌墙所需石料的条件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiċwil tal-ġebel għall-ħajt? Karmenu: Il-fornitur tagħna; se jġib il-ġebel għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will handle the supply of stone for the wall? Karmenu: Our supplier; he'll bring the stone tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: Marija：谁负责供应砌墙的石料？Karmenu：我们的供应商，他明天早上会把石料送来。

messages.speaker: Marija (工程负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiċwil tal-ġebel għall-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiċwil tal-ġebel għall-ħajt?
messages.zh: 谁负责供应砌墙的石料？
messages.en: Who will handle the supply of stone for the wall?

messages.speaker: Karmenu (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fornitur tagħna; se jġib il-ġebel għada filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fornitur tagħna; se jġib il-ġebel għada filgħodu.
messages.zh: 我们的供应商，他明天早上会把石料送来。
messages.en: Our supplier; he'll bring the stone tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象砌墙前一车车石料送到工地，把这个词与石料的提供和持续供应联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of denying that something is true, or of rejecting something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 否认某事属实的行为，或拒绝接受某事物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jgħid li xi ħaġa mhix vera, jew li jirrifjuta li jaċċettaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 否认；表示某件事不属实的行为。
拒绝；不接受某事物。

formal.mt: Fl-istqarrija tiegħu, id-direttur esprima tiċħid ċar tal-akkużi.
formal.en: In his statement, the director expressed a clear denial of the accusations.
formal.zh: 主任在声明中明确否认了这些指控。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tiċħid tal-proposta kien sorpriża għalik? Mark: Iva, ħsibt li kienu se jaċċettawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Were you surprised by the rejection of the proposal? Mark: Yes, I thought they were going to accept it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：提案遭到拒绝，你觉得意外吗？Mark：是啊，我以为他们会接受。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tiċħid tal-proposta kien sorpriża għalik?
messages.mt_standard: It-tiċħid tal-proposta kien sorpriża għalik?
messages.zh: 提案遭到拒绝，你觉得意外吗？
messages.en: Were you surprised by the rejection of the proposal?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħsibt li kienu se jaċċettawha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħsibt li kienu se jaċċettawha.
messages.zh: 是啊，我以为他们会接受。
messages.en: Yes, I thought they were going to accept it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个说“不”的场景记忆：对指控说“不是真的”是否认，对提案说“不接受”是拒绝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of pulling something, or stretching something to make it longer or more extended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力拉动物体的动作；也指使物体或身体部位伸展开的拉伸动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha tiġbed xi ħaġa, jew testendi xi ħaġa jew parti mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 施力把物体拉动或拉向某个方向。
使物体或身体部位伸展、拉长的动作。

formal.mt: It-tiġbid tal-ħabel mexxa l-kaxxa lejn il-bieb.
formal.en: Pulling the rope moved the box towards the door.
formal.zh: 拉动绳子使箱子朝门口移动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nagħmlu ftit tiġbid qabel nibdew? David: Iva, nibdew bid-dirgħajn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we do some stretching before we start? David: Yes, let's start with our arms.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：开始之前做点拉伸好吗？戴维：好，先从手臂开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (运动伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu ftit tiġbid qabel nibdew?
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu ftit tiġbid qabel nibdew?
messages.zh: 开始之前做点拉伸好吗？
messages.en: Shall we do some stretching before we start?

messages.speaker: David (运动伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nibdew bid-dirgħajn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nibdew bid-dirgħajn.
messages.zh: 好，先从手臂开始。
messages.en: Yes, let's start with our arms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用双手拉绳与伸展手臂两个动作记 tiġbid：拉绳强调物体移动，伸臂强调身体伸展，分别对应拉动和拉伸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming stony, or of material turning into stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得多石、呈石质的过程；也指物质变成石头的石化过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir ġeblija jew tinbidel f'ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变得多石或呈石质的过程。
物质变成石头的过程；石化。

collocations.en: the process of becoming stony or turning into stone
collocations.zh: 变得呈石质或石化的过程

formal.mt: It-tabella fil-mużew tispjega t-tiġbil tal-injam.
formal.en: The display panel in the museum explains the petrification of wood.
formal.zh: 博物馆里的展板解释了木材的石化过程。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Dan kien injam qabel? Pawlu: Iva, u t-tabella tgħid li nbidel f'ġebel permezz tat-tiġbil.
colloquial.en: Emma: Was this wood before? Pawlu: Yes, and the panel says it turned into stone through petrification.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：这个以前是木头吗？保罗：是的，展板说它经过石化变成了石头。

messages.speaker: Emma (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan kien injam qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Dan kien injam qabel?
messages.zh: 这个以前是木头吗？
messages.en: Was this wood before?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u t-tabella tgħid li nbidel f'ġebel permezz tat-tiġbil.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u t-tabella tgħid li nbidel f'ġebel permezz tat-tiġbil.
messages.zh: 是的，展板说它经过石化变成了石头。
messages.en: Yes, and the panel says it turned into stone through petrification.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiġbil 配上一幅木头逐渐呈现石头质感的教学图，记住它表示“变得像石头或变成石头”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of collecting things or bringing people or things together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品收集起来，或把人、物聚到一起的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha jinġabru affarijiet jew jitlaqqgħu nies jew affarijiet flimkien.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of collecting or gathering
sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集物品，或将人、物聚集起来的行为。

formal.mt: It-tiġbir ta' informazzjoni mingħand ir-residenti jgħin lill-kunsill jifhem il-ħtiġijiet tal-lokalità.
formal.en: Collecting information from residents helps the council understand the needs of the locality.
formal.zh: 向居民收集信息，有助于地方议会了解当地的需求。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiġbir tal-kotba? Mark: Jien, u npoġġihom kollha f'din il-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will take care of collecting the books? Mark: I will, and I'll put them all in this box.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：谁来负责收集书本？马克：我来，我会把它们全放进这个箱子。

messages.speaker: Marija (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiġbir tal-kotba?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiġbir tal-kotba?
messages.zh: 谁来负责收集书本？
messages.en: Who will take care of collecting the books?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, u npoġġihom kollha f'din il-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, u npoġġihom kollha f'din il-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 我来，我会把它们全放进这个箱子。
messages.en: I will, and I'll put them all in this box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把散落的书一本本放进同一个箱子，用“分散变集中”的画面记 tiġbir，再扩展到收集信息和募集资金。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of applying plaster to a wall, ceiling, or another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在墙壁、天花板或其他表面涂抹灰泥、石膏的施工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih jitqiegħed saff ta' ġibs fuq ħajt, saqaf jew wiċċ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在墙面等表面涂抹灰泥或石膏的工作；抹灰。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol ta' tiġbis tal-ħitan għandu jitlesta qabel iż-żebgħa.
formal.en: The wall plastering work must be completed before painting.
formal.zh: 墙壁抹灰工程必须在刷漆之前完成。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Lest it-tiġbis tal-kamra? Ġużeppi: Kważi; għad fadal dan il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is the plastering in the room finished? Ġużeppi: Almost; this wall is still left.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：房间的抹灰做完了吗？朱塞佩：快了，还剩这面墙。

messages.speaker: Anna (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Lest it-tiġbis tal-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Lest it-tiġbis tal-kamra?
messages.zh: 房间的抹灰做完了吗？
messages.en: Is the plastering in the room finished?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (抹灰工)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għad fadal dan il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għad fadal dan il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 快了，还剩这面墙。
messages.en: Almost; this wall is still left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工人拿抹子把墙面抹平，用这一连续动作记 tiġbis；例句中的“先抹灰、后刷漆”也能帮助区分两道工序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something new or usable again, renovating it, or extending its period of validity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物重新焕新或恢复可用状态的行为；也指建筑翻新或延长证件、合同等的有效期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha xi ħaġa terġa' ssir ġdida jew tajba għall-użu, tiġi rinnovata, jew jiġġedded iż-żmien tal-validità tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使事物重新焕新、恢复或延续的行为；更新。
对建筑、房间等进行修整和改善；翻新。
重新生效或延长有效期；续期、续办，也可指更新。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jinkludi t-tiġdid tal-bini u t-titjib tal-faċilitajiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The project includes renovating the building and improving its facilities.
formal.zh: 该项目包括翻新建筑并改善其设施。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħadt ħsieb it-tiġdid tal-liċenzja? David: Għadni; se nimla l-formola llum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you taken care of renewing the licence? David: Not yet; I'll fill in the form today.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：许可证续期办好了吗？戴维：还没，我今天会填表。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt ħsieb it-tiġdid tal-liċenzja?
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt ħsieb it-tiġdid tal-liċenzja?
messages.zh: 许可证续期办好了吗？
messages.en: Have you taken care of renewing the licence?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni; se nimla l-formola llum.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni; se nimla l-formola llum.
messages.zh: 还没，我今天会填表。
messages.en: Not yet; I'll fill in the form today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiġdid 放进三个“重新”的场景：旧物重新焕新、旧屋重新整修、证件重新取得有效期，分别帮助记住更新、翻新和续期。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something dirty; in a separate sense, leprosy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变脏、受到污损的行为；另有独立义项指麻风病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tħammeġ xi ħaġa; f'tifsira oħra distinta, il-lebbra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏；使某物沾上污物。
使变脏；造成污损。
麻风病。

formal.mt: Biex jiġi evitat it-tiġdim tal-ħwejjeġ bl-inka, għandu jintlibes fardal waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: To prevent clothes from being soiled with ink, an apron should be worn while working.
formal.zh: 为避免墨水弄脏衣物，工作时应穿围裙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tilbes fardal? Toni: Biex nevita t-tiġdim tal-ħwejjeġ bl-inka.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you wearing an apron? Toni: To avoid getting ink on my clothes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么穿围裙？Toni：为了避免墨水弄脏衣服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tilbes fardal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tilbes fardal?
messages.zh: 你为什么穿围裙？
messages.en: Why are you wearing an apron?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nevita t-tiġdim tal-ħwejjeġ bl-inka.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nevita t-tiġdim tal-ħwejjeġ bl-inka.
messages.zh: 为了避免墨水弄脏衣服。
messages.en: To avoid getting ink on my clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用围裙挡住墨水的画面记住“弄脏、污损”；“麻风病”另设一张义项卡，避免把两类意思混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pockmarks on the face, or pustules on the skin, depending on the sense intended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指面部留下的痘痕，也可指皮肤上的脓疱，须根据上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħofor żgħar fil-ġilda tal-wiċċ, jew nfafet mimlijin timbotta, skont it-tifsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面部痘痕；脸上留下的小凹痕。
脓疱；内含脓液的小疱。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-wiċċ fil-katalgu ssemmi tiġdir fuq il-ħaddejn.
formal.en: The description of the face in the catalogue mentions pockmarks on the cheeks.
formal.zh: 目录中对面容的描述提到双颊上的痘痕。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'tiġdir' f'din id-deskrizzjoni? Mark: Hawn tfisser il-ħofor żgħar fuq il-wiċċ, mhux in-nfafet.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'tiġdir' mean in this description? Mark: Here it means the little pockmarks on the face, rather than pustules.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这段描述里的“tiġdir”是什么意思？Mark：这里指脸上的小凹痕，不是脓疱。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'tiġdir' f'din id-deskrizzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'tiġdir' f'din id-deskrizzjoni?
messages.zh: 这段描述里的“tiġdir”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tiġdir' mean in this description?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser il-ħofor żgħar fuq il-wiċċ, mhux in-nfafet.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser il-ħofor żgħar fuq il-wiċċ, mhux in-nfafet.
messages.zh: 这里指脸上的小凹痕，不是脓疱。
messages.en: Here it means the little pockmarks on the face, rather than pustules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两幅词义示意图：一幅是脸上的凹痕，一幅是皮肤上的脓疱；用上下文判断当前指哪一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or action of making something curl, for example hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物形成卷曲形状的过程或动作，例如把头发弄卷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' forma ta' nokkli, pereżempju lix-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷曲；使某物形成卷状的动作或过程。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi lezzjoni prattika dwar it-tiġgħid tax-xagħar.
formal.en: The course includes a practical lesson on curling hair.
formal.zh: 该课程包含一节关于卷发操作的实践课。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm jieħu ħin it-tiġgħid tax-xagħar? Rita: Għal xagħrek, madwar għoxrin minuta.
colloquial.en: Nina: How long does curling the hair take? Rita: For your hair, about twenty minutes.
colloquial.zh: Nina：卷头发需要多久？Rita：你的头发大约需要二十分钟。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm jieħu ħin it-tiġgħid tax-xagħar?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm jieħu ħin it-tiġgħid tax-xagħar?
messages.zh: 卷头发需要多久？
messages.en: How long does curling the hair take?

messages.speaker: Rita (理发师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xagħrek, madwar għoxrin minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Għal xagħrek, madwar għoxrin minuta.
messages.zh: 你的头发大约需要二十分钟。
messages.en: For your hair, about twenty minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象理发师把一束直发慢慢卷成发卷，用这个动作画面记住“卷曲的过程”这一名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of forcing someone to do something, including against their will.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 迫使某人做某事的行为，包括违背其意愿的强迫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa, anki kontra r-rieda tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫、迫使某人行动的行为。

collocations.mt: tiġgħil kontra r-rieda ta' xi ħadd

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddistingwi bejn il-persważjoni u t-tiġgħil: tal-ewwel tfittex il-qbil, filwaqt li t-tieni timponi azzjoni.
formal.en: The author distinguishes between persuasion and compulsion: the former seeks agreement, while the latter imposes an action.
formal.zh: 作者区分了说服与强迫：前者寻求认同，后者强制他人采取行动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qaluli li rrid immur, anki jekk ma rridx. Toni: Dak tiġgħil; inti ma tajtx il-kunsens tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: They told me I have to go, even if I don't want to. Toni: That's compulsion; you haven't given your consent.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他们说即使我不愿意也必须去。Toni：那就是强迫；你并没有表示同意。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaluli li rrid immur, anki jekk ma rridx.
messages.mt_standard: Qaluli li rrid immur, anki jekk ma rridx.
messages.zh: 他们说即使我不愿意也必须去。
messages.en: They told me I have to go, even if I don't want to.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tiġgħil; inti ma tajtx il-kunsens tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Dak tiġgħil; inti ma tajtx il-kunsens tiegħek.
messages.zh: 那就是强迫；你并没有表示同意。
messages.en: That's compulsion; you haven't given your consent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“我不愿意，却被迫去做”的情景配给这个词；记住它表示强迫这一行为，而不是自愿同意。

gloss_zh: 给新娘置办嫁妆的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of providing a bride with her dowry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为新娘提供、置办嫁妆的行为，侧重给予嫁妆这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tingħata d-dota lill-għarusa.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of giving a bride her dowry
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给新娘提供嫁妆；为新娘置办嫁妆的行为。

collocations.en: providing the bride with her dowry
an agreement about providing the dowry

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi t-tiġhiż tal-għarusa u jelenka l-oġġetti li se jingħataw bħala dota.
formal.en: The document describes the provision of the bride's dowry and lists the items to be given as dowry.
formal.zh: 文件说明了为新娘提供嫁妆的安排，并列出将作为嫁妆给予的物品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Tiġhiż' tfisser id-dota nnifisha? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser l-att li tingħata d-dota lill-għarusa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does 'tiġhiż' mean the dowry itself? Pawlu: Here it means the act of giving the bride her dowry.
colloquial.zh: Lara：“tiġhiż”指嫁妆本身吗？Pawlu：这里指把嫁妆给予新娘这一行为。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Tiġhiż' tfisser id-dota nnifisha?
messages.mt_standard: 'Tiġhiż' tfisser id-dota nnifisha?
messages.zh: “tiġhiż”指嫁妆本身吗？
messages.en: Does 'tiġhiż' mean the dowry itself?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser l-att li tingħata d-dota lill-għarusa.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser l-att li tingħata d-dota lill-għarusa.
messages.zh: 这里指把嫁妆给予新娘这一行为。
messages.en: Here it means the act of giving the bride her dowry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把备好的嫁妆交给新娘，重点记住“交付、提供嫁妆”的动作，而非仅记住嫁妆物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Domestic chickens, referred to collectively or as more than one bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为家禽饲养的鸡，常用于统称鸡或表示多只鸡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasafar domestiċi mrobbija bħala tjur, imsemmija flimkien bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸡；多只鸡或鸡的统称。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tar-razzett jinkludi spazju għat-tiġieġ u post fejn jinħażen l-għalf.
formal.en: The farm plan includes space for the chickens and a place to store their feed.
formal.zh: 农场规划包括养鸡的空间和存放饲料的地方。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Tajthom jieklu lit-tiġieġ? Anna: Iva, u bdiltilhom l-ilma wkoll.
colloquial.en: Ben: Have you fed the chickens? Anna: Yes, and I've changed their water too.
colloquial.zh: Ben：你喂过鸡了吗？Anna：喂过了，也给它们换了水。

messages.speaker: Ben (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajthom jieklu lit-tiġieġ?
messages.mt_standard: Tajthom jieklu lit-tiġieġ?
messages.zh: 你喂过鸡了吗？
messages.en: Have you fed the chickens?

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u bdiltilhom l-ilma wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u bdiltilhom l-ilma wkoll.
messages.zh: 喂过了，也给它们换了水。
messages.en: Yes, and I've changed their water too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象院子里一群鸡围着饲料啄食，把整个鸡群与 tiġieġ 联系起来，练习用它统称这些鸡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Eurasian coot, the bird species with the scientific name Fulica atra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白骨顶，又称白骨顶鸡，学名为 Fulica atra 的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ispeċi ta' għasfur bl-isem xjentifiku Fulica atra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白骨顶（白骨顶鸡，学名 Fulica atra）。

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-għasafar osservati, it-tiġieġ tal-baħar huma elenkati bl-isem xjentifiku Fulica atra.
formal.en: In the list of birds observed, the Eurasian coots are listed under the scientific name Fulica atra.
formal.zh: 在观测鸟类名录中，白骨顶以学名 Fulica atra 列出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn fir-ritratt huma tiġieġ tal-baħar? Mark: Iva, fil-ktieb huma mniżżla bħala Fulica atra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are these birds in the photograph Eurasian coots? Mark: Yes, the book lists them as Fulica atra.
colloquial.zh: Sara：照片里的这些鸟是白骨顶吗？Mark：是的，书中把它们列为 Fulica atra。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn fir-ritratt huma tiġieġ tal-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn fir-ritratt huma tiġieġ tal-baħar?
messages.zh: 照片里的这些鸟是白骨顶吗？
messages.en: Are these birds in the photograph Eurasian coots?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fil-ktieb huma mniżżla bħala Fulica atra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fil-ktieb huma mniżżla bħala Fulica atra.
messages.zh: 是的，书中把它们列为 Fulica atra。
messages.en: Yes, the book lists them as Fulica atra.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语作为鸟名记忆，在词卡上并排写“tiġieġ tal-baħar—白骨顶—Fulica atra”，用三项配对巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The red-knobbed coot, the bird species with the scientific name Fulica cristata.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 红瘤骨顶，又称红瘤骨顶鸡，学名为 Fulica cristata 的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ispeċi ta' għasfur bl-isem xjentifiku Fulica cristata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红瘤骨顶（红瘤骨顶鸡，学名 Fulica cristata）。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jidentifika t-tiġieġ tat-toppu bl-isem xjentifiku Fulica cristata u jippreżenta ritratt tal-ispeċi.
formal.en: The catalogue identifies the red-knobbed coot by the scientific name Fulica cristata and presents a photograph of the species.
formal.zh: 目录以学名 Fulica cristata 标明红瘤骨顶，并附上该物种的照片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jissejħu dawn l-għasafar fil-ktieb? Pawlu: Tiġieġ tat-toppu; l-isem xjentifiku tagħhom hu Fulica cristata.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are these birds called in the book? Pawlu: Red-knobbed coots; their scientific name is Fulica cristata.
colloquial.zh: Lara：书中把这些鸟叫什么？Pawlu：红瘤骨顶；它们的学名是 Fulica cristata。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jissejħu dawn l-għasafar fil-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: X'jissejħu dawn l-għasafar fil-ktieb?
messages.zh: 书中把这些鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What are these birds called in the book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiġieġ tat-toppu; l-isem xjentifiku tagħhom hu Fulica cristata.
messages.mt_standard: Tiġieġ tat-toppu; l-isem xjentifiku tagħhom hu Fulica cristata.
messages.zh: 红瘤骨顶；它们的学名是 Fulica cristata。
messages.en: Red-knobbed coots; their scientific name is Fulica cristata.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作成对词卡：tat-toppu 对应红瘤骨顶和 Fulica cristata，tal-baħar 对应白骨顶和 Fulica atra；重点辨认短语后半部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of bringing or carrying something to a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西带到某处或搬运到某处的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġġib jew iġġorr xi ħaġa lejn xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带来；把某物带到指定地点的行为。
搬运；携带或运送某物的行为。

formal.mt: It-tiġjib tal-provvisti lejn ir-raħal kien diffiċli minħabba t-triq magħluqa.
formal.en: Bringing supplies to the village was difficult because the road was closed.
formal.zh: 由于道路封闭，把物资运到村里十分困难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiġjib tal-ilma għall-piknik? Pawlu: Jien. Inġib żewġ fliexken kbar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will take care of bringing water for the picnic? Pawlu: I will. I'll bring two large bottles.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁负责把野餐用的水带来？保罗：我来。我会带两大瓶。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiġjib tal-ilma għall-piknik?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiġjib tal-ilma għall-piknik?
messages.zh: 谁负责把野餐用的水带来？
messages.en: Who will take care of bringing water for the picnic?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Inġib żewġ fliexken kbar.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Inġib żewġ fliexken kbar.
messages.zh: 我来。我会带两大瓶。
messages.en: I will. I'll bring two large bottles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把两大瓶水从家里带到野餐地点：tiġjib 记的是“带来、搬运”这个过程，两个义项可用同一幅运水画面串联。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaviour that shows cowardice when facing danger or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对危险或困难时表现出来的怯懦行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba li turi nuqqas ta' kuraġġ quddiem il-periklu jew id-diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怯懦行为；因缺乏勇气而表现出的退缩或逃避。

collocations.en: cowardly behaviour in the face of danger
collocations.zh: 面对危险时的怯懦表现

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħarba tal-kaptan waqt li l-ekwipaġġ kien għadu fil-periklu hija ppreżentata bħala att ta' tiġjif.
formal.en: In the story, the captain's flight while the crew was still in danger is presented as an act of cowardice.
formal.zh: 故事中，船长在船员仍身处险境时逃走，被描写为一种怯懦行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li l-ħarba tal-kaptan kienet att ta' tiġjif? Mark: Iva, għax telaq u ħalla lill-oħrajn fil-periklu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think the captain's flight was an act of cowardice? Mark: Yes, because he left the others in danger.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得船长逃走是怯懦的表现吗？马克：是的，因为他自己走了，把其他人留在险境中。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li l-ħarba tal-kaptan kienet att ta' tiġjif?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li l-ħarba tal-kaptan kienet att ta' tiġjif?
messages.zh: 你觉得船长逃走是怯懦的表现吗？
messages.en: Do you think the captain's flight was an act of cowardice?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax telaq u ħalla lill-oħrajn fil-periklu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax telaq u ħalla lill-oħrajn fil-periklu.
messages.zh: 是的，因为他自己走了，把其他人留在险境中。
messages.en: Yes, because he left the others in danger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiġjif 放进故事里的“临危弃人而逃”画面，记住它评价的是怯懦的行为，而不只是心里感到害怕。

gloss_zh: 包皮革；用皮革包覆或装面

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of covering furniture or another object with leather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用皮革包覆家具或其他物件表面的工序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih għamara jew oġġett ieħor jinkesa bil-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用皮革为家具装面，或用皮革包覆物件。

formal.mt: Qabel beda t-tiġlid tas-siġġijiet, l-artiġjan kejjel is-sedili u għażel il-ġilda.
formal.en: Before beginning to upholster the chairs in leather, the craftsman measured the seats and selected the leather.
formal.zh: 开始给椅子包皮革之前，工匠测量了座面并选好了皮革。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm idum it-tiġlid ta' dan is-siġġu? Ġużeppi: Madwar jumejn. Trid ġilda kannella jew sewda?
colloquial.en: Nina: How long does upholstering this chair in leather take? Ġużeppi: About two days. Would you like brown or black leather?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：给这把椅子包皮革需要多久？朱塞佩：大约两天。你想用棕色皮革还是黑色皮革？

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm idum it-tiġlid ta' dan is-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm idum it-tiġlid ta' dan is-siġġu?
messages.zh: 给这把椅子包皮革需要多久？
messages.en: How long does upholstering this chair in leather take?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (家具工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar jumejn. Trid ġilda kannella jew sewda?
messages.mt_standard: Madwar jumejn. Trid ġilda kannella jew sewda?
messages.zh: 大约两天。你想用棕色皮革还是黑色皮革？
messages.en: About two days. Would you like brown or black leather?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工匠给椅子套上一件皮革外衣：tiġlid 表示“用皮革包覆”的工序，记忆时把皮革和椅面一起想出来。

gloss_zh: 使沾上烟灰；用烟灰覆盖；熏黑

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something sooty or covering its surface with soot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体表面沾上烟灰，或被烟灰覆盖而变黑的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titħammeġ jew tinkesa bin-nugrufun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物沾上烟灰；把某物熏得发黑。
用烟灰覆盖；使表面蒙上一层烟灰。

collocations.en: the coating of walls with soot
the blackening of the bottom of the pot with soot

formal.mt: Id-duħħan mill-fuklar ikkawża t-tiġmid tal-ħajt ta' warajh.
formal.en: Smoke from the fireplace caused the wall behind it to become coated with soot.
formal.zh: 壁炉冒出的烟使后面的墙蒙上了烟灰。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-qiegħ tal-borma sar iswed? Toni: Minħabba t-tiġmid fuq in-nar tal-injam. Hemm nugrufun mal-qiegħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why has the bottom of the pot turned black? Toni: Because it became sooty over the wood fire. There's soot on the bottom.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：锅底为什么变黑了？托尼：因为放在柴火上时被熏黑了。底下沾着烟灰。

messages.speaker: Sara (露营同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-qiegħ tal-borma sar iswed?
