messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-qiegħ tal-borma sar iswed?
messages.zh: 锅底为什么变黑了？
messages.en: Why has the bottom of the pot turned black?

messages.speaker: Toni (露营同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tiġmid fuq in-nar tal-injam. Hemm nugrufun mal-qiegħ.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tiġmid fuq in-nar tal-injam. Hemm nugrufun mal-qiegħ.
messages.zh: 因为放在柴火上时被熏黑了。底下沾着烟灰。
messages.en: Because it became sooty over the wood fire. There's soot on the bottom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiġmid 和柴火上熏黑的锅底绑定：先有烟，再有表面的黑灰，两个义项都围绕“沾烟灰、覆烟灰”来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of bringing people or things together, or collecting items or information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或事物聚到一起，或收集物品、信息的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li nies jew affarijiet jinġabru flimkien, jew li jinġabru oġġetti jew informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聚集；使人或事物汇聚到一起。
收集；把分散的物品、资料等逐一搜集起来。

formal.mt: It-tiġmigħ tal-informazzjoni sar permezz ta' intervisti mar-residenti.
formal.en: The gathering of information was carried out through interviews with residents.
formal.zh: 信息收集是通过访谈居民进行的。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Bdejtu t-tiġmigħ tal-kotba għad-donazzjoni? David: Iva, diġà għandna tliet kaxxi mimlijin.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you started collecting books for the donation? David: Yes, we already have three full boxes.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你们开始收集要捐赠的书了吗？戴维：开始了，我们已经装满三箱了。

messages.speaker: Marija (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Bdejtu t-tiġmigħ tal-kotba għad-donazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Bdejtu t-tiġmigħ tal-kotba għad-donazzjoni?
messages.zh: 你们开始收集要捐赠的书了吗？
messages.en: Have you started collecting books for the donation?

messages.speaker: David (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà għandna tliet kaxxi mimlijin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà għandna tliet kaxxi mimlijin.
messages.zh: 开始了，我们已经装满三箱了。
messages.en: Yes, we already have three full boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象分散的书一本本放进同一个箱子：tiġmigħ 的共同画面是“由散到聚”，可串起聚集与收集两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of adding decoration or making something more beautiful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过添加装饰或改善外观，使事物更美观的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li żżid dekorazzjonijiet jew tagħmel xi ħaġa isbaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰；修饰；通过添加细节使事物更美观。
美化；改善某物或某处的外观，使其更加美丽。

formal.mt: Il-proġett ta' tiġmil tal-pjazza jinkludi t-tħawwil ta' fjuri u ż-żebgħa tal-bankijiet.
formal.en: The square's beautification project includes planting flowers and painting the benches.
formal.zh: 广场美化项目包括种花和给长椅刷漆。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'se nużaw għat-tiġmil tas-sala? Rita: Fjuri fuq l-imwejjed u ftit dwal mal-ħitan.
colloquial.en: Elena: What will we use to decorate the hall? Rita: Flowers on the tables and a few lights along the walls.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我们用什么来装饰大厅？丽塔：桌上摆花，墙边装一些灯。

messages.speaker: Elena (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nużaw għat-tiġmil tas-sala?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nużaw għat-tiġmil tas-sala?
messages.zh: 我们用什么来装饰大厅？
messages.en: What will we use to decorate the hall?

messages.speaker: Rita (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fjuri fuq l-imwejjed u ftit dwal mal-ħitan.
messages.mt_standard: Fjuri fuq l-imwejjed u ftit dwal mal-ħitan.
messages.zh: 桌上摆花，墙边装一些灯。
messages.en: Flowers on the tables and a few lights along the walls.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tiġmil 配一幅布置前后的对照图：添花、挂灯、刷漆之后更好看，把“装饰细节”和“整体美化”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Burning, or the state of glowing because of intense heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燃烧的过程，或物体因高温而发红发亮的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruq, jew l-istat li fih xi ħaġa tiddi minħabba sħana qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燃烧；物体燃烧的过程。
因高温而发红发亮；受热后呈现灼亮状态。

collocations.en: the burning or glowing of charcoal
the glowing of metal from heat

formal.mt: It-tiġmir tal-metall kien jidher mill-kulur aħmar tiegħu wara li ssaħħan fil-forn.
formal.en: The metal's glow from heat was visible in its red colour after it was heated in the furnace.
formal.zh: 金属在炉中加热后呈现红色，可以看出它正因高温而发亮。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Il-fjammi spiċċaw, imma għadni nara dawl aħmar. Samwel: Dak it-tiġmir tal-faħam. Għadu jaħraq ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lina: The flames have gone out, but I can still see a red glow. Samwel: That's the charcoal glowing. It's still very hot.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：火焰已经没了，可我还看见红光。萨姆韦尔：那是木炭还在灼亮。它仍然很烫。

messages.speaker: Lina (露营同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fjammi spiċċaw, imma għadni nara dawl aħmar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fjammi spiċċaw, imma għadni nara dawl aħmar.
messages.zh: 火焰已经没了，可我还看见红光。
messages.en: The flames have gone out, but I can still see a red glow.

messages.speaker: Samwel (露营同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tiġmir tal-faħam. Għadu jaħraq ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tiġmir tal-faħam. Għadu jaħraq ħafna.
messages.zh: 那是木炭还在灼亮。它仍然很烫。
messages.en: That's the charcoal glowing. It's still very hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象炭火从燃烧到留下红亮余炭的连续画面：tiġmir 可记“燃烧”，也可记“因热发亮”，后者不一定有可见火焰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting something aside, often to keep it for a particular purpose or for later use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物放到一旁或留出一部分，通常为特定目的或以后使用而保留。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqiegħed xi ħaġa fil-ġenb, spiss biex iżżommha għal skop partikolari jew għal aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 留出；拨出；把某物放到一旁或保留供以后使用。

collocations.en: setting aside a portion for the next day
collocations.zh: 留出一份供第二天食用

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi t-tiġnib ta' parti mid-dħul għal tiswijiet futuri.
formal.en: The plan includes setting aside part of the income for future repairs.
formal.zh: 这项计划包括留出一部分收入，用于日后的维修。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ħallejt dik il-porzjon fil-kaxxa? Pietru: Qed nieħu ħsieb it-tiġnib tal-ikel għal għada. Dik se tkun l-ikla tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you leave that portion in the container? Pietru: I'm taking care of setting aside food for tomorrow. That will be my meal.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么把那一份留在盒子里？彼得：我在留出明天的食物。那份就是我明天的一餐。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallejt dik il-porzjon fil-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallejt dik il-porzjon fil-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你为什么把那一份留在盒子里？
messages.en: Why did you leave that portion in the container?

messages.speaker: Pietru (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nieħu ħsieb it-tiġnib tal-ikel għal għada. Dik se tkun l-ikla tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nieħu ħsieb it-tiġnib tal-ikel għal għada. Dik se tkun l-ikla tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我在留出明天的食物。那份就是我明天的一餐。
messages.en: I'm taking care of setting aside food for tomorrow. That will be my meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一份饭装进盒子，贴上“留到明天”：tiġnib 的核心是“先放一旁、特意留出”，也可用同样画面记留出钱款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Experience gained through life, especially through difficulties, troubles, or strife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生活中的经历，尤其指经历困难、磨难或纷争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Esperjenza tal-ħajja, speċjalment meta tinvolvi diffikultajiet, inkwiet jew ġlied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经历；亲身体验
烦恼；困境；磨难
纷争；冲突；争斗

collocations.en: the trials and experiences of life

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi t-tiġrib tal-familja tiegħu matul is-snin diffiċli.
formal.en: The author describes his family's trials during the difficult years.
formal.zh: 作者描述了家人在艰难岁月中经历的磨难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għaddiet din is-sena għalik? Pawlu: Kienet sena mimlija tiġrib, imma l-ħbieb għenuni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How has this year been for you? Pawlu: It was a year full of troubles, but my friends helped me a lot.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你这一年过得怎么样？Pawlu：这一年经历了很多困难，不过朋友们帮了我很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għaddiet din is-sena għalik?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għaddiet din is-sena għalik?
messages.zh: 你这一年过得怎么样？
messages.en: How has this year been for you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet sena mimlija tiġrib, imma l-ħbieb għenuni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet sena mimlija tiġrib, imma l-ħbieb għenuni ħafna.
messages.zh: 这一年经历了很多困难，不过朋友们帮了我很多。
messages.en: It was a year full of troubles, but my friends helped me a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人生经历想成一本日记：有体验，也有磨难和纷争。用这三个相关场景记住 tiġrib 的不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The demolition of a structure, or its falling or toppling down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑物等被拆除的行为，或物体倒塌、倾倒的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twaqqigħ ta' bini jew struttura, jew il-waqgħa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆除；拆毁
倒塌；倾倒；倒下

collocations.en: the collapse or demolition of a wall

formal.mt: It-tiġrif tal-bini l-antik se jibda nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The demolition of the old building will begin on Monday.
formal.zh: 旧建筑的拆除工作将于星期一开始。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għalqu t-triq? Mark: Minħabba t-tiġrif tal-bini l-antik; nistgħu ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did they close the road? Mark: Because of the demolition of the old building; we can take the other road.
colloquial.zh: Rita：他们为什么把路封了？Mark：因为要拆除那栋旧建筑；我们可以走另一条路。

messages.speaker: Rita (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għalqu t-triq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għalqu t-triq?
messages.zh: 他们为什么把路封了？
messages.en: Why did they close the road?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tiġrif tal-bini l-antik; nistgħu ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tiġrif tal-bini l-antik; nistgħu ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
messages.zh: 因为要拆除那栋旧建筑；我们可以走另一条路。
messages.en: Because of the demolition of the old building; we can take the other road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tiġrif 配两幅图：一幅是工人拆楼，一幅是墙体倒下；前者帮助记住拆除，后者帮助记住倒塌。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of swallowing food, drink, or another substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将食物、饮料或其他物质咽下去的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tibla' ikel, xorb jew sustanza oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吞咽；咽下的动作

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-diffikultà tal-pazjent fit-tiġrigħ tal-ikel.
formal.en: The report describes the patient's difficulty swallowing food.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该患者吞咽食物时的困难。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed tiekol daqshekk bil-mod? Toni: Għax illum għandi diffikultà fit-tiġrigħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you eating so slowly? Toni: Because I'm having difficulty swallowing today.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你为什么吃得这么慢？Toni：因为我今天吞咽有些困难。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiekol daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiekol daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.zh: 你为什么吃得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you eating so slowly?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax illum għandi diffikultà fit-tiġrigħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax illum għandi diffikultà fit-tiġrigħ.
messages.zh: 因为我今天吞咽有些困难。
messages.en: Because I'm having difficulty swallowing today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiġrigħ 和食物咽下去的动作一起记；书写时圈出词尾 għ，帮助与表示致伤的 tiġriħ 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contest of speed, or the course along which such a contest takes place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比拼速度的比赛，也可指比赛所经过的路线或使用的赛道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni ta' ħeffa, jew il-korsa li fuqha ssir din il-kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比赛路线；跑程
速度竞赛；赛跑；比赛
赛道；竞赛跑道

formal.mt: It-tiġrija se tibda fil-pjazza u tispiċċa ħdejn il-baħar.
formal.en: The race will start in the square and finish by the sea.
formal.zh: 比赛将在广场起跑，在海边结束。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tieħu sehem fit-tiġrija nhar il-Ħadd? Mark: Iva, imma rrid niġri bil-mod fil-bidu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you taking part in the race on Sunday? Mark: Yes, but I want to run slowly at the start.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你星期天要参加赛跑吗？Mark：要，不过我想在开始时跑慢一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (跑步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tieħu sehem fit-tiġrija nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Se tieħu sehem fit-tiġrija nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 你星期天要参加赛跑吗？
messages.en: Are you taking part in the race on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Mark (跑步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rrid niġri bil-mod fil-bidu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rrid niġri bil-mod fil-bidu.
messages.zh: 要，不过我想在开始时跑慢一点。
messages.en: Yes, but I want to run slowly at the start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一场赛跑，再沿着比赛路线看向脚下的赛道；用比赛、路线、场地三个画面记住 tiġrija 的三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of causing wounds or injuries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成伤口或使人受伤的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih jiġu kkawżati ġrieħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 致伤；使人受伤；造成创伤

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tiġriħ ta' żewġ persuni waqt l-inċident.
formal.en: The report describes the wounding of two people during the incident.
formal.zh: 报告描述了事件中两人受伤的情况。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kulħadd ħareġ sew mill-inċident? Pawlu: Iva, fortunatament ma kien hemm ebda tiġriħ.
colloquial.en: Elena: Did everyone come through the incident unharmed? Pawlu: Yes, fortunately no one was wounded.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这次事故中大家都平安无事吗？Pawlu：是的，幸好没有人受伤。

messages.speaker: Elena (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd ħareġ sew mill-inċident?
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd ħareġ sew mill-inċident?
messages.zh: 这次事故中大家都平安无事吗？
messages.en: Did everyone come through the incident unharmed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fortunatament ma kien hemm ebda tiġriħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fortunatament ma kien hemm ebda tiġriħ.
messages.zh: 是的，幸好没有人受伤。
messages.en: Yes, fortunately no one was wounded.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiġriħ 写在伤口示意图旁，记住它表示致伤；再对照 tiġrigħ，注意本词词尾是 ħ，没有前面的 g。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The expression of an idea or quality in a concrete or visible form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使抽象的思想或品质以具体、可见的形式得到体现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' forma konkreta jew viżibbli lil idea jew kwalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体现；具象化；某种思想或品质的具体化身

formal.mt: L-iskultura hija tiġsim tal-idea tal-libertà.
formal.en: The sculpture is an embodiment of the idea of freedom.
formal.zh: 这座雕塑是自由理念的具体体现。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għażilt idejn magħqudin għall-istatwa? Ġanni: Għax ridt tiġsim tal-ħbiberija, xi ħaġa li nistgħu naraw.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you choose joined hands for the statue? Ġanni: Because I wanted an embodiment of friendship, something we can see.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么为这座雕像选择了双手相握的造型？Ġanni：因为我想把友谊具体表现出来，变成我们看得见的东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt idejn magħqudin għall-istatwa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt idejn magħqudin għall-istatwa?
messages.zh: 你为什么为这座雕像选择了双手相握的造型？
messages.en: Why did you choose joined hands for the statue?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (雕塑创作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ridt tiġsim tal-ħbiberija, xi ħaġa li nistgħu naraw.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ridt tiġsim tal-ħbiberija, xi ħaġa li nistgħu naraw.
messages.zh: 因为我想把友谊具体表现出来，变成我们看得见的东西。
messages.en: Because I wanted an embodiment of friendship, something we can see.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把抽象的友谊画成两只相握的手：从看不见的概念变成看得见的形象，就是 tiġsim 所表达的具象化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The uncomfortable or painful sensations felt when hungry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饥饿时感到的阵阵不适或疼痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-uġigħ jew l-iskumdità li wieħed iħoss meta jkun bil-ġuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饥饿引起的阵痛；一阵阵饿得难受的感觉

collocations.zh: 感到饥饿引起的阵阵不适

formal.mt: Wara ħafna sigħat mingħajr ikel, il-vjaġġatur ħass tiġwiħ qawwi.
formal.en: After many hours without food, the traveller felt intense hunger pangs.
formal.zh: 许多小时没有进食后，旅人感到强烈的饥饿阵痛。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nieqfu nieklu xi ħaġa? Qed inħoss tiġwiħ. David: Iva, hemm kafetterija ftit passi 'l quddiem.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we stop and get something to eat? I'm getting hunger pangs. David: Yes, there's a café a few steps ahead.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们停下来吃点东西好吗？我饿得有些难受了。David：好啊，前面几步就有一家咖啡馆。

messages.speaker: Nina (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieqfu nieklu xi ħaġa? Qed inħoss tiġwiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Nieqfu nieklu xi ħaġa? Qed inħoss tiġwiħ.
messages.zh: 我们停下来吃点东西好吗？我饿得有些难受了。
messages.en: Shall we stop and get something to eat? I'm getting hunger pangs.

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm kafetterija ftit passi 'l quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm kafetterija ftit passi 'l quddiem.
messages.zh: 好啊，前面几步就有一家咖啡馆。
messages.en: Yes, there's a café a few steps ahead.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象错过午饭后肚子一阵阵饿得难受，把这种身体感觉与 tiġwiħ 绑定，记住重点是饥饿带来的不适。

gloss_zh: 用面包佐餐；吃饭时配面包

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of eating bread as an accompaniment to a meal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃饭时搭配面包一起吃的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-drawwa li tiekol il-ħobż mal-ikla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用面包佐餐；吃饭时配着面包一起吃

collocations.en: the habit of eating bread with meals

formal.mt: Il-kitba tiddeskrivi d-drawwa tat-tiġwiż, jiġifieri li tiekol il-ħobż mal-ikla.
formal.en: The text describes the practice of accompanying meals with bread, that is, eating bread alongside a meal.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述了用面包佐餐的做法，也就是吃饭时配着面包一起吃。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid ftit ħobż għat-tiġwiż? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Inħobb niekol il-ħobż mal-ikla.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like some bread to go with your meal? Mark: Yes, thank you. I like eating bread with my meal.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你要来点面包配着饭吃吗？Mark：要，谢谢。我喜欢吃饭时配点面包。

messages.speaker: Anna (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit ħobż għat-tiġwiż?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit ħobż għat-tiġwiż?
messages.zh: 你要来点面包配着饭吃吗？
messages.en: Would you like some bread to go with your meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Inħobb niekol il-ħobż mal-ikla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Inħobb niekol il-ħobż mal-ikla.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。我喜欢吃饭时配点面包。
messages.en: Yes, thank you. I like eating bread with my meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐盘旁边放着一篮面包，每吃几口饭菜就配一口面包；用这个完整的佐餐场景记住 tiġwiż。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of attacking or assaulting someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或事物实施攻击、袭击的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' attakk fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人或某物发起攻击的行为。
对他人实施暴力袭击或人身攻击的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tiħjib fuq il-vittma u l-ġrieħi li ġarrbet.
formal.en: The report describes the assault on the victim and the injuries she sustained.
formal.zh: 报告描述了受害者遭袭的经过及其所受的伤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jiġifieri tiħjib f'din is-sentenza? | Mark: Hawn ifisser attakk fuq persuna.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does tiħjib mean in this sentence? | Mark: Here it means an attack on a person.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个句子里的 tiħjib 是什么意思？ | Mark：这里指对一个人的袭击。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri tiħjib f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri tiħjib f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 tiħjib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tiħjib mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser attakk fuq persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser attakk fuq persuna.
messages.zh: 这里指对一个人的袭击。
messages.en: Here it means an attack on a person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用新闻报告中的“发生袭击、描述伤情”这一场景记 tiħjib，并提醒自己它是表示攻击行为的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of uttering curses against someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事说出诅咒话语、进行咒骂的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jgħid kliem ta' saħta kontra xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诅咒；咒骂。此处按名词学习，指说出诅咒话语的行为。

formal.mt: L-għalliem waqqaf it-tiżbib u talab lill-istudenti jesprimu r-rabja tagħhom mingħajr kliem ta' saħta.
formal.en: The teacher stopped the cursing and asked the students to express their anger without using curses.
formal.zh: 老师制止了咒骂，要求学生表达愤怒时不要使用诅咒的话语。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajt dak il-kliem ta' tiżbib? Pawlu: Iva. Nifhem li hu rrabjat, imma jista' jitkellem mingħajr ma jisħet.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you hear those curses? Pawlu: Yes. I understand he's angry, but he can speak without cursing.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你听到那些咒骂的话了吗？保罗：听到了。我理解他很生气，但他说话可以不用诅咒。

messages.speaker: 安娜（同事）
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dak il-kliem ta' tiżbib?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dak il-kliem ta' tiżbib?
messages.zh: 你听到那些咒骂的话了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear those curses?

messages.speaker: 保罗（同事）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Nifhem li hu rrabjat, imma jista' jitkellem mingħajr ma jisħet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Nifhem li hu rrabjat, imma jista' jitkellem mingħajr ma jisħet.
messages.zh: 听到了。我理解他很生气，但他说话可以不用诅咒。
messages.en: Yes. I understand he's angry, but he can speak without cursing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“愤怒时出口咒骂”的场景记 tiżbib；把它当作行为名词，理解为“咒骂这件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making butter by churning cream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过持续搅打奶油使其形成黄油的制作过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih issir il-butir billi titħabbat il-krema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作黄油；将奶油搅打成黄油的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni tat-tiżbid, il-krema titħabbat sakemm jifforma l-butir.
formal.en: During the butter-making demonstration, the cream is churned until butter forms.
formal.zh: 在制作黄油的演示中，奶油被持续搅打，直到形成黄油。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tagħmel b'dik il-krema? Nanna: Qed nagħmel il-butir. Dan il-proċess jissejjaħ tiżbid. Sara: Nista' nipprova jien ukoll?
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you doing with that cream? Grandma: I'm making butter. This process is called tiżbid. Sara: Can I try too?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在用那些奶油做什么？奶奶：我在做黄油。这个过程叫 tiżbid。萨拉：我也可以试试吗？

messages.speaker: 萨拉（孙女）
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tagħmel b'dik il-krema?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tagħmel b'dik il-krema?
messages.zh: 你在用那些奶油做什么？
messages.en: What are you doing with that cream?

messages.speaker: 奶奶（祖母）
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel il-butir. Dan il-proċess jissejjaħ tiżbid.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel il-butir. Dan il-proċess jissejjaħ tiżbid.
messages.zh: 我在做黄油。这个过程叫 tiżbid。
messages.en: I'm making butter. This process is called tiżbid.

messages.speaker: 萨拉（孙女）
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nipprova jien ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nipprova jien ukoll?
messages.zh: 我也可以试试吗？
messages.en: Can I try too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 tiżbid，就想象一碗奶油经过反复搅打变成黄油；记的是制作过程，不是黄油成品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of applying paint to a surface or dye to a material to give it colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给物体表面涂上油漆，或用染料使布料等材料着色的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih jingħata kulur lil wiċċ biż-żebgħa jew jinbidel il-kulur ta' materjal permezz ta' żebgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂漆；在物体表面涂上颜料或油漆。
染色；使用染料改变布料等材料的颜色。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi żewġ attivitajiet: tiżbigħ tal-injam b'pinzell u tiżbigħ tad-drapp f'banju taż-żebgħa.
formal.en: The course includes two activities: painting wood with a brush and dyeing fabric in a dye bath.
formal.zh: 课程包括两项活动：用刷子给木材涂漆，以及把布料放入染液中染色。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lest it-tiżbigħ tal-kamra? Anna: Kważi. Fadal ħajt wieħed biss. Mark: Tajjeb, inġib il-pinzell u ngħinek.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the room painting finished? Anna: Almost. There's only one wall left. Mark: Good, I'll get the brush and help you.
colloquial.zh: 马克：房间刷好了吗？安娜：快了。只剩一面墙。马克：好，我拿刷子来帮你。

messages.speaker: 马克（室友）
messages.mt_spoken: Lest it-tiżbigħ tal-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Lest it-tiżbigħ tal-kamra?
messages.zh: 房间刷好了吗？
messages.en: Is the room painting finished?

messages.speaker: 安娜（室友）
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Fadal ħajt wieħed biss.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Fadal ħajt wieħed biss.
messages.zh: 快了。只剩一面墙。
messages.en: Almost. There's only one wall left.

messages.speaker: 马克（室友）
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inġib il-pinzell u ngħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inġib il-pinzell u ngħinek.
messages.zh: 好，我拿刷子来帮你。
messages.en: Good, I'll get the brush and help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“墙面刷上颜色、布料染上颜色”两个画面记 tiżbigħ；注意它与表示串珠的 tiżbiġ 拼写不同。

gloss_zh: 把地方变成垃圾场；撒施粪肥

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of turning a place into a rubbish dump, or of spreading manure over land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一个地方弄成垃圾堆放场的行为；也指在土地上撒施粪肥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li post jinbidel f'miżbla, jew li jinfirex id-demel fuq l-art.

sense_translations.en_definition: turning a place into a rubbish dump
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某个地方变成垃圾场；任由垃圾堆积，使该处成为垃圾堆放地。
撒施粪肥，例如把粪肥撒在田地里。

collocations.en: turning a place into a dump with rubbish
collocations.zh: 用垃圾把某处弄成垃圾场

formal.mt: It-tiżbil tal-għalqa bid-demel għandu skop agrikolu; it-tiżbil ta' art b'żibel jagħmilha miżbla.
formal.en: Spreading manure over a field serves an agricultural purpose; filling land with rubbish turns it into a dump.
formal.zh: 在田地里撒施粪肥具有农业用途；往土地上堆放垃圾则会使其变成垃圾场。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Rajt kemm tefgħu żibel f'dik l-art? Pawlu: Iva, dan tiżbil. Qed ibiddluha f'miżbla. Lina: Xi ħasra, kienet nadifa.
colloquial.en: Lina: Did you see how much rubbish they've dumped on that land? Pawlu: Yes, that's turning it into a dump. Lina: What a shame, it used to be clean.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你看到他们往那块地上倒了多少垃圾吗？保罗：看到了，这就是把地方弄成垃圾场。他们正在把那里变成垃圾堆。莉娜：真可惜，那里原本很干净。

messages.speaker: 莉娜（邻居）
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kemm tefgħu żibel f'dik l-art?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kemm tefgħu żibel f'dik l-art?
messages.zh: 你看到他们往那块地上倒了多少垃圾吗？
messages.en: Did you see how much rubbish they've dumped on that land?

messages.speaker: 保罗（邻居）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan tiżbil. Qed ibiddluha f'miżbla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan tiżbil. Qed ibiddluha f'miżbla.
messages.zh: 看到了，这就是把地方弄成垃圾场。他们正在把那里变成垃圾堆。
messages.en: Yes, that's turning it into a dump.

messages.speaker: 莉娜（邻居）
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħasra, kienet nadifa.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħasra, kienet nadifa.
messages.zh: 真可惜，那里原本很干净。
messages.en: What a shame, it used to be clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tiżbil 配两幅土地画面：一幅堆满垃圾，一幅撒上粪肥；结合语境区分这两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cutting back of plant growth, or the cutting off of an animal's wool or hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剪除或剪短植物枝条的修剪活动；也指剪下动物身上的羊毛或毛发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtugħ ta' friegħi jew partijiet minn pjanta biex tiġi rranġata, jew il-qtugħ tas-suf jew tax-xagħar ta' annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修剪；剪除或剪短植物的枝条等部分。
剪毛；剪下羊等动物身上的毛。

formal.mt: Il-programm tat-taħriġ jinkludi t-tiżbir tas-siġar fil-ġnien u t-tiżbir tan-nagħaġ fir-razzett.
formal.en: The training programme includes pruning trees in the garden and shearing sheep on the farm.
formal.zh: 培训计划包括在花园里修剪树木，以及在农场给羊剪毛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed taqta' dawk il-friegħi? Ġużeppi: Dan tiżbir. Qed inneħħi l-friegħi niexfa. Sara: Issa nifhem. Nista' niġborhom?
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you cutting those branches? Ġużeppi: This is pruning. I'm removing the dry branches. Sara: Now I understand. Can I gather them up?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么剪那些树枝？朱塞佩：这是修剪。我在剪掉干枯的枝条。萨拉：现在我明白了。我可以把它们收起来吗？

messages.speaker: 萨拉（园艺学员）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed taqta' dawk il-friegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed taqta' dawk il-friegħi?
messages.zh: 你为什么剪那些树枝？
messages.en: Why are you cutting those branches?

messages.speaker: 朱塞佩（园丁）
messages.mt_spoken: Dan tiżbir. Qed inneħħi l-friegħi niexfa.
messages.mt_standard: Dan tiżbir. Qed inneħħi l-friegħi niexfa.
messages.zh: 这是修剪。我在剪掉干枯的枝条。
messages.en: This is pruning. I'm removing the dry branches.

messages.speaker: 萨拉（园艺学员）
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem. Nista' niġborhom?
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem. Nista' niġborhom?
messages.zh: 现在我明白了。我可以把它们收起来吗？
messages.en: Now I understand. Can I gather them up?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一把剪刀先修剪树枝，再给羊剪毛，用这两个剪除场景记住 tiżbir 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of threading beads onto a string or similar material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把珠子逐颗穿到线或类似材料上，连成一串的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha ż-żibeġ jiddaħħal wieħed wieħed f'ħajta biex jifforma sensiela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 串珠；把珠子逐颗穿在线上的过程。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tat-tiżbiġ, il-parteċipanti jitgħallmu jgħaddu l-ħajta mit-toqob taż-żibeġ u jagħmlu ġiżirana.
formal.en: In the bead-stringing lesson, participants learn to pass thread through the holes in beads and make a necklace.
formal.zh: 在串珠课上，参与者学习把线穿过珠孔，制作一条项链。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qatt ippruvajt it-tiżbiġ? Lina: Le. Kif nibda? Maja: Għaddi l-ħajta minn din iż-żibġa, imbagħad żid oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you ever tried stringing beads? Lina: No. How do I start? Maja: Pass the thread through this bead, then add another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你试过串珠吗？莉娜：没有。怎么开始？玛雅：把线穿过这颗珠子，然后再加一颗。

messages.speaker: 玛雅（手工课老师）
messages.mt_spoken: Qatt ippruvajt it-tiżbiġ?
messages.mt_standard: Qatt ippruvajt it-tiżbiġ?
messages.zh: 你试过串珠吗？
messages.en: Have you ever tried stringing beads?

messages.speaker: 莉娜（学员）
messages.mt_spoken: Le. Kif nibda?
messages.mt_standard: Le. Kif nibda?
messages.zh: 没有。怎么开始？
messages.en: No. How do I start?

messages.speaker: 玛雅（手工课老师）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddi l-ħajta minn din iż-żibġa, imbagħad żid oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddi l-ħajta minn din iż-żibġa, imbagħad żid oħra.
messages.zh: 把线穿过这颗珠子，然后再加一颗。
messages.en: Pass the thread through this bead, then add another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiżbiġ 末尾 ġ 上的小点想象成一颗珠子，用“一颗颗穿在线上”的画面帮助记住串珠义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of stuffiness or blockage, especially congestion in the sinuses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感觉堵塞、不通畅的状态，尤指鼻窦充塞所产生的堵闷感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' sadd jew imblukkar, speċjalment fis-sinus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堵闷感；感觉不通畅、被堵住的状态。
鼻窦充塞；鼻窦部位的堵塞感。

formal.mt: Fil-formola, il-pazjent iddeskriva sensazzjoni ta' tiżdim fis-sinus li bdiet ilbieraħ.
formal.en: On the form, the patient described a feeling of sinus congestion that began yesterday.
formal.zh: 患者在表格中描述了从昨天开始出现的鼻窦堵塞感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titkellem hekk? Mark: Għandi tiżdim f'imnieħri u leħni qed jinstema' differenti. Maja: Iva, innutajt meta bdejt titkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you sound like that? Mark: My nose feels blocked, and my voice sounds different. Maja: Yes, I noticed when you started speaking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说话的声音怎么这样？马克：我鼻子有堵塞感，声音也变了。玛雅：是的，你一开口我就注意到了。

messages.speaker: 玛雅（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed titkellem hekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed titkellem hekk?
messages.zh: 你说话的声音怎么这样？
messages.en: Why do you sound like that?

messages.speaker: 马克（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tiżdim f'imnieħri u leħni qed jinstema' differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tiżdim f'imnieħri u leħni qed jinstema' differenti.
messages.zh: 我鼻子有堵塞感，声音也变了。
messages.en: My nose feels blocked, and my voice sounds different.

messages.speaker: 玛雅（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, innutajt meta bdejt titkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, innutajt meta bdejt titkellem.
messages.zh: 是的，你一开口我就注意到了。
messages.en: Yes, I noticed when you started speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“鼻子像被堵住，说话带着鼻音”的体验记 tiżdim，再联想到鼻窦部位的充塞感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of dancing, or the act of making someone dance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 跳舞这一活动，也可指使某人跳舞的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività taż-żfin, jew l-att li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiżfen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跳舞；舞蹈活动。
使人跳舞；引人起舞的行为。

formal.mt: Il-programm kulturali jinkludi wirja ta' tiżfin tradizzjonali.
formal.en: The cultural programme includes a display of traditional dancing.
formal.zh: 文化活动安排中包括一场传统舞蹈表演。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi għal lezzjoni tat-tiżfin miegħi? Mark: Iva, imma għadni ma nafx niżfen sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come to a dancing lesson with me? Mark: Yes, but I still don't know how to dance well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想和我一起去上舞蹈课吗？马克：想，不过我还不太会跳舞。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi għal lezzjoni tat-tiżfin miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi għal lezzjoni tat-tiżfin miegħi?
messages.zh: 你想和我一起去上舞蹈课吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to a dancing lesson with me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadni ma nafx niżfen sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadni ma nafx niżfen sew.
messages.zh: 想，不过我还不太会跳舞。
messages.en: Yes, but I still don't know how to dance well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiżfin 和舞蹈课的画面绑定：音乐响起，大家跳舞；若语境强调带动别人，则记作使人起舞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of coating a surface with tar or pitch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个表面涂覆柏油或沥青的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih wiċċ jinkesa biż-żift.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用柏油或沥青涂覆表面的作业或过程。

formal.mt: It-tiżfit tas-saqaf għandu jsir wara li l-wiċċ jitnaddaf u jinxef.
formal.en: The roof should be coated with tar after the surface has been cleaned and has dried.
formal.zh: 应在表面清理干净并干燥后，给屋顶涂柏油。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistax nitla' fuq is-saqaf illum? Pawlu: Għax għaddej ix-xogħol ta' tiżfit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't I go up onto the roof today? Pawlu: Because the tar-coating work is in progress.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么今天不能上屋顶？保罗：因为正在进行涂柏油作业。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nitla' fuq is-saqaf illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nitla' fuq is-saqaf illum?
messages.zh: 为什么今天不能上屋顶？
messages.en: Why can't I go up onto the roof today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għaddej ix-xogħol ta' tiżfit.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għaddej ix-xogħol ta' tiżfit.
messages.zh: 因为正在进行涂柏油作业。
messages.en: Because the tar-coating work is in progress.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tiżfit 时想象工人把黑色柏油涂在屋顶上；这个词指涂覆的过程，不只是那层黑色材料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Foolish behaviour or talk that shows little sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏理智的愚蠢行为，或没有道理的傻话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba jew diskors iblah li juri nuqqas ta' għaqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愚蠢的行为或言谈；胡闹或说傻话。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, it-tiżgig ta' xi parteċipanti fixkel id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: During the meeting, the foolish behaviour of some participants disrupted the discussion.
formal.zh: 会上，一些与会者的愚蠢举动干扰了讨论。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Biżżejjed tiżgig, irridu nispiċċaw ix-xogħol. Ben: Sewwa, issa nikkonċentra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Enough messing around; we need to finish the work. Ben: All right, I'll concentrate now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：别再胡闹了，我们得把工作做完。本：好，我现在专心做。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biżżejjed tiżgig, irridu nispiċċaw ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Biżżejjed tiżgig, irridu nispiċċaw ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 别再胡闹了，我们得把工作做完。
messages.en: Enough messing around; we need to finish the work.

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, issa nikkonċentra.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, issa nikkonċentra.
messages.zh: 好，我现在专心做。
messages.en: All right, I'll concentrate now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiżgig 放进“别再胡闹了”的对话中记忆；它的两个 g 没有点，注意与 tiżġiġ 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of multiplying or increasing greatly in number.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量不断增加或大量繁增的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa titkattar jew tiżdied ħafna fin-numru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增殖；数量大量增加或繁增。

formal.mt: L-istudju jkejjel it-tiżgħid taċ-ċelloli f'kundizzjonijiet differenti.
formal.en: The study measures cell proliferation under different conditions.
formal.zh: 这项研究测量不同条件下的细胞增殖情况。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'jiġifieri tiżgħid taċ-ċelloli? Adam: Ifisser li ċ-ċelloli qed jiżdiedu fin-numru.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does cell proliferation mean? Adam: It means that the cells are increasing in number.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：细胞增殖是什么意思？亚当：意思是细胞的数量正在增加。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri tiżgħid taċ-ċelloli?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri tiżgħid taċ-ċelloli?
messages.zh: 细胞增殖是什么意思？
messages.en: What does cell proliferation mean?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ċ-ċelloli qed jiżdiedu fin-numru.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ċ-ċelloli qed jiżdiedu fin-numru.
messages.zh: 意思是细胞的数量正在增加。
messages.en: It means that the cells are increasing in number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象显微镜里的细胞从几个变成一大片，用 tiżgħid 记住“数量增多”；重点是数量变化，不是单个细胞变大。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of something becoming smaller or being reduced in size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物变小或被缩小尺寸的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir iżgħar jew titnaqqas fid-daqs.

sense_translations.en_definition: process of being reduced in size
sense_translations.zh_definition: 尺寸被缩小或体积减小的过程。

collocations.en: reduction of the image in size

formal.mt: Wara t-tiżgħir tal-immaġni, it-test li fiha għandu jibqa' jinqara faċilment.
formal.en: After the image has been reduced in size, the text within it should remain easy to read.
formal.zh: 图像缩小后，其中的文字应仍然易于阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Wara t-tiżgħir, ir-ritratt se joqgħod fuq il-paġna? Mark: Iva, u jibqa' spazju għat-titlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: After the reduction in size, will the photo fit on the page? Mark: Yes, and there will still be room for the title.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：缩小以后，照片能放进这一页吗？马克：能，而且还会留出放标题的空间。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara t-tiżgħir, ir-ritratt se joqgħod fuq il-paġna?
messages.mt_standard: Wara t-tiżgħir, ir-ritratt se joqgħod fuq il-paġna?
messages.zh: 缩小以后，照片能放进这一页吗？
messages.en: After the reduction in size, will the photo fit on the page?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jibqa' spazju għat-titlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jibqa' spazju għat-titlu.
messages.zh: 能，而且还会留出放标题的空间。
messages.en: Yes, and there will still be room for the title.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiżgħir 配上照片四角向内收的画面，记作尺寸缩小；与 tiżgħid 的数量增多分别用两张卡片练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition or process of smelling bad, or of rotting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散发难闻气味的状态或过程，也可指腐烂的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' riħa ħażina jew il-proċess tat-taħsir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发臭；散发难闻气味。
腐烂；腐败变质的过程。

collocations.en: food rotting or developing a bad smell

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tiżhim taż-żibel li tħalla għal diversi jiem fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The report describes the stinking of rubbish left in the courtyard for several days.
formal.zh: 报告描述了垃圾在院子里放置数日后发臭的情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa? Pawlu: Mit-tiżhim tal-ikel li baqa' fil-borża.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is this smell coming from? Pawlu: From the food rotting in the bag.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这股气味是从哪里来的？保罗：是袋子里剩下的食物腐烂发出的。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa?
messages.zh: 这股气味是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this smell coming from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mit-tiżhim tal-ikel li baqa' fil-borża.
messages.mt_standard: Mit-tiżhim tal-ikel li baqa' fil-borża.
messages.zh: 是袋子里剩下的食物腐烂发出的。
messages.en: From the food rotting in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tiżhim 时想象打开久放的食物袋，先闻到臭味，再发现腐烂；用同一场景分别记住发臭和腐烂两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The neighing of a horse, or the blossoming or flowering of a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马发出嘶鸣的行为，或植物开花的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss li jagħmel iż-żiemel meta jinħem, jew il-ħruġ tal-fjuri fil-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马的嘶鸣；马发出嘶鸣声。
开花；花朵绽放。
植物开花的过程或现象。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tiżhir tas-siġar fil-ġnien matul ir-rebbiegħa.
formal.en: The students observed the blossoming of the trees in the garden during spring.
formal.zh: 学生们在春季观察了花园里树木开花的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Smajt dak it-tiżhir? Adam: Iva, ġej miż-żiemel fl-istalla.
colloquial.en: Lina: Did you hear that neighing? Adam: Yes, it's coming from the horse in the stable.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你听到那阵马嘶声了吗？亚当：听到了，是马厩里的那匹马发出的。

messages.speaker: Lina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dak it-tiżhir?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dak it-tiżhir?
messages.zh: 你听到那阵马嘶声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that neighing?

messages.speaker: Adam (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej miż-żiemel fl-istalla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej miż-żiemel fl-istalla.
messages.zh: 听到了，是马厩里的那匹马发出的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the horse in the stable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tiżhir 配两幅画：马厩里听马嘶，春天看树开花；遇到马匹或植物的上下文，就能选出对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in an amount, or the addition of something to what is already present.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量的增加，或在已有事物中添加东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fl-ammont ta' xi ħaġa, jew iż-żieda ta' xi ħaġa ma' dak li diġà hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；使数量或程度上升的过程。
添加；在原有内容或数量之外加入东西。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri tiżjid fl-ispejjeż tat-trasport matul l-aħħar sena.
formal.en: The report shows an increase in transport expenses over the past year.
formal.zh: 报告显示，过去一年运输开支有所增加。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-taħlita għadha ħoxna wisq. Taħseb li hemm bżonn tiżjid ta' ilma? Marija: Iva, imma żid ftit kull darba.
colloquial.en: Lara: The mixture is still too thick. Do you think it needs some added water? Marija: Yes, but add a little at a time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：混合物还是太稠了。你觉得需要再加些水吗？玛丽娅：需要，但每次只加一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: It-taħlita għadha ħoxna wisq. Taħseb li hemm bżonn tiżjid ta' ilma?
messages.mt_standard: It-taħlita għadha ħoxna wisq. Taħseb li hemm bżonn tiżjid ta' ilma?
messages.zh: 混合物还是太稠了。你觉得需要再加些水吗？
messages.en: The mixture is still too thick. Do you think it needs some added water?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma żid ftit kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma żid ftit kull darba.
messages.zh: 需要，但每次只加一点。
messages.en: Yes, but add a little at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiżjid 放进“杯中再加一点水”的画面：水量上升对应“增加”，倒入的动作对应“添加”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Decoration used to make something more attractive, or the ornaments used for that purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了使事物更美观而进行的装饰，也指为此使用的装饰物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jsir biex xi ħaġa tidher isbaħ, jew l-oġġetti li jintużaw għal dan il-għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰；使某物或某处更美观的布置。
装饰品；用于美化环境或物件的饰物。

formal.mt: It-tiżjin tas-sala jinkludi fjuri bojod u dwal żgħar.
formal.en: The hall's decoration includes white flowers and small lights.
formal.zh: 大厅的装饰包括白花和小彩灯。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn poġġejt it-tiżjin tal-Milied? Pawlu: Fil-kaxxa l-kbira. Trid inġibha? Nina: Iva, ejja nżejnu s-siġra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did you put the Christmas decorations? Pawlu: In the big box. Shall I bring it? Nina: Yes, let's decorate the tree.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你把圣诞装饰品放哪儿了？保罗：在大箱子里。要我拿来吗？妮娜：好，我们来装饰圣诞树吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt it-tiżjin tal-Milied?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt it-tiżjin tal-Milied?
messages.zh: 你把圣诞装饰品放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the Christmas decorations?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxa l-kbira. Trid inġibha?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxa l-kbira. Trid inġibha?
messages.zh: 在大箱子里。要我拿来吗？
messages.en: In the big box. Shall I bring it?

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nżejnu s-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nżejnu s-siġra.
messages.zh: 好，我们来装饰圣诞树吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's decorate the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一棵挂满彩灯的树：整体布置是“装饰”，树上的饰物是“装饰品”，两者都可联系 tiżjin。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of visiting people or places regularly or habitually.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常或习惯性地探访某人、走访某处的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-drawwa li wieħed iżur nies jew postijiet ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常探访；作为习惯而反复进行的拜访或走访。

formal.mt: It-tiżjir regolari għand il-qraba jgħin biex jinżammu r-rabtiet tal-familja.
formal.en: Regular visits to relatives help maintain family ties.
formal.zh: 经常探访亲戚有助于维系家庭关系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek tmur għand in-nanna kull nhar ta' Ħadd? Mark: Iva, dak it-tiżjir sar drawwa sabiħa għalija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you still go to your grandmother's every Sunday? Mark: Yes, those regular visits have become a lovely habit for me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你现在还是每个星期天都去奶奶家吗？马克：是啊，这样经常去探望她，已经成了我的一个好习惯。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek tmur għand in-nanna kull nhar ta' Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek tmur għand in-nanna kull nhar ta' Ħadd?
messages.zh: 你现在还是每个星期天都去奶奶家吗？
messages.en: Do you still go to your grandmother's every Sunday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak it-tiżjir sar drawwa sabiħa għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak it-tiżjir sar drawwa sabiħa għalija.
messages.zh: 是啊，这样经常去探望她，已经成了我的一个好习惯。
messages.en: Yes, those regular visits have become a lovely habit for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上给每个星期天画一扇亲友家的门，用反复登门的画面记住 tiżjir 的“习惯性探访”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The short, repeated chirping sounds made by birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟发出的短促、连续的啁啾声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħsejjes qosra u ripetuti li jagħmlu l-għasafar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟的啁啾声；鸟发出的短促鸣叫声。

formal.mt: Filgħodu, it-tiżjiż tal-għasafar jinstema' mill-ġnien tal-iskola.
formal.en: In the morning, birds can be heard chirping in the school garden.
formal.zh: 早晨，可以听见学校花园里传来的鸟鸣声。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Qed tisma' dak it-tiżjiż? Toni: Iva, hemm għasafar żgħar fis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lina: Can you hear that chirping? Toni: Yes, there are little birds in the tree beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你听到那阵鸟叫了吗？托尼：听到了，窗边的树上有几只小鸟。

messages.speaker: Lina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dak it-tiżjiż?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dak it-tiżjiż?
messages.zh: 你听到那阵鸟叫了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that chirping?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm għasafar żgħar fis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm għasafar żgħar fis-siġra ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 听到了，窗边的树上有几只小鸟。
messages.en: Yes, there are little birds in the tree beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiżjiż 写在清晨窗边的小鸟旁，读词时想象短促连续的鸟鸣，让声音场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nasal congestion, meaning a blocked or stuffy nose; also flu.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子堵塞、不通气的状态；也可指流感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' mnieħer misdud; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għall-influwenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻塞；鼻子堵塞、不通气的状态。
流感；流行性感冒。

formal.mt: L-istudent kiteb li ma setax jorqod tajjeb minħabba t-tiżkim.
formal.en: The student wrote that he could not sleep well because of nasal congestion.
formal.zh: 这名学生写道，他因鼻塞而睡不好。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ma rqadtx tajjeb? David: Kelli tiżkim qawwi u mnieħri kien misdud il-lejl kollu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why didn't you sleep well? David: I had severe nasal congestion, and my nose was blocked all night.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么没睡好？戴维：我鼻塞得很厉害，鼻子堵了一整夜。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma rqadtx tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma rqadtx tajjeb?
messages.zh: 你为什么没睡好？
messages.en: Why didn't you sleep well?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli tiżkim qawwi u mnieħri kien misdud il-lejl kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli tiżkim qawwi u mnieħri kien misdud il-lejl kollu.
messages.zh: 我鼻塞得很厉害，鼻子堵了一整夜。
messages.en: I had severe nasal congestion, and my nose was blocked all night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“鼻子像被塞住”的画面记住 tiżkim，再另设一张“流感”词义卡；两个义项分开记，避免混为同一概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or action of extending outward beyond a surrounding surface or edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 超出周围表面或边缘而向外伸出的状态或现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li xi ħaġa toħroġ 'il barra minn wiċċ jew minn tarf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向外突出；从表面或边缘向外伸出的现象。
凸出；某物伸出周围表面之外的状态。

formal.mt: It-tiżkir tal-ġebel mill-ħajt inaqqas il-wisa' tal-passaġġ.
formal.en: The protrusion of the stones from the wall reduces the width of the passage.
formal.zh: 石块从墙面凸出，使通道变窄。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex l-ixkaffa ma toqgħodx sew mal-ħajt? Ben: Minħabba t-tiżkir ta' dik il-ġebla. Qed timbotta l-ixkaffa 'l barra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why doesn't the shelf sit properly against the wall? Ben: Because that stone sticks out. It's pushing the shelf outward.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：为什么架子不能好好贴着墙？本：因为那块石头凸出来了，把架子往外顶。

messages.speaker: Anna (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-ixkaffa ma toqgħodx sew mal-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-ixkaffa ma toqgħodx sew mal-ħajt?
messages.zh: 为什么架子不能好好贴着墙？
messages.en: Why doesn't the shelf sit properly against the wall?

messages.speaker: Ben (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tiżkir ta' dik il-ġebla. Qed timbotta l-ixkaffa 'l barra.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tiżkir ta' dik il-ġebla. Qed timbotta l-ixkaffa 'l barra.
messages.zh: 因为那块石头凸出来了，把架子往外顶。
messages.en: Because that stone sticks out. It's pushing the shelf outward.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象平墙上有一块石头伸出来，手掌沿墙滑过时碰到它；这个“向外凸出”的状态就是 tiżkir。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tangling of threads together so that they are difficult to separate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多根线互相缠绕、难以分开的状态或现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tħabbil tal-ħjut ma' xulxin, b'mod li jkun diffiċli tifridhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线的缠结；多根线互相缠绕在一起的状态。

formal.mt: Il-ħjut għandhom jinżammu separati biex jiġi evitat it-tiżlim waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The threads should be kept separate to prevent tangling during the work.
formal.zh: 应将各根线分开放置，以免工作时缠结。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ara dan it-tiżlim tal-ħjut! Ma nafx minn fejn nibda. Marija: Iġbed ħajta waħda bil-mod, u jien inżomm l-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Look at this tangle of threads! I don't know where to start. Marija: Pull one thread gently, and I'll hold the others.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你看这些线缠成什么样了！我都不知道从哪儿开始。玛丽娅：你慢慢拉一根，我来拿住其他的。

messages.speaker: Rita (缝纫学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan it-tiżlim tal-ħjut! Ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan it-tiżlim tal-ħjut! Ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
messages.zh: 你看这些线缠成什么样了！我都不知道从哪儿开始。
messages.en: Look at this tangle of threads! I don't know where to start.

messages.speaker: Marija (缝纫老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iġbed ħajta waħda bil-mod, u jien inżomm l-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Iġbed ħajta waħda bil-mod, u jien inżomm l-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 你慢慢拉一根，我来拿住其他的。
messages.en: Pull one thread gently, and I'll hold the others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiżlim 写在线团图旁：几根不同颜色的线越拉越缠，必须逐根理开，用这个画面记住“线的缠结”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sliding or slipping; also a lapse in judgment, attention, or conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体或身体的滑移、滑动；也可指判断、注意或行为上的一次失误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment ta' xi ħaġa li tiżloq; ukoll żball jew nuqqas fil-ġudizzju, fl-attenzjoni jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑移；原有位置或接触状态发生滑动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moviment li jseħħ meta xi ħaġa tiżloq minn postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次疏忽、失误或行为上的失检。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żball jew nuqqas li jseħħ fil-ġudizzju, fl-attenzjoni jew fl-imġiba.

formal.mt: Minħabba l-art imxarrba, tqiegħdet tabella biex twissi dwar ir-riskju ta' tiżliq.
formal.en: Because the floor was wet, a sign was placed to warn of the risk of slipping.
formal.zh: 由于地面湿滑，现场放置了警示牌，提醒人们注意滑倒风险。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Oqgħod attent, hemm riskju ta' tiżliq ħdejn il-bieb. Mark: Grazzi, se nimxi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Be careful, there's a risk of slipping near the door. Mark: Thanks, I'll walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小心，门边容易滑倒。马克：谢谢，我会慢慢走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attent, hemm riskju ta' tiżliq ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attent, hemm riskju ta' tiżliq ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 小心，门边容易滑倒。
messages.en: Be careful, there's a risk of slipping near the door.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, se nimxi bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, se nimxi bil-mod.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我会慢慢走。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想脚下一滑，再想判断上也可能“滑一下”：用这两个画面分别记住滑移和失误。

gloss_zh: 涂抹性的；易抹开留痕的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a substance or material that spreads in smears when rubbed across a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物质或材料在表面被擦抹时会铺展开来、留下涂抹痕迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinfirex fuq wiċċ u jħalli marki meta jingħorok.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹性的；擦抹时会铺展开来并留下痕迹的。

collocations.zh: 擦抹时容易铺开留痕的材料
擦抹时容易留下涂痕的产品

formal.mt: Dan il-materjal tiżliġ iħalli marki fuq il-karta meta jingħorok.
formal.en: This smearing material leaves marks on paper when rubbed.
formal.zh: 这种易抹开留痕的材料被擦抹时，会在纸上留下痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Dan il-prodott tiżliġ; ara l-marka li ħalla fuq il-karta. Leo: Iva, infirex meta messejtu.
colloquial.en: Eva: This product smears; look at the mark it left on the paper. Leo: Yes, it spread when I touched it.
colloquial.zh: 伊娃：这个产品一抹就会留痕，你看它在纸上留下的印子。利奥：是啊，我一碰它就抹开了。

messages.speaker: Eva (美术课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prodott tiżliġ; ara l-marka li ħalla fuq il-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prodott tiżliġ; ara l-marka li ħalla fuq il-karta.
messages.zh: 这个产品一抹就会留痕，你看它在纸上留下的印子。
messages.en: This product smears; look at the mark it left on the paper.

messages.speaker: Leo (美术课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, infirex meta messejtu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, infirex meta messejtu.
messages.zh: 是啊，我一碰它就抹开了。
messages.en: Yes, it spread when I touched it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指擦过一团颜料，颜色被拖成一道痕迹；用 tiżliġ 描述这种材料“擦抹会铺开留痕”的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of holding something or keeping an action, impulse, or movement under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 握住、持住某物的行为；也指对行动、冲动或运动的约束与控制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li żżomm xi ħaġa, jew li trażżan azzjoni, impuls jew moviment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 握持；把某物持住或保持在一定位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li żżomm xi ħaġa f'idejk jew f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约束；对行为、冲动或动作的限制与控制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trażżin jew kontroll ta' mġiba, impuls jew moviment.

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jitlob tiżmim sod tal-ħabel waqt li l-oġġett jitmexxa bil-mod.
formal.en: The exercise requires a firm hold on the rope while the object is moved slowly.
formal.zh: 这项练习要求在缓慢移动物体时牢牢握住绳子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'dan l-eżempju, 'tiżmim' ifisser li żżomm il-ħabel? Pawlu: Iva, li żżommu sew biex ma jiżloqx minn idejk.
colloquial.en: Lara: In this example, does 'tiżmim' mean holding the rope? Pawlu: Yes, holding it securely so it doesn't slip out of your hands.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个例子里的 tiżmim 是指握住绳子吗？保罗：对，就是握牢它，免得它从手里滑出去。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-eżempju, 'tiżmim' ifisser li żżomm il-ħabel?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżempju, 'tiżmim' ifisser li żżomm il-ħabel?
messages.zh: 这个例子里的 tiżmim 是指握住绳子吗？
messages.en: In this example, does 'tiżmim' mean holding the rope?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, li żżommu sew biex ma jiżloqx minn idejk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, li żżommu sew biex ma jiżloqx minn idejk.
messages.zh: 对，就是握牢它，免得它从手里滑出去。
messages.en: Yes, holding it securely so it doesn't slip out of your hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“握住绳子”和“管住冲动”并排想象：手握住物体，意志约束行动，分别对应两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of playing a fife, a small transverse flute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吹奏小横笛这一活动，强调演奏行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddoqq flawt żgħir li jinżamm mal-ġenb waqt id-daqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小横笛的吹奏；演奏小横笛这一行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daqq ta' flawt żgħir li jinżamm mal-ġenb.

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni bdiet b'eżerċizzju ta' tiżmir, u l-istudenti rrepetew melodija qasira.
formal.en: The lesson began with a fife-playing exercise, and the students repeated a short melody.
formal.zh: 课程以一项小横笛吹奏练习开始，学生们反复演奏了一段短旋律。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se nagħmlu fil-lezzjoni tal-lum? Toni: Se nagħmlu ftit tiżmir u nippruvaw melodija ġdida.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are we doing in today's lesson? Toni: We'll do some fife playing and try a new melody.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今天的课我们做什么？托尼：我们会练一会儿小横笛，再试着吹一段新旋律。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nagħmlu fil-lezzjoni tal-lum?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nagħmlu fil-lezzjoni tal-lum?
messages.zh: 今天的课我们做什么？
messages.en: What are we doing in today's lesson?

messages.speaker: Toni (音乐教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħmlu ftit tiżmir u nippruvaw melodija ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħmlu ftit tiżmir u nippruvaw melodija ġdida.
messages.zh: 我们会练一会儿小横笛，再试着吹一段新旋律。
messages.en: We'll do some fife playing and try a new melody.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象学生举起小横笛吹出短旋律；把整段“正在吹奏”的动作画面与 tiżmir 联系起来。

gloss_zh: 燧石的生成；变得像燧石一样坚硬

teaching_sense.en_definition: The production of flint, or the process of becoming hard like flint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燧石的生成或生产；也指某种材料变得像燧石一样坚硬的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-produzzjoni taż-żnied, jew il-proċess li bih materjal isir iebes bħaż-żnied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燧石的生成或生产。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-produzzjoni taż-żnied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得像燧石一样坚硬的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir iebsa bħaż-żnied.

collocations.en: a process of flint production or flint-like hardening
collocations.zh: 燧石生成或燧石般硬化的过程

collocations.en: the material's becoming hard like flint
collocations.zh: 材料变得像燧石一样坚硬

formal.mt: It-test jiddistingwi bejn it-tiżnid bħala produzzjoni taż-żnied u t-tiżnid bħala proċess li bih materjal isir iebes bħaż-żnied.
formal.en: The text distinguishes between tiżnid as the production of flint and tiżnid as a process in which material becomes hard like flint.
formal.zh: 该文本区分了 tiżnid 的两个含义：燧石的生成，以及材料变得像燧石一样坚硬的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk, 'tiżnid' ifisser li l-materjal isir iebes bħaż-żnied? David: Iva, f'din is-sentenza qed jintuża b'dak is-sens.
colloquial.en: Maja: Here, does 'tiżnid' mean that the material becomes hard like flint? David: Yes, that's the sense being used in this sentence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 tiżnid 是指材料变得像燧石一样坚硬吗？戴维：对，这句话用的就是这个意思。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, 'tiżnid' ifisser li l-materjal isir iebes bħaż-żnied?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, 'tiżnid' ifisser li l-materjal isir iebes bħaż-żnied?
messages.zh: 这里的 tiżnid 是指材料变得像燧石一样坚硬吗？
messages.en: Here, does 'tiżnid' mean that the material becomes hard like flint?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'din is-sentenza qed jintuża b'dak is-sens.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'din is-sentenza qed jintuża b'dak is-sens.
messages.zh: 对，这句话用的就是这个意思。
messages.en: Yes, that's the sense being used in this sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张记忆卡：一张写“生成燧石”，另一张写“变得像燧石一样硬”，用来区分两个过程义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexual intercourse between people who are not married to each other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彼此没有婚姻关系的人之间发生的性交。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非婚性交；没有彼此婚姻关系的人之间的性行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, il-kelma 'tiżnija' tirreferi għal rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.
formal.en: In the analysis of the text, the word 'tiżnija' refers to sexual intercourse between people who are not married to each other.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本的分析中，tiżnija 一词指彼此没有婚姻关系的人之间发生的性交。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'tiżnija' f'dan il-paragrafu? Mark: Tfisser rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'tiżnija' mean in this paragraph? Mark: It means sexual intercourse between people who aren't married to each other.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这一段里的 tiżnija 是什么意思？马克：指彼此没有婚姻关系的人之间发生的性交。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'tiżnija' f'dan il-paragrafu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'tiżnija' f'dan il-paragrafu?
messages.zh: 这一段里的 tiżnija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tiżnija' mean in this paragraph?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser rapport sesswali bejn persuni li mhumiex miżżewġin lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 指彼此没有婚姻关系的人之间发生的性交。
messages.en: It means sexual intercourse between people who aren't married to each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“彼此无婚姻关系＋发生性交”这两个条件记忆词义，阅读例句时同时核对这两点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The forceful discharge of liquid in spurts or jets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体以一股股或射流的形式向外喷出、喷涌的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' likwidu bil-qawwa, f'daqqiet jew f'ġettijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷涌；液体一股股地向外喷出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħruġ ta' likwidu bil-qawwa f'daqqiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷出；液体呈射流状向外涌出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħruġ ta' likwidu f'ġett.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tiżnin tal-ilma minn pajp miksur ħdejn il-bini.
formal.en: The report describes water spurting from a broken pipe near the building.
formal.zh: 报告描述了大楼附近一根破裂管道向外喷水的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara t-tiżnin tal-ilma minn dak il-pajp? Pawlu: Iva, ejja nagħlqu l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see the water spurting from that pipe? Pawlu: Yes, let's turn off the water.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看见那根管子往外喷水了吗？保罗：看见了，我们把水关掉吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara t-tiżnin tal-ilma minn dak il-pajp?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara t-tiżnin tal-ilma minn dak il-pajp?
messages.zh: 你看见那根管子往外喷水了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the water spurting from that pipe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nagħlqu l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nagħlqu l-ilma.
messages.zh: 看见了，我们把水关掉吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's turn off the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象破水管向外喷出一股股水柱，把水向外冲出的动态画面与 tiżnin 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formation of tracks or paths that lead out to a road.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通向道路的小径或通行路径逐渐形成的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-formazzjoni ta' mogħdijiet li jagħtu għal triq.

sense_translations.en_definition: Formation of tracks leading out to a road
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通向道路的小径或通行路径的形成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-formazzjoni ta' mogħdijiet li jwasslu għal triq.

collocations.en: formation of tracks leading to the main road
formation of tracks leading from a field to a road
collocations.zh: 从田地通向道路的小径形成

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi t-tiżniq minn diversi għelieqi lejn it-triq prinċipali, jiġifieri l-formazzjoni ta' mogħdijiet li jagħtu għal dik it-triq.
formal.en: The study describes the formation of tracks from several fields to the main road, meaning the development of paths that lead out to that road.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了从几块田地通向主路的小径形成过程，即一些连接到该道路的通行路径逐渐形成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: 'Tiżniq' hawnhekk jirreferi għall-karozzi? Toni: Le, jirreferi għall-formazzjoni ta' mogħdijiet li jwasslu għat-triq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does 'tiżniq' refer to cars here? Toni: No, it refers to the formation of paths leading out to the road.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里的 tiżniq 是说汽车吗？托尼：不是，是说通向道路的小径形成。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Tiżniq' hawnhekk jirreferi għall-karozzi?
messages.mt_standard: 'Tiżniq' hawnhekk jirreferi għall-karozzi?
messages.zh: 这里的 tiżniq 是说汽车吗？
messages.en: Does 'tiżniq' refer to cars here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jirreferi għall-formazzjoni ta' mogħdijiet li jwasslu għat-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jirreferi għall-formazzjoni ta' mogħdijiet li jwasslu għat-triq.
messages.zh: 不是，是说通向道路的小径形成。
messages.en: No, it refers to the formation of paths leading out to the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一条大路，再画几条逐渐形成并接入大路的小径；把整个形成过程记作 tiżniq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of having a large, protruding belly; also swelling or becoming enlarged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腹部肥大、明显向前突出的状态；也可指身体部位肿胀或体积增大的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' min għandu żaqq kbira u mqabbża; ukoll nefħa jew żieda fid-daqs ta' parti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大腹便便的状态；肚腹肥大并向外突出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' min għandu żaqq kbira u mqabbża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肿胀；某个部位鼓起或体积增大。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nefħa jew żieda fid-daqs ta' parti tal-ġisem.

collocations.en: paunchiness or swelling of the belly

formal.mt: Fit-test, it-tiżqiq tal-wiċċ huwa deskritt bħala nefħa, mingħajr ma tingħata l-kawża.
formal.en: In the text, the swelling of the face is described without its cause being given.
formal.zh: 文本描述了面部肿胀的情况，但没有说明其原因。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'tiżqiq' f'din is-sentenza? David: Hawnhekk il-kelma tfisser nefħa; tista' tfisser ukoll il-kundizzjoni ta' min għandu żaqq kbira u mqabbża.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'tiżqiq' mean in this sentence? David: Here the word means swelling; it can also mean the condition of having a large, protruding belly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这句话里的 tiżqiq 是什么意思？戴维：这里指肿胀；这个词也可以指肚腹肥大、向外突出的状态。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'tiżqiq' f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'tiżqiq' f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这句话里的 tiżqiq 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tiżqiq' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk il-kelma tfisser nefħa; tista' tfisser ukoll il-kundizzjoni ta' min għandu żaqq kbira u mqabbża.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk il-kelma tfisser nefħa; tista' tfisser ukoll il-kundizzjoni ta' min għandu żaqq kbira u mqabbża.
messages.zh: 这里指肿胀；这个词也可以指肚腹肥大、向外突出的状态。
messages.en: Here the word means swelling; it can also mean the condition of having a large, protruding belly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图分开记忆：一张是突出的肚腹，另一张是肿起的部位；再根据上下文选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of fabric, stitching, or something fastened becoming frayed or coming undone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料边缘磨散、缝线脱开，或原本固定的东西逐渐松脱的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih drapp jitfarrak fit-truf, ħjata tinfetaħ, jew xi ħaġa marbuta tinħall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布料或线绳的纤维磨散、散边。
原本缝合、系紧或固定的部分松开、散脱。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni wriet tiżrid fit-truf tad-drapp u ħsara fil-ħjata.
formal.en: The inspection revealed fraying at the edges of the fabric and damage to the stitching.
formal.zh: 检查发现布料边缘磨散，缝线也有损坏。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ara t-tiżrid fit-tarf tal-kmiem. Pawlu: Iva, il-ħjut qed joħorġu. Nieħduh għand il-ħajjat?
colloquial.en: Marija: Look at the fraying at the end of the sleeve. Pawlu: Yes, the threads are coming out. Shall we take it to the tailor?
colloquial.zh: Marija：看看袖口这里，都散边了。Pawlu：是啊，线都露出来了。我们拿去给裁缝修一下吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara t-tiżrid fit-tarf tal-kmiem.
messages.mt_standard: Ara t-tiżrid fit-tarf tal-kmiem.
messages.zh: 看看袖口这里，都散边了。
messages.en: Look at the fraying at the end of the sleeve.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħjut qed joħorġu. Nieħduh għand il-ħajjat?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħjut qed joħorġu. Nieħduh għand il-ħajjat?
messages.zh: 是啊，线都露出来了。我们拿去给裁缝修一下吗？
messages.en: Yes, the threads are coming out. Shall we take it to the tailor?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象袖口一根根线散出来，把这个画面与 tiżrid 配对记忆；也可联想到缝好的地方逐渐松脱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of placing or scattering seeds in soil so that plants can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把种子放入或撒入土壤，使其发芽生长的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha ż-żrieragħ jitqiegħdu jew jinxterdu fil-ħamrija biex jikbru l-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 播种；把种子播入土壤。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tiżrigħ, l-istudenti ħejjew il-ħamrija u qasmu ż-żrieragħ fi gruppi.
formal.en: Before sowing, the students prepared the soil and divided the seeds into groups.
formal.zh: 播种前，学生们整理了土壤，并把种子分成几组。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta se nibdew it-tiżrigħ? Ġużi: Għada filgħodu. Illum inħejju l-ħamrija.
colloquial.en: Lara: When are we going to start sowing? Ġużi: Tomorrow morning. Today we'll prepare the soil.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们什么时候开始播种？Ġużi：明天早上。今天先整理土壤。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se nibdew it-tiżrigħ?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se nibdew it-tiżrigħ?
messages.zh: 我们什么时候开始播种？
messages.en: When are we going to start sowing?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu. Illum inħejju l-ħamrija.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu. Illum inħejju l-ħamrija.
messages.zh: 明天早上。今天先整理土壤。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning. Today we'll prepare the soil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“整理土壤、撒下种子、等待发芽”的连续画面记住 tiżrigħ，重点是播种这项活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of something becoming blue or beginning to show a blue colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物逐渐变成蓝色，或开始呈现蓝色色泽的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir blu jew tibda tidher b'lewn blu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变蓝；开始呈现蓝色。

collocations.en: gradual development of a blue colour
fabric taking on a blue colour

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment biż-żebgħa, l-istudenti osservaw it-tiżriq gradwali tad-drapp.
formal.en: During the dye experiment, the students observed the fabric gradually taking on a blue colour.
formal.zh: 在染色实验中，学生们观察到布料逐渐变蓝。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed tara t-tiżriq tad-drapp? Samwel: Iva, issa qed isir blu ċar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you see the fabric taking on a blue colour? Samwel: Yes, it's turning light blue now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看到布料开始变蓝了吗？Samwel：看到了，现在正变成浅蓝色。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara t-tiżriq tad-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara t-tiżriq tad-drapp?
messages.zh: 你看到布料开始变蓝了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the fabric taking on a blue colour?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qed isir blu ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qed isir blu ċar.
messages.zh: 看到了，现在正变成浅蓝色。
messages.en: Yes, it's turning light blue now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象白布慢慢染上蓝色，用颜色变化记住 tiżriq；它指变蓝的过程，而不是蓝色物品本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forced separation from one's country or home, or the act of sending someone away and excluding them from a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被迫离开祖国或家园的流亡状态，也指把某人驱离并禁止其留在某地的放逐行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min hu mġiegħel jgħix barra minn pajjiżu jew daru, jew l-att li xi ħadd jitkeċċa minn post u ma jitħalliex jibqa' fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流亡；被迫离开祖国或家园的处境。
放逐；把某人驱逐出某地。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru ewlieni jqatta' snin ta' tiżwil u jittama li xi darba jerġa' lura lejn pajjiżu.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character spends years in exile and hopes to return to his country one day.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公流亡多年，盼望有一天能返回祖国。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-karattru ma jistax imur lura d-dar? Mark: Minħabba t-tiżwil. Ma jħalluhx jirritorna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't the character go back home? Mark: Because of his banishment. They won't let him return.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个人物为什么不能回家？Mark：因为他被放逐了。他们不准他回来。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru ma jistax imur lura d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru ma jistax imur lura d-dar?
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么不能回家？
messages.en: Why can't the character go back home?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tiżwil. Ma jħalluhx jirritorna.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tiżwil. Ma jħalluhx jirritorna.
messages.zh: 因为他被放逐了。他们不准他回来。
messages.en: Because of his banishment. They won't let him return.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说人物离开家园、久久不能归来的画面来记 tiżwil，把被迫远离家园与流亡、放逐联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Decoration or added detail that makes something more elaborate, or variation in its colours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物更美观或更精致的装饰、增饰，也可指多种颜色交错呈现的效果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dekorazzjoni jew dettalji miżjuda biex xi ħaġa ssir isbaħ jew aktar elaborata, jew varjazzjoni fil-kuluri tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰；为增加美感而设置的装饰细节。
增饰；使外观或表达更加丰富精致的修饰。
杂色；不同颜色交错分布而形成的斑驳效果。

formal.mt: It-tiżwiq tal-qoxra tal-ktieb jinkludi fjuri żgħar u linji b'kuluri differenti.
formal.en: The ornamentation of the book cover includes small flowers and lines in different colours.
formal.zh: 书封面的装饰包括小花和不同颜色的线条。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Jogħġbok it-tiżwiq fuq din il-kaxxa? Rita: Iva, speċjalment il-fjuri u l-kuluri.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you like the decoration on this box? Rita: Yes, especially the flowers and the colours.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你喜欢这个盒子上的装饰吗？Rita：喜欢，尤其是那些花和配色。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġbok it-tiżwiq fuq din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġbok it-tiżwiq fuq din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个盒子上的装饰吗？
messages.en: Do you like the decoration on this box?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment il-fjuri u l-kuluri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment il-fjuri u l-kuluri.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其是那些花和配色。
messages.en: Yes, especially the flowers and the colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给普通盒子加上花纹和彩色线条，用 tiżwiq 记装饰与增饰，再用多色交错的画面记杂色义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman's striped petticoat worn beneath an outer skirt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 女性穿在外裙里面的一种条纹衬裙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Falda ta' taħt tan-nisa li jkollha disinn bi strixxi u tintlibes taħt falda oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女式条纹衬裙；带有条纹图案的女用内衬裙。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-kostum, it-tiżwiqa hija falda ta' taħt bi strixxi ħomor u bojod.
formal.en: In the costume description, the striped petticoat is an underskirt with red and white stripes.
formal.zh: 在服装说明中，这件条纹衬裙是一条红白相间的内衬裙。

colloquial.mt: Klara: Din it-tiżwiqa tintlibes taħt il-falda? Elena: Iva, u għandha strixxi ħomor u bojod.
colloquial.en: Klara: Is this striped petticoat worn under the skirt? Elena: Yes, and it has red and white stripes.
colloquial.zh: Klara：这件条纹衬裙是穿在裙子里面的吗？Elena：是的，上面有红白相间的条纹。

messages.speaker: Klara (服装设计学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tiżwiqa tintlibes taħt il-falda?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tiżwiqa tintlibes taħt il-falda?
messages.zh: 这件条纹衬裙是穿在裙子里面的吗？
messages.en: Is this striped petticoat worn under the skirt?

messages.speaker: Elena (服装老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandha strixxi ħomor u bojod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandha strixxi ħomor u bojod.
messages.zh: 是的，上面有红白相间的条纹。
messages.en: Yes, and it has red and white stripes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“女性、条纹、穿在外裙里面”三个提示记住 tiżwiqa，把整件具体衣物的画面牢牢记下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting two things together as a pair or joining two parts so that they are connected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把两个事物组成一对，或把两个部件接合起来的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li żewġ affarijiet jitqiegħdu flimkien bħala par jew li żewġ partijiet jingħaqdu ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配对；把两个事物组成一对。
联接；使两个部分相互接合。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jitlob it-tiżwiġ ta' kull karta bi stampa mal-karta li fiha l-kelma t-tajba.
formal.en: The exercise requires pairing each picture card with the card containing the correct word.
formal.zh: 这项练习要求把每张图片卡与写有正确单词的卡片配成一对。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif nagħmlu t-tiżwiġ tal-karti? David: Poġġi kull stampa ħdejn il-kelma t-tajba.
colloquial.en: Marta: How do we pair the cards? David: Put each picture next to the correct word.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这些卡片怎么配对？David：把每张图片放在正确的单词旁边。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nagħmlu t-tiżwiġ tal-karti?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nagħmlu t-tiżwiġ tal-karti?
messages.zh: 这些卡片怎么配对？
messages.en: How do we pair the cards?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġi kull stampa ħdejn il-kelma t-tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġi kull stampa ħdejn il-kelma t-tajba.
messages.zh: 把每张图片放在正确的单词旁边。
messages.en: Put each picture next to the correct word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一张图片卡和一张词卡放成一对来记 tiżwiġ；再联想两个部件接在一起，兼记配对和联接。

gloss_zh: 眼中闪光；迅速飞离；滑动

teaching_sense.en_definition: A glimmer in the eyes; in other contexts, the action of flitting away or of slipping or sliding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 眼中闪现光芒的现象；在其他语境中，也可指迅速飞离、溜走或滑动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Leħħa fl-għajnejn; f'kuntesti oħra, il-ħarba ħafifa jew iż-żliq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼中闪现微光；眼神闪亮。
轻快而迅速地飞离或溜走。
滑动；滑行；打滑。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, it-tiżġiġ tal-għajnejn tat-tifel juri l-ferħ tiegħu meta jara r-rigal.
formal.en: In the story, the glimmer in the boy's eyes shows his joy when he sees the gift.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩看到礼物时眼中闪现的光芒表现了他的喜悦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt it-tiżġiġ f'għajnejn Lina meta fetħet ir-rigal? Mark: Iva, kienet ferħana ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the glimmer in Lina's eyes when she opened the gift? Mark: Yes, she was so happy!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到莉娜打开礼物时眼里闪着光了吗？马克：看到了，她可高兴了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt it-tiżġiġ f'għajnejn Lina meta fetħet ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt it-tiżġiġ f'għajnejn Lina meta fetħet ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 你看到莉娜打开礼物时眼里闪着光了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the glimmer in Lina's eyes when she opened the gift?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet ferħana ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet ferħana ħafna!
messages.zh: 看到了，她可高兴了！
messages.en: Yes, she was so happy!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tiżġiġ 做三张情景卡：眼睛一闪、小鸟飞离、脚底滑动；分别记忆三个义项，并留意两个 ġ 都有点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become enslaved or to be subdued and brought under another's control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沦为奴隶；也指被制服、被置于他人的控制之下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ilsir jew jiġi mrażżan u mqiegħed taħt il-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沦为奴隶，进入受奴役的状态。
被制服或被压服。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel tjassar wara li nqabad u tilef il-libertà tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the man became enslaved after being captured and lost his freedom.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这名男子被俘后沦为奴隶，失去了自由。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawnhekk, tjassar ifisser li sar ilsir? David: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li ġie mrażżan bil-forza.
colloquial.en: Sara: Here, does tjassar mean that he became a slave? David: No, in this sentence it means that he was subdued by force.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 tjassar 是说他成了奴隶吗？戴维：不是，在这句话里是说他被武力制服了。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, tjassar ifisser li sar ilsir?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, tjassar ifisser li sar ilsir?
messages.zh: 这里的 tjassar 是说他成了奴隶吗？
messages.en: Here, does tjassar mean that he became a slave?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li ġie mrażżan bil-forza.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li ġie mrażżan bil-forza.
messages.zh: 不是，在这句话里是说他被武力制服了。
messages.en: No, in this sentence it means that he was subdued by force.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住失去自主这个共同场景，再分清语境：成为奴隶是身份变化，被制服是受到压制。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making people slaves and depriving them of freedom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人沦为奴隶、剥夺其自由的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih persuni jsiru lsiera u jitilfu l-libertà tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奴役，即使人沦为奴隶、失去自由的行为或过程。

formal.mt: L-esej jiddeskrivi t-tjassir tal-priġunieri u t-telf tal-libertà tagħhom.
formal.en: The essay describes the enslavement of prisoners and their loss of freedom.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了俘虏遭受奴役、失去自由的过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar xiex se tikteb fl-esej? Ben: Dwar it-tjassir tal-priġunieri fir-rakkont li qrajna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you going to write about in the essay? Ben: About the enslavement of the prisoners in the story we read.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的文章准备写什么？本：写我们读过的那个故事里，俘虏遭受奴役的事情。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar xiex se tikteb fl-esej?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar xiex se tikteb fl-esej?
messages.zh: 你的文章准备写什么？
messages.en: What are you going to write about in the essay?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar it-tjassir tal-priġunieri fir-rakkont li qrajna.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar it-tjassir tal-priġunieri fir-rakkont li qrajna.
messages.zh: 写我们读过的那个故事里，俘虏遭受奴役的事情。
messages.en: About the enslavement of the prisoners in the story we read.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成文章标题里的奴役这一过程；看到这个名词，就联想到人被剥夺自由的情景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being good, kind, and morally upright.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为人善良、仁厚、品行端正的品质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min hu tajjeb, qalbu tajba u jġib ruħu sewwa ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 善良、仁善或良好的道德品质。

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni juri t-tjieba tiegħu billi jgħin lil min jinsab fil-bżonn.
formal.en: The main character shows his goodness by helping people in need.
formal.zh: 主人公通过帮助有需要的人，展现了他的善良。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rita ġabitli l-ikel meta kont marida. Marija: Kemm għandha tjieba! Dejjem taħseb f'ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Anna: Rita brought me food when I was ill. Marija: She's so kind! She always thinks of others.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我生病的时候，丽塔给我送了饭。玛丽娅：她心地真好！总是想着别人。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rita ġabitli l-ikel meta kont marida.
messages.mt_standard: Rita ġabitli l-ikel meta kont marida.
messages.zh: 我生病的时候，丽塔给我送了饭。
messages.en: Rita brought me food when I was ill.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandha tjieba! Dejjem taħseb f'ħaddieħor.
