messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandha tjieba! Dejjem taħseb f'ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 她心地真好！总是想着别人。
messages.en: She's so kind! She always thinks of others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用生病时有人送来热饭的画面记住它：善良通过体贴他人的具体行动表现出来。

gloss_zh: 变得虚荣；变得骄傲自大；被放大

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become vain or proud; also, to be made larger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得虚荣或骄傲自大；也指尺寸被增大、被放大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir vanituż jew imkabbar bih innifsu; ukoll jiżdied fid-daqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得虚荣，开始过分在意自己的形象或他人的赞美。
变得骄傲、自大或自视甚高。
被放大；尺寸被增大。

collocations.zh: 因受到赞美而变得虚荣

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt tkabbar biex id-dettalji jidhru aktar ċari fir-rapport.
formal.en: The photograph was enlarged so that the details would appear more clearly in the report.
formal.zh: 照片经过放大，以便在报告中更清楚地呈现细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn meta rebaħ il-premju, Leo tkabbar ħafna. Luqa: Iva, issa jaħseb li jaf kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Since winning the prize, Leo has become very conceited. Luqa: Yes, now he thinks he knows everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：自从获奖以后，利奥变得很自大。卢卡：是啊，他现在觉得自己什么都懂。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn meta rebaħ il-premju, Leo tkabbar ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Minn meta rebaħ il-premju, Leo tkabbar ħafna.
messages.zh: 自从获奖以后，利奥变得很自大。
messages.en: Since winning the prize, Leo has become very conceited.

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jaħseb li jaf kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jaħseb li jaf kollox.
messages.zh: 是啊，他现在觉得自己什么都懂。
messages.en: Yes, now he thinks he knows everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图作学习联想：照片尺寸变大，一个人的自我评价膨胀；前者是被放大，后者帮助记住虚荣和自大义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wrap or cover oneself with a garment, especially a cloak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用衣物把自己裹住或遮住，尤指披上斗篷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi jew jgħatti lilu nnifsu b'ilbies, speċjalment b'mantar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用衣物等把自己裹住。
给自己披上斗篷或类似的外衣。

collocations.en: wrapped himself up to keep out the cold

formal.mt: Qabel ħareġ fil-kesħa, il-vjaġġatur tkabbaz b'mantar oħxon.
formal.en: Before going out into the cold, the traveller wrapped himself in a thick cloak.
formal.zh: 出门走进寒冷的室外之前，旅人用一件厚斗篷裹住了自己。

colloquial.mt: Lena: Għaliex Mark tkabbaz bil-mantar? Sara: Għax barra hemm ħafna riħ u qed iħoss il-bard.
colloquial.en: Lena: Why did Mark wrap himself in the cloak? Sara: Because it is very windy outside and he is feeling cold.
colloquial.zh: 莱娜：马克为什么用斗篷裹住自己？萨拉：因为外面风很大，他觉得冷。

messages.speaker: Lena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark tkabbaz bil-mantar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark tkabbaz bil-mantar?
messages.zh: 马克为什么用斗篷裹住自己？
messages.en: Why did Mark wrap himself in the cloak?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax barra hemm ħafna riħ u qed iħoss il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Għax barra hemm ħafna riħ u qed iħoss il-bard.
messages.zh: 因为外面风很大，他觉得冷。
messages.en: Because it is very windy outside and he is feeling cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前把斗篷两边拉紧、整个人裹住的动作，用这个画面记住 tkabbaz。

gloss_zh: 扩大；生长；虚荣；自我吹捧；炫耀

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in size or agricultural growth; also vanity, self-aggrandisement, or ostentatious display.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸或规模的扩大，也指农作物的生长；还可表示虚荣、自我吹捧或炫耀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fid-daqs jew tkabbir ta' prodotti agrikoli; ukoll vanità, tifħir żejjed ta' oneself jew wirja biex wieħed jimpressjona lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尺寸、面积或规模的扩大；放大。
过分看重自身形象、优点或他人赞赏的虚荣心。
夸大自身的重要性、地位或成就；自我吹捧。
为了引人注意或赢得羡慕而刻意炫耀。
农作物或其他农业产物的生长。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effett tal-ilma u tad-dawl fuq it-tkabbir tal-ħxejjex.
formal.en: The report describes the effect of water and light on the growth of vegetables.
formal.zh: 报告说明了水分和光照对蔬菜生长的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tkabbir ta' dan ir-ritratt kemm jiswa? Mark: Ħames ewro, u jkun lest għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much does enlarging this photograph cost? Mark: Five euros, and it will be ready tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：放大这张照片要多少钱？马克：五欧元，明天就能做好。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tkabbir ta' dan ir-ritratt kemm jiswa?
messages.mt_standard: It-tkabbir ta' dan ir-ritratt kemm jiswa?
messages.zh: 放大这张照片要多少钱？
messages.en: How much does enlarging this photograph cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħames ewro, u jkun lest għada.
messages.mt_standard: Ħames ewro, u jkun lest għada.
messages.zh: 五欧元，明天就能做好。
messages.en: Five euros, and it will be ready tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面分别记忆：照片放大、蔬菜长大、把自己夸大；后一个画面帮助联想虚荣和炫耀，具体词义仍看语境。

gloss_zh: 戴上兜帽；用兜帽或斗篷遮盖

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting on a hood or covering someone with a hood or cloak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴上兜帽的动作，或用兜帽、斗篷把人遮盖起来的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li titqiegħed kappa fuq ir-ras jew li persuna titgħatta b'kappa jew b'mantar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给人戴上兜帽或用兜帽罩住头部的动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: covering with a hood or cloak
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用兜帽或斗篷遮盖的行为。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tkabbiz b'mantar oħxon jgħin lill-vjaġġatur jibqa' sħun.
formal.en: In the story, covering himself with a thick cloak helps the traveller stay warm.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅人用厚斗篷裹住身体，以保持温暖。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tkabbiz b'dan il-mantar jgħin kontra r-riħ? Pawlu: Iva, speċjalment jekk tgħatti rasek ukoll.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does covering yourself with this cloak help against the wind? Pawlu: Yes, especially if you cover your head too.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：用这件斗篷裹住自己能挡风吗？保罗：能，尤其是把头也遮住的时候。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tkabbiz b'dan il-mantar jgħin kontra r-riħ?
messages.mt_standard: It-tkabbiz b'dan il-mantar jgħin kontra r-riħ?
messages.zh: 用这件斗篷裹住自己能挡风吗？
messages.en: Does covering yourself with this cloak help against the wind?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment jekk tgħatti rasek ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment jekk tgħatti rasek ukoll.
messages.zh: 能，尤其是把头也遮住的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially if you cover your head too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把记忆镜头停在兜帽罩上头部的那一刻：tkabbiz 是名词，给这个遮盖动作起名字。

gloss_zh: 翻滚；在尘土中或沿斜坡滚动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To roll or tumble, especially in dust or down a slope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或物体翻滚，尤指在尘土中打滚或沿斜坡向下滚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idur fuq innifsu jew jinqaleb, speċjalment fit-trab jew għal isfel fuq art imżerżqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to roll (especially in the dust or down an incline)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻滚，尤其指在尘土中打滚或沿斜坡滚下。

formal.mt: Il-kelb tkabras fit-trab u mbagħad qam u farfar ġismu.
formal.en: The dog rolled in the dust and then got up and shook its body.
formal.zh: 狗在尘土中打了滚，随后站起来抖了抖身子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-kelb mimli trab? Toni: Għax tkabras ħdejn il-bieb waqt li kont qed insaqqi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the dog covered in dust? Toni: Because it rolled around by the door while I was watering.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：狗身上怎么全是灰？托尼：因为我浇水的时候，它在门边打滚了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kelb mimli trab?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kelb mimli trab?
messages.zh: 狗身上怎么全是灰？
messages.en: Why is the dog covered in dust?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tkabras ħdejn il-bieb waqt li kont qed insaqqi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tkabras ħdejn il-bieb waqt li kont qed insaqqi.
messages.zh: 因为我浇水的时候，它在门边打滚了。
messages.en: Because it rolled around by the door while I was watering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗在尘土里翻身打滚，再想象东西沿坡滚下；两个运动画面都能帮助记住 tkabras。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of rolling or tumbling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或物体翻滚、打滚这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li persuna, annimal jew oġġett idur fuq innifsu jew jinqaleb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻滚或打滚的动作。

formal.mt: It-tkabris tal-kelb fit-trab ħalla marki ċari fuq l-art.
formal.en: The dog's rolling in the dust left clear marks on the ground.
formal.zh: 狗在尘土中打滚，在地面上留下了清晰的痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan it-tkabris kollu fit-trab ħammeġ lill-kelb! Ġanni: Iva, issa rridu naħsluh qabel jidħol.
colloquial.en: Nina: All this rolling in the dust has made the dog dirty! Ġanni: Yes, now we need to wash him before he comes inside.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：在灰里这么一通打滚，狗都弄脏了！詹尼：是啊，现在得给它洗干净才能让它进屋。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tkabris kollu fit-trab ħammeġ lill-kelb!
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tkabris kollu fit-trab ħammeġ lill-kelb!
messages.zh: 在灰里这么一通打滚，狗都弄脏了！
messages.en: All this rolling in the dust has made the dog dirty!

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa rridu naħsluh qabel jidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa rridu naħsluh qabel jidħol.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在得给它洗干净才能让它进屋。
messages.en: Yes, now we need to wash him before he comes inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把打滚拍成一段视频，再给视频标上“翻滚这一动作”；tkabris 是动作名称，按名词记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become ruffled or disordered, as hair or fur can.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得不平整、蓬松凌乱，例如头发或毛发被弄乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imħarbat jew mhux lixx, bħax-xagħar jew il-pil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得蓬乱或不平整；如毛发被弄乱。

collocations.en: the hair became ruffled by the wind

formal.mt: Waqt il-mixja mal-baħar, ix-xagħar tiegħu tkafkaf bir-riħ qawwi.
formal.en: During the walk by the sea, his hair became ruffled by the strong wind.
formal.zh: 在海边散步时，他的头发被强风吹乱了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara xagħri, tkafkaf kollu bir-riħ! Lara: Għandi moxt fil-basket, jekk trid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at my hair, it has become completely ruffled by the wind! Lara: I have a comb in my bag, if you want it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看看我的头发，全被风吹乱了！拉拉：我包里有把梳子，你需要的话可以用。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara xagħri, tkafkaf kollu bir-riħ!
messages.mt_standard: Ara xagħri, tkafkaf kollu bir-riħ!
messages.zh: 看看我的头发，全被风吹乱了！
messages.en: Look at my hair, it has become completely ruffled by the wind!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi moxt fil-basket, jekk trid.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi moxt fil-basket, jekk trid.
messages.zh: 我包里有把梳子，你需要的话可以用。
messages.en: I have a comb in my bag, if you want it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前梳好的头发被海风吹得翘起、散乱，用“整齐变蓬乱”的前后对比记住 tkafkaf。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take on the shape of a ring-shaped cake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形成环形糕饼那样的形状，即中间有孔、外围成环。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu l-forma ta' qagħqa, b'ċirku madwar toqba fin-nofs.

sense_translations.en_definition: to take the shape of a ring-cake
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变成环形糕饼的形状。

collocations.en: the bread took on a ring-cake shape
collocations.zh: 面包形成了环形糕饼的形状

collocations.en: took on a ring-cake shape during shaping
collocations.zh: 在整形时变成环形糕饼状

formal.mt: Il-ħobż tkagħak meta l-furnar għaqqad iż-żewġt itruf tal-għaġina u ħalla toqba fin-nofs.
formal.en: The bread took on a ring-cake shape when the baker joined the two ends of the dough and left a hole in the middle.
formal.zh: 面包师把面团的两端接起来，并在中间留孔，面包便形成了环形糕饼的形状。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara, il-ħobż tkagħak! Pawlu: Iva, għaqqadt it-truf u ħallejt toqba fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look, the bread has taken on a ring-cake shape! Pawlu: Yes, I joined the ends and left a hole in the middle.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，面包变成环形糕饼的样子了！保罗：对，我把两端接起来，在中间留了个孔。

messages.speaker: Nina (烘焙学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, il-ħobż tkagħak!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, il-ħobż tkagħak!
messages.zh: 看，面包变成环形糕饼的样子了！
messages.en: Look, the bread has taken on a ring-cake shape!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (面包师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għaqqadt it-truf u ħallejt toqba fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għaqqadt it-truf u ħallejt toqba fin-nofs.
messages.zh: 对，我把两端接起来，在中间留了个孔。
messages.en: Yes, I joined the ends and left a hole in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条面团首尾相接，中间留孔，变成环形糕饼；tkagħak 重点记“形成这种形状”。

gloss_zh: 受到虐待；被滥用；用坏；累得精疲力竭

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer mistreatment or misuse, to wear out through overuse, or to become exhausted by physical effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到虐待或不当使用；因过度使用而破损，或因体力劳动而精疲力竭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi ttrattat ħażin jew użat ħażin; jitmermer bl-użu żejjed, jew jegħja ħafna minħabba sforz fiżiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到恶劣对待、虐待或粗暴处置。
被不当使用或遭到滥用。

sense_translations.en_definition: to wear out due to overuse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因过度使用而磨损、破旧或损坏。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be exhausted due to physical effort
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因体力付出而疲惫不堪、精疲力竭。

collocations.en: the book became worn out through use

collocations.zh: 因体力劳动而累得精疲力竭

formal.mt: Il-ktieb tkagħbar minħabba l-użu żejjed, u diversi paġni bdew jinqalgħu.
formal.en: The book became worn out through excessive use, and several pages began to come loose.
formal.zh: 这本书因过度使用而变得破旧，好几页开始脱落。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu mar jistrieħ daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Tkagħbar bil-ġarr tal-kaxxi l-ġurnata kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu go to rest so early? Mark: He became exhausted from carrying boxes all day.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗怎么这么早就去休息了？马克：他搬了一整天箱子，累得精疲力竭。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu mar jistrieħ daqshekk kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu mar jistrieħ daqshekk kmieni?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么这么早就去休息了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go to rest so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkagħbar bil-ġarr tal-kaxxi l-ġurnata kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Tkagħbar bil-ġarr tal-kaxxi l-ġurnata kollha.
messages.zh: 他搬了一整天箱子，累得精疲力竭。
messages.en: He became exhausted from carrying boxes all day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记四幅图：人受苛待、工具被滥用、书被翻旧、搬箱子的人累倒；用受损或耗尽的画面区分各义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Harsh or abusive treatment of someone, or improper use of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指对人粗暴、虐待性的对待，或对物品的不当使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament aħrax jew ħażin ta' xi ħadd, jew użu ħażin ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虐待；对某人粗暴或恶劣的对待。
误用；对物品或其他事物的不当使用。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każijiet ta' tkagħbir tal-annimali u jitlob li jittieħdu miżuri biex jiġu protetti.
formal.en: The report describes cases of mistreatment of animals and calls for measures to protect them.
formal.zh: 报告描述了虐待动物的案例，并呼吁采取保护措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx issellfu l-għodda? Pawlu: Għax dan hu tkagħbir tal-għodda; juża t-tornavit bħala martell!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to lend him the tools? Pawlu: Because this is misuse of tools; he uses the screwdriver as a hammer!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不愿意把工具借给他？保罗：因为他这样是在糟蹋工具，竟然把螺丝刀当锤子用！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx issellfu l-għodda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx issellfu l-għodda?
messages.zh: 你为什么不愿意把工具借给他？
messages.en: Why don't you want to lend him the tools?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工具主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan hu tkagħbir tal-għodda; juża t-tornavit bħala martell!
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan hu tkagħbir tal-għodda; juża t-tornavit bħala martell!
messages.zh: 因为他这样是在糟蹋工具，竟然把螺丝刀当锤子用！
messages.en: Because this is misuse of tools; he uses the screwdriver as a hammer!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“粗暴对人”和“糟蹋物品”放在同一张记忆卡上：共同点都是对待方式不当，再按对象区分虐待与误用。

gloss_zh: 扭动身体；因疼痛或大笑而扭曲身体

teaching_sense.en_definition: To twist or contort one's body because of pain, laughter, or a similar strong reaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因疼痛、大笑或类似的强烈反应而扭动、蜷曲身体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħawweġ jew idawwar ġismu minħabba uġigħ, daħk jew reazzjoni qawwija oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to writhe (due to pain, laughter etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭动或扭曲身体，通常由疼痛、大笑等引起。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, il-pazjent tkagħweġ bl-uġigħ u t-tabib waqaf għal mument.
formal.en: During the examination, the patient writhed in pain and the doctor paused for a moment.
formal.zh: 检查过程中，病人痛得扭动身体，医生便暂停了片刻。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark tkagħweġ hekk? Ben: Bid-daħk! Il-film kien tassew tad-daħk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark double up like that? Ben: With laughter! The film was really funny.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么那样弯腰扭身？本：笑的呀！那部电影实在太搞笑了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark tkagħweġ hekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark tkagħweġ hekk?
messages.zh: 马克为什么那样弯腰扭身？
messages.en: Why did Mark double up like that?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bid-daħk! Il-film kien tassew tad-daħk.
messages.mt_standard: Bid-daħk! Il-film kien tassew tad-daħk.
messages.zh: 笑的呀！那部电影实在太搞笑了。
messages.en: With laughter! The film was really funny.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人先痛得蜷身，再笑得弯腰：两个画面都突出身体扭动，用动作记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The twisting or contorting movement of the body, for example in response to pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体扭动或蜷曲的动作或过程，例如因疼痛而发生的扭动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment tal-ġisem meta jitgħawweġ jew idur, pereżempju minħabba l-uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体的扭动、扭曲或蜷曲，尤指强烈感受引起的动作。

formal.mt: L-osservazzjoni tiddeskrivi t-tkagħwiġ tal-ġisem tal-pazjent waqt episodju ta' uġigħ qawwi.
formal.en: The observation describes the patient's bodily writhing during an episode of severe pain.
formal.zh: 观察记录描述了病人在一阵剧痛期间身体扭动的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak it-tkagħwiġ fuq is-sufan? Toni: Kelli bugħawwieġ f'sieqi, imma issa għadda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was all that writhing on the sofa? Toni: I had a cramp in my leg, but it's gone now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你刚才在沙发上扭来扭去是怎么了？托尼：我腿抽筋了，不过现在好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak it-tkagħwiġ fuq is-sufan?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak it-tkagħwiġ fuq is-sufan?
messages.zh: 你刚才在沙发上扭来扭去是怎么了？
messages.en: What was all that writhing on the sofa?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli bugħawwieġ f'sieqi, imma issa għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli bugħawwieġ f'sieqi, imma issa għadda.
messages.zh: 我腿抽筋了，不过现在好了。
messages.en: I had a cramp in my leg, but it's gone now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“这种扭动”来提示名词用法：关注可以被描述和观察的动作过程，而不是一句“他扭动了”。

gloss_zh: 动词，具体词义未由所给注记说明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb whose lexical meaning is not specified in the supplied packet; its definition field contains the annotation 'itih Mifsud fl-appendix'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将其列为动词，但释义栏仅有注记“itih Mifsud fl-appendix”，不足以确认具体词义；学习时应暂存词形并标明释义待核。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li t-tifsira tiegħu mhix speċifikata fil-materjal mogħti; fil-qasam tat-tifsira hemm biss in-nota 'itih Mifsud fl-appendix'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原文注记提及 Mifsud 和附录，但未明确说明此动词的词汇意义；具体释义无法仅据此确定。

formal.mt: Il-verb 'tkakka' huwa elenkat fil-materjal, iżda n-nota mogħtija ma tipprovdix definizzjoni ċara tat-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The verb 'tkakka' is listed in the material, but the supplied annotation does not provide a clear definition of its meaning.
formal.zh: 材料列出了动词“tkakka”，但所给注记并未清楚界定它的词义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'tkakka'? Pawlu: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din in-nota biss; ejja nimmarkaw it-tifsira bħala mhux ikkonfermata.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tkakka' mean? Pawlu: We can't be sure from this note alone; let's mark the meaning as unconfirmed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“tkakka”是什么意思？保罗：只凭这条注记还不能确定，我们先把词义标为待确认吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'tkakka'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'tkakka'?
messages.zh: “tkakka”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tkakka' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din in-nota biss; ejja nimmarkaw it-tifsira bħala mhux ikkonfermata.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti minn din in-nota biss; ejja nimmarkaw it-tifsira bħala mhux ikkonfermata.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张“词形已知、词义待核”的卡片，记住 tkakka 的拼写和动词标签，暂不把注记当作实际释义背诵。

gloss_zh: 被撒出；被投放（通常指渔网）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cast or thrown out, typically referring to fishing nets being put into the water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被撒出或投放出去，通常用于渔网被撒入水中的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintefa' jew jinfirex fl-ilma, ġeneralment b'referenza għax-xibak tas-sajd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be cast (typically used of fishing nets)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被撒出或投下，通常指渔网被撒入水中。

formal.mt: Ix-xibak tkala fil-baħar kmieni filgħodu, qabel ma żdied ir-riħ.
formal.en: The fishing nets were cast into the sea early in the morning, before the wind picked up.
formal.zh: 清晨，风力增强之前，渔网被撒入了海中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ix-xibak diġà tkala? Toni: Iva, tkala ħdejn il-blat; issa rridu nistennew.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have the fishing nets been cast already? Toni: Yes, they were cast near the rocks; now we have to wait.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：渔网已经撒下去了吗？托尼：是的，撒在礁石附近了，现在得等一等。

messages.speaker: Rita (捕鱼伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xibak diġà tkala?
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xibak diġà tkala?
messages.zh: 渔网已经撒下去了吗？
messages.en: Have the fishing nets been cast already?

messages.speaker: Toni (渔民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkala ħdejn il-blat; issa rridu nistennew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkala ħdejn il-blat; issa rridu nistennew.
messages.zh: 是的，撒在礁石附近了，现在得等一等。
messages.en: Yes, they were cast near the rocks; now we have to wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜头始终对着渔网：网从船边展开、落入海里。用“网被撒出”的画面记住它的被动意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sung or performed with the singing voice, as a song or anthem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指歌曲、颂歌等被人用歌声唱出或演唱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi esegwit bil-kant, bħal innu jew għanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被唱出；被演唱，主语通常是歌曲等演唱内容。

formal.mt: L-innu tkanta mill-kor fil-bidu taċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The anthem was sung by the choir at the beginning of the ceremony.
formal.zh: 仪式开始时，合唱团演唱了颂歌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-innu tkanta wkoll ilbieraħ? Ben: Iva, tkanta fl-aħħar, u kulħadd kanta magħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was the anthem sung yesterday too? Ben: Yes, it was sung at the end, and everyone sang along with us.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天也唱了那首颂歌吗？本：是的，最后唱的，大家都跟着我们一起唱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-innu tkanta wkoll ilbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: L-innu tkanta wkoll ilbieraħ?
messages.zh: 昨天也唱了那首颂歌吗？
messages.en: Was the anthem sung yesterday too?

messages.speaker: Ben (合唱团成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkanta fl-aħħar, u kulħadd kanta magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkanta fl-aħħar, u kulħadd kanta magħna.
messages.zh: 是的，最后唱的，大家都跟着我们一起唱。
messages.en: Yes, it was sung at the end, and everyone sang along with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把歌曲名称放在句子主角的位置，想成“这首歌被唱出来了”；再补上合唱团，记住内容与演唱者的区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop bad habits or begin behaving in morally wrong ways.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐染上恶习，开始形成不良的行为方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jieħu drawwiet ħżiena u jġib ruħu ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 染上恶习；逐渐形成邪恶或败坏的行为方式。

collocations.en: developed bad ways through bad company
collocations.zh: 因结交损友而染上恶习

collocations.en: developed bad ways and began deceiving people

formal.mt: Il-karattru fir-rakkont tkarfas meta beda jigdeb u jisraq biex jikseb dak li ried.
formal.en: The character in the story developed evil ways when he began lying and stealing to obtain what he wanted.
formal.zh: 故事中的人物开始靠说谎和偷窃获取自己想要的东西，逐渐走上了邪路。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma tafdahx aktar? Pawlu: Tkarfas; issa jigdeb u jqarraq bin-nies.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why don't you trust him anymore? Pawlu: He's developed bad ways; now he lies and deceives people.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么不再信任他了？保罗：他变坏了，现在既说谎又骗人。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdahx aktar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdahx aktar?
messages.zh: 你为什么不再信任他了？
messages.en: Why don't you trust him anymore?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkarfas; issa jigdeb u jqarraq bin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Tkarfas; issa jigdeb u jqarraq bin-nies.
messages.zh: 他变坏了，现在既说谎又骗人。
messages.en: He's developed bad ways; now he lies and deceives people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“从说谎到骗人，逐渐染上恶习”的故事里记，重点是行为逐渐变坏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be dragged along a surface, or to continue longer than necessary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被拖着沿某个表面移动；也指事情持续过久、被拖延。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mkaxkar fuq wiċċ, jew idum għaddej aktar milli jkun meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拖动；被拖着走。
被拖长；持续过久。

collocations.en: the debate dragged on for hours

formal.mt: Is-siġġu tkarkar mal-art meta l-ħaddiema ċaqilqu l-mejda.
formal.en: The chair was dragged along the floor when the workers moved the table.
formal.zh: 工人搬动桌子时，椅子被拖着在地板上移动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Id-dibattitu spiċċa fil-ħin? Mark: Le, tkarkar għal sagħtejn oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the debate finish on time? Mark: No, it dragged on for another two hours.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：辩论按时结束了吗？马克：没有，又拖了两个小时。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dibattitu spiċċa fil-ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Id-dibattitu spiċċa fil-ħin?
messages.zh: 辩论按时结束了吗？
messages.en: Did the debate finish on time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tkarkar għal sagħtejn oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tkarkar għal sagħtejn oħra.
messages.zh: 没有，又拖了两个小时。
messages.en: No, it dragged on for another two hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象椅子在地上被拖长长一段路，再联想到讨论在时间上被拖长，串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of dragging something, or of making something last longer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拖着某物移动的动作；也指把某件事的持续时间拉长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tkaxkar xi ħaġa, jew li ġġiegħel xi ħaġa ddum aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖动；拖着物体移动的动作。
把某事拖长；延长某事的过程或持续时间。

formal.mt: It-tkarkir tal-għamara jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-art tal-injam.
formal.en: Dragging furniture can damage a wooden floor.
formal.zh: 拖动家具可能损坏木地板。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għadna hawn? David: Minħabba t-tkarkir tad-diskussjoni; għadhom jirrepetu l-istess punti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we still here? David: Because the discussion is being drawn out; they're still repeating the same points.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们怎么还在这里？戴维：因为讨论一直被拖长，他们还在重复同样的观点。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadna hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadna hawn?
messages.zh: 我们怎么还在这里？
messages.en: Why are we still here?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tkarkir tad-diskussjoni; għadhom jirrepetu l-istess punti.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tkarkir tad-diskussjoni; għadhom jirrepetu l-istess punti.
messages.zh: 因为讨论一直被拖长，他们还在重复同样的观点。
messages.en: Because the discussion is being drawn out; they're still repeating the same points.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成名词“拖的动作”：空间上拖家具，时间上拖讨论；搭配具体对象就容易区分。

gloss_zh: 萎缩；干瘪，尤指某些水果

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wither or shrink, especially when certain kinds of fruit lose their freshness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 枯萎、收缩或变得干瘪，尤其用于某些水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinxef jew jiċkien, speċjalment meta ċerti tipi ta' frott jitilfu l-freskezza tagħhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: to wither or shrink (used especially of certain types of fruit)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 枯萎或萎缩，尤指某些水果变得干瘪。

formal.mt: Il-ħawħ li tħalla għal diversi jiem fis-sħana tkarmas u tilef il-freskezza tiegħu.
formal.en: The peaches left in the heat for several days shrivelled and lost their freshness.
formal.zh: 桃子在高温下放了几天后变得干瘪，失去了新鲜度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara mill-ħawħ li ħallejna fuq il-mejda? Toni: Tkarmas; dam wisq fis-sħana.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened to the peaches we left on the table? Toni: They shrivelled; they were in the heat too long.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们放在桌上的桃子怎么了？托尼：干瘪了，在热的地方放得太久了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara mill-ħawħ li ħallejna fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara mill-ħawħ li ħallejna fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 我们放在桌上的桃子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the peaches we left on the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkarmas; dam wisq fis-sħana.
messages.mt_standard: Tkarmas; dam wisq fis-sħana.
messages.zh: 干瘪了，在热的地方放得太久了。
messages.en: They shrivelled; they were in the heat too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饱满的桃子放久后表皮起皱、体积缩小，用这个画面记住“变干瘪”的过程。

gloss_zh: 水果未熟的状态；未熟水果的酸涩味

teaching_sense.en_definition: The unripe state of fruit, or the tart taste associated with unripe fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水果尚未成熟的状态；也指未熟水果所带的酸涩味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat tal-frott meta jkun għadu mhux misjur, jew it-togħma qarsa tiegħu f'dak l-istat.

sense_translations.en_definition: the state of fruit when it is unripe
sense_translations.zh_definition: 水果尚未成熟时的状态。
未熟水果所具有的酸涩味。

collocations.en: a tart taste characteristic of unripe fruit
collocations.zh: 未熟水果特有的酸涩口感

formal.mt: Fit-togħma tal-frott kien jinħass it-tkarmis, għax il-frott kien għadu mhux misjur.
formal.en: The fruit tasted tart because it was still unripe.
formal.zh: 水果还没成熟，因此尝起来带有酸涩味。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex dan il-frott għandu togħma daqshekk qarsa? Ġanni: Dak it-tkarmis; il-frott għadu mhux misjur.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why does this fruit taste so tart? Ġanni: That's the tartness of unripe fruit; it isn't ripe yet.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这水果怎么这么酸涩？詹尼：那是未熟水果的酸涩味，它还没熟呢。

messages.speaker: Elena (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-frott għandu togħma daqshekk qarsa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-frott għandu togħma daqshekk qarsa?
messages.zh: 这水果怎么这么酸涩？
messages.en: Why does this fruit taste so tart?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tkarmis; il-frott għadu mhux misjur.
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tkarmis; il-frott għadu mhux misjur.
messages.zh: 那是未熟水果的酸涩味，它还没熟呢。
messages.en: That's the tartness of unripe fruit; it isn't ripe yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“果子还青”和“入口酸涩”连成一幅画面，分别记住未熟状态和未熟酸味两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To groan, complain, or plead with someone for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因痛苦而呻吟、表达不满，或向某人恳切哀求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilmenta b'leħen ta' wġigħ jew nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon, jew jitlob bil-ħniena lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟；因疼痛或难受而发出低沉的声音。
抱怨；表达不满。
向某人哀求；恳求某人答应请求。

formal.mt: Il-midrub tkarrab bl-uġigħ sakemm waslet l-għajnuna.
formal.en: The injured man groaned in pain until help arrived.
formal.zh: 伤者痛得呻吟，直到救援人员赶到。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Missierek aċċetta li jagħtik ċans ieħor? Luqa: Iva, wara li tkarrabt miegħu biex jagħtini ċans ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did your father agree to give you another chance? Luqa: Yes, after I pleaded with him to give me another chance.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你爸爸答应再给你一次机会了吗？卢卡：答应了，我哀求他再给我一次机会。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missierek aċċetta li jagħtik ċans ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Missierek aċċetta li jagħtik ċans ieħor?
messages.zh: 你爸爸答应再给你一次机会了吗？
messages.en: Did your father agree to give you another chance?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wara li tkarrabt miegħu biex jagħtini ċans ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wara li tkarrabt miegħu biex jagħtini ċans ieħor.
messages.zh: 答应了，我哀求他再给我一次机会。
messages.en: Yes, after I pleaded with him to give me another chance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三种带情绪的声音记忆：疼痛时呻吟、不满时抱怨、求助时哀求，再靠语境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become fertile and productive, especially of land that begins to yield well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得肥沃并富有生产力，尤其指土地开始能有良好的产出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir fertili u produttiv, speċjalment meta l-art tibda tagħti ħsad tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得肥沃且丰产；逐渐具有良好的生产能力。

collocations.en: the soil began to become fertile and productive
collocations.zh: 土壤开始变得肥沃且能丰产

collocations.en: became fertile and productive after years of care
collocations.zh: 经过多年养护后变得肥沃丰产

formal.mt: Wara snin ta' kura, il-ħamrija bdiet titkarrem u l-ħsad tjieb.
formal.en: After years of care, the soil began to become fertile and productive, and the harvest improved.
formal.zh: 经过多年的养护，土壤开始变得肥沃丰产，收成也有所改善。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-ħamrija fil-ġnien għadha fqira? Anton: Le, bdiet titkarrem, u din is-sena kellna ħsad aħjar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the soil in the garden still poor? Anton: No, it's becoming fertile and productive, and we had a better harvest this year.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：园子里的土壤还很贫瘠吗？安东：不，已经开始变得肥沃丰产，今年的收成更好了。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħamrija fil-ġnien għadha fqira?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħamrija fil-ġnien għadha fqira?
messages.zh: 园子里的土壤还很贫瘠吗？
messages.en: Is the soil in the garden still poor?

messages.speaker: Anton (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bdiet titkarrem, u din is-sena kellna ħsad aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bdiet titkarrem, u din is-sena kellna ħsad aħjar.
messages.zh: 不，已经开始变得肥沃丰产，今年的收成更好了。
messages.en: No, it's becoming fertile and productive, and we had a better harvest this year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块贫瘠土地经过养护后庄稼茂盛、收成增加，同时记住“变肥沃”和“能丰产”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Groaning caused by pain or distress, or pleading earnestly for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因疼痛或难受而发出的呻吟；也指恳切的哀求或乞求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħsejjes ta' min ikun qed ibati, jew it-talb bil-ħniena biex wieħed jikseb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟；因痛苦或难受而发出的低沉声音。
哀求；恳切地乞求帮助、准许或其他所需之物。

formal.mt: L-infermier sema' t-tkarrib tal-pazjent u mar ħdejh minnufih.
formal.en: The nurse heard the patient's groaning and went to him immediately.
formal.zh: 护士听到病人的呻吟，立即走到他身边。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Aċċetta li jgħinek? Pietru: Iva, iżda biss wara ħafna tkarrib.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did he agree to help you? Pietru: Yes, but only after a lot of pleading.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：他答应帮你了吗？彼得：答应了，不过我哀求了好久。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aċċetta li jgħinek?
messages.mt_standard: Aċċetta li jgħinek?
messages.zh: 他答应帮你了吗？
messages.en: Did he agree to help you?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda biss wara ħafna tkarrib.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda biss wara ħafna tkarrib.
messages.zh: 答应了，不过我哀求了好久。
messages.en: Yes, but only after a lot of pleading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当作名词来记：病床边听到的是“呻吟”，请求帮助时反复说出的是“哀求”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making land fertile and able to produce more.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使土地变得肥沃、能够产出更多作物的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-art issir aktar fertili u kapaċi tagħti aktar prodott.

sense_translations.en_definition: causing to become productive and fertile
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使土地等变得肥沃并具有生产力。

collocations.en: making the soil fertile and productive
methods of improving fertility and productivity
collocations.zh: 提高肥力和产出的方法

formal.mt: Il-proġett jiffoka fuq it-tkarrim tal-ħamrija biex l-għelieqi jagħtu aktar prodott.
formal.en: The project focuses on making the soil fertile and productive so that the fields yield more.
formal.zh: 该项目着重改善土壤肥力和生产力，以提高田地产量。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed iżżid il-kompost mal-ħamrija? Pawlu: Biex ngħin fit-tkarrim tagħha u l-ħaxix jikber aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you adding compost to the soil? Pawlu: To help make it fertile and productive so the vegetables grow better.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么往土里加堆肥？保罗：为了改善土壤肥力和生产力，让蔬菜长得更好。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iżżid il-kompost mal-ħamrija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iżżid il-kompost mal-ħamrija?
messages.zh: 你为什么往土里加堆肥？
messages.en: Why are you adding compost to the soil?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ngħin fit-tkarrim tagħha u l-ħaxix jikber aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ngħin fit-tkarrim tagħha u l-ħaxix jikber aħjar.
messages.zh: 为了改善土壤肥力和生产力，让蔬菜长得更好。
messages.en: To help make it fertile and productive so the vegetables grow better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkarrim 配上贫瘠土地变成丰收菜园的画面，记住它强调使土地肥沃、提高产出这一过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of walking while wearing slippers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿着拖鞋行走这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mixi bil-papoċċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 走路时穿着拖鞋；穿拖鞋行走。

collocations.en: walking around the house in slippers
the sound of walking in slippers

formal.mt: L-awtur isemmi l-ħoss tat-tkartib fil-kuritur biex juri li xi ħadd kien għadu mqajjem.
formal.en: The author mentions the sound of walking in slippers in the corridor to show that someone was still awake.
formal.zh: 作者提到走廊里穿拖鞋走路的声音，以表明还有人醒着。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-kuritur? Ben: Il-ħoss tat-tkartib ta' missieri; qed jimxi bil-papoċċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that sound in the corridor? Ben: It's the sound of my dad walking in slippers; he's got his slippers on.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：走廊里是什么声音？本：是我爸爸穿拖鞋走路的声音，他正穿着拖鞋走动。

messages.speaker: Lara (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-kuritur?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-kuritur?
messages.zh: 走廊里是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound in the corridor?

messages.speaker: Ben (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħoss tat-tkartib ta' missieri; qed jimxi bil-papoċċi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħoss tat-tkartib ta' missieri; qed jimxi bil-papoċċi.
messages.zh: 是我爸爸穿拖鞋走路的声音，他正穿着拖鞋走动。
messages.en: It's the sound of my dad walking in slippers; he's got his slippers on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人穿着拖鞋沿走廊走动，把整个动作标成 tkartib；重点是穿拖鞋行走，而非拖鞋这个物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a deep rumbling sound, or to be ground into smaller particles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出低沉的隆隆声；也可指被研磨成较小的颗粒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss baxx u qawwi li jdum; jew jiġi mitħun f'partiċelli iżgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出低沉、持续的隆隆声。
被研磨；被磨碎。

collocations.en: the wheat was ground in the mill
collocations.zh: 小麦在磨坊里被磨碎了

formal.mt: Is-sema tkarwat għal diversi minuti qabel bdiet ix-xita.
formal.en: The sky rumbled for several minutes before the rain began.
formal.zh: 下雨之前，天空隆隆作响了好几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-qamħ diġà tkarwat? Ġużeppi: Iva, fil-mitħna dalgħodu; issa għandna d-dqiq.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has this wheat already been ground? Ġużeppi: Yes, at the mill this morning; now we have the flour.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这些小麦已经磨好了吗？朱塞佩：是的，今天早上在磨坊磨的，现在我们有面粉了。

messages.speaker: Anna (面包师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-qamħ diġà tkarwat?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-qamħ diġà tkarwat?
messages.zh: 这些小麦已经磨好了吗？
messages.en: Has this wheat already been ground?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (磨坊工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fil-mitħna dalgħodu; issa għandna d-dqiq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fil-mitħna dalgħodu; issa għandna d-dqiq.
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上在磨坊磨的，现在我们有面粉了。
messages.en: Yes, at the mill this morning; now we have the flour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tkarwat 做两张场景卡：天空对应隆隆作响，小麦与磨坊对应被磨碎；靠上下文分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deep rumbling sound, especially the rumbling of thunder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低沉的隆隆声，主要用于描述雷声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss baxx u qawwi, l-aktar dak tar-ragħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隆隆声，主要指雷的隆隆声。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, it-tkarwit tar-ragħad instema' fir-raħal kollu.
formal.en: During the night, the rumbling of thunder was heard throughout the village.
formal.zh: 夜间，整个村庄都听到了隆隆雷声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' dak it-tkarwit fil-bogħod? Mark: Iva, ġejja maltempata; ejja nidħlu ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that rumbling in the distance? Mark: Yes, a storm is coming; let's go inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见远处的隆隆声了吗？马克：听见了，暴风雨要来了，我们进去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dak it-tkarwit fil-bogħod?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dak it-tkarwit fil-bogħod?
messages.zh: 你听见远处的隆隆声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that rumbling in the distance?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġejja maltempata; ejja nidħlu ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġejja maltempata; ejja nidħlu ġewwa.
messages.zh: 听见了，暴风雨要来了，我们进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, a storm is coming; let's go inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象暴雨前远处传来持续的隆隆雷声，把这段声音命名为 tkarwit，记住它是表示声音的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer oppressive treatment or the unjust use of power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遭受压迫，受到权力的不公压制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġarrab oppressjoni jew ikun suġġett għal użu inġust tal-poter.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到压迫；遭到不公的压制。

collocations.zh: 在该政权统治下受到了压迫

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-poplu tkasbar taħt ir-reġim u tilef ħafna mid-drittijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes how the people were oppressed under the regime and lost many of their rights.
formal.zh: 报告描述了人民如何在该政权统治下遭受压迫，并失去许多权利。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex in-nannu ma kienx jitkellem fil-pubbliku dwar il-politika? David: Għax tkasbar taħt ir-reġim u kien jibża' jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't Grandpa use to talk about politics in public? David: Because he was oppressed under the regime and was afraid to speak.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：爷爷以前为什么不在公开场合谈政治？戴维：因为他在那个政权下受过压迫，害怕开口。

messages.speaker: Sara (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex in-nannu ma kienx jitkellem fil-pubbliku dwar il-politika?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex in-nannu ma kienx jitkellem fil-pubbliku dwar il-politika?
messages.zh: 爷爷以前为什么不在公开场合谈政治？
messages.en: Why didn't Grandpa use to talk about politics in public?

messages.speaker: David (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tkasbar taħt ir-reġim u kien jibża' jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tkasbar taħt ir-reġim u kien jibża' jitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为他在那个政权下受过压迫，害怕开口。
messages.en: Because he was oppressed under the regime and was afraid to speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkasbar 放进受压迫者的叙述中：一个人因权力压制而不敢发声，提醒自己主语是遭受压迫的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cruel or harmful treatment, or the unjust exercise of power over people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人的残酷或有害对待；也指利用权力对人施加的不公压迫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament ħażin jew krudili, jew użu inġust tal-poter fuq in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虐待；对人的恶劣或有害对待。
压迫；凭借权力对人施加的不公控制和压制。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza t-tkasbir tal-poplu u l-effetti tiegħu fuq il-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The study analyzes the oppression of the people and its effects on everyday life.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了人民遭受的压迫及其对日常生活的影响。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex telqet minn dak ix-xogħol? Toni: Minħabba t-tkasbir li ġarrbet hemm; kienu jgħajtu magħha u jumiljawha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did she leave that job? Toni: Because of the maltreatment she suffered there; they used to shout at her and humiliate her.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：她为什么辞掉那份工作？托尼：因为她在那里受到了虐待，他们经常冲她大喊，还羞辱她。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex telqet minn dak ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex telqet minn dak ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 她为什么辞掉那份工作？
messages.en: Why did she leave that job?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tkasbir li ġarrbet hemm; kienu jgħajtu magħha u jumiljawha.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tkasbir li ġarrbet hemm; kienu jgħajtu magħha u jumiljawha.
messages.zh: 因为她在那里受到了虐待，他们经常冲她大喊，还羞辱她。
messages.en: Because of the maltreatment she suffered there; they used to shout at her and humiliate her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tkasbir 配两幅图：个人遭到恶劣对待表示虐待，人民受到权力压制表示压迫；两幅图都在记同一个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in number, amount, or size, or the act of making something greater.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量、总量或规模的增加，也指使某事物增多、增大的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fin-numru, fil-kwantità jew fid-daqs, jew l-att li tagħmel xi ħaġa akbar jew aktar numeruża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；数量、总量或规模的增长。
增大；扩增；使原有数量、规模或程度进一步增加。

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipprevedi t-tkattir tar-riżorsi disponibbli għall-iskejjel.
formal.en: The plan provides for an increase in the resources available to schools.
formal.zh: 该计划拟增加可供学校使用的资源。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex qed niġbru aktar kotba? Samwel: Biex ngħinu fit-tkattir tar-riżorsi tal-librerija; it-tfal ikollhom aktar għażla.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why are we collecting more books? Samwel: To help expand the library's resources; the children will have more choice.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我们为什么要收集更多书？萨姆韦尔：为了帮助扩充图书馆的资源，让孩子们有更多选择。

messages.speaker: Elena (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed niġbru aktar kotba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed niġbru aktar kotba?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要收集更多书？
messages.en: Why are we collecting more books?

messages.speaker: Samwel (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ngħinu fit-tkattir tar-riżorsi tal-librerija; it-tfal ikollhom aktar għażla.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ngħinu fit-tkattir tar-riżorsi tal-librerija; it-tfal ikollhom aktar għażla.
messages.zh: 为了帮助扩充图书馆的资源，让孩子们有更多选择。
messages.en: To help expand the library's resources; the children will have more choice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书架上的书从一排增加到三排，用 tkattir 标注这个增加过程；资源和知识变多时也可用这一概念记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become disordered, confused, or messed up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得混乱、失去条理或陷入一团糟的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imħawwad jew bla ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得一团糟；变得混乱或乱了套。

collocations.en: the whole schedule got messed up

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-konferenza tkawlat wara li żewġ kelliema ma setgħux jattendu.
formal.en: The conference schedule became disorganized after two speakers were unable to attend.
formal.zh: 两位演讲者无法出席后，会议日程安排乱了套。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadna sejrin il-baħar għada? Karl: Il-pjan tkawlat għax il-karozza għand il-mekkanik; irridu nsibu mezz ieħor.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are we still going to the seaside tomorrow? Karl: The plan got messed up because the car is at the mechanic's; we need to find another way to get there.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们明天还去海边吗？卡尔：车送去修了，计划乱了套，我们得另想办法过去。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna sejrin il-baħar għada?
messages.mt_standard: Għadna sejrin il-baħar għada?
messages.zh: 我们明天还去海边吗？
messages.en: Are we still going to the seaside tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pjan tkawlat għax il-karozza għand il-mekkanik; irridu nsibu mezz ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pjan tkawlat għax il-karozza għand il-mekkanik; irridu nsibu mezz ieħor.
messages.zh: 车送去修了，计划乱了套，我们得另想办法过去。
messages.en: The plan got messed up because the car is at the mechanic's; we need to find another way to get there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本整齐的日程被临时变动弄得一团糟，把变化后的状态连到 tkawlat，记住它强调变乱、乱了套。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Confusion or disorder, especially when things are mixed up or handled badly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 混乱或杂乱的状态，尤指东西被弄混或事情处理不当造成的混乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħwid jew nuqqas ta' ordni, speċjalment meta l-affarijiet jitħalltu jew ma jsirux sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混乱；分不清情况或缺乏条理的状态。
把事情弄乱、搞错或搞砸。

formal.mt: It-tkawlit fid-dokumenti wassal għal dewmien fit-tħejjija tar-rapport.
formal.en: Confusion in the documents led to a delay in preparing the report.
formal.zh: 文件中的混乱导致报告编写延误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan it-tkawlit fuq il-mejda? Mark: Ħallatt il-karti l-qodma ma' dawk il-ġodda. Issa nirranġahom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's all this confusion on the table? Mark: I mixed the old papers with the new ones. I'll sort them out now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上怎么乱成这样？马克：我把旧文件和新文件混在一起了。我现在就整理。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tkawlit fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tkawlit fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌上怎么乱成这样？
messages.en: What's all this confusion on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallatt il-karti l-qodma ma' dawk il-ġodda. Issa nirranġahom.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallatt il-karti l-qodma ma' dawk il-ġodda. Issa nirranġahom.
messages.zh: 我把旧文件和新文件混在一起了。我现在就整理。
messages.en: I mixed the old papers with the new ones. I'll sort them out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新旧文件混成一堆：tkawlit既可指眼前的混乱，也可指把事情搞乱这件事。

gloss_zh: 拖着身子前行；被拖动；惨败

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move by dragging oneself along, to be dragged, or figuratively to suffer a heavy defeat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拖着身体勉强前行，或被外力拖动；比喻遭到惨败。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi billi jkaxkar ġismu, jinġibed minn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew, b'mod figurattiv, jitlef b'differenza kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖着身子前行；费力地挪动身体。
被拖着移动；受到拖拽。
被彻底击败；遭到惨败。

formal.mt: Wara l-waqgħa, ir-raġel tkaxkar sal-bieb biex jitlob l-għajnuna.
formal.en: After the fall, the man dragged himself to the door to ask for help.
formal.zh: 摔倒后，那名男子拖着身子挪到门口求助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar it-tim tagħna lbieraħ? Pawlu: Tkaxkar. Tilef ħamsa b'xejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did our team do yesterday? Pawlu: They got trounced. They lost five-nil.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们队昨天踢得怎么样？保罗：惨败，输了个零比五。

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar it-tim tagħna lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar it-tim tagħna lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 我们队昨天踢得怎么样？
messages.en: How did our team do yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkaxkar. Tilef ħamsa b'xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Tkaxkar. Tilef ħamsa b'xejn.
messages.zh: 惨败，输了个零比五。
messages.en: They got trounced. They lost five-nil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记身体被拖着走的画面，再联想球队被对手压着打；用情境区分勉强前行、被拖动和惨败。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of dragging, or figuratively a very heavy defeat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拖动或拖拽的行为；也可比喻比赛、民调等场合中的惨败。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tkaxkar lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa; ukoll, b'mod figurattiv, telfa b'differenza kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖动；拖拽这一行为或过程。

sense_translations.en_definition: a trouncing or dramatic defeat (e.g. in a poll or at sport)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惨败；例如在民调或体育比赛中以悬殊差距落败。

formal.mt: It-tkaxkir tal-għamara jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-art tal-injam.
formal.en: Dragging furniture can damage the wooden floor.
formal.zh: 拖动家具可能损坏木地板。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Smajt kemm tilef it-tim? Rita: Iva, sitta b'xejn. Dak kien tkaxkir!
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you hear how much the team lost by? Rita: Yes, six-nil. That was a trouncing!
colloquial.zh: 马克：你听说球队输了多少了吗？丽塔：听说了，零比六。那可真是惨败！

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt kemm tilef it-tim?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt kemm tilef it-tim?
messages.zh: 你听说球队输了多少了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how much the team lost by?

messages.speaker: Rita (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sitta b'xejn. Dak kien tkaxkir!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sitta b'xejn. Dak kien tkaxkir!
messages.zh: 听说了，零比六。那可真是惨败！
messages.en: Yes, six-nil. That was a trouncing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把tkaxkir放进两个名词画面：地板上的拖拽声，以及记分牌上的悬殊惨败。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of walking with difficulty and pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行走时感到疼痛、步履艰难的行为或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mixi b'diffikultà u bl-uġigħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: walking with difficulty and in pain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伴随疼痛、十分吃力地行走；痛苦而艰难的步行。

collocations.en: painful, difficult walking from one room to another
collocations.zh: 忍痛艰难地从一个房间走到另一个房间

formal.mt: It-tkaxxix tiegħu tul il-kuritur kien bil-mod u bl-uġigħ.
formal.en: His laboured walk along the corridor was slow and painful.
formal.zh: 他沿着走廊艰难行走，步子缓慢而痛苦。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif kien il-mixi llum? Ġanni: Tkaxxix minn kamra għal oħra. Kull pass weġġagħni.
colloquial.en: Anna: How was walking today? Ġanni: A painful struggle from one room to another. Every step hurt.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天走路怎么样？詹尼：从一个房间走到另一个房间都很吃力，每走一步都疼。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien il-mixi llum?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien il-mixi llum?
messages.zh: 今天走路怎么样？
messages.en: How was walking today?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkaxxix minn kamra għal oħra. Kull pass weġġagħni.
messages.mt_standard: Tkaxxix minn kamra għal oħra. Kull pass weġġagħni.
messages.zh: 从一个房间走到另一个房间都很吃力，每走一步都疼。
messages.en: A painful struggle from one room to another. Every step hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住每走一步都疼、只能缓缓挪步的画面；tkaxxix同时强调行走困难和疼痛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become angry or annoyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事而生气、恼怒或动怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirrabja jew iħoss rabja minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生气；变得恼怒。

collocations.en: got angry because of the delay

formal.mt: Il-klijent tkazzaz minħabba d-dewmien u talab spjegazzjoni mingħand il-maniġer.
formal.en: The customer got angry because of the delay and asked the manager for an explanation.
formal.zh: 顾客因延误而生气，并要求经理作出解释。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex tkazzaz Pawlu? Mark: Għax il-karozza ma riditx tistartja u kien diġà tard.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Pawlu get angry? Mark: Because the car wouldn't start and he was already late.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗为什么生气了？马克：因为车发动不了，而且他已经迟到了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tkazzaz Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tkazzaz Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu get angry?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-karozza ma riditx tistartja u kien diġà tard.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-karozza ma riditx tistartja u kien diġà tard.
messages.zh: 因为车发动不了，而且他已经迟到了。
messages.en: Because the car wouldn't start and he was already late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把tkazzaz和赶时间却发动不了汽车的画面连起来：事情不顺，情绪一下变成生气。

gloss_zh: 被抹灰；撞上表面；陷入某种处境

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be coated with plaster, to crash against a surface, or to become trapped in a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指墙面等被抹上灰泥，也可指猛烈撞上某个表面，或发现自己陷入难以脱身的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa bil-ġibs jew bit-tikħil, jaħbat ma' wiċċ b'saħħa, jew isib ruħu maqbud f'sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抹灰；表面被涂上灰泥。

sense_translations.en_definition: to crash or smash against a surface (e.g. in a car crash)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 猛烈撞上或撞向某个表面，例如车辆事故中撞上墙面。

sense_translations.en_definition: to find oneself trapped or caught up in a situation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发现自己陷入某种处境，或卷入难以脱身的局面。

collocations.en: became trapped in a difficult situation

formal.mt: Il-ħajt ta' barra tkaħħal wara li tlestew it-tiswijiet strutturali.
formal.en: The exterior wall was plastered after the structural repairs were completed.
formal.zh: 结构维修完成后，外墙进行了抹灰。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif tkaħħal f'din is-sitwazzjoni? Mark: Aċċetta wisq xogħol u issa ma jafx minn fejn jibda.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did he get caught up in this situation? Mark: He accepted too much work and now doesn't know where to start.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他怎么陷入这种处境了？马克：他接了太多工作，现在都不知道从哪里开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tkaħħal f'din is-sitwazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tkaħħal f'din is-sitwazzjoni?
messages.zh: 他怎么陷入这种处境了？
messages.en: How did he get caught up in this situation?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aċċetta wisq xogħol u issa ma jafx minn fejn jibda.
messages.mt_standard: Aċċetta wisq xogħol u issa ma jafx minn fejn jibda.
messages.zh: 他接了太多工作，现在都不知道从哪里开始。
messages.en: He accepted too much work and now doesn't know where to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三幅情境卡：墙面抹灰、车辆撞墙、人物陷入困境。靠句中对象与介词辨认义项，三幅图仅作学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work or process of applying plaster to a wall or another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把灰泥涂抹到墙壁或其他表面上的作业或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol jew il-proċess li bih jitqiegħed il-ġibs jew it-tikħil fuq ħajt jew wiċċ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抹灰这一动作或作业，即在表面涂抹灰泥。

formal.mt: It-tkaħħil tal-ħitan għandu jitlesta qabel ma jibda x-xogħol taż-żebgħa.
formal.en: The plastering of the walls should be completed before the painting work begins.
formal.zh: 墙壁抹灰应在油漆作业开始前完成。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nistgħu niżbgħu l-kamra għada? Ġużeppi: Għad le; it-tkaħħil għadu ma spiċċax.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can we paint the room tomorrow? Ġużeppi: Not yet; the plastering isn't finished.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们明天可以给房间刷漆吗？朱塞佩：还不行，抹灰还没做完。

messages.speaker: Anna (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu niżbgħu l-kamra għada?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu niżbgħu l-kamra għada?
messages.zh: 我们明天可以给房间刷漆吗？
messages.en: Can we paint the room tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (装修工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad le; it-tkaħħil għadu ma spiċċax.
messages.mt_standard: Għad le; it-tkaħħil għadu ma spiċċax.
messages.zh: 还不行，抹灰还没做完。
messages.en: Not yet; the plastering isn't finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把装修步骤排成“先抹灰、再刷漆”，在抹灰这道工序旁写 tkaħħil，记住它指作业过程。

gloss_zh: 对他人的不当行为表示震惊或愤慨

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show shock or scandalised disapproval at another person's wrongdoing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 看到或听到他人的不当行为时，表现出震惊、反感或道德上的愤慨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri skantament jew diżapprovazzjoni għall-għemil ħażin ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to evince shock at other people's misdeeds
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对他人的恶行或不当行为表现出震惊与愤慨。

collocations.zh: 对他们的行为感到震惊和愤慨

collocations.en: showed shock at what he heard
collocations.zh: 对听到的事情表示震惊

collocations.en: was scandalised by the offensive language
collocations.zh: 对侮辱性的言辞表示愤慨

formal.mt: Id-direttur tkaża bl-imġiba ta' dawk li umiljaw lill-impjegat quddiem il-kollegi tiegħu.
formal.en: The director was scandalised by the behaviour of those who humiliated the employee in front of his colleagues.
formal.zh: 那些人当着同事的面羞辱该员工，主管对此表示震惊和愤慨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tkaża Mark? Lara: Għax sema' lil xi ħadd jidħak b'raġel anzjan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Mark so shocked and disapproving? Lara: Because he heard someone making fun of an elderly man.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么那么震惊和愤慨？拉拉：因为他听见有人嘲笑一位老人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tkaża Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tkaża Mark?
messages.zh: 马克为什么那么震惊和愤慨？
messages.en: Why was Mark so shocked and disapproving?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax sema' lil xi ħadd jidħak b'raġel anzjan.
messages.mt_standard: Għax sema' lil xi ħadd jidħak b'raġel anzjan.
messages.zh: 因为他听见有人嘲笑一位老人。
messages.en: Because he heard someone making fun of an elderly man.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到别人欺负老人时皱眉惊叹；tkaża的重点是对他人不当行为表示震惊。

gloss_zh: 被缠绕；被卷收；被包裹；蜷缩身体

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wound, reeled in or wrapped, or to curl one's body into a foetal position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 线、毛线等被缠绕或卷收，物体被包裹，或人把身体蜷成胎儿般的姿势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgeżwer jew jinġabar f'romblu, jiġi mgħotti b'xi ħaġa madwaru, jew jiġbor ġismu b'irkopptejh qrib sidru.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be wound (used of thread, wool etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被缠绕成团或绕在某物上，用于线、毛线等。
被卷收；借助卷绕动作收回。
被包裹；被某种材料围住或裹住。
蜷起身体，膝盖靠近胸部，呈胎儿般的姿势。

collocations.en: the wool was wound into a ball
the fishing line was reeled onto the reel
the book was wrapped in paper
curled up with his knees against his chest
collocations.zh: 蜷缩身体，双膝贴近胸口

formal.mt: Il-ktieb tkebbeb fil-karta qabel tqiegħed fil-kaxxa għall-ġarr.
formal.en: The book was wrapped in paper before being placed in the box for transport.
formal.zh: 这本书先用纸包好，然后放进箱子运输。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif raqad it-tifel? Pawlu: Tkebbeb b'irkopptejh ma' sidru u raqad mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did the boy sleep? Pawlu: He curled up with his knees against his chest and fell asleep straight away.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：孩子是怎么睡的？保罗：他把膝盖蜷到胸前，一下就睡着了。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif raqad it-tifel?
messages.mt_standard: Kif raqad it-tifel?
messages.zh: 孩子是怎么睡的？
messages.en: How did the boy sleep?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkebbeb b'irkopptejh ma' sidru u raqad mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Tkebbeb b'irkopptejh ma' sidru u raqad mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 他把膝盖蜷到胸前，一下就睡着了。
messages.en: He curled up with his knees against his chest and fell asleep straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅画记忆：毛线绕成团、鱼线卷回来、礼物被包住、孩子蜷成团；逐幅对应四个义项。

gloss_zh: 燃起；激动起来；产生热情

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be kindled into flame, or figuratively to become emotionally worked up or enthusiastic about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被点燃而燃起火焰；比喻情绪被激起，或对某事产生热情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbad in-nar jew, b'mod figurattiv, jitqanqal ħafna jew jimtela bil-ħeġġa għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被点燃；开始燃起火焰。

sense_translations.en_definition: to get worked up about sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某事而情绪激动起来；变得亢奋或激愤。
产生热情；变得热切或兴致勃勃。

collocations.en: got worked up during the discussion

collocations.zh: 对这个想法产生了热情

formal.mt: In-nar tkebbes malajr minħabba l-injam niexef.
formal.en: The fire was quickly kindled because the wood was dry.
formal.zh: 由于木柴干燥，火很快就燃起来了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għoġbitu l-idea tal-ġnien? Maja: Iva, tkebbes bl-idea u diġà beda jippjana x'jiżra'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark like the idea of the garden? Maja: Yes, he became enthusiastic about it and has already started planning what to plant.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克喜欢建花园这个想法吗？玛雅：喜欢，他一下就来了热情，已经开始计划种什么了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għoġbitu l-idea tal-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Mark għoġbitu l-idea tal-ġnien?
messages.zh: 马克喜欢建花园这个想法吗？
messages.en: Did Mark like the idea of the garden?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkebbes bl-idea u diġà beda jippjana x'jiżra'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkebbes bl-idea u diġà beda jippjana x'jiżra'.
messages.zh: 喜欢，他一下就来了热情，已经开始计划种什么了。
messages.en: Yes, he became enthusiastic about it and has already started planning what to plant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想火苗被点燃，再想情绪或热情被点燃；这幅学习联想可串起燃起、激动和热心三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of winding something around an object or covering something by wrapping it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把线等物绕在某物上，或用材料把物品包起来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddawwar xi ħaġa madwar oġġett jew li tgħatti oġġett billi tgeżwru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠绕；把线、绳等绕起来的动作。
包裹；用纸、布等把物品包起来的动作。

formal.mt: It-tkebbib tar-rigali għandu jsir b'attenzjoni biex il-karta ma titqattax.
formal.en: Gift wrapping should be done carefully so that the paper does not tear.
formal.zh: 包装礼物时应当小心，以免把包装纸弄破。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħinni fit-tkebbib tar-rigali? Lara: Żgur. Int aqta' l-karta u jien ingeżwer il-kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you help me with wrapping the gifts? Lara: Sure. You cut the paper and I'll wrap the boxes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能帮我包装礼物吗？Lara：当然。你剪纸，我来包盒子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinni fit-tkebbib tar-rigali?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinni fit-tkebbib tar-rigali?
messages.zh: 你能帮我包装礼物吗？
messages.en: Can you help me with wrapping the gifts?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Int aqta' l-karta u jien ingeżwer il-kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Int aqta' l-karta u jien ingeżwer il-kaxxi.
messages.zh: 当然。你剪纸，我来包盒子。
messages.en: Sure. You cut the paper and I'll wrap the boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把线绕在线轴上、把纸包在礼盒外，想象这两个动作，就能一起记住“缠绕”和“包裹”两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of starting a fire by making fuel begin to burn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使木柴等燃料开始燃烧、把火生起来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqabbad in-nar billi tagħmel il-fjuwil jibda jaqbad.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of lighting a fire
sense_translations.zh_definition: 点火；使燃料燃烧而生起火来的动作。

collocations.en: the lighting of a fire in the fireplace

formal.mt: Qabel it-tkebbis tan-nar fil-fuklar, iċċekkja li ċ-ċumnija tkun nadifa.
formal.en: Before lighting a fire in the fireplace, check that the chimney is clean.
formal.zh: 在壁炉里生火之前，先检查烟囱是否干净。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'għandna bżonn għat-tkebbis tan-nar? Pawlu: Ftit karti u biċċiet żgħar tal-injam.
colloquial.en: Mark: What do we need to get the fire started? Pawlu: Some paper and small pieces of wood.
colloquial.zh: Mark：生火需要什么？Pawlu：一些纸和小木块。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandna bżonn għat-tkebbis tan-nar?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandna bżonn għat-tkebbis tan-nar?
messages.zh: 生火需要什么？
messages.en: What do we need to get the fire started?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit karti u biċċiet żgħar tal-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit karti u biċċiet żgħar tal-injam.
messages.zh: 一些纸和小木块。
messages.en: Some paper and small pieces of wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把纸和小木块点着、火苗刚刚升起的瞬间；这个词记的是“生火的动作”。

gloss_zh: 使丈夫遭妻子性背叛；给丈夫戴绿帽

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexual infidelity involving a married woman that makes her husband a cuckold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已婚女性与他人发生性关系，使其丈夫遭受婚姻中的性背叛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-infedeltà sesswali ta' mara miżżewġa li biha żewġha jiġi tradut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使丈夫因妻子与他人发生性关系而遭受背叛；俗称给丈夫戴绿帽。

collocations.zh: 有关给丈夫戴绿帽的指控
关于妻子出轨、丈夫遭背叛的故事

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-akkuża ta' tkebbix twassal għal kunflitt bejn il-personaġġi.
formal.en: In the novel, the accusation of cuckolding leads to conflict between the characters.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，有关妻子给丈夫戴绿帽的指控引发了人物之间的冲突。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser tkebbix f'din l-istorja? Mark: Ifisser li mara miżżewġa jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' persuna oħra u tittradixxi lil żewġha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does tkebbix mean in this story? Mark: It means a married woman having a sexual relationship with someone else and betraying her husband.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个故事里的 tkebbix 是什么意思？Mark：指已婚女性与他人发生性关系，背叛自己的丈夫。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tkebbix f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tkebbix f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 tkebbix 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tkebbix mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li mara miżżewġa jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' persuna oħra u tittradixxi lil żewġha.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li mara miżżewġa jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' persuna oħra u tittradixxi lil żewġha.
messages.zh: 指已婚女性与他人发生性关系，背叛自己的丈夫。
messages.en: It means a married woman having a sexual relationship with someone else and betraying her husband.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小说人物关系来记：妻子与他人发生性关系，丈夫因此遭背叛；将词义与这一具体关系对应。

gloss_zh: 因过度使用而磨损；用旧

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become worn out or shabby as a result of excessive use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品因过度或频繁使用而变得磨损、破旧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li oġġett jintlibes jew jiqdiem minħabba użu żejjed.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be worn out after excessive use
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因过度使用而磨损、用旧或变得破旧。

formal.mt: It-tapit tkedded minħabba l-użu kontinwu fil-kuritur.
formal.en: The carpet became worn out because of constant use in the corridor.
formal.zh: 走廊里的地毯因持续使用而磨损了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kowt tkedded sew. Lara: Iva, ilbistu kuljum għal snin sħaħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: This coat has become really worn out. Lara: Yes, I've worn it every day for years.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这件外套已经穿得很旧了。Lara：是啊，我连续好多年每天都穿它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kowt tkedded sew.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kowt tkedded sew.
messages.zh: 这件外套已经穿得很旧了。
messages.en: This coat has become really worn out.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilbistu kuljum għal snin sħaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilbistu kuljum għal snin sħaħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，我连续好多年每天都穿它。
messages.en: Yes, I've worn it every day for years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天天穿的外套袖口逐渐磨破：重点记住物品“用得太多而变旧”的变化过程。

gloss_zh: 使人烦恼；惹人心烦的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of annoying, troubling or vexing someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人烦恼、苦恼或心烦的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddejjaq lil xi ħadd jew iġġiegħlu jħossu mħasseb jew irritat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人烦恼、苦恼或恼火的行为。

formal.mt: It-tkeddid kontinwu bejn il-kollegi jfixkel ix-xogħol u joħloq tensjoni.
formal.en: Constant vexation among colleagues disrupts work and creates tension.
formal.zh: 同事之间持续不断的烦扰会妨碍工作，并造成紧张气氛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tkeddid kollu għaliex? Mark: Għax nibqgħu nargumentaw fuq l-istess ħaġa. Ejja nsibu soluzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why all this vexation? Mark: Because we keep arguing about the same thing. Let's find a solution.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么要这样不断惹彼此心烦？Mark：因为我们一直在为同一件事争论。我们想个解决办法吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tkeddid kollu għaliex?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tkeddid kollu għaliex?
messages.zh: 为什么要这样不断惹彼此心烦？
messages.en: Why all this vexation?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nibqgħu nargumentaw fuq l-istess ħaġa. Ejja nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nibqgħu nargumentaw fuq l-istess ħaġa. Ejja nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 因为我们一直在为同一件事争论。我们想个解决办法吧。
messages.en: Because we keep arguing about the same thing. Let's find a solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一件小事被反复争论，越说越让人心烦；把这个名词记作“使人烦恼的行为”。

gloss_zh: 被缝上折边；被缝好衣边

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have an edge folded and sewn to form a hem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指衣物或布料的边缘被折起并缝好，形成整齐的折边。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta tarf ta' lbies jew drapp jintewa u jinħiet biex ikun lest u pulit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣物或布料被缝上折边。

collocations.en: the edge of the skirt was hemmed
the edge of the curtain was hemmed

formal.mt: It-tarf tad-dublett tkeffef bir-reqqa biex id-drapp ma jibqax jinħall.
formal.en: The edge of the skirt was carefully hemmed to stop the fabric from fraying.
formal.zh: 裙子的边缘被仔细缝好，以防布料继续脱线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tarf tal-purtiera tkeffef diġà? Rita: Iva, issa nistgħu ndendluha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the edge of the curtain been hemmed yet? Rita: Yes, we can hang it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：窗帘的边缝好了吗？丽塔：好了，现在可以挂起来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tarf tal-purtiera tkeffef diġà?
messages.mt_standard: It-tarf tal-purtiera tkeffef diġà?
messages.zh: 窗帘的边缝好了吗？
messages.en: Has the edge of the curtain been hemmed yet?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nistgħu ndendluha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nistgħu ndendluha.
messages.zh: 好了，现在可以挂起来了。
messages.en: Yes, we can hang it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裙边先折起再缝好，把 tkeffef 和“衣边已经被缝好”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become harsh or severe in one's manner or treatment of others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一个人的态度或待人方式变得严厉、苛刻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta persuna ssir aktar ħarxa jew severa fl-imġiba tagħha jew fil-mod kif tittratta lill-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得严厉、苛刻或严酷。

formal.mt: Wara diversi ksur tar-regoli, il-kap tkeffer mal-ħaddiema u beda jinsisti fuq dixxiplina aktar stretta.
formal.en: After several breaches of the rules, the manager became harsher with the workers and began insisting on stricter discipline.
formal.zh: 在多次发生违规行为后，主管对员工变得更加严厉，并开始要求更严格的纪律。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-kowċ tkeffer magħna llum? Mark: Għax erġajna wasalna tard għat-taħriġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the coach become so harsh with us today? Mark: Because we arrived late for training again.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：教练今天怎么对我们变得这么严厉？马克：因为我们训练又迟到了。

messages.speaker: Lara (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kowċ tkeffer magħna llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kowċ tkeffer magħna llum?
messages.zh: 教练今天怎么对我们变得这么严厉？
messages.en: Why did the coach become so harsh with us today?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax erġajna wasalna tard għat-taħriġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax erġajna wasalna tard għat-taħriġ.
messages.zh: 因为我们训练又迟到了。
messages.en: Because we arrived late for training again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教练原本温和，队员迟到后表情变严肃，用这个变化记住 tkeffer。

gloss_zh: 衣物折边的缝制；缝衣边

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sewing of a folded edge on a garment to make a finished hem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣物边缘折起并缝牢，使衣边整齐完工的缝纫工序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħjata ta' tarf mitwi ta' lbies biex it-tarf ikun lest u pulit.

sense_translations.en_definition: sewing of the hem on a garment
sense_translations.zh_definition: 缝制衣物的折边，即把衣边折起并缝牢的工序。

formal.mt: It-tkeffif tal-qalziet għandu jsir wara li jiġi ċċekkjat it-tul mixtieq.
formal.en: The trousers should be hemmed after the desired length has been checked.
formal.zh: 裤脚折边的缝制应在确认所需裤长之后进行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm idum it-tkeffif ta' dan id-dublett? Rita: Madwar nofs siegħa; tista' tiġi għalih wara.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long will hemming this skirt take? Rita: About half an hour; you can collect it afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条裙子缝折边要多久？丽塔：大约半小时，之后你可以来取。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm idum it-tkeffif ta' dan id-dublett?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm idum it-tkeffif ta' dan id-dublett?
messages.zh: 这条裙子缝折边要多久？
messages.en: How long will hemming this skirt take?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar nofs siegħa; tista' tiġi għalih wara.
messages.mt_standard: Madwar nofs siegħa; tista' tiġi għalih wara.
messages.zh: 大约半小时，之后你可以来取。
messages.en: About half an hour; you can collect it afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkeffif 配上裁缝缝裤脚的画面，重点记住它表示“缝折边这道工序”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wrapping something in cloth or another covering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用布或其他覆盖材料把某物包住、裹起来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa titgeżwer fi drapp jew f'materjal ieħor li jgħattiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包裹、裹覆的动作。

formal.mt: It-tkeffin tal-oġġetti fraġli fi drapp artab jgħin biex jiġu protetti waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: Wrapping fragile objects in soft cloth helps protect them during transport.
formal.zh: 用柔软的布包裹易碎物品，有助于在运输过程中保护它们。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lestejt it-tkeffin tal-vażun? Pawlu: Iva, geżwirtu fi drapp artab u poġġejtu fil-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you finished wrapping the vase? Pawlu: Yes, I wrapped it in soft cloth and put it in the box.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：花瓶包好了吗？保罗：好了，我用软布把它包起来，放进箱子里了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt it-tkeffin tal-vażun?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt it-tkeffin tal-vażun?
messages.zh: 花瓶包好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished wrapping the vase?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, geżwirtu fi drapp artab u poġġejtu fil-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, geżwirtu fi drapp artab u poġġejtu fil-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 好了，我用软布把它包起来，放进箱子里了。
messages.en: Yes, I wrapped it in soft cloth and put it in the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给花瓶裹上一层软布，把 tkeffin 和“用材料包住物体”的动作联系起来。

gloss_zh: 肆行残酷行为；残酷施为

teaching_sense.en_definition: Engaging in cruel actions that cause suffering to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做出使他人受苦的残酷行为，或肆意施行这类行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' atti krudili li jġiegħlu lil ħaddieħor ibati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肆意做出残酷行为；放任自己残酷地对待他人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ikkundanna t-tkeffir tal-priġunieri u talab li l-abbużi jieqfu minnufih.
formal.en: The report condemned the cruel treatment of prisoners and called for the abuses to stop immediately.
formal.zh: 报告谴责了对囚犯施行的残酷行为，并要求立即停止这些虐待。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak li rajna fil-film kien tkeffir tal-priġunieri. Mark: Iva, kien diffiċli tarahom ibatu hekk.
colloquial.en: Sara: What we saw in the film was cruel treatment of prisoners. Mark: Yes, it was hard to watch them suffer like that.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们在电影里看到的是对囚犯的残酷虐待。马克：是啊，看着他们那样受苦，真让人难受。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li rajna fil-film kien tkeffir tal-priġunieri.
messages.mt_standard: Dak li rajna fil-film kien tkeffir tal-priġunieri.
messages.zh: 我们在电影里看到的是对囚犯的残酷虐待。
messages.en: What we saw in the film was cruel treatment of prisoners.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien diffiċli tarahom ibatu hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien diffiċli tarahom ibatu hekk.
messages.zh: 是啊，看着他们那样受苦，真让人难受。
messages.en: Yes, it was hard to watch them suffer like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“报告谴责残酷行为”这个句子记 tkeffir，关注实际施行的残酷行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel melancholy, with a quiet sense of sadness or low spirits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到忧郁、愁闷，处于安静而低落的情绪之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta persuna tħoss dwejjaq u tkun b'burdata baxxa u kwieta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到忧郁；心情愁闷低落。

collocations.en: grew melancholy after his friend's departure
collocations.zh: 在朋友离开后变得忧郁

collocations.en: grew melancholy when he remembered his childhood

formal.mt: Meta qara l-ittri l-qodma, Pawlu tkejjeb u baqa' għal ftit ħin iħares mit-tieqa.
formal.en: When he read the old letters, Pawlu grew melancholy and spent a little while looking out of the window.
formal.zh: 读到那些旧信时，保罗感到惆怅，望着窗外出神了一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark tkejjeb illum? Sara: Ħabibu telaq jgħix barra, u diġà qed iħoss in-nuqqas tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has Mark been feeling melancholy today? Sara: His friend moved abroad, and he already misses him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克今天怎么这么忧郁？萨拉：他的朋友搬到国外去了，他已经开始想念他了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark tkejjeb illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark tkejjeb illum?
messages.zh: 马克今天怎么这么忧郁？
messages.en: Why has Mark been feeling melancholy today?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħabibu telaq jgħix barra, u diġà qed iħoss in-nuqqas tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħabibu telaq jgħix barra, u diġà qed iħoss in-nuqqas tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他的朋友搬到国外去了，他已经开始想念他了。
messages.en: His friend moved abroad, and he already misses him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读旧信后望着窗外发愁的人，用这幅安静惆怅的画面记住 tkejjeb。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be bent into a curved shape; in a separate sense, to drink too much alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指物体被弄弯；另一个独立义项指人饮酒过量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta oġġett jitgħawweġ; f'tifsira oħra, meta persuna tixrob iżżejjed alkoħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弯曲；被弄弯。
饮酒过量；喝太多酒。

collocations.en: drank too much at the party

formal.mt: Il-wajer tkejjef taħt il-pressjoni u ma baqax dritt.
formal.en: The wire was bent under pressure and was no longer straight.
formal.zh: 金属丝在压力下被弄弯，不再保持笔直。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark tkejjef fil-festa lbieraħ? Pawlu: Iva, xorob wisq; mort miegħu d-dar b'taxi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark drink too much at the party yesterday? Pawlu: Yes, he drank too much; I went home with him in a taxi.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克昨天在聚会上喝多了吗？保罗：是啊，他喝太多了；我陪他坐出租车回家了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark tkejjef fil-festa lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Mark tkejjef fil-festa lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 马克昨天在聚会上喝多了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark drink too much at the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xorob wisq; mort miegħu d-dar b'taxi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xorob wisq; mort miegħu d-dar b'taxi.
messages.zh: 是啊，他喝太多了；我陪他坐出租车回家了。
messages.en: Yes, he drank too much; I went home with him in a taxi.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tkejjef 分别画两张记忆卡：弯掉的金属丝、聚会上喝多的人，按上下文选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a size or quantity determined by measurement, or to have an amount estimated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指尺寸或数量通过测量被确定，也可指某个数值被估算出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta daqs jew kwantità jiġu stabbiliti permezz ta' kejl, jew meta ammont jiġi stmat bejn wieħed u ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被测量；尺寸或数量经测量而确定。
被估算；数值经大致判断而确定。

collocations.en: the length was measured with a tape measure

collocations.mt: il-ħin meħtieġ tkejjel bejn wieħed u ieħor
collocations.en: the time needed was roughly estimated
collocations.zh: 所需时间被大致估算了

formal.mt: It-tul tal-mejda tkejjel b'tejp tal-kejl u ġie rreġistrat bħala żewġ metri.
formal.en: The length of the table was measured with a tape measure and recorded as two metres.
formal.zh: 桌子的长度用卷尺测量，并记录为两米。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tkejjel il-ħin meħtieġ għax-xogħol? Mark: Bejn wieħed u ieħor, skont kemm domna l-aħħar darba.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the time needed for the work estimated? Mark: Roughly, based on how long we took last time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这项工作需要的时间是怎么估算的？马克：根据我们上次花的时间，大致估算了一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tkejjel il-ħin meħtieġ għax-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tkejjel il-ħin meħtieġ għax-xogħol?
messages.zh: 这项工作需要的时间是怎么估算的？
messages.en: How was the time needed for the work estimated?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Bejn wieħed u ieħor, skont kemm domna l-aħħar darba.
messages.mt_standard: Bejn wieħed u ieħor, skont kemm domna l-aħħar darba.
messages.zh: 根据我们上次花的时间，大致估算了一下。
messages.en: Roughly, based on how long we took last time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkejjel 放进两个场景记忆：拿卷尺得到尺寸，凭经验估算时间，分别对应测量与估算。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave humbly, without showing pride or claiming special importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以谦逊的态度行事，不自夸，也不把自己看得高人一等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'umiltà, mingħajr kburija jew ftaħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现谦逊；以谦卑的态度行事。

collocations.zh: 取得成功后仍表现谦逊

formal.mt: Meta rċieva l-premju, ir-riċerkatur tkejjen u rringrazzja lit-tim kollu.
formal.en: When he received the award, the researcher acted humbly and thanked the whole team.
formal.zh: 研究员领奖时表现谦逊，并向整个团队致谢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ġab ruħu Pawlu meta faħħruh? Rita: Tkejjen u qal li kulħadd kien għen.
