colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu behave when they praised him? Rita: He acted humbly and said that everyone had helped.
colloquial.zh: Maja：大家表扬保罗时，他表现怎么样？Rita：他很谦逊，说每个人都帮了忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ġab ruħu Pawlu meta faħħruh?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ġab ruħu Pawlu meta faħħruh?
messages.zh: 大家表扬保罗时，他表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu behave when they praised him?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkejjen u qal li kulħadd kien għen.
messages.mt_standard: Tkejjen u qal li kulħadd kien għen.
messages.zh: 他很谦逊，说每个人都帮了忙。
messages.en: He acted humbly and said that everyone had helped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词联想到领奖时先感谢团队的画面，记住它强调主动表现谦逊。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be lazy or lethargic, showing little willingness or energy to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得懒散，或处于精神不振、缺乏行动精力的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun għażżien jew bla ħeġġa u enerġija biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒散；不愿费力做事。
精神不振；无精打采，缺乏精力。

collocations.mt: tkejjet u ħalla x-xogħol għal wara
collocations.en: was lazy and left the work until later

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla ta' nofsinhar, l-impjegat tkejjet u ħadem b'inqas enerġija.
formal.en: After lunch, the employee felt lethargic and worked with less energy.
formal.zh: 午饭后，这名员工精神不振，工作时精力也较差。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu għadu ma ħasilx il-platti? Mark: Tkejjet u ħalliehom għal wara.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why hasn't Pawlu washed the dishes yet? Mark: He was lazy and left them until later.
colloquial.zh: Sara：保罗怎么还没洗碗？Mark：他犯懒了，把碗留到以后再洗。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu għadu ma ħasilx il-platti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu għadu ma ħasilx il-platti?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么还没洗碗？
messages.en: Why hasn't Pawlu washed the dishes yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkejjet u ħalliehom għal wara.
messages.mt_standard: Tkejjet u ħalliehom għal wara.
messages.zh: 他犯懒了，把碗留到以后再洗。
messages.en: He was lazy and left them until later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人瘫在椅子上：可能不愿做事，也可能没有精力，分别对应懒散和精神不振。

gloss_zh: 使人难过；令人悲伤的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making someone feel sad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到难过或悲伤的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss niket jew dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人难过或悲伤这一行为或过程。

collocations.en: making someone sad through harsh words

formal.mt: Fit-taħriġ dwar il-komunikazzjoni, ġie diskuss it-tkejjib li jista' jikkawża kliem iebes.
formal.en: The communication training discussed the sadness that harsh words can cause.
formal.zh: 沟通培训讨论了严厉言语可能给人带来的悲伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li dik iċ-ċajta kienet xierqa? Rita: Le, kienet biss tkejjib bla bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think that joke was appropriate? Rita: No, it just made someone sad for no reason.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得那个玩笑合适吗？Rita：不合适，只是无谓地让人难过。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dik iċ-ċajta kienet xierqa?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dik iċ-ċajta kienet xierqa?
messages.zh: 你觉得那个玩笑合适吗？
messages.en: Do you think that joke was appropriate?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kienet biss tkejjib bla bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kienet biss tkejjib bla bżonn.
messages.zh: 不合适，只是无谓地让人难过。
messages.en: No, it just made someone sad for no reason.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一句伤人的话让对方低下头的画面；这个名词关注使人悲伤这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being bent or curved rather than straight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体不再笔直而呈弯曲的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa li tkun milwija jew mgħawġa minflok dritta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弯曲；物体处于弯曲的状态。

collocations.en: the bent condition of the rod

formal.mt: Matul l-ispezzjoni, it-tekniku nnota tkejjif fil-virga tal-metall.
formal.en: During the inspection, the technician noticed a bend in the metal rod.
formal.zh: 检查时，技术人员注意到金属杆发生了弯曲。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-wajer għadu dritt? Toni: Le, hemm tkejjif fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this wire still straight? Toni: No, there's a bend in the middle.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这根金属丝还是直的吗？Toni：不是，中间有一处弯曲。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-wajer għadu dritt?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-wajer għadu dritt?
messages.zh: 这根金属丝还是直的吗？
messages.en: Is this wire still straight?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hemm tkejjif fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hemm tkejjif fin-nofs.
messages.zh: 不是，中间有一处弯曲。
messages.en: No, there's a bend in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中并排放一根直杆和一根弯杆，用弯杆的形状记住这个表示弯曲状态的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of measuring a size or quantity, or estimating its approximate value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 测定尺寸或数量的过程，也可指对其大致数值进行估量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitkejjel daqs jew ammont, jew jiġi stmat il-valur approssimattiv tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 测量；测定尺寸、数量等数值。
估量；推算大致的数量或数值。

formal.mt: It-tkejjil preċiż tat-tul tal-kamra huwa meħtieġ qabel ma tiġi ordnata l-għamara.
formal.en: Precise measurement of the room's length is required before the furniture is ordered.
formal.zh: 订购家具之前，需要精确测量房间的长度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għamilt it-tkejjil tal-mejda? Mark: Iva, u t-tul tagħha huwa żewġ metri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you measured the table? Mark: Yes, and it is two metres long.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你量过桌子了吗？Mark：量过了，桌子长两米。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt it-tkejjil tal-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt it-tkejjil tal-mejda?
messages.zh: 你量过桌子了吗？
messages.en: Have you measured the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u t-tul tagħha huwa żewġ metri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u t-tul tagħha huwa żewġ metri.
messages.zh: 量过了，桌子长两米。
messages.en: Yes, and it is two metres long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先用卷尺量桌子，再凭眼睛估长度；两幅画面分别帮助记住测量和估量。

gloss_zh: 令人受辱的事；使人蒙羞之事

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that humiliates a person or makes them feel ashamed and diminished.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到受辱、蒙羞或尊严受损的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tumilja lil persuna jew iġġegħelha tħossha mċekkna u mistħija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人受辱、蒙羞或感到尊严受损的事。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qies il-kumment bħala tkejjin pubbliku għall-impjegat.
formal.en: The committee regarded the comment as a public humiliation for the employee.
formal.zh: 委员会认为，这番评论使该员工当众受辱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħassejtek meta daħku bik quddiem kulħadd? Pawlu: Kien tkejjin għalija.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you feel when they laughed at you in front of everyone? Pawlu: It was humiliating for me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他们当着大家的面嘲笑你，你是什么感受？Pawlu：我觉得那是件很屈辱的事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta daħku bik quddiem kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta daħku bik quddiem kulħadd?
messages.zh: 他们当着大家的面嘲笑你，你是什么感受？
messages.en: How did you feel when they laughed at you in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien tkejjin għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Kien tkejjin għalija.
messages.zh: 我觉得那是件很屈辱的事。
messages.en: It was humiliating for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想当众被嘲笑后脸红低头的场景，把这个名词记成令人感到受辱的一件事。

gloss_zh: 使人倦怠或懒散的作用

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of causing someone to become lethargic or idle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人变得精神不振、懒散或不愿活动的行为或作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd isir bla enerġija jew għażżien.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of causing lethargy or idleness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人产生倦怠或陷入懒散状态的行为或作用。

collocations.en: the induction of lethargy by heat
the induction of idleness through a lack of activity
collocations.zh: 缺乏活动使人懒散的作用

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tkejjit ikkawżat mis-sħana waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The report describes how heat induces lethargy during work.
formal.zh: 报告描述了炎热在工作期间使人产生倦怠的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tiftaħ it-tieqa? Mark: Biex nidħol ftit arja u nnaqqas it-tkejjit li qed iġġib din is-sħana.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you opening the window? Mark: To let in some air and reduce the lethargy this heat is causing.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么开窗？Mark：让空气进来一点，减轻这股热气带来的倦怠。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiftaħ it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiftaħ it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你为什么开窗？
messages.en: Why are you opening the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nidħol ftit arja u nnaqqas it-tkejjit li qed iġġib din is-sħana.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nidħol ftit arja u nnaqqas it-tkejjit li qed iġġib din is-sħana.
messages.zh: 让空气进来一点，减轻这股热气带来的倦怠。
messages.en: To let in some air and reduce the lethargy this heat is causing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闷热房间让人越来越不想动，记住这里强调使人变倦怠或懒散的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a crown or have a crown placed on one's head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受加冕，或被人在头上戴上王冠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titqiegħed kuruna fuq rasu jew jirċievi kuruna f'ċerimonja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加冕；被戴上王冠。

collocations.en: was crowned with a golden crown

formal.mt: Il-prinċep tkellel re waqt ċerimonja fil-palazz.
formal.en: The prince was crowned king during a ceremony at the palace.
formal.zh: 王子在宫殿举行的仪式上被加冕为国王。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara fl-aħħar tad-dramm? Toni: Il-prinċep tkellel re, u kulħadd ċapċap.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened at the end of the play? Toni: The prince was crowned king, and everyone applauded.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这出戏最后发生了什么？Toni：王子被加冕为国王，大家都鼓掌了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara fl-aħħar tad-dramm?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara fl-aħħar tad-dramm?
messages.zh: 这出戏最后发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened at the end of the play?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prinċep tkellel re, u kulħadd ċapċap.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prinċep tkellel re, u kulħadd ċapċap.
messages.zh: 王子被加冕为国王，大家都鼓掌了。
messages.en: The prince was crowned king, and everyone applauded.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仪式上王冠被放到王子头顶，记住这个动词的主语是接受加冕的人。

gloss_zh: 环绕装饰；戴冠；以花环围饰

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of encircling someone or something, especially with a wreath or crown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕某人或某物进行装饰的行为，尤其指戴上王冠、花冠或围上花环。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddawwar lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa b'kuruna jew girlanda, speċjalment bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.en_definition: encircling (especially with a wreath or crown)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 环绕，尤指用花环或冠饰围绕、装饰。

collocations.en: the crowning or wreathing of the statue
collocations.zh: 为雕像戴冠或饰以花环

collocations.en: encircling with a wreath of flowers

formal.mt: Il-programm taċ-ċerimonja jinkludi t-tkellil tal-istatwa b'girlanda tal-fjuri.
formal.en: The ceremony programme includes wreathing the statue with a garland of flowers.
formal.zh: 仪式安排包括用鲜花花环装饰雕像。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tkellil tal-istatwa? Mark: Jien. Il-girlanda tal-fjuri diġà lesta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will take care of wreathing the statue? Mark: I will. The flower garland is already ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来负责给雕像围上花环？马克：我来。鲜花花环已经准备好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tkellil tal-istatwa?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tkellil tal-istatwa?
messages.zh: 谁来负责给雕像围上花环？
messages.en: Who will take care of wreathing the statue?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Il-girlanda tal-fjuri diġà lesta.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Il-girlanda tal-fjuri diġà lesta.
messages.zh: 我来。鲜花花环已经准备好了。
messages.en: I will. The flower garland is already ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkellil 记成一个动作画面：花环绕着雕像或冠饰围着头部，重点是“环绕、戴冠”这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of speaking or having a conversation with someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话或与他人交谈的活动，既可指发言，也可指彼此交流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tgħid xi ħaġa bil-kliem jew li titkellem ma' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话；用言语表达或发言的活动。
交谈；与他人通过言语进行交流。

formal.mt: It-tkellim bil-Malti waqt l-attivitajiet tal-klassi jgħin lill-istudenti jużaw il-kliem il-ġdid.
formal.en: Speaking Maltese during classroom activities helps students use new vocabulary.
formal.zh: 在课堂活动中用马耳他语交谈，有助于学生运用新词。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tkellim bil-Malti għadu diffiċli għalija. Pawlu: Ejja nitkellmu ftit kuljum. Tista' tibda b'sentenzi qosra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Speaking Maltese is still difficult for me. Pawlu: Let's talk a little every day. You can start with short sentences.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：用马耳他语说话对我来说还是很难。保罗：我们每天聊一会儿吧。你可以从短句开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tkellim bil-Malti għadu diffiċli għalija.
messages.mt_standard: It-tkellim bil-Malti għadu diffiċli għalija.
messages.zh: 用马耳他语说话对我来说还是很难。
messages.en: Speaking Maltese is still difficult for me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nitkellmu ftit kuljum. Tista' tibda b'sentenzi qosra.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nitkellmu ftit kuljum. Tista' tibda b'sentenzi qosra.
messages.zh: 我们每天聊一会儿吧。你可以从短句开始。
messages.en: Let's talk a little every day. You can start with short sentences.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两位同学轮流开口，把 tkellim 与“说话、交谈这项活动”连在一起；这里要记作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have warm water or a medicated liquid applied to a painful part of one's body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让身体疼痛的部位接受温水或药液的敷治。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu ilma sħun jew likwidu mediċinali applikat fuq parti minn ġismu li tkun tuġgħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have warm water or medicated liquid applied to an aching part of the body
sense_translations.zh_definition: 让身体疼痛的部位接受温水或药液敷治。

collocations.en: to have warm water applied to an aching part of the body
to have a medicated liquid applied to an aching part of the body

formal.mt: Ir-raġel tkemmed b'ċarruta mxarrba b'ilma sħun fuq l-ispalla li kienet tuġgħu.
formal.en: The man had a cloth soaked in warm water applied to his aching shoulder.
formal.zh: 那名男子疼痛的肩膀上敷了一块用温水浸湿的布。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għamel Pawlu meta bdiet tuġgħu l-ispalla? Marija: Tkemmed b'ċarruta mxarrba b'ilma sħun.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did Pawlu do when his shoulder started hurting? Marija: He had a cloth soaked in warm water applied to it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗肩膀开始疼的时候做了什么？玛丽亚：他用温水浸湿的布敷了肩膀。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel Pawlu meta bdiet tuġgħu l-ispalla?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel Pawlu meta bdiet tuġgħu l-ispalla?
messages.zh: 保罗肩膀开始疼的时候做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do when his shoulder started hurting?

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkemmed b'ċarruta mxarrba b'ilma sħun.
messages.mt_standard: Tkemmed b'ċarruta mxarrba b'ilma sħun.
messages.zh: 他用温水浸湿的布敷了肩膀。
messages.en: He had a cloth soaked in warm water applied to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“疼痛肩膀上敷着温湿布”的画面记 tkemmed：注意是某人接受敷治，词性是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become wrinkled or develop creases, as fabric or paper does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得有皱纹或折痕，例如布料或纸张起皱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imkemmex jew jiżviluppa tinjiet, bħalma jiġri lid-drapp jew lill-karta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起皱；变得皱巴巴或出现皱纹。
出现折痕；因折叠、挤压等而形成褶痕。

formal.mt: Id-drapp tkemmex waqt it-trasport u kellu bżonn jinħadem bil-ħadida qabel l-użu.
formal.en: The fabric became wrinkled during transport and needed ironing before use.
formal.zh: 布料在运输过程中起了皱，使用前需要熨烫。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Id-drapp tkemmex fil-bagalja. Mark: Nista' ngħaddih qabel ma noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: The fabric got wrinkled in the suitcase. Mark: I can iron it before we go out.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：布料在行李箱里压皱了。马克：出门前我可以把它熨一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-drapp tkemmex fil-bagalja.
messages.mt_standard: Id-drapp tkemmex fil-bagalja.
messages.zh: 布料在行李箱里压皱了。
messages.en: The fabric got wrinkled in the suitcase.

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' ngħaddih qabel ma noħorġu.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' ngħaddih qabel ma noħorġu.
messages.zh: 出门前我可以把它熨一下。
messages.en: I can iron it before we go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开行李箱，原本平整的布变皱了；用这个变化画面记 tkemmex 的“起皱、出现折痕”。

gloss_zh: 温水敷治；药液敷治；温敷

teaching_sense.en_definition: The application of warm water, lotion, or a warm wet compress to an aching part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把温水、洗剂或温湿敷布用于身体疼痛部位的敷治行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-applikazzjoni ta' ilma sħun, lozjoni jew ċarruta sħuna u mxarrba fuq parti tal-ġisem li tkun tuġgħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: application of warm water or lotion against ache
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为缓解疼痛而施用温水或洗剂的敷治。
温敷；在疼痛部位施用温热液体或温湿敷物。

collocations.en: the application of a warm compress to the shoulder

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tkemmid tal-ispalla b'ċarruta mxarrba b'ilma sħun.
formal.en: The report describes the application of a cloth soaked in warm water to the shoulder.
formal.zh: 报告描述了用温水浸湿的布敷治肩部的过程。

colloquial.mt: Rita: It-tkemmid tal-ispalla għen lil Pawlu? Anna: Qal li wara ħass inqas uġigħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the warm compress on his shoulder help Pawlu? Anna: He said he felt less pain afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：肩部温敷对保罗有帮助吗？安娜：他说敷完以后没那么疼了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tkemmid tal-ispalla għen lil Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: It-tkemmid tal-ispalla għen lil Pawlu?
messages.zh: 肩部温敷对保罗有帮助吗？
messages.en: Did the warm compress on his shoulder help Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li wara ħass inqas uġigħ.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li wara ħass inqas uġigħ.
messages.zh: 他说敷完以后没那么疼了。
messages.en: He said he felt less pain afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkemmid 放进“进行一次温敷”的句框里记忆：它指敷治这项行为，是名词；可与动词 tkemmed 对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming wrinkled or forming creases in a surface or material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面或材料变皱、形成皱纹或折痕的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih wiċċ jew materjal isir imkemmex jew jiżviluppa tinjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起皱；形成皱纹或细褶的过程。
形成折痕或褶痕的过程。

formal.mt: Il-kampjuni nżammu ċatti biex jiġi evitat it-tkemmix tal-karta.
formal.en: The samples were kept flat to prevent the paper from creasing.
formal.zh: 样品保持平放，以防纸张出现折痕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nista' nevita t-tkemmix tal-karta fil-basket? Lara: Poġġiha f'folder iebes.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I stop the paper from getting creased in my bag? Lara: Put it in a rigid folder.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎样才能避免纸张在包里压出折痕？劳拉：把它放进硬质文件夹里。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nevita t-tkemmix tal-karta fil-basket?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nevita t-tkemmix tal-karta fil-basket?
messages.zh: 怎样才能避免纸张在包里压出折痕？
messages.en: How can I stop the paper from getting creased in my bag?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha f'folder iebes.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha f'folder iebes.
messages.zh: 把它放进硬质文件夹里。
messages.en: Put it in a rigid folder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“防止布料起皱、防止纸张折损”记 tkemmix，关注起皱这个过程；与动词 tkemmex 成对区分词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To seek a sheltered place for protection, for example from rain, wind, or danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寻找有遮蔽的地方以获得保护，例如躲避雨、风或危险。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifittex post fejn ikun protett, pereżempju mix-xita, mir-riħ jew minn xi periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寻求庇护；找有遮蔽的地方躲避。

collocations.en: to seek shelter from the rain
to seek shelter under a roof
collocations.zh: 到屋顶遮盖的地方躲避

formal.mt: Meta bdiet il-maltempata, il-mixi waqaf u l-grupp tkennen f'bini fil-qrib.
formal.en: When the storm began, the walk stopped and the group sought shelter in a nearby building.
formal.zh: 暴风雨开始时，队伍停止步行，到附近的一栋建筑里躲避。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn mar Mark meta bdiet ix-xita? Pawlu: Tkennen taħt is-saqaf tal-waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did Mark go when it started raining? Pawlu: He took shelter under the roof of the bus stop.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：开始下雨时马克去哪儿了？保罗：他到公交车站的顶棚下避雨了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar Mark meta bdiet ix-xita?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar Mark meta bdiet ix-xita?
messages.zh: 开始下雨时马克去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Mark go when it started raining?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkennen taħt is-saqaf tal-waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Tkennen taħt is-saqaf tal-waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 他到公交车站的顶棚下避雨了。
messages.en: He took shelter under the roof of the bus stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象突然下雨，你跑到公交站顶棚下面；用“自己找地方躲避”的动作记 tkennen。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The provision of shelter or protective help to someone in need.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向有需要的人提供遮蔽、安身之处或保护性援助的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' kenn, protezzjoni jew għajnuna lil min ikun fil-bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供庇护；为他人提供可躲避或安身的地方。
救助；向身处困难或危险中的人提供援助和保护。

collocations.en: the provision of shelter for families
providing shelter and succour to people in need
collocations.zh: 为有需要的人提供庇护与救助

formal.mt: L-għaqda ħadet ħsieb it-tkennin tal-familji li tilfu djarhom waqt il-maltempata.
formal.en: The organisation arranged shelter for the families who lost their homes during the storm.
formal.zh: 该组织为在暴风雨中失去家园的家庭安排了庇护住所。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tkennin tal-familji llejla? Mark: L-għaqda tagħna. Diġà ħejjejna s-sala u s-sodod.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who will take care of sheltering the families tonight? Mark: Our organisation. We have already prepared the hall and the beds.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：今晚谁来负责安置这些家庭？马克：我们组织来负责。大厅和床位已经准备好了。

messages.speaker: Rita (社区协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tkennin tal-familji llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tkennin tal-familji llejla?
messages.zh: 今晚谁来负责安置这些家庭？
messages.en: Who will take care of sheltering the families tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (救助组织志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għaqda tagħna. Diġà ħejjejna s-sala u s-sodod.
messages.mt_standard: L-għaqda tagħna. Diġà ħejjejna s-sala u s-sodod.
messages.zh: 我们组织来负责。大厅和床位已经准备好了。
messages.en: Our organisation. We have already prepared the hall and the beds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象志愿者打开大厅、摆好床位，为别人提供庇护与援助；用这一整项救助工作记名词 tkennin。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become chilled or feel cold after exposure to low temperatures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因接触低温而感到寒冷或受冻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss il-bard wara li jkun espost għal temperatura baxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受冻；感到寒冷。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tkerċaħ waqt li kien jaħdem barra mingħajr ġakketta.
formal.en: The worker became chilled while working outside without a jacket.
formal.zh: 那名工人没穿外套在户外工作，受了冻。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu daħal ġewwa? Mark: Tkerċaħ wara l-għawma u ried jilbes xi ħaġa sħuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu come inside? Mark: He got chilled after swimming and wanted to put on something warm.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu为什么进屋了？Mark：他游泳后觉得冷，想穿件暖和的衣服。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu daħal ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu daħal ġewwa?
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么进屋了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu come inside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkerċaħ wara l-għawma u ried jilbes xi ħaġa sħuna.
messages.mt_standard: Tkerċaħ wara l-għawma u ried jilbes xi ħaġa sħuna.
messages.zh: 他游泳后觉得冷，想穿件暖和的衣服。
messages.en: He got chilled after swimming and wanted to put on something warm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象游泳后湿着身子吹冷风，再披上外套；把这个受冻的动作画面与 tkerċaħ 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chilly feeling, or shivering caused by cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体感到寒冷的感觉，也可指因寒冷而出现的发抖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' bard, jew rogħda tal-ġisem minħabba l-kesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒冷感；身体觉得发冷的感觉。
因寒冷而发抖；冷得打战。

formal.mt: Wara li qagħad għal siegħa fix-xita kiesħa, ir-raġel ħass tkerċiħ mal-ġisem kollu.
formal.en: After spending an hour in the cold rain, the man felt a chill throughout his body.
formal.zh: 在冰冷的雨中待了一小时后，那名男子感到全身发冷。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qabadni tkerċiħ wara li ħriġt mill-baħar. Sara: Ħu dan ix-xugaman u ejja noqogħdu fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Nina: I started shivering after I came out of the sea. Sara: Take this towel and let's sit in the sun.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我从海里出来后就开始冷得发抖。Sara：拿着这条毛巾，我们去太阳底下坐吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qabadni tkerċiħ wara li ħriġt mill-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Qabadni tkerċiħ wara li ħriġt mill-baħar.
messages.zh: 我从海里出来后就开始冷得发抖。
messages.en: I started shivering after I came out of the sea.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu dan ix-xugaman u ejja noqogħdu fix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu dan ix-xugaman u ejja noqogħdu fix-xemx.
messages.zh: 拿着这条毛巾，我们去太阳底下坐吧。
messages.en: Take this towel and let's sit in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个连续画面记忆 tkerċiħ：先觉得一阵冷，再冷得肩膀发抖，分别对应两个名词义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stirred into action by someone, or to be provoked into anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到他人的煽动而行动，或受到刺激而生气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mħeġġeġ minn xi ħadd biex jaġixxi, jew jiġi pprovokat biex jirrabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到煽动；受人挑唆而行动。
被激怒；因受到刺激而生气。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, iż-żagħżugħ tkeskes minn sħabu biex jibda argument mal-ġar.
formal.en: According to the report, the young man was instigated by his friends to start an argument with the neighbour.
formal.zh: 据报告所述，那名年轻人受到朋友们的挑唆，去与邻居争吵。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark beda jgħajjat? Lara: Tkeskes bil-kummenti ta' sieħbu, imma issa kkalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark start shouting? Lara: His friend's comments angered him, but he has calmed down now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么突然大喊起来？Lara：他被朋友的话激怒了，不过现在已经平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark beda jgħajjat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark beda jgħajjat?
messages.zh: Mark为什么突然大喊起来？
messages.en: Why did Mark start shouting?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkeskes bil-kummenti ta' sieħbu, imma issa kkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Tkeskes bil-kummenti ta' sieħbu, imma issa kkalma.
messages.zh: 他被朋友的话激怒了，不过现在已经平静下来了。
messages.en: His friend's comments angered him, but he has calmed down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkeskes 放在受影响的人身上记忆：有人在旁挑唆，他被煽动；有人出言刺激，他被激怒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of encouraging someone to become angry or to use violence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语或行为挑动他人的怒气，或煽动他人使用暴力的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd biex jirrabja jew juża l-vjolenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑动怒气或煽动暴力的行为；使他人愤怒或诉诸暴力的挑唆。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jikkundanna t-tkeskis għall-vjolenza u jappella għal diskussjoni kalma.
formal.en: The article condemns incitement to violence and calls for a calm discussion.
formal.zh: 这篇文章谴责煽动暴力的行为，并呼吁冷静讨论。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qiegħed jgħidilhom biex imorru jiġġieldu. Nina: Dak tkeskis għall-vjolenza; aħjar nippruvaw nikkalmawhom.
colloquial.en: Mark: He is telling them to go and fight. Nina: That is incitement to violence; we'd better try to calm them down.
colloquial.zh: Mark：他在叫他们去打架。Nina：那是在煽动暴力，我们最好设法让他们冷静下来。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed jgħidilhom biex imorru jiġġieldu.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed jgħidilhom biex imorru jiġġieldu.
messages.zh: 他在叫他们去打架。
messages.en: He is telling them to go and fight.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tkeskis għall-vjolenza; aħjar nippruvaw nikkalmawhom.
messages.mt_standard: Dak tkeskis għall-vjolenza; aħjar nippruvaw nikkalmawhom.
messages.zh: 那是在煽动暴力，我们最好设法让他们冷静下来。
messages.en: That is incitement to violence; we'd better try to calm them down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旁边有人不断喊着去打架，把这种挑起怒气和冲突的行为整体记为名词 tkeskis。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming cold; in another sense, affected or ostentatious behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温度降低、逐渐变冷的过程；另一个义项指装腔作势或炫耀的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li xi ħaġa ssir kiesħa; f'sens ieħor, imġiba artifiċjali jew maħsuba biex tiġbed l-attenzjoni u timpressjona.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变冷；逐渐冷下来的过程。

sense_translations.en_definition: behaving in an affected or ostentatious manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 装腔作势；以做作或炫耀的方式表现自己。

formal.mt: It-tkessiħ tat-temp matul il-lejl wassal biex il-parteċipanti jilbsu ħwejjeġ eħxen.
formal.en: The weather becoming colder during the night led the participants to put on thicker clothes.
formal.zh: 夜间天气转冷，参加者因此换上了更厚的衣服。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għalfejn dak it-tkessiħ kollu quddiem il-mistednin? Mark: Ried jimpressjonahom, imma deher artifiċjali.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why all that showing off in front of the guests? Mark: He wanted to impress them, but he came across as affected.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他为什么在客人面前那么装腔作势？Mark：他想给他们留下深刻印象，却显得很做作。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalfejn dak it-tkessiħ kollu quddiem il-mistednin?
messages.mt_standard: Għalfejn dak it-tkessiħ kollu quddiem il-mistednin?
messages.zh: 他为什么在客人面前那么装腔作势？
messages.en: Why all that showing off in front of the guests?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jimpressjonahom, imma deher artifiċjali.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jimpressjonahom, imma deher artifiċjali.
messages.zh: 他想给他们留下深刻印象，却显得很做作。
messages.en: He wanted to impress them, but he came across as affected.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tkessiħ 分放两张记忆卡：一张画温度下降，一张画人在客人面前摆架子；根据语境选择义项。

gloss_zh: 变得繁星遍布；布满星星

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dotted or filled with stars, as the sky does when stars appear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得星星点点、繁星遍布，常用于描写星星出现后的天空。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bil-kwiekeb, bħas-sema meta jidhru fih il-kwiekeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得繁星遍布；呈现布满星星的景象。

collocations.en: the sky became filled with stars
became dotted with stars after sunset

formal.mt: Wara nżul ix-xemx, is-sema tkewkeb u l-baħar baqa' kwiet.
formal.en: After sunset, the sky became filled with stars and the sea remained calm.
formal.zh: 日落后，天空繁星遍布，海面依然平静。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħares 'il fuq, is-sema tkewkeb! Pawlu: Kemm hemm kwiekeb illejla; ejja noqogħdu narawhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look up, the sky has filled with stars! Pawlu: There are so many stars tonight; let's sit and watch them.
colloquial.zh: Lara：抬头看，天空布满星星了！Pawlu：今晚星星真多，我们坐下来看看吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares 'il fuq, is-sema tkewkeb!
messages.mt_standard: Ħares 'il fuq, is-sema tkewkeb!
messages.zh: 抬头看，天空布满星星了！
messages.en: Look up, the sky has filled with stars!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hemm kwiekeb illejla; ejja noqogħdu narawhom.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hemm kwiekeb illejla; ejja noqogħdu narawhom.
messages.zh: 今晚星星真多，我们坐下来看看吧。
messages.en: There are so many stars tonight; let's sit and watch them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkewkeb 想成一段天空变化的短片：日落后，一颗颗星出现，最后整片天空繁星遍布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The twinkling of stars, whose light seems to brighten and fade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 星星的光看起来忽明忽暗、不断闪动的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dija tal-kwiekeb li tidher tissaħħaħ u tiddgħajjef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪烁；专指星光看起来忽明忽暗的现象。

collocations.en: to admire the twinkling of the stars

formal.mt: Il-poeta ddeskriva t-tkewkib tal-kwiekeb fuq il-baħar mudlam.
formal.en: The poet described the twinkling of the stars above the dark sea.
formal.zh: 诗人描写了漆黑海面上方闪烁的星光。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Minn hawn nistgħu naraw it-tkewkib tal-kwiekeb. Mark: Iva, ejja nitfu d-dawl biex narawh aħjar.
colloquial.en: Nina: We can see the stars twinkling from here. Mark: Yes, let's turn off the light so we can see it better.
colloquial.zh: Nina：从这里能看到星光闪烁。Mark：是啊，我们把灯关掉，就能看得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn hawn nistgħu naraw it-tkewkib tal-kwiekeb.
messages.mt_standard: Minn hawn nistgħu naraw it-tkewkib tal-kwiekeb.
messages.zh: 从这里能看到星光闪烁。
messages.en: We can see the stars twinkling from here.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nitfu d-dawl biex narawh aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nitfu d-dawl biex narawh aħjar.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们把灯关掉，就能看得更清楚。
messages.en: Yes, let's turn off the light so we can see it better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用星星一明一暗的画面记住 tkewkib；学习时把注意力放在星光闪动这一现象上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of finding excuses to explain one's behaviour or avoid doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为解释自己的行为或逃避某件事而寻找借口、托辞的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ifittex skużi biex jiġġustifika l-imġiba tiegħu jew jevita li jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 找借口；寻找用来推托或辩解的理由。

formal.mt: L-għalliem talab lill-istudenti jieqfu mit-tkewtil u jibdew ix-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: The teacher asked the students to stop finding excuses and start their work on time.
formal.zh: 老师要求学生们停止找借口，按时开始做作业。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Ma nistax naħsel il-platti għax se jibda l-programm. Sara: Biżżejjed tkewtil; aħsilhom issa u mbagħad ara l-programm.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I can't wash the dishes because the show is about to start. Sara: Enough excuses; wash them now and then watch the show.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：节目快开始了，我没法洗碗。Sara：别再找借口了，现在洗完再看节目。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax naħsel il-platti għax se jibda l-programm.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax naħsel il-platti għax se jibda l-programm.
messages.zh: 节目快开始了，我没法洗碗。
messages.en: I can't wash the dishes because the show is about to start.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biżżejjed tkewtil; aħsilhom issa u mbagħad ara l-programm.
messages.mt_standard: Biżżejjed tkewtil; aħsilhom issa u mbagħad ara l-programm.
messages.zh: 别再找借口了，现在洗完再看节目。
messages.en: Enough excuses; wash them now and then watch the show.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象轮到洗碗时，一个人接连说节目开始了、自己太累了；把这一串找借口的行为记作 tkewtil。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of pouring, decanting, or otherwise handling liquids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾倒液体、把液体转注到另一容器或进行其他液体操作的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tferra' likwidu, tgħaddih minn reċipjent għal ieħor jew timmaniġġjah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾倒液体的动作。
把液体从一个容器转注到另一个容器。
对液体进行转移、倾倒等操作。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tkewwis tal-likwidu, żomm ir-reċipjent sod biex tevita t-tixrid.
formal.en: While pouring the liquid, hold the container firmly to avoid spillage.
formal.zh: 倾倒液体时，请握稳容器，以免洒出。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Tista' tgħinni bit-tkewwis tal-ilma fil-fliexken? Pawlu: Iva, żomm il-flixkun u jien inferra' bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can you help me pour the water into the bottles? Pawlu: Yes, hold the bottle and I'll pour slowly.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你能帮我把水倒进瓶子里吗？Pawlu：可以，你扶住瓶子，我慢慢倒。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinni bit-tkewwis tal-ilma fil-fliexken?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinni bit-tkewwis tal-ilma fil-fliexken?
messages.zh: 你能帮我把水倒进瓶子里吗？
messages.en: Can you help me pour the water into the bottles?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żomm il-flixkun u jien inferra' bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żomm il-flixkun u jien inferra' bil-mod.
messages.zh: 可以，你扶住瓶子，我慢慢倒。
messages.en: Yes, hold the bottle and I'll pour slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把水壶倾斜、将水转入瓶子的连续动作，把 tkewwis 与“倾倒和转注液体”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become terrified or to tremble because of fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得十分害怕，或因恐惧而身体发抖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass biża' kbira jew beda jitriegħed bil-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得惊恐；受到极大的惊吓。
因为恐惧而发抖。

collocations.en: became terrified when he heard the scream
collocations.zh: 听到尖叫声时惊恐起来

formal.mt: Ix-xhud tkexkex meta ra l-inċident u ma setax jitkellem għal ftit ħin.
formal.en: The witness became terrified when he saw the accident and could not speak for a short time.
formal.zh: 目击者看到事故时惊恐万分，一时说不出话来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex telaq Mark miċ-ċinema? Lara: Tkexkex waqt il-film u ried joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark leave the cinema? Lara: He became terrified during the film and wanted to get out.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 为什么离开电影院了？Lara：他看电影时吓坏了，想出去。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex telaq Mark miċ-ċinema?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex telaq Mark miċ-ċinema?
messages.zh: Mark 为什么离开电影院了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave the cinema?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkexkex waqt il-film u ried joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Tkexkex waqt il-film u ried joħroġ.
messages.zh: 他看电影时吓坏了，想出去。
messages.en: He became terrified during the film and wanted to get out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkexkex 配上突然听到尖叫、身体跟着发抖的画面，记住这是“惊恐起来”的动作。

gloss_zh: 恐怖；恐惧中的颤抖；轻颤

teaching_sense.en_definition: Horror, trembling caused by fear, or a slight quivering movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 恐怖的感受、因害怕而产生的颤抖，或轻微的颤动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' biża' kbira, rogħda minħabba l-biża', jew ċaqliq ħafif ta' tregħid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈的恐惧感；恐怖。
因恐惧而产生的颤抖。
轻微而短促的颤动；轻颤。

collocations.en: a slight quiver in the hands

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tax-xena tqanqal sens ta' tkexkix fil-qarrej.
formal.en: The description of the scene evokes a feeling of horror in the reader.
formal.zh: 对这一场景的描写使读者产生恐怖感。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif kien il-film? Toni: Ħassejt tkexkix waqt xi xeni; għadni qed naħseb fihom.
colloquial.en: Nina: What was the film like? Toni: I felt horror during some scenes; I'm still thinking about them.
colloquial.zh: Nina：电影怎么样？Toni：有些场景让我感到恐怖，我现在还在想着那些画面。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien il-film?
messages.zh: 电影怎么样？
messages.en: What was the film like?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt tkexkix waqt xi xeni; għadni qed naħseb fihom.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt tkexkix waqt xi xeni; għadni qed naħseb fihom.
messages.zh: 有些场景让我感到恐怖，我现在还在想着那些画面。
messages.en: I felt horror during some scenes; I'm still thinking about them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 tkexkex 记“人吓得发抖”，用 tkexkix 记“那种恐怖感或颤抖本身”，成对区分动词与名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of working in a kitchen, such as preparing food and doing kitchen tasks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在厨房里准备食物、料理厨房事务等劳作活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li jsir fil-kċina, bħat-tħejjija tal-ikel u xogħlijiet oħra tal-kċina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在厨房工作或忙活；作为名词，指厨房劳作这一活动。

collocations.en: a day of working in the kitchen

formal.mt: It-tħejjija tal-ikla għall-mistednin kienet teħtieġ ħafna tkeċnir.
formal.en: Preparing the meal for the guests required a lot of kitchen work.
formal.zh: 为客人准备这顿饭需要做大量厨房工作。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Illum kelli ħafna tkeċnir. Pawlu: X'ħejjejt? Anna: Soppa, laħam u kejk għall-mistednin.
colloquial.en: Anna: I had a lot of kitchen work today. Pawlu: What did you prepare? Anna: Soup, meat and a cake for the guests.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我今天在厨房忙了很多活。Pawlu：你准备了什么？Anna：给客人准备了汤、肉和一个蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum kelli ħafna tkeċnir.
messages.mt_standard: Illum kelli ħafna tkeċnir.
messages.zh: 我今天在厨房忙了很多活。
messages.en: I had a lot of kitchen work today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ħejjejt?
messages.mt_standard: X'ħejjejt?
messages.zh: 你准备了什么？
messages.en: What did you prepare?

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Soppa, laħam u kejk għall-mistednin.
messages.mt_standard: Soppa, laħam u kejk għall-mistednin.
messages.zh: 给客人准备了汤、肉和一个蛋糕。
messages.en: Soup, meat and a cake for the guests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象为客人备餐，从准备食材到料理饭菜一直在厨房忙活；用这一整段活动记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 被罚下；被开除；被驱散；被赶走；被解雇；被裁员

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be required to leave a place, group, game or job, or to be driven away or dispelled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被要求离开某处、团体、比赛或工作岗位；也可指被赶走或被驱散。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jiġi mġiegħel jitlaq minn post, grupp, logħba jew impjieg, jew li xi ħaġa tiġi mwarrba jew imxerrda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在体育比赛中被罚下场。
被学校、组织等开除或逐出。
被驱散；被消除。
被赶走；被驱离。
被雇主解雇；被辞退。
因职位不再需要而被裁员。

formal.mt: Il-plejer tkeċċa mill-grawnd wara li rċieva t-tieni karta safra.
formal.en: The player was sent off the field after receiving a second yellow card.
formal.zh: 这名球员在领到第二张黄牌后被罚下场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tkeċċa l-plejer? Mark: Għax irċieva t-tieni karta safra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was the player sent off? Mark: Because he received a second yellow card.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个球员为什么被罚下？Mark：因为他领到了第二张黄牌。

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tkeċċa l-plejer?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tkeċċa l-plejer?
messages.zh: 那个球员为什么被罚下？
messages.en: Why was the player sent off?

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irċieva t-tieni karta safra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irċieva t-tieni karta safra.
messages.zh: 因为他领到了第二张黄牌。
messages.en: Because he received a second yellow card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住“被迫离开或被清除”的共同画面：球员离场、学生离校、员工离职；再按语境区分具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or event of expelling someone, dismissing someone from employment, or chasing someone away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人逐出或开除、解除其雇佣关系，或将其赶走的行为或事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-ġrajja li fiha xi ħadd jitneħħa minn grupp jew impjieg, jew jitkeċċa minn post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开除；逐出某个机构、团体或场所。
解雇；由雇主解除工作关系。
驱赶；把人或动物赶走的行为。

formal.mt: L-ittra ta' tkeċċija tispjega r-raġuni għat-tmiem tal-impjieg.
formal.en: The dismissal letter explains the reason for the termination of employment.
formal.zh: 解雇信说明了解除雇佣关系的原因。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Waslet l-ittra ta' tkeċċija? Lara: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Se naqraha sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has the dismissal letter arrived? Lara: Yes, it arrived this morning. I'll read it carefully.
colloquial.zh: Mark：解雇信到了吗？Lara：到了，今天早上到的。我会仔细读一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet l-ittra ta' tkeċċija?
messages.mt_standard: Waslet l-ittra ta' tkeċċija?
messages.zh: 解雇信到了吗？
messages.en: Has the dismissal letter arrived?

messages.speaker: Lara (员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Se naqraha sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Se naqraha sew.
messages.zh: 到了，今天早上到的。我会仔细读一下。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning. I'll read it carefully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“收到一封解雇信”的画面中，记住这是“解雇、开除、驱赶”这类行为或事件的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wriggle or twist the body while walking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时身体扭来扭去，呈现扭动的步态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexa b'ġismu jitgħawweġ u jitħarrek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行走时扭动身体；扭来扭去地走。

collocations.en: walked along the road with a wriggling gait

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, l-attur tkiewa minn naħa għall-oħra tal-palk.
formal.en: During the rehearsal, the actor walked from one side of the stage to the other with a wriggling gait.
formal.zh: 排练时，演员扭动着身体，从舞台一侧走到另一侧。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif mexa Toni fuq il-palk? Ġanni: Tkiewa waqt li kien miexi, u t-tfal daħku.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did Toni walk on the stage? Ġanni: He wriggled as he walked, and the children laughed.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Toni 在舞台上是怎么走的？Ġanni：他边走边扭动身体，孩子们都笑了。

messages.speaker: Marija (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mexa Toni fuq il-palk?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mexa Toni fuq il-palk?
messages.zh: Toni 在舞台上是怎么走的？
messages.en: How did Toni walk on the stage?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkiewa waqt li kien miexi, u t-tfal daħku.
messages.mt_standard: Tkiewa waqt li kien miexi, u t-tfal daħku.
messages.zh: 他边走边扭动身体，孩子们都笑了。
messages.en: He wriggled as he walked, and the children laughed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演员一边向前走、一边把身体扭来扭去，把 tkiewa 与这种行走动作绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be acquired or to be achieved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种知识、事物等被获得，或某项目标、成果得以实现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie akkwistat jew intlaħaq bħala riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被取得；被获得。
得以实现；被达成。

formal.mt: L-għarfien li tkisseb matul il-kors jista' jintuża fil-prattika.
formal.en: The knowledge acquired during the course can be used in practice.
formal.zh: 课程期间获得的知识可以运用于实践。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan is-suċċess tkisseb faċilment? David: Le, ħdimna ħafna għalih.
colloquial.en: Elena: Was this success achieved easily? David: No, we worked hard for it.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这次成功来得容易吗？David：不容易，我们为此付出了很多努力。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-suċċess tkisseb faċilment?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-suċċess tkisseb faċilment?
messages.zh: 这次成功来得容易吗？
messages.en: Was this success achieved easily?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħdimna ħafna għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħdimna ħafna għalih.
messages.zh: 不容易，我们为此付出了很多努力。
messages.en: No, we worked hard for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把知识证书和完成的目标并排想象：知识“被获得”，目标“被实现”，两者都可用 tkisseb 表达。

gloss_zh: 被打碎；接受高强度训练

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be broken, or, when referring to a person, to undergo intensive training.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体被打破或弄碎；用于人时，也可指接受高强度训练。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie miksur jew, meta jingħad dwar persuna, għadda minn taħriġ intensiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被打破；被弄碎。
接受高强度的训练。

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ tat-tieqa tkisser waqt il-maltemp.
formal.en: The window glass was broken during the storm.
formal.zh: 窗玻璃在暴风雨中破碎了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif mar it-taħriġ ta' Mark fil-kamp? Luqa: Tkisser fit-taħriġ; kull jum kellu sigħat twal ta' eżerċizzju.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did Mark's training at the camp go? Luqa: He underwent intensive training; every day he had long hours of exercise.
colloquial.zh: Rita：Mark 在营地的训练怎么样？Luqa：他接受了高强度训练，每天都要锻炼很长时间。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar it-taħriġ ta' Mark fil-kamp?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar it-taħriġ ta' Mark fil-kamp?
messages.zh: Mark 在营地的训练怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark's training at the camp go?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkisser fit-taħriġ; kull jum kellu sigħat twal ta' eżerċizzju.
messages.mt_standard: Tkisser fit-taħriġ; kull jum kellu sigħat twal ta' eżerċizzju.
messages.zh: 他接受了高强度训练，每天都要锻炼很长时间。
messages.en: He underwent intensive training; every day he had long hours of exercise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tkisser 配两张情境卡：一张是破碎玻璃，一张是密集训练日程；看到主语和语境再选择词义。

gloss_zh: 努力后的获得；通过努力取得

teaching_sense.en_definition: The acquisition of something as a result of effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过努力而获得某种事物、知识或成果的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-akkwist ta' xi ħaġa bħala riżultat ta' sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过努力而取得或获得某物。

collocations.en: the acquisition of knowledge through effort
the acquisition of skills through effort

formal.mt: It-tkissib tal-ħiliet meħtieġa jitlob studju u prattika regolari.
formal.en: Acquiring the necessary skills through effort requires study and regular practice.
formal.zh: 要通过努力掌握所需技能，就需要学习并定期练习。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif sejjer bit-tkissib tal-ħiliet għall-impjieg il-ġdid? Ben: Qed nipprattika kuljum, u issa qed insib ix-xogħol aktar faċli.
colloquial.en: Anna: How are you getting on with acquiring the skills for the new job? Ben: I'm practising every day, and I'm finding the work easier now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为新工作学习技能，进展怎么样？Ben：我每天都练习，现在觉得工作更容易上手了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer bit-tkissib tal-ħiliet għall-impjieg il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer bit-tkissib tal-ħiliet għall-impjieg il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 你为新工作学习技能，进展怎么样？
messages.en: How are you getting on with acquiring the skills for the new job?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nipprattika kuljum, u issa qed insib ix-xogħol aktar faċli.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nipprattika kuljum, u issa qed insib ix-xogħol aktar faċli.
messages.zh: 我每天都练习，现在觉得工作更容易上手了。
messages.en: I'm practising every day, and I'm finding the work easier now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从每天练习通向掌握技能的箭头，把 tkissib 记成“付出努力之后的获得”这一名词概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of breaking or smashing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体打破、弄碎或用力砸碎的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li tkisser xi ħaġa jew tfarrakha f'biċċiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打破或弄碎物体的行为或过程。
用力砸碎；把物体打得粉碎。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tkissir tal-ġebel, il-ħaddiema għandhom jilbsu nuċċali protettiv.
formal.en: During the breaking of stones, workers should wear protective goggles.
formal.zh: 破碎石块时，工人应佩戴护目镜。

colloquial.mt: Klara: X'kien dak il-ħoss qawwi? Pietru: Kien il-ħoss tat-tkissir tal-ħġieġ; waqa' flixkun fl-art.
colloquial.en: Klara: What was that loud noise? Pietru: It was the sound of glass breaking; a bottle fell on the floor.
colloquial.zh: Klara：刚才那声巨响是什么？Pietru：是玻璃破碎的声音，一个瓶子掉到地上了。

messages.speaker: Klara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak il-ħoss qawwi?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak il-ħoss qawwi?
messages.zh: 刚才那声巨响是什么？
messages.en: What was that loud noise?

messages.speaker: Pietru (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien il-ħoss tat-tkissir tal-ħġieġ; waqa' flixkun fl-art.
messages.mt_standard: Kien il-ħoss tat-tkissir tal-ħġieġ; waqa' flixkun fl-art.
messages.zh: 是玻璃破碎的声音，一个瓶子掉到地上了。
messages.en: It was the sound of glass breaking; a bottle fell on the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象瓶子落地后发出碎裂声，把 tkissir 与“打碎这一过程”相连；它是名词，可接“玻璃的、石块的”等对象。

gloss_zh: 穿着紧身衣服；在游戏中输掉钱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be dressed in tight clothes; also, to lose one's money in a game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿着紧贴身体的衣服；也可指在游戏或赌局中输掉自己的钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun liebes ħwejjeġ issikkati; jista' jfisser ukoll li jitlef flusu f'logħba.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be dressed in tight clothes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿着紧身或过紧的衣服。

sense_translations.en_definition: to lose one's money in a game
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在游戏或赌局中输掉自己的钱。

collocations.en: to be dressed in tight clothes
to lose one's money in a card game

formal.mt: Għar-ritratt, Pawlu tkittef b'ġakketta żgħira wisq u ma setax iċaqlaq dirgħajh sew.
formal.en: For the photograph, Pawlu wore a jacket that was far too tight and could not move his arms properly.
formal.zh: 为了拍照，保罗穿上了一件过紧的夹克，双臂都活动不便。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Pawlu waqaf jilgħab il-karti? Rita: Tkittef fl-aħħar logħba u m'għad baqagħlu ebda flus.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Pawlu stop playing cards? Rita: He lost his money in the last game and has none left.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗为什么不打牌了？丽塔：他上一局把钱输掉了，现在一点钱都没剩。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu waqaf jilgħab il-karti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu waqaf jilgħab il-karti?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不打牌了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop playing cards?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkittef fl-aħħar logħba u m'għad baqagħlu ebda flus.
messages.mt_standard: Tkittef fl-aħħar logħba u m'għad baqagħlu ebda flus.
messages.zh: 他上一局把钱输掉了，现在一点钱都没剩。
messages.en: He lost his money in the last game and has none left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情景卡分别记忆：一张画衣服紧得抬不起手，另一张画牌局结束后空空的钱包；两个义项分开练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a crop such as wheat to become thin or flimsy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指小麦等庄稼变得纤细、单薄或柔弱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal uċuħ tar-raba', bħall-qamħ, meta jsiru rqaq jew dgħajfa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become flimsy or thin (used of crops, such as wheat)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得细弱或单薄，用于小麦等庄稼。

collocations.en: the wheat became thin and weak
the barley became thin and weak

formal.mt: Il-bidwi nnota li l-qamħ tkitten u li z-zkuk tiegħu kienu rqaq u dgħajfa.
formal.en: The farmer noted that the wheat had become flimsy and that its stems were thin and weak.
formal.zh: 农民注意到小麦已经变得细弱，茎秆纤细而柔弱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu l-qamħ din is-sena? Toni: Tkitten; ara kemm huma rqaq iz-zkuk.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is the wheat this year? Toni: It has become flimsy; look how thin the stems are.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今年的小麦长得怎么样？托尼：变得细弱了，你看茎秆多细。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu l-qamħ din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu l-qamħ din is-sena?
messages.zh: 今年的小麦长得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the wheat this year?

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkitten; ara kemm huma rqaq iz-zkuk.
messages.mt_standard: Tkitten; ara kemm huma rqaq iz-zkuk.
messages.zh: 变得细弱了，你看茎秆多细。
messages.en: It has become flimsy; look how thin the stems are.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一株麦子从挺拔变成细细弱弱的样子，把这个词与“庄稼变细弱”的变化画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or practice of wearing clothing that fits very tightly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿着非常贴身、紧绷衣服的行为或穿衣方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ilbies ta' ħwejjeġ li jkunu ssikkati ħafna mal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿着非常紧身的衣服这一行为或状态。

collocations.en: to avoid wearing very tight clothes

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni dwar l-ilbies, l-għalliema ddiskutiet it-tkittif u l-għażla ta' ħwejjeġ li jippermettu moviment komdu.
formal.en: In the lesson on clothing, the teacher discussed wearing very tight clothes and choosing garments that allow comfortable movement.
formal.zh: 在服装课上，老师讨论了穿着过紧衣服的现象，以及如何选择便于舒适活动的衣服。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma tilbisx dak il-flokk? Nina: Ma nħobbx it-tkittif; nippreferi wieħed aktar wiesa'.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why don't you wear that top? Nina: I don't like wearing very tight clothes; I prefer a looser one.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么不穿那件上衣？妮娜：我不喜欢穿得紧绷绷的，我更喜欢宽松一点的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tilbisx dak il-flokk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tilbisx dak il-flokk?
messages.zh: 你为什么不穿那件上衣？
messages.en: Why don't you wear that top?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nħobbx it-tkittif; nippreferi wieħed aktar wiesa'.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nħobbx it-tkittif; nippreferi wieħed aktar wiesa'.
messages.zh: 我不喜欢穿得紧绷绷的，我更喜欢宽松一点的。
messages.en: I don't like wearing very tight clothes; I prefer a looser one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当作一个穿衣行为的名称来记：镜子前衣服紧贴身体，中文提示就是“穿得紧绷绷这件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sowing of hemp or flax seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 播撒大麻或亚麻种子的农事活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żrigħ tal-qanneb jew tal-kittien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大麻或亚麻的播种。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport agrikolu jiddeskrivi t-tħejjija tal-ħamrija u t-tkittin tal-kittien f'din l-għalqa.
formal.en: The agricultural report describes the preparation of the soil and the sowing of flax in this field.
formal.zh: 农业报告介绍了这块田地的土壤准备工作及亚麻播种活动。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se tagħmlu fl-għalqa llum? Ġużeppi: Illum għandna t-tkittin tal-kittien; iż-żerriegħa lesta.
colloquial.en: Marija: What are you going to do in the field today? Ġużeppi: Today we're sowing flax; the seeds are ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你们今天要在田里做什么？朱塞佩：今天要播种亚麻，种子已经准备好了。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se tagħmlu fl-għalqa llum?
messages.mt_standard: X'se tagħmlu fl-għalqa llum?
messages.zh: 你们今天要在田里做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do in the field today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandna t-tkittin tal-kittien; iż-żerriegħa lesta.
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandna t-tkittin tal-kittien; iż-żerriegħa lesta.
messages.zh: 今天要播种亚麻，种子已经准备好了。
messages.en: Today we're sowing flax; the seeds are ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两袋分别标着“大麻”和“亚麻”的种子，再画手把种子撒进田里；整幅图对应这个播种名词。

gloss_zh: 探询消息；寻求披露；窥探他人私事

teaching_sense.en_definition: To seek information or disclosure, sometimes by prying into other people's affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 探询信息或寻求事情的披露；也可指打听、窥探别人的私事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifittex tagħrif jew li jinkixfu affarijiet; jista' wkoll jindaħal fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor biex isir jafhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 探询信息，设法获得消息或资料。
寻求事情的披露或揭示，设法让尚未公开的内容显露出来。
窥探他人的事务，尤其是打听别人的私事。

collocations.en: to seek information about the case
to pry into other people's affairs

collocations.mt: tkixxef dwar dettalji li ma kinux pubbliċi
collocations.en: to seek disclosure of details that were not public
collocations.zh: 探询尚未公开的细节，寻求其披露

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur tkixxef dwar l-istorja tal-bini billi qara dokumenti qodma u tkellem mar-residenti.
formal.en: The researcher sought information about the building's history by reading old documents and speaking to residents.
formal.zh: 研究人员通过阅读旧文件和与居民交谈，探询这座建筑的历史。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark staqsa kemm taqla' flus? Rita: Tkixxef fl-affarijiet tiegħi, u għedtlu li dik ħaġa privata.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did Mark ask how much you earn? Rita: He was prying into my affairs, and I told him that was private.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克为什么问你挣多少钱？丽塔：他在打听我的私事，我告诉他那是隐私。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark staqsa kemm taqla' flus?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark staqsa kemm taqla' flus?
messages.zh: 马克为什么问你挣多少钱？
messages.en: Why did Mark ask how much you earn?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkixxef fl-affarijiet tiegħi, u għedtlu li dik ħaġa privata.
messages.mt_standard: Tkixxef fl-affarijiet tiegħi, u għedtlu li dik ħaġa privata.
messages.zh: 他在打听我的私事，我告诉他那是隐私。
messages.en: He was prying into my affairs, and I told him that was private.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“问消息—求披露—探私事”三个场景记忆：同样是想知道更多，是否涉及隐私要由上下文判断。

gloss_zh: 爱打听别人私事的；好窥探的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nosy: excessively interested in other people's private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人爱打听、窥探别人的私事，对他人的隐私过分好奇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jindaħal fl-affarijiet privati ta' ħaddieħor u jistaqsi dwarhom iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱打听别人私事的，好窥探的；用于形容爱管闲事的人。

collocations.zh: 一个爱打听别人私事的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar tkixxiefi jistaqsi kontinwament dwar il-ħajja privata tan-nies tat-triq.
formal.en: In the story, the nosy neighbour constantly asks about the private lives of the people on the street.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个爱打听私事的邻居不断询问街坊的私人生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ġar irid ikun jaf min jiġi għandek? Lara: Għax hu tkixxiefi wisq; dejjem jistaqsi dwar kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the neighbour want to know who visits you? Lara: Because he's far too nosy; he's always asking about everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：邻居为什么想知道谁来你家？拉拉：因为他太爱打听了，总是问这问那，打听每个人的事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ġar irid ikun jaf min jiġi għandek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ġar irid ikun jaf min jiġi għandek?
messages.zh: 邻居为什么想知道谁来你家？
messages.en: Why does the neighbour want to know who visits you?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu tkixxiefi wisq; dejjem jistaqsi dwar kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu tkixxiefi wisq; dejjem jistaqsi dwar kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他太爱打听了，总是问这问那，打听每个人的事。
messages.en: Because he's far too nosy; he's always asking about everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个邻居总把耳朵凑过来问私事，用“这个人很爱打听”整句记住它的形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The investigation of a matter or the act of prying into other people's affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了解情况而进行的调查；也可指窥探、打听他人私事的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiftix ta' tagħrif dwar xi ħaġa; jista' wkoll ikun indħil fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor biex wieħed isir jafhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 调查，探查事情的情况或事实。
窥探，打听或探查别人的私事。

formal.mt: It-tkixxif tal-fatti kien jinkludi qari tad-dokumenti u intervisti ma' persuni li kienu preżenti.
formal.en: The investigation of the facts included reading documents and interviewing people who had been present.
formal.zh: 对事实的调查包括查阅文件，以及访谈当时在场的人。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma weġibtx il-mistoqsijiet tiegħu? Nina: Għax dak kien tkixxif fl-affarijiet privati tiegħi, u ma ridtx nitkellem.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why didn't you answer his questions? Nina: Because that was prying into my private affairs, and I didn't want to talk.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么没有回答他的问题？妮娜：因为那是在窥探我的私事，我不想谈。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma weġibtx il-mistoqsijiet tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma weġibtx il-mistoqsijiet tiegħu?
messages.zh: 你为什么没有回答他的问题？
messages.en: Why didn't you answer his questions?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dak kien tkixxif fl-affarijiet privati tiegħi, u ma ridtx nitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dak kien tkixxif fl-affarijiet privati tiegħi, u ma ridtx nitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为那是在窥探我的私事，我不想谈。
messages.en: Because that was prying into my private affairs, and I didn't want to talk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“调查事实”和“窥探隐私”各写在一张卡上，再把本词放在中间；记住它是行为名称，语气随语境变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The continuation of an activity, process, or story beyond an earlier point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项活动、过程或故事在原有基础上的继续或延续，也可指后续部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li attività, proċess jew storja jkomplu; ukoll il-parti li tiġi wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继续，延续；活动、过程或叙述的后续部分。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva t-tkomplija tax-xogħol wara li eżamina r-rapport dwar l-ewwel fażi tal-proġett.
formal.en: The committee approved the continuation of the work after examining the report on the project's first phase.
formal.zh: 委员会审阅项目第一阶段的报告后，批准继续开展工作。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Fejn nista' naqra t-tkomplija tal-istorja? Sara: Fil-ktieb li jmiss; għandi kopja u nista' nsellifhielek.
colloquial.en: Luca: Where can I read the continuation of the story? Sara: In the next book; I have a copy and can lend it to you.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我在哪里可以读到故事的后续？萨拉：在下一本书里，我有一本，可以借给你。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' naqra t-tkomplija tal-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' naqra t-tkomplija tal-istorja?
messages.zh: 我在哪里可以读到故事的后续？
messages.en: Where can I read the continuation of the story?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-ktieb li jmiss; għandi kopja u nista' nsellifhielek.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-ktieb li jmiss; għandi kopja u nista' nsellifhielek.
messages.zh: 在下一本书里，我有一本，可以借给你。
messages.en: In the next book; I have a copy and can lend it to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书页底部写着“未完待续”，翻到下一页故事接着展开；再联想到工作接着做，记住“延续、后续”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered, or to be included and accounted for in a calculation or record.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被某物盖住；也指某项金额或事项已被计入并得到交代。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mgħotti b'xi ħaġa, jew li jkun inkluż u meqjus f'kalkolu jew f'reġistru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被盖住；被覆盖。
被计入；在账目或记录中得到交代。

collocations.en: to be covered with a lid
to be accounted for in the accounts

formal.mt: Il-bir tkopra b'għatu biex ma jaqa' ħadd fih.
formal.en: The well was covered with a lid to prevent anyone from falling into it.
formal.zh: 水井加上了盖子，以免有人掉进去。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għad fadal xi ammont nieqes mill-kontijiet? Pawlu: Le, l-ammont kollu tkopra fil-kontijiet.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is any amount still missing from the accounts? Pawlu: No, the whole amount has been accounted for.
colloquial.zh: Marta：账目里还有金额没计入吗？Pawlu：没有，全部金额都已计入账目。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal xi ammont nieqes mill-kontijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal xi ammont nieqes mill-kontijiet?
messages.zh: 账目里还有金额没计入吗？
messages.en: Is any amount still missing from the accounts?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-ammont kollu tkopra fil-kontijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-ammont kollu tkopra fil-kontijiet.
messages.zh: 没有，全部金额都已计入账目。
messages.en: No, the whole amount has been accounted for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两幅画面并排记：井口被盖住，金额被记进账；前者是实物受到覆盖，后者是事项得到交代。

gloss_zh: 费用保障；开支的资金支持

teaching_sense.en_definition: Financial provision or cover that makes funds available to meet expenses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为支付某些开支而提供的资金保障或费用支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Provvediment finanzjarju li jiżgura li jkun hemm flus biex jitħallsu l-ispejjeż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于支付开支的资金保障；费用的财务支持。

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni se tipprovdi tkoprija għall-ispejjeż tal-ivvjaġġar tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The organization will provide financial cover for the participants' travel expenses.
formal.zh: 主办机构将为参与者的差旅开支提供资金支持。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Irrid inħallas il-vjaġġ jien? Mark: Le, hemm tkoprija għall-ispejjeż tal-ivvjaġġar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do I have to pay for the trip myself? Mark: No, there is financial cover for the travel expenses.
colloquial.zh: Lara：旅费要我自己付吗？Mark：不用，差旅开支有资金保障。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid inħallas il-vjaġġ jien?
messages.mt_standard: Irrid inħallas il-vjaġġ jien?
messages.zh: 旅费要我自己付吗？
messages.en: Do I have to pay for the trip myself?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hemm tkoprija għall-ispejjeż tal-ivvjaġġar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hemm tkoprija għall-ispejjeż tal-ivvjaġġar.
messages.zh: 不用，差旅开支有资金保障。
messages.en: No, there is financial cover for the travel expenses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象差旅账单下面放着一笔已备好的经费：看到这个词，就记起开支背后有资金保障。

gloss_zh: 牌局中的报分；宣告点数

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of declaring points during a card game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纸牌游戏中，玩家宣告自己点数或分数的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dikjarazzjoni tal-punti minn plejer waqt logħba tal-karti.

sense_translations.en_definition: declaration of points in a game of cards
sense_translations.zh_definition: 纸牌游戏中的点数宣告；牌局报分。

collocations.en: to make the declaration of points

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba tal-karti, il-plejer għamel it-tkużija tal-punti b'vuċi ċara.
formal.en: During the card game, the player declared the points in a clear voice.
formal.zh: 在牌局中，这位玩家清楚地报出了点数。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għamilt it-tkużija? Toni: Iva, imma nerġa' ngħid il-punti biex tismagħhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you declared your points? Toni: Yes, but I'll say the points again so you can hear them.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你报过分了吗？Toni：报过了，不过我再报一遍，让你听清楚。

messages.speaker: Nina (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt it-tkużija?
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt it-tkużija?
messages.zh: 你报过分了吗？
messages.en: Have you declared your points?

messages.speaker: Toni (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nerġa' ngħid il-punti biex tismagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nerġa' ngħid il-punti biex tismagħhom.
messages.zh: 报过了，不过我再报一遍，让你听清楚。
messages.en: Yes, but I'll say the points again so you can hear them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把场景固定在牌桌边：玩家开口报出点数。记住它指报分这个动作，不是手里的纸牌。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be fastened or held in place with a pin or pins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被一枚或多枚别针固定在某个位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imwaħħal jew miżmum f'postu b'labra jew b'labar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被别针别住；被用针固定。

collocations.en: to be pinned to the jacket
to be fastened with a safety pin

formal.mt: In-numru tal-parteċipant tlabbar mal-ġakketta b'labra tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: The participant's number was pinned to the jacket with a safety pin.
formal.zh: 参与者的号码用安全别针固定在了夹克上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu n-numru tiegħi? Ben: Tlabbar mal-ġakketta tiegħek; ara fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is my number? Ben: It was pinned to your jacket; look on the left.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的号码在哪里？Ben：别在你的夹克上了，看左边。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu n-numru tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu n-numru tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我的号码在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my number?

messages.speaker: Ben (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlabbar mal-ġakketta tiegħek; ara fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Tlabbar mal-ġakketta tiegħek; ara fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 别在你的夹克上了，看左边。
messages.en: It was pinned to your jacket; look on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象号码牌已经被别在衣服上：学习时把注意力放在被针固定的物品上，就能记住这个被动意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of fastening something with pins, or of piercing something with pins or needles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用别针固定物品的动作；也指用别针或针刺穿某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li twaħħal xi ħaġa bil-labar, jew li ttaqqab xi ħaġa bil-labar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用别针固定；别住物品的动作。
用别针或针刺穿；针刺的动作。

formal.mt: It-tlabbir tad-drapp qabel il-ħjata jgħin biex il-biċċiet jibqgħu f'posthom.
formal.en: Pinning the fabric before sewing helps keep the pieces in place.
formal.zh: 缝纫前用针固定布料，有助于让各块布保持在适当的位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tuża daqshekk labar? Rita: Għat-tlabbir tad-drapp, biex il-biċċiet ma jiċċaqalqux waqt li nħit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you using so many pins? Rita: For pinning the fabric, so the pieces don't move while I sew.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么用这么多别针？Rita：用来固定布料，免得我缝的时候布块移动。

messages.speaker: Sara (缝纫学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tuża daqshekk labar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tuża daqshekk labar?
messages.zh: 你为什么用这么多别针？
messages.en: Why are you using so many pins?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tlabbir tad-drapp, biex il-biċċiet ma jiċċaqalqux waqt li nħit.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tlabbir tad-drapp, biex il-biċċiet ma jiċċaqalqux waqt li nħit.
messages.zh: 用来固定布料，免得我缝的时候布块移动。
messages.en: For pinning the fabric, so the pieces don't move while I sew.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一枚针记两个动作：把两块布别在一起是固定，针尖穿过材料是刺穿；这个名词可以指这两类动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Casual, often continuous talking, including conversation about everyday or unimportant matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随意而有时持续不断的说话声或交谈，也指围绕日常小事展开的闲聊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit ħafif, xi drabi bla waqfien, dwar affarijiet ta' kuljum jew ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叽叽喳喳的交谈；连续不断的闲谈。
闲聊；围绕轻松日常话题的寒暄。

collocations.en: a little small talk among friends

formal.mt: Qabel ma bdiet il-laqgħa, kien hemm ftit tlablib bejn il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: Before the meeting began, there was a little small talk among the participants.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，参与者之间闲聊了一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fuq xiex kontu qed titkellmu? Marija: Xejn speċjali, ftit tlablib dwar it-temp u l-vaganzi.
colloquial.en: Lina: What were you talking about? Marija: Nothing special, just a little small talk about the weather and holidays.
colloquial.zh: Lina：你们刚才在聊什么？Marija：没什么特别的，就是聊聊天气和假期。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex kontu qed titkellmu?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex kontu qed titkellmu?
messages.zh: 你们刚才在聊什么？
messages.en: What were you talking about?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xejn speċjali, ftit tlablib dwar it-temp u l-vaganzi.
messages.mt_standard: Xejn speċjali, ftit tlablib dwar it-temp u l-vaganzi.
messages.zh: 没什么特别的，就是聊聊天气和假期。
messages.en: Nothing special, just a little small talk about the weather and holidays.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友见面从天气聊到假期：轻轻松松是闲聊，接连不断就像叽叽喳喳；用谈话场景串起两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short prayer; the diminutive form of talba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一段简短的祈祷或小祷文，是 talba 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba qasira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' talba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简短的祈祷或小祷文，为 talba 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet il-laqgħa, il-parteċipanti qalu tlajba għall-paċi.
formal.en: Before the meeting began, the participants said a short prayer for peace.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，参与者为和平作了一个简短的祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Nistgħu ngħidu tlajba qabel norqdu? Marija: Iva, ejja nirringrazzjaw għal din il-ġurnata.
colloquial.en: Luca: Can we say a short prayer before we go to sleep? Marija: Yes, let's give thanks for this day.
colloquial.zh: Luca：我们睡前可以作一个简短的祈祷吗？Marija：可以，让我们为今天献上感谢。

messages.speaker: Luca (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu ngħidu tlajba qabel norqdu?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu ngħidu tlajba qabel norqdu?
messages.zh: 我们睡前可以作一个简短的祈祷吗？
messages.en: Can we say a short prayer before we go to sleep?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nirringrazzjaw għal din il-ġurnata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nirringrazzjaw għal din il-ġurnata.
messages.zh: 可以，让我们为今天献上感谢。
messages.en: Yes, let's give thanks for this day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 talba“祈祷”和它的指小形式 tlajba 成对记忆：想象睡前只说几句话的一小段祈祷。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make oneself move or act more slowly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使自己的行动或做事速度慢下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-ħeffa tal-moviment jew tal-ħidma tiegħu stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放慢自己的动作、步伐或做事速度。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant tlajjem waqt il-mixi sabiex il-bqija tal-grupp setgħu jibqgħu miegħu.
formal.en: The participant slowed himself down while walking so that the rest of the group could keep up with him.
formal.zh: 这名参与者在行走时放慢了脚步，让队伍中的其他人能够跟上。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tlajjem ftit, għax ma nistax inżomm il-pass miegħek. Mark: Sewwa, nimxi aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Rita: Slow down a little, because I can't keep up with you. Mark: All right, I'll walk more slowly.
colloquial.zh: Rita：走慢一点，我跟不上你。Mark：好，我走慢些。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlajjem ftit, għax ma nistax inżomm il-pass miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Tlajjem ftit, għax ma nistax inżomm il-pass miegħek.
messages.zh: 走慢一点，我跟不上你。
messages.en: Slow down a little, because I can't keep up with you.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, nimxi aktar bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, nimxi aktar bil-mod.
messages.zh: 好，我走慢些。
messages.en: All right, I'll walk more slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 tlajjem 时想象朋友在身后喊“慢一点”，自己随即放慢脚步；重点记住是让自己慢下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Heavy rainfall, especially rain falling in a strong downpour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雨势很大的降雨，尤其指倾盆而下的大雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xita qawwija li tinżel b'abbundanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大雨；雨量大、雨势强的降雨。
倾盆大雨；猛烈而集中的一场降雨。

formal.mt: It-tlanġis qawwi matul il-lejl ħalla diversi toroq mgħarrqa u fixkel it-traffiku ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The heavy downpour during the night left several roads flooded and disrupted the morning traffic.
formal.zh: 夜间的倾盆大雨使多条道路积水，并扰乱了早晨的交通。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tlanġis! Lanqas bl-umbrella ma nibqgħu nexfin. Rita: Ejja nistennew hawn taħt is-saqaf sakemm tnaqqas ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: What a downpour! We won't stay dry even with an umbrella. Rita: Let's wait here under the roof until the rain eases.
colloquial.zh: Maja：雨下得真大！撑伞也保不住身上干爽。Rita：我们先在屋檐下等雨小一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tlanġis! Lanqas bl-umbrella ma nibqgħu nexfin.
messages.mt_standard: X'tlanġis! Lanqas bl-umbrella ma nibqgħu nexfin.
messages.zh: 雨下得真大！撑伞也保不住身上干爽。
messages.en: What a downpour! We won't stay dry even with an umbrella.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nistennew hawn taħt is-saqaf sakemm tnaqqas ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nistennew hawn taħt is-saqaf sakemm tnaqqas ix-xita.
messages.zh: 我们先在屋檐下等雨小一点吧。
messages.en: Let's wait here under the roof until the rain eases.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlanġis 和“雨水像整桶倒下，撑伞也难保持干爽”的画面绑定，用强烈雨势记住“大雨、倾盆大雨”。

gloss_zh: 变得毛发硬竖；变得扎手

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered with stiff, short hairs or develop a bristly texture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长出短而硬的毛，或变得毛发硬竖、摸起来扎手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikseb xagħar qasir u iebes jew isir aħrax minħabba xagħar bħal dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得生有短硬毛，呈现毛发硬竖、扎手的状态。

collocations.mt: tlanżat wara ftit jiem bla tqaxxir
collocations.en: became bristly after a few days without shaving
collocations.zh: 几天没剃须后变得胡茬扎手

formal.mt: Wara ftit jiem bla tqaxxir, il-geddum tar-raġel tlanżat u sar aħrax mal-mess.
formal.en: After a few days without shaving, the man's chin became bristly and felt rough to the touch.
formal.zh: 几天没有剃须后，男子的下巴长出了硬胡茬，摸起来粗糙扎手。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-geddum tiegħek tlanżat! Mark: Iva, ilni ftit jiem ma nqaxxar il-leħja.
colloquial.en: Rita: Your chin has become bristly! Mark: Yes, I haven't shaved for a few days.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你的下巴都长出扎手的胡茬了！Mark：是啊，我好几天没剃须了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-geddum tiegħek tlanżat!
messages.mt_standard: Il-geddum tiegħek tlanżat!
messages.zh: 你的下巴都长出扎手的胡茬了！
messages.en: Your chin has become bristly!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilni ftit jiem ma nqaxxar il-leħja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilni ftit jiem ma nqaxxar il-leħja.
messages.zh: 是啊，我好几天没剃须了。
messages.en: Yes, I haven't shaved for a few days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手掌摸过几天没剃的下巴，感觉短硬胡茬扎手；用这个状态变化记住动词 tlanżat。

gloss_zh: 短硬毛的生长；胡茬长出

teaching_sense.en_definition: The growth of short, stiff hairs, such as bristles or facial stubble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短而硬的毛逐渐长出的过程，例如硬毛或胡茬的生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkabbir ta' xagħar qasir u iebes, bħal dak li joħroġ fuq il-geddum wara t-tqaxxir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短硬毛的生长；硬毛或胡茬的长出。

collocations.en: the growth of stubble on the chin
the growth of bristles after shaving

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tiegħu, l-awtur semma t-tlanżit fuq il-geddum bħala dettall tad-dehra tal-karattru.
formal.en: In his description, the author mentioned the growth of stubble on the chin as a detail of the character's appearance.
formal.zh: 作者在描写中提到下巴上胡茬的生长，将其作为人物外貌的一个细节。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Diġà qed ninnota t-tlanżit fuq il-geddum. Rita: Iva, inħoss ix-xagħar qasir u iebes meta mmissek.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm already noticing stubble growing on my chin. Rita: Yes, I can feel the short, stiff hairs when I touch you.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我已经发现下巴开始长胡茬了。Rita：是的，碰你的时候能感觉到那些短硬的毛。

messages.speaker: Mark (伴侣)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà qed ninnota t-tlanżit fuq il-geddum.
messages.mt_standard: Diġà qed ninnota t-tlanżit fuq il-geddum.
messages.zh: 我已经发现下巴开始长胡茬了。
messages.en: I'm already noticing stubble growing on my chin.

messages.speaker: Rita (伴侣)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inħoss ix-xagħar qasir u iebes meta mmissek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inħoss ix-xagħar qasir u iebes meta mmissek.
messages.zh: 是的，碰你的时候能感觉到那些短硬的毛。
messages.en: Yes, I can feel the short, stiff hairs when I touch you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlanżit 记成一个过程名词：原本光滑的下巴逐渐冒出短硬胡茬；和 tlanżat“变得扎手”的动作意义对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Speech marked by interruptions, repetitions or difficulty getting words out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时出现停顿、重复或难以顺畅说出词语的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit b'interruzzjonijiet, ripetizzjonijiet jew diffikultà biex joħroġ il-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口吃；说话时出现不自主的停顿、重复或发音困难。
结巴；言语流畅性受到重复、拖长或卡顿影响的现象。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ta lill-istudent ħin biżżejjed biex iwieġeb, għax it-tlaqliq ma jnaqqasx il-valur tal-ideat tiegħu.
formal.en: The teacher gave the student enough time to answer, because stuttering does not diminish the value of his ideas.
formal.zh: 老师给了这名学生充分的回答时间，因为口吃并不降低他所表达观点的价值。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kultant għandi ftit tlaqliq meta nitkellem. Lara: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek, qed nisimgħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Sometimes I stammer a little when I speak. Lara: Take your time; I'm listening.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我说话时有时会有一点口吃。Lara：慢慢说，我在听。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kultant għandi ftit tlaqliq meta nitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Kultant għandi ftit tlaqliq meta nitkellem.
messages.zh: 我说话时有时会有一点口吃。
messages.en: Sometimes I stammer a little when I speak.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek, qed nisimgħek.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek, qed nisimgħek.
messages.zh: 慢慢说，我在听。
messages.en: Take your time; I'm listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlaqliq 与“说话过程中反复卡顿”的整体画面相连，记住它表示口吃现象；可与表示一次结巴的 tlaqliqa 对照。

gloss_zh: 一次结巴；一句结结巴巴的话

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single instance of stammering or an utterance spoken with a stammer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次说话结巴的情况，或一句结结巴巴说出的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Każ wieħed ta' tlaqliq jew kelma jew frażi li tingħad bi tlaqliq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a stammer, stutter, an instance of stammering, a stuttered utterance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次结巴、一次口吃，或结结巴巴说出的一句话。

collocations.en: a stammer at the beginning of the sentence

formal.mt: Wara tlaqliqa żgħira fil-bidu tad-diskors, il-kelliem kompla jippreżenta l-ideat tiegħu b'mod ċar.
formal.en: After a slight stammer at the beginning of the speech, the speaker continued presenting his ideas clearly.
formal.zh: 演讲者开头轻微结巴了一下，随后继续清楚地阐述自己的观点。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kelli tlaqliqa meta għedt ismi. Nina: Smajtek sew. Kompli bil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: I stammered when I said my name. Nina: I heard you clearly. Take your time and carry on.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我说自己名字时结巴了一下。Nina：我听清楚了，慢慢接着说。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli tlaqliqa meta għedt ismi.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli tlaqliqa meta għedt ismi.
messages.zh: 我说自己名字时结巴了一下。
messages.en: I stammered when I said my name.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajtek sew. Kompli bil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Smajtek sew. Kompli bil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 我听清楚了，慢慢接着说。
messages.en: I heard you clearly. Take your time and carry on.
