cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlaqliqa 记成对话中“结巴了一下”的一个小片段；与表示整体口吃现象的 tlaqliq 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation used to urge a group to start moving or begin an activity: let's go!
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 催促大家动身或开始活动时使用的感叹语，相当于“走吧！”或“出发吧！”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tħeġġeġ lil grupp jitlaq jew jibda attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 走吧！出发吧！（字面意思是“我们已经出发了！”）

formal.mt: Qabel il-bidu tal-mixja, il-gwida indirizzat lill-parteċipanti: "Kulħadd lest? Tlaqna!"
formal.en: Before the walk began, the guide addressed the participants: "Is everyone ready? Let's go!"
formal.zh: 步行活动开始前，向导对参与者说：“大家准备好了吗？出发吧！”

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lest? Ix-xarabank dalwaqt tasal. Ben: Iva, għandi kollox. Tlaqna!
colloquial.en: Sara: Ready? The bus will be here soon. Ben: Yes, I've got everything. Let's go!
colloquial.zh: Sara：准备好了吗？公交车快到了。Ben：好了，东西都带齐了。走吧！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lest? Ix-xarabank dalwaqt tasal.
messages.mt_standard: Lest? Ix-xarabank dalwaqt tasal.
messages.zh: 准备好了吗？公交车快到了。
messages.en: Ready? The bus will be here soon.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi kollox. Tlaqna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi kollox. Tlaqna!
messages.zh: 好了，东西都带齐了。走吧！
messages.en: Yes, I've got everything. Let's go!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友们背好包、站在门口，一声 tlaqna 就集体出发；作为整句口令记成“走吧！”。

gloss_zh: 被介绍认识；被安排见面；汇合

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be introduced or brought together to meet, or to come together at a common point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被介绍给某人、被安排与人见面，或向同一点汇合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi introdott lil xi ħadd jew jitwassal biex jiltaqa' ma' oħrajn, jew jinġabar f'punt wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被介绍给某人；经人介绍而与某人认识。
被安排或促成与人见面。
汇合；从不同方向聚到同一点。

collocations.en: was brought to meet the director

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara uffiċjali, ir-riċerkatur tlaqqa' mad-direttur biex jiddiskutu l-proġett.
formal.en: During the official visit, the researcher was brought to meet the director to discuss the project.
formal.zh: 正式访问期间，这位研究人员被安排与主管见面，讨论该项目。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark tlaqqa' mal-kollegi l-ġodda? Pawlu: Iva, dalgħodu. Diġà jaf isimhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was Mark introduced to the new colleagues? Pawlu: Yes, this morning. He already knows their names.
colloquial.zh: Lara：有人把 Mark 介绍给新同事们了吗？Pawlu：介绍了，今天早上。他已经知道他们的名字了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark tlaqqa' mal-kollegi l-ġodda?
messages.mt_standard: Mark tlaqqa' mal-kollegi l-ġodda?
messages.zh: 有人把 Mark 介绍给新同事们了吗？
messages.en: Was Mark introduced to the new colleagues?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dalgħodu. Diġà jaf isimhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dalgħodu. Diġà jaf isimhom.
messages.zh: 介绍了，今天早上。他已经知道他们的名字了。
messages.en: Yes, this morning. He already knows their names.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“两个人经安排走到一起”的画面记 tlaqqa'：人际场景是被介绍或被安排见面，空间场景则是汇合。

gloss_zh: 被嫁接；接种疫苗；得了绰号

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be grafted, receive a vaccination, or acquire a nickname, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境表示植物被嫁接、人或动物接种疫苗，或某人得了一个绰号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi tilqima bħala pjanta, persuna jew annimal, jew jingħata laqam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被嫁接；植物接受嫁接处理。
接种疫苗；接受预防接种。
得了一个绰号；因特点或行为而被人起外号。

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru tal-ġnien, il-larinġ tlaqqam fir-rebbiegħa u mbagħad kompla jikber.
formal.en: According to the garden record, the orange tree was grafted in spring and then continued to grow.
formal.zh: 根据园圃记录，这棵橙树在春季接受了嫁接，随后继续生长。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħuk għaliex tlaqqam "il-Professur"? Mark: Għax dejjem qed jispjega xi ħaġa!
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did your brother earn the nickname "the Professor"? Mark: Because he's always explaining something!
colloquial.zh: Nina：你哥哥为什么得了“教授”这个绰号？Mark：因为他总是在解释各种事情！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk għaliex tlaqqam "il-Professur"?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk għaliex tlaqqam "il-Professur"?
messages.zh: 你哥哥为什么得了“教授”这个绰号？
messages.en: Why did your brother earn the nickname "the Professor"?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem qed jispjega xi ħaġa!
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem qed jispjega xi ħaġa!
messages.zh: 因为他总是在解释各种事情！
messages.en: Because he's always explaining something!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tlaqqam 配三张情景卡：树枝嫁接、接种疫苗、朋友起绰号。用句子的主语和搭配选择词义，不把三义混为一谈。

gloss_zh: 被搜集得一干二净；被拾取；被粗劣地拼制

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be collected down to the last scrap, gathered as leftovers, or put together poorly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被一点不剩地搜集起来、作为剩余物被拾取，或被粗劣地拼凑制作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġabar sal-aħħar biċċa, jinġabar minn dak li jkun fadal, jew jinħadem b'mod fqir.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be collected down to the last scrap
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被搜集得一干二净，连最后一点碎屑也不留下。
被拾取或收集，尤其指收获后剩下的谷物等零星残余。
被粗劣地制作；被随便拼凑出来。

collocations.en: was collected down to the last piece
collocations.zh: 被收集得连最后一块都不剩

formal.mt: Wara l-ħsad, il-qamħ li kien fadal fl-għalqa tlaqqat bir-reqqa.
formal.en: After the harvest, the grain remaining in the field was carefully gleaned.
formal.zh: 收获结束后，田里剩下的谷物被仔细拾取起来。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Dan ix-xogħol tlaqqat; ara kemm hemm żbalji. Sara: Veru, irridu nirranġawh qabel ngħadduh.
colloquial.en: Ben: This work was poorly put together; look how many mistakes there are. Sara: You're right; we need to fix it before handing it in.
colloquial.zh: Ben：这份作业做得很粗糙，你看有多少错误。Sara：确实，我们得改好再交。

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ix-xogħol tlaqqat; ara kemm hemm żbalji.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ix-xogħol tlaqqat; ara kemm hemm żbalji.
messages.zh: 这份作业做得很粗糙，你看有多少错误。
messages.en: This work was poorly put together; look how many mistakes there are.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, irridu nirranġawh qabel ngħadduh.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, irridu nirranġawh qabel ngħadduh.
messages.zh: 确实，我们得改好再交。
messages.en: You're right; we need to fix it before handing it in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlaqqat 放进两个画面：田间余粮被一点点拾起，作业被草草拼成。前者帮助记“搜集、拾取”，后者记“制作粗劣”。

gloss_zh: 被削成楔形；被削去碎片

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be shaped into a wedge or have small pieces chipped off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被加工成楔形，或表面被削、凿去小块材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata forma ta' feles jew jitneħħew minnu biċċiet żgħar bit-tqattigħ jew bid-daqqiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加工成楔形；被削成一端较薄的形状。
被削去或凿去小块；出现小块材料脱落的缺口。

formal.mt: It-tarf tal-injam tlaqqax f'forma ta' feles biex jidħol fl-ispazju dejjaq.
formal.en: The end of the wood was shaped into a wedge so that it would fit into the narrow gap.
formal.zh: 木料的一端被削成楔形，以便插入狭窄的缝隙。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: It-tarf tal-injam tlaqqax biżżejjed? Maja: Iva, issa jidħol fil-vojt.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Has the end of the wood been chipped down enough? Maja: Yes, it fits into the gap now.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：木头这一端削得够了吗？Maja：够了，现在能放进缝隙了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tarf tal-injam tlaqqax biżżejjed?
messages.mt_standard: It-tarf tal-injam tlaqqax biżżejjed?
messages.zh: 木头这一端削得够了吗？
messages.en: Has the end of the wood been chipped down enough?

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jidħol fil-vojt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jidħol fil-vojt.
messages.zh: 够了，现在能放进缝隙了。
messages.en: Yes, it fits into the gap now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木料边缘被一点点削掉，最后形成能塞进门缝的楔子；用这个加工画面同时记住“被削去小块”和“被削成楔形”。

gloss_zh: 促成会面；把人或事物连接起来

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of arranging for people to meet or connecting people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安排并促成人们会面的行为，或把人、事物连接起来的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġġib lin-nies biex jiltaqgħu jew li tgħaqqad persuni jew affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促成会面；安排人们见面。
把人或事物连接、联系或聚合起来。

collocations.zh: 把不同的想法联系起来

formal.mt: L-għan tal-programm huwa t-tlaqqigħ ta' studenti ma' professjonisti biex jaqsmu l-għarfien u l-esperjenzi.
formal.en: The aim of the programme is to bring students together with professionals to share knowledge and experiences.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在促成学生与专业人士会面，分享知识和经验。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tlaqqigħ tal-ġirien il-ġodda? Mark: Jien. Nistedinhom għal kafè s-Sibt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who will arrange for the new neighbours to meet? Mark: I will. I'll invite them for coffee on Saturday.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁来安排新邻居们见面认识一下？Mark：我来。我会邀请他们星期六喝咖啡。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tlaqqigħ tal-ġirien il-ġodda?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tlaqqigħ tal-ġirien il-ġodda?
messages.zh: 谁来安排新邻居们见面认识一下？
messages.en: Who will arrange for the new neighbours to meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Nistedinhom għal kafè s-Sibt.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Nistedinhom għal kafè s-Sibt.
messages.zh: 我来。我会邀请他们星期六喝咖啡。
messages.en: I will. I'll invite them for coffee on Saturday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象活动组织者把原本互不认识的人请到同一张桌边；tlaqqigħ 表示“促成相遇、建立连接”这件事，也可用于连接想法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of being vaccinated or, for a plant, being grafted; also the act of giving nicknames.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受疫苗接种的过程，也可指植物接受嫁接，或给人起绰号的行为；具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li persuna tirċievi tilqima jew li pjanta tiġi mlaqqma; ukoll l-għoti ta' laqmijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物接受嫁接的过程。
接受疫苗接种的过程。
给人起绰号或昵称的行为。

formal.mt: L-avviż jagħti d-data u l-post tat-tlaqqim tat-tfal.
formal.en: The notice gives the date and location of the children's vaccination.
formal.zh: 通知列明了儿童接种疫苗的日期和地点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-fuljett jitkellem fuq it-tlaqqim tat-tfal? Pawlu: Le, hawn jitkellem fuq it-tlaqqim tas-siġar fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this leaflet about vaccinating children? Pawlu: No, here it is about grafting trees in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张宣传单讲的是儿童接种疫苗吗？保罗：不是，这里讲的是花园里的树木嫁接。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-fuljett jitkellem fuq it-tlaqqim tat-tfal?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-fuljett jitkellem fuq it-tlaqqim tat-tfal?
messages.zh: 这张宣传单讲的是儿童接种疫苗吗？
messages.en: Is this leaflet about vaccinating children?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn jitkellem fuq it-tlaqqim tas-siġar fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn jitkellem fuq it-tlaqqim tas-siġar fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 不是，这里讲的是花园里的树木嫁接。
messages.en: No, here it is about grafting trees in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张情境卡记忆：诊所对应接种，果园对应嫁接，朋友间称呼对应起绰号；这是辨义提示，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 零星挑取；拾穗；收集碎料

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of picking at things or gathering small leftovers, including gleaning crops and collecting scraps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一点一点地挑取东西或收集剩余零碎的行为，包括拾取收割后遗留的谷穗和收集碎料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiġbor jew jaqbad affarijiet ftit ftit, inkluż ġbir ta' fdalijiet tal-ħsad jew ta' biċċiet żgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of picking at things
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对东西进行零星挑取、拨弄或一点点取下的行为。
拾穗；拾取收割后留在田间的谷穗或其他作物。
收集零碎材料、边角料或残余物。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħsad, it-tlaqqit tas-sbul li baqa' fl-għalqa sar bl-idejn.
formal.en: After the harvest, the ears of grain left in the field were gleaned by hand.
formal.zh: 收割后，人们用手拾取了田间遗留的谷穗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek bit-tlaqqit ta' dawk il-biċċiet tal-karti? Pawlu: Iva, irrid nużahom għal stampa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still collecting those scraps of paper? Pawlu: Yes, I want to use them for a picture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在收集那些碎纸片吗？保罗：是啊，我想用它们拼一幅画。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek bit-tlaqqit ta' dawk il-biċċiet tal-karti?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek bit-tlaqqit ta' dawk il-biċċiet tal-karti?
messages.zh: 你还在收集那些碎纸片吗？
messages.en: Are you still collecting those scraps of paper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid nużahom għal stampa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid nużahom għal stampa.
messages.zh: 是啊，我想用它们拼一幅画。
messages.en: Yes, I want to use them for a picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指一小点一小点地拾取：田里拾谷穗，桌上拾碎料；用共同的零星收集画面串联各义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of removing small chips or thin pieces from a material by chipping or paring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过凿、削等方式，从材料上去除小碎块或薄片的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jitneħħew biċċiet żgħar jew saffi rqaq minn materjal permezz ta' daqqiet jew qtugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凿削；从物体上敲下或削下小碎块。
薄削；从物体表面削去薄层或小片。

collocations.en: the chipping or paring of wood

formal.mt: It-tlaqqix tal-ġebla neħħa l-biċċiet żejda u ta forma lill-wiċċ tagħha.
formal.en: Chipping the stone removed the excess pieces and shaped its surface.
formal.zh: 凿削去除了石料多余的碎块，并修整了它的表面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm dawn il-biċċiet żgħar mal-art? Pawlu: Mit-tlaqqix tal-injam; issa niġborhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are these little pieces on the floor? Pawlu: They are from chipping the wood; I will pick them up now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：地上怎么有这些小碎片？保罗：是削木头留下的，我现在就收起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawn il-biċċiet żgħar mal-art?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawn il-biċċiet żgħar mal-art?
messages.zh: 地上怎么有这些小碎片？
messages.en: Why are these little pieces on the floor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mit-tlaqqix tal-injam; issa niġborhom.
messages.mt_standard: Mit-tlaqqix tal-injam; issa niġborhom.
messages.zh: 是削木头留下的，我现在就收起来。
messages.en: They are from chipping the wood; I will pick them up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住材料表面逐渐变薄、旁边落下小片的画面：敲下碎块是凿削，削去薄层是薄削。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rinse one's body or part of it with water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水冲洗自己的身体或身体的某个部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħsel ġismu jew parti minnu bl-ilma biex jitneħħa dak li jkun hemm fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用水冲洗自己或自己的身体部位。

formal.mt: Wara li ħareġ mill-baħar, l-għawwiem tlaħlaħ bl-ilma ħelu biex neħħa l-melħ minn fuq ġismu.
formal.en: After coming out of the sea, the swimmer rinsed himself with fresh water to remove the salt from his body.
formal.zh: 从海里出来后，游泳者用淡水冲洗身体，洗去身上的盐分。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għad għandi r-ramel fuq saqajja. Maja: Tlaħlaħ taħt id-doċċa qabel tilbes iż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Rita: I still have sand on my feet. Maja: Rinse yourself under the shower before putting on your shoes.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我脚上还有沙子。Maja：穿鞋前先到淋浴下面冲一冲。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandi r-ramel fuq saqajja.
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandi r-ramel fuq saqajja.
messages.zh: 我脚上还有沙子。
messages.en: I still have sand on my feet.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlaħlaħ taħt id-doċċa qabel tilbes iż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Tlaħlaħ taħt id-doċċa qabel tilbes iż-żraben.
messages.zh: 穿鞋前先到淋浴下面冲一冲。
messages.en: Rinse yourself under the shower before putting on your shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlaħlaħ 配上“海泳后站在淋浴下冲盐和沙”的画面，记住动作是冲洗自己的身体。

gloss_zh: 发胖；得到充实阐述；成为肉身

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become corpulent; to be developed or explained in greater detail; or to take bodily form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体变得肥胖；论点或内容得到更充分的展开和阐述；也可指成为肉身或取得肉体形态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir oħxon fil-ġisem; li jiġi żviluppat jew spjegat b'aktar dettall; jew li jieħu sura ta' ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发胖；身体变得肥胖。
得到详细展开；被充分阐述或解释。
成为肉身；取得肉体形态。

collocations.en: the argument was elaborated with examples
collocations.zh: 论点借助例子得到充实阐述

collocations.en: to become incarnate in a human body

formal.mt: L-argument ewlieni tlaħħam b'eżempji u bi spjegazzjoni dettaljata.
formal.en: The main argument was elaborated with examples and a detailed explanation.
formal.zh: 主要论点通过例子和详细解释得到了充分阐述。

colloquial.mt: Marta: L-argument fir-rapport għadu qasir wisq? Pawlu: Le, fl-aħħar verżjoni tlaħħam b'żewġ eżempji oħra.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is the argument in the report still too brief? Pawlu: No, in the latest version it was fleshed out with two more examples.
colloquial.zh: Marta：报告里的论证还是太简略吗？Pawlu：不是了，最新版又加了两个例子，已经充实起来了。

messages.speaker: Marta (报告作者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-argument fir-rapport għadu qasir wisq?
messages.mt_standard: L-argument fir-rapport għadu qasir wisq?
messages.zh: 报告里的论证还是太简略吗？
messages.en: Is the argument in the report still too brief?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fl-aħħar verżjoni tlaħħam b'żewġ eżempji oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fl-aħħar verżjoni tlaħħam b'żewġ eżempji oħra.
messages.zh: 不是了，最新版又加了两个例子，已经充实起来了。
messages.en: No, in the latest version it was fleshed out with two more examples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张学习卡分别记：身体变胖、论述变充实、取得肉身。这只是帮助区分词义的场景联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 被达到；被延长至某处；获得晋升

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be reached; to be extended far enough to reach a place; or to be promoted to a higher position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个目标或位置被达到；某物被加长到足以够到某处；也指某人获得职位晋升。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintlaħaq post jew għan; li xi ħaġa tittawwal biżżejjed biex tasal sa post; jew li persuna tingħata kariga ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被达到；被够到或抵达。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be extended or lengthened to reach a spot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被延伸或加长，以便够到某个位置。
获得晋升；被提升到更高职位。

collocations.en: the rope was lengthened to reach the balcony
collocations.zh: 绳子被加长到能够够到阳台

collocations.en: to be promoted to the position of manager

formal.mt: Wara diversi snin ta' servizz, Mark tlaħħaq għall-kariga ta' maniġer.
formal.en: After several years of service, Mark was promoted to the position of manager.
formal.zh: 任职数年后，Mark 获晋升为经理。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ħabel issa jasal sal-gallarija? Toni: Iva, tlaħħaq b'biċċa oħra u issa jasal.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does the rope reach the balcony now? Toni: Yes, it was lengthened with another piece, and now it reaches.
colloquial.zh: Nina：绳子现在够得到阳台了吗？Toni：够了，又接长了一段，现在够得到了。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħabel issa jasal sal-gallarija?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħabel issa jasal sal-gallarija?
messages.zh: 绳子现在够得到阳台了吗？
messages.en: Does the rope reach the balcony now?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tlaħħaq b'biċċa oħra u issa jasal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tlaħħaq b'biċċa oħra u issa jasal.
messages.zh: 够了，又接长了一段，现在够得到了。
messages.en: Yes, it was lengthened with another piece, and now it reaches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个意思画成三格：目标被达到、绳子接长后够到阳台、员工升到更高职位；用不同场景分别牢牢记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of gaining body weight, or of developing an argument by adding detail and explanation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体重量增加的过程；也指通过补充细节和解释来展开论点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' żieda fil-piż tal-ġisem, jew l-iżvilupp ta' argument permezz ta' aktar dettalji u spjegazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重增加；增重。

sense_translations.en_definition: elaboration or expatiation of an argument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对论点作进一步展开、详述或充分阐释。

formal.mt: It-tlaħħim tal-argument jeħtieġ eżempji ċari u spjegazzjoni tar-rabta bejn il-punti ewlenin.
formal.en: The elaboration of the argument requires clear examples and an explanation of the connection between the main points.
formal.zh: 展开这一论点需要清楚的例子，并解释各主要观点之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed ninnota ftit tlaħħim dan l-aħħar. Rita: Jien ukoll; il-qalziet qed jiġini aktar issikkat.
colloquial.en: Maja: I've been noticing a little weight gain lately. Rita: Me too; my trousers are getting tighter.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我最近发现自己有点增重。Rita：我也是，裤子穿着越来越紧了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed ninnota ftit tlaħħim dan l-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Qed ninnota ftit tlaħħim dan l-aħħar.
messages.zh: 我最近发现自己有点增重。
messages.en: I've been noticing a little weight gain lately.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll; il-qalziet qed jiġini aktar issikkat.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll; il-qalziet qed jiġini aktar issikkat.
messages.zh: 我也是，裤子穿着越来越紧了。
messages.en: Me too; my trousers are getting tighter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项联成一幅学习画面：身体增加重量，论点增加细节；看到 tlaħħim 时用上下文判断是哪一种“充实”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of advancing someone to a higher position, or of bringing things together so that they join.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某人提升到更高职位的行为；也指使事物连接或接合的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' kariga jew grad ogħla lil xi ħadd, jew il-proċess li bih affarijiet jitqabbdu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提拔或晋升某人至更高职位、职级的行为。
使事物相互连接、接合或衔接起来。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-kriterji għat-tlaħħiq tal-impjegati għal gradi ogħla.
formal.en: The report explains the criteria for promoting employees to higher grades.
formal.zh: 报告说明了将员工晋升至更高职级的标准。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif sejjer it-tlaħħiq tal-pajpijiet? Pawlu: Kważi lest; fadal inqabbad l-aħħar żewġ biċċiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: How is the joining of the pipes going? Pawlu: Almost done; I still need to connect the last two pieces.
colloquial.zh: Mark：管道接合得怎么样了？Pawlu：快好了，还要把最后两段接起来。

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer it-tlaħħiq tal-pajpijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer it-tlaħħiq tal-pajpijiet?
messages.zh: 管道接合得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the joining of the pipes going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (水管工)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi lest; fadal inqabbad l-aħħar żewġ biċċiet.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi lest; fadal inqabbad l-aħħar żewġ biċċiet.
messages.zh: 快好了，还要把最后两段接起来。
messages.en: Almost done; I still need to connect the last two pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 tlaħħiq：员工被提到更高职位，两段管子被接到一起；分别对应“晋升”和“接合”。

gloss_zh: 被吓得畏缩；被迫逃跑；被快速骑乘

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to cower in fear or forced to flee; of a horse, to be ridden at speed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受到惊吓而畏缩，或被迫逃走；用于马时，也可表示被人快速骑乘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitbeżża' tant li jinġibed lura jew ikollu jaħrab; għal żiemel, li jiġi misjuq b'ħeffa minn rikkieb.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to cower or quail with fear
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被吓得畏缩、退缩或胆怯。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be forced to run away
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迫逃跑或逃离。
被快速骑乘；指马等坐骑被人骑着疾行。

collocations.en: the horse was ridden at speed

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel tlebbet tul it-triq u mbagħad tħalla jistrieħ.
formal.en: The horse was ridden at speed along the road and was then allowed to rest.
formal.zh: 那匹马被人骑着沿路疾行，随后获准休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil Pawlu meta sema' dik l-għajta? Mark: Tlebbet bil-biża' u mar lura.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to Pawlu when he heard that shout? Mark: He cowered in fear and backed away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗听到那声喊叫后怎么了？马克：他吓得畏缩，往后退了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lil Pawlu meta sema' dik l-għajta?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lil Pawlu meta sema' dik l-għajta?
messages.zh: 保罗听到那声喊叫后怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Pawlu when he heard that shout?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlebbet bil-biża' u mar lura.
messages.mt_standard: Tlebbet bil-biża' u mar lura.
messages.zh: 他吓得畏缩，往后退了。
messages.en: He cowered in fear and backed away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅画记：人受到惊吓而缩身或逃走，马则被骑着疾行；先辨认主语，再选择对应词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An escape or act of running off; also the act of riding a horse at speed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逃脱或跑离的行为，也可指骑着马快速行进的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jaħrab jew jitlaq jiġri; ukoll l-att li wieħed isuq żiemel b'ħeffa waqt li jkun riekeb fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃脱；从束缚、看管或危险处境中脱身。
跑开、跑走或突然离去的行为。
快速骑马；骑着马疾行的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tlebbit taż-żiemel mill-istalla u l-mod kif instab.
formal.en: The report describes the horse's escape from the stable and how it was found.
formal.zh: 报告描述了那匹马逃离马厩的经过，以及后来如何找到它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħareġ iż-żiemel mill-istalla? Pawlu: Il-bieb kien miftuħ; it-tlebbit tiegħu sorpriża lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the horse get out of the stable? Pawlu: The door was open; its running off surprised everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那匹马怎么出了马厩？保罗：门开着，它突然跑走，让大家都很意外。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħareġ iż-żiemel mill-istalla?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħareġ iż-żiemel mill-istalla?
messages.zh: 那匹马怎么出了马厩？
messages.en: How did the horse get out of the stable?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb kien miftuħ; it-tlebbit tiegħu sorpriża lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb kien miftuħ; it-tlebbit tiegħu sorpriża lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 门开着，它突然跑走，让大家都很意外。
messages.en: The door was open; its running off surprised everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词放在事件标题里记：一次逃脱、一次跑离、一次快速骑马；它命名的是整件活动。

gloss_zh: 产生强烈渴望；馋得想要

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel a strong craving or eager desire for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种东西产生强烈的渴望或迫切的想要之感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iħoss xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生强烈渴望；感到很想得到或享用某物。

formal.mt: Meta xamm il-ħobż frisk, Pawlu tlebleb għal biċċa.
formal.en: When he smelled the fresh bread, Pawlu craved a piece.
formal.zh: 闻到新鲜面包的香味时，保罗很想吃上一块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu mar dritt għand tal-ħelu? Mark: Ra l-kejk fit-tieqa u tlebleb għal biċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu go straight to the sweet shop? Mark: He saw the cake in the window and craved a slice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么直接去甜品店了？马克：他看见橱窗里的蛋糕，馋得想吃一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu mar dritt għand tal-ħelu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu mar dritt għand tal-ħelu?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么直接去甜品店了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go straight to the sweet shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ra l-kejk fit-tieqa u tlebleb għal biċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Ra l-kejk fit-tieqa u tlebleb għal biċċa.
messages.zh: 他看见橱窗里的蛋糕，馋得想吃一块。
messages.en: He saw the cake in the window and craved a slice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象经过面包店时闻到香味，心里突然特别想吃；用这种迫切想要的感觉记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wrapped, or to wrap oneself in warm clothing to keep out the cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被包裹起来；也可指为抵御寒冷而用保暖衣物裹住自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jiġi mgeżwer, jew jitgeżwer hu stess fi ħwejjeġ sħan biex jilqa' għall-kesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被包住、裹住或包裹起来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to wrap oneself in warm clothes against the cold
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为抵御寒冷而用保暖衣物裹住自己。

formal.mt: Qabel ħareġ fil-kesħa, ir-raġel tleffef fi ħwejjeġ sħan.
formal.en: Before going out into the cold, the man wrapped himself in warm clothes.
formal.zh: 出门进入寒冷的室外前，那名男子用保暖衣物裹好了自己。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Pawlu? Mark: Fuq is-sufan; tleffef f'kutra għax qed iħoss il-bard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Pawlu? Mark: On the sofa; he wrapped himself in a blanket because he feels cold.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗在哪里？马克：在沙发上，他觉得冷，就用毯子裹住了自己。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-sufan; tleffef f'kutra għax qed iħoss il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-sufan; tleffef f'kutra għax qed iħoss il-bard.
messages.zh: 在沙发上，他觉得冷，就用毯子裹住了自己。
messages.en: On the sofa; he wrapped himself in a blanket because he feels cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象冷风吹来时把毯子拉到身上、裹紧身体；记住既可表示被裹住，也可表示自己裹好御寒。

gloss_zh: 用围巾或披肩裹住自己的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wrapping oneself up in a scarf or shawl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用围巾或披肩把自己裹起来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitgeżwer b'xalpa jew b'drapp li jintlibes fuq l-ispallejn.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of wrapping oneself up in a scarf of shawl
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用围巾或披肩将自己裹起来的行为。

collocations.en: wrapping oneself up in a scarf
wrapping oneself up against the cold

formal.mt: It-tleffif b'xalpa madwar l-għonq kien parti mit-tħejjija tiegħu qabel ħareġ fil-kesħa.
formal.en: Wrapping a scarf around his neck was part of his preparation before going out into the cold.
formal.zh: 出门进入寒冷的室外前，他做准备时也把围巾裹在了脖子上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lest biex noħorġu? Pawlu: Kważi; għadni bit-tleffif b'din ix-xalpa twila.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you ready to go out? Pawlu: Almost; I am still wrapping myself up in this long scarf.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：准备好出门了吗？保罗：快好了，我还在围这条长围巾。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lest biex noħorġu?
messages.mt_standard: Lest biex noħorġu?
messages.zh: 准备好出门了吗？
messages.en: Are you ready to go out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għadni bit-tleffif b'din ix-xalpa twila.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għadni bit-tleffif b'din ix-xalpa twila.
messages.zh: 快好了，我还在围这条长围巾。
messages.en: Almost; I am still wrapping myself up in this long scarf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把围巾一圈圈围好、把披肩拢紧的动作当成一个完整事件来记；这个名词指裹围动作本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For food to be eaten very quickly and greedily; to be wolfed down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物被人快速而贪婪地吃下，即被狼吞虎咽地吃掉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal ikel li jittiekel malajr ħafna u b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被狼吞虎咽地吃掉。

collocations.en: All the bread was wolfed down.
collocations.zh: 面包全被狼吞虎咽地吃掉了。

collocations.en: The cake was wolfed down in no time.
collocations.zh: 蛋糕一转眼就被狼吞虎咽地吃掉了。

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, il-ħobż li tqassam lill-parteċipanti tleflef f'ħakka t'għajn.
formal.en: After the long walk, the bread distributed to the participants was wolfed down in no time.
formal.zh: 长途步行结束后，分给参加者的面包一转眼就被狼吞虎咽地吃掉了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-kejk? Mark: Tleflef kollu! Ma baqa' xejn. Maja: Mela d-darba li jmiss nixtri tnejn!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the cake? Mark: It was all wolfed down! There's none left. Maja: Then next time I'll buy two!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：蛋糕呢？马克：全被狼吞虎咽地吃光了！一点也没剩。玛雅：那我下次买两个！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-kejk?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-kejk?
messages.zh: 蛋糕呢？
messages.en: Where's the cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tleflef kollu! Ma baqa' xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Tleflef kollu! Ma baqa' xejn.
messages.zh: 全被狼吞虎咽地吃光了！一点也没剩。
messages.en: It was all wolfed down! There's none left.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela d-darba li jmiss nixtri tnejn!
messages.mt_standard: Mela d-darba li jmiss nixtri tnejn!
messages.zh: 那我下次买两个！
messages.en: Then next time I'll buy two!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tleflef 和一盘转眼被吃光的蛋糕联系起来：注意句子的主角是食物，意思是食物被狼吞虎咽地吃掉。

gloss_zh: 被咕咚咕咚地大口喝下

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a drink to be swallowed quickly in large amounts; to be guzzled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指饮料被人快速、大口地喝下，强调豪饮或猛喝的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xorb li jinxtorob malajr ħafna u b'belgħat kbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被快速、大口地喝下；被咕咚咕咚地猛喝掉。

collocations.en: The milk was guzzled in no time.
collocations.zh: 牛奶一转眼就被咕咚咕咚地喝掉了。

formal.mt: Wara t-taħriġ, il-meraq li tqassam lill-plejers tlegleg f'ħakka t'għajn.
formal.en: After training, the juice distributed to the players was guzzled in no time.
formal.zh: 训练结束后，分给球员的果汁一转眼就被大口喝光了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fadal meraq fil-buqar? Pawlu: Le, tlegleg kollu wara l-logħba. Sara: Mela nimla l-buqar bl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any juice left in the jug? Pawlu: No, it was all guzzled after the game. Sara: Then I'll fill the jug with water.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：壶里还有果汁吗？保罗：没有，比赛后全被大口喝光了。萨拉：那我往壶里装些水。

messages.speaker: Sara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fadal meraq fil-buqar?
messages.mt_standard: Fadal meraq fil-buqar?
messages.zh: 壶里还有果汁吗？
messages.en: Is there any juice left in the jug?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tlegleg kollu wara l-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tlegleg kollu wara l-logħba.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 tlegleg 时，想象一壶果汁伴着咕咚声迅速见底：饮料是被喝掉的对象，重点是大口猛喝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of passing the tongue over something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用舌头舔某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tgħaddi l-ilsien fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舔；舔舐的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tgħaddi l-ilsien fuq xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: It-tlegħiq jgħin lill-qattus iżomm il-pil nadif.
formal.en: Licking helps the cat keep its fur clean.
formal.zh: 舔舐有助于猫保持毛发清洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm qed jilgħaq saqajh il-qattus! Mark: Iva, dan it-tlegħiq jgħinu jnaddaf il-pil.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how much the cat is licking its paws! Mark: Yes, this licking helps it clean its fur.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看，猫一直在舔爪子！马克：是啊，这样舔能帮助它清洁毛发。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm qed jilgħaq saqajh il-qattus!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm qed jilgħaq saqajh il-qattus!
messages.zh: 你看，猫一直在舔爪子！
messages.en: Look how much the cat is licking its paws!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan it-tlegħiq jgħinu jnaddaf il-pil.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan it-tlegħiq jgħinu jnaddaf il-pil.
messages.zh: 是啊，这样舔能帮助它清洁毛发。
messages.en: Yes, this licking helps it clean its fur.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlegħiq 和猫舔毛的画面连在一起记：它是名词，表示“舔舐这个动作”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hill rising above the surrounding ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比周围地面稍高的小山丘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għolja żgħira li togħla ftit fuq l-art ta' madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小山丘。

formal.mt: Il-kappella tinsab fuq tlejgħa ħdejn ir-raħal.
formal.en: The chapel stands on a small hill near the village.
formal.zh: 小教堂坐落在村庄附近的一座小山丘上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se noqogħdu nieklu? Pawlu: Fuq dik it-tlejgħa, taħt is-siġra. Maja: Tajjeb, minn hemm naraw il-baħar!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we sit to eat? Pawlu: On that little hill, under the tree. Maja: Great, we can see the sea from there!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们坐在哪里吃东西？保罗：就在那座小山丘上，树下面。玛雅：好啊，从那里能看见海！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se noqogħdu nieklu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se noqogħdu nieklu?
messages.zh: 我们坐在哪里吃东西？
messages.en: Where shall we sit to eat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq dik it-tlejgħa, taħt is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq dik it-tlejgħa, taħt is-siġra.
messages.zh: 就在那座小山丘上，树下面。
messages.en: On that little hill, under the tree.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, minn hemm naraw il-baħar!
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, minn hemm naraw il-baħar!
messages.zh: 好啊，从那里能看见海！
messages.en: Great, we can see the sea from there!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tle j għa 连写成 tlejgħa 来认读，并想象平地上鼓起的一座绿色小山丘；用 fuq tlejgħa“在小山丘上”把词义和位置一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shine with a faint or flickering light, or to look excessively bright and showy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出微弱或闪动的光；也指因色彩或装饰过于抢眼而显得花哨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddi b'dawl ħafif jew li jteptep; ukoll, li jidher jgħajjat wisq fil-kuluri jew fit-tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出微光；隐约闪烁。
显得过分鲜艳、花哨或装饰过度。

collocations.en: to look gaudy with overly bright colours
collocations.zh: 因色彩过于鲜艳而显得花哨

formal.mt: Mill-bogħod deher dawl żgħir jitlellex fid-dlam.
formal.en: In the distance, a small light could be seen glimmering in the dark.
formal.zh: 远处可以看见一点微光在黑暗中闪烁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'taħseb fuq dan il-ġakkett? Pawlu: Jitlellex wisq bil-kuluri u bit-tiżjin tiegħu. Maja: Għandek raġun, se nagħżel wieħed aktar sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you think of this jacket? Pawlu: It looks too gaudy with all its colours and decoration. Maja: You're right, I'll choose a simpler one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这件夹克怎么样？保罗：它的颜色和装饰让它显得太花哨了。玛雅：你说得对，我选一件更简洁的。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'taħseb fuq dan il-ġakkett?
messages.mt_standard: X'taħseb fuq dan il-ġakkett?
messages.zh: 你觉得这件夹克怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of this jacket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (陪同购物的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jitlellex wisq bil-kuluri u bit-tiżjin tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Jitlellex wisq bil-kuluri u bit-tiżjin tiegħu.
messages.zh: 它的颜色和装饰让它显得太花哨了。
messages.en: It looks too gaudy with all its colours and decoration.

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, se nagħżel wieħed aktar sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, se nagħżel wieħed aktar sempliċi.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我选一件更简洁的。
messages.en: You're right, I'll choose a simpler one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记住 tlellex：远处灯光轻轻闪，是“闪烁微光”；衣服颜色和装饰太抢眼，是“显得花哨”。这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A glimmer or shine; also an attractive glamour or an excessively showy appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 微弱闪现的光或明亮的光泽；也指令人着迷的华丽魅力，或过分显眼的浮华。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl li jleqq jew jidher ħafif; ukoll dehra li tiġbed u ssaħħar, jew tiżjin żejjed li jolqot l-għajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微光；隐约闪现的光亮。
华丽而迷人的魅力；令人向往的耀眼风采。
光泽；物体表面明亮或反光的效果。
浮华；装饰或外观过分鲜艳、显眼而显得俗艳的特点。

collocations.en: the glamour of life in the film world
collocations.zh: 电影圈生活的华丽魅力

formal.mt: It-tlellix tad-dwal fuq l-ilma kien jidher mit-tieqa tas-sala.
formal.en: The glimmer of the lights on the water was visible from the hall window.
formal.zh: 从大厅的窗户可以看见灯光在水面上闪烁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara t-tlellix ta' dawk id-dwal fuq l-ilma! Lara: Iva, ejja nieħdu ritratt minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at those lights shimmering on the water! Lara: Yes, let's take a photo from here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那些灯光在水面上闪闪发亮！拉拉：是啊，我们在这里拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara t-tlellix ta' dawk id-dwal fuq l-ilma!
messages.mt_standard: Ara t-tlellix ta' dawk id-dwal fuq l-ilma!
messages.zh: 看那些灯光在水面上闪闪发亮！
messages.en: Look at those lights shimmering on the water!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nieħdu ritratt minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nieħdu ritratt minn hawn.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们在这里拍张照吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's take a photo from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlellix 配上一幅水面灯光图：一点光是微光，金属反光是光泽，舞台耀眼是魅力，装饰过头则是浮华。用亮光逐步增强的画面串联四义。

gloss_zh: 获准瞥见；经引导而察觉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given a brief look at something, or to be led to notice or perceive something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被给予短暂看一眼某物的机会，或在他人的引导下注意到、察觉到某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata l-opportunità li jara xi ħaġa għal ftit, jew jiġi megħjun jinduna b'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被给予瞥一眼的机会；获准短暂看一下。
经他人提示或引导而察觉、看出或意识到某事。

collocations.en: was given a peek at what is inside
was led to perceive the difference

formal.mt: Wara l-ispjegazzjoni tal-għalliema, l-istudent tlemmaħ id-differenza bejn iż-żewġ każijiet.
formal.en: After the teacher's explanation, the student was led to perceive the difference between the two cases.
formal.zh: 经过老师的讲解，学生在引导下看出了两个案例之间的差别。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark tlemmaħ x'hemm fil-kaxxa? Lara: Iva, ħallejtu jħares għal mument biss.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was Mark given a peek at what's in the box? Lara: Yes, I let him look for just a moment.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克获准看一眼盒子里有什么了吗？拉拉：是的，我只让他看了一小会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark tlemmaħ x'hemm fil-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Mark tlemmaħ x'hemm fil-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 马克获准看一眼盒子里有什么了吗？
messages.en: Was Mark given a peek at what's in the box?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħallejtu jħares għal mument biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħallejtu jħares għal mument biss.
messages.zh: 是的，我只让他看了一小会儿。
messages.en: Yes, I let him look for just a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tlemmaħ 时想两个教学画面：别人把盒盖掀开，让你瞥见；老师把差别指出，让你察觉。两义都抓住“经别人帮助而看见或看懂”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be rolled out or spread flat using a rolling pin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指面团等被擀面杖擀开，成为较薄、较平的形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinfirex u jsir aktar ċatt jew irqiq permezz ta' romblu tal-għaġina.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be spread with a rolling pin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被擀面杖擀开；被擀平。

collocations.en: pasta dough that was rolled out thin
was rolled out on the table

formal.mt: L-għaġin tlenbeb fuq wiċċ nadif sakemm sar irqiq biżżejjed biex jinqata'.
formal.en: The pasta dough was rolled out on a clean surface until it was thin enough to cut.
formal.zh: 意面面团在干净的台面上被擀开，直到薄得可以切割。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan l-għaġin tlenbeb diġà? Pawlu: Iva, tlenbeb fuq il-mejda u issa nistgħu naqtgħuh.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has this pasta dough been rolled out already? Pawlu: Yes, it was rolled out on the table, and now we can cut it.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这块意面面团已经擀开了吗？Pawlu：对，已经在桌上擀开了，现在可以切了。

messages.speaker: Marta (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-għaġin tlenbeb diġà?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-għaġin tlenbeb diġà?
messages.zh: 这块意面面团已经擀开了吗？
messages.en: Has this pasta dough been rolled out already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烹饪老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tlenbeb fuq il-mejda u issa nistgħu naqtgħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tlenbeb fuq il-mejda u issa nistgħu naqtgħuh.
messages.zh: 对，已经在桌上擀开了，现在可以切了。
messages.en: Yes, it was rolled out on the table, and now we can cut it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面团躺在桌上，被擀面杖来回压薄；把 tlenbeb 记成面团“被擀开”的动作。

gloss_zh: 用擀面杖擀开的动作；擀制

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or process of rolling out dough with a rolling pin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用擀面杖来回滚压，把面团擀开或擀薄的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih l-għaġina tinfirex u ssir irqaq permezz ta' romblu tal-għaġina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用擀面杖进行擀压；擀开面团的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tlenbib tal-għaġina, żomm pressjoni uniformi biex il-ħxuna tkun l-istess kullimkien.
formal.en: When rolling out the dough, maintain even pressure so that its thickness is the same throughout.
formal.zh: 擀制面团时，应保持用力均匀，使各处厚度一致。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nibda bit-tlenbib tal-għaġina? Toni: Iva, imma roxx ftit dqiq fuq il-mejda l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall I start rolling out the dough? Toni: Yes, but sprinkle a little flour on the table first.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我开始擀面团吗？Toni：好，不过先在桌上撒一点面粉。

messages.speaker: Lara (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibda bit-tlenbib tal-għaġina?
messages.mt_standard: Nibda bit-tlenbib tal-għaġina?
messages.zh: 我开始擀面团吗？
messages.en: Shall I start rolling out the dough?

messages.speaker: Toni (烹饪老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma roxx ftit dqiq fuq il-mejda l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma roxx ftit dqiq fuq il-mejda l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 好，不过先在桌上撒一点面粉。
messages.en: Yes, but sprinkle a little flour on the table first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把食谱中的“擀面步骤”画上擀面杖，并标记 tlenbib；这里记的是整个擀制过程，是名词。

gloss_zh: 通过漏斗倾注；把物件做成漏斗形

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of pouring something through a funnel, or shaping a material such as paper into a funnel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指通过漏斗倾倒物质的动作，也可指把纸等材料做成漏斗形的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tferra' xi ħaġa minn lembut, jew li tagħti lil materjal bħall-karta l-għamla ta' lembut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过漏斗倾倒或灌注物质。

sense_translations.en_definition: shaping sth. (e.g. paper) like a funnel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物，例如纸，做成漏斗形。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, it-tlenbit tal-karta jsir l-ewwel; imbagħad isir it-tlenbit tar-ramel fil-flixkun permezz tal-lembut tal-karta.
formal.en: In the exercise, the paper is first shaped into a funnel; the sand is then poured into the bottle through the paper funnel.
formal.zh: 练习中先把纸做成漏斗形，再通过这个纸漏斗把沙子倒入瓶中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għat-tlenbit tar-ramel, nista' nuża lembut tal-karta? Mark: Iva, imma agħmel fetħa żgħira fil-qiegħ biex ir-ramel jgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I use a paper funnel to pour the sand? Mark: Yes, but make a small opening at the bottom so the sand can pass through.
colloquial.zh: Sara：用漏斗倒沙子时，我可以用纸漏斗吗？Mark：可以，不过要在底部开个小口，让沙子通过。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tlenbit tar-ramel, nista' nuża lembut tal-karta?
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tlenbit tar-ramel, nista' nuża lembut tal-karta?
messages.zh: 用漏斗倒沙子时，我可以用纸漏斗吗？
messages.en: Can I use a paper funnel to pour the sand?

messages.speaker: Mark (科学老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma agħmel fetħa żgħira fil-qiegħ biex ir-ramel jgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma agħmel fetħa żgħira fil-qiegħ biex ir-ramel jgħaddi.
messages.zh: 可以，不过要在底部开个小口，让沙子通过。
messages.en: Yes, but make a small opening at the bottom so the sand can pass through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅连续画面记 tlenbit：先把纸卷成漏斗，再让沙子穿过漏斗；两幅分别对应两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The gleaming or shining appearance of something that gives off or reflects light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体因发光或反射光线而呈现的闪亮状态或光泽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dehra ta' xi ħaġa li tleqq għax tagħti jew tirrifletti d-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪着亮光；呈现闪亮光泽。
发亮；呈现明亮、有光泽的状态。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, it-tleqqija tal-fidda dehret aktar ċara taħt id-dawl tal-lampa.
formal.en: After cleaning, the silver's gleam was more noticeable under the lamplight.
formal.zh: 清洁后，银器的光泽在灯光下显得更加明显。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara t-tleqqija ta' dan iċ-ċirku! David: Iva, għadni kif naddaftu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at the shine on this ring! David: Yes, I've just cleaned it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看这枚戒指多有光泽！David：是啊，我刚把它清洁好。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara t-tleqqija ta' dan iċ-ċirku!
messages.mt_standard: Ara t-tleqqija ta' dan iċ-ċirku!
messages.zh: 看这枚戒指多有光泽！
messages.en: Look at the shine on this ring!

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kif naddaftu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kif naddaftu.
messages.zh: 是啊，我刚把它清洁好。
messages.en: Yes, I've just cleaned it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚擦亮的银戒指在灯下一闪，把那一层看得见的亮光标为 tleqqija，记住它是表示光泽的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be finished or brought to completion, with the required work done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指工作、项目或其他事项已经做完，达到完成状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jasal fi tmiemu wara li jsir ix-xogħol meħtieġ kollu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被完成；达到已经做完的状态。

formal.mt: Il-proġett tlesta fil-ħin u r-rapport finali ntbagħat lill-kumitat.
formal.en: The project was completed on time, and the final report was sent to the committee.
formal.zh: 项目按时完成，最终报告已提交委员会。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ir-rapport tlesta? Ġużeppi: Iva, tlesta dalgħodu. Tista' taqrah issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the report finished? Ġużeppi: Yes, it was finished this morning. You can read it now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：报告完成了吗？Ġużeppi：对，今天上午完成了。你现在可以看了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rapport tlesta?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rapport tlesta?
messages.zh: 报告完成了吗？
messages.en: Is the report finished?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (报告撰写人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tlesta dalgħodu. Tista' taqrah issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tlesta dalgħodu. Tista' taqrah issa.
messages.zh: 对，今天上午完成了。你现在可以看了。
messages.en: Yes, it was finished this morning. You can read it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象任务清单的最后一格被打上勾，同时说 ix-xogħol tlesta，把这个词与“事情已经完成”连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of finishing something and bringing it to completion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把工作、作品或其他事项做完，使其达到完成状态的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titwassal sa tmiemha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完成某事的动作；把某事做完或收尾。

formal.mt: It-tlestija tar-rapport teħtieġ verifika finali taċ-ċifri u tal-ismijiet.
formal.en: Finishing the report requires a final check of the figures and names.
formal.zh: 完成报告需要对数字和姓名进行最后核查。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'jonqos għat-tlestija tar-rapport? Karl: Biss il-konklużjoni u l-aħħar verifika.
colloquial.en: Rita: What remains to finish the report? Karl: Just the conclusion and the final check.
colloquial.zh: Rita：报告还差什么才能完成？Karl：只差结论和最后核查。

messages.speaker: Rita (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jonqos għat-tlestija tar-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: X'jonqos għat-tlestija tar-rapport?
messages.zh: 报告还差什么才能完成？
messages.en: What remains to finish the report?

messages.speaker: Karl (报告撰写人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biss il-konklużjoni u l-aħħar verifika.
messages.mt_standard: Biss il-konklużjoni u l-aħħar verifika.
messages.zh: 只差结论和最后核查。
messages.en: Just the conclusion and the final check.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“写完最后一句、核对、交稿”圈成一个收尾过程，标注 tlestija；用名词“完成这件事”来记。

gloss_zh: 三位一体；三者组成的一组

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unity of three, especially the Christian Trinity, or a group consisting of three members.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 三者构成的统一体，尤指基督教的三位一体；也可指由三个成员组成的一组。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' tlieta, speċjalment it-Tletija Qaddisa, jew grupp magħmul minn tliet membri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三位一体；三者合一的统一体，尤指基督教中的三位一体。
由三个成员组成的一组；三人组或三件一组。

formal.mt: Fit-tagħlim Nisrani, it-Tletija Qaddisa tirreferi għall-Missier, l-Iben u l-Ispirtu s-Santu.
formal.en: In Christian teaching, the Holy Trinity refers to the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
formal.zh: 在基督教教义中，神圣的三位一体指圣父、圣子和圣灵。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min se jkanta llejla? Mario: Tletija ta' kantanti mill-iskola tagħna.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who is singing tonight? Mario: A group of three singers from our school.
colloquial.zh: Elena：今晚谁来唱歌？Mario：我们学校的三人歌唱组合。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkanta llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkanta llejla?
messages.zh: 今晚谁来唱歌？
messages.en: Who is singing tonight?

messages.speaker: Mario (演出组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tletija ta' kantanti mill-iskola tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Tletija ta' kantanti mill-iskola tagħna.
messages.zh: 我们学校的三人歌唱组合。
messages.en: A group of three singers from our school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三个圆并用一个大圈圈住，标注 tletija：日常语境记“三个一组”，宗教语境另记“三位一体”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 13,000, equal to thirteen groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值为13,000，即十三个一千，中文读作“一万三千”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 13,000, jiġifieri tlettax-il darba elf.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, tlettax-il elf persuna żaru l-wirja matul ix-xahar ta' Ottubru.
formal.en: According to the report, thirteen thousand people visited the exhibition during October.
formal.zh: 根据报告，十月期间有一万三千人参观了展览。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm tiswa l-karozza? Ben: Tlettax-il elf ewro. Anna: U l-assigurazzjoni hija inkluża? Ben: Le, dik titħallas separatament.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much does the car cost? Ben: Thirteen thousand euros. Anna: And is insurance included? Ben: No, that is paid separately.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这辆车多少钱？Ben：一万三千欧元。Anna：保险也包含在内吗？Ben：不，保险要另外付费。

messages.speaker: Anna (购车顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm tiswa l-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm tiswa l-karozza?
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does the car cost?

messages.speaker: Ben (汽车销售员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlettax-il elf ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Tlettax-il elf ewro.
messages.zh: 一万三千欧元。
messages.en: Thirteen thousand euros.

messages.speaker: Anna (购车顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: U l-assigurazzjoni hija inkluża?
messages.mt_standard: U l-assigurazzjoni hija inkluża?
messages.zh: 保险也包含在内吗？
messages.en: And is insurance included?

messages.speaker: Ben (汽车销售员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dik titħallas separatament.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dik titħallas separatament.
messages.zh: 不，保险要另外付费。
messages.en: No, that is paid separately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlettax-il elf 对应到十三捆、每捆一千的钞票：13×1000＝13000，中文应读“一万三千”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To quarrel with someone, or to end a relationship by breaking up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指与别人发生争吵，或结束一段恋爱关系而分手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jargumenta jew jiġġieled ma' xi ħadd, jew itemm relazzjoni ta' mħabba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与别人争吵、发生口角。
结束恋爱关系；分手。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Mark tlewwaq ma' kollega dwar kif kellu jitqassam ix-xogħol.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mark quarrelled with a colleague about how the work should be divided.
formal.zh: 会议期间，马克与一位同事因工作应如何分配而发生争吵。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq Mark? Lara: Tlewwaq ma' sieħbu u ħareġ biex jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave? Lara: He quarrelled with his friend and went out to calm down.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么走了？拉拉：他和朋友吵了一架，出去冷静一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex telaq Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex telaq Mark?
messages.zh: 马克为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlewwaq ma' sieħbu u ħareġ biex jikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Tlewwaq ma' sieħbu u ħareġ biex jikkalma.
messages.zh: 他和朋友吵了一架，出去冷静一下。
messages.en: He quarrelled with his friend and went out to calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张关系场景卡记忆：一张是两人争吵，一张是恋人分手；根据上下文判断具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be moved with a shovel or lifted out with a scooping action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指材料被用铲子移动，或被用舀取的动作取出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mċaqlaq b'pala jew jinġabar b'għodda li biha jittella' minn fejn ikun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用铲子铲起或移走。
被舀起或舀出。

formal.mt: Ir-ramel tlewwaħ mill-art għal ġol-karrettun qabel ma beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The sand was shovelled from the ground into the wheelbarrow before work began.
formal.zh: 开工前，沙子被从地上铲进了手推车。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar ir-ramel li kien hawn? Mark: Tlewwaħ għal ġol-karrettun; issa nistgħu ngħaddu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the sand that was here go? Mark: It was shovelled into the wheelbarrow; we can get through now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才这里的沙子去哪儿了？马克：被铲进手推车了，现在可以通行了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar ir-ramel li kien hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar ir-ramel li kien hawn?
messages.zh: 刚才这里的沙子去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the sand that was here go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlewwaħ għal ġol-karrettun; issa nistgħu ngħaddu.
messages.mt_standard: Tlewwaħ għal ġol-karrettun; issa nistgħu ngħaddu.
messages.zh: 被铲进手推车了，现在可以通行了。
messages.en: It was shovelled into the wheelbarrow; we can get through now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在沙子被铲起、冰淇淋被舀起的一刻，记住这个动词关注被移动的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have colour applied or added to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物被涂上颜色或被加入色彩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata kulur billi jiżdied jew jitqiegħed il-kulur fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被着色；被涂上颜色。

collocations.en: a drawing that was coloured in

formal.mt: Il-mappa tlewwnet b'kuluri differenti biex kull reġjun jidher ċar.
formal.en: The map was coloured with different colours so that each region would be clearly visible.
formal.zh: 地图被涂上不同颜色，以便清楚地区分各个区域。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan iċ-ċirku aħmar? Mark: Tlewwen bl-aħmar biex jidher aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this circle red? Mark: It was coloured red to make it easier to see.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个圆圈为什么是红色的？马克：把它涂成红色，是为了让它更显眼。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan iċ-ċirku aħmar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan iċ-ċirku aħmar?
messages.zh: 这个圆圈为什么是红色的？
messages.en: Why is this circle red?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlewwen bl-aħmar biex jidher aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Tlewwen bl-aħmar biex jidher aħjar.
messages.zh: 把它涂成红色，是为了让它更显眼。
messages.en: It was coloured red to make it easier to see.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本空白的圆圈被涂成红色，把这个动词与物体获得颜色的变化画面联系起来。

gloss_zh: 弄脏了；被狼吞虎咽地吃掉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dirty, or, when referring to food, to be eaten quickly and greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指变脏；用于食物时，也指被迅速、贪馋地吃掉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir maħmuġ, jew, meta jirreferi għall-ikel, jittiekel malajr u b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变脏；被弄脏。
被狼吞虎咽地吃掉。

collocations.en: food that was gobbled down quickly

formal.mt: Il-flokk tlewwet waqt ix-xogħol fil-ġnien u kellu jinħasel.
formal.en: The shirt got dirty during the gardening work and had to be washed.
formal.zh: 这件上衣在园艺劳动中弄脏了，需要清洗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-kejk kollu? Mark: Tlewwet f'ħames minuti; kulħadd kien bil-ġuħ!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did all the cake go? Mark: It was gobbled down in five minutes; everyone was hungry!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：整块蛋糕怎么都没了？马克：五分钟就被大家狼吞虎咽地吃光了，大家都饿了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar il-kejk kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar il-kejk kollu?
messages.zh: 整块蛋糕怎么都没了？
messages.en: Where did all the cake go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlewwet f'ħames minuti; kulħadd kien bil-ġuħ!
messages.mt_standard: Tlewwet f'ħames minuti; kulħadd kien bil-ġuħ!
messages.zh: 五分钟就被大家狼吞虎咽地吃光了，大家都饿了！
messages.en: It was gobbled down in five minutes; everyone was hungry!

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记两幅画：上衣沾土变脏，蛋糕被迅速吃光；先看主语是衣物还是食物再选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow almonds, or, when referring to food, to have almonds added.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指生长、结出杏仁；用于食品时，指被加入杏仁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipproduċi l-lewż, jew, meta jirreferi għall-ikel, jiżdiedlu l-lewż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生长、结出杏仁。
被加入杏仁作为配料。

collocations.en: a cake that had almonds added before baking
collocations.zh: 烘焙前加入了杏仁的蛋糕

formal.mt: Il-ħelu tlewweż bil-lewż imqatta' qabel ma tqiegħed fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: The dessert had chopped almonds added before it was placed on the table.
formal.zh: 甜点在端上桌前加入了切碎的杏仁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kejk fih il-lewż? Mark: Iva, tlewweż qabel il-ħami.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this cake contain almonds? Mark: Yes, it had almonds added before baking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个蛋糕里有杏仁吗？马克：有，烘焙前加了杏仁。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kejk fih il-lewż?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kejk fih il-lewż?
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕里有杏仁吗？
messages.en: Does this cake contain almonds?

messages.speaker: Mark (面包师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tlewweż qabel il-ħami.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tlewweż qabel il-ħami.
messages.zh: 有，烘焙前加了杏仁。
messages.en: Yes, it had almonds added before baking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用杏仁串起两个场景：树上结出杏仁，厨房里给蛋糕加入杏仁；这是情景联想记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression of dissatisfaction, or a tendency to quarrel with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指表达不满的抱怨，也指容易与别人争吵的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon, jew tendenza li wieħed jargumenta u jiġġieled ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱怨；表达不满的话或行为。
好争吵、爱与人争执的性情或倾向。

formal.mt: It-tendenza għat-tlewwim fixklet il-kooperazzjoni bejn il-membri tal-grupp.
formal.en: The tendency towards quarrelsomeness hindered cooperation among the group members.
formal.zh: 好争吵的倾向妨碍了小组成员之间的合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm dan it-tlewwim kollu dwar is-servizz? Mark: Għax ilna siegħa nistennew u ħadd ma kellimna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there all this complaint about the service? Mark: Because we have been waiting for an hour and nobody has spoken to us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家为什么都在抱怨这里的服务？马克：因为我们等了一个小时，都没人来招呼。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dan it-tlewwim kollu dwar is-servizz?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dan it-tlewwim kollu dwar is-servizz?
messages.zh: 大家为什么都在抱怨这里的服务？
messages.en: Why is there all this complaint about the service?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilna siegħa nistennew u ħadd ma kellimna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilna siegħa nistennew u ħadd ma kellimna.
messages.zh: 因为我们等了一个小时，都没人来招呼。
messages.en: Because we have been waiting for an hour and nobody has spoken to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把不满的声音分成两层：针对一件事是抱怨，经常与人争执则是好争吵的性情；两层都用名词来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of applying colour or making something colourful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指给某物着色，或使其具有丰富色彩的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti tal-kulur lil xi ħaġa jew iż-żieda ta' kuluri biex issir ikkulurita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 着色、涂色的行为。
使某物色彩丰富、鲜艳多彩的行为。

formal.mt: L-attività ta' tlewwin għenet lit-tfal jagħżlu kuluri differenti għal kull parti tat-tpinġija.
formal.en: The colouring activity helped the children choose different colours for each part of the drawing.
formal.zh: 这项涂色活动帮助孩子们为图画的各个部分选择不同颜色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nagħmlu wara li npinġu? Mark: Nibdew it-tlewwin; il-lapsijiet tal-kulur qegħdin fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What will we do after we draw? Mark: We will start colouring; the coloured pencils are on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：画完以后我们做什么？马克：开始涂色，彩色铅笔在桌上。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nagħmlu wara li npinġu?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nagħmlu wara li npinġu?
messages.zh: 画完以后我们做什么？
messages.en: What will we do after we draw?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew it-tlewwin; il-lapsijiet tal-kulur qegħdin fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew it-tlewwin; il-lapsijiet tal-kulur qegħdin fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 开始涂色，彩色铅笔在桌上。
messages.en: We will start colouring; the coloured pencils are on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一盒彩色铅笔把黑白图画逐步变得五彩缤纷，用整个涂色过程记住这个表示活动的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Quarreling or arguing between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人之间争吵、吵嘴的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tilwim jew argumenti bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 争吵；吵嘴；相互争执。

formal.mt: It-tlewwiq bejn il-parteċipanti fixkel id-diskussjoni u ttardja d-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The quarreling between the participants disrupted the discussion and delayed the decision.
formal.zh: 参与者之间的争吵扰乱了讨论，延误了决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan it-tlewwiq kollu? Mark: Qed nargumentaw dwar min għandu jaħsel il-platti. Maja: Aħsluhom flimkien u tieqfu targumentaw!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's all this quarreling? Mark: We're arguing about who should wash the dishes. Maja: Wash them together and stop arguing!
colloquial.zh: Maja：怎么吵成这样？Mark：我们在争谁该洗碗。Maja：一起洗，别吵了！

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tlewwiq kollu?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tlewwiq kollu?
messages.zh: 怎么吵成这样？
messages.en: What's all this quarreling?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nargumentaw dwar min għandu jaħsel il-platti.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nargumentaw dwar min għandu jaħsel il-platti.
messages.zh: 我们在争谁该洗碗。
messages.en: We're arguing about who should wash the dishes.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħsluhom flimkien u tieqfu targumentaw!
messages.mt_standard: Aħsluhom flimkien u tieqfu targumentaw!
messages.zh: 一起洗，别吵了！
messages.en: Wash them together and stop arguing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlewwiq 配上两个人为洗碗吵嘴的画面，记住它表示争吵这一行为。

gloss_zh: 弄脏自己；变脏，尤指婴幼儿

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of getting dirty or soiling oneself, especially referring to infants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变脏或弄脏自己的过程，尤其用于婴幼儿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li wieħed jitħammeġ, speċjalment meta wieħed jitkellem fuq trabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变脏；弄脏自己，尤其用于婴幼儿。

formal.mt: It-tlewwit waqt l-ikel huwa komuni meta t-tarbija tibda tiekol waħedha.
formal.en: Getting dirty during meals is common when a baby begins to eat independently.
formal.zh: 宝宝开始自己吃东西时，吃得脏兮兮是常见的情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara t-tarbija, għandha l-ikel ma' wiċċha kollu! Pawlu: Dan it-tlewwit kollu minn ftit soppa? Sara: Iva, se nġib ċarruta biex innaddafha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at the baby, there's food all over her face! Pawlu: All this mess from a little soup? Sara: Yes, I'll get a cloth to clean her up.
colloquial.zh: Sara：看宝宝，吃得满脸都是！Pawlu：就吃了一点汤，怎么弄得这么脏？Sara：是啊，我去拿块布给她擦擦。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara t-tarbija, għandha l-ikel ma' wiċċha kollu!
messages.mt_standard: Ara t-tarbija, għandha l-ikel ma' wiċċha kollu!
messages.zh: 看宝宝，吃得满脸都是！
messages.en: Look at the baby, there's food all over her face!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tlewwit kollu minn ftit soppa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tlewwit kollu minn ftit soppa?
messages.zh: 就吃了一点汤，怎么弄得这么脏？
messages.en: All this mess from a little soup?

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nġib ċarruta biex innaddafha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nġib ċarruta biex innaddafha.
messages.zh: 是啊，我去拿块布给她擦擦。
messages.en: Yes, I'll get a cloth to clean her up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象宝宝把汤吃到脸上和围嘴上，用 tlewwit 记住弄脏自己的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of moving material with a shovel or working soil with a spade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指用铲子移动材料，或用锹翻动、整理土壤的劳动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih jitmexxa materjal b'pala jew tinħadem il-ħamrija b'pala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用铲子铲起、移动材料的动作或劳动。
用锹挖土或翻土的动作或劳动。

formal.mt: It-tlewwiħ tal-ħamrija sar qabel it-tħawwil biex l-art tkun lesta.
formal.en: The soil was spaded before planting to prepare the ground.
formal.zh: 种植前进行了翻土，以准备好土地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad fadal ħafna tlewwiħ tar-ramel? Mark: Ftit biss; għinni nimla dan il-karrettun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there much sand shovelling left? Mark: Just a little; help me fill this wheelbarrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：还有很多沙子要铲吗？马克：只剩一点了，帮我装满这辆手推车吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal ħafna tlewwiħ tar-ramel?
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal ħafna tlewwiħ tar-ramel?
messages.zh: 还有很多沙子要铲吗？
messages.en: Is there much sand shovelling left?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit biss; għinni nimla dan il-karrettun.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit biss; għinni nimla dan il-karrettun.
messages.zh: 只剩一点了，帮我装满这辆手推车吧。
messages.en: Just a little; help me fill this wheelbarrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象铲子一下一下搬沙、翻土，把整个劳动过程装进一个名词里，记住它表示铲运或翻土这项活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The growth and development of almonds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扁桃果生长、发育的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkabbir u l-iżvilupp tal-lewż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扁桃果的生长、发育。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tlewwiż fil-ġnien u rreġistraw il-bidliet fid-daqs tal-frott.
formal.en: The students observed almond growth in the garden and recorded changes in the size of the fruit.
formal.zh: 学生们在园中观察扁桃果的生长，并记录果实大小的变化。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'qed tikteb fuq il-lewż? Ġanni: Qed nieħu noti dwar it-tlewwiż. Lina: Mela ejja nieħdu ritratt illum u ieħor il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Lina: What are you writing about the almonds? Ġanni: I'm taking notes on almond growth. Lina: Then let's take a photo today and another next week.
colloquial.zh: Lina：你在写扁桃果的什么呢？Ġanni：我在记录它们的生长。Lina：那我们今天拍张照片，下周再拍一张吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tikteb fuq il-lewż?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tikteb fuq il-lewż?
messages.zh: 你在写扁桃果的什么呢？
messages.en: What are you writing about the almonds?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nieħu noti dwar it-tlewwiż.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nieħu noti dwar it-tlewwiż.
messages.zh: 我在记录它们的生长。
messages.en: I'm taking notes on almond growth.

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja nieħdu ritratt illum u ieħor il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja nieħdu ritratt illum u ieħor il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.zh: 那我们今天拍张照片，下周再拍一张吧。
messages.en: Then let's take a photo today and another next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlewwiż 与连续拍照观察扁桃果长大的画面绑定，记的是生长过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut or shaped with an adze, referring to wood; also, to be turned over with a hoe, referring to soil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指木材被锛子削切、修整；也指土壤被锄头翻动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' jew jissawwar b'lexxuna, meta jkun injam; jinqaleb b'mgħażqa, meta jkun ħamrija.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be cut (used of wood to which an adze is applied)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被锛子削切、修整，用于木材。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be turned over with a hoe
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被锄头翻动、锄翻，用于土壤。

collocations.en: the timber was dressed with an adze
the soil is turned over with a hoe

formal.mt: L-injam tlexxen b'lexxuna biex il-wiċċ tiegħu jsir aktar uniformi.
formal.en: The timber was dressed with an adze to make its surface more even.
formal.zh: 这块木材用锛子削整过，使表面更加平整。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħamrija trid titlexxen qabel niżirgħu? Toni: Biex tinħall u tkun aktar faċli biex naħdmuha. Maja: Tajjeb, se nġib il-mgħażqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the soil need to be turned over before we sow? Toni: To loosen it and make it easier to work. Maja: All right, I'll get the hoe.
colloquial.zh: Maja：播种前为什么要把土锄翻？Toni：为了把土弄松，方便耕作。Maja：好，我去拿锄头。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħamrija trid titlexxen qabel niżirgħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħamrija trid titlexxen qabel niżirgħu?
messages.zh: 播种前为什么要把土锄翻？
messages.en: Why does the soil need to be turned over before we sow?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex tinħall u tkun aktar faċli biex naħdmuha.
messages.mt_standard: Biex tinħall u tkun aktar faċli biex naħdmuha.
messages.zh: 为了把土弄松，方便耕作。
messages.en: To loosen it and make it easier to work.

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nġib il-mgħażqa.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nġib il-mgħażqa.
messages.zh: 好，我去拿锄头。
messages.en: All right, I'll get the hoe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅受事画面记 tlexxen：木材被锛削，土壤被锄翻；注意主语是被加工的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The dressing of timber with an adze or similar tool; also, the turning over of soil with a hoe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锛子或类似工具削整木材的作业；也指用锄头翻土的作业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol ta' tiswir tal-injam b'lexxuna jew għodda simili, jew ta' qlib tal-ħamrija b'mgħażqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: dressing of timber (using an adze or similar implement)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锛子或类似工具削切、修整木材的作业。

sense_translations.en_definition: turning over soil with a hoe
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锄头翻土的作业。

collocations.en: the turning over of soil with a hoe

formal.mt: Waqt it-tlexxin tal-injam, il-ħaddiem neħħa saffi rqaq b'lexxuna biex jirranġa l-wiċċ.
formal.en: While dressing the timber, the worker removed thin layers with an adze to even out the surface.
formal.zh: 在锛削修整木材时，工人用锛子削去薄层，使表面平整。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Lestejt it-tlexxin tal-ħamrija? Ġużeppi: Għad baqagħli din ir-rokna, u mbagħad nistgħu niżirgħu. Rita: Se nġib iż-żrieragħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you finished hoeing over the soil? Ġużeppi: I've still got this corner left, and then we can sow. Rita: I'll get the seeds.
colloquial.zh: Rita：土都锄翻好了吗？Ġużeppi：还剩这个角落，弄完就可以播种了。Rita：我去拿种子。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt it-tlexxin tal-ħamrija?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt it-tlexxin tal-ħamrija?
messages.zh: 土都锄翻好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished hoeing over the soil?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad baqagħli din ir-rokna, u mbagħad nistgħu niżirgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għad baqagħli din ir-rokna, u mbagħad nistgħu niżirgħu.
messages.zh: 还剩这个角落，弄完就可以播种了。
messages.en: I've still got this corner left, and then we can sow.

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nġib iż-żrieragħ.
messages.mt_standard: Se nġib iż-żrieragħ.
messages.zh: 我去拿种子。
messages.en: I'll get the seeds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlexxin 当作作业名称来记：一边削整木材，一边锄翻土壤，两个场景都强调这项劳动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of using the voice to produce sounds or speak words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用嗓音发出声音或说出话语的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu tal-vuċi biex jinħarġu ħsejjes jew jingħad kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发声；用嗓音发出声音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tipproduċi ħsejjes bil-vuċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话；用口头语言表达。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li titkellem.

formal.mt: Fit-taħriġ tal-qari, it-tleħħin ċar tal-kliem jgħin lis-semmiegħa jifhmu t-test.
formal.en: In reading practice, voicing the words clearly helps listeners understand the text.
formal.zh: 在朗读练习中，清晰地读出词语有助于听众理解文本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien it-tleħħin tiegħi waqt il-qari? Pawlu: Kien ċar, imma aqra ftit aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was my vocal delivery while reading? Pawlu: It was clear, but read a little more slowly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我朗读时说得怎么样？保罗：说得很清楚，不过再读慢一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien it-tleħħin tiegħi waqt il-qari?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien it-tleħħin tiegħi waqt il-qari?
messages.zh: 我朗读时说得怎么样？
messages.en: How was my vocal delivery while reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ċar, imma aqra ftit aktar bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ċar, imma aqra ftit aktar bil-mod.
messages.zh: 说得很清楚，不过再读慢一点。
messages.en: It was clear, but read a little more slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tleħħin 和朗读时开口发声的画面联系起来：先想到“发声”，再想到“说话”，两个义项都作名词。

gloss_zh: 被穿上衣服；由别人给穿衣

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be dressed in clothes by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由别人给穿上衣服，着重表示接受穿衣这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata l-ħwejjeġ fuq ġismu minn persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被穿上衣服；由别人给穿衣。

collocations.en: he was dressed by his mother
collocations.zh: 他由母亲给穿好了衣服

collocations.en: he was dressed for the celebration
collocations.zh: 他被穿戴好去参加庆典

formal.mt: It-tifel tlibbes minn ommu qabel ma telaq għall-iskola.
formal.en: The boy was dressed by his mother before leaving for school.
formal.zh: 男孩去上学前，母亲给他穿好了衣服。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tifel tlibbes diġà? Pawlu: Iva, imma għad irid jilbes iż-żraben. Anna: Tajjeb, se ngħinu jorbot il-lazzijiet.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has the boy been dressed already? Pawlu: Yes, but he still needs to put his shoes on. Anna: All right, I'll help him tie his shoelaces.
colloquial.zh: Anna：孩子已经穿好衣服了吗？Pawlu：是的，不过还得穿鞋。Anna：好，我去帮他系鞋带。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel tlibbes diġà?
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel tlibbes diġà?
messages.zh: 孩子已经穿好衣服了吗？
messages.en: Has the boy been dressed already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għad irid jilbes iż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għad irid jilbes iż-żraben.
messages.zh: 是的，不过还得穿鞋。
messages.en: Yes, but he still needs to put his shoes on.

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se ngħinu jorbot il-lazzijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se ngħinu jorbot il-lazzijiet.
messages.zh: 好，我去帮他系鞋带。
messages.en: All right, I'll help him tie his shoelaces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子站着让大人帮忙套上衣服，tlibbes 的观察重点是接受穿衣动作的孩子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting clothes on another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给另一个人穿上衣服的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ipoġġi l-ħwejjeġ fuq persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人穿衣服的行为。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tlibbis tat-tarbija, il-ġenitur għandu jiċċekkja li l-ħwejjeġ ma jkunux issikkati wisq.
formal.en: When dressing the baby, the parent should check that the clothes are not too tight.
formal.zh: 给宝宝穿衣时，家长应检查衣服是否过紧。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek bżonn għajnuna fit-tlibbis tat-tarbija? Sara: Iva, għaddili l-qalziet, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Hawn hu, u l-kalzetti qegħdin ħdejk.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you need help dressing the baby? Sara: Yes, pass me the trousers, please. Mark: Here they are, and the socks are next to you.
colloquial.zh: Mark：给宝宝穿衣需要帮忙吗？Sara：需要，请把裤子递给我。Mark：给你，袜子就在你旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek bżonn għajnuna fit-tlibbis tat-tarbija?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek bżonn għajnuna fit-tlibbis tat-tarbija?
messages.zh: 给宝宝穿衣需要帮忙吗？
messages.en: Do you need help dressing the baby?

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għaddili l-qalziet, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għaddili l-qalziet, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 需要，请把裤子递给我。
messages.en: Yes, pass me the trousers, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hu, u l-kalzetti qegħdin ħdejk.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hu, u l-kalzetti qegħdin ħdejk.
messages.zh: 给你，袜子就在你旁边。
messages.en: Here they are, and the socks are next to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把给宝宝穿上衣、套裤子的整个过程命名为 tlibbis，记住这是行为名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lick; figuratively, to flatter someone excessively in order to gain favor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用舌头舔；引申指为了讨好别人而过分奉承、拍马屁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi lsienu fuq xi ħaġa; figurattivament, ifaħħar lil xi ħadd iżżejjed biex jikseb il-favur tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舔；用舌头接触或扫过某物。
表现得阿谀奉承；为了讨好他人而一味恭维、迎合。
拍马屁；巴结，通常指为了得到好处而奉承有权势的人，带贬义。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-kelb tliegħaq il-platt wara li spiċċa l-ikel.
formal.en: In the story, the dog licked the plate after finishing its food.
formal.zh: 故事中，狗吃完食物后舔了舔盘子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd jgħid li Mark jitliegħaq mal-kap? Toni: Għax dejjem ifaħħru, anki meta ma jaqbilx miegħu. Maja: Mela qed jipprova jogħġbu b'kull mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does everyone say Mark brown-noses the boss? Toni: Because he always praises him, even when he disagrees with him. Maja: So he's trying to please him in every way.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么大家都说 Mark 拍上司的马屁？Toni：因为他总是夸上司，连不赞同的时候也夸。Maja：那他是在想方设法讨好上司。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd jgħid li Mark jitliegħaq mal-kap?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd jgħid li Mark jitliegħaq mal-kap?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都说 Mark 拍上司的马屁？
messages.en: Why does everyone say Mark brown-noses the boss?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem ifaħħru, anki meta ma jaqbilx miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem ifaħħru, anki meta ma jaqbilx miegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他总是夸上司，连不赞同的时候也夸。
messages.en: Because he always praises him, even when he disagrees with him.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed jipprova jogħġbu b'kull mod.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed jipprova jogħġbu b'kull mod.
messages.zh: 那他是在想方设法讨好上司。
messages.en: So he's trying to please him in every way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时并排放两幅画：小狗舔盘子，同事过分恭维上司；分别记住字面义和带贬义的奉承义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To breathe heavily or with a wheezing sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼吸急促、费力，或呼吸时发出喘鸣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieħu n-nifs b'mod qawwi jew b'ħoss ta' tisfir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大口喘气；费力地呼吸
喘鸣；呼吸时发出类似哨音的声音

formal.mt: Wara l-ġirja, Mark tlieheġ għal ftit minuti qabel ma n-nifs tiegħu reġa' sar regolari.
formal.en: After the run, Mark panted for a few minutes before his breathing became regular again.
formal.zh: 跑步后，马克大口喘了几分钟，呼吸才恢复平稳。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark tlieheġ hekk? Ben: Għax ġera biex jilħaq ix-xarabank.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why was Mark panting like that? Ben: Because he ran to catch the bus.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克刚才为什么喘得那么厉害？本：因为他跑着去赶公交车。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark tlieheġ hekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark tlieheġ hekk?
messages.zh: 马克刚才为什么喘得那么厉害？
messages.en: Why was Mark panting like that?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ġera biex jilħaq ix-xarabank.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ġera biex jilħaq ix-xarabank.
messages.zh: 因为他跑着去赶公交车。
messages.en: Because he ran to catch the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象跑着赶上公交车后大口喘气的画面，把这个词与费力呼吸联系起来；若呼吸还带哨音，就对应喘鸣义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number three hundred, equal to three groups of one hundred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词三百，即三个一百相加所得的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 300, jiġifieri tliet gruppi ta' mija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三百。

formal.mt: In-numru totali ta' parteċipanti fil-konferenza kien tliet mija.
formal.en: The total number of participants at the conference was three hundred.
formal.zh: 会议参加者的总人数为三百。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm hemm siġġijiet fis-sala? Lara: Hemm tliet mija, u kollha huma lesti.
colloquial.en: Mark: How many chairs are there in the hall? Lara: There are three hundred, and they are all ready.
colloquial.zh: Mark：大厅里有多少把椅子？Lara：有三百把，都准备好了。

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hemm siġġijiet fis-sala?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hemm siġġijiet fis-sala?
messages.zh: 大厅里有多少把椅子？
messages.en: How many chairs are there in the hall?

messages.speaker: Lara (活动助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tliet mija, u kollha huma lesti.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tliet mija, u kollha huma lesti.
messages.zh: 有三百把，都准备好了。
messages.en: There are three hundred, and they are all ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象三叠各一百张的卡片，把 tliet mija 整组贴在旁边，用“三个一百”记住三百。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number ninety-three, equal to ninety plus three.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词九十三，表示九十加三的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 93, jiġifieri disgħin u tlieta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九十三；数字93

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jinsab f'paġna tlieta u disgħin tal-ktieb.
formal.en: The exercise is on page ninety-three of the book.
formal.zh: 这道练习在书的第九十三页。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema paġna għandna naqraw? Pawlu: Paġna tlieta u disgħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which page should we read? Pawlu: Page ninety-three.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们应该读哪一页？保罗：第九十三页。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)

messages.mt_standard: Liema paġna għandna naqraw?

colloquial.zh: 劳拉：路上花了多久？本：六十三分钟，比一小时多一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三重的；为某一数量或程度的三倍的。
