teaching_sense.en_definition: To attack back after being attacked.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为回应先前的攻击而发动攻击；反击。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have bait attached, as a fishing hook does before use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被放上或装上诱饵，例如鱼钩在使用前被挂上鱼饵。

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话这一行为，或把具体词语、想法说出来的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitkellem jew jesprimi kliem jew ħsibijiet bil-fomm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话这一行为或活动。
把某个词语、句子或内容说出来的行为。

collocations.en: the spoken expression of a thought

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jiffoka fuq it-tlissin tal-kliem b'mod ċar u b'ritmu kalm.
formal.en: The exercise focuses on uttering words clearly and at a calm pace.
formal.zh: 这项练习侧重于以平稳的节奏清楚地说出词语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tlissin ta' dan il-kliem għadu diffiċli għalija. Pawlu: Ejja ngħiduh flimkien, bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Saying these words is still difficult for me. Pawlu: Let's say them together, slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：把这些词说出来对我来说还是很难。保罗：我们一起慢慢说吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tlissin ta' dan il-kliem għadu diffiċli għalija.
messages.mt_standard: It-tlissin ta' dan il-kliem għadu diffiċli għalija.
messages.zh: 把这些词说出来对我来说还是很难。
messages.en: Saying these words is still difficult for me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ngħiduh flimkien, bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ngħiduh flimkien, bil-mod.
messages.zh: 我们一起慢慢说吧。
messages.en: Let's say them together, slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“开口说话这个动作”记 tlissin；再接具体内容，就想到“把某事说出来”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The long attributive form of the numeral tlieta, used before a noun to express a quantity of three.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词 tlieta 的长定语形式，放在名词前表示数量为三。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma attributtiva twila tan-numru tlieta, li tintuża qabel nom biex tindika kwantità ta' tlieta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: tlieta 的长定语形式，用于修饰后面的名词，表示“三”。

formal.mt: Il-kors se jdum tlitt ijiem u se jinkludi eżerċizzji prattiċi.
formal.en: The course will last three days and will include practical exercises.
formal.zh: 课程将持续三天，并包含实践练习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm se ddumu hemm? Daniel: Tlitt ijiem, u mbagħad nerġgħu lura.
colloquial.en: Sara: How long will you stay there? Daniel: Three days, and then we'll come back.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们要在那里待多久？丹尼尔：三天，然后我们就回来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm se ddumu hemm?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm se ddumu hemm?
messages.zh: 你们要在那里待多久？
messages.en: How long will you stay there?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlitt ijiem, u mbagħad nerġgħu lura.
messages.mt_standard: Tlitt ijiem, u mbagħad nerġgħu lura.
messages.zh: 三天，然后我们就回来。
messages.en: Three days, and then we'll come back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlitt ijiem 整体记成“三天”，看到 tlitt 就想到它在后面的名词前表示三。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 3,000, equal to three groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值三千，即三个一千相加所得的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 3,000, jiġifieri elf għal tliet darbiet.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, tlitt elef persuna ħadu sehem fl-attività.
formal.en: According to the report, three thousand people took part in the event.
formal.zh: 据报告，有三千人参加了这项活动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-karozza? Anna: Tlitt elef ewro. Trid taraha minn ġewwa?
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this car cost? Anna: Three thousand euros. Would you like to see the inside?
colloquial.zh: 马克：这辆车多少钱？安娜：三千欧元。你想看看车里面吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (买家)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm tiswa din il-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm tiswa din il-karozza?
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this car cost?

messages.speaker: Anna (卖家)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlitt elef ewro. Trid taraha minn ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Tlitt elef ewro. Trid taraha minn ġewwa?
messages.zh: 三千欧元。你想看看车里面吗？
messages.en: Three thousand euros. Would you like to see the inside?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中摆出三组一千，把 tlitt elef 与数字 3,000 对应，再接货币或人数练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be restrained or brought under control, or to have a bridle put on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到约束或控制；也指马等动物被套上马勒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżamm taħt kontroll jew jitqiegħedlu lġiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到约束、限制或控制。
被套上马勒。

formal.mt: L-entużjażmu għall-proġett tliġġem minħabba n-nuqqas ta' fondi.
formal.en: Enthusiasm for the project was restrained by the lack of funds.
formal.zh: 由于缺乏资金，人们对该项目的热情受到了抑制。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Iż-żiemel lest għar-rikba? Pawlu: Iva, diġà tliġġem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the horse ready for the ride? Pawlu: Yes, it has already been bridled.
colloquial.zh: Sara：马已经准备好供人骑乘了吗？Pawlu：是的，已经套好马勒了。

messages.speaker: Sara (骑术学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żiemel lest għar-rikba?
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żiemel lest għar-rikba?
messages.zh: 马已经准备好供人骑乘了吗？
messages.en: Is the horse ready for the ride?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (骑术教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà tliġġem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà tliġġem.
messages.zh: 是的，已经套好马勒了。
messages.en: Yes, it has already been bridled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“马被套上马勒”和“热情受到控制”并排画出，用两个受控场景记忆两个义项；这只是记忆联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting a bridle on a horse, or restraint that keeps something under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给马套上马勒这一行为；也指使事物受到控制的约束或抑制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li jitqiegħed lġiem lil żiemel, jew it-trażżin ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给马套上马勒的行为。
约束；限制；抑制。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħriġ dwar it-tliġġim taż-żiemel qabel ir-rikba.
formal.en: The course includes training in bridling a horse before riding.
formal.zh: 课程包括骑乘前给马套马勒的训练。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien diffiċli waqt id-diskussjoni? Mark: It-tliġġim tar-rabja; ridt nibqa' kalm.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was difficult during the discussion? Mark: Keeping my anger in check; I wanted to stay calm.
colloquial.zh: Maja：讨论时最难的是什么？Mark：克制愤怒；我想保持冷静。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien diffiċli waqt id-diskussjoni?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien diffiċli waqt id-diskussjoni?
messages.zh: 讨论时最难的是什么？
messages.en: What was difficult during the discussion?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tliġġim tar-rabja; ridt nibqa' kalm.
messages.mt_standard: It-tliġġim tar-rabja; ridt nibqa' kalm.
messages.zh: 克制愤怒；我想保持冷静。
messages.en: Keeping my anger in check; I wanted to stay calm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给两张动作照片写标题：“套马勒这件事”和“克制愤怒这件事”。用“这件事”提醒自己 tliġġim 是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ascent or upward movement, including rising or soaring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向上移动或升高的过程，包括攀升、升起和腾升。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment lejn post ogħla, bħal meta xi ħadd jitla' jew xi ħaġa togħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上升；升腾；升起；向高处攀升。

formal.mt: It-tlugħ tal-muntanja beda kmieni filgħodu u sar taħt is-superviżjoni ta' gwida.
formal.en: The ascent of the mountain began early in the morning and took place under a guide's supervision.
formal.zh: 登山活动于清晨开始，并在向导的指导下进行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tara tlugħ ix-xemx għada? Ben: Iva, imma rridu nqumu kmieni ħafna!
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to watch the sunrise tomorrow? Ben: Yes, but we'll have to get up very early!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你明天想看日出吗？本：想，不过我们得起得特别早！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tara tlugħ ix-xemx għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tara tlugħ ix-xemx għada?
messages.zh: 你明天想看日出吗？
messages.en: Do you want to watch the sunrise tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rridu nqumu kmieni ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rridu nqumu kmieni ħafna!
messages.zh: 想，不过我们得起得特别早！
messages.en: Yes, but we'll have to get up very early!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tlugħ 画一个向上的箭头：太阳升起、人往山上走，都抓住“向上”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Ascension of Christ into heaven after his resurrection, or the church feast commemorating that event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督复活后升入天堂的事件，也指教会纪念这一事件的耶稣升天节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tlugħ ta' Kristu fis-sema wara l-qawmien tiegħu mill-mewt, jew il-festa tal-Knisja li tfakkar din il-ġrajja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Ascension (Christ’s rising to heaven after being resurrected; the ecclesiastic feast commemorating this)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 耶稣升天，即基督复活后升入天堂；也指纪念这一事件的教会节日。

collocations.en: the feast of the Ascension of the Lord
the celebration of the Ascension of the Lord

formal.mt: Il-festa ta' Tlugħ il-Mulej fis-Sema tfakkar it-tlugħ ta' Kristu fis-sema wara l-qawmien tiegħu mill-mewt.
formal.en: The feast of the Ascension of the Lord commemorates Christ's ascent into heaven after his resurrection.
formal.zh: 耶稣升天节纪念基督复活后升入天堂的事件。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi tfisser il-festa ta' Tlugħ il-Mulej fis-Sema? Pawlu: Tfakkar meta Kristu tela' fis-sema wara li qam mill-mewt.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does the feast of the Ascension of the Lord mean? Pawlu: It commemorates Christ going up into heaven after he rose from the dead.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：耶稣升天节有什么含义？保罗：它纪念基督从死者中复活后升入天堂。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-festa ta' Tlugħ il-Mulej fis-Sema?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-festa ta' Tlugħ il-Mulej fis-Sema?
messages.zh: 耶稣升天节有什么含义？
messages.en: What does the feast of the Ascension of the Lord mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfakkar meta Kristu tela' fis-sema wara li qam mill-mewt.
messages.mt_standard: Tfakkar meta Kristu tela' fis-sema wara li qam mill-mewt.
messages.zh: 它纪念基督从死者中复活后升入天堂。
messages.en: It commemorates Christ going up into heaven after he rose from the dead.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个名称与“基督复活后升天”的画面配对；遇到 festa，就想到纪念这件事的节日。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Departure or the act of leaving; also a starting point for a journey, activity, or discussion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出发或离开的行为，也可表示旅程、活动或讨论的起点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin jew l-att li wieħed jitlaq minn post; ukoll il-punt minn fejn jibda vjaġġ, attività jew diskussjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出发；启程。
离开这一行为；离去。
起点；出发点。

formal.mt: Il-pjazza ewlenija ntgħażlet bħala l-punt tat-tluq tal-mixja, u l-ħin tat-tluq ġie stabbilit għad-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The main square was chosen as the starting point of the walk, and the departure time was set for nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 主广场被选为步行活动的起点，出发时间定于上午九点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ħin hu t-tluq għada? Mark: Fit-tmienja. Niltaqgħu fil-punt tat-tluq għaxar minuti qabel.
colloquial.en: Sara: What time do we leave tomorrow? Mark: At eight. Let's meet at the starting point ten minutes beforehand.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：明天几点出发？马克：八点。我们提前十分钟在起点碰面吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ħin hu t-tluq għada?
messages.mt_standard: X'ħin hu t-tluq għada?
messages.zh: 明天几点出发？
messages.en: What time do we leave tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tmienja. Niltaqgħu fil-punt tat-tluq għaxar minuti qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tmienja. Niltaqgħu fil-punt tat-tluq għaxar minuti qabel.
messages.zh: 八点。我们提前十分钟在起点碰面吧。
messages.en: At eight. Let's meet at the starting point ten minutes beforehand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从地图起点迈步离开：tluq 可记“出发、离开”，punt tat-tluq 则记“起点”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dirty, or to have another substance mixed into something so that it is no longer pure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被弄脏，或因掺入其他物质而变得不纯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir maħmuġ, jew li jitħallat ma' sustanza oħra u ma jibqax pur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄脏，变得不干净。
被掺入其他物质而变得不纯。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li ż-żejt taż-żebbuġa tmallat b'żejt irħis qabel ma nbiegħ.
formal.en: The report states that the olive oil was adulterated with cheap oil before it was sold.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这批橄榄油在出售前被掺入了廉价油。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex biddilt il-qmis? Toni: Tmallat bit-tajn waqt li kont fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you change your shirt? Toni: It got dirty with mud while I was in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么换了衬衫？托尼：我在花园里时，衬衫被泥弄脏了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex biddilt il-qmis?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex biddilt il-qmis?
messages.zh: 你为什么换了衬衫？
messages.en: Why did you change your shirt?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmallat bit-tajn waqt li kont fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Tmallat bit-tajn waqt li kont fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 我在花园里时，衬衫被泥弄脏了。
messages.en: It got dirty with mud while I was in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把泥点落到衬衫上、杂油混进纯油里两幅画面并排记：共同点是原来的干净或纯净状态受到破坏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or manner of dressing in a shoddy or inelegant way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿戴粗劣、不雅致或搭配不得体的行为或方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-mod kif wieħed jilbes b'mod traskurat jew bla eleganza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己打扮得粗劣、不雅致或不得体。

formal.mt: Fil-kummentarju tiegħu dwar il-kostumi, il-kritiku ddeskriva t-tmallit tal-karattru prinċipali bħala għażla intenzjonata.
formal.en: In his commentary on the costumes, the critic described the main character's shoddy manner of dressing as a deliberate choice.
formal.zh: 评论家在服装评论中指出，主角粗劣不得体的打扮是一种刻意的安排。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-ġakketta tmur ma' dawn il-qalziet? Maja: Naħseb li le; biex tevita t-tmallit, ipprova l-ġakketta l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this jacket go with these trousers? Maja: I don't think so; to avoid looking shoddily dressed, try the other jacket.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这件夹克和这条裤子搭吗？玛雅：我觉得不搭；想避免穿得不得体，试试另一件夹克。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-ġakketta tmur ma' dawn il-qalziet?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-ġakketta tmur ma' dawn il-qalziet?
messages.zh: 这件夹克和这条裤子搭吗？
messages.en: Does this jacket go with these trousers?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li le; biex tevita t-tmallit, ipprova l-ġakketta l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li le; biex tevita t-tmallit, ipprova l-ġakketta l-oħra.
messages.zh: 我觉得不搭；想避免穿得不得体，试试另一件夹克。
messages.en: I don't think so; to avoid looking shoddily dressed, try the other jacket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前照镜子，发现外套和裤子搭得粗糙又不雅致；这个名词记的是穿戴方式，而不是某一件衣服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become disordered or spoiled, or to be wasted through careless use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被弄得混乱或糟糕，或因不善使用而被浪费、挥霍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitħarbat jew jiġi mħassar, jew li jinħela minħabba użu bla għaqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄乱、弄糟或搞得一团糟。
被挥霍或白白浪费。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-ġid tal-familja tmandar f'infiq bla kontroll.
formal.en: According to the report, the family's wealth was squandered through uncontrolled spending.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这个家庭的财富因毫无节制的开支而被挥霍了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għadna sejrin il-baħar illum? Toni: Il-pjan tmandar għax il-karozza ma tridx tistartja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are we still going to the seaside today? Toni: The plan got messed up because the car won't start.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们今天还去海边吗？托尼：车发动不了，计划全被打乱了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna sejrin il-baħar illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għadna sejrin il-baħar illum?
messages.zh: 我们今天还去海边吗？
messages.en: Are we still going to the seaside today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pjan tmandar għax il-karozza ma tridx tistartja.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pjan tmandar għax il-karozza ma tridx tistartja.
messages.zh: 车发动不了，计划全被打乱了。
messages.en: The plan got messed up because the car won't start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个结果画面记忆：安排表被搅成一团，钱袋被挥霍到空；遇到计划想到弄糟，遇到财富想到浪费。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become gentle, manageable, and willing to accept guidance or control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得温顺、容易管束，愿意接受引导或控制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir ġwejjed u aktar lest li jaċċetta l-gwida jew il-kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得温顺、驯服或容易管束。

formal.mt: Wara perjodu ta' taħriġ regolari u ġentili, il-kelb tmannas u beda jwieġeb aħjar għall-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: After a period of regular, gentle training, the dog became docile and began responding better to instructions.
formal.zh: 经过一段时间规律而温和的训练，这只狗变得温顺了，也开始更好地听从指令。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb għadu jiġbed ħafna ċ-ċinga? Sara: Le, issa tmannas u jimxi ħdejja bil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the dog still pull hard on the lead? Sara: No, he has become docile now and walks quietly beside me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只狗还会使劲拽牵引绳吗？萨拉：不会了，它现在变温顺了，会安静地走在我身边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb għadu jiġbed ħafna ċ-ċinga?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb għadu jiġbed ħafna ċ-ċinga?
messages.zh: 这只狗还会使劲拽牵引绳吗？
messages.en: Does the dog still pull hard on the lead?

messages.speaker: Sara (养狗的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa tmannas u jimxi ħdejja bil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa tmannas u jimxi ħdejja bil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 不会了，它现在变温顺了，会安静地走在我身边。
messages.en: No, he has become docile now and walks quietly beside me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本使劲拉绳的小狗，现在安静地跟着主人走；重点记住从难管到温顺的变化过程。

gloss_zh: 变得衰弱；变得虚弱不健

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become physically weak and infirm, with reduced strength or ability to move.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体变得衰弱、不健壮，体力或行动能力下降。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir dgħajjef f'ġismu u jonqsulu s-saħħa jew il-ħila li jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体变得虚弱、衰弱，行动或活动能力减退。

collocations.en: became weak and infirm after the illness
became weak and infirm with old age

formal.mt: Wara marda twila, ir-raġel tmantar u kellu bżonn l-għajnuna biex jimxi.
formal.en: After a long illness, the man became weak and infirm and needed help to walk.
formal.zh: 久病之后，这名男子身体变得衰弱，需要有人帮助才能行走。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu n-nannu dan l-aħħar? Mark: Tmantar xi ftit wara l-marda, u issa ngħinuh bit-taraġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: How has your grandfather been lately? Mark: He became a little frail after the illness, and now we help him on the stairs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你爷爷最近怎么样？马克：他病后身体衰弱了一些，现在上下楼梯我们都会扶着他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu n-nannu dan l-aħħar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu n-nannu dan l-aħħar?
messages.zh: 你爷爷最近怎么样？
messages.en: How has your grandfather been lately?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmantar xi ftit wara l-marda, u issa ngħinuh bit-taraġ.
messages.mt_standard: Tmantar xi ftit wara l-marda, u issa ngħinuh bit-taraġ.
messages.zh: 他病后身体衰弱了一些，现在上下楼梯我们都会扶着他。
messages.en: He became a little frail after the illness, and now we help him on the stairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用从前能独自上楼、后来需要人搀扶的画面记忆；这个动词强调身体逐渐或后来变得衰弱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or condition of becoming weaker, especially through a loss of physical strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得衰弱的过程或状态，尤指身体力量减退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-istat li fih wieħed isir aktar dgħajjef, speċjalment billi jitlef is-saħħa fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衰弱；身体力量或能力的减退。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tmantir fiżiku tal-pazjent u l-għajnuna li jeħtieġ fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The report describes the patient's physical enfeeblement and the help he needs in daily life.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这名患者身体衰弱的情况，以及他在日常生活中需要的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex in-nannu għandu bżonn aktar għajnuna? Sara: Minħabba t-tmantir; issa jgħejja anki wara mixja qasira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does your grandfather need more help? Sara: Because of his growing weakness; now he gets tired even after a short walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爷爷为什么需要更多帮助了？萨拉：因为身体衰弱了，现在连走一小段路都会累。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex in-nannu għandu bżonn aktar għajnuna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex in-nannu għandu bżonn aktar għajnuna?
messages.zh: 你爷爷为什么需要更多帮助了？
messages.en: Why does your grandfather need more help?

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tmantir; issa jgħejja anki wara mixja qasira.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tmantir; issa jgħejja anki wara mixja qasira.
messages.zh: 因为身体衰弱了，现在连走一小段路都会累。
messages.en: Because of his growing weakness; now he gets tired even after a short walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把体力想成慢慢下降的电量条，给这个下降过程贴上“衰弱”的名词标签；这样可与表示变弱的动词区别记忆。

gloss_zh: 得到供养或支持；得到维持或养护

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive the support or resources needed to live, or the care needed to remain in a particular condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到生活所需的供养或支持，或得到使某种状态得以保持的照料、养护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħata l-appoġġ jew ir-riżorsi meħtieġa biex jgħix, jew il-kura meħtieġa biex jibqa' f'ċerta kundizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到支持、资助或生活上的供养。
得到维持、保养或养护，使生活或状态得以保持。

collocations.zh: 得到养护，保持良好状态

formal.mt: Matul is-snin, il-bini tmantna f'kundizzjoni tajba permezz ta' xogħol regolari ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: Over the years, the building was maintained in good condition through regular maintenance work.
formal.zh: 多年来，这座建筑通过定期维护得到了妥善养护，一直保持良好状态。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għadda Mark sakemm sab xogħol? Toni: Għal ftit xhur tmantna bl-għajnuna tal-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark get by until he found a job? Toni: For a few months, he was supported with help from his family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克找到工作之前是怎么维持生活的？托尼：有几个月，他靠家人的帮助维持生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għadda Mark sakemm sab xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għadda Mark sakemm sab xogħol?
messages.zh: 马克找到工作之前是怎么维持生活的？
messages.en: How did Mark get by until he found a job?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal ftit xhur tmantna bl-għajnuna tal-familja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għal ftit xhur tmantna bl-għajnuna tal-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 有几个月，他靠家人的帮助维持生活。
messages.en: For a few months, he was supported with help from his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象家人提供生活费、工人定期养护房屋：前者让生活继续，后者让状态保持；共同记住“得到持续支持”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of carrying or moving materials, especially stones used in masonry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 搬运材料的活动，尤指砌筑工程中搬运石材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha jinġarr jew jitmexxa materjal, speċjalment il-ġebel użat fix-xogħol tal-bini.

sense_translations.en_definition: carrying (especially in the context of stone masonry)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 搬运，尤指石工或石砌工程中的石材搬运。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tax-xogħol jinkludi t-tmanwil tal-ġebel mill-post tal-ħażna sal-ħajt li qed jinbena.
formal.en: The work plan includes carrying the stones from the storage area to the wall being built.
formal.zh: 施工计划包括把石材从存放区搬运到正在砌筑的墙边。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se nagħmlu l-ewwel dalgħodu? Toni: Nibdew bit-tmanwil tal-ġebel; il-bennej għandu bżonnu ħdejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Mark: What shall we do first this morning? Toni: Let's start by carrying the stones; the mason needs them beside the wall.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天早上我们先做什么？托尼：先搬石材吧，石匠需要把石材放在墙边。

messages.speaker: Mark (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nagħmlu l-ewwel dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nagħmlu l-ewwel dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 今天早上我们先做什么？
messages.en: What shall we do first this morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (工友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew bit-tmanwil tal-ġebel; il-bennej għandu bżonnu ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew bit-tmanwil tal-ġebel; il-bennej għandu bżonnu ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 先搬石材吧，石匠需要把石材放在墙边。
messages.en: Let's start by carrying the stones; the mason needs them beside the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工人把一块块石头从料堆搬到墙边；记住这个名词指搬运这项活动，石砌工地是尤其典型的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive criticism or be spoken about in a way that lowers one's worth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到别人的批评，或被人用言语贬低价值、能力或地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġifieri li wieħed jirċievi kritika jew li ħaddieħor jitkellem fuqu b'mod li jnaqqaslu l-valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到批评；被指出缺点或错误。
受到言语贬低；被人说得一无是处或低人一等。

collocations.en: was criticised or put down in public

formal.mt: L-istudent tmaqdar quddiem il-klassi kollha minħabba żball żgħir fil-preżentazzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The student was criticised in front of the whole class because of a small mistake in his presentation.
formal.zh: 这名学生因为报告中的一个小错误，在全班面前受到了批评。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jerġa' jitkellem fil-laqgħa? Lara: Għax l-aħħar darba tmaqdar quddiem kulħadd, u issa qed jibża' jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Mark want to speak at the meeting again? Lara: Because last time he was put down in front of everyone, and now he's afraid to speak.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么不愿意再在会上发言？拉拉：因为上次他当着大家的面被贬低了，现在害怕开口。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jerġa' jitkellem fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jerġa' jitkellem fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 马克为什么不愿意再在会上发言？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark want to speak at the meeting again?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-aħħar darba tmaqdar quddiem kulħadd, u issa qed jibża' jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-aħħar darba tmaqdar quddiem kulħadd, u issa qed jibża' jitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为上次他当着大家的面被贬低了，现在害怕开口。
messages.en: Because last time he was put down in front of everyone, and now he's afraid to speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发言者被别人挑错或说得抬不起头，用 tmaqdar 记住“承受批评、遭到贬低”的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Criticism or an unfavourable reaction to a person, action, idea, or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对人、行为、想法或事物的批评，或表示不赞同的负面反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kritika jew reazzjoni negattiva għal persuna, azzjoni, idea jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 批评；指出缺点或表达否定评价。
对某事物的负面反应；不赞同或不满意的回应。

formal.mt: Il-proposta l-ġdida qanqlet tmaqdir qawwi fost ir-residenti minħabba n-nuqqas ta' konsultazzjoni.
formal.en: The new proposal drew strong criticism from residents because of the lack of consultation.
formal.zh: 由于缺乏意见征询，新提案引起了居民的强烈批评。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif laqgħuha l-idea tiegħek? Nina: Kien hemm ħafna tmaqdir, imma ħadd ma spjega x'għandi nbiddel.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did they receive your idea? Nina: There was a lot of criticism, but nobody explained what I should change.
colloquial.zh: 马克：他们对你的想法反应怎么样？妮娜：批评很多，可是没人解释我应该改什么。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif laqgħuha l-idea tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif laqgħuha l-idea tiegħek?
messages.zh: 他们对你的想法反应怎么样？
messages.en: How did they receive your idea?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna tmaqdir, imma ħadd ma spjega x'għandi nbiddel.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna tmaqdir, imma ħadd ma spjega x'għandi nbiddel.
messages.zh: 批评很多，可是没人解释我应该改什么。
messages.en: There was a lot of criticism, but nobody explained what I should change.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmaqdir 想成提案旁边一排否定意见：它指“批评、负面反应”这件事，可搭配“很多”或“强烈”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Grumbling about dissatisfaction, or remaining gloomy and dispirited.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不满而嘟囔抱怨，或情绪低落、提不起精神的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgergir minħabba nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon, jew qagħda ta' dwejjaq u nuqqas ta' ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘟囔抱怨；带着不满低声或反复发牢骚。
闷闷不乐；沉浸在低落情绪中，显得无精打采。

formal.mt: It-tmaqmiq kontinwu dwar l-ikel fixkel l-atmosfera waqt l-ikla tal-grupp.
formal.en: The constant grumbling about the food spoiled the atmosphere during the group meal.
formal.zh: 集体用餐时，对饭菜没完没了的嘟囔抱怨破坏了气氛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn meta tħassar il-vjaġġ, Pawlu qiegħed waħdu fil-kamra. Maja: Dak it-tmaqmiq kollu mhux se jgħinu; ejja nistednuh joħroġ magħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Since the trip was cancelled, Pawlu has been alone in his room. Maja: All that moping won't help him; let's invite him out with us.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：旅行取消以后，保罗就一直独自待在房间里。玛雅：这样一直闷闷不乐也帮不了他；我们叫他一起出去吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn meta tħassar il-vjaġġ, Pawlu qiegħed waħdu fil-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Minn meta tħassar il-vjaġġ, Pawlu qiegħed waħdu fil-kamra.
messages.zh: 旅行取消以后，保罗就一直独自待在房间里。
messages.en: Since the trip was cancelled, Pawlu has been alone in his room.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tmaqmiq kollu mhux se jgħinu; ejja nistednuh joħroġ magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tmaqmiq kollu mhux se jgħinu; ejja nistednuh joħroġ magħna.
messages.zh: 这样一直闷闷不乐也帮不了他；我们叫他一起出去吧。
messages.en: All that moping won't help him; let's invite him out with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 tmaqmiq：嘴里嘟嘟囔囔发牢骚，或独自坐着闷闷不乐；分别对应两个义项。

gloss_zh: 抱怨；哼哼唧唧地发牢骚

teaching_sense.en_definition: Complaining about dissatisfaction, especially in a persistent or whining manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达不满的抱怨，尤其指持续不断或带着哼唧语气的诉苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilmenti dwar xi nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon, speċjalment b'mod kontinwu jew b'ton ta' tgergir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱怨；诉说自己对某种情况的不满。
哼哼唧唧地抱怨；用惹人厌烦的诉苦语气发牢骚。

formal.mt: It-tmarmir dwar ix-xogħol kompla matul il-laqgħa, iżda ma tressqet ebda proposta konkreta.
formal.en: The complaining about work continued throughout the meeting, but no concrete proposal was put forward.
formal.zh: 整场会议中，对工作的抱怨一直不断，却没有人提出具体建议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad fadlilna ħafna mixi? Għajjejt! Mark: Nistrieħu ftit hawn, imma b'dan it-tmarmir kollu l-mixja tidher itwal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have we still got a lot of walking to do? I'm tired! Mark: Let's rest here for a bit, but all this whining makes the walk seem longer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们还要走很远吗？我累了！马克：在这里歇一会儿吧，不过这样一直哼哼唧唧地抱怨，会觉得路更长。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadlilna ħafna mixi? Għajjejt!
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadlilna ħafna mixi? Għajjejt!
messages.zh: 我们还要走很远吗？我累了！
messages.en: Have we still got a lot of walking to do? I'm tired!

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistrieħu ftit hawn, imma b'dan it-tmarmir kollu l-mixja tidher itwal.
messages.mt_standard: Nistrieħu ftit hawn, imma b'dan it-tmarmir kollu l-mixja tidher itwal.
messages.zh: 在这里歇一会儿吧，不过这样一直哼哼唧唧地抱怨，会觉得路更长。
messages.en: Let's rest here for a bit, but all this whining makes the walk seem longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmarmir 配上一路喊累、反复诉苦的声音，记住它既可指抱怨，也可强调哼哼唧唧的语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become bitter in feeling or attitude, especially after painful experiences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 情绪或态度变得苦涩、怨愤，尤其指经历痛苦之后的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġifieri li wieħed isir mimli mrar jew riżentiment, speċjalment wara esperjenzi ta' wġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得苦涩；心中逐渐充满怨愤。

collocations.en: became bitter because of the injustice
collocations.zh: 因遭遇不公而心生怨愤

formal.mt: Wara snin ta' trattament inġust, ir-raġel tmarrar u beda jitlef il-fiduċja fl-oħrajn.
formal.en: After years of unfair treatment, the man became bitter and began to lose trust in others.
formal.zh: 多年遭受不公平对待后，这名男子变得怨愤，并开始失去对别人的信任。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Pawlu kien dejjem ferrieħi. X'ġara? Sara: Minn meta tilef ix-xogħol, tmarrar u sar diffiċli għalih li jafda lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Nina: Pawlu used to be cheerful all the time. What happened? Sara: Since he lost his job, he has become bitter and finds it hard to trust people.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗以前总是很开朗。发生什么事了？萨拉：失业以后，他变得怨愤，很难再信任别人。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu kien dejjem ferrieħi. X'ġara?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu kien dejjem ferrieħi. X'ġara?
messages.zh: 保罗以前总是很开朗。发生什么事了？
messages.en: Pawlu used to be cheerful all the time. What happened?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn meta tilef ix-xogħol, tmarrar u sar diffiċli għalih li jafda lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Minn meta tilef ix-xogħol, tmarrar u sar diffiċli għalih li jafda lin-nies.
messages.zh: 失业以后，他变得怨愤，很难再信任别人。
messages.en: Since he lost his job, he has become bitter and finds it hard to trust people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人的笑容在挫折后渐渐消失，用 tmarrar 记“心境变苦”的变化，而不只是当下难过。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spreading of illness to others, or the process of becoming ill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疾病向他人传播，或原本未生病的人开始患病的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tixrid tal-mard lil ħaddieħor, jew il-proċess li fih wieħed jimrad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疾病的传播；把疾病传给他人。
患病；由未生病转为生病的过程。

collocations.en: the spreading of illness to others

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tmarrid fost il-ħaddiema u l-assenzi mix-xogħol matul ix-xitwa.
formal.en: The report describes workers becoming ill and their absences from work during the winter.
formal.zh: 报告描述了冬季工人患病以及缺勤的情况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex Anna tilfet tant lezzjonijiet dan ix-xahar? Lara: Minħabba t-tmarrid frekwenti tagħha; issa qed tipprova tlaħħaq max-xogħol tal-iskola.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why has Anna missed so many lessons this month? Lara: Because she has been getting ill so often; now she's trying to catch up with her schoolwork.
colloquial.zh: 马克：安娜这个月为什么缺了那么多课？拉拉：因为她频繁生病；现在正努力补上学校的功课。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Anna tilfet tant lezzjonijiet dan ix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Anna tilfet tant lezzjonijiet dan ix-xahar?
messages.zh: 安娜这个月为什么缺了那么多课？
messages.en: Why has Anna missed so many lessons this month?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tmarrid frekwenti tagħha; issa qed tipprova tlaħħaq max-xogħol tal-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tmarrid frekwenti tagħha; issa qed tipprova tlaħħaq max-xogħol tal-iskola.
messages.zh: 因为她频繁生病；现在正努力补上学校的功课。
messages.en: Because she has been getting ill so often; now she's trying to catch up with her schoolwork.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记 tmarrid：疾病从一人传向另一人，以及一个人开始生病；分别对应“传播”和“患病”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of causing someone or something to become bitter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物变得苦涩的行为或过程，也可指使人的内心充满苦楚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li jagħmel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa morra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变得苦涩；造成苦味或使人产生内心的苦楚。

collocations.en: the act of making life bitter
the causing of bitterness in the heart

formal.mt: Il-kittieb jiddeskrivi t-tmarrir tal-ħajja tal-protagonist permezz ta' sensiela ta' umiljazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The writer describes how a series of humiliations makes the protagonist's life bitter.
formal.zh: 作家描写了一连串羞辱如何使主人公的生活变得苦涩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex inhi din l-istorja? Nina: Fuq it-tmarrir tal-ħajja ta' familja minħabba tilwim li ma jieqaf qatt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this story about? Nina: About a family's life being made bitter by arguments that never stop.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事讲什么？妮娜：讲一家人的生活如何被无休无止的争吵弄得苦不堪言。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex inhi din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex inhi din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事讲什么？
messages.en: What is this story about?

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq it-tmarrir tal-ħajja ta' familja minħabba tilwim li ma jieqaf qatt.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq it-tmarrir tal-ħajja ta' familja minħabba tilwim li ma jieqaf qatt.
messages.zh: 讲一家人的生活如何被无休无止的争吵弄得苦不堪言。
messages.en: About a family's life being made bitter by arguments that never stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmarrir 记成“让生活变苦这件事”，与 tmarrar 的“变得苦涩”对照，重点抓住“使其变苦”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be struck with a hammer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到锤子的敲击；被人用锤子敲打。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġifieri li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jintlaqat b'martell.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be hit with a hammer
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被锤子击中；受到锤子的敲打。

formal.mt: Il-ħadid tmartel fuq l-inkwina sakemm ħa l-għamla mixtieqa.
formal.en: The iron was hammered on the anvil until it took the desired shape.
formal.zh: 铁料在铁砧上被锤打，直到形成所需的形状。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm dawn il-marki fuq il-metall? Pawlu: Għax tmartel bil-qawwa waqt ix-xogħol tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are there these marks on the metal? Pawlu: Because it was hammered forcefully during yesterday's work.
colloquial.zh: 马克：金属上为什么有这些痕迹？保罗：因为昨天干活时，它被锤子用力敲打过。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawn il-marki fuq il-metall?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawn il-marki fuq il-metall?
messages.zh: 金属上为什么有这些痕迹？
messages.en: Why are there these marks on the metal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tmartel bil-qawwa waqt ix-xogħol tal-bieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tmartel bil-qawwa waqt ix-xogħol tal-bieraħ.
messages.zh: 因为昨天干活时，它被锤子用力敲打过。
messages.en: Because it was hammered forcefully during yesterday's work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象铁砧上的金属挨了一锤，用 tmartel 记住“被锤打”；例句中的金属是承受敲击的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of striking something with a hammer, often repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锤子敲击物体的动作，常指连续敲打。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tolqot xi ħaġa bil-martell, spiss għal diversi drabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锤击；用锤子进行的敲打。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss tat-tmartil mill-ħanut tax-xogħol instema' fit-triq kollha.
formal.en: The sound of hammering from the workshop could be heard along the whole street.
formal.zh: 作坊里的锤击声整条街都听得见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Toni: Dak it-tmartil ta' missieri; qed isewwi s-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that noise? Toni: That's my father's hammering; he's fixing the chair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是什么声音？托尼：是我爸爸敲锤子的声音；他正在修椅子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss?
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tmartil ta' missieri; qed isewwi s-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tmartil ta' missieri; qed isewwi s-siġġu.
messages.zh: 是我爸爸敲锤子的声音；他正在修椅子。
messages.en: That's my father's hammering; he's fixing the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmartil 和修椅子时连续响起的锤声联系起来，记住它指锤击这个动作。

gloss_zh: 痛斥；对某人大怒；表示鄙视

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scold someone severely, become very angry with someone, or express contempt for them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 严厉斥责某人、对某人大发脾气，或向某人表示鄙视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċanfar lil xi ħadd bl-aħrax, jirrabja ħafna għalih, jew juri disprezz lejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狠狠地训斥；严厉而彻底地责骂。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be very angry at sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人非常生气；对某人大发雷霆。
对某人表示鄙视或轻蔑。

collocations.en: he became very angry because of the mistake
collocations.zh: 他因那个错误而大发脾气

formal.mt: Il-maniġer tmasħar mal-impjegat wara li dan injora t-twissijiet dwar is-sigurtà.
formal.en: The manager severely scolded the employee after he ignored the safety warnings.
formal.zh: 那名员工无视安全警告后，经理严厉训斥了他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu tmasħar miegħek? Toni: Għax wasalt tard u ma avżajtux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu scold you so harshly? Toni: Because I arrived late and didn't let him know.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么那么严厉地训你？托尼：因为我迟到了，也没提前告诉他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu tmasħar miegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu tmasħar miegħek?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么那么严厉地训你？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu scold you so harshly?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax wasalt tard u ma avżajtux.
messages.mt_standard: Għax wasalt tard u ma avżajtux.
messages.zh: 因为我迟到了，也没提前告诉他。
messages.en: Because I arrived late and didn't let him know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张愤怒的脸记 tmasħar：可能在狠狠训人，也可能表现为对某人大怒或表示轻蔑，具体看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of anger, especially when it becomes very intense or turns into rage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愤怒的情绪，尤其指强烈的怒气或暴怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' rabja, speċjalment meta tkun qawwija ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愤怒；生气的情绪。
暴怒；极其强烈的愤怒。

formal.mt: F'mument ta' tmasħin, il-parteċipant telaq mil-laqgħa qabel ma ntemmet id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: In a moment of anger, the participant left the meeting before the discussion ended.
formal.zh: 那位与会者一时气愤，在讨论结束前离开了会议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tlaqt hekk? Mark: Kien mument ta' tmasħin; issa kkalmajt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you leave like that? Mark: It was a moment of anger; I've calmed down now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么就那样走了？马克：当时是一时生气；现在我已经冷静下来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tlaqt hekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tlaqt hekk?
messages.zh: 你为什么就那样走了？
messages.en: Why did you leave like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien mument ta' tmasħin; issa kkalmajt.
messages.mt_standard: Kien mument ta' tmasħin; issa kkalmajt.
messages.zh: 当时是一时生气；现在我已经冷静下来了。
messages.en: It was a moment of anger; I've calmed down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmasħin 想成情绪温度计上的怒气刻度：可以是愤怒，也可以升到暴怒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Scolding, the expression of disapproval, or anger directed at someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 训斥、表达不赞同，或针对某人某事的愤怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċanfir, espressjoni ta' nuqqas ta' approvazzjoni, jew rabja lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 训斥；责骂。
不赞同；反对或不认可的态度。
愤怒；怒气。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-għalliem enfasizza li t-tmasħir aħrax jista' jiskoraġġixxi lill-istudenti milli jistaqsu.
formal.en: In his report, the teacher emphasized that harsh scolding can discourage students from asking questions.
formal.zh: 老师在报告中强调，严厉的训斥可能使学生不敢提问。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-laqgħa mal-kowċ? Toni: Kien hemm ftit tmasħir għax ma konniex attenti, imbagħad komplejna nitħarrġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the meeting with the coach go? Toni: There was a bit of scolding because we weren't paying attention, then we carried on training.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：和教练的谈话怎么样？托尼：我们因为没认真听而挨了几句训，之后就继续训练了。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif marret il-laqgħa mal-kowċ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif marret il-laqgħa mal-kowċ?
messages.zh: 和教练的谈话怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting with the coach go?

messages.speaker: Toni (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ftit tmasħir għax ma konniex attenti, imbagħad komplejna nitħarrġu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ftit tmasħir għax ma konniex attenti, imbagħad komplejna nitħarrġu.
messages.zh: 我们因为没认真听而挨了几句训，之后就继续训练了。
messages.en: There was a bit of scolding because we weren't paying attention, then we carried on training.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tmasħir 时想象老师皱眉批评的场面：话语是斥责，态度是不赞同，情绪可能是愤怒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be forced by circumstances to postpone making a payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于客观情况而不得不推迟付款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu jħalli ħlas għal aktar tard minħabba ċirkostanzi li jġegħluh jagħmel hekk.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be forced to defer payment
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迫延后付款；不得不延期支付。

collocations.en: he was forced to defer payment
he was forced to defer payment because of a lack of money
collocations.zh: 他因资金不足而被迫延期付款

formal.mt: Il-klijent tmatal fil-ħlas minħabba dewmien mhux mistenni fid-dħul tiegħu.
formal.en: The client was forced to defer payment because of an unexpected delay in receiving his income.
formal.zh: 客户因收入意外延迟到账而被迫延期付款。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark tmatal fil-ħlas din id-darba? Pawlu: Iva, kellu jistenna sakemm jidħol is-salarju.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was Mark forced to defer payment this time? Pawlu: Yes, he had to wait until his salary came in.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克这次是不得不延期付款吗？保罗：是的，他得等工资到账。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark tmatal fil-ħlas din id-darba?
messages.mt_standard: Mark tmatal fil-ħlas din id-darba?
messages.zh: 马克这次是不得不延期付款吗？
messages.en: Was Mark forced to defer payment this time?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu jistenna sakemm jidħol is-salarju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu jistenna sakemm jidħol is-salarju.
messages.zh: 是的，他得等工资到账。
messages.en: Yes, he had to wait until his salary came in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用工资尚未到账、账单只好后付的情景记 tmatal，重点记住其中的不得已。

gloss_zh: 反复伸展身体；接连伸懒腰

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stretch one's body repeatedly, making several stretching movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复伸展自己的身体，连续做出几次伸懒腰的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġġebbed diversi drabi, b'movimenti ripetuti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复伸展身体；接连伸懒腰。

collocations.zh: 他接连伸展了几次身体

collocations.en: he stretched repeatedly after sitting for a long time
collocations.zh: 他久坐后反复伸展身体

formal.mt: Wara sagħtejn bilqiegħda, l-istudent qam u tmatar diversi drabi qabel kompla jaqra.
formal.en: After sitting for two hours, the student stood up and stretched several times before continuing to read.
formal.zh: 坐了两个小时后，学生站起来接连伸展了几次身体，然后继续阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Toni tmatar daqshekk? Sara: Għax dam bilqiegħda quddiem il-kompjuter għal sigħat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Toni stretch so many times? Sara: Because he had been sitting at the computer for hours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼怎么接连伸了那么多次懒腰？萨拉：因为他在电脑前坐了好几个小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Toni tmatar daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Toni tmatar daqshekk?
messages.zh: 托尼怎么接连伸了那么多次懒腰？
messages.en: Why did Toni stretch so many times?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dam bilqiegħda quddiem il-kompjuter għal sigħat.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dam bilqiegħda quddiem il-kompjuter għal sigħat.
messages.zh: 因为他在电脑前坐了好几个小时。
messages.en: Because he had been sitting at the computer for hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmatar 记成一段循环画面：久坐的人站起后，一次又一次地伸展身体，重点是反复。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The postponement of a payment to a later time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把付款时间推迟到以后；付款的延期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-posponiment ta' ħlas għal żmien aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延期付款；将支付时间延后。

collocations.en: a request for deferment of payment

formal.mt: Il-fornitur aċċetta t-talba tal-klijent għal tmatil ta' xahar.
formal.en: The supplier accepted the client's request for a one-month deferment of payment.
formal.zh: 供应商接受了客户延期一个月付款的申请。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Aċċettaw it-talba tiegħek għal tmatil? Sara: Iva, nista' nħallas ix-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did they accept your request to defer payment? Sara: Yes, I can pay next month.
colloquial.zh: 马克：他们同意你的延期付款申请了吗？萨拉：同意了，我可以下个月再付。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aċċettaw it-talba tiegħek għal tmatil?
messages.mt_standard: Aċċettaw it-talba tiegħek għal tmatil?
messages.zh: 他们同意你的延期付款申请了吗？
messages.en: Did they accept your request to defer payment?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nista' nħallas ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nista' nħallas ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 同意了，我可以下个月再付。
messages.en: Yes, I can pay next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmatil 和日历上向后移动的付款日期联系起来；它是名词，表示延期付款这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stretch one's body, for example after waking up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伸展自己的身体，例如刚睡醒时伸懒腰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġġebbed, pereżempju meta jqum mill-irqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伸展身体；伸懒腰，例如在刚睡醒时。

collocations.en: he stretched as soon as he woke up
collocations.zh: 他一睡醒就伸了个懒腰

formal.mt: Meta qam mill-irqad, it-tifel tmattar fis-sodda qabel niżel għall-kolazzjon.
formal.en: When he woke up, the boy stretched in bed before going downstairs for breakfast.
formal.zh: 男孩睡醒后先在床上伸了个懒腰，然后下楼吃早餐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Toni għadu rieqed? Omm: Le, għadu kemm qam u tmattar; dalwaqt jiġi għall-kolazzjon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Toni still asleep? Mother: No, he has just woken up and stretched; he'll come for breakfast soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼还在睡吗？妈妈：没有，他刚睡醒，伸了个懒腰；一会儿就来吃早餐。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni għadu rieqed?
messages.mt_standard: Toni għadu rieqed?
messages.zh: 托尼还在睡吗？
messages.en: Is Toni still asleep?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu kemm qam u tmattar; dalwaqt jiġi għall-kolazzjon.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu kemm qam u tmattar; dalwaqt jiġi għall-kolazzjon.
messages.zh: 没有，他刚睡醒，伸了个懒腰；一会儿就来吃早餐。
messages.en: No, he has just woken up and stretched; he'll come for breakfast soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用清晨醒来在床上伸懒腰的画面记 tmattar；与 tmatar 对照时，后者强调反复伸展。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of stretching one's body or limbs, for example after resting or sitting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伸展自己的身体或四肢的动作，例如休息后伸懒腰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiġġebbed u jifrex ġismu jew dirgħajh u riġlejh, pereżempju wara mistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伸展自己身体的动作；伸懒腰。

collocations.zh: 睡醒后稍微伸展一下身体

formal.mt: Wara perjodu twil bilqiegħda, ftit tmattir tal-ġisem jista' jkun parti minn waqfa qasira.
formal.en: After a long period of sitting, a little stretching can be part of a short break.
formal.zh: 久坐之后，可以在短暂休息时稍微伸展一下身体。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ilni bilqiegħda s-siegħa kollha. Pawlu: Qum u agħmel ftit tmattir qabel inkomplu.
colloquial.en: Maja: I've been sitting for a whole hour. Pawlu: Get up and have a little stretch before we carry on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我已经坐了整整一个小时了。保罗：起来伸展一下身体，我们再继续。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilni bilqiegħda s-siegħa kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Ilni bilqiegħda s-siegħa kollha.
messages.zh: 我已经坐了整整一个小时了。
messages.en: I've been sitting for a whole hour.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qum u agħmel ftit tmattir qabel inkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Qum u agħmel ftit tmattir qabel inkomplu.
messages.zh: 起来伸展一下身体，我们再继续。
messages.en: Get up and have a little stretch before we carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmattir 和睡醒后张开双臂伸懒腰的画面联系起来，记住它指伸展身体这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of making repeated or frequent trips to a place or between places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频繁前往某处或在不同地点之间反复跑动的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħmel ħafna vjaġġi lejn xi post jew bejn postijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁出行；屡次前往或往返。

collocations.en: frequent trips between home and the office
collocations.zh: 在家和办公室之间频繁往返

formal.mt: It-tmawwir bejn iż-żewġ uffiċċji ħa ħafna ħin matul il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: Frequent trips between the two offices took up a great deal of time during the week.
formal.zh: 这一周，在两个办公室之间频繁往返占用了大量时间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Erġajt mort il-ħanut illum? Mark: Iva, xbajt b'dan it-tmawwir; għada nagħmel lista qabel noħroġ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you go to the shop again today? Mark: Yes, I'm fed up with all these trips; tomorrow I'll make a list before I go out.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你今天又去商店了？马克：是啊，这样来回跑真烦；明天我出门前先列个清单。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Erġajt mort il-ħanut illum?
messages.mt_standard: Erġajt mort il-ħanut illum?
messages.zh: 你今天又去商店了？
messages.en: Did you go to the shop again today?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xbajt b'dan it-tmawwir; għada nagħmel lista qabel noħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xbajt b'dan it-tmawwir; għada nagħmel lista qabel noħroġ.
messages.zh: 是啊，这样来回跑真烦；明天我出门前先列个清单。
messages.en: Yes, I'm fed up with all these trips; tomorrow I'll make a list before I go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清单总漏东西、一天跑好几趟商店的情景，用 tmawwir 记住频繁跑动和往返。

gloss_zh: 被狼吞虎咽地吃下；被大量吃掉

teaching_sense.en_definition: For food to be eaten very quickly and greedily, or consumed in large quantities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物被急切地狼吞虎咽吃下，或被大量吃掉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-ikel jittiekel malajr ħafna u b'regħba, jew fi kwantitajiet kbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被狼吞虎咽地吃下。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be eaten in large quantities
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被大量吃掉。

collocations.en: the food was wolfed down quickly
collocations.zh: 食物很快被狼吞虎咽地吃下

collocations.en: all the bread was gobbled up

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, l-ikel tmaxtar fi ftit minuti.
formal.en: After the long walk, the food was wolfed down in a few minutes.
formal.zh: 长途步行之后，食物几分钟内就被狼吞虎咽地吃光了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fadal xi ħobż? Ben: Le, tmaxtar kollu hekk kif waslu t-tfal.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is there any bread left? Ben: No, it was all gobbled up as soon as the children arrived.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：还有面包剩下吗？本：没有，孩子们一来就全给大口吃光了。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fadal xi ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Fadal xi ħobż?
messages.zh: 还有面包剩下吗？
messages.en: Is there any bread left?

messages.speaker: Ben (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tmaxtar kollu hekk kif waslu t-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tmaxtar kollu hekk kif waslu t-tfal.
messages.zh: 没有，孩子们一来就全给大口吃光了。
messages.en: No, it was all gobbled up as soon as the children arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一篮面包转眼被吃光，从食物的角度记 tmaxtar：它被狼吞虎咽吃下或被大量吃掉。

gloss_zh: 大口咀嚼；大量进食；狼吞虎咽

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of chomping food, eating large quantities, or wolfing food down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大口咀嚼、大量进食或狼吞虎咽地吃东西的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jomgħod bil-qawwa, jiekol fi kwantitajiet kbar jew jibla' l-ikel malajr u b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大口用力咀嚼。
大量进食；吃很多东西。
狼吞虎咽地吃东西。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tax-xena, il-ħoss tat-tmaxtir juri kemm il-mistednin kienu qed jieklu bil-għaġla.
formal.en: In the description of the scene, the sound of chomping shows how hurriedly the guests were eating.
formal.zh: 在这段场景描写中，大口咀嚼的声音表现出客人们吃得多么匆忙。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Toni: It-tmaxtir ta' ħija; qed jiekol tuffieħa ħdejk.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that noise? Toni: My brother chomping; he's eating an apple next to you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那是什么声音？托尼：我弟弟大口嚼东西的声音；他就在你旁边吃苹果。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss?
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tmaxtir ta' ħija; qed jiekol tuffieħa ħdejk.
messages.mt_standard: It-tmaxtir ta' ħija; qed jiekol tuffieħa ħdejk.
messages.zh: 我弟弟大口嚼东西的声音；他就在你旁边吃苹果。
messages.en: My brother chomping; he's eating an apple next to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tmaxtir 配上大口嚼苹果的声音，再联想到吃得很多、吃得很急；它是这些进食行为的名词。

gloss_zh: 被梳理开松（指棉、羊毛等纤维）

teaching_sense.en_definition: For cotton, wool, or similar fibres to be carded, separating and arranging the fibres for further processing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指棉花、羊毛等纤维经过梳理，被分开并整理，以便进一步加工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li s-suf, il-qoton jew fibri simili jiġu mimxuta biex il-fibri jinfirdu u jitħejjew għal aktar xogħol.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be carded (used of cotton, wool etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被梳理、开松，用于棉花、羊毛等纤维。

collocations.en: the wool was carded by hand
the cotton was carded before spinning
collocations.zh: 棉花在纺纱前经过梳理

formal.mt: Is-suf tmaxxat biex il-fibri jinfirdu qabel l-għażil.
formal.en: The wool was carded to separate the fibres before spinning.
formal.zh: 羊毛在纺纱前经过梳理，使纤维分开。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan is-suf lest għall-għażil? Ġużeppi: Iva, diġà tmaxxat.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this wool ready for spinning? Ġużeppi: Yes, it's already been carded.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这些羊毛可以开始纺了吗？朱塞佩：可以，已经梳理过了。

messages.speaker: Marta (纺织学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-suf lest għall-għażil?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-suf lest għall-għażil?
messages.zh: 这些羊毛可以开始纺了吗？
messages.en: Is this wool ready for spinning?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (纺织老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà tmaxxat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà tmaxxat.
messages.zh: 可以，已经梳理过了。
messages.en: Yes, it's already been carded.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一团羊毛被梳具梳开，变成松散的纤维；用这个加工后的画面记 tmaxxat 的被动含义。

gloss_zh: 梳理羊毛或棉花；梳棉工序

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of carding wool or cotton to separate and arrange its fibres.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将羊毛或棉花的纤维梳开、分离并整理的加工过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih is-suf jew il-qoton jiġi mimxut biex il-fibri jinfirdu u jitħejjew għall-ipproċessar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羊毛或棉花的梳理、开松工序。

formal.mt: Id-dimostrazzjoni turi t-tmaxxit tas-suf bħala pass qabel l-għażil.
formal.en: The demonstration presents wool carding as a step before spinning.
formal.zh: 这次演示展示了纺纱之前梳理羊毛的工序。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se nitgħallmu llum? Marija: It-tmaxxit tas-suf; l-ewwel nurik l-għodda.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are we going to learn today? Marija: Wool carding; first I'll show you the tools.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们今天学什么？玛丽亚：梳理羊毛；我先给你看看工具。

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nitgħallmu llum?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nitgħallmu llum?
messages.zh: 我们今天学什么？
messages.en: What are we going to learn today?

messages.speaker: Marija (手工课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tmaxxit tas-suf; l-ewwel nurik l-għodda.
messages.mt_standard: It-tmaxxit tas-suf; l-ewwel nurik l-għodda.
messages.zh: 梳理羊毛；我先给你看看工具。
messages.en: Wool carding; first I'll show you the tools.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmaxxit 当作手工课上的工序名称：先把羊毛或棉花梳开，再进入纺纱步骤。

gloss_zh: 被动过手脚（常指一副纸牌）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be tampered with or improperly interfered with, especially referring to a pack of cards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人擅自摆弄或动过手脚，尤其用于一副纸牌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa, speċjalment pakkett karti tal-logħob, tiġi mbagħbsa jew imbagħbsa b'mod mhux xieraq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be tampered with (typically used of a pack of cards)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被动过手脚，通常用于一副纸牌。

collocations.en: the pack of cards was tampered with
was tampered with before the game

formal.mt: Jekk il-pakkett tal-karti tmazzaz qabel il-logħba, għandu jintuża pakkett ġdid.
formal.en: If the pack of cards was tampered with before the game, a new pack should be used.
formal.zh: 如果这副纸牌在开局前被动过手脚，就应换用一副新牌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex trid pakkett ġdid? Pawlu: Naħseb li dan tmazzaz; aħjar niftħu ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you want a new pack? Pawlu: I think this one has been tampered with; we'd better open another.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么要换一副新牌？保罗：我觉得这副被动过手脚；我们还是再拆一副吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid pakkett ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid pakkett ġdid?
messages.zh: 你为什么要换一副新牌？
messages.en: Why do you want a new pack?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li dan tmazzaz; aħjar niftħu ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li dan tmazzaz; aħjar niftħu ieħor.
messages.zh: 我觉得这副被动过手脚；我们还是再拆一副吧。
messages.en: I think this one has been tampered with; we'd better open another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开局前发现整副纸牌被人偷偷摆弄过，用 tmazzaz 记住物品被动过手脚的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cheating at cards by using deceptive tricks to gain an unfair advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打牌时通过欺骗手法获取不公平优势的行为，即出千。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerq fil-logħob tal-karti permezz ta' manuvri biex wieħed jikseb vantaġġ inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在纸牌游戏中使用欺骗手法作弊；出千。

formal.mt: Ir-regoli tat-turnew jipprojbixxu t-tmazziz fil-logħob tal-karti.
formal.en: The tournament rules prohibit cheating at cards.
formal.zh: 比赛规则禁止在牌局中作弊。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex waqaft tilgħab il-karti magħhom? Pawlu: Għax kelli suspett ta' tmazziz.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you stop playing cards with them? Pawlu: Because I suspected cheating.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你为什么不再跟他们打牌了？Pawlu：因为我怀疑有人出千。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqaft tilgħab il-karti magħhom?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqaft tilgħab il-karti magħhom?
messages.zh: 你为什么不再跟他们打牌了？
messages.en: Why did you stop playing cards with them?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kelli suspett ta' tmazziz.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kelli suspett ta' tmazziz.
messages.zh: 因为我怀疑有人出千。
messages.en: Because I suspected cheating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与牌桌下偷偷换牌的画面相连，记住它指打牌出千。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak in a low, indistinct voice, so that the words are difficult for others to hear clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用低而含混的声音说话，使别人难以听清所说的内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid xi ħaġa b'leħen baxx u mhux ċar, b'mod li ħaddieħor ma jismax sew il-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低声嘟囔；含混地小声说话，让人不容易听清。

formal.mt: Meta qara l-ittra, Pawlu tmaħmaħ ftit kliem li ħadd ma sema' sew.
formal.en: When he read the letter, Pawlu muttered a few words that no one heard clearly.
formal.zh: 读信时，Pawlu 低声嘟囔了几句话，谁也没听清。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qal Pawlu? Mark: Ma fhimtx. Tmaħmaħ xi ħaġa u telaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu say? Mark: I didn't understand. He muttered something and left.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 说了什么？Mark：我没听懂。他嘟囔了句什么就走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qal Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: X'qal Pawlu?
messages.zh: Pawlu 说了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu say?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma fhimtx. Tmaħmaħ xi ħaġa u telaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ma fhimtx. Tmaħmaħ xi ħaġa u telaq.
messages.zh: 我没听懂。他嘟囔了句什么就走了。
messages.en: I didn't understand. He muttered something and left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人低头小声说话，旁人只听见含混的声音；用“声音低、词句不清”的画面记住嘟囔这个动作。

gloss_zh: 嘟囔声；咕哝；带鼻音说话

teaching_sense.en_definition: Low, indistinct speech, or speech produced with a noticeable nasal voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低声而含混的说话或嘟囔声，也可指带明显鼻音说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskors b'leħen baxx u mhux ċar, jew diskors b'leħen li jinstema' mill-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘟囔；低声、含混地说话，或这种说话产生的声音。
带鼻音说话；说话时声音具有明显的鼻音。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa nstema' tmaħmiħ b'leħen baxx minn wara tas-sala.
formal.en: During the meeting, quiet muttering could be heard from the back of the hall.
formal.zh: 会议期间，可以听见大厅后方传来低声嘟囔的声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt x'qal? Mark: Le, smajt biss ftit tmaħmiħ. Se nitolbu jirrepeti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear what he said? Mark: No, I only heard some muttering. I'll ask him to repeat it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听见他说什么了吗？Mark：没有，我只听见几声嘟囔。我会请他再说一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt x'qal?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt x'qal?
messages.zh: 你听见他说什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear what he said?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, smajt biss ftit tmaħmiħ. Se nitolbu jirrepeti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, smajt biss ftit tmaħmiħ. Se nitolbu jirrepeti.
messages.zh: 没有，我只听见几声嘟囔。我会请他再说一遍。
messages.en: No, I only heard some muttering. I'll ask him to repeat it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 准备两段想象中的录音：一段是听不清词句的低声嘟囔，一段是鼻音明显的说话声；用这两种声音记住它的两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be erased, cancelled, or deleted, so that something written, recorded, or arranged is removed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指文字、记录等被擦去或删除，也指原定的安排被取消。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitneħħa dak li jkun miktub jew irreġistrat, jew jiġi kkanċellat dak li jkun ippjanat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被擦去；指书写的文字或痕迹被清除。
被取消；指原定的活动、安排等不再进行。
被删除；指记录、信息或其他内容被移除。

formal.mt: Wara l-korrezzjoni, l-isem żbaljat tmaħħa mil-lista.
formal.en: After the correction, the incorrect name was erased from the list.
formal.zh: 更正后，名单中的错误姓名被删去了。

colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the message I sent you? Mark: It was deleted by mistake. Can you send it again?
colloquial.zh: Maja：我发给你的消息在哪里？Mark：被误删了。你能再发一次吗？

cognitive_memory_aid: 把名单上的名字、手机里的消息和日历里的预约想成三个格子：内容被清掉或安排被取消，都可联系这个词来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blow one's nose vigorously, or to produce mucus or snot from the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指用力擤鼻涕，也可指鼻子产生或流出鼻涕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jonfoħ imnieħru bis-saħħa biex joħroġ il-mukus, jew joħroġ mukus minn imnieħru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力擤鼻涕；使劲从鼻子里擤出鼻涕。
产生或流出黏液、鼻涕。

collocations.en: blew his nose into a handkerchief

formal.mt: Qabel kompla jaqra, Pawlu tmaħħat b'saħħa f'maktur.
formal.en: Before continuing to read, Pawlu blew his nose vigorously into a handkerchief.
formal.zh: 继续阅读之前，Pawlu 用手帕使劲擤了擤鼻涕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Mark: Pawlu tmaħħat b'saħħa. Għandu riħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that sound? Mark: Pawlu blew his nose forcefully. He has a cold.
colloquial.zh: Maja：刚才是什么声音？Mark：Pawlu 使劲擤了鼻涕。他感冒了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak il-ħoss?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak il-ħoss?
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu tmaħħat b'saħħa. Għandu riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu tmaħħat b'saħħa. Għandu riħ.
messages.zh: Pawlu 使劲擤了鼻涕。他感冒了。
messages.en: Pawlu blew his nose forcefully. He has a cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人拿起手帕，使劲擤鼻涕，旁边的人听见声音；把这个具体动作与该动词一起记，也兼记流鼻涕的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of erasing or deleting writing, information, or another recorded item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 擦去文字、清除信息或删除记录这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li titħassar kitba jew titneħħa informazzjoni jew xi ħaġa rreġistrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦除这一行为；把写下的文字或留下的痕迹擦去。
删除；将文字、信息或记录移除的操作或行为。

formal.mt: It-tmaħħija tal-isem żbaljat mil-lista kienet parti mill-korrezzjoni.
formal.en: The deletion of the incorrect name from the list was part of the correction.
formal.zh: 从名单中删除错误姓名是更正工作的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tuża l-gomma? Mark: Għat-tmaħħija ta' din il-kelma. Ktibtha ħażin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you using the eraser? Mark: To erase this word. I wrote it incorrectly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么用橡皮？Mark：为了擦掉这个词。我写错了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tuża l-gomma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tuża l-gomma?
messages.zh: 你为什么用橡皮？
messages.en: Why are you using the eraser?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tmaħħija ta' din il-kelma. Ktibtha ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tmaħħija ta' din il-kelma. Ktibtha ħażin.
messages.zh: 为了擦掉这个词。我写错了。
messages.en: To erase this word. I wrote it incorrectly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一块橡皮和一个删除按钮作记忆图：两者代表的都是清除内容这一行为；这个词是名词，要记成“擦除、删除这件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Delay in doing something, including procrastination that puts an action or task off until later.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某事时出现的延误，也指把应做的事情一再推后的拖延行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dewmien biex issir xi ħaġa, inkluż meta persuna tibqa' tħalli xogħol jew azzjoni għal aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延误；事情没有及时发生或完成而产生的耽搁。
拖延行为；把本来该做的事情反复推到以后。

formal.mt: Id-direttur talab li x-xogħol jitlesta mingħajr aktar tmaħħir.
formal.en: The director requested that the work be completed without further delay.
formal.zh: 主管要求完成这项工作，不得再拖延。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek ma bdejtx ir-rapport? Mark: Le, imma biżżejjed tmaħħir. Se nibda issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: You still haven't started the report? Mark: No, but enough procrastinating. I'll start now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还没开始写报告吗？Mark：还没有，不过不能再拖了。我现在就开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek ma bdejtx ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek ma bdejtx ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 你还没开始写报告吗？
messages.en: You still haven't started the report?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma biżżejjed tmaħħir. Se nibda issa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma biżżejjed tmaħħir. Se nibda issa.
messages.zh: 还没有，不过不能再拖了。我现在就开始。
messages.en: No, but enough procrastinating. I'll start now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象待办事项旁边的时钟不停走，工作却一直没开始：看结果是延误，看反复往后推的行为就是拖延。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of blowing one's nose, or the production of a large amount of snot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 擤鼻涕这一动作，也指鼻子产生大量鼻涕的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jonfoħ imnieħru biex joħroġ il-mukus, jew il-produzzjoni ta' ħafna mukus mill-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擤鼻涕；用气流把鼻涕从鼻子里擤出的动作。
大量产生鼻涕；鼻涕分泌很多的情况。

formal.mt: It-tmaħħit qawwi tiegħu nstema' waqt il-qari fis-sala.
formal.en: His forceful nose-blowing could be heard during the reading in the hall.
formal.zh: 大厅里进行朗读时，能听见他用力擤鼻涕的声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek bżonn aktar maktur tal-karti? Mark: Iva, b'dan it-tmaħħit kollu diġà spiċċawli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you need more tissues? Mark: Yes, with all this nose-blowing I've already run out.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还需要纸巾吗？Mark：需要，我一直擤鼻涕，纸巾已经用完了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek bżonn aktar maktur tal-karti?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek bżonn aktar maktur tal-karti?
messages.zh: 你还需要纸巾吗？
messages.en: Do you need more tissues?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, b'dan it-tmaħħit kollu diġà spiċċawli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, b'dan it-tmaħħit kollu diġà spiċċawli.
messages.zh: 需要，我一直擤鼻涕，纸巾已经用完了。
messages.en: Yes, with all this nose-blowing I've already run out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一堆用过的纸巾当作记忆画面：它提示擤鼻涕这个动作，也提示鼻涕很多；这个词要按名词记忆。

gloss_zh: 忧虑；反复思量；反刍式思考

teaching_sense.en_definition: Worry or repeated thinking about a matter, especially when someone keeps turning it over in their mind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某件事的忧虑或反复思量，尤其指一个念头在脑中不断盘旋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħassib jew ħsieb ripetut dwar xi ħaġa li persuna tibqa' ddawwar f'moħħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忧虑；因某件事而感到担心或不安。
反复思量；把某件事放在心里来回考虑。
反刍式思考；围绕同一件事或同一个念头反复琢磨。

collocations.zh: 对一项决定的反复思量

collocations.en: a night of worry and rumination

formal.mt: Wara ħafna tmaħħiħ fuq id-deċiżjoni, Maria għażlet li tkompli l-istudji tagħha.
formal.en: After much deliberation over the decision, Maria chose to continue her studies.
formal.zh: 围绕这个决定反复思量后，Maria 选择继续学业。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadek imqajjem? Mark: Ma nistax norqod b'dan it-tmaħħiħ kollu fuq l-eżami.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you still awake? Mark: I can't sleep with all this worrying about the exam.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么还没睡？Mark：我一直担心考试，睡不着。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadek imqajjem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadek imqajjem?
messages.zh: 你怎么还没睡？
messages.en: Why are you still awake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax norqod b'dan it-tmaħħiħ kollu fuq l-eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax norqod b'dan it-tmaħħiħ kollu fuq l-eżami.
messages.zh: 我一直担心考试，睡不着。
messages.en: I can't sleep with all this worrying about the exam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它画成脑中不断转动的思考圈：平静时是反复考虑，心里不安时是忧虑，念头停不下来时是反刍式思考。

gloss_zh: 笨拙使用；笨手笨脚的操作

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clumsy or awkward use or handling of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用或操作某物时笨拙、不熟练的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu jew l-immaniġġjar ta' xi ħaġa b'mod goff u mingħajr ħila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨拙的使用或操作。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jattribwixxi l-ħsara fit-tagħmir għat-tmażliġ waqt l-użu tiegħu.
formal.en: The report attributes the damage to the equipment to clumsy handling during use.
formal.zh: 报告将设备损坏归因于使用过程中的笨拙操作。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed tiżloqli l-għodda minn idi? Rita: Bit-tmażliġ mhux se tasal; żommha sew u aħdem bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why does the tool keep slipping out of my hand? Rita: You won't get anywhere handling it so clumsily; hold it properly and work slowly.
colloquial.zh: 马克：工具怎么老从我手里滑出去？丽塔：这样笨手笨脚地操作可不行；拿稳一点，慢慢来。

messages.speaker: Mark (维修学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiżloqli l-għodda minn idi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiżloqli l-għodda minn idi?
messages.zh: 工具怎么老从我手里滑出去？
messages.en: Why does the tool keep slipping out of my hand?

messages.speaker: Rita (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-tmażliġ mhux se tasal; żommha sew u aħdem bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-tmażliġ mhux se tasal; żommha sew u aħdem bil-mod.
messages.zh: 这样笨手笨脚地操作可不行；拿稳一点，慢慢来。
messages.en: You won't get anywhere handling it so clumsily; hold it properly and work slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工具在手里拿不稳、操作时磕磕碰碰的样子，用 tmażliġ 记住笨拙使用这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be laid down on a surface or spread out over an area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被放置在某个表面上，或被展开、铺开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed fuq wiċċ jew jinfirex fuq medda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放下；被平放或铺设。
被展开；被铺开。

collocations.en: was laid down on the ground
was spread out on the table

formal.mt: Id-drapp tmedd fuq il-mejda sabiex jitkejjel qabel il-qtugħ.
formal.en: The fabric was spread out on the table to be measured before cutting.
formal.zh: 布料被铺在桌上，以便裁剪前测量。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Id-drapp tmedd fuq il-mejda? Marija: Iva, u issa nistgħu nkejluh.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has the fabric been spread out on the table? Marija: Yes, and now we can measure it.
colloquial.zh: Anna：布料已经铺在桌上了吗？Marija：是的，现在可以量了。

messages.speaker: Anna (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-drapp tmedd fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Id-drapp tmedd fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 布料已经铺在桌上了吗？
messages.en: Has the fabric been spread out on the table?

messages.speaker: Marija (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u issa nistgħu nkejluh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u issa nistgħu nkejluh.
messages.zh: 是的，现在可以量了。
messages.en: Yes, and now we can measure it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一卷布被放到桌上再铺开的过程，把动词记成被放下、被铺开。

gloss_zh: 放下；铺展；织机上纱线的纵向拉伸

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of laying something down or spreading it out; also the lengthwise stretching, on a loom, of yarn constituting the weft.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体放下或铺开的动作；也指在织机上将构成纬线的纱线沿纵向拉伸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqiegħed xi ħaġa jew tifrixha; ukoll it-tiġbid fit-tul, fuq newl, tal-ħajt li jifforma t-tgħama.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放下、平放或铺设的动作。
展开、铺开或铺展的动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: stretching yarn constituting the weft lengthwise in a loom
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在织机上将构成纬线的纱线沿纵向拉伸。

formal.mt: It-tmeddid tal-kejbils għandu jitlesta qabel ma jitqiegħed il-madum.
formal.en: The laying of cables should be completed before the tiles are laid.
formal.zh: 电缆铺设应在铺贴瓷砖之前完成。

colloquial.en: Luca: Can I start measuring the fabric? Sara: Wait a moment; first we need to finish spreading it out.
colloquial.zh: Luca：我可以开始量布了吗？Sara：等一下，我们得先把它完全铺开。

messages.speaker: Luca (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nibda nkejjel id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nibda nkejjel id-drapp?

messages.speaker: Sara (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; l-ewwel irridu nlestu t-tmeddid tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; l-ewwel irridu nlestu t-tmeddid tiegħu.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把铺电缆、展开布料、拉伸织机纱线画成三张学习卡，分别记住三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of spreading something out over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物展开并铺在一个表面上的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tifrex xi ħaġa fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将物体展开、铺开或铺展的动作。

collocations.en: the spreading out of the blanket
the spreading out of the fabric

formal.mt: It-tmeddija tad-drapp fuq il-mejda għandha ssir b'attenzjoni biex ma jibqax mitwi.
formal.en: The fabric should be spread out carefully on the table so that no folds remain.
formal.zh: 应仔细将布料铺在桌上，避免留下折叠的部分。
