messages.mt_standard: Tgħinni bit-tmeddija tal-kutra fuq il-ħaxix?
messages.zh: 你能帮我把毯子铺在草地上吗？
messages.en: Will you help me spread the blanket on the grass?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, jien naqbad din in-naħa u int l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, jien naqbad din in-naħa u int l-oħra.
messages.zh: 当然，我抓这一边，你抓另一边。
messages.en: Sure, I'll take this side and you take the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人各抓毯子一端，把毯子慢慢铺平，用整个动作记住铺展这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wallowing or rolling about on the ground or floor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在泥地、地面或地板上打滚、来回翻滚的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitgerbeb fit-tajn, fl-art jew fuq l-art ta' kamra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在泥、水等处打滚或翻滚。

sense_translations.en_definition: rolling on the ground or floor
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在地面或地板上打滚、翻滚。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ġie rreġistrat it-tmegħik tal-ħanżir fit-tajn.
formal.en: During the observation, the pig's wallowing in the mud was recorded.
formal.zh: 观察期间记录了这头猪在泥里打滚的行为。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex il-kelb kollu tajn? Ġużeppi: Wara dak it-tmegħik fil-ġnien, bilfors!
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is the dog covered in mud? Ġużeppi: After all that rolling around in the garden, of course he is!
colloquial.zh: Marta：狗怎么浑身都是泥？Ġużeppi：刚才在花园里打了那么多滚，当然会这样！

messages.speaker: Marta (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kelb kollu tajn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kelb kollu tajn?
messages.zh: 狗怎么浑身都是泥？
messages.en: Why is the dog covered in mud?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dak it-tmegħik fil-ġnien, bilfors!
messages.mt_standard: Wara dak it-tmegħik fil-ġnien, bilfors!
messages.zh: 刚才在花园里打了那么多滚，当然会这样！
messages.en: After all that rolling around in the garden, of course he is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗在泥地上滚来滚去、全身沾泥，用这个连续动作记住打滚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of contradicting someone, complaining, or raising objections.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反驳他人的话、表达不满，或针对某事提出异议的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed imur kontra dak li jgħid ħaddieħor, jilmenta jew iqajjem oġġezzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对他人所说内容的反驳或否认。
表达不满；抱怨。
对某项意见、提议或安排提出异议。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa nstema' tmegħir kontra l-proposta, u ċ-chairperson talab li jingħataw raġunijiet ċari.
formal.en: During the meeting, objections were raised to the proposal, and the chairperson asked for clear reasons.
formal.zh: 会议上有人对提议提出异议，主持人要求说明明确的理由。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex dan it-tmegħir kollu dwar il-ħin il-ġdid? David: Għax ħafna minna ma jistgħux jaslu daqshekk kmieni.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why all this complaining about the new time? David: Because many of us can't arrive that early.
colloquial.zh: Elena：大家为什么对新时间有这么多抱怨？David：因为我们很多人都没法那么早到。

messages.speaker: Elena (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tmegħir kollu dwar il-ħin il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tmegħir kollu dwar il-ħin il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 大家为什么对新时间有这么多抱怨？
messages.en: Why all this complaining about the new time?

messages.speaker: David (参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħafna minna ma jistgħux jaslu daqshekk kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħafna minna ma jistgħux jaslu daqshekk kmieni.
messages.zh: 因为我们很多人都没法那么早到。
messages.en: Because many of us can't arrive that early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三句学习提示串起来：我不同意、我不满意、我有异议，对应反驳、抱怨和提出异议。

gloss_zh: 利用情势获利；从中取得好处

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of obtaining a benefit or advantage from a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用某种情势或机会，从中获得利益或有利条件的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jikseb benefiċċju jew vantaġġ minn sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用某种情势，从中取得好处或有利条件。

collocations.en: obtaining an advantage from the situation
collocations.zh: 利用当前情势取得好处

collocations.en: obtaining a benefit from the opportunity

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tmegħix ta' xi negozjanti min-nuqqas ta' provvisti.
formal.en: The report describes how some traders obtained an advantage from the shortage of supplies.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一些商人如何利用物资短缺的情势获利。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jiġifieri tmegħix f'dan l-artiklu? Pawlu: Ifisser li xi ħadd qed jikseb vantaġġ mis-sitwazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does tmegħix mean in this article? Pawlu: It means that someone is obtaining an advantage from the situation.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这篇文章里的 tmegħix 是什么意思？保罗：意思是有人正在利用这个情势取得好处。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri tmegħix f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri tmegħix f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 tmegħix 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tmegħix mean in this article?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħadd qed jikseb vantaġġ mis-sitwazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħadd qed jikseb vantaġġ mis-sitwazzjoni.
messages.zh: 意思是有人正在利用这个情势取得好处。
messages.en: It means that someone is obtaining an advantage from the situation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人看准眼前机会，把情势变成自己的好处；用这个画面记住“利用情势获益”的名词义。

gloss_zh: 欢蹦嬉闹；任性胡闹或放荡举止

teaching_sense.en_definition: Playful, lively cavorting, or behavior that is capricious or lascivious, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指活泼地欢蹦嬉闹，也可依语境指任性胡闹或带有淫荡意味的举止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qbiż u ċajt ferrieħi, jew imġiba kapriċċuża jew żienja, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欢蹦乱跳、嬉戏打闹。
任性胡闹，或做出放荡、淫荡的举动。

collocations.zh: 毫无节制的嬉闹或胡闹

formal.mt: It-tmegħiż tal-atturi ta lix-xena atmosfera ferrieħa u mimlija ħajja.
formal.en: The actors' cavorting gave the scene a cheerful and lively atmosphere.
formal.zh: 演员们的蹦跳嬉闹使这一幕充满了欢乐与活力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tmegħiż kollu parti mill-prova? Mark: Iva, qed nippruvaw xena fejn kulħadd jaqbeż u jiċċajta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is all this cavorting part of the rehearsal? Mark: Yes, we're rehearsing a scene where everyone jumps about and jokes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这么一通蹦跳嬉闹也是排练的一部分吗？马克：对，我们正在排一场大家又蹦又闹、互相逗趣的戏。

messages.speaker: Lara (剧团成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tmegħiż kollu parti mill-prova?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tmegħiż kollu parti mill-prova?
messages.zh: 这么一通蹦跳嬉闹也是排练的一部分吗？
messages.en: Is all this cavorting part of the rehearsal?

messages.speaker: Mark (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nippruvaw xena fejn kulħadd jaqbeż u jiċċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nippruvaw xena fejn kulħadd jaqbeż u jiċċajta.
messages.zh: 对，我们正在排一场大家又蹦又闹、互相逗趣的戏。
messages.en: Yes, we're rehearsing a scene where everyone jumps about and jokes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想舞台上欢蹦嬉闹的人，再看语境是否带批评意味；这个词也可能表示任性或放荡的举止。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slowness in movement, action, or progress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动作、办事或进展缓慢的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li moviment, azzjoni jew progress iseħħ bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓慢、迟缓的状态。

formal.mt: It-tmehil fl-ipproċessar tat-talbiet wassal għal żieda fil-ħin ta' stennija.
formal.en: Slowness in processing applications led to an increase in waiting time.
formal.zh: 申请处理缓慢，导致等候时间增加。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għadna hawn? Hemm ħafna tmehil illum. Ġorġ: Iva, il-kju miexi bil-mod ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are we still here? Things are very slow today. Ġorġ: Yes, the queue is moving very slowly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们怎么还在这里？今天办得真慢。乔治：是啊，队伍前进得特别慢。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadna hawn? Hemm ħafna tmehil illum.
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadna hawn? Hemm ħafna tmehil illum.
messages.zh: 我们怎么还在这里？今天办得真慢。
messages.en: Why are we still here? Things are very slow today.

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kju miexi bil-mod ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kju miexi bil-mod ħafna.
messages.zh: 是啊，队伍前进得特别慢。
messages.en: Yes, the queue is moving very slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象排队时队伍一点点往前挪；把那种“进展很慢”的状态和这个名词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of tilting something; also, the act of making fun of someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体倾斜的动作；也指取笑、嘲弄某人或某事的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed imejjel xi ħaġa; ukoll, l-att li wieħed iwaqqa' lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa għaċ-ċajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物体偏斜、倾斜的动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: making fun of sb. or sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 取笑或嘲弄某人或某事。

formal.mt: It-tmejjil tal-kontenitur għandu jsir bil-mod biex il-likwidu ma jixteridx.
formal.en: The container should be tilted slowly so that the liquid does not spill.
formal.zh: 应缓慢倾斜容器，以免液体洒出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-tmejjil b'Pawlu qed iweġġgħu. Mark: Għandek raġun; aħjar nieqfu u nitolbuh skuża.
colloquial.en: Sara: This making fun of Pawlu is hurting him. Mark: You're right; we'd better stop and apologize to him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这样取笑保罗让他很难受。马克：你说得对，我们还是停下来，向他道歉吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tmejjil b'Pawlu qed iweġġgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tmejjil b'Pawlu qed iweġġgħu.
messages.zh: 这样取笑保罗让他很难受。
messages.en: This making fun of Pawlu is hurting him.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; aħjar nieqfu u nitolbuh skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; aħjar nieqfu u nitolbuh skuża.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我们还是停下来，向他道歉吧。
messages.en: You're right; we'd better stop and apologize to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立画面记忆：一张是容器倾斜，一张是有人被取笑；遇到这个词先判断是哪一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made sharp or given a finer cutting edge by honing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刀刃或工具的刃口经过磨砺而变得锋利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xifer li jsir aktar jaqta' billi jingħorok fuq ġebla jew wiċċ adattat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被磨砺、磨利；刃口经过研磨而变得锋利。

collocations.en: the edge was honed on a stone

formal.mt: Qabel it-test, it-tarf tal-għodda tmejlaq fuq ġebla fina biex jaqta' aħjar.
formal.en: Before the test, the tool's edge was honed on a fine stone to improve its cutting ability.
formal.zh: 测试前，工具的刃口在细磨石上经过磨砺，以提高切削能力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tarf tmejlaq, jew għadu ma jaqtax sew? Pawlu: Iva, tmejlaq dalgħodu; issa jaqta' sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the edge been honed, or does it still cut poorly? Pawlu: Yes, it was honed this morning; it cuts well now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：刃口磨利了吗，还是仍然不好切？保罗：磨利了，今天早上磨的；现在很好切了。

messages.speaker: Lara (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tarf tmejlaq, jew għadu ma jaqtax sew?
messages.mt_standard: It-tarf tmejlaq, jew għadu ma jaqtax sew?
messages.zh: 刃口磨利了吗，还是仍然不好切？
messages.en: Has the edge been honed, or does it still cut poorly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tmejlaq dalgħodu; issa jaqta' sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tmejlaq dalgħodu; issa jaqta' sew.
messages.zh: 磨利了，今天早上磨的；现在很好切了。
messages.en: Yes, it was honed this morning; it cuts well now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜头对准刀刃：刀刃经过磨石摩擦，终于变锋利；记住这里描述的是刃口“被磨利”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of sharpening an edge, especially by whetting a blade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使刃口锋利的研磨过程，尤其指磨刀刃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xifer isir jaqta', speċjalment billi xafra tingħorok fuq ġebla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨利；使刃口锋利的过程。
磨刀刃；通过研磨使刀刃锋利。

formal.mt: It-tmejliq tax-xafra sar b'attenzjoni biex jinkiseb xifer jaqta' b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: The blade was carefully whetted to obtain an evenly sharp edge.
formal.zh: 刀刃经过仔细研磨，使整个刃口均匀锋利。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'għandek bżonn għat-tmejliq tas-sikkina? Nina: Ġebla fina u ftit ħin; it-tarf għadu ma jaqtax sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: What do you need to sharpen the knife? Nina: A fine stone and a little time; the edge still doesn't cut well.
colloquial.zh: 马克：磨这把刀需要什么？妮娜：一块细磨石，再花一点时间；刃口现在还不够锋利。

messages.speaker: Mark (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandek bżonn għat-tmejliq tas-sikkina?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandek bżonn għat-tmejliq tas-sikkina?
messages.zh: 磨这把刀需要什么？
messages.en: What do you need to sharpen the knife?

messages.speaker: Nina (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġebla fina u ftit ħin; it-tarf għadu ma jaqtax sew.
messages.mt_standard: Ġebla fina u ftit ħin; it-tarf għadu ma jaqtax sew.
messages.zh: 一块细磨石，再花一点时间；刃口现在还不够锋利。
messages.en: A fine stone and a little time; the edge still doesn't cut well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把磨石旁写着“磨刀工序”的标签想成这个名词：它表示磨利的过程，可与表示被磨利的 tmejlaq 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 把身体紧贴表面；把自己弄脏

teaching_sense.en_definition: To press one's body against a surface, or to get oneself dirty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把身体紧紧贴向某个表面；也可指把自己弄脏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħfas ġismu ma' wiċċ, jew iħammeġ lilu nnifsu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to press oneself against a surface
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己的身体紧紧贴在某个表面上。
把自己弄脏，使自己沾上污物。

collocations.en: he pressed himself against the wall
he got himself dirty with mud

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tmekkaħ mal-ħajt biex iħalli spazju biżżejjed għall-ġarr tal-kaxxa.
formal.en: The worker pressed himself against the wall to leave enough room for the box to be carried past.
formal.zh: 工人把身体紧贴在墙上，为箱子搬运通过留出足够空间。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif spiċċa Pawlu kollu tajn? Ġorġ: Tmekkaħ waqt li kien jilgħab fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did Pawlu end up covered in mud? Ġorġ: He got himself dirty while playing in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗怎么弄得满身都是泥？乔治：他在花园玩的时候把自己弄脏了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif spiċċa Pawlu kollu tajn?
messages.mt_standard: Kif spiċċa Pawlu kollu tajn?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么弄得满身都是泥？
messages.en: How did Pawlu end up covered in mud?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmekkaħ waqt li kien jilgħab fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Tmekkaħ waqt li kien jilgħab fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 他在花园玩的时候把自己弄脏了。
messages.en: He got himself dirty while playing in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别记两个生活画面：侧身紧贴墙壁让路，以及玩泥巴后弄脏自己；两幅画帮助区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 被来回移动；被往复推移

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be moved repeatedly in one direction and then in the opposite direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体被反复朝一个方向及其相反方向移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal oġġett li jitmexxa ripetutament f'direzzjoni u mbagħad fid-direzzjoni opposta.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be moved back and forth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被来回移动；被反复向两个相反方向推移。

collocations.en: it was moved back and forth
it was moved from side to side

formal.mt: Matul it-test, il-kexxun tmekkek 'il quddiem u lura biex jiġi vverifikat il-moviment tiegħu.
formal.en: During the test, the drawer was moved back and forth to check its movement.
formal.zh: 测试期间，抽屉被前后来回推拉，以检查其移动情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kexxun tmekkek 'il quddiem u lura waqt it-test? Mark: Iva, diversi drabi, u ma weħilx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was the drawer moved back and forth during the test? Mark: Yes, several times, and it didn't get stuck.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：测试时有没有把抽屉来回推拉？马克：有，推拉了好几次，都没有卡住。

messages.speaker: Sara (家具店员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kexxun tmekkek 'il quddiem u lura waqt it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kexxun tmekkek 'il quddiem u lura waqt it-test?
messages.zh: 测试时有没有把抽屉来回推拉？
messages.en: Was the drawer moved back and forth during the test?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diversi drabi, u ma weħilx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diversi drabi, u ma weħilx.
messages.zh: 有，推拉了好几次，都没有卡住。
messages.en: Yes, several times, and it didn't get stuck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象抽屉被人反复推入、拉出，用双向箭头记住“被来回移动”，注意句中承受移动的是物体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Repeated walking or other movement back and forth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复来回走动，或其他形式的往复移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mixi jew moviment ieħor li jsir ripetutament 'il quddiem u lura.

sense_translations.en_definition: back and forth walking or other movement
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来回走动或其他往复移动。

collocations.en: pacing back and forth in the corridor

formal.mt: It-tmekkik fil-kuritur kompla sakemm infetħet il-kamra tal-laqgħat.
formal.en: The pacing in the corridor continued until the meeting room was opened.
formal.zh: 人们一直在走廊里来回踱步，直到会议室开门。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan it-tmekkik kollu? Pawlu: Qed nistenna telefonata u ma nistax noqgħod bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why all this pacing? Pawlu: I'm waiting for a phone call and can't sit still.
colloquial.zh: Lara：怎么一直走来走去？Pawlu：我在等一个电话，实在坐不住。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tmekkik kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tmekkik kollu?
messages.zh: 怎么一直走来走去？
messages.en: Why all this pacing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistenna telefonata u ma nistax noqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistenna telefonata u ma nistax noqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 我在等一个电话，实在坐不住。
messages.en: I'm waiting for a phone call and can't sit still.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等电话时在走廊两端反复折返，把 tmekkik 记成来回走动的整段过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of lightly scraping a surface or scratching something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻轻擦刮某个表面或抓挠某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni ta' brix ħafif fuq wiċċ jew ta' grif fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻微擦刮或抓挠。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport issemma t-tmekkiħ fuq il-wiċċ tal-injam waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The report mentioned scratching on the wooden surface during transport.
formal.zh: 报告提到了运输过程中木质表面受到擦刮的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-tmekkiħ qed iħalli marki fuq il-mejda. Mark: Mela npoġġi biċċa drapp taħt il-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: This scraping is leaving marks on the table. Mark: Then I'll put a cloth under the box.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这样擦刮会在桌上留下痕迹。Mark：那我在箱子下面垫块布。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tmekkiħ qed iħalli marki fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tmekkiħ qed iħalli marki fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 这样擦刮会在桌上留下痕迹。
messages.en: This scraping is leaving marks on the table.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela npoġġi biċċa drapp taħt il-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Mela npoġġi biċċa drapp taħt il-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 那我在箱子下面垫块布。
messages.en: Then I'll put a cloth under the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmekkiħ 和箱底擦过木桌的画面一起记：关注的是擦刮、抓挠这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of chewing or munching food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用牙齿反复嚼食、把食物嚼碎的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha wieħed jomgħod l-ikel bis-snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嚼食；一口口地咀嚼食物。
咀嚼；用牙齿将食物嚼碎的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni ġie rreġistrat il-ħoss tat-tmekmik tal-ikel.
formal.en: During the observation, the sound of food being chewed was recorded.
formal.zh: 观察过程中记录了咀嚼食物的声音。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak il-ħoss ta' tmekmik? Ben: Qed niekol gallettina; trid waħda?
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that munching sound? Ben: I'm eating a biscuit; would you like one?
colloquial.zh: Nina：那是什么嚼东西的声音？Ben：我在吃饼干，你要一块吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss ta' tmekmik?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss ta' tmekmik?
messages.zh: 那是什么嚼东西的声音？
messages.en: What's that munching sound?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed niekol gallettina; trid waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Qed niekol gallettina; trid waħda?
messages.zh: 我在吃饼干，你要一块吗？
messages.en: I'm eating a biscuit; would you like one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用吃饼干时嘴巴反复咀嚼的画面记 tmekmik；两个义项都围绕嚼食这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be disliked or regarded with strong aversion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到他人的讨厌，或引起强烈的厌恶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jintgħoġobx jew li jitqies b'disgust qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被讨厌；不受喜欢。
被憎恶；受到强烈厌恶。

collocations.en: was disliked because of his arrogance

formal.mt: Il-kumment offensiv tmell minn dawk li semgħuh.
formal.en: The offensive comment was disliked by those who heard it.
formal.zh: 那句冒犯人的评论引起了听者的反感。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak il-kumment tmell minn kulħadd. Mark: Mhux ta' b'xejn; kien offensiv.
colloquial.en: Sara: Everyone disliked that comment. Mark: No wonder; it was offensive.
colloquial.zh: Sara：大家都很反感那句话。Mark：难怪，那话太冒犯人了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kumment tmell minn kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kumment tmell minn kulħadd.
messages.zh: 大家都很反感那句话。
messages.en: Everyone disliked that comment.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux ta' b'xejn; kien offensiv.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux ta' b'xejn; kien offensiv.
messages.zh: 难怪，那话太冒犯人了。
messages.en: No wonder; it was offensive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句话说完，听众纷纷皱眉；用这个画面记 tmell 的被讨厌、被憎恶。

gloss_zh: 被加盐；嘲弄；取笑某人；处境不佳

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have salt added to it, as when food is salted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被加入盐，通常指食物经过加盐处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiżdiedlu l-melħ, bħal meta jiġi mmellaħ l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加盐；经过盐渍处理。
嘲弄；以戏谑或轻蔑的方式对待。
取笑某人；拿某人开玩笑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be in a poor state
sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于糟糕的状态；境况不佳。

collocations.en: he made fun of his friend

formal.mt: Il-ħut tmellaħ qabel ma tqiegħed fil-forn.
formal.en: The fish was salted before it was placed in the oven.
formal.zh: 鱼在放入烤箱前加了盐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu tmellaħ b'Mark? Ben: Ħaseb li kien qed jiċċajta, imma Mark ħa għalih.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu make fun of Mark? Ben: He thought he was joking, but Mark took offence.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 为什么取笑 Mark？Ben：他以为自己只是在开玩笑，但 Mark 生气了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu tmellaħ b'Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu tmellaħ b'Mark?
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么取笑 Mark？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu make fun of Mark?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħaseb li kien qed jiċċajta, imma Mark ħa għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Ħaseb li kien qed jiċċajta, imma Mark ħa għalih.
messages.zh: 他以为自己只是在开玩笑，但 Mark 生气了。
messages.en: He thought he was joking, but Mark took offence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tmellaħ 做三张场景卡：食物加盐、取笑别人、境况糟糕；靠上下文分别提取词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be gently stroked or touched with affection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到温柔、带有爱意的抚摸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintmess jew jintmesaħ bil-mod bħala turija ta' mħabba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被爱抚；受到轻柔的抚摸。

formal.mt: Il-qattus tmelles bil-mod mit-tifel waqt li kien mimdud fuq il-kutra.
formal.en: The cat was gently stroked by the boy while it was lying on the blanket.
formal.zh: 猫躺在毯子上时，小男孩轻柔地抚摸了它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus tmelles u raqad. Mark: Mela ħallih jistrieħ fuq il-kutra.
colloquial.en: Maja: The cat was stroked and fell asleep. Mark: Then let him rest on the blanket.
colloquial.zh: Maja：猫被摸了摸，就睡着了。Mark：那就让它在毯子上休息吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus tmelles u raqad.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus tmelles u raqad.
messages.zh: 猫被摸了摸，就睡着了。
messages.en: The cat was stroked and fell asleep.

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ħallih jistrieħ fuq il-kutra.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ħallih jistrieħ fuq il-kutra.
messages.zh: 那就让它在毯子上休息吧。
messages.en: Then let him rest on the blanket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小猫被轻轻摸头后睡着；记 tmelles 时，把注意力放在接受爱抚的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of gently stroking or touching someone or an animal with affection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着爱意轻柔抚摸人或动物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed imiss jew imelles lil persuna jew annimal bil-mod u b'imħabba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抚；带有爱意的轻柔抚摸。

formal.mt: Wara ftit tmellis ġentili fuq ir-ras, il-qattus baqa' mimdud ħdejn it-tifla.
formal.en: After a little gentle stroking on the head, the cat remained lying beside the girl.
formal.zh: 头部被轻柔地抚摸了一会儿后，猫仍躺在女孩身旁。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara kemm iħobb it-tmellis dan il-qattus! Lara: Iva, speċjalment fuq rasu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look how much this cat loves being stroked! Lara: Yes, especially on his head.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看这只猫多喜欢被抚摸！Lara：是啊，尤其喜欢别人摸它的头。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm iħobb it-tmellis dan il-qattus!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm iħobb it-tmellis dan il-qattus!
messages.zh: 看这只猫多喜欢被抚摸！
messages.en: Look how much this cat loves being stroked!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment fuq rasu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment fuq rasu.
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其喜欢别人摸它的头。
messages.en: Yes, especially on his head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmellis 记作轻轻摸猫头这个动作名词；与 tmelles 对照，后者表示被爱抚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mockery or teasing, including joking that makes fun of someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嘲弄或戏谑，包括拿别人取笑的玩笑行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed iwaqqa' lil xi ħadd għaċ-ċajt jew jgħaddih biż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘲弄；取笑。
逗趣；玩笑；嬉闹。
愚蠢的言行；胡闹。

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega li t-tmelliħ fuq ħaddieħor jista' jweġġa' s-sentimenti tiegħu.
formal.en: The teacher explained that making fun of someone can hurt their feelings.
formal.zh: 老师解释说，取笑别人可能会伤害对方的感情。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Biżżejjed tmelliħ, issa rridu nlestu x-xogħol. Pawlu: Sewwa, nieqaf niċċajta u nibda naħdem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Enough fooling around; we need to finish the work now. Pawlu: All right, I'll stop joking and get to work.
colloquial.zh: Sara：别再胡闹了，现在得把活干完。Pawlu：好，我不开玩笑了，开始干活。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biżżejjed tmelliħ, issa rridu nlestu x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Biżżejjed tmelliħ, issa rridu nlestu x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 别再胡闹了，现在得把活干完。
messages.en: Enough fooling around; we need to finish the work now.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, nieqaf niċċajta u nibda naħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, nieqaf niċċajta u nibda naħdem.
messages.zh: 好，我不开玩笑了，开始干活。
messages.en: All right, I'll stop joking and get to work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmelliħ 放在玩笑场景里记：轻则逗趣，针对别人可成嘲弄，过了头就是胡闹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or manner of behaving wickedly or devilishly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以邪恶、恶毒或如恶魔般的方式行事的行为或表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aġir ta' min jagħmel il-ħażen jew iġib ruħu b'mod ħażin ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以邪恶或恶毒的方式行事；作恶。
如恶魔般行事；表现得极其恶毒。

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkundanna t-tmengħil tal-karattru li jweġġa' lil ħaddieħor apposta.
formal.en: The author condemns the wicked behaviour of the character who deliberately hurts others.
formal.zh: 作者谴责了这个故意伤害他人的角色所表现出的恶行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħeba l-mediċina tan-nanna biex ibeżżagħha. Mark: Dak tmengħil, mhux ċajta.
colloquial.en: Maja: He hid Grandma's medicine to frighten her. Mark: That's wicked behaviour, not a joke.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他把奶奶的药藏起来，想吓唬她。马克：那是作恶，不是开玩笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħeba l-mediċina tan-nanna biex ibeżżagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħeba l-mediċina tan-nanna biex ibeżżagħha.
messages.zh: 他把奶奶的药藏起来，想吓唬她。
messages.en: He hid Grandma's medicine to frighten her.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tmengħil, mhux ċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Dak tmengħil, mhux ċajta.
messages.zh: 那是作恶，不是开玩笑。
messages.en: That's wicked behaviour, not a joke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词放进“故意害人”的画面来记：重点是恶毒的行为，不只是心情不好。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be gathered into a heap or placed in a stack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 东西被聚集成堆，或被一件件叠放起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġabar f'ġemgħa jew jitqiegħed wieħed fuq l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被聚拢成堆；被堆积起来。
被一件件叠起或码放起来。

collocations.en: the hay was heaped up in the field
the wood was stacked against the wall

formal.mt: L-injam tmenzel taħt is-saqaf biex jibqa' niexef.
formal.en: The wood was stacked under the roof to keep it dry.
formal.zh: 木材被码放在屋顶下，以保持干燥。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn qiegħed l-injam li wasal dalgħodu? Rita: Tmenzel kollu mal-ħajt fil-garaxx.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where is the wood that arrived this morning? Rita: It was all stacked against the wall in the garage.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：今天早上送来的木材在哪里？丽塔：全都靠着车库里的墙码好了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qiegħed l-injam li wasal dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qiegħed l-injam li wasal dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 今天早上送来的木材在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the wood that arrived this morning?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmenzel kollu mal-ħajt fil-garaxx.
messages.mt_standard: Tmenzel kollu mal-ħajt fil-garaxx.
messages.zh: 全都靠着车库里的墙码好了。
messages.en: It was all stacked against the wall in the garage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象干草堆成一堆、木材码成一叠：两个场景共同记住“被堆起来”的意思。

gloss_zh: 被分层排列；被层层铺放

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be arranged in successive layers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被按一层接一层的方式排列或铺放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed f'saffi, saff fuq ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被分层排列；被一层层铺放。

collocations.en: the vegetation was arranged in thin layers
collocations.zh: 草木被铺成薄薄的几层

collocations.en: the straw was arranged in layers on the ground
collocations.zh: 稻草被一层层铺在地上

formal.mt: Il-materjal tal-pjanti tmergħen f'saffi rqaq, wieħed fuq l-ieħor.
formal.en: The plant material was arranged in thin layers, one above another.
formal.zh: 植物材料被铺成薄层，一层叠在另一层上。

colloquial.mt: Lina: It-tiben qiegħed kollu f'ġemgħa waħda? Ġużeppi: Le, tmergħen f'saffi rqaq fuq l-art.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is all the straw in one heap? Ġużeppi: No, it was arranged in thin layers on the ground.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：稻草全都堆成一堆了吗？朱塞佩：没有，它被一层层薄薄地铺在地上了。

messages.speaker: Lina (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tiben qiegħed kollu f'ġemgħa waħda?
messages.mt_standard: It-tiben qiegħed kollu f'ġemgħa waħda?
messages.zh: 稻草全都堆成一堆了吗？
messages.en: Is all the straw in one heap?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tmergħen f'saffi rqaq fuq l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tmergħen f'saffi rqaq fuq l-art.
messages.zh: 没有，它被一层层薄薄地铺在地上了。
messages.en: No, it was arranged in thin layers on the ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“铺一层，再铺一层”的动作记这个动词；注意画面中有清楚的层次。

gloss_zh: 分层排列；层状铺放，尤指植物

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement in layers, especially of plants or plant material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按层次排列或铺放的方式，尤其用于植物或植物材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqegħid f'saffi, speċjalment ta' pjanti jew materjal tal-pjanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: arrangement in layers (used especially of plants)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 分层排列或层状铺放，尤其用于描述植物。

collocations.en: the arrangement of plants in layers
the arrangement of straw in layers

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi t-tmergħin tal-materjal tal-pjanti f'saffi ta' ħxuna differenti.
formal.en: The diagram shows the arrangement of plant material in layers of different thicknesses.
formal.zh: 示意图展示了植物材料按不同厚度分层铺放的方式。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser il-kelma tmergħin hawn? Toni: It-tqegħid tat-tiben f'saffi, wieħed fuq l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the word tmergħin mean here? Toni: Placing the straw in layers, one above another.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 tmergħin 是什么意思？托尼：就是把稻草分层铺放，一层叠在另一层上。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma tmergħin hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma tmergħin hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 tmergħin 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word tmergħin mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tqegħid tat-tiben f'saffi, wieħed fuq l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: It-tqegħid tat-tiben f'saffi, wieħed fuq l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 就是把稻草分层铺放，一层叠在另一层上。
messages.en: Placing the straw in layers, one above another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把分层铺好的植物画成侧面图，用这个名词给整幅“层状排列”图命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Contradiction or confrontation, or the questioning of another person's judgement or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反驳或与人对抗，也可指对他人的判断或决定提出质疑、事后挑剔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tmeri lil xi ħadd, tidħol f'konfront miegħu, jew tiddubita l-ġudizzju jew id-deċiżjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人的说法加以反驳或否认。
人与人之间的对抗、冲突或正面交锋。
对他人的判断或决定加以质疑，尤指事后认为自己本可判断得更好。

formal.mt: It-tmerija kontinwa tad-deċiżjonijiet mingħajr raġunijiet ċari xekklet il-ħidma tal-kumitat.
formal.en: Constant questioning of decisions without clear reasons hindered the committee's work.
formal.zh: 在没有明确理由的情况下不断质疑决定，妨碍了委员会的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kull darba li niddeċiedi xi ħaġa, tgħidli li kelli nagħmel mod ieħor. Mark: Għandek raġun; din it-tmerija kollha mhix tgħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Every time I decide something, you tell me I should have done it differently. Mark: You're right; all this second-guessing isn't helping.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：每次我做了决定，你都说我本该换一种做法。马克：你说得对，这样不断事后质疑没有帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kull darba li niddeċiedi xi ħaġa, tgħidli li kelli nagħmel mod ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Kull darba li niddeċiedi xi ħaġa, tgħidli li kelli nagħmel mod ieħor.
messages.zh: 每次我做了决定，你都说我本该换一种做法。
messages.en: Every time I decide something, you tell me I should have done it differently.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; din it-tmerija kollha mhix tgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; din it-tmerija kollha mhix tgħin.
messages.zh: 你说得对，这样不断事后质疑没有帮助。
messages.en: You're right; all this second-guessing isn't helping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 串起三个交流场景来记：反驳一句话、与人起冲突、事后挑剔决定；具体义随语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deteriorate through decay or rot, or to wear away through erosion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因腐朽、腐烂而变坏，或因侵蚀而逐渐损耗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħassar jew jitmermer bit-taħsir, jew jittiekel bil-mod bl-erożjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐腐坏、腐朽或衰败。
腐烂；因腐败而失去原有质地。
受到侵蚀；逐渐被磨损或蚀去。

collocations.en: the rock was eroded by the waves

formal.mt: Il-blat ta' mal-kosta tmermer bil-mewġ matul is-snin.
formal.en: The coastal rock was eroded by the waves over the years.
formal.zh: 多年来，海岸岩石受到海浪的侵蚀。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw dan l-injam? Pawlu: Tmermer bl-umdità u issa jinkiser malajr.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why can't we use this wood? Pawlu: It rotted from damp and now breaks easily.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么这块木材不能用了？保罗：它受潮腐烂了，现在很容易断。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw dan l-injam?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw dan l-injam?
messages.zh: 为什么这块木材不能用了？
messages.en: Why can't we use this wood?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmermer bl-umdità u issa jinkiser malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Tmermer bl-umdità u issa jinkiser malajr.
messages.zh: 它受潮腐烂了，现在很容易断。
messages.en: It rotted from damp and now breaks easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木头慢慢烂、岩石慢慢被浪蚀去：共同点是材料逐渐损坏，记住这是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of decaying, rotting, or gradually wearing away through erosion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物质逐渐腐坏、腐烂，或受到侵蚀而损耗的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih materjal jitħassar, jitmermer bit-taħsir, jew jittiekel bl-erożjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐坏、腐朽或逐渐衰败的过程。
腐烂的过程或现象。
侵蚀、蚀损或逐渐磨损的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tmermir tal-blat ikkawżat mill-mewġ.
formal.en: The report describes the erosion of rock caused by the waves.
formal.zh: 报告描述了海浪造成的岩石侵蚀。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qiegħed tiċċekkja l-qiegħ tal-bieb? Toni: Qiegħed infittex sinjali ta' tmermir fl-injam.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you checking the bottom of the door? Toni: I'm looking for signs of rot in the wood.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么检查门的底部？托尼：我在找木材腐烂的迹象。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qiegħed tiċċekkja l-qiegħ tal-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qiegħed tiċċekkja l-qiegħ tal-bieb?
messages.zh: 你为什么检查门的底部？
messages.en: Why are you checking the bottom of the door?

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed infittex sinjali ta' tmermir fl-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed infittex sinjali ta' tmermir fl-injam.
messages.zh: 我在找木材腐烂的迹象。
messages.en: I'm looking for signs of rot in the wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“木材的腐烂、岩石的侵蚀”两个名词短语来记，把注意力放在损坏的过程上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be juicy or to contain more liquid than desired.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有丰富汁液，或液体过多而显得太稀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun mimli meraq jew ikollu aktar likwidu milli mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 富含汁液；汁水充足。
含有过多液体；汁水太多或过稀。

collocations.en: the stew had too much liquid

formal.mt: L-istuffat tmerraq iżżejjed minħabba ż-żieda ta' wisq ilma waqt it-tisjir.
formal.en: The stew had too much liquid because too much water was added during cooking.
formal.zh: 由于烹调时加水过多，炖菜的汤汁过量了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: L-istuffat tmerraq iżżejjed; żidt wisq ilma. Mark: Ħallih ftit ieħor fuq in-nar bla għatu.
colloquial.en: Rita: The stew has too much liquid; I added too much water. Mark: Leave it on the heat a little longer without a lid.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：炖菜的汤汁太多了，我水加多了。马克：别盖锅盖，再放在火上煮一会儿。

messages.speaker: Rita (做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-istuffat tmerraq iżżejjed; żidt wisq ilma.
messages.mt_standard: L-istuffat tmerraq iżżejjed; żidt wisq ilma.
messages.zh: 炖菜的汤汁太多了，我水加多了。
messages.en: The stew has too much liquid; I added too much water.

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallih ftit ieħor fuq in-nar bla għatu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallih ftit ieħor fuq in-nar bla għatu.
messages.zh: 别盖锅盖，再放在火上煮一会儿。
messages.en: Leave it on the heat a little longer without a lid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 同时想象咬开水果满口汁、炖菜加水太多：都是液体多，是否过量要看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of smacking the lips, or the sound made while chewing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咂嘴的动作，或咀嚼食物时发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment tax-xufftejn li jagħmel ħoss, jew il-ħoss li jsir waqt li wieħed jomgħod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘴唇开合时发出声响的动作；咂嘴。
咀嚼食物时发出的声音。

collocations.en: smacking or chewing noises while eating
collocations.zh: 吃东西时的咂嘴声或咀嚼声

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni jinstema' t-tmeċliq waqt li l-persuna tomgħod.
formal.en: The recording captures chewing noises as the person chews.
formal.zh: 录音中可以听到那个人咀嚼时发出的声音。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Toni: Hu t-tmeċliq tiegħi waqt li niekol; se nipprova niekol aktar bil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that sound? Toni: It's the noise I make while chewing; I'll try to eat more quietly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那是什么声音？Toni：是我吃东西时的咀嚼声；我会尽量吃得小声一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-ħoss?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-ħoss?
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu t-tmeċliq tiegħi waqt li niekol; se nipprova niekol aktar bil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hu t-tmeċliq tiegħi waqt li niekol; se nipprova niekol aktar bil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 是我吃东西时的咀嚼声；我会尽量吃得小声一点。
messages.en: It's the noise I make while chewing; I'll try to eat more quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安静饭桌上清楚传来的吧唧声，把咂嘴动作和咀嚼声音一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Speaking quietly and unclearly so that the words are difficult to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话声音低而含糊，使人难以听清内容的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit b'leħen baxx u bi kliem mhux ċar li jkun diffiċli tifhmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含糊不清地低声说话；嘟囔。

formal.mt: It-tmeċmiċ tal-kelliem għamilha diffiċli għall-udjenza biex tifhem it-tweġiba.
formal.en: The speaker's mumbling made it difficult for the audience to understand the answer.
formal.zh: 发言者含糊低语，使听众难以听清回答。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ma fhimt xejn minn dak it-tmeċmiċ. Mark: Skużani, nerġa' ngħidha b'leħen aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Rita: I couldn't understand any of that mumbling. Mark: Sorry, I'll say it again more clearly.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你刚才嘟囔的那些话，我一句也没听懂。Mark：抱歉，我再说一遍，说清楚一点。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma fhimt xejn minn dak it-tmeċmiċ.
messages.mt_standard: Ma fhimt xejn minn dak it-tmeċmiċ.
messages.zh: 你刚才嘟囔的那些话，我一句也没听懂。
messages.en: I couldn't understand any of that mumbling.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, nerġa' ngħidha b'leħen aktar ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, nerġa' ngħidha b'leħen aktar ċar.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我再说一遍，说清楚一点。
messages.en: Sorry, I'll say it again more clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用嘴巴几乎不张开、别人听不清的说话画面，记住这是含糊嘟囔。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made publicly known through an announcement, or to be predicted in a forecast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过公告等方式被公开宣布，或作为未来情况被预测、预报。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir magħruf permezz ta' avviż, jew jingħad minn qabel li se jiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被宣布；被公布。
被预报；被预测。

formal.mt: Għal għada tħabbar maltemp, u għalhekk l-attività se ssir ġewwa.
formal.en: Bad weather has been forecast for tomorrow, so the event will take place indoors.
formal.zh: 天气预报说明天将有恶劣天气，因此活动将在室内举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tħabbar il-programm il-ġdid? Mark: Dalgħodu, fuq is-sit tal-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: When was the new programme announced? Mark: This morning, on the school's website.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新安排是什么时候公布的？马克：今天早上，在学校网站上公布的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tħabbar il-programm il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tħabbar il-programm il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 新安排是什么时候公布的？
messages.en: When was the new programme announced?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dalgħodu, fuq is-sit tal-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Dalgħodu, fuq is-sit tal-iskola.
messages.zh: 今天早上，在学校网站上公布的。
messages.en: This morning, on the school's website.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象学校公告栏和天气预报屏幕：前者帮助记“被宣布”，后者帮助记“被预报”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be knocked or struck; in another sense, to be put to trouble or inconvenience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到敲击或碰击；另一个义项指受到麻烦、因某事而费事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintlaqat jew jissawwat; f'sens ieħor, ikollu l-inkonvenjent jew il-battikata biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被敲击；受到碰击。
受到不便或麻烦；为某事费事。

collocations.en: was put to trouble finding the address
collocations.zh: 为了找到地址而费了周折

formal.mt: Il-bieb tħabbat diversi drabi qabel ma nfetaħ.
formal.en: The door was knocked on several times before it was opened.
formal.zh: 门被敲了好几次之后才打开。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Wasal il-pakkett? Ben: Iva, iżda l-kurrier tħabbat biex isib id-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the parcel arrive? Ben: Yes, but the courier had trouble finding the house.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：包裹到了吗？本：到了，不过快递员为了找到这栋房子费了些周折。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasal il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Wasal il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 包裹到了吗？
messages.en: Did the parcel arrive?

messages.speaker: Ben (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda l-kurrier tħabbat biex isib id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda l-kurrier tħabbat biex isib id-dar.
messages.zh: 到了，不过快递员为了找到这栋房子费了些周折。
messages.en: Yes, but the courier had trouble finding the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立小画面记忆：门受到敲击，快递员找地址费周折；看主语和语境选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To seek someone's favour by being friendly, or to try to form a friendship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过表现友好来讨好某人、争取好感，或主动设法与人建立友谊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifittex li jikseb il-favur ta' xi ħadd billi jkun ħabib miegħu, jew jipprova jagħmel ħbieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讨好；巴结；设法博取好感。
设法交朋友；主动寻求建立友谊。

collocations.en: sought to make friends with the neighbours
curried favour with the boss to gain an advantage
collocations.zh: 为获得好处而讨好上司

formal.mt: L-impjegat tħabbeb mal-kap bit-tama li jikseb vantaġġ personali.
formal.en: The employee curried favour with the boss in the hope of gaining a personal advantage.
formal.zh: 那名员工讨好上司，希望从中获得个人好处。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mar Pawlu fil-lokal il-ġdid? Toni: Tħabbeb mal-ġirien u issa għandu ma' min jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Pawlu get on in the new neighbourhood? Toni: He made friends with the neighbours, and now he has people to talk to.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗搬到新社区后过得怎么样？托尼：他主动和邻居交了朋友，现在有人可以聊天了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar Pawlu fil-lokal il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar Pawlu fil-lokal il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 保罗搬到新社区后过得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get on in the new neighbourhood?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħabbeb mal-ġirien u issa għandu ma' min jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Tħabbeb mal-ġirien u issa għandu ma' min jitkellem.
messages.zh: 他主动和邻居交了朋友，现在有人可以聊天了。
messages.en: He made friends with the neighbours, and now he has people to talk to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“主动拉近关系”的场景，再看动机：为了友谊是交朋友，为了好处则是讨好巴结。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become entangled, to become confused, or to become pregnant, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随语境表示被缠住、变得糊涂，或怀孕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqabad f'xi ħaġa mħabbla, jitfixkel fil-ħsieb, jew jinqabad tqil, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被缠住；陷入纠缠。
变得糊涂；理不清头绪。
怀孕；受孕。

formal.mt: L-istudent tħabbel fil-kalkoli u talab lill-għalliem jispjega l-proċedura mill-ġdid.
formal.en: The student got confused by the calculations and asked the teacher to explain the procedure again.
formal.zh: 学生被计算弄糊涂了，请老师重新解释步骤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaf Pawlu? Mark: Tħabbel fil-ħbula. Ejja ngħinuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu stop? Mark: He got tangled in the ropes. Let's help him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 怎么停下来了？Mark：他被绳子缠住了。我们去帮帮他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqaf Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqaf Pawlu?
messages.zh: Pawlu 怎么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħabbel fil-ħbula. Ejja ngħinuh.
messages.mt_standard: Tħabbel fil-ħbula. Ejja ngħinuh.
messages.zh: 他被绳子缠住了。我们去帮帮他。
messages.en: He got tangled in the ropes. Let's help him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象绳子缠成一团，再联想到思路打结；怀孕义单独配卡记忆，阅读时依靠语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put in prison and lose one's freedom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被关进监狱，失去人身自由。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed il-ħabs u jitlef il-libertà tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被关进监狱；被监禁。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel tħabbes għal sena wara l-proċess.
formal.en: According to the report, the man was imprisoned for a year after the trial.
formal.zh: 据报告，这名男子在审判后被监禁一年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara mill-karattru fl-aħħar tal-film? Mark: Tħabbes, imma ħuh baqa' jipprova jgħinu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the character at the end of the film? Mark: He was put in prison, but his brother kept trying to help him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影最后那个角色怎么样了？Mark：他被关进监狱了，不过他哥哥一直设法帮助他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara mill-karattru fl-aħħar tal-film?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara mill-karattru fl-aħħar tal-film?
messages.zh: 电影最后那个角色怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the character at the end of the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħabbes, imma ħuh baqa' jipprova jgħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Tħabbes, imma ħuh baqa' jipprova jgħinu.
messages.zh: 他被关进监狱了，不过他哥哥一直设法帮助他。
messages.en: He was put in prison, but his brother kept trying to help him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上牢门关闭的画面，记成某人被关进去；特别留意它与末尾带点的 tħabbeż 不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be baked, or to be forced to withdraw from an activity or competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示被烘烤，或被迫退出某项活动、竞争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissajjar fil-forn, jew jiġi mġiegħel jirtira minn attività jew kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烘烤；经烘焙制成。
被迫退出；被迫撤出。

collocations.en: was forced to withdraw from the competition

formal.mt: Il-ħobż tħabbeż fil-forn u tħalla jiksaħ qabel tqassam.
formal.en: The bread was baked in the oven and left to cool before it was distributed.
formal.zh: 面包在烤箱中烤好后，先放凉再分发。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu mhux se jikkompeti? Mark: Tħabbeż mill-kompetizzjoni kontra qalbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't Pawlu going to compete? Mark: He was forced to withdraw from the competition against his wishes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 为什么不参赛了？Mark：他被迫退出比赛，心里并不情愿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu mhux se jikkompeti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu mhux se jikkompeti?
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么不参赛了？
messages.en: Why isn't Pawlu going to compete?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħabbeż mill-kompetizzjoni kontra qalbu.
messages.mt_standard: Tħabbeż mill-kompetizzjoni kontra qalbu.
messages.zh: 他被迫退出比赛，心里并不情愿。
messages.en: He was forced to withdraw from the competition against his wishes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张场景卡：一张画烤箱里的面包，一张画被迫退赛的人；同一个词分场景记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making friends and developing friendly relationships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结交朋友、建立友好关系的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih in-nies jagħmlu ħbieb u jibnu relazzjonijiet ta' ħbiberija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交朋友；结交朋友并建立友谊的过程。

formal.mt: L-attivitajiet tal-grupp joffru opportunitajiet għat-tħabbib bejn l-istudenti l-ġodda.
formal.en: The group activities offer opportunities for new students to make friends.
formal.zh: 小组活动为新生提供了结交朋友的机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed torganizzaw dawn il-logħob? Mark: Għat-tħabbib bejn it-tfal. Hekk isiru jafu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you organizing these games? Mark: To help the children make friends. That way they get to know one another.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们为什么组织这些游戏？Mark：为了让孩子们交朋友，这样他们就能互相认识。

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed torganizzaw dawn il-logħob?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed torganizzaw dawn il-logħob?
messages.zh: 你们为什么组织这些游戏？
messages.en: Why are you organizing these games?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tħabbib bejn it-tfal. Hekk isiru jafu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tħabbib bejn it-tfal. Hekk isiru jafu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 为了让孩子们交朋友，这样他们就能互相认识。
messages.en: To help the children make friends. That way they get to know one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新同学通过游戏互相认识，把这个名词记成交朋友的过程，而不是某一位朋友。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Entanglement, confusion, or the process of causing pregnancy, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随语境表示物体的缠结、思绪或事情的混乱，或使受孕的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-taħbil ta' affarijiet ma' xulxin, konfużjoni fil-ħsieb, jew il-proċess li jwassal għat-tqala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠结；物体互相缠绕或被缠住的状态。
混乱；困惑；理不清头绪的状态。
使受孕；使怀孕的过程。

formal.mt: It-tħabbil tal-ħbula waqqaf ix-xogħol sakemm il-ħaddiema firduhom.
formal.en: The entanglement of the ropes stopped the work until the workers separated them.
formal.zh: 绳索缠结使工作停了下来，直到工人把绳索分开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tieħu daqshekk ħin? Mark: Hemm tħabbil fil-ħbula. Għinni nifridhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is it taking you so long? Mark: The ropes are tangled. Help me separate them.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么花了这么长时间？Mark：绳子缠在一起了，帮我把它们分开。

messages.speaker: Maja (同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tieħu daqshekk ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tieħu daqshekk ħin?
messages.zh: 你怎么花了这么长时间？
messages.en: Why is it taking you so long?

messages.speaker: Mark (同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tħabbil fil-ħbula. Għinni nifridhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tħabbil fil-ħbula. Għinni nifridhom.
messages.zh: 绳子缠在一起了，帮我把它们分开。
messages.en: The ropes are tangled. Help me separate them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用绳结图记缠结，用乱线图记困惑，再把使受孕义另列一栏；同时记住这是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of announcing information so that other people know about it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把消息告知他人或公众的行为，即宣布、公布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih tingħata aħbar jew informazzjoni biex issir magħrufa lil oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣布；公布消息或信息的行为。

formal.mt: It-tħabbir tar-riżultati se jsir fis-sala prinċipali wara l-aħħar prova.
formal.en: The results will be announced in the main hall after the final test.
formal.zh: 最后一项测试结束后，将在主厅公布结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se jkun it-tħabbir tar-riżultati? Mark: Għada filgħodu. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-paġna tal-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: When will the results be announced? Mark: Tomorrow morning. Let's check the school's page.
colloquial.zh: Maja：什么时候公布结果？Mark：明天早上。我们看看学校的网页吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se jkun it-tħabbir tar-riżultati?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se jkun it-tħabbir tar-riżultati?
messages.zh: 什么时候公布结果？
messages.en: When will the results be announced?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-paġna tal-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-paġna tal-iskola.
messages.zh: 明天早上。我们看看学校的网页吧。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning. Let's check the school's page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主持人拿着结果单向大家宣布，把这个名词和公布消息的动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting someone in prison or the state of being held there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人关进监狱的行为，或被关押在监狱中的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li persuna titqiegħed il-ħabs, jew l-istat li tkun miżmuma hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监禁；关押；被囚禁的状态。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-effetti ta' tħabbis fit-tul fuq ir-relazzjonijiet tal-familja.
formal.en: The study examines the effects of long-term imprisonment on family relationships.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察长期监禁对家庭关系的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Mark: Fuq it-tħabbis u kif ibiddel il-ħajja tal-familji.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this book about? Mark: About imprisonment and how it changes families' lives.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这本书讲什么？Mark：讲监禁，以及监禁如何改变家庭的生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex inhu dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex inhu dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq it-tħabbis u kif ibiddel il-ħajja tal-familji.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq it-tħabbis u kif ibiddel il-ħajja tal-familji.
messages.zh: 讲监禁，以及监禁如何改变家庭的生活。
messages.en: About imprisonment and how it changes families' lives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħabbes 配成他被关押的句子，把 tħabbis 写在监禁这一概念的卡片上，成对区分动词和名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or sound of knocking, for example on a door.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敲击的动作或声音，例如敲门或敲门声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-ħoss ta' meta wieħed iħabbat, pereżempju fuq bieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敲击；敲门；敲击产生的声音。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa waqfet għal mument meta nstema' tħabbit qawwi fuq il-bieb.
formal.en: The meeting paused for a moment when loud knocking was heard at the door.
formal.zh: 门外传来响亮的敲门声，会议因此暂停了片刻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak it-tħabbit fuq il-bieb? Mark: Iva, sejjer niftaħ. Forsi waslet Anna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that knocking on the door? Mark: Yes, I'm going to open it. Maybe Anna has arrived.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听见那阵敲门声了吗？Mark：听见了，我去开门。可能是 Anna 来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dak it-tħabbit fuq il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dak it-tħabbit fuq il-bieb?
messages.zh: 你听见那阵敲门声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that knocking on the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sejjer niftaħ. Forsi waslet Anna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sejjer niftaħ. Forsi waslet Anna.
messages.zh: 听见了，我去开门。可能是 Anna 来了。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to open it. Maybe Anna has arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 轻敲桌面两下，再读 tħabbit，把声音、敲击动作和这个名词绑在同一个记忆画面里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of withdrawing from an activity or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某项活动或某种处境中退出或撤出的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jirtira minn attività jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退出；撤出。

formal.mt: It-tħabbiż tat-tim mill-kompetizzjoni ġie kkonfermat bil-miktub.
formal.en: The team's withdrawal from the competition was confirmed in writing.
formal.zh: 该队退出比赛一事已获得书面确认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tħabbiż mit-tellieqa kien minħabba l-korriment? Mark: Iva, ma stajtx niġri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was your withdrawal from the race because of the injury? Mark: Yes, I couldn't run.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你是因为受伤才退出赛跑的吗？Mark：对，我没法跑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tħabbiż mit-tellieqa kien minħabba l-korriment?
messages.mt_standard: It-tħabbiż mit-tellieqa kien minħabba l-korriment?
messages.zh: 你是因为受伤才退出赛跑的吗？
messages.en: Was your withdrawal from the race because of the injury?

messages.speaker: Mark (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma stajtx niġri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma stajtx niġri.
messages.zh: 对，我没法跑。
messages.en: Yes, I couldn't run.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一张选手离开赛道的画面，记住它表示“退出”这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physical effort made when doing a demanding task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成吃力的任务时付出的体力或力气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sforz fiżiku li wieħed jagħmel biex iwettaq biċċa xogħol li titlob ħafna saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体力上的付出；干活时费的力气。

formal.mt: Il-ġarr tal-ġebel jitlob ħafna tħabit fiżiku.
formal.en: Carrying the stones requires a great deal of physical effort.
formal.zh: 搬运这些石头需要付出大量体力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kien hemm ħafna tħabit biex iġġorr il-kaxxi? Mark: Iva, kienu tqal ħafna. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did carrying the boxes take a lot of effort? Mark: Yes, they were very heavy. I need to rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：搬这些箱子很费力吗？Mark：对，箱子特别重。我得休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna tħabit biex iġġorr il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna tħabit biex iġġorr il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 搬这些箱子很费力吗？
messages.en: Did carrying the boxes take a lot of effort?

messages.speaker: Mark (搬箱子的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienu tqal ħafna. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienu tqal ħafna. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 对，箱子特别重。我得休息一下。
messages.en: Yes, they were very heavy. I need to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己搬重箱子时满头大汗，把这个词和“身体费力”的感觉连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive an embrace, with someone holding you in their arms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到别人的拥抱，被对方用双臂抱住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jiġi mgħannaq minn persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拥抱；受到别人的拥抱。

formal.mt: Meta wasal lura, it-tifel tħaddan minn ommu.
formal.en: When he returned, the boy was embraced by his mother.
formal.zh: 男孩回来时，母亲拥抱了他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk tħaddan minn ommok meta wasal? Mark: Iva, kienet ferħana ħafna li reġgħet ratu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was your brother embraced by your mother when he arrived? Mark: Yes, she was very happy to see him again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥到的时候，你妈妈拥抱他了吗？Mark：对，她特别高兴又见到他了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk tħaddan minn ommok meta wasal?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk tħaddan minn ommok meta wasal?
messages.zh: 你哥哥到的时候，你妈妈拥抱他了吗？
messages.en: Was your brother embraced by your mother when he arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet ferħana ħafna li reġgħet ratu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet ferħana ħafna li reġgħet ratu.
messages.zh: 对，她特别高兴又见到他了。
messages.en: Yes, she was very happy to see him again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把自己放在拥抱的接受者位置：别人伸出双臂，而你“被拥抱”，借此记住被动含义。

gloss_zh: 变绿；在亲友陪同下赴婚礼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become green; also, to be accompanied to one's wedding by friends or other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成绿色；也指在朋友等人的陪同下前往自己的婚礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir aħdar; ukoll, li wieħed jiġi akkumpanjat minn ħbieb jew nies oħra għat-tieġ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变绿；呈现出绿色。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be accompanied to one's wedding by friends, etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 由朋友等人陪同前往自己的婚礼。

collocations.en: the groom was accompanied to his wedding by his friends
collocations.zh: 新郎由朋友们陪同前往婚礼

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, il-ġnien tħaddar u deher mimli ħajja.
formal.en: After the rain, the garden became green and looked full of life.
formal.zh: 雨后，花园变绿了，显得生机勃勃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-għarus tħaddar minn sħabu għat-tieġ? Mark: Iva, marru miegħu sal-knisja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the groom accompanied to his wedding by his friends? Mark: Yes, they went with him to the church.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新郎是由朋友们陪着去婚礼的吗？Mark：对，他们陪他去了教堂。

messages.speaker: Maja (婚礼宾客)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għarus tħaddar minn sħabu għat-tieġ?
messages.mt_standard: L-għarus tħaddar minn sħabu għat-tieġ?
messages.zh: 新郎是由朋友们陪着去婚礼的吗？
messages.en: Was the groom accompanied to his wedding by his friends?

messages.speaker: Mark (新郎的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, marru miegħu sal-knisja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, marru miegħu sal-knisja.
messages.zh: 对，他们陪他去了教堂。
messages.en: Yes, they went with him to the church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为两个义项各画一张卡片：一张是雨后变绿的花园，一张是朋友陪新郎赴婚礼，分场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be employed to do work; also, to be used frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受雇从事工作；也指某物或某种方法被经常使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jingħata xogħol; ukoll, li xi ħaġa tintuża ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受雇；被雇用来工作。
被经常使用；被频繁运用。

formal.mt: Wara t-taħriġ, ir-raġel tħaddem bħala tekniku fil-fabbrika.
formal.en: After the training, the man was employed as a technician at the factory.
formal.zh: 培训结束后，这名男子受雇在工厂担任技术员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-metodu tħaddem ta' spiss fil-klassi? Mark: Iva, u għen lill-istudenti jifhmu aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this method used frequently in class? Mark: Yes, and it helped the students understand better.
colloquial.zh: Maja：课堂上经常用这个方法吗？Mark：对，它帮助学生理解得更好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-metodu tħaddem ta' spiss fil-klassi?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-metodu tħaddem ta' spiss fil-klassi?
messages.zh: 课堂上经常用这个方法吗？
messages.en: Was this method used frequently in class?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għen lill-istudenti jifhmu aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għen lill-istudenti jifhmu aħjar.
messages.zh: 对，它帮助学生理解得更好了。
messages.en: Yes, and it helped the students understand better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面区分义项：人拿到工作是“受雇”，方法在课堂反复出现是“被频繁使用”。

gloss_zh: 雇用人员；频繁使用；使正常运作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The employing of people, the frequent use of something, or the act of making something function properly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雇用人员的行为、对某物的频繁使用，或使某物正常运作的操作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' xogħol lil persuni, l-użu ta' xi ħaġa ta' spiss, jew l-att li wieħed jagħmel xi ħaġa taħdem kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雇用人员；安排人员从事工作的行为。
频繁使用某物；经常运用某物的行为。
使某物正常运作；让设备等按要求发挥功能的操作。

collocations.en: the frequent use of the equipment
the proper operation of the machine
collocations.zh: 正确操作机器，使其正常运转

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega l-passi meħtieġa għat-tħaddim korrett tal-magna.
formal.en: The manual explains the steps required for the proper operation of the machine.
formal.zh: 手册说明了正确操作机器、使其正常运转所需的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' turini t-tħaddim ta' din il-magna? Mark: Żgur. L-ewwel agħfas il-buttuna l-ħadra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you show me how to operate this machine? Mark: Sure. First press the green button.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能教我怎么操作这台机器吗？Mark：当然。先按绿色按钮。

messages.mt_spoken: Tista' turini t-tħaddim ta' din il-magna?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' turini t-tħaddim ta' din il-magna?
messages.zh: 你能教我怎么操作这台机器吗？
messages.en: Can you show me how to operate this machine?

messages.speaker: Mark (培训员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. L-ewwel agħfas il-buttuna l-ħadra.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. L-ewwel agħfas il-buttuna l-ħadra.
messages.zh: 当然。先按绿色按钮。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项放进同一家工厂：招聘员工、频繁使用设备、正确开动机器，分别对应三种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of holding someone in one's arms in an embrace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用双臂抱住某人的行为，即拥抱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jgħannaq lil xi ħadd u jżommu f'dirgħajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥抱；用双臂抱住对方的行为。

formal.mt: Wara l-aħbar tajba, kien hemm tħaddin ta' ferħ bejn il-membri tal-familja.
formal.en: After the good news, there was joyful embracing among the family members.
formal.zh: 听到好消息后，家人们喜悦地拥抱在一起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kien hemm ħafna tħaddin meta ltqajtu mill-ġdid? Mark: Iva, konna ilna sena ma naraw lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was there a lot of hugging when you met again? Mark: Yes, we hadn't seen each other for a year.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们重逢时是不是拥抱了好一阵？Mark：对，我们已经一年没见了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna tħaddin meta ltqajtu mill-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna tħaddin meta ltqajtu mill-ġdid?
messages.zh: 你们重逢时是不是拥抱了好一阵？
messages.en: Was there a lot of hugging when you met again?

messages.speaker: Mark (重逢的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, konna ilna sena ma naraw lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, konna ilna sena ma naraw lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 对，我们已经一年没见了。
messages.en: Yes, we hadn't seen each other for a year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重逢时张开双臂的动作拍成一张照片，照片里的“拥抱行为”就是这个名词的记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming green; also, attendance at a wedding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成绿色的过程；也指参加或出席婚礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir ħadra; ukoll, l-att li wieħed jattendi tieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变绿；逐渐呈现绿色的过程。
参加婚礼；出席婚礼。

formal.mt: Ix-xita għenet fit-tħaddir tal-għelieqi wara s-sajf niexef.
formal.en: The rain helped the fields become green after the dry summer.
formal.zh: 干燥的夏季过后，雨水帮助田野重新变绿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek ma weġibtx dwar it-tħaddir tiegħek għat-tieġ. Se tiġi? Mark: Iva, se niġi. Grazzi tal-istedina!
colloquial.en: Maja: You still haven't replied about attending the wedding. Are you coming? Mark: Yes, I'll come. Thanks for the invitation!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还没回复是否出席婚礼呢。你会来吗？Mark：会，我会来。谢谢邀请！

messages.speaker: Maja (新娘)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek ma weġibtx dwar it-tħaddir tiegħek għat-tieġ. Se tiġi?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek ma weġibtx dwar it-tħaddir tiegħek għat-tieġ. Se tiġi?
messages.zh: 你还没回复是否出席婚礼呢。你会来吗？
messages.en: You still haven't replied about attending the wedding. Are you coming?

messages.speaker: Mark (受邀宾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se niġi. Grazzi tal-istedina!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se niġi. Grazzi tal-istedina!
messages.zh: 会，我会来。谢谢邀请！
messages.en: Yes, I'll come. Thanks for the invitation!

cognitive_memory_aid: 准备两张名词卡：田野由黄转绿的一段过程，以及宾客出席婚礼这件事；分别记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 被减轻重量；被加快；变得更容易

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become lighter in weight, to be expedited, or to be made easier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重量被减轻，事情的进展被加快，或任务变得更容易。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir eħfef fil-piż, jitħaffef il-progress tiegħu, jew isir aktar faċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重量被减轻。
被加快处理或推进。
被简化；变得更容易。

formal.mt: Il-proċess tħaffef wara li tneħħew żewġ passi mhux meħtieġa.
formal.en: The process was expedited after two unnecessary steps were removed.
formal.zh: 取消两个不必要的步骤后，流程加快了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għadek iġġorr dak il-piż kollu? Pawlu: Le, il-piż tħaffef wara li ħriġt il-kotba.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you still carrying all that weight? Pawlu: No, the load became lighter after I took the books out.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你还背着那么重的东西吗？保罗：没有了，把书拿出来以后就轻了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek iġġorr dak il-piż kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek iġġorr dak il-piż kollu?
messages.zh: 你还背着那么重的东西吗？
messages.en: Are you still carrying all that weight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-piż tħaffef wara li ħriġt il-kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-piż tħaffef wara li ħriġt il-kotba.
messages.zh: 没有了，把书拿出来以后就轻了。
messages.en: No, the load became lighter after I took the books out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把书包变轻、办事加快、作业变容易三个画面连起来，记住这个动词的三种变化结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be dug, as when a hole, well, or trench is made by removing earth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指坑、井或沟等通过移走泥土而被挖出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir bit-tneħħija tal-ħamrija, bħal bir, toqba jew foss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挖掘；通过挖土而形成。

formal.mt: Il-foss tħaffer tul il-ħajt biex jitqiegħdu l-pajpijiet.
formal.en: The trench was dug along the wall so that the pipes could be laid.
formal.zh: 沿墙挖出了一条沟，以便铺设管道。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-bir għadu mhux lest? Ġużeppi: Il-bir tħaffer, imma għad irridu ngħattuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the well still unfinished? Ġużeppi: The well has been dug, but we still need to cover it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：井还没弄好吗？朱塞佩：已经挖好了，不过我们还得把它盖上。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bir għadu mhux lest?
messages.mt_standard: Il-bir għadu mhux lest?
messages.zh: 井还没弄好吗？
messages.en: Is the well still unfinished?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bir tħaffer, imma għad irridu ngħattuh.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bir tħaffer, imma għad irridu ngħattuh.
messages.zh: 已经挖好了，不过我们还得把它盖上。
messages.en: The well has been dug, but we still need to cover it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一口井已经被挖出来，把这个词与“井被挖成”的完整句子一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 负担的减轻；使事情更容易

teaching_sense.en_definition: The lightening of a burden or the act of making something easier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减轻负担的过程或做法，也指使事情更容易完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tnaqqis ta' piż jew ta' tagħbija, jew l-għemil ta' xi ħaġa aktar faċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负担的减轻；减轻负担这一过程。
使某事更容易；降低某事的难度。

formal.mt: L-għan tal-għodda l-ġdida huwa t-tħaffif tax-xogħol ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The purpose of the new tool is to make everyday work easier.
formal.zh: 新工具的目的是减轻日常工作的难度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex xtrajt dan il-karru żgħir? Mark: Għat-tħaffif tal-piż; hekk ma jkollix inġorr kollox f'idejja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you buy this little trolley? Mark: To lighten the load; this way I won't have to carry everything in my hands.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么买这辆小推车？马克：为了减轻负担，这样就不用把所有东西都提在手里了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex xtrajt dan il-karru żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex xtrajt dan il-karru żgħir?
messages.zh: 你为什么买这辆小推车？
messages.en: Why did you buy this little trolley?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tħaffif tal-piż; hekk ma jkollix inġorr kollox f'idejja.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tħaffif tal-piż; hekk ma jkollix inġorr kollox f'idejja.
messages.zh: 为了减轻负担，这样就不用把所有东西都提在手里了。
messages.en: To lighten the load; this way I won't have to carry everything in my hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把小推车接过手中重物的画面记作“减轻负担”，再联想到工作难度的降低。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of digging or excavating by removing earth or other material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 移走泥土或其他材料进行挖掘、开挖的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li titneħħa l-ħamrija jew materjal ieħor biex isiru toqob, fosos jew spazji fl-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖土；挖掘这一活动。
开挖；通过移除土石等材料进行挖掘。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol ta' tħaffir se jibda wara li tiġi mmarkata ż-żona.
formal.en: The excavation work will begin after the area has been marked out.
formal.zh: 划定区域后，开挖工程将开始。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn ġej dan l-istorbju? Toni: Hemm xogħol ta' tħaffir fit-triq; qed jagħmlu foss għall-pajpijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is this noise coming from? Toni: There's excavation work in the street; they're digging a trench for the pipes.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这噪声是从哪里来的？托尼：街上正在开挖，他们在挖一条铺管道的沟。

messages.speaker: Sara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġej dan l-istorbju?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġej dan l-istorbju?
messages.zh: 这噪声是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this noise coming from?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xogħol ta' tħaffir fit-triq; qed jagħmlu foss għall-pajpijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xogħol ta' tħaffir fit-triq; qed jagħmlu foss għall-pajpijiet.
messages.zh: 街上正在开挖，他们在挖一条铺管道的沟。
messages.en: There's excavation work in the street; they're digging a trench for the pipes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用铲子不断挖土的连续画面记住名词“挖掘”，与表示“被挖出”的动词分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel a desire or appetite for something, or to become attracted to it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事物产生想要的念头、食欲或兴趣，受到其吸引。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħoss xewqa jew aptit għal xi ħaġa, jew tibda tinġibed lejha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想要某物；渴望某事物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have an appetite for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 想吃某种食物；对某物产生食欲。
受到某事物吸引；对某事物产生兴趣。

collocations.en: felt like having a piece of cake
felt tempted to buy a bicycle

formal.mt: Wara li qara l-programm, Mark tħajjar jieħu sehem fil-kors tal-fotografija.
formal.en: After reading the programme, Mark became interested in taking part in the photography course.
formal.zh: 读完课程安排后，马克对参加摄影课程产生了兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-kejk! Pawlu: Meta rajtu, tħajjart nieħu biċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that cake! Pawlu: When I saw it, I felt like having a slice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那个蛋糕！保罗：我一看到它，就想吃一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-kejk!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-kejk!
messages.zh: 看那个蛋糕！
messages.en: Look at that cake!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta rajtu, tħajjart nieħu biċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Meta rajtu, tħajjart nieħu biċċa.
messages.zh: 我一看到它，就想吃一块。
messages.en: When I saw it, I felt like having a slice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把蛋糕、自行车和摄影课画成三张卡片，分别联想嘴馋、想要和被吸引，记住这个动词共同表达“动了心”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To form a mental picture or an idea of something, including something that does not yet exist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在脑海中形成某事物的画面或概念，也可指构想尚不存在的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toħloq f'moħħok stampa jew idea ta' xi ħaġa, anki jekk għadha ma teżistix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想象；在脑海中形成画面。
构想；在头脑中形成某种想法或概念。

formal.mt: L-awtur tħajjel belt mingħajr karozzi u ddeskriva kif jgħixu n-nies fiha.
formal.en: The author imagined a city without cars and described how its inhabitants live.
formal.zh: 作者想象了一座没有汽车的城市，并描写了居民在其中的生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġie f'moħħok waqt l-istorja? Pawlu: Tħajjilt dar żgħira ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What came to mind during the story? Pawlu: I imagined a small house by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：听故事时，你脑海里出现了什么？保罗：我想象了一栋海边的小房子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġie f'moħħok waqt l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġie f'moħħok waqt l-istorja?
messages.zh: 听故事时，你脑海里出现了什么？
messages.en: What came to mind during the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħajjilt dar żgħira ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Tħajjilt dar żgħira ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 我想象了一栋海边的小房子。
messages.en: I imagined a small house by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一块脑内画板：画出海边小屋是“想象”，设计尚未出现的方案是“构想”，两义一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive affectionate caresses or to be indulged so much that one becomes spoilt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到温柔的抚摸和疼爱，或因受到过度迁就而被宠坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tirċievi tmellis u għożża, jew titħalla tagħmel li trid tant li titħassar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到爱抚；被温柔地抚摸。
被宠坏；因受到过度纵容而养成任性的习惯。

formal.mt: It-tifel tħajjem iżżejjed, għax l-adulti dejjem tawh kull ma talab.
formal.en: The boy was spoilt because the adults always gave him everything he asked for.
formal.zh: 这个男孩被宠坏了，因为大人总是满足他的所有要求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus jidher kuntent ħafna. Pawlu: Iva, illum tħajjem bi tmellis ġentili.
colloquial.en: Maja: The cat looks very happy. Pawlu: Yes, today he was caressed with gentle strokes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只猫看起来很开心。保罗：是呀，今天有人轻轻地抚摸了它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus jidher kuntent ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus jidher kuntent ħafna.
messages.zh: 这只猫看起来很开心。
messages.en: The cat looks very happy.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum tħajjem bi tmellis ġentili.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum tħajjem bi tmellis ġentili.
messages.zh: 是呀，今天有人轻轻地抚摸了它。
messages.en: Yes, today he was caressed with gentle strokes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“被疼爱的人或动物”作记忆主角：轻轻抚摸是受到爱抚，一味满足要求则可能被宠坏；注意两义都强调接受者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become cunning and willing to deceive others for one's own advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得狡猾且不诚实，开始为自身利益而欺骗他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issir makakk u tibda tqarraq b'ħaddieħor biex tikseb vantaġġ għalik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得狡猾而具有欺骗性；变得善于耍诡计骗人。

collocations.en: became cunning and deceitful over time
collocations.zh: 逐渐变得狡猾而善于欺骗

collocations.en: became cunning and deceitful to gain an advantage
collocations.zh: 为取得优势而变得狡猾善骗

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, in-negozjant tħajjen maż-żmien u beda jqarraq bil-klijenti biex iżid il-profitt.
formal.en: In the story, the merchant became cunning and deceitful over time and began cheating customers to increase his profit.
formal.zh: 故事中，商人逐渐变得狡猾善骗，开始欺骗顾客以增加利润。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-karattru? Pawlu: Għax tħajjen u issa jigdeb biex jieħu li jrid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you trust that character? Pawlu: Because he has become cunning and deceitful, and now he lies to get what he wants.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不信任那个角色？保罗：因为他变得狡猾善骗，现在靠撒谎得到自己想要的东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-karattru?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-karattru?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个角色？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that character?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tħajjen u issa jigdeb biex jieħu li jrid.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tħajjen u issa jigdeb biex jieħu li jrid.
messages.zh: 因为他变得狡猾善骗，现在靠撒谎得到自己想要的东西。
messages.en: Because he has become cunning and deceitful, and now he lies to get what he wants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给故事人物画一条变化箭头：从老实走向耍计骗人。这个词要记住“变得”的过程，也要保留欺骗性的贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become enclosed by walls or fences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被围墙或栅栏围起来，形成有边界的封闭空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkun imdawwar b'ħitan jew ċnut li jagħlqu l-ispazju.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be enclosed with walls or fences
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被围墙或栅栏围住；被筑墙或设置栅栏封围起来。

collocations.en: was enclosed by a stone wall
was enclosed by a wooden fence

formal.mt: Il-ġnien tħajjet b'ħajt tal-ġebel, u tħalliet daħla waħda għall-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The garden was enclosed by a stone wall, and one entrance was left for visitors.
formal.zh: 花园被石墙围了起来，并为访客保留了一个入口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inbidel fil-ġnien? Pawlu: Tħajjet b'ċint tal-injam; issa l-kelb ma jistax joħroġ waħdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What has changed in the garden? Pawlu: It has been enclosed by a wooden fence; now the dog can't get out on his own.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：花园有什么变化？保罗：它被木栅栏围起来了，现在狗不能自己跑出去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inbidel fil-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: X'inbidel fil-ġnien?
messages.zh: 花园有什么变化？
messages.en: What has changed in the garden?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħajjet b'ċint tal-injam; issa l-kelb ma jistax joħroġ waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Tħajjet b'ċint tal-injam; issa l-kelb ma jistax joħroġ waħdu.
messages.zh: 它被木栅栏围起来了，现在狗不能自己跑出去了。
messages.en: It has been enclosed by a wooden fence; now the dog can't get out on his own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一个花园，再沿四周补上墙或栅栏，把这个词写在围好的空间里，联想“被围起来”的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Affectionate caresses, or the act of indulging someone excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达疼爱的抚摸，也可指过度迁就、纵容某人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tmellis li juri għożża, jew l-għoti ta' kull ma jitlob xi ħadd b'mod eċċessiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抚；表达亲昵与疼爱的轻柔抚摸。
宠溺某人；过度迁就、纵容某人。

formal.mt: It-tħajjim żejjed, bħall-għoti ta' kull ma jitlob it-tifel, huwa differenti mill-għożża li tinkludi limiti ċari.
formal.en: Excessive indulgence, such as giving a child everything he asks for, differs from affection that includes clear boundaries.
formal.zh: 过度宠溺，例如孩子要什么就给什么，与包含明确界限的关爱有所区别。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jgħin lill-qattus jikkalma? Pawlu: Ftit tħajjim ġentili fuq rasu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What helps the cat calm down? Pawlu: A few gentle caresses on his head.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎样能让这只猫平静下来？保罗：轻轻摸摸它的头就好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jgħin lill-qattus jikkalma?
messages.mt_standard: X'jgħin lill-qattus jikkalma?
messages.zh: 怎样能让这只猫平静下来？
messages.en: What helps the cat calm down?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit tħajjim ġentili fuq rasu.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit tħajjim ġentili fuq rasu.
messages.zh: 轻轻摸摸它的头就好。
messages.en: A few gentle caresses on his head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在名词卡片上，左边画轻抚猫咪，右边画凡事迁就孩子；分别记“爱抚”和“宠溺”这两种行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cunning: the use of clever but deceitful methods to gain an advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过机巧而带有欺骗性的手段获取优势的狡猾或诡诈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Makakkerija li tuża l-qerq biex tikseb vantaġġ fuq ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狡猾；诡诈；善于使用计谋骗人的心机。

formal.mt: L-awtur juri t-tħajjin tal-karattru permezz tal-wegħdiet foloz li jagħmel biex jikseb il-fiduċja tan-nies.
formal.en: The author reveals the character's cunning through the false promises he makes to gain people's trust.
formal.zh: 作者通过这个人物为赢得他人信任而作出的虚假承诺，展现了他的狡诈。
