colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-volpi rebħet fl-istorja? Pawlu: Bit-tħajjin tagħha; qarrqet bl-annimali l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the fox win in the story? Pawlu: Through her cunning; she tricked the other animals.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的狐狸为什么赢了？保罗：靠它的狡猾，它骗过了其他动物。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-volpi rebħet fl-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-volpi rebħet fl-istorja?
messages.zh: 故事里的狐狸为什么赢了？
messages.en: Why did the fox win in the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-tħajjin tagħha; qarrqet bl-annimali l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-tħajjin tagħha; qarrqet bl-annimali l-oħra.
messages.zh: 靠它的狡猾，它骗过了其他动物。
messages.en: Through her cunning; she tricked the other animals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想寓言里用假话设圈套的狐狸，把这个名词记作“狡诈心机”；与表示“变得狡猾”的动词 tħajjen 对照辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of encouraging or persuading someone to do something, or making something seem tempting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过鼓励、劝说或吸引力促使某人行动，也可指使人动心的引诱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tħeġġeġ jew tipperswadi lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew li tagħmilha tidher attraenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使；劝导或诱导某人采取某种行动。
引诱；使人产生想要某物或做某事的欲望。

formal.mt: Il-librerija organizzat attivitajiet ta' tħajjir għall-qari sabiex aktar tfal jiskopru l-kotba.
formal.en: The library organised activities to encourage reading so that more children would discover books.
formal.zh: 图书馆组织了鼓励阅读的活动，让更多孩子接触并发现书籍的乐趣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex poġġew il-ħelu ħdejn il-kaxxiera? Pawlu: Dak hu tħajjir biex tixtri xi ħaġa oħra qabel titlaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did they put the sweets by the checkout? Pawlu: That's an inducement to buy something else before you leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么把糖果放在收银台旁边？保罗：这是为了诱使你离开前再买点东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġew il-ħelu ħdejn il-kaxxiera?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġew il-ħelu ħdejn il-kaxxiera?
messages.zh: 他们为什么把糖果放在收银台旁边？
messages.en: Why did they put the sweets by the checkout?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu tħajjir biex tixtri xi ħaġa oħra qabel titlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu tħajjir biex tixtri xi ħaġa oħra qabel titlaq.
messages.zh: 这是为了诱使你离开前再买点东西。
messages.en: That's an inducement to buy something else before you leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支把人引向行动的箭头：指向图书是鼓励阅读，指向糖果是诱惑购买；用同一画面记住“促使”和“引诱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of enclosing a place with walls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某处四周修建墙壁，将其围起来的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bini ta' ħitan madwar post biex jingħalaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用墙围起某处；在四周筑墙。

formal.mt: It-tħajjit tal-għalqa għandu jitlesta qabel jibda x-xogħol tat-tħawwil.
formal.en: The enclosure of the field with walls should be completed before planting work begins.
formal.zh: 田地四周的筑墙工程应在种植工作开始前完成。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta se jibda t-tħajjit tal-ġnien? Pawlu: It-Tnejn, u nittamaw li nlestuh sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: When will the work to enclose the garden with walls begin? Pawlu: On Monday, and we hope to finish it by Friday.
colloquial.zh: Marija：花园四周什么时候开始筑墙？Pawlu：星期一，我们希望星期五前完工。

messages.speaker: Marija (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se jibda t-tħajjit tal-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se jibda t-tħajjit tal-ġnien?
messages.zh: 花园四周什么时候开始筑墙？
messages.en: When will the work to enclose the garden with walls begin?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (泥瓦匠)
messages.mt_spoken: It-Tnejn, u nittamaw li nlestuh sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: It-Tnejn, u nittamaw li nlestuh sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 星期一，我们希望星期五前完工。
messages.en: On Monday, and we hope to finish it by Friday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把花园想成一幅平面图，再沿四边画上墙；用这个动作记住 tħajjit 表示“筑墙围起”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wheat that has been ground into smaller particles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过研磨、成为较小颗粒的小麦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qamħ li jkun ġie mitħun f'partiċelli iżgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨碎的小麦；经研磨的小麦。

formal.mt: It-tħajni għandu jinħażen f'kontenitur magħluq, f'post frisk u niexef.
formal.en: Ground wheat should be stored in a sealed container in a cool, dry place.
formal.zh: 磨碎的小麦应装在密闭容器中，存放于阴凉干燥处。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek tħajni oħxon? Toni: Iva, kemm għandek bżonn? Lara: Nofs kilo, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have coarsely ground wheat? Toni: Yes, how much do you need? Lara: Half a kilo, please.
colloquial.zh: Lara：有粗磨小麦吗？Toni：有，你要多少？Lara：请给我半公斤。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek tħajni oħxon?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek tħajni oħxon?
messages.zh: 有粗磨小麦吗？
messages.en: Do you have coarsely ground wheat?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kemm għandek bżonn?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kemm għandek bżonn?
messages.zh: 有，你要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much do you need?

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nofs kilo, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nofs kilo, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我半公斤。
messages.en: Half a kilo, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象完整麦粒进入磨盘，出来变成细小颗粒；把这碗“磨碎的小麦”与 tħajni 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be scratched or grated; also, to try to gain someone's favour by flattering them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被刮擦或被擦成碎屑；也指通过奉承来讨好、巴结某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mibrux jew maħkuk f'biċċiet żgħar; ukoll, jipprova jikseb il-favur ta' xi ħadd bit-tifħir żejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刮擦；表面被刮出痕迹。
被用擦板等工具擦成碎屑。
巴结某人；以奉承等方式讨取某人的欢心。

collocations.en: he curried favour with the boss

formal.mt: Il-ġobon tħakkek fin u tqassam fuq l-għaġin qabel ma ġie servut.
formal.en: The cheese was finely grated and spread over the pasta before it was served.
formal.zh: 奶酪被擦成细屑，在意面上桌前撒在了上面。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex David faħħar lill-kap daqshekk? Luqa: Naħseb li tħakkek miegħu biex jingħata l-proġett.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did David praise the boss so much? Luqa: I think he curried favour with him to get assigned the project.
colloquial.zh: Marta：David 为什么那么夸上司？Luqa：我觉得他是在巴结上司，好让自己接到那个项目。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex David faħħar lill-kap daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex David faħħar lill-kap daqshekk?
messages.zh: David 为什么那么夸上司？
messages.en: Why did David praise the boss so much?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li tħakkek miegħu biex jingħata l-proġett.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li tħakkek miegħu biex jingħata l-proġett.
messages.zh: 我觉得他是在巴结上司，好让自己接到那个项目。
messages.en: I think he curried favour with him to get assigned the project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格画面分别记：木板被刮、奶酪被擦碎、员工奉承上司。这只是帮助区分 tħakkek 三个义项的情景联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of grating something into small pieces; also, excessive flattery intended to gain favour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西擦成碎屑的动作或过程；也指为了讨好别人而进行的阿谀奉承。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha xi ħaġa tinħakk f'biċċiet żgħar; ukoll, tifħir żejjed biex wieħed jikseb il-favur ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦碎；用擦板等工具将东西擦成碎屑的动作。
阿谀奉承；为讨取欢心而巴结他人的行为。

formal.mt: It-tħakkik tal-ġobon għandu jsir ftit qabel ma jitħejja l-platt.
formal.en: The grating of the cheese should be done shortly before the dish is prepared.
formal.zh: 应在准备这道菜前不久将奶酪擦碎。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-tifħir kollu lill-kap jidher esaġerat. Mark: Naqbel; għalija dan tħakkik, mhux tifħir sinċier.
colloquial.en: Sara: All this praise for the boss seems excessive. Mark: I agree; to me, this is sycophancy, not sincere praise.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这样一个劲儿地夸上司，有点过头了。Mark：我同意；在我看来，这是阿谀奉承，不是真心赞美。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tifħir kollu lill-kap jidher esaġerat.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tifħir kollu lill-kap jidher esaġerat.
messages.zh: 这样一个劲儿地夸上司，有点过头了。
messages.en: All this praise for the boss seems excessive.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel; għalija dan tħakkik, mhux tifħir sinċier.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel; għalija dan tħakkik, mhux tifħir sinċier.
messages.zh: 我同意；在我看来，这是阿谀奉承，不是真心赞美。
messages.en: I agree; to me, this is sycophancy, not sincere praise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tħakkik 配两张名词标签：“擦奶酪的过程”和“奉承上司的行为”；看到具体语境再选择对应含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become mixed or combined with another substance or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一种物质或事物混合，形成混在一起的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħaqad ma' sustanza jew ħaġa oħra u jsir taħlita magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被混合；与其他东西混在一起。

collocations.en: the milk was mixed with the coffee
the sugar was mixed with the flour

formal.mt: Iz-zokkor tħalat mad-dqiq qabel ma żdiedu l-bajd u l-ħalib.
formal.en: The sugar was mixed with the flour before the eggs and milk were added.
formal.zh: 在加入鸡蛋和牛奶之前，糖已与面粉混合。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ħalib diġà tħalat mal-kafè? Adam: Iva, ħawwadtu sew. Trid ftit zokkor ukoll?
colloquial.en: Nina: Has the milk already been mixed with the coffee? Adam: Yes, I stirred it well. Would you like some sugar too?
colloquial.zh: Nina：牛奶已经和咖啡混好了吗？Adam：是的，我搅匀了。你还要加点糖吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħalib diġà tħalat mal-kafè?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħalib diġà tħalat mal-kafè?
messages.zh: 牛奶已经和咖啡混好了吗？
messages.en: Has the milk already been mixed with the coffee?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħawwadtu sew. Trid ftit zokkor ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħawwadtu sew. Trid ftit zokkor ukoll?
messages.zh: 是的，我搅匀了。你还要加点糖吗？
messages.en: Yes, I stirred it well. Would you like some sugar too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象白色牛奶倒进深色咖啡，搅拌后颜色均匀；用“已经混在一起”的结果画面记住 tħalat。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be left in a place or condition, or to be abandoned; in a separate sense, to become sweet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被留在某处或保持某种状态，或被遗弃；另有变甜的独立义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' f'post jew f'ċerta kundizzjoni għax xi ħadd ħallieh hemm, jew jiġi abbandunat; f'tifsira oħra, isir ħelu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被留下；被留在某处或某种状态。
被遗弃；被抛弃而无人照顾或处理。
变甜；开始具有甜味或甜味增加。

collocations.en: the book was left on the table

formal.mt: Il-bini tħalla għal ħafna snin mingħajr manutenzjoni, u diversi kmamar ġarrbu ħsarat.
formal.en: The building was abandoned for many years without maintenance, and several rooms suffered damage.
formal.zh: 这栋建筑被弃置多年，无人维护，多个房间出现了损坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-frott kien qares ilbieraħ. Mark: Iva, imma llum tħalla. Maja: Ħa nduqu; issa għandu jkun tajjeb biex niekluh.
colloquial.en: Maja: This fruit was sour yesterday. Mark: Yes, but today it has become sweet. Maja: Let me taste it; it should be good to eat now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这水果昨天还是酸的。Mark：是啊，不过今天变甜了。Maja：让我尝尝；现在应该好吃了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-frott kien qares ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-frott kien qares ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 这水果昨天还是酸的。
messages.en: This fruit was sour yesterday.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma llum tħalla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma llum tħalla.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过今天变甜了。
messages.en: Yes, but today it has become sweet.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa nduqu; issa għandu jkun tajjeb biex niekluh.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa nduqu; issa għandu jkun tajjeb biex niekluh.
messages.zh: 让我尝尝；现在应该好吃了。
messages.en: Let me taste it; it should be good to eat now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tħalla 建三个独立抽屉：桌上留下的书、遭遗弃的建筑、变甜的水果。依靠上下文选义，不把“留下”和“变甜”强行串成因果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel a strong desire to eat something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种食物产生强烈的想吃的欲望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu xewqa qawwija li jiekol xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生强烈的渴望；尤其指馋某种食物。

formal.mt: Meta ra l-ħobż frisk fil-vetrina, it-tifel tħallaq għal biċċa.
formal.en: When he saw the fresh bread in the shop window, the boy craved a piece.
formal.zh: 男孩看见橱窗里的新鲜面包时，馋得想吃一块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaf Pawlu quddiem il-ħanut tal-ħelu? Lara: Ra l-kejk taċ-ċikkulata u tħallaq għal biċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu stop outside the sweet shop? Lara: He saw the chocolate cake and craved a piece.
colloquial.zh: Maja：保罗为什么在甜品店门口停下来了？Lara：他看见巧克力蛋糕，馋得想吃一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqaf Pawlu quddiem il-ħanut tal-ħelu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqaf Pawlu quddiem il-ħanut tal-ħelu?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么在甜品店门口停下来了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop outside the sweet shop?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ra l-kejk taċ-ċikkulata u tħallaq għal biċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Ra l-kejk taċ-ċikkulata u tħallaq għal biċċa.
messages.zh: 他看见巧克力蛋糕，馋得想吃一块。
messages.en: He saw the chocolate cake and craved a piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进看见蛋糕就嘴馋的画面中，并连着 għal 记住想吃的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive payment, to be settled as a debt or bill, or to receive punishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人收到报酬、债务或账单得到结清，也可指受到惩罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi l-ħlas; jingħalaq bil-ħlas, bħal dejn jew kont; jew jirċievi kastig.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到付款；收到工资或报酬。
被结清；指债务、账单等得到清偿。
受到惩罚；为自己的行为付出代价。

collocations.zh: 因所做的工作得到报酬

collocations.en: the bill was paid in full

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tħallas għax-xogħol kollu li għamel matul ix-xahar.
formal.en: The worker was paid for all the work he did during the month.
formal.zh: 这名工人已收到本月全部工作的报酬。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-kont tad-dawl għadu ma tħallasx? Sara: Le, tħallas ilbieraħ; hawn l-irċevuta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the electricity bill still unpaid? Sara: No, it was paid yesterday; here is the receipt.
colloquial.zh: Mark：电费账单还没付吗？Sara：已经付了，昨天付的；收据在这里。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kont tad-dawl għadu ma tħallasx?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kont tad-dawl għadu ma tħallasx?
messages.zh: 电费账单还没付吗？
messages.en: Is the electricity bill still unpaid?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tħallas ilbieraħ; hawn l-irċevuta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tħallas ilbieraħ; hawn l-irċevuta.
messages.zh: 已经付了，昨天付的；收据在这里。
messages.en: No, it was paid yesterday; here is the receipt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景记忆：工人收到钱、账单结清、犯错者付出代价；先看主语再判断词义。

gloss_zh: 被混合；与人交往；卷入；通过婚姻加入某家庭

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become mixed with something, associate with people, become involved in an affair, or join a family through marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指事物混合、人参与交往或卷入某事，也可指通过婚姻加入某个家庭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħaqad ma' xi ħaġa f'taħlita, jidħol fost in-nies, jinvolvi ruħu fi kwistjoni, jew jingħaqad ma' familja biż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被混合；与其他事物混在一起。

sense_translations.en_definition: to mix oneself with sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与其中；与某人交往或打成一片。

sense_translations.en_definition: to entangle oneself in an affair
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己卷入某件事情或纠纷。
通过结婚成为某个家庭的一员。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa ta' merħba, l-istudent il-ġdid tħallat mal-istudenti l-oħra.
formal.en: During the welcome meeting, the new student mingled with the other students.
formal.zh: 在欢迎会上，新同学与其他学生交谈，融入了大家。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar Pawlu fl-ewwel jum tiegħu fil-klabb? Maja: Tajjeb ħafna; tħallat mal-oħrajn mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Pawlu get on during his first day at the club? Maja: Very well; he mixed with the others straight away.
colloquial.zh: Lara：保罗第一天去俱乐部怎么样？Maja：很好，他一下就和其他人打成一片了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar Pawlu fl-ewwel jum tiegħu fil-klabb?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar Pawlu fl-ewwel jum tiegħu fil-klabb?
messages.zh: 保罗第一天去俱乐部怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get on during his first day at the club?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna; tħallat mal-oħrajn mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna; tħallat mal-oħrajn mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 很好，他一下就和其他人打成一片了。
messages.en: Very well; he mixed with the others straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把几种用法串成进入其中的画面：液体混入、人融入群体、卷入事情、婚后加入家庭。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become sour, especially when wine turns into vinegar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变酸，尤其指葡萄酒等变成醋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir qares, speċjalment meta l-inbid jinbidel f'ħall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变酸；味道发生酸化。
变成醋。

formal.mt: L-inbid f'dan il-flixkun tħallel u issa għandu togħma qarsa.
formal.en: The wine in this bottle has turned sour and now has a sour taste.
formal.zh: 这个瓶子里的葡萄酒已经变酸，现在带有酸味。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dan l-inbid għandu riħa ta' ħall? Sara: Għax tħallel; ejja niftħu flixkun ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why does this wine smell like vinegar? Sara: Because it has turned sour; let's open another bottle.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这葡萄酒怎么闻起来像醋？Sara：因为变酸了；我们另开一瓶吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-inbid għandu riħa ta' ħall?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-inbid għandu riħa ta' ħall?
messages.zh: 这葡萄酒怎么闻起来像醋？
messages.en: Why does this wine smell like vinegar?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tħallel; ejja niftħu flixkun ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tħallel; ejja niftħu flixkun ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为变酸了；我们另开一瓶吧。
messages.en: Because it has turned sour; let's open another bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开酒瓶却闻到醋味，用酒变酸的感官画面记住这个动词。

gloss_zh: 被引入梦境；受引导而做梦

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be caused or prompted to dream by something or someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到某人或某事的作用而做梦，强调梦境受到引发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġiegħel jew jitħajjar joħlom minħabba xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被使得做梦；受到引导或作用而进入梦境。

collocations.en: was made to dream by magic
was made to dream of a castle
collocations.zh: 被引导着梦见一座城堡

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, it-tifel tħallem b'kastell fuq sħaba permezz ta' seħer.
formal.en: In the fairy tale, the boy was made by magic to dream of a castle on a cloud.
formal.zh: 在这个童话中，男孩受到魔法作用，梦见了一座云上的城堡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lit-tifel fil-ħrafa? Lara: Tħallem bis-seħer u fil-ħolma ra kastell fuq sħaba.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the boy in the fairy tale? Lara: He was made to dream by magic, and in the dream he saw a castle on a cloud.
colloquial.zh: Maja：童话里的男孩怎么了？Lara：他被魔法引入梦境，在梦里看见了一座云上的城堡。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lit-tifel fil-ħrafa?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lit-tifel fil-ħrafa?
messages.zh: 童话里的男孩怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the boy in the fairy tale?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħallem bis-seħer u fil-ħolma ra kastell fuq sħaba.
messages.mt_standard: Tħallem bis-seħer u fil-ħolma ra kastell fuq sħaba.
messages.zh: 他被魔法引入梦境，在梦里看见了一座云上的城堡。
messages.en: He was made to dream by magic, and in the dream he saw a castle on a cloud.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用童话里的魔法引梦来记忆：关注某人被引导着做梦这一动作和经历。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of filling joints or gaps with grout, or carrying out waterproofing on a roof.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用浆料填充接缝或空隙的施工，也可指屋顶的防水处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol ta' mili tal-ġonot jew tax-xquq b'materjal likwidu, jew xogħol biex saqaf ma jħallix l-ilma jgħaddi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌浆；用浆料填充接缝或空隙的施工。
屋顶防水处理；使屋顶不渗水的施工。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jinkludi t-tħallib tas-saqaf biex l-ilma tax-xita ma jidħolx fil-bini.
formal.en: The contract includes waterproofing the roof to prevent rainwater from entering the building.
formal.zh: 合同包含屋顶防水处理，以防雨水进入建筑物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'fadal biex jitlesta x-xogħol fuq is-saqaf? Mark: It-tħallib biss; nibdew għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is left to finish the work on the roof? Mark: Just the waterproofing; we will start tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: Sara：屋顶的工程还剩什么？Mark：只剩防水处理了；我们明天早上开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: X'fadal biex jitlesta x-xogħol fuq is-saqaf?
messages.mt_standard: X'fadal biex jitlesta x-xogħol fuq is-saqaf?
messages.zh: 屋顶的工程还剩什么？
messages.en: What is left to finish the work on the roof?

messages.speaker: Mark (施工人员)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tħallib biss; nibdew għada filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: It-tħallib biss; nibdew għada filgħodu.
messages.zh: 只剩防水处理了；我们明天早上开始。
messages.en: Just the waterproofing; we will start tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工人填满接缝、处理屋顶防水的施工画面，把两个义项一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of causing or prompting someone to dream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人做梦或引发其梦境的行为、过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħadd jitħajjar jew jinġiegħel joħlom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引发梦境；使人做梦的行为或过程。

collocations.en: the inducing of dreams by magic
the inducing of dreams in the prince

formal.mt: F'din il-ħrafa, it-tħallim tal-prinċep bis-seħer huwa parti importanti mill-ġrajja.
formal.en: In this fairy tale, the magical inducing of dreams in the prince is an important part of the story.
formal.zh: 在这个童话中，用魔法使王子做梦是情节的重要组成部分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se jiġri fix-xena li jmiss? Maja: It-tħallim tal-prinċep bis-seħer; fil-ħolma tiegħu se jara l-baħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What will happen in the next scene? Maja: The prince will be made to dream by magic; in his dream he will see the sea.
colloquial.zh: Lara：下一幕会发生什么？Maja：会用魔法让王子做梦；他会在梦里看见大海。

messages.speaker: Lara (戏剧社成员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se jiġri fix-xena li jmiss?
messages.mt_standard: X'se jiġri fix-xena li jmiss?
messages.zh: 下一幕会发生什么？
messages.en: What will happen in the next scene?

messages.speaker: Maja (戏剧社成员)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tħallim tal-prinċep bis-seħer; fil-ħolma tiegħu se jara l-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: It-tħallim tal-prinċep bis-seħer; fil-ħolma tiegħu se jara l-baħar.
messages.zh: 会用魔法让王子做梦；他会在梦里看见大海。
messages.en: The prince will be made to dream by magic; in his dream he will see the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把魔法引梦这一整个过程当作一个名词来记，并与表示被引入梦境的动词区分。

gloss_zh: 食欲上的强烈渴望；馋意

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong desire to eat a particular food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种食物特别想吃的强烈欲望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija li wieħed jiekol xi ikel partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对食物的强烈渴望；馋意。

collocations.en: a craving for a piece of fresh bread
collocations.zh: 特别想吃一块新鲜面包的馋意

formal.mt: Ir-riħa tal-ħobż frisk qajmet fih tħalliq għal biċċa sħuna.
formal.en: The smell of fresh bread stirred in him a craving for a warm piece.
formal.zh: 新鲜面包的香气勾起了他的馋意，让他特别想吃一块热面包。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex xtrajt kejk illum? Sara: Kelli tħalliq għal xi ħaġa ħelwa, u għażilt biċċa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you buy cake today? Sara: I had a craving for something sweet, so I chose a small piece.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你今天为什么买蛋糕？Sara：我特别想吃点甜的，就选了一小块。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex xtrajt kejk illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex xtrajt kejk illum?
messages.zh: 你今天为什么买蛋糕？
messages.en: Why did you buy cake today?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli tħalliq għal xi ħaġa ħelwa, u għażilt biċċa żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli tħalliq għal xi ħaġa ħelwa, u għażilt biċċa żgħira.
messages.zh: 我特别想吃点甜的，就选了一小块。
messages.en: I had a craving for something sweet, so I chose a small piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把闻到面包香后冒出的那股馋意当作一个东西来记：这是名词，表示想吃的欲望。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of paying money for something or settling an amount owed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某物付钱或结清应付金额的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħallas għal xi ħaġa jew iħallas ammont dovut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 付款这一行为；支付。

collocations.en: the act of paying the bill

formal.mt: It-tħallis tal-kont għandu jsir qabel id-data indikata fuq il-fattura.
formal.en: Payment of the bill should be made before the date indicated on the invoice.
formal.zh: 应在发票注明的日期之前支付账单。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn isir it-tħallis tal-kont? Rita: Mal-kaxxier, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where do I pay the bill? Rita: At the cashier's, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: Mark：在哪里付账？Rita：在门旁边的收银处。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn isir it-tħallis tal-kont?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn isir it-tħallis tal-kont?
messages.zh: 在哪里付账？
messages.en: Where do I pay the bill?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mal-kaxxier, ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Mal-kaxxier, ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 在门旁边的收银处。
messages.en: At the cashier's, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和付账时递钱的动作绑定：重点记住“付款行为”，再用“支付账单”这一搭配复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of combining two or more substances or ingredients together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把两种或多种物质、配料混在一起的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih żewġ sustanzi jew ingredjenti jew aktar jitħalltu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混合；把不同物质搅在一起的过程。

formal.mt: It-tħallit tal-ingredjenti għandu jsir bil-mod sakemm it-taħlita tkun lixxa.
formal.en: The ingredients should be mixed slowly until the mixture is smooth.
formal.zh: 应慢慢混合配料，直到混合物变得细滑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nieħu ħsieb it-tħallit tal-ingredjenti jien? Nina: Iva, u jien inħejji l-forn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall I take care of mixing the ingredients? Nina: Yes, and I'll get the oven ready.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我来负责混合配料好吗？Nina：好，我来准备烤箱。

messages.speaker: Lara (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieħu ħsieb it-tħallit tal-ingredjenti jien?
messages.mt_standard: Nieħu ħsieb it-tħallit tal-ingredjenti jien?
messages.zh: 我来负责混合配料好吗？
messages.en: Shall I take care of mixing the ingredients?

messages.speaker: Nina (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jien inħejji l-forn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jien inħejji l-forn.
messages.zh: 好，我来准备烤箱。
messages.en: Yes, and I'll get the oven ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把几种配料倒进同一个碗，再用勺子搅匀；用这个连续动作记住“混合过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become less dense, turn into a liquid, or become soft.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 密度或稠厚程度降低而变稀、变成液体，或由较硬的状态变软。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir inqas dens jew inqas magħqud, jinbidel f'likwidu, jew isir artab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 密度降低；变得较稀或不那么稠厚。
液化；变成液体。
变软；失去原有的硬度。

collocations.en: the mixture became thinner with water
the wax turned liquid with heat

formal.mt: It-taħlit tħalħal wara li żdiedlu l-ilma, u sar aktar faċli biex jitferra'.
formal.en: The mixture became thinner after water was added to it and became easier to pour.
formal.zh: 混合物加水后变稀，更容易倾倒了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-butir għadu iebes? Ben: Le, tħalħal wara ftit ħin barra mill-friġġ. Rita: Tajjeb, issa nista' nidilku fuq il-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the butter still hard? Ben: No, it went soft after a little time out of the fridge. Rita: Good, now I can spread it on the bread.
colloquial.zh: Rita：黄油还硬吗？Ben：不硬了，从冰箱拿出来放了一会儿就变软了。Rita：好，现在可以抹在面包上了。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-butir għadu iebes?
messages.mt_standard: Il-butir għadu iebes?
messages.zh: 黄油还硬吗？
messages.en: Is the butter still hard?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tħalħal wara ftit ħin barra mill-friġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tħalħal wara ftit ħin barra mill-friġġ.
messages.zh: 不硬了，从冰箱拿出来放了一会儿就变软了。
messages.en: No, it went soft after a little time out of the fridge.

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa nista' nidilku fuq il-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa nista' nidilku fuq il-ħobż.
messages.zh: 好，现在可以抹在面包上了。
messages.en: Good, now I can spread it on the bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tħalħal 记三幅变化图：浓汤变稀、蜡块变液体、黄油变软；分别对应三个义项，不必把它们当成同一种变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making or becoming liquid or soft.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变成液体或变软，或某物发生这种变化的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir likwida jew ratba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 液化；使某物变成液体或某物变成液体的过程。
软化；使某物变软或某物逐渐变软的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tħalħil tax-xama', il-materjal jinbidel minn stat solidu għal stat likwidu.
formal.en: During the liquifying of wax, the material changes from a solid state to a liquid state.
formal.zh: 在蜡液化的过程中，材料由固态变为液态。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex għadna ma bdejniex il-kejk? Ġanni: Qed nistenna t-tħalħil tal-butir; għadu iebes wisq. Elena: Mela nħejji l-ingredjenti l-oħra sadattant.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why haven't we started the cake yet? Ġanni: I'm waiting for the butter to soften; it's still too hard. Elena: Then I'll prepare the other ingredients in the meantime.
colloquial.zh: Elena：我们怎么还没开始做蛋糕？Ġanni：我在等黄油软化；它还太硬。Elena：那我先准备其他原料。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadna ma bdejniex il-kejk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadna ma bdejniex il-kejk?
messages.zh: 我们怎么还没开始做蛋糕？
messages.en: Why haven't we started the cake yet?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistenna t-tħalħil tal-butir; għadu iebes wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistenna t-tħalħil tal-butir; għadu iebes wisq.
messages.zh: 我在等黄油软化；它还太硬。
messages.en: I'm waiting for the butter to soften; it's still too hard.

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nħejji l-ingredjenti l-oħra sadattant.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nħejji l-ingredjenti l-oħra sadattant.
messages.zh: 那我先准备其他原料。
messages.en: Then I'll prepare the other ingredients in the meantime.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħalħil 写在两段过程录像上：一段蜡逐渐成为液体，一段黄油逐渐变软；重点记它是表示过程的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To argue vehemently or to speak loudly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 激烈地争辩，或大声说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jargumenta b'qawwa kbira jew jitkellem b'leħen għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激烈争辩；情绪强烈地争论。
大声说话；高声讲话。

collocations.en: to talk loudly in the street

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-rappreżentant tħambaq dwar il-proposta u baqa' jinsisti li kellha tinbidel.
formal.en: During the meeting, the representative argued vehemently about the proposal and kept insisting that it had to be changed.
formal.zh: 会议期间，这位代表就提案激烈争辩，并一直坚持必须修改提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titħambaq? Nista' nisimgħek sew. Mark: Skużani, se nbaxxi leħni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you talking so loudly? I can hear you perfectly well. Mark: Sorry, I'll lower my voice.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么说话这么大声？我听得很清楚。Mark：抱歉，我会小声一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed titħambaq? Nista' nisimgħek sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed titħambaq? Nista' nisimgħek sew.
messages.zh: 你为什么说话这么大声？我听得很清楚。
messages.en: Why are you talking so loudly? I can hear you perfectly well.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, se nbaxxi leħni.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, se nbaxxi leħni.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我会小声一点。
messages.en: Sorry, I'll lower my voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分开记义项：会议桌前激烈争辩，街边聊天声音很大；两种情景都练习一次。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heated argument in which people express disagreement strongly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与者强烈表达分歧的一场激烈争论或争吵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Argument jaħraq li fih in-nies jesprimu n-nuqqas ta' qbil tagħhom b'qawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一场激烈争论；激烈争吵。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa ntemmet wara tħambiq bejn iż-żewġ rappreżentanti dwar it-tqassim tal-fondi.
formal.en: The meeting ended after a heated argument between the two representatives about the allocation of funds.
formal.zh: 两位代表就资金分配发生激烈争论后，会议结束了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'kien dak it-tħambiq bejn il-ġirien? Toni: Kienu qed jargumentaw dwar fejn jipparkjaw il-karozzi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was that heated argument between the neighbours about? Toni: They were arguing about where to park their cars.
colloquial.zh: Sara：邻居们刚才吵得那么激烈，是为了什么？Toni：他们在争论汽车该停在哪里。

messages.speaker: Sara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak it-tħambiq bejn il-ġirien?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak it-tħambiq bejn il-ġirien?
messages.zh: 邻居们刚才吵得那么激烈，是为了什么？
messages.en: What was that heated argument between the neighbours about?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienu qed jargumentaw dwar fejn jipparkjaw il-karozzi.
messages.mt_standard: Kienu qed jargumentaw dwar fejn jipparkjaw il-karozzi.
messages.zh: 他们在争论汽车该停在哪里。
messages.en: They were arguing about where to park their cars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 和动词 tħambaq 配对记忆：一个表示“激烈争辩”这个动作，这个名词表示“一场激烈争论”。

gloss_zh: 彼此容忍；相互忍受得了

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be able to put up with one another despite differences or irritation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 即使存在分歧或让彼此不快的地方，仍能相互容忍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikunu kapaċi jissaportu lil xulxin minkejja d-differenzi jew id-dwejjaq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be able to bear (in a mutual sense: to bear each other)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够相互忍受；彼此容忍得了。

collocations.en: to be able to tolerate each other
to put up with one another despite their differences
collocations.zh: 尽管存在分歧仍能相互忍受

formal.mt: Għalkemm kellhom fehmiet differenti, iż-żewġ kollegi setgħu jitħamlu u jaħdmu flimkien.
formal.en: Although they held different views, the two colleagues could tolerate each other and work together.
formal.zh: 尽管观点不同，两位同事仍能彼此容忍并一起工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int u ħuk titħamlu meta tkunu fl-istess kamra? Ben: Iva, sakemm hu ma jgħollix il-mużika u jien ma nmisslux l-affarijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you and your brother put up with each other when you're in the same room? Ben: Yes, as long as he doesn't turn the music up and I don't touch his things.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你和你哥哥待在同一个房间时，能互相忍受吗？Ben：能，只要他不把音乐开大，我也不碰他的东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int u ħuk titħamlu meta tkunu fl-istess kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Int u ħuk titħamlu meta tkunu fl-istess kamra?
messages.zh: 你和你哥哥待在同一个房间时，能互相忍受吗？
messages.en: Can you and your brother put up with each other when you're in the same room?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sakemm hu ma jgħollix il-mużika u jien ma nmisslux l-affarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sakemm hu ma jgħollix il-mużika u jien ma nmisslux l-affarijiet.
messages.zh: 能，只要他不把音乐开大，我也不碰他的东西。
messages.en: Yes, as long as he doesn't turn the music up and I don't touch his things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个性格不同的室友各让一步，并画出双向箭头；这个词要把“彼此”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Defense in which people or groups protect one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或群体彼此保护、相互防卫的行为或安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Difiża li fiha persuni jew gruppi jipproteġu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相互防卫；彼此保护的共同防御。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim ta' tħamija jipprevedi li kull grupp jgħin lill-ieħor jekk ikun hemm attakk.
formal.en: The mutual defense agreement provides for each group to help the other in the event of an attack.
formal.zh: 共同防御协议规定，一方遭到攻击时，另一方应提供帮助。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser tħamija f'din l-istorja? Lara: Iż-żewġ gruppi jipproteġu lil xulxin; jekk wieħed jiġi attakkat, l-ieħor jgħinu.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does mutual defense mean in this story? Lara: The two groups protect each other; if one is attacked, the other helps it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个故事里的相互防卫是什么意思？Lara：就是两个群体彼此保护；一方受到攻击，另一方就帮助它。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser tħamija f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser tħamija f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的相互防卫是什么意思？
messages.en: What does mutual defense mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żewġ gruppi jipproteġu lil xulxin; jekk wieħed jiġi attakkat, l-ieħor jgħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żewġ gruppi jipproteġu lil xulxin; jekk wieħed jiġi attakkat, l-ieħor jgħinu.
messages.zh: 就是两个群体彼此保护；一方受到攻击，另一方就帮助它。
messages.en: The two groups protect each other; if one is attacked, the other helps it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两面盾牌，中间用双向箭头连接：你保护我，我也保护你；用这幅图记牢“相互防卫”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mutual patience and tolerance toward one another's faults or difficulties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彼此以耐心和宽容对待对方的不足或困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Paċenzja u tolleranza bejn persuni li jaċċettaw in-nuqqasijiet jew id-diffikultajiet ta' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相互包容；彼此忍让

formal.mt: It-tħamil bejn il-membri tal-komunità jgħin biex in-nuqqas ta' qbil ma jinbidilx f'kunflitt.
formal.en: Mutual forbearance among community members helps prevent disagreement from turning into conflict.
formal.zh: 社区成员之间的相互包容有助于防止分歧演变成冲突。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kultant ma naqblux dwar l-istorbju. Mark: Iva, imma bi ftit tħamil nistgħu nsibu soluzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Sometimes we disagree about the noise. Mark: Yes, but with a little mutual forbearance we can find a solution.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有时会在噪声问题上有分歧。马克：是啊，不过彼此多包容一点，我们就能找到解决办法。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kultant ma naqblux dwar l-istorbju.
messages.mt_standard: Kultant ma naqblux dwar l-istorbju.
messages.zh: 我们有时会在噪声问题上有分歧。
messages.en: Sometimes we disagree about the noise.

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma bi ftit tħamil nistgħu nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma bi ftit tħamil nistgħu nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过彼此多包容一点，我们就能找到解决办法。
messages.en: Yes, but with a little mutual forbearance we can find a solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两位邻居各退一步，把这个词与“彼此包容”一起记，重点是双方互相忍让。

gloss_zh: 被清理干净；内部被清空清洁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cleaned out by having accumulated dirt or unwanted material removed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内部积存的污物或杂物被清除，从而得到清理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitnaddaf minn ġewwa billi jitneħħa l-ħmieġ jew il-materjal mhux mixtieq li jkun inġabar fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被清理干净；内部污物或杂物被清除

formal.mt: Il-ġibjun tħammel u ġie spezzjonat qabel reġa' ntuża għall-ħażna tal-ilma.
formal.en: The reservoir was cleaned out and inspected before being used again to store water.
formal.zh: 蓄水池经过内部清理和检查后，才重新用于储水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-bir tħammel diġà? Mark: Iva, neħħew il-ħmieġ kollu minn ġewwa dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the well been cleaned out already? Mark: Yes, they removed all the dirt from inside this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水井已经清理干净了吗？马克：是的，他们今天早上把里面的污物全清除了。

messages.speaker: Maja (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bir tħammel diġà?
messages.mt_standard: Il-bir tħammel diġà?
messages.zh: 水井已经清理干净了吗？
messages.en: Has the well been cleaned out already?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, neħħew il-ħmieġ kollu minn ġewwa dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, neħħew il-ħmieġ kollu minn ġewwa dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 是的，他们今天早上把里面的污物全清除了。
messages.en: Yes, they removed all the dirt from inside this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象井底积泥被一桶桶清出，抓住“内部被清理”的结果来记这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become five times the original number or amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量或数额变为原来的五倍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ħames darbiet in-numru jew l-ammont oriġinali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被乘以五；变为原来的五倍

formal.mt: In-numru ta' parteċipanti tħammes minn għaxra għal ħamsin matul is-sena.
formal.en: The number of participants increased fivefold, from ten to fifty, over the year.
formal.zh: 这一年里，参与人数从十人增至五十人，变为原来的五倍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandna ordnijiet illum? Mark: Ħamsin! Ilbieraħ kellna għaxra, allura l-għadd tħammes.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many orders do we have today? Mark: Fifty! Yesterday we had ten, so the number has increased fivefold.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今天有多少份订单？马克：五十份！昨天只有十份，所以数量变为原来的五倍了。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandna ordnijiet illum?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandna ordnijiet illum?
messages.zh: 我们今天有多少份订单？
messages.en: How many orders do we have today?

messages.speaker: Mark (店长)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħamsin! Ilbieraħ kellna għaxra, allura l-għadd tħammes.
messages.mt_standard: Ħamsin! Ilbieraħ kellna għaxra, allura l-għadd tħammes.
messages.zh: 五十份！昨天只有十份，所以数量变为原来的五倍了。
messages.en: Fifty! Yesterday we had ten, so the number has increased fivefold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用十变五十的算式记忆：结果等于原数乘五，也就是“变为原来的五倍”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dirty, or figuratively to have one's reputation damaged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得不干净；也可比喻名誉受到玷污。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir maħmuġ, jew, f'sens figurattiv, ikollu r-reputazzjoni tiegħu mtebbgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变脏；沾上污物
名誉受到玷污；声誉被抹黑

formal.mt: Ismu tħammeġ minħabba akkużi foloz, għalkemm ma kien hemm ebda prova kontrih.
formal.en: His name was besmirched by false accusations, although there was no evidence against him.
formal.zh: 他的名声因虚假指控而受到玷污，尽管没有任何对他不利的证据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qmis tiegħek tħammeġ bit-tajn! Mark: Iva, waqajt waqt li kont nilgħab fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your shirt got muddy! Mark: Yes, I fell while I was playing in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的衬衫沾上泥，变脏了！马克：是啊，我在花园玩的时候摔了一跤。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qmis tiegħek tħammeġ bit-tajn!
messages.mt_standard: Il-qmis tiegħek tħammeġ bit-tajn!
messages.zh: 你的衬衫沾上泥，变脏了！
messages.en: Your shirt got muddy!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waqajt waqt li kont nilgħab fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waqajt waqt li kont nilgħab fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 是啊，我在花园玩的时候摔了一跤。
messages.en: Yes, I fell while I was playing in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想衣服沾泥而变脏，再想名声被污点遮住，用同一幅“染污”画面连接两个义项。

gloss_zh: 内部清理；清除积存污物

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of cleaning out a space or container by removing accumulated dirt or unwanted material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清除某个空间或容器内部积存的污物、杂物的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tindif ta' spazju jew reċipjent minn ġewwa billi jitneħħa l-ħmieġ jew il-materjal mhux mixtieq li jkun inġabar fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内部清理；清除积存的污物或杂物

formal.mt: It-tħammil tal-bir kien jinkludi t-tneħħija tat-tajn u tal-ġebel li nġabru fil-qiegħ.
formal.en: Cleaning out the well included removing the mud and stones that had accumulated at the bottom.
formal.zh: 水井的内部清理包括清除井底积存的泥和石块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se jibda t-tħammil tal-ġibjun? Mark: Għada filgħodu; l-ewwel irridu nbattluh.
colloquial.en: Maja: When will cleaning out the reservoir begin? Mark: Tomorrow morning; first we need to empty it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：蓄水池的内部清理什么时候开始？马克：明天早上；我们得先把它排空。

messages.speaker: Maja (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se jibda t-tħammil tal-ġibjun?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se jibda t-tħammil tal-ġibjun?
messages.zh: 蓄水池的内部清理什么时候开始？
messages.en: When will cleaning out the reservoir begin?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu; l-ewwel irridu nbattluh.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu; l-ewwel irridu nbattluh.
messages.zh: 明天早上；我们得先把它排空。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning; first we need to empty it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清理人员正在掏出池底积泥，把它记成一项“内部清理工作”，注意它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Repeated or prolonged thought about something, sometimes accompanied by worry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事反复或长时间思量，也可指由此产生的忧虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb fit-tul jew ripetut dwar xi ħaġa, xi drabi flimkien ma' tħassib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复思量；长时间琢磨
忧虑；担心

formal.mt: Wara ħafna tħammim dwar il-proposta, il-kumitat iddeċieda li jitlob aktar tagħrif.
formal.en: After much reflection on the proposal, the committee decided to request more information.
formal.zh: 委员会对提案反复思量后，决定要求提供更多资料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaddejt lejl ta' tħammim dwar l-eżami. Mark: Ejja nirrevedu flimkien; forsi tħossok aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: I spent the night worrying about the exam. Mark: Let's revise together; perhaps you'll feel better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我为考试担心得一整夜都不安。马克：我们一起复习吧；也许你会感觉好一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddejt lejl ta' tħammim dwar l-eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddejt lejl ta' tħammim dwar l-eżami.
messages.zh: 我为考试担心得一整夜都不安。
messages.en: I spent the night worrying about the exam.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nirrevedu flimkien; forsi tħossok aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nirrevedu flimkien; forsi tħossok aħjar.
messages.zh: 我们一起复习吧；也许你会感觉好一点。
messages.en: Let's revise together; perhaps you'll feel better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个念头在脑中不断回放：平静时是反复思量，伴随不安时就是忧虑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming red or redder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色变红或红色加深的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir ħamra jew aktar ħamra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变红；发红；红色加深

formal.mt: L-awtur iddeskriva t-tħammir ta' wiċċ il-karattru meta sema' t-tifħir.
formal.en: The author described the reddening of the character's face upon hearing the praise.
formal.zh: 作者描写了人物听到赞扬时脸部发红的情景。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Innutajt it-tħammir ta' wiċċi meta kellimt lill-klassi? Mark: Ftit biss. Tkellimt tajjeb ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you notice my face going red when I spoke to the class? Mark: Only a little. You spoke very well!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我对全班讲话时，你注意到我脸红了吗？马克：只红了一点点。你讲得很好！

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt it-tħammir ta' wiċċi meta kellimt lill-klassi?
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt it-tħammir ta' wiċċi meta kellimt lill-klassi?
messages.zh: 我对全班讲话时，你注意到我脸红了吗？
messages.en: Did you notice my face going red when I spoke to the class?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit biss. Tkellimt tajjeb ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Ftit biss. Tkellimt tajjeb ħafna!
messages.zh: 只红了一点点。你讲得很好！
messages.en: Only a little. You spoke very well!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脸颊从原来的肤色渐渐变红，把这个名词与“颜色正在变红的过程”连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming dirty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品或身体沾上污物、变得不干净的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd isir maħmuġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变脏；沾上污物的过程

formal.mt: L-użu ta' ingwanti waqt ix-xogħol fil-ġnien inaqqas it-tħammiġ tal-idejn.
formal.en: Wearing gloves while gardening reduces how dirty the hands get.
formal.zh: 做园艺工作时戴手套，可以减少双手沾污。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se nilbes il-fardal qabel nibda npinġi. Mark: Idea tajba, hekk tevita t-tħammiġ tal-ħwejjeġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'll put on an apron before I start painting. Mark: Good idea; that way you avoid getting your clothes dirty.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：开始画画前，我要先穿上围裙。马克：好主意，这样就能避免把衣服弄脏。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nilbes il-fardal qabel nibda npinġi.
messages.mt_standard: Se nilbes il-fardal qabel nibda npinġi.
messages.zh: 开始画画前，我要先穿上围裙。
messages.en: I'll put on an apron before I start painting.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Idea tajba, hekk tevita t-tħammiġ tal-ħwejjeġ.
messages.mt_standard: Idea tajba, hekk tevita t-tħammiġ tal-ħwejjeġ.
messages.zh: 好主意，这样就能避免把衣服弄脏。
messages.en: Good idea; that way you avoid getting your clothes dirty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手从干净到沾满颜料的过程想成一段短片，这个名词表示“变脏这件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become flustered and lose one's composure in a stressful or unexpected situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在紧张或意外的情况下变得慌乱，失去镇定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħawwad u jitlef il-kalma f'sitwazzjoni ta' tensjoni jew quddiem xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得慌乱；因紧张或突发情况而乱了方寸。

collocations.en: to get flustered during an interview
to get flustered by an unexpected question
collocations.zh: 面对意外的问题而慌乱

formal.mt: Il-kandidat tħamħam meta ntalab jispjega żball fid-dokument, iżda reġa' kiseb il-kalma wara ftit.
formal.en: The candidate became flustered when asked to explain an error in the document, but regained his composure shortly afterwards.
formal.zh: 候选人被要求解释文件中的一个错误时慌了神，但不久后便恢复了镇定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tħamħamt meta staqsewni dik il-mistoqsija. Rita: Ħu nifs u aħseb ftit qabel twieġeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: I got flustered when they asked me that question. Rita: Take a breath and think for a moment before you answer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他们问我那个问题时，我一下子慌了。Rita：先吸口气，想一想再回答。

messages.speaker: Maja (参加面试的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħamħamt meta staqsewni dik il-mistoqsija.
messages.mt_standard: Tħamħamt meta staqsewni dik il-mistoqsija.
messages.zh: 他们问我那个问题时，我一下子慌了。
messages.en: I got flustered when they asked me that question.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu nifs u aħseb ftit qabel twieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu nifs u aħseb ftit qabel twieġeb.
messages.zh: 先吸口气，想一想再回答。
messages.en: Take a breath and think for a moment before you answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词形中重复出现的 ħam 当作课堂节奏提示，联想突然被点名时心里一乱；这只是助记联想。

gloss_zh: 变得无礼或脾气暴躁的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming churlish or bad-tempered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 态度变得粗鲁无礼或脾气变坏的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih persuna ssir goffa fl-imġiba jew ta' burdata ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得粗鲁无礼或脾气暴躁这一过程。

collocations.en: becoming bad-tempered after a long day
collocations.zh: 忙碌一天后变得脾气暴躁
因疲倦而变得脾气不好

formal.mt: Fil-każ deskritt, it-tħamħim tal-parteċipant beda wara sigħat twal mingħajr mistrieħ, u t-tweġibiet tiegħu saru dejjem aktar goffi.
formal.en: In the case described, the participant began becoming bad-tempered after long hours without rest, and his replies grew increasingly rude.
formal.zh: 在所描述的案例中，参与者连续多时未休息后开始变得烦躁，回答也越来越无礼。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed ninnota t-tħamħim tiegħi wara x-xogħol; malajr nibda nwieġeb ħażin. Sara: Ipprova strieħ ftit qabel tibda titkellem fuq il-problemi tal-ġurnata.
colloquial.en: Nina: I'm noticing that I become bad-tempered after work; I quickly start answering rudely. Sara: Try resting a little before you start talking about the day's problems.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我发现自己下班后容易变得烦躁，很快就开始没好气地回答。Sara：试着先休息一会儿，再谈白天遇到的问题。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed ninnota t-tħamħim tiegħi wara x-xogħol; malajr nibda nwieġeb ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Qed ninnota t-tħamħim tiegħi wara x-xogħol; malajr nibda nwieġeb ħażin.
messages.zh: 我发现自己下班后容易变得烦躁，很快就开始没好气地回答。
messages.en: I'm noticing that I become bad-tempered after work; I quickly start answering rudely.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova strieħ ftit qabel tibda titkellem fuq il-problemi tal-ġurnata.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova strieħ ftit qabel tibda titkellem fuq il-problemi tal-ġurnata.
messages.zh: 试着先休息一会儿，再谈白天遇到的问题。
messages.en: Try resting a little before you start talking about the day's problems.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按名词记成一段变化过程：原本语气平和，疲倦后逐渐没好气；把“变得暴躁”画成连续三格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take up a protected position in a trench, or to dig oneself into such a position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入壕沟等防御位置据守，或挖掘壕沟使自己获得掩护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu pożizzjoni protetta f'ħandaq, jew iħaffer ħandaq biex jistkenn u jiddefendi ruħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于壕沟或其他有掩护的防御位置中；据守。
为自己挖掘壕沟或掩体，以便隐蔽和固守。

collocations.en: dug himself in behind the hill
dug himself in to defend the position

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, is-suldat tħandaq wara l-għolja biex jiddefendi l-pożizzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: According to the report, the soldier dug himself in behind the hill to defend his position.
formal.zh: 根据报告，这名士兵在山丘后方掘壕，以守住自己的阵地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex is-suldat waqaf wara l-għolja? Pawlu: Tħandaq hemm biex ikollu kenn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the soldier stop behind the hill? Pawlu: He dug himself in there to get some cover.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个士兵为什么停在山丘后面？保罗：他在那里挖了掩体，好让自己有地方隐蔽。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex is-suldat waqaf wara l-għolja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex is-suldat waqaf wara l-għolja?
messages.zh: 那个士兵为什么停在山丘后面？
messages.en: Why did the soldier stop behind the hill?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħandaq hemm biex ikollu kenn.
messages.mt_standard: Tħandaq hemm biex ikollu kenn.
messages.zh: 他在那里挖了掩体，好让自己有地方隐蔽。
messages.en: He dug himself in there to get some cover.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在士兵挖好壕沟后伏低身体：既能记住“掘壕进入”的动作，也能记住“在壕中据守”的状态。

gloss_zh: 掘壕设防；掘壕固守的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of digging into a protected defensive position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挖掘壕沟、进入掩体并建立防御位置的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess ta' tħaffir ta' ħandaq biex wieħed jieħu pożizzjoni protetta għad-difiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掘壕设防；通过壕沟等设施建立防御阵地。
为自己挖掘壕沟或掩体并进入其中固守的行为。

collocations.zh: 在坚硬土层中掘壕设防

formal.mt: It-tħandiq tat-truppi mexa bil-mod minħabba l-ħamrija iebsa.
formal.en: The troops' digging in proceeded slowly because of the hard ground.
formal.zh: 由于土层坚硬，部队的掘壕设防工作进展缓慢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed idumu daqshekk biex iħejju d-difiża? Pawlu: It-tħandiq jieħu ż-żmien meta l-art tkun iebsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are they taking so long to prepare the defences? Pawlu: Digging in takes time when the ground is hard.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们准备防御工事怎么花了这么久？保罗：地面坚硬时，掘壕设防是需要时间的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed idumu daqshekk biex iħejju d-difiża?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed idumu daqshekk biex iħejju d-difiża?
messages.zh: 他们准备防御工事怎么花了这么久？
messages.en: Why are they taking so long to prepare the defences?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tħandiq jieħu ż-żmien meta l-art tkun iebsa.
messages.mt_standard: It-tħandiq jieħu ż-żmien meta l-art tkun iebsa.
messages.zh: 地面坚硬时，掘壕设防是需要时间的。
messages.en: Digging in takes time when the ground is hard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当成一项写在任务清单上的工程：“掘壕设防”。这里命名的是整项行为或过程，而非某个人正在做的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become annoyed or irritated by something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事感到不快、恼火或烦躁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddejjaq jew jirrita ruħu minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到恼火或烦躁；受到某事刺激而心情不快。

collocations.en: became irritated when he had to wait
collocations.zh: 因为不得不等待而恼火

formal.mt: Il-klijent tħanfes meta sar jaf li kellu jistenna siegħa oħra.
formal.en: The customer became irritated when he learned that he had to wait another hour.
formal.zh: 这位顾客得知自己还得再等一个小时时，感到十分恼火。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jitkellem? Rita: Tħanfes minħabba l-istorbju; ejja nitkellmu aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Pawlu want to talk? Rita: He got irritated by the noise; let's speak more quietly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么不想说话？丽塔：他被噪声弄烦了；我们小声一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jitkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jitkellem?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不想说话？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pawlu want to talk?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħanfes minħabba l-istorbju; ejja nitkellmu aktar bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Tħanfes minħabba l-istorbju; ejja nitkellmu aktar bil-mod.
messages.zh: 他被噪声弄烦了；我们小声一点吧。
messages.en: He got irritated by the noise; let's speak more quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象身边噪声不断，你皱起眉头、心里冒出一句“真烦”：用这个瞬间记住“感到恼火、烦躁起来”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sulky or grumpy mood, shown through displeasure, silence, or an irritable manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 闹别扭或脾气烦躁的情绪状态，可表现为不高兴、沉默或态度不耐烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Burdata ta' dwejjaq jew irritazzjoni li tidher fis-skiet, fil-geddum jew f'imġiba bla sabar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闹别扭、生闷气的情绪或表现，常以沉默和不愿理人来表达不满。
脾气烦躁、容易不高兴或态度不耐烦的状态。

formal.mt: It-tħanfis wara t-tilwima għamel il-komunikazzjoni bejn il-kollegi aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: The sulkiness after the argument made communication between the colleagues more difficult.
formal.zh: 争吵后闹别扭的情绪使同事之间的沟通更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara? Għaliex dan it-tħanfis kollu? Pawlu: Għadni mdejjaq bit-tilwima tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened? Why all this sulking? Pawlu: I'm still upset about yesterday's argument.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么了？怎么一直闹别扭？保罗：我还在为昨天吵架的事难过。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara? Għaliex dan it-tħanfis kollu?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara? Għaliex dan it-tħanfis kollu?
messages.zh: 怎么了？怎么一直闹别扭？
messages.en: What happened? Why all this sulking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni mdejjaq bit-tilwima tal-bieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni mdejjaq bit-tilwima tal-bieraħ.
messages.zh: 我还在为昨天吵架的事难过。
messages.en: I'm still upset about yesterday's argument.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给“抱着胳膊、噘着嘴、不想理人”的画面贴上名词标签：闹别扭或烦躁的情绪。注意这里说的是情绪本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel a strong desire to eat a particular food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种食物产生强烈的食欲，特别想吃到它。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu xewqa qawwija li jiekol xi ikel partikolari.

sense_translations.en_definition: have a strong wish to eat s.th
sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常想吃某种东西；对某种食物嘴馋。

formal.mt: Meta ra l-kejk fil-vetrina, it-tifel tħannaq għal biċċa minnu.
formal.en: When he saw the cake in the shop window, the boy strongly wanted a slice.
formal.zh: 男孩看到橱窗里的蛋糕时，特别想吃上一块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu mar sal-ħanut tal-ħelu? Rita: Tħannaq għal ftit ċikkulata wara l-ikla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu go to the sweet shop? Rita: He was craving some chocolate after the meal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么去糖果店了？丽塔：他吃完饭后特别想吃点巧克力。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu mar sal-ħanut tal-ħelu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu mar sal-ħanut tal-ħelu?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么去糖果店了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go to the sweet shop?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħannaq għal ftit ċikkulata wara l-ikla.
messages.mt_standard: Tħannaq għal ftit ċikkulata wara l-ikla.
messages.zh: 他吃完饭后特别想吃点巧克力。
messages.en: He was craving some chocolate after the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象已经吃饱，却一看到巧克力就特别想来一口：用“馋某样东西”的具体感觉记住这个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try to gain someone's favour through flattering or ingratiating behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过奉承或刻意讨好的举动，设法获得某人的好感或照顾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprova jikseb il-favur ta' xi ħadd billi jfaħħru jew jogħġbu apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴结、奉承或刻意讨好某人，以争取对方的好感或优待。

formal.mt: L-impjegat tħannek mal-kap bit-tama li jingħata trattament preferenzjali.
formal.en: The employee curried favour with the boss in the hope of receiving preferential treatment.
formal.zh: 这名员工巴结上司，希望获得优待。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu faħħar lill-kap daqshekk? Rita: Tħannek miegħu għax irid jum liberu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu praise the boss so much? Rita: He was currying favour with him because he wants a day off.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么那么使劲地夸上司？丽塔：他想请一天假，所以在讨好他。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu faħħar lill-kap daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu faħħar lill-kap daqshekk?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么那么使劲地夸上司？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu praise the boss so much?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħannek miegħu għax irid jum liberu.
messages.mt_standard: Tħannek miegħu għax irid jum liberu.
messages.zh: 他想请一天假，所以在讨好他。
messages.en: He was currying favour with him because he wants a day off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想“想请假，先拼命夸上司”的小场景：把带着目的争取好感的行为记作“巴结、讨好某人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show mercy or compassion; in a separate sense, to be soothed into sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人表现出怜悯或慈悲；另一个义项指受到安抚而入睡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri ħniena ma' xi ħadd; f'sens ieħor, jiġi mraqqad bil-ħlewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发慈悲；对他人的困难或过失表现出怜悯和宽容。
在轻柔的声音或安抚下被哄入睡。

collocations.en: was lulled to sleep by his mother's singing
collocations.zh: 在母亲的歌声中被哄入睡

formal.mt: Is-sid tħannen għall-familja fil-bżonn u taha aktar żmien biex tħallas il-kera.
formal.en: The landlord showed compassion for the family in need and gave them more time to pay the rent.
formal.zh: 房东怜悯这个生活困难的家庭，给了他们更多时间支付房租。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tifel għadu mqajjem? Rita: Le, tħannen bil-kant ta' ommu u issa rieqed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the boy still awake? Rita: No, he was lulled to sleep by his mother's singing and is asleep now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：孩子还醒着吗？丽塔：没有，他听着妈妈唱歌被哄睡了，现在正睡着。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel għadu mqajjem?
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel għadu mqajjem?
messages.zh: 孩子还醒着吗？
messages.en: Is the boy still awake?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tħannen bil-kant ta' ommu u issa rieqed.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tħannen bil-kant ta' ommu u issa rieqed.
messages.zh: 没有，他听着妈妈唱歌被哄睡了，现在正睡着。
messages.en: No, he was lulled to sleep by his mother's singing and is asleep now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立的卡片记两个义项：一张画房东宽限租金，提示“发慈悲”；另一张画母亲唱歌哄孩子睡觉，提示“被哄入睡”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive especially affectionate care, comfort, and attention, sometimes more than necessary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到格外温柔、周到的照顾和宠爱，有时带有被过分娇惯的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi ħafna għożża, faraġ u kura, xi drabi aktar milli jkun hemm bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被悉心呵护、宠爱或娇养，有时含受到过度照顾之意。

collocations.zh: 生病期间受到格外呵护

formal.mt: Waqt il-marda, it-tifel tħannes mill-familja kollha u ngħata kull kumdità.
formal.en: During his illness, the boy was cosseted by the whole family and given every comfort.
formal.zh: 男孩生病期间受到全家人的格外呵护，大家尽力让他过得舒适。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għadda t-tmiem il-ġimgħa Pawlu għand in-nanna? Rita: Tħannes sew; sajritlu l-ikel favorit tiegħu u ħallietu jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was Pawlu's weekend at his grandmother's? Rita: He was thoroughly pampered; she cooked his favourite food and let him rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗在奶奶家过周末过得怎么样？丽塔：可受宠了；奶奶给他做了最爱吃的东西，还让他好好休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għadda t-tmiem il-ġimgħa Pawlu għand in-nanna?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għadda t-tmiem il-ġimgħa Pawlu għand in-nanna?
messages.zh: 保罗在奶奶家过周末过得怎么样？
messages.en: How was Pawlu's weekend at his grandmother's?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħannes sew; sajritlu l-ikel favorit tiegħu u ħallietu jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Tħannes sew; sajritlu l-ikel favorit tiegħu u ħallietu jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 可受宠了；奶奶给他做了最爱吃的东西，还让他好好休息。
messages.en: He was thoroughly pampered; she cooked his favourite food and let him rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象到奶奶家后，爱吃的饭菜和舒适的休息都安排好了：自己是接受宠爱和照顾的人，用这个画面记“被娇宠、被呵护”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with worms, or to grow long.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得有虫、开始生虫；也可指长度增加、变长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bid-dud, jew jikber fit-tul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生虫，变得有虫。
长长，长度增加。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li parti mill-frott tħannex u ma kienx tajjeb għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: During the inspection, some of the fruit was found to have become wormy and was unsuitable for sale.
formal.zh: 检查发现，部分水果已经生虫，不宜出售。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-frott tħannex? Pawlu: Iva, ara d-dud ġewwa. Aħjar ma nikluhx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has this fruit become wormy? Pawlu: Yes, look at the worms inside. We'd better not eat it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这水果生虫了吗？保罗：是啊，看里面的虫子。我们还是别吃了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-frott tħannex?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-frott tħannex?
messages.zh: 这水果生虫了吗？
messages.en: Has this fruit become wormy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara d-dud ġewwa. Aħjar ma nikluhx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara d-dud ġewwa. Aħjar ma nikluhx.
messages.zh: 是啊，看里面的虫子。我们还是别吃了。
messages.en: Yes, look at the worms inside. We'd better not eat it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项分别放进画面：水果里面生了虫，头发则越长越长；用主语区分含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Flattering or excessively pleasing someone in order to gain their favour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了获得某人的好感或照顾而奉承、巴结对方的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba ta' tifħir żejjed jew ta' serviliżmu biex wieħed jikseb il-favur ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人阿谀奉承、刻意巴结的行为。

formal.mt: Id-deċiżjonijiet dwar il-promozzjonijiet għandhom ikunu bbażati fuq ix-xogħol, mhux fuq it-tħannik mal-kap.
formal.en: Promotion decisions should be based on work, not on toadying up to the boss.
formal.zh: 晋升决定应依据工作表现，而非巴结上司的行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dejjem ifaħħar lill-kap, anki meta jiżbalja? Mark: Dak tħannik; irid xi favur mingħandu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does he always praise the boss, even when the boss makes a mistake? Mark: That's toadying; he wants a favour from him.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：他为什么总夸上司，连上司犯错时也夸？马克：那是在巴结，他想让上司给点照顾。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem ifaħħar lill-kap, anki meta jiżbalja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem ifaħħar lill-kap, anki meta jiżbalja?
messages.zh: 他为什么总夸上司，连上司犯错时也夸？
messages.en: Why does he always praise the boss, even when the boss makes a mistake?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tħannik; irid xi favur mingħandu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak tħannik; irid xi favur mingħandu.
messages.zh: 那是在巴结，他想让上司给点照顾。
messages.en: That's toadying; he wants a favour from him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人为求上司照顾而句句奉承，把这个词记成带着目的的巴结行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Acts that show mercy and compassion towards someone in need or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向有需要或身处困境的人表现怜悯与仁慈的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għemejjel li juru ħniena u mogħdrija ma' min jinsab fil-bżonn jew f'diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体现仁慈、怜悯与体恤的善行。

collocations.en: acts of mercy towards the poor
acts of mercy towards those who suffer
collocations.zh: 对受苦之人的怜悯善行

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tħannin tal-voluntiera ma' familji li tilfu djarhom.
formal.en: The report describes the volunteers' acts of mercy towards families who lost their homes.
formal.zh: 报告记述了志愿者向失去家园的家庭施以援助的仁慈之举。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ħadtilha l-ikel lill-ġara li hi marida? Rita: Iva, u għada nerġa' mmur. Anna: Dak tħannin tassew.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you take food to the neighbour who is ill? Rita: Yes, and I'll go again tomorrow. Anna: That's a real act of mercy.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你给生病的邻居送饭了吗？丽塔：送了，明天我还会去。安娜：这真是仁慈之举。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadtilha l-ikel lill-ġara li hi marida?
messages.mt_standard: Ħadtilha l-ikel lill-ġara li hi marida?
messages.zh: 你给生病的邻居送饭了吗？
messages.en: Did you take food to the neighbour who is ill?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għada nerġa' mmur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għada nerġa' mmur.
messages.zh: 送了，明天我还会去。
messages.en: Yes, and I'll go again tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tħannin tassew.
messages.mt_standard: Dak tħannin tassew.
messages.zh: 这真是仁慈之举。
messages.en: That's a real act of mercy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用给病中邻居送饭的画面记忆：心中的怜悯化为行动，就是这里的仁慈善行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving someone excessive care, comfort, or protection; pampering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某人过多的照顾、安抚或保护，即娇养、过度呵护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kura, kumdità jew protezzjoni żejda mogħtija lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 娇养、宠护或过分细致地照料。

formal.mt: Il-gwida għall-ġenituri twissi li t-tħannis żejjed jista' jnaqqas l-opportunitajiet tat-tfal li jitgħallmu jagħmlu l-affarijiet waħedhom.
formal.en: The parenting guide warns that excessive cosseting can reduce children's opportunities to learn to do things independently.
formal.zh: 育儿指南提醒，过度娇养可能减少孩子学习独立做事的机会。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Se nerġa' nilbislu ż-żarbun jien. David: Ħallih jipprova waħdu; dan it-tħannis kollu ma jgħinux jitgħallem.
colloquial.en: Marta: I'll put his shoes on for him again. David: Let him try by himself; all this cosseting doesn't help him learn.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我还是再帮他穿鞋吧。戴维：让他自己试试，这么娇养他可不利于他学会。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nerġa' nilbislu ż-żarbun jien.
messages.mt_standard: Se nerġa' nilbislu ż-żarbun jien.
messages.zh: 我还是再帮他穿鞋吧。
messages.en: I'll put his shoes on for him again.

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallih jipprova waħdu; dan it-tħannis kollu ma jgħinux jitgħallem.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallih jipprova waħdu; dan it-tħannis kollu ma jgħinux jitgħallem.
messages.zh: 让他自己试试，这么娇养他可不利于他学会。
messages.en: Let him try by himself; all this cosseting doesn't help him learn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子连穿鞋都有人代劳的场景，用照顾过多、事事包办来记住娇养之意。

gloss_zh: 生虫；忸怩作笑；阿谀巴结

teaching_sense.en_definition: The production of worms; also affected, coy smiling or behaviour intended to flatter and gain favour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生虫子的过程；也指忸怩、做作地笑，或为讨好他人而阿谀巴结的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitnissel id-dud; ukoll tbissim mistħi u affettwat, jew imġiba servili biex wieħed jikseb il-favur ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生虫子、生虫的过程。
忸怩、做作地微笑；装出羞怯的笑态。
为讨好他人而阿谀奉承、巴结的行为。

collocations.en: the production of worms in fruit
simpering in front of the camera

formal.mt: Fil-kummentarju tiegħu, l-awtur jikkritika t-tħannix mal-kap bħala mezz biex wieħed jikseb vantaġġ personali.
formal.en: In his commentary, the author criticises toadying up to the boss as a means of gaining personal advantage.
formal.zh: 作者在评论中批评了通过巴结上司来谋取个人利益的行为。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed titbissem b'dak il-mod quddiem il-kamera? Sara: Qed nipprova nidher ħelwa. Nina: Tbissima naturali tkun aħjar minn dak it-tħannix.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you smiling like that in front of the camera? Sara: I'm trying to look sweet. Nina: A natural smile would be better than that simpering.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么对着镜头那样笑？萨拉：我想显得甜美一点。妮娜：自然地笑会比那样忸怩作笑更好。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed titbissem b'dak il-mod quddiem il-kamera?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed titbissem b'dak il-mod quddiem il-kamera?
messages.zh: 你为什么对着镜头那样笑？
messages.en: Why are you smiling like that in front of the camera?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nipprova nidher ħelwa.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nipprova nidher ħelwa.
messages.zh: 我想显得甜美一点。
messages.en: I'm trying to look sweet.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbissima naturali tkun aħjar minn dak it-tħannix.
messages.mt_standard: Tbissima naturali tkun aħjar minn dak it-tħannix.
messages.zh: 自然地笑会比那样忸怩作笑更好。
messages.en: A natural smile would be better than that simpering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成三张情境卡记忆：水果生虫、镜头前忸怩作笑、上司面前奉承；依据上下文选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut open or damaged by a slashing action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到划割或砍割，形成裂口、割口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' jew jinfetaħ b'daqqa ta' xafra jew ta' xi ħaġa taqta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被划破、割开或砍伤。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-ħsara jindika li t-tajer tħanxar b'oġġett li jaqta'.
formal.en: The damage report indicates that the tyre was slashed with a sharp object.
formal.zh: 损坏报告指出，轮胎被锋利物体割破。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ġara mit-tajer tar-rota? Pawlu: Tħanxar. Ara din il-qatgħa twila fil-ġenb.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happened to the bicycle tyre? Pawlu: It was slashed. Look at this long cut in the side.
colloquial.zh: 马克：自行车轮胎怎么了？保罗：被割破了。看侧面这道长口子。

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara mit-tajer tar-rota?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara mit-tajer tar-rota?
messages.zh: 自行车轮胎怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the bicycle tyre?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (修车师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħanxar. Ara din il-qatgħa twila fil-ġenb.
messages.mt_standard: Tħanxar. Ara din il-qatgħa twila fil-ġenb.
messages.zh: 被割破了。看侧面这道长口子。
messages.en: It was slashed. Look at this long cut in the side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象轮胎侧面被利器划出一道长口子，重点记住物体承受划割的被动含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop small roots.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物或枝条开始长出细小的根。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ għeruq żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出小根，生出细小的根。

collocations.en: a branch that has developed small roots

formal.mt: Wara ġimagħtejn fl-ilma, iz-zokk tħanxel u kien lest biex jitħawwel fil-ħamrija.
formal.en: After two weeks in water, the stem developed small roots and was ready to be planted in soil.
formal.zh: 在水中放置两周后，茎长出了细小的根，可以栽入土中了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, iz-zokk tħanxel! Toni: Iva, nara l-għeruq żgħar. Issa nistgħu nħawluh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, the stem has developed small roots! Toni: Yes, I can see the little roots. Now we can plant it.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：看，茎长出小根了！托尼：是啊，我看到那些小根了。现在可以把它种下了。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, iz-zokk tħanxel!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, iz-zokk tħanxel!
messages.zh: 看，茎长出小根了！
messages.en: Look, the stem has developed small roots!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nara l-għeruq żgħar. Issa nistgħu nħawluh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nara l-għeruq żgħar. Issa nistgħu nħawluh.
messages.zh: 是啊，我看到那些小根了。现在可以把它种下了。
messages.en: Yes, I can see the little roots. Now we can plant it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象透明水杯里的枝条冒出几根细细的小根，把这个动词与小根出现的变化联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of taking root.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物生出根并逐渐扎根的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih pjanta taqbad l-għeruq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生根、扎根这一过程。

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment ġie osservat it-tħanxil tal-pjanti fil-ħamrija.
formal.en: During the experiment, the process of the plants taking root in soil was observed.
formal.zh: 实验期间观察了植物在土壤中生根的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħares lejn il-pjanta kuljum? Rita: Qed insegwi t-tħanxil tagħha; irrid nara meta jibdew jidhru l-għeruq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you looking at the plant every day? Rita: I'm following its rooting process; I want to see when the roots start to appear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么每天都看这株植物？丽塔：我在观察它的生根过程，想看看根什么时候开始长出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tħares lejn il-pjanta kuljum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tħares lejn il-pjanta kuljum?
messages.zh: 你为什么每天都看这株植物？
messages.en: Why are you looking at the plant every day?

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed insegwi t-tħanxil tagħha; irrid nara meta jibdew jidhru l-għeruq.
messages.mt_standard: Qed insegwi t-tħanxil tagħha; irrid nara meta jibdew jidhru l-għeruq.
messages.zh: 我在观察它的生根过程，想看看根什么时候开始长出来。
messages.en: I'm following its rooting process; I want to see when the roots start to appear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把植物从无根到扎根的连续照片想成一段过程；这个名词给整段生根过程命名。

gloss_zh: 割断；劈砍；粗暴扫弦；歇斯底里的喊叫

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of severing or slashing; also rough strumming of a string instrument or hysterical shouting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指割断、劈砍的动作，也可指对弦乐器的粗暴扫弦或歇斯底里的喊叫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li taqta' jew iċċarrat b'daqqiet; ukoll daqq goff fuq il-kordi ta' strument jew għajjat isteriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 割断；切断。
用利器猛划、劈砍。

sense_translations.en_definition: rough strumming of a string instrument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对弦乐器进行粗暴、生硬的扫弦。
情绪失控、歇斯底里的喊叫。

formal.mt: Fit-taħriġ mużikali, l-għalliem wera d-differenza bejn daqq ikkontrollat u tħanxir tal-kordi.
formal.en: During the music lesson, the teacher demonstrated the difference between controlled playing and rough strumming of the strings.
formal.zh: 音乐课上，老师示范了有控制的演奏与粗暴扫弦之间的区别。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan it-tħanxir fuq il-kitarra? Mark: Qed nipprova ndoqq, imma għadni qed nitgħallem. Maja: Ipprova bil-mod u b'inqas saħħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's all this rough strumming on the guitar? Mark: I'm trying to play, but I'm still learning. Maja: Try slowly and with less force.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么把吉他扫得这么生硬？马克：我在试着弹，不过还在学。玛雅：试着慢一点，少用些力。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tħanxir fuq il-kitarra?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tħanxir fuq il-kitarra?
messages.zh: 怎么把吉他扫得这么生硬？
messages.en: What's all this rough strumming on the guitar?

messages.speaker: Mark (吉他初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nipprova ndoqq, imma għadni qed nitgħallem.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nipprova ndoqq, imma għadni qed nitgħallem.
messages.zh: 我在试着弹，不过还在学。
messages.en: I'm trying to play, but I'm still learning.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova bil-mod u b'inqas saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova bil-mod u b'inqas saħħa.
messages.zh: 试着慢一点，少用些力。
messages.en: Try slowly and with less force.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格画面记义：绳子割断、利器劈砍、琴弦乱扫、人声失控；遇到这个词，先看上下文属于哪一格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of eating excessively or greedily, especially eating more than one needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指贪吃、暴饮暴食或进食超过所需的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiekol iżżejjed jew b'regħba, aktar milli jkollok bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放开肚皮大吃；贪婪地猛吃。
吃得过多；进食过量。

collocations.zh: 庆祝活动期间的暴饮暴食

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi t-tħanżir waqt il-festi bħala drawwa li fiha n-nies jieklu aktar milli jkollhom bżonn.
formal.en: The text describes overeating during celebrations as a habit in which people eat more than they need.
formal.zh: 文章把庆祝活动期间的暴饮暴食描述为一种进食超过所需的习惯。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid biċċa kejk oħra? Pawlu: Le, grazzi. Biżżejjed tħanżir għal-lum! Lara: Mela nħallu l-bqija għal għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want another piece of cake? Pawlu: No, thanks. Enough pigging out for today! Lara: Then let's leave the rest for tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：还要一块蛋糕吗？保罗：不了，谢谢。今天已经吃得够放纵了！拉拉：那剩下的留到明天吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid biċċa kejk oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Trid biċċa kejk oħra?
messages.zh: 还要一块蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Do you want another piece of cake?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Biżżejjed tħanżir għal-lum!
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Biżżejjed tħanżir għal-lum!
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。今天已经吃得够放纵了！
messages.en: No, thanks. Enough pigging out for today!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nħallu l-bqija għal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nħallu l-bqija għal għada.
messages.zh: 那剩下的留到明天吧。
messages.en: Then let's leave the rest for tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚餐后盘子已经清空，自己还不断加餐；把这个词与“吃过头、停不下嘴”的情景绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 被坚持主张；被坚决论辩

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a point or claim to be asserted or argued with firmness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个观点或主张被明确坚持提出，或被坚决地加以论辩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal punt jew argument li jiġi sostnut jew difiż b'insistenza u b'determinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被明确提出并坚持主张。
被坚决地论辩或据理力争地维护。

collocations.en: was firmly argued during the debate

formal.mt: Il-punt dwar il-ħtieġa ta' aktar provi tħaqqaq b'insistenza waqt id-dibattitu.
formal.en: The point about the need for more evidence was firmly argued during the debate.
formal.zh: 辩论中，关于需要更多证据的观点得到了坚决的论辩支持。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-punt tiegħek tħaqqaq fil-laqgħa? David: Iva, tħaqqaq b'insistenza, u fl-aħħar qablu li jeżaminawh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was your point firmly argued at the meeting? David: Yes, it was argued insistently, and in the end they agreed to examine it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：会上有人坚决为你的观点据理力争吗？戴维：有，大家坚持提出，最后他们同意研究这个观点。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-punt tiegħek tħaqqaq fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-punt tiegħek tħaqqaq fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 会上有人坚决为你的观点据理力争吗？
messages.en: Was your point firmly argued at the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tħaqqaq b'insistenza, u fl-aħħar qablu li jeżaminawh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tħaqqaq b'insistenza, u fl-aħħar qablu li jeżaminawh.
messages.zh: 有，大家坚持提出，最后他们同意研究这个观点。
messages.en: Yes, it was argued insistently, and in the end they agreed to examine it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一个观点想成会议桌中央的牌子，众人不断为它发言；注意这里记的是“观点被坚持主张”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Firm or repeated insistence on a point, request, or desired action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指对某个观点、要求或希望采取的行动坚定或反复地坚持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insistenza qawwija jew ripetuta fuq punt, talba jew azzjoni mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚持；反复强调；执意要求。

formal.mt: Bit-tħaqqiq tar-rappreżentant, il-kumitat qabel li jerġa' jeżamina t-talba.
formal.en: Through the representative's insistence, the committee agreed to examine the request again.
formal.zh: 在代表的坚持下，委员会同意重新审查该项请求。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fl-aħħar se jsewwu l-bieb? Toni: Iva, bit-tħaqqiq tiegħi qablu li jiġu għada. Nina: Tajjeb, ilna nistennew.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are they finally going to fix the door? Toni: Yes, through my insistence they agreed to come tomorrow. Nina: Good, we've been waiting a long time.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他们终于要来修门了吗？托尼：是啊，在我的坚持下，他们同意明天来。妮娜：太好了，我们已经等了很久。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-aħħar se jsewwu l-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Fl-aħħar se jsewwu l-bieb?
messages.zh: 他们终于要来修门了吗？
messages.en: Are they finally going to fix the door?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bit-tħaqqiq tiegħi qablu li jiġu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bit-tħaqqiq tiegħi qablu li jiġu għada.
messages.zh: 是啊，在我的坚持下，他们同意明天来。
messages.en: Yes, through my insistence they agreed to come tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ilna nistennew.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ilna nistennew.
messages.zh: 太好了，我们已经等了很久。
messages.en: Good, we've been waiting a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这件事还得办”反复提醒的场景记住坚持之意；与动词 tħaqqaq 对照，本词给这种坚持行为命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put out of joint, thrown into disarray, or ruined.
