teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指失去正常衔接或位置、被弄得混乱，或遭到毁坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-pożizzjoni jew l-ordni normali tiegħu, jitqalleb jew jispiċċa mħassar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be put out of joint
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄得脱节；偏离正常位置或衔接状态。
被弄乱；陷入杂乱无序的状态。
被毁坏；遭到破坏而无法保持原状。

collocations.en: the place was thrown into disarray

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-konferenza tħarbat minħabba dewmien fit-trasport.
formal.en: The conference schedule was disrupted because of transport delays.
formal.zh: 由于交通延误，会议日程被打乱了。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex il-kċina kollha tħarbtet? Ben: Kont qed infittex il-kejkiera. Issa nqiegħed kollox f'postu. Marta: Tajjeb, għax dalwaqt insajru.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why has the whole kitchen been thrown into disarray? Ben: I was looking for the cake tin. I'll put everything back now. Marta: Good, because we'll be cooking soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：怎么整个厨房都被弄乱了？本：我刚才在找蛋糕模，现在就把东西放回去。玛尔塔：好，我们马上要做饭了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kċina kollha tħarbtet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kċina kollha tħarbtet?
messages.zh: 怎么整个厨房都被弄乱了？
messages.en: Why has the whole kitchen been thrown into disarray?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed infittex il-kejkiera. Issa nqiegħed kollox f'postu.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed infittex il-kejkiera. Issa nqiegħed kollox f'postu.
messages.zh: 我刚才在找蛋糕模，现在就把东西放回去。
messages.en: I was looking for the cake tin. I'll put everything back now.

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, għax dalwaqt insajru.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, għax dalwaqt insajru.
messages.zh: 好，我们马上要做饭了。
messages.en: Good, because we'll be cooking soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象整齐的积木突然错位、散乱甚至倒塌，把“脱节、弄乱、毁坏”连成一个由轻到重的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be written or marked in a hurried, untidy, or scribbled way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指文字或记号被匆忙、潦草地写下或涂写出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkiteb jew jitniżżel b'mod mgħaġġel, imħawwad jew mhux ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被潦草地写下；被随手涂写。

collocations.en: was scribbled on a piece of paper

formal.mt: L-indirizz tħarbex fuq biċċa karta u kien diffiċli biex jinqara.
formal.en: The address was scribbled on a piece of paper and was difficult to read.
formal.zh: 地址被潦草地写在一张纸上，很难辨认。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Dan in-numru tħarbex malajr wisq. Tista' taqrah? Samwel: Naħseb li l-aħħar ċifra hija tlieta. Julia: Aħjar nistaqsu biex inkunu ċerti.
colloquial.en: Julia: This number was scribbled down too quickly. Can you read it? Samwel: I think the last digit is three. Julia: We'd better ask to be sure.
colloquial.zh: 尤莉娅：这个号码写得太潦草了，你看得清吗？萨姆韦尔：我觉得最后一位是三。尤莉娅：我们最好问一下，确认清楚。

messages.speaker: Julia (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan in-numru tħarbex malajr wisq. Tista' taqrah?
messages.mt_standard: Dan in-numru tħarbex malajr wisq. Tista' taqrah?
messages.zh: 这个号码写得太潦草了，你看得清吗？
messages.en: This number was scribbled down too quickly. Can you read it?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li l-aħħar ċifra hija tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li l-aħħar ċifra hija tlieta.
messages.zh: 我觉得最后一位是三。
messages.en: I think the last digit is three.

messages.speaker: Julia (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar nistaqsu biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar nistaqsu biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.zh: 我们最好问一下，确认清楚。
messages.en: We'd better ask to be sure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电话响起时匆忙记号码，写完却认不出来；用“号码被潦草写下”记住这个动词的被动含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of ruining something, or extensive destruction and devastation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把事物毁坏的行为或过程，也指广泛、严重的破坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li tħassar jew teqred xi ħaġa, jew qerda kbira u mifruxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毁坏；使事物遭到破坏的行为或过程。
严重破坏；大范围的毁坏。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tħarbit li ħalliet il-maltempata fl-għelieqi u fil-ġonna.
formal.en: The report describes the devastation that the storm left in the fields and gardens.
formal.zh: 报告描述了暴风雨给田地和花园造成的严重破坏。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rajt it-tħarbit fil-ġnien wara r-riħ tal-lejl? Ġanni: Iva, inkisru żewġ qsari u waqgħet parti miċ-ċint. Rita: Nibdew niġbru l-biċċiet.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you seen the destruction in the garden after last night's wind? Ġanni: Yes, two pots broke and part of the fence fell down. Rita: Let's start collecting the pieces.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你看到昨晚大风把花园破坏成什么样了吗？贾尼：看到了，两个花盆碎了，围栏也倒了一部分。丽塔：我们开始收拾碎片吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt it-tħarbit fil-ġnien wara r-riħ tal-lejl?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt it-tħarbit fil-ġnien wara r-riħ tal-lejl?
messages.zh: 你看到昨晚大风把花园破坏成什么样了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the destruction in the garden after last night's wind?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inkisru żewġ qsari u waqgħet parti miċ-ċint.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inkisru żewġ qsari u waqgħet parti miċ-ċint.
messages.zh: 看到了，两个花盆碎了，围栏也倒了一部分。
messages.en: Yes, two pots broke and part of the fence fell down.

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew niġbru l-biċċiet.
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew niġbru l-biċċiet.
messages.zh: 我们开始收拾碎片吧。
messages.en: Let's start collecting the pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用暴风雨后花盆破碎、围栏倒下的画面记“毁坏”；对照 tħarbat 表示遭到破坏，本词是破坏这件事的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of scratching a surface or writing and drawing in an untidy, scribbled way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指刮划表面的动作，也指潦草书写或随手乱写乱画。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tobrox wiċċ, jew li tikteb u tpinġi b'mod imħawwad u mhux ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮划；在表面上抓刮或划动。
潦草书写；随手乱写乱画。

collocations.zh: 在页边空白处乱写乱画

formal.mt: It-tħarbix fuq il-wiċċ tal-injam jista' jħalli marki li jibqgħu jidhru.
formal.en: Scratching the surface of the wood can leave lasting visible marks.
formal.zh: 在木头表面刮划可能留下长久可见的痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu dan it-tħarbix fil-marġni tal-pitazz? Leo: Kont qed nistenna u bdejt npinġi forom żgħar. Anna: Sewwa, imma ħalli spazju għan-noti.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's all this scribbling in the margin of the notebook? Leo: I was waiting and started drawing little shapes. Anna: All right, but leave room for notes.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：笔记本页边怎么有这么多乱画？莱奥：我等着的时候，随手画了些小图形。安娜：好吧，不过要留些地方记笔记。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tħarbix fil-marġni tal-pitazz?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tħarbix fil-marġni tal-pitazz?
messages.zh: 笔记本页边怎么有这么多乱画？
messages.en: What's all this scribbling in the margin of the notebook?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed nistenna u bdejt npinġi forom żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed nistenna u bdejt npinġi forom żgħar.
messages.zh: 我等着的时候，随手画了些小图形。
messages.en: I was waiting and started drawing little shapes.

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, imma ħalli spazju għan-noti.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, imma ħalli spazju għan-noti.
messages.zh: 好吧，不过要留些地方记笔记。
messages.en: All right, but leave room for notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个表面：木头上刮划，纸面上乱画；它们都留下线条，但本词是名词，指刮划或涂写这种行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To engage in or carry on a war.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与或持续进行战争，指武装冲突层面的交战。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiġġieled jew tieħu sehem fi gwerra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行战争；交战。

collocations.en: war was waged for many years
war was waged between two countries

formal.mt: F'dan ir-reġjun tħareb għal ħafna snin qabel ma ntlaħaq ftehim ta' paċi.
formal.en: War was waged in this region for many years before a peace agreement was reached.
formal.zh: 这个地区进行了多年的战争，之后才达成和平协议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'dan il-post tħareb ukoll? Pawlu: Iva, imma issa hawn il-paċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was war waged in this place too? Pawlu: Yes, but it is peaceful here now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个地方也打过仗吗？保罗：是的，不过这里现在很和平。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan il-post tħareb ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan il-post tħareb ukoll?
messages.zh: 这个地方也打过仗吗？
messages.en: Was war waged in this place too?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma issa hawn il-paċi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma issa hawn il-paċi.
messages.zh: 是的，不过这里现在很和平。
messages.en: Yes, but it is peaceful here now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词放进“两国交战多年”的画面里记，重点是进行战争这一行为。

gloss_zh: 受到监视；受到保护；得到遵守或纪念

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be kept under surveillance, to be protected, or, of a special day, to be observed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示受到监视或保护；用于特殊日子时，表示该日得到遵守、庆祝或纪念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinżamm taħt sorveljanza jew protezzjoni, jew, fil-każ ta' jum speċjali, li jiġi ċċelebrat jew imfakkar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到监视；被持续留意或看守。
受到保护；得到防护或守护。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be observed (used, e.g. of special days of the calendar)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到遵守、庆祝或纪念，例如日历上的特殊日子。

collocations.en: was kept under surveillance by the police
the day was observed with a ceremony
collocations.zh: 以仪式纪念了这个日子

formal.mt: Il-maħżen tħares mill-pulizija lejl u nhar matul l-investigazzjoni.
formal.en: The warehouse was kept under police surveillance day and night during the investigation.
formal.zh: 调查期间，这座仓库受到警方日夜监视。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kwadru tħares mill-ħsara waqt iċ-ċaqliq? Mark: Iva, għattejnieh sew qabel mexxejnieh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the painting protected from damage during the move? Mark: Yes, we covered it well before moving it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：搬运时，那幅画有受到保护、避免损坏吗？马克：有，我们搬之前把它包好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (画作主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kwadru tħares mill-ħsara waqt iċ-ċaqliq?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kwadru tħares mill-ħsara waqt iċ-ċaqliq?
messages.zh: 搬运时，那幅画有受到保护、避免损坏吗？
messages.en: Was the painting protected from damage during the move?

messages.speaker: Mark (搬运人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għattejnieh sew qabel mexxejnieh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għattejnieh sew qabel mexxejnieh.
messages.zh: 有，我们搬之前把它包好了。
messages.en: Yes, we covered it well before moving it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个对象分开记：仓库受到监视、画作受到保护、特殊日子得到纪念，靠语境选择词义。

gloss_zh: 被草率完成；做得粗制滥造

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a task or piece of work to be carried out carelessly and poorly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指工作或任务被马虎、粗糙地完成，成品质量较差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xogħol isir bl-addoċċ u mingħajr il-kura meħtieġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be done in a shoddy manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被草率、粗糙地完成；做得质量低劣。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol tħarfex u kellu jerġa' jsir biex jilħaq il-livell meħtieġ.
formal.en: The work was done shoddily and had to be redone to meet the required standard.
formal.zh: 这项工作完成得很粗糙，必须重做才能达到要求的标准。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex għad hemm l-ilma ħiereġ? Rita: It-tiswija tħarfex; irridu nsejħu lill-plamer mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is water still leaking? Rita: The repair was done shoddily; we need to call the plumber again.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么还在漏水？丽塔：维修做得太马虎了；我们得再叫水管工来。

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għad hemm l-ilma ħiereġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għad hemm l-ilma ħiereġ?
messages.zh: 为什么还在漏水？
messages.en: Why is water still leaking?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tiswija tħarfex; irridu nsejħu lill-plamer mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: It-tiswija tħarfex; irridu nsejħu lill-plamer mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 维修做得太马虎了；我们得再叫水管工来。
messages.en: The repair was done shoddily; we need to call the plumber again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象修过的水管仍在漏水，用“这活儿被做糙了”记住它的动词含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of scraping the surface of the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对地表进行刮擦的动作，重点是刮动地面表层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni ta' brix tal-wiċċ tal-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮擦地面；刮动地表的动作。

formal.mt: It-tħarfin tal-art sar b'għodda żgħira biex jitneħħa s-saff ta' fuq.
formal.en: The ground was scraped with a small tool to remove the top layer.
formal.zh: 用小工具刮擦了地面，以去除表层。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tuża dik l-għodda żgħira? Pawlu: Għat-tħarfin tal-art; irrid inneħħi biss saff irqiq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you using that small tool? Pawlu: For scraping the ground; I only want to remove a thin layer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么用那个小工具？保罗：用来刮地；我只想刮掉薄薄一层。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tuża dik l-għodda żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tuża dik l-għodda żgħira?
messages.zh: 你为什么用那个小工具？
messages.en: Why are you using that small tool?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tħarfin tal-art; irrid inneħħi biss saff irqiq.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tħarfin tal-art; irrid inneħħi biss saff irqiq.
messages.zh: 用来刮地；我只想刮掉薄薄一层。
messages.en: For scraping the ground; I only want to remove a thin layer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小工具贴着地面刮下一层薄土，把这个名词记成“刮地这一动作”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clumsy or careless handling of a task, or the poor workmanship that results.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指笨拙、马虎地处理工作的行为，也指由此体现出的粗劣做工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twettiq ta' xogħol b'mod goff jew bl-addoċċ, jew il-kwalità fqira tax-xogħol li jirriżulta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨拙乱做；因处理不当而把事情搞砸。
粗劣的做工；马虎、不合标准的工艺质量。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni sabet sinjali ta' tħarfix fit-twaħħil tal-bibien, li ma kinux jingħalqu sew.
formal.en: The inspection found signs of shoddy workmanship in the installation of the doors, which did not close properly.
formal.zh: 检查发现，门的安装存在做工粗劣的迹象，门无法正常关合。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Din l-ixkaffa għadha mxengla. Mark: Dan tħarfix; irridu nwaħħluha sew.
colloquial.en: Rita: This shelf is still crooked. Mark: This is shoddy workmanship; we need to fix it properly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个架子还是歪的。马克：这做工太差了；我们得把它好好固定。

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-ixkaffa għadha mxengla.
messages.mt_standard: Din l-ixkaffa għadha mxengla.
messages.zh: 这个架子还是歪的。
messages.en: This shelf is still crooked.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan tħarfix; irridu nwaħħluha sew.
messages.mt_standard: Dan tħarfix; irridu nwaħħluha sew.
messages.zh: 这做工太差了；我们得把它好好固定。
messages.en: This is shoddy workmanship; we need to fix it properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看着装歪的架子说“这是什么烂做工”，把它记成评价乱做行为或粗劣工艺的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The habit or practice of using money and resources carefully and reducing unnecessary spending.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谨慎使用金钱和资源、减少不必要开支的习惯或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-drawwa jew il-prattika li tuża l-flus u r-riżorsi bil-għaqal u tnaqqas l-infiq bla bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节俭；谨慎花钱、避免浪费的习惯。
节约开支；通过减少不必要的消耗来省钱。

formal.mt: It-tħarir fl-ispejjeż tad-dar għen lill-familja twarrab somma żgħira kull xahar.
formal.en: Economising on household expenses helped the family put aside a small sum each month.
formal.zh: 节约家庭开支帮助这个家庭每月存下一小笔钱。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed nieħdu l-ikel magħna? Mark: Ftit tħarir jgħinna; hekk nonfqu inqas fuq l-ikel barra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are we taking food with us? Mark: A little economising helps us; this way we spend less on eating out.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们为什么要自己带吃的？马克：节省一点对我们有帮助；这样在外面吃饭就能少花些钱。

messages.speaker: Rita (伴侣)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nieħdu l-ikel magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nieħdu l-ikel magħna?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要自己带吃的？
messages.en: Why are we taking food with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (伴侣)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit tħarir jgħinna; hekk nonfqu inqas fuq l-ikel barra.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit tħarir jgħinna; hekk nonfqu inqas fuq l-ikel barra.
messages.zh: 节省一点对我们有帮助；这样在外面吃饭就能少花些钱。
messages.en: A little economising helps us; this way we spend less on eating out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门自带午餐，把省下的钱放进储蓄罐：既能记住节俭的习惯，也能记住节约开支的做法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of keeping watch over someone or something, or supervising an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 留意并看守某人或某物，或监督某项活动的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jgħasses lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew jissorvelja attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 看守；保持警戒并留意情况。
监督；留意他人的活动或工作的进行情况。

formal.mt: It-tħaris fuq ix-xogħol għandu jkun kontinwu biex jiġu evitati l-inċidenti.
formal.en: Supervision of the work should be continuous to prevent accidents.
formal.zh: 应持续监督工作，以防发生事故。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tħaris billejl? Pawlu: Jien se nibqa' hawn u nżomm għajnejja fuq il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will take care of keeping watch tonight? Pawlu: I'll stay here and keep an eye on the door.
colloquial.zh: Marija：今晚谁负责看守？Pawlu：我会留在这里，留意门口。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tħaris billejl?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tħaris billejl?
messages.zh: 今晚谁负责看守？
messages.en: Who will take care of keeping watch tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (值班同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien se nibqa' hawn u nżomm għajnejja fuq il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Jien se nibqa' hawn u nżomm għajnejja fuq il-bieb.
messages.zh: 我会留在这里，留意门口。
messages.en: I'll stay here and keep an eye on the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词联想成值班表上的一项任务：守门时是看守，盯着工作进度时是监督。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of keeping oneself busy by doing tasks or attending to various things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让自己忙于做事、处理各种事务的活动或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iżomm ruħu okkupat billi jagħmel xogħol jew jieħu ħsieb diversi affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忙活；让自己忙于各种事情。

collocations.en: keeping oneself busy without a break

formal.mt: It-tħarkin fid-dar qabel il-wasla tal-mistednin dam għaddej sa nofsinhar.
formal.en: The activity of busying oneself around the house before the guests arrived continued until noon.
formal.zh: 客人到来前，家里的忙活一直持续到中午。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan it-tħarkin kollu fil-kċina? Ninu: Qed inħejji l-ikel għall-mistednin.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's all this activity in the kitchen? Ninu: I'm preparing food for the guests.
colloquial.zh: Lara：厨房里怎么忙成这样？Ninu：我在给客人准备饭菜。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tħarkin kollu fil-kċina?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tħarkin kollu fil-kċina?
messages.zh: 厨房里怎么忙成这样？
messages.en: What's all this activity in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Ninu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħejji l-ikel għall-mistednin.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħejji l-ikel għall-mistednin.
messages.zh: 我在给客人准备饭菜。
messages.en: I'm preparing food for the guests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象客人快到时，一个人在厨房和客厅之间忙来忙去，用这个名词记住整段忙活的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be allowed to escape instead of being stopped or kept under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被允许逃脱或被放走，而没有受到阻止或继续看管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitħalla jaħrab minflok jinżamm jew jitwaqqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被允许逃脱；被放走。

collocations.en: the prisoner was allowed to escape
was allowed to escape from prison

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-priġunier tħarrab għax il-gwardjan ħallieh jgħaddi mingħajr ma waqqfu.
formal.en: According to the report, the prisoner was allowed to escape because the guard let him pass without stopping him.
formal.zh: 据报告，囚犯被放走了，因为看守让他通过，没有加以阻拦。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif ħareġ il-priġunier? Mark: Tħarrab; il-gwardjan fetaħlu l-bieb u ħallieh jitlaq.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did the prisoner get out? Mark: He was allowed to escape; the guard opened the door for him and let him leave.
colloquial.zh: Rita：那个囚犯怎么出去的？Mark：他被放走了；看守给他开了门，让他离开。

messages.speaker: Rita (读报的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħareġ il-priġunier?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħareġ il-priġunier?
messages.zh: 那个囚犯怎么出去的？
messages.en: How did the prisoner get out?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起读报的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħarrab; il-gwardjan fetaħlu l-bieb u ħallieh jitlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Tħarrab; il-gwardjan fetaħlu l-bieb u ħallieh jitlaq.
messages.zh: 他被放走了；看守给他开了门，让他离开。
messages.en: He was allowed to escape; the guard opened the door for him and let him leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住看守主动开门放人的画面，重点是获准逃脱。再留意末尾是 ab，和 tħarreb 的 eb 区分。

gloss_zh: 表现得好色；灼热至白炽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave lecherously, or, of a material, to glow white-hot from intense heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人表现得好色；也指材料因极高温度而发出白炽光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iġib ruħu b'xewqa sesswali eċċessiva, jew li materjal jiddu b'dawl abjad minħabba sħana qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现得好色；显露过度的色欲。
灼热至白炽；因高温而发出白光。

collocations.en: behaved lecherously in pursuit of women
the metal glowed white-hot in the furnace

formal.mt: Il-metall tħarraq fil-forn u beda jiddu b'dawl abjad minħabba t-temperatura għolja.
formal.en: The metal glowed white-hot in the furnace, emitting white light because of the high temperature.
formal.zh: 金属在炉中烧至白炽，因高温而发出白光。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-metall qed jidher abjad? Toni: Tħarraq bis-sħana tal-forn. Ibqa' lura.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the metal look white? Toni: It has become white-hot from the heat of the furnace. Stay back.
colloquial.zh: Sara：金属为什么看起来是白色的？Toni：炉子的高温把它烧至白炽了。站远一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-metall qed jidher abjad?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-metall qed jidher abjad?
messages.zh: 金属为什么看起来是白色的？
messages.en: Why does the metal look white?

messages.speaker: Toni (工坊师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħarraq bis-sħana tal-forn. Ibqa' lura.
messages.mt_standard: Tħarraq bis-sħana tal-forn. Ibqa' lura.
messages.zh: 炉子的高温把它烧至白炽了。站远一点。
messages.en: It has become white-hot from the heat of the furnace. Stay back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给两个义项各放一张记忆卡：一张写人的好色表现，一张画炉中发白光的金属；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a surface made rough or less smooth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面被处理得粗糙，变得不再光滑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wiċċ isir aħrax u inqas lixx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄粗糙；表面被处理得不再光滑。

collocations.zh: 被砂纸打磨出粗糙表面

formal.mt: Il-wiċċ tal-injam tħarrax bil-karta tax-xkatlar qabel ma ġiet applikata l-kolla.
formal.en: The surface of the wood was roughened with sandpaper before the glue was applied.
formal.zh: 涂胶之前，木材表面先用砂纸打磨得粗糙。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex dan il-wiċċ m'għadux lixx? Ġorġ: Tħarrax bil-karta tax-xkatlar biex il-kolla taqbad aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is this surface no longer smooth? Ġorġ: It was roughened with sandpaper so the glue would adhere better.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这个表面怎么不光滑了？Ġorġ：用砂纸打磨粗糙了，这样胶水能粘得更牢。

messages.speaker: Marta (手工课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-wiċċ m'għadux lixx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-wiċċ m'għadux lixx?
messages.zh: 这个表面怎么不光滑了？
messages.en: Why is this surface no longer smooth?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħarrax bil-karta tax-xkatlar biex il-kolla taqbad aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Tħarrax bil-karta tax-xkatlar biex il-kolla taqbad aħjar.
messages.zh: 用砂纸打磨粗糙了，这样胶水能粘得更牢。
messages.en: It was roughened with sandpaper so the glue would adhere better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指摸过打磨后的木板，能感觉到细小划痕；把这种表面变粗的触感和词义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be abandoned or left without the care or support previously given.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被抛弃或弃置，失去原有的照料、支持或关注。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jew post jitħalla abbandunat, mingħajr il-kura jew l-appoġġ ta' qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被遗弃；被抛下而不再受到照顾或支持。

formal.mt: Il-post tħarreb minn sidu u baqa' għal snin sħaħ mingħajr ħadd ma jieħu ħsiebu.
formal.en: The place was forsaken by its owner and remained without anyone caring for it for years.
formal.zh: 这个地方被主人弃置，多年来一直无人照管。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex ħadd ma jieħu ħsieb dan il-post? David: Tħarreb minn sidu meta telaq mir-raħal.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why does nobody look after this place? David: It was forsaken by its owner when he left the village.
colloquial.zh: Elena：为什么没人照管这个地方？David：主人离开村子时就把它弃置了。

messages.speaker: Elena (新搬来的邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħadd ma jieħu ħsieb dan il-post?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħadd ma jieħu ħsieb dan il-post?
messages.zh: 为什么没人照管这个地方？
messages.en: Why does nobody look after this place?

messages.speaker: David (村民)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħarreb minn sidu meta telaq mir-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Tħarreb minn sidu meta telaq mir-raħal.
messages.zh: 主人离开村子时就把它弃置了。
messages.en: It was forsaken by its owner when he left the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上一座多年无人照料的空屋。注意末尾 eb 表示本条的被遗弃，另用开门放人的画面记 tħarrab。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be invented or made up rather than based on actual events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内容被编造或虚构，并非依据实际发生的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li rakkont jew kontenut jinħoloq mill-immaġinazzjoni u mhux minn ġrajjiet li seħħew tassew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被编造；被虚构出来。

collocations.en: was made up by the author

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont tħarref mill-awtur u ma jiddeskrivix ġrajjiet li seħħew tassew.
formal.en: The story was made up by the author and does not describe events that actually happened.
formal.zh: 这个故事由作者虚构，并未描述真实发生的事件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan ir-rakkont ġara tassew? Beppe: Le, tħarref biex id-dramm ikun aktar interessanti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did this story really happen? Beppe: No, it was made up to make the play more interesting.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这个故事真的发生过吗？Beppe：没有，是为了让戏更有趣而编出来的。

messages.speaker: Anna (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-rakkont ġara tassew?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-rakkont ġara tassew?
messages.zh: 这个故事真的发生过吗？
messages.en: Did this story really happen?

messages.speaker: Beppe (剧团成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tħarref biex id-dramm ikun aktar interessanti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tħarref biex id-dramm ikun aktar interessanti.
messages.zh: 没有，是为了让戏更有趣而编出来的。
messages.en: No, it was made up to make the play more interesting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作者在稿纸上给故事贴上虚构标签，把这个词与故事被编出来的过程相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a slight movement or to change position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻微地动一下，或改变所在的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jagħmel ċaqliq żgħir jew ibiddel il-pożizzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微微动一下；原本静止时出现轻微动作。
移动；改变位置。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent tħarrek ftit meta sema' leħen l-infermiera.
formal.en: The patient stirred slightly when he heard the nurse's voice.
formal.zh: 病人听到护士的声音时，微微动了一下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus għadu rieqed? Luqa: Naħseb li iva, imma tħarrek ftit meta ftaħt il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the cat still asleep? Luqa: I think so, but it stirred a little when I opened the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：猫还在睡吗？Luqa：我想是的，不过我开门时它稍微动了一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus għadu rieqed?
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus għadu rieqed?
messages.zh: 猫还在睡吗？
messages.en: Is the cat still asleep?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li iva, imma tħarrek ftit meta ftaħt il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li iva, imma tħarrek ftit meta ftaħt il-bieb.
messages.zh: 我想是的，不过我开门时它稍微动了一下。
messages.en: I think so, but it stirred a little when I opened the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象熟睡的猫微微动一下，再想象它挪到另一处；两个连续画面分别帮助记住轻动和移动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of escaping, laying waste to a place, or destroying something, according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境指逃脱的行为，或蹂躏某地、毁坏某物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att ta' ħarba, jew l-att li jitħalla post ħerba jew tinqered xi ħaġa, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃脱；逃离拘禁或危险的行为
蹂躏；使一片地方变得荒废或满目疮痍
毁坏；摧毁某物的行为

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi t-tħarrib tal-irħula matul il-gwerra u t-telf li ġarrbu r-residenti.
formal.en: The account describes the laying waste of villages during the war and the losses suffered by the residents.
formal.zh: 这篇记述描写了战争期间村庄遭到蹂躏的情形，以及居民承受的损失。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk, tħarrib ifisser ħarba? Pawlu: Iva, għax is-sentenza titkellem dwar priġunier li ħarab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does tħarrib mean escape here? Pawlu: Yes, because the sentence is about a prisoner who escaped.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 tħarrib 是逃脱的意思吗？保罗：是的，因为这句话讲的是一个逃走的囚犯。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, tħarrib ifisser ħarba?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, tħarrib ifisser ħarba?
messages.zh: 这里的 tħarrib 是逃脱的意思吗？
messages.en: Does tħarrib mean escape here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax is-sentenza titkellem dwar priġunier li ħarab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax is-sentenza titkellem dwar priġunier li ħarab.
messages.zh: 是的，因为这句话讲的是一个逃走的囚犯。
messages.en: Yes, because the sentence is about a prisoner who escaped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：囚犯逃出牢房，村庄遭到毁坏；读句子时先看对象，再选“逃脱”或“毁坏”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of telling stories, or of telling things that are untrue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 讲述故事的活动，也可指讲假话或编造不实内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jirrakkonta stejjer, jew li jgħid affarijiet li mhumiex veri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲故事；叙述故事的活动
说谎；讲述或编造不实之词

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi sessjoni ta' tħarrif li fiha n-nanniet jirrakkontaw ħrejjef lit-tfal.
formal.en: The programme includes a storytelling session in which grandparents tell fairy tales to children.
formal.zh: 活动安排包括一场讲故事环节，由祖父母辈的人给孩子们讲童话。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejjaħt dak li qal tħarrif? Mark: Għax ivvinta kollox; xejn minn dak li qal ma ġara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you call what he said tħarrif? Mark: Because he made everything up; none of what he said happened.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么把他说的话叫作 tħarrif？马克：因为全是他编的；他说的那些事一件也没发生。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejjaħt dak li qal tħarrif?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejjaħt dak li qal tħarrif?
messages.zh: 你为什么把他说的话叫作 tħarrif？
messages.en: Why did you call what he said tħarrif?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ivvinta kollox; xejn minn dak li qal ma ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ivvinta kollox; xejn minn dak li qal ma ġara.
messages.zh: 因为全是他编的；他说的那些事一件也没发生。
messages.en: Because he made everything up; none of what he said happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住同一个“讲”字的两面：讲童话是讲故事，把编造的事当真话讲就成了说谎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexual desire understood as lust or as an excessively sexual interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有色欲意味的性欲，或过分关注性事的欲念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa sesswali meqjusa bħala żejda jew bħala interess eċċessiv f'affarijiet sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好色的欲念；对性事带有窥探意味或过度兴趣的欲望
色欲；好色或充满淫欲的状态

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, il-kritika tiddistingwi bejn l-imħabba tal-karattru u t-tħarriq li jidher fi kliemu.
formal.en: In her analysis of the novel, the critic distinguishes between the character's love and the lust evident in his words.
formal.zh: 在对小说的分析中，这位女评论家区分了人物的爱情与其言语中显露的色欲。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta tgħid tħarriq f'din is-silta, qed tfisser imħabba? Mark: Le, qed infisser xewqa sesswali; hawnhekk il-kelma għandha sens negattiv.
colloquial.en: Lara: When you say tħarriq in this passage, do you mean love? Mark: No, I mean sexual desire; the word has a negative sense here.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你说这段里的 tħarriq，是指爱情吗？马克：不是，我指的是性欲；这个词在这里带有负面意味。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid tħarriq f'din is-silta, qed tfisser imħabba?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid tħarriq f'din is-silta, qed tfisser imħabba?
messages.zh: 你说这段里的 tħarriq，是指爱情吗？
messages.en: When you say tħarriq in this passage, do you mean love?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed infisser xewqa sesswali; hawnhekk il-kelma għandha sens negattiv.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed infisser xewqa sesswali; hawnhekk il-kelma għandha sens negattiv.
messages.zh: 不是，我指的是性欲；这个词在这里带有负面意味。
messages.en: No, I mean sexual desire; the word has a negative sense here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进文学人物的“目光与言语”场景，记作带有色欲的欲念，避免笼统译成普通的愿望。

gloss_zh: 神态转为严厉；态度变得严峻

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change towards a stern or severe demeanour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 神态或待人态度转为严厉、严峻的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla li biha l-imġiba jew id-dehra ta' persuna ssir aktar severa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神态或态度变得严厉这一变化

collocations.en: a change towards a stern appearance

formal.mt: L-awtur juri t-tħarrix fl-imġiba tal-kap wara li jsir jaf bl-iżball serju.
formal.en: The author shows the leader's demeanour becoming stern after he learns of the serious mistake.
formal.zh: 作者描写了负责人得知严重错误之后，态度变得严厉的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser tħarrix hawn? Pawlu: Li sar aktar sever; għall-ewwel kien jitbissem, imbagħad wiċċu sar serju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tħarrix mean here? Pawlu: That he became sterner; at first he was smiling, then his expression became serious.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 tħarrix 是什么意思？保罗：就是说他变得更严厉了；起初他还在微笑，后来神情就严肃起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser tħarrix hawn?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser tħarrix hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 tħarrix 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tħarrix mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li sar aktar sever; għall-ewwel kien jitbissem, imbagħad wiċċu sar serju.
messages.mt_standard: Li sar aktar sever; għall-ewwel kien jitbissem, imbagħad wiċċu sar serju.
messages.zh: 就是说他变得更严厉了；起初他还在微笑，后来神情就严肃起来。
messages.en: That he became sterner; at first he was smiling, then his expression became serious.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师听到坏消息后收起笑容、板起面孔；把这个名词记成“由和蔼转为严厉的变化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Training or practice undertaken to develop a skill or improve an ability.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为掌握技能或提高能力而进行的训练或练习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività ta' tagħlim jew prattika biex wieħed jiżviluppa ħila jew itejjeb il-kapaċitajiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 训练；为获得或提高技能而接受的系统指导与实践
练习；为巩固技能或锻炼能力而进行的活动

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema l-ġodda se jirċievu tħarriġ professjonali qabel jibdew jużaw it-tagħmir.
formal.en: The new employees will receive professional training before they begin using the equipment.
formal.zh: 新员工将在开始使用设备之前接受专业培训。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed tmur bil-kitarra? Pawlu: Aħjar! It-tħarriġ ta' kuljum qed jgħinni ndoqq b'aktar kunfidenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you getting on with the guitar? Pawlu: Better! Daily practice is helping me play more confidently.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的吉他学得怎么样？保罗：进步了！每天练习让我弹得更有信心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed tmur bil-kitarra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed tmur bil-kitarra?
messages.zh: 你的吉他学得怎么样？
messages.en: How are you getting on with the guitar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (吉他学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar! It-tħarriġ ta' kuljum qed jgħinni ndoqq b'aktar kunfidenza.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar! It-tħarriġ ta' kuljum qed jgħinni ndoqq b'aktar kunfidenza.
messages.zh: 进步了！每天练习让我弹得更有信心。
messages.en: Better! Daily practice is helping me play more confidently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每天拿起吉他练十分钟：有指导时是“训练”，自己反复做时是“练习”，都围绕能力提升。

gloss_zh: 呼吸带有喉间杂响；沉重地呼吸

teaching_sense.en_definition: To breathe with a rattling sound or to breathe heavily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼吸时发出喉间或胸中的杂响，或呼吸明显沉重、费力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tieħu n-nifs b'ħoss ta' ħarħir jew b'mod tqil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼吸带有杂响；呼吸时发出喉间或胸中的呼噜声。
沉重地呼吸；喘着粗气。

collocations.en: breathed with a rattling sound during sleep

formal.mt: Wara l-ġirja twila, l-atleta tħarħar għal ftit minuti qabel ma reġa' ħa n-nifs bil-kalma.
formal.en: After the long run, the athlete breathed heavily for a few minutes before breathing calmly again.
formal.zh: 长跑结束后，这名运动员喘了几分钟粗气，随后呼吸才恢复平稳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu tħarħar wara li tela' t-taraġ kollu. Rita: Iva, waqaf ftit biex jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu breathed heavily after climbing all those stairs. Rita: Yes, he stopped for a moment to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗爬完那些楼梯后直喘粗气。丽塔：是啊，他停下来休息了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu tħarħar wara li tela' t-taraġ kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu tħarħar wara li tela' t-taraġ kollu.
messages.zh: 保罗爬完那些楼梯后直喘粗气。
messages.en: Pawlu breathed heavily after climbing all those stairs.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waqaf ftit biex jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waqaf ftit biex jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，他停下来休息了一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, he stopped for a moment to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把爬楼后的粗重喘气和睡眠中的呼吸杂响连在一起，记住它描述呼吸的动作与状态。

gloss_zh: 粗重呼吸；临终喉鸣；猫的呼噜声

teaching_sense.en_definition: Heavy breathing, a death-rattle, or the purring sound made by a cat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指粗重的呼吸，也可指临终时的喉间杂响，或猫发出的呼噜声；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nifs tqil, ħoss fin-nifs ta' persuna li tkun qed tmut, jew il-ħoss li jagħmel qattus meta jkun kuntent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗重的呼吸；明显沉重或费力的喘息。
临终喉鸣；人在临终时随呼吸发出的喉间杂响。
猫发出的呼噜声。

formal.mt: Wara l-eżerċizzju, it-tħarħir tal-atleta kien jinstema' fil-kamra kwieta.
formal.en: After exercise, the athlete's heavy breathing could be heard in the quiet room.
formal.zh: 运动结束后，在安静的房间里可以听到这名运动员粗重的呼吸声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tisma' t-tħarħir tal-qattus? Pawlu: Iva, jidher kuntent ħafna fuq ħoġrok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear the cat purring? Pawlu: Yes, he looks very happy on your lap.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到猫的呼噜声了吗？保罗：听到了，它趴在你腿上，看起来很开心。

messages.speaker: Maja (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tisma' t-tħarħir tal-qattus?
messages.mt_standard: Tisma' t-tħarħir tal-qattus?
messages.zh: 你听到猫的呼噜声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the cat purring?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher kuntent ħafna fuq ħoġrok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher kuntent ħafna fuq ħoġrok.
messages.zh: 听到了，它趴在你腿上，看起来很开心。
messages.en: Yes, he looks very happy on your lap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景分别记：运动员喘粗气、临终者发出喉鸣、猫舒服地打呼噜；先看发声者再选词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel worried or anxious about something that may happen or has happened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因可能发生或已经发生的事情而担忧、感到焦虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss inkwiet jew ansjetà dwar xi ħaġa li tista' tiġri jew li diġà ġrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 担心；为某人或某事感到忧虑
感到焦虑；心神不安

formal.mt: Il-missier tħaseb meta bintu ma waslitx id-dar fil-ħin miftiehem.
formal.en: The father became worried when his daughter did not arrive home at the agreed time.
formal.zh: 女儿没有在约定时间到家，父亲因此担忧起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ċempillek Mark daqshekk drabi? Pawlu: Tħaseb għax ma weġibtx il-messaġġi tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark call you so many times? Pawlu: He got worried because I didn't answer his messages.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：马克为什么给你打了那么多次电话？保罗：因为我没回他的消息，他担心起来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ċempillek Mark daqshekk drabi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ċempillek Mark daqshekk drabi?
messages.zh: 马克为什么给你打了那么多次电话？
messages.en: Why did Mark call you so many times?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħaseb għax ma weġibtx il-messaġġi tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Tħaseb għax ma weġibtx il-messaġġi tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为我没回他的消息，他担心起来了。
messages.en: He got worried because I didn't answer his messages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“消息一直没回复，他担心起来”当作记忆画面；本词是动词，重点记人产生担忧的动作或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of worry or anxiety about a situation or an uncertain outcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对某种情况或不确定的结果时产生的忧虑、焦虑感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' inkwiet jew ansjetà dwar sitwazzjoni jew riżultat mhux ċert.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忧虑；对某人、某事或某种结果的担心
焦虑；紧张不安的感受

formal.mt: Id-dewmien fit-tħabbir tar-riżultati żied it-tħasib fost l-istudenti.
formal.en: The delay in announcing the results increased the worry among the students.
formal.zh: 成绩公布时间的推迟加重了学生们的忧虑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadni ma naf xejn dwar ix-xogħol il-ġdid, u dan qed iġibli ħafna tħasib. Mark: Nifhem. Forsi għada tasallek tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Maja: I still haven't heard anything about the new job, and it's causing me a lot of worry. Mark: I understand. Maybe you'll get an answer tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新工作的事我还是一点消息也没有，这让我很忧虑。马克：我理解。也许明天你就会收到答复。

messages.speaker: Maja (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma naf xejn dwar ix-xogħol il-ġdid, u dan qed iġibli ħafna tħasib.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma naf xejn dwar ix-xogħol il-ġdid, u dan qed iġibli ħafna tħasib.
messages.zh: 新工作的事我还是一点消息也没有，这让我很忧虑。
messages.en: I still haven't heard anything about the new job, and it's causing me a lot of worry.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhem. Forsi għada tasallek tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhem. Forsi għada tasallek tweġiba.
messages.zh: 我理解。也许明天你就会收到答复。
messages.en: I understand. Maybe you'll get an answer tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 与动词 tħaseb 配对记：一个表示“感到担心”，这个名词表示心里的“担忧、焦虑”本身。

gloss_zh: 腐烂；毁坏；作废；取消；怜悯某人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rot or become ruined; to be annulled or cancelled; or to feel pity for someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物等腐烂、事物毁坏、某项决定或安排作废或取消，也可指怜悯某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitmermer jew isir ħażin, jinqered, jiġi annullat jew ikkanċellat, jew iħoss ħasra għal xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐烂；因腐败而变质
被毁坏；变得不能使用或失去原有价值
被宣告无效；被废止或撤销
被取消；原定活动或安排不再进行
怜悯某人；对某人的不幸处境感到同情

collocations.en: he felt pity for the boy

formal.mt: Il-kunċert tħassar minħabba l-maltemp, u l-organizzaturi ħabbru li l-flus tal-biljetti se jingħataw lura.
formal.en: The concert was cancelled because of bad weather, and the organisers announced that ticket payments would be refunded.
formal.zh: 音乐会因恶劣天气取消，主办方宣布将退还票款。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' niekol dan it-tadam? Mark: Le, tħassar. Ħu minn dak frisk fil-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I eat these tomatoes? Mark: No, they've gone bad. Take some of the fresh ones in the fridge.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这些番茄还能吃吗？马克：不能，已经坏了。拿冰箱里那些新鲜的吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' niekol dan it-tadam?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' niekol dan it-tadam?
messages.zh: 这些番茄还能吃吗？
messages.en: Can I eat these tomatoes?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tħassar. Ħu minn dak frisk fil-friġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tħassar. Ħu minn dak frisk fil-friġġ.
messages.zh: 不能，已经坏了。拿冰箱里那些新鲜的吧。
messages.en: No, they've gone bad. Take some of the fresh ones in the fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按对象记五个场景：食物腐烂、物品毁坏、合同作废、活动取消；另把“怜悯某人”单独配一张同情他人的画面。

gloss_zh: 担忧；变得焦虑；反复思量

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel worried or become anxious about something, or to think something over carefully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某事担忧、变得焦虑，或对某事反复思考。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass inkwiet dwar xi ħaġa, sar anzjuż, jew qagħad jaħseb sew dwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 担心；为某事忧虑
变得焦虑；开始感到不安
反复思量某事；仔细考虑某事

formal.mt: Id-direttur tħasseb dwar l-ispejjeż tal-proġett u talab rapport aktar dettaljat qabel ma ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The director worried about the project's costs and requested a more detailed report before making a decision.
formal.zh: 主管担心项目的费用，要求先提交更详细的报告，再作决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu tħasseb daqshekk? Rita: Għax ibnu dam ma wasal id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu get so worried? Rita: Because his son was late getting home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么那么担心？丽塔：因为他儿子很晚还没到家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu tħasseb daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu tħasseb daqshekk?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么那么担心？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu get so worried?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ibnu dam ma wasal id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ibnu dam ma wasal id-dar.
messages.zh: 因为他儿子很晚还没到家。
messages.en: Because his son was late getting home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“消息迟迟不来，心里担忧；决定尚未作出，反复思量”的画面，串起担忧与思考两个用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be obtained or acquired, as a result of a request or effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物经过申请或努力而被取得、被获得。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie miksub wara talba jew sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被取得；被获得

collocations.en: the result was obtained through effort
collocations.zh: 这一结果是经过努力取得的

formal.mt: Il-permess tħassel wara li l-applikant ippreżenta d-dokumenti kollha meħtieġa lill-uffiċċju responsabbli.
formal.en: The permit was obtained after the applicant submitted all the required documents to the responsible office.
formal.zh: 申请人向主管办事处提交全部所需文件后，取得了许可证。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-permess tħassel? Lara: Iva, wasal dalgħodu u issa nistgħu nibdew.
colloquial.en: Mark: Was the permit obtained? Lara: Yes, it arrived this morning, and now we can start.
colloquial.zh: 马克：许可证拿到了吗？劳拉：拿到了，今天早上送到了，现在我们可以开始了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-permess tħassel?
messages.mt_standard: Il-permess tħassel?
messages.zh: 许可证拿到了吗？
messages.en: Was the permit obtained?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wasal dalgħodu u issa nistgħu nibdew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wasal dalgħodu u issa nistgħu nibdew.
messages.zh: 拿到了，今天早上送到了，现在我们可以开始了。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning, and now we can start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象申请表交上去后，许可证终于拿到手；用“东西被取得”的结果画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To seek out information, or to listen secretly to what other people are saying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过探听了解情况，或暗中听取别人的谈话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fittex li jsir jaf xi ħaġa, jew sema' bil-moħbi dak li kienu qed jgħidu oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 探知；打听到；弄清情况
偷听；暗中听取别人的谈话

formal.mt: Il-ġurnalist tħasses biex isir jaf għaliex il-laqgħa kienet ġiet posposta, iżda ma kiseb ebda tweġiba ċara.
formal.en: The journalist made inquiries to find out why the meeting had been postponed, but obtained no clear answer.
formal.zh: 记者探听会议推迟的原因，但没有得到明确答复。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Mark tħasses wara l-bieb? Ben: Ried jisma' x'kienu qed jgħidu ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Mark eavesdrop behind the door? Ben: He wanted to hear what they were saying inside.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克为什么在门后偷听？本：他想听听他们在里面说什么。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark tħasses wara l-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark tħasses wara l-bieb?
messages.zh: 马克为什么在门后偷听？
messages.en: Why did Mark eavesdrop behind the door?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jisma' x'kienu qed jgħidu ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jisma' x'kienu qed jgħidu ġewwa.
messages.zh: 他想听听他们在里面说什么。
messages.en: He wanted to hear what they were saying inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“想知道消息，就去探听；躲到门后听，就是偷听”的连续画面，区分两个相关义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of anxiety or worry about a problem, an uncertain situation, or something that may happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对问题、不确定的情况或可能发生的事情时产生的焦虑与担忧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' inkwiet jew ansjetà dwar problema, sitwazzjoni mhux ċerta, jew xi ħaġa li tista' tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焦虑；不安的情绪
担忧；忧虑

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jesprimi tħassib dwar iż-żieda fl-ispejjeż u jitlob miżuri biex jitnaqqas il-piż fuq il-familji.
formal.en: The report expresses concern about rising costs and calls for measures to reduce the burden on families.
formal.zh: 报告对费用上涨表示担忧，并呼吁采取措施减轻家庭负担。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi ħafna tħassib dwar l-eżami ta' għada. Luqa: Ejja nirrevedu flimkien illejla.
colloquial.en: Sara: I have a lot of anxiety about tomorrow's exam. Luqa: Let's revise together tonight.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我很担心明天的考试。卢卡：我们今晚一起复习吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna tħassib dwar l-eżami ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna tħassib dwar l-eżami ta' għada.
messages.zh: 我很担心明天的考试。
messages.en: I have a lot of anxiety about tomorrow's exam.

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nirrevedu flimkien illejla.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nirrevedu flimkien illejla.
messages.zh: 我们今晚一起复习吧。
messages.en: Let's revise together tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“考试前心里那团担忧”当作一个可以命名的东西；这个词是名词，表示焦虑或忧虑本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of obtaining something that is needed or sought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取得或获取所需、所求之物的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih tinkiseb xi ħaġa meħtieġa jew mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取得某物；获取某物的行为或过程

formal.mt: It-tħassil tal-permess huwa meħtieġ qabel il-bidu tax-xogħol, u l-applikazzjoni għandha tinkludi d-dokumenti kollha mitluba.
formal.en: Obtaining the permit is required before work begins, and the application must include all requested documents.
formal.zh: 开工前必须取得许可证，申请材料应包括所有要求提交的文件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tħassil tal-permess ħa ħafna żmien? Mark: Le, kellna kollox lest u rċevejnieh malajr.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did obtaining the permit take a long time? Mark: No, we had everything ready and received it quickly.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：取得许可证花了很长时间吗？马克：没有，我们把材料都准备好了，很快就收到了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tħassil tal-permess ħa ħafna żmien?
messages.mt_standard: It-tħassil tal-permess ħa ħafna żmien?
messages.zh: 取得许可证花了很长时间吗？
messages.en: Did obtaining the permit take a long time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kellna kollox lest u rċevejnieh malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kellna kollox lest u rċevejnieh malajr.
messages.zh: 没有，我们把材料都准备好了，很快就收到了。
messages.en: No, we had everything ready and received it quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“递交申请、等待处理、最终拿到”整段过程装进一个名词盒子，用来记住“获取这件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cancellation of something planned, the spoiling or decay of something, or a feeling of pity or grief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原定事项的取消、食物或牙齿等的腐坏，也可表示怜惜或悲伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-annullament ta' xi ħaġa ppjanata, il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titħassar, jew sens ta' ħasra jew niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取消；撤销原定安排

sense_translations.en_definition: spoiling or rotting (of food, teeth etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐坏；腐烂；食物变质或牙齿腐蚀等
怜惜；悲伤；哀痛

formal.mt: It-tħassir tal-laqgħa tħabbar permezz ta' avviż uffiċjali, u l-parteċipanti ntalbu jistennew data ġdida.
formal.en: The cancellation of the meeting was announced through an official notice, and participants were asked to await a new date.
formal.zh: 会议取消的消息通过正式通知发布，与会者被告知等待新的日期。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajt bit-tħassir tal-kunċert? Ġanni: Iva, bagħtuli messaġġ dalgħodu; se jagħtuna l-flus lura.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you heard about the concert's cancellation? Ġanni: Yes, they sent me a message this morning; they're going to refund us.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你听说演唱会取消了吗？詹尼：听说了，他们今天早上给我发了消息，会给我们退款。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt bit-tħassir tal-kunċert?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt bit-tħassir tal-kunċert?
messages.zh: 你听说演唱会取消了吗？
messages.en: Have you heard about the concert's cancellation?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bagħtuli messaġġ dalgħodu; se jagħtuna l-flus lura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bagħtuli messaġġ dalgħodu; se jagħtuna l-flus lura.
messages.zh: 听说了，他们今天早上给我发了消息，会给我们退款。
messages.en: Yes, they sent me a message this morning; they're going to refund us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张独立卡片记忆：日历上划掉会议表示取消，食物发坏表示腐坏，难过的表情表示怜惜或悲伤。

gloss_zh: 在地平线上聚集，尤指云层

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather on the horizon, especially when describing clouds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在地平线附近聚集，尤其用于描述云层的聚集。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inġabar fuq ix-xefaq, speċjalment meta jingħad dwar is-sħab.

sense_translations.en_definition: to gather on the horizon (used especially of cloud formations)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在地平线上聚集，尤指云团或云层

collocations.en: dark clouds gathered on the distant horizon

formal.mt: Lejn filgħaxija, sħab skur tħata fuq ix-xefaq, filwaqt li r-riħ beda jissaħħaħ tul il-kosta.
formal.en: Toward evening, dark clouds gathered on the horizon while the wind began to strengthen along the coast.
formal.zh: 临近傍晚，乌云在地平线上聚集，沿海的风也开始增强。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm tħata sħab fuq ix-xefaq! Pawlu: Iva, ejja mmorru lura qabel tibda x-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how many clouds have gathered on the horizon! Pawlu: Yes, let's head back before it starts raining.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，地平线上聚起了那么多云！保罗：是啊，我们趁还没下雨赶快回去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm tħata sħab fuq ix-xefaq!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm tħata sħab fuq ix-xefaq!
messages.zh: 看，地平线上聚起了那么多云！
messages.en: Look how many clouds have gathered on the horizon!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja mmorru lura qabel tibda x-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja mmorru lura qabel tibda x-xita.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们趁还没下雨赶快回去吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's head back before it starts raining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在海边，看远处天与海相接的线上云团慢慢聚拢；把“天际聚云”整幅画面与这个词绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be taken suddenly or forcibly from someone or somewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物从某人手中或某处被突然、强行夺走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie meħud minn xi ħadd jew minn xi post f'daqqa jew bil-forza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抢走；被突然夺去

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-basket tħataf minn id il-mara waqt li kienet qed tistenna l-karozza tal-linja.
formal.en: According to the report, the bag was snatched from the woman's hand while she was waiting for the bus.
formal.zh: 据报告，这名女子等公交车时，手里的包被抢走了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil Rita? Mark: Il-basket tagħha tħataf fit-triq, imma hi ma weġġgħetx.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to Rita? Mark: Her bag was snatched in the street, but she wasn't hurt.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：丽塔怎么了？马克：她的包在街上被抢走了，不过她没有受伤。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lil Rita?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lil Rita?
messages.zh: 丽塔怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Rita?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-basket tagħha tħataf fit-triq, imma hi ma weġġgħetx.
messages.mt_standard: Il-basket tagħha tħataf fit-triq, imma hi ma weġġgħetx.
messages.zh: 她的包在街上被抢走了，不过她没有受伤。
messages.en: Her bag was snatched in the street, but she wasn't hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里的包突然被别人一把夺走；让注意力落在“包被抢走”的遭遇上，记住这个动词的被动含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become related to a family through marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过结婚与某个家庭建立姻亲关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir qarib ta' familja permezz taż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to marry and become related to a family
sense_translations.zh_definition: 结婚并因此与某个家庭成为亲戚。

collocations.en: became related to another family through marriage
collocations.zh: 通过婚姻与另一家庭结亲

collocations.en: became related to our family through marriage

formal.mt: Meta Pawlu żżewweġ lil Marija, tħaten mal-familja tagħha.
formal.en: When Pawlu married Marija, he became related to her family through marriage.
formal.zh: 保罗与玛丽亚结婚后，便与她的家人建立了姻亲关系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu jiġi minnkom? Rita: Iva, tħaten magħna meta żżewweġ lil oħti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Pawlu related to your family? Rita: Yes, he became related to us when he married my sister.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗是你们家的亲戚吗？丽塔：是的，他娶了我姐姐，就与我们家结亲了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu jiġi minnkom?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu jiġi minnkom?
messages.zh: 保罗是你们家的亲戚吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu related to your family?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tħaten magħna meta żżewweġ lil oħti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tħaten magħna meta żżewweġ lil oħti.
messages.zh: 是的，他娶了我姐姐，就与我们家结亲了。
messages.en: Yes, he became related to us when he married my sister.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把婚礼想成两家亲属合影：tħaten 强调结婚之后，两家由此结亲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To risk money or something else on the outcome of an uncertain event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 就尚未确定的结果打赌，押上金钱或其他赌注。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilgħab flus jew xi ħaġa oħra fuq ir-riżultat ta' ġrajja mhux ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打赌；就某个结果下注。

collocations.en: bet on the result of the game

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li r-raġel tħater għaxar ewro fuq ir-riżultat tal-logħba.
formal.en: The report states that the man bet ten euros on the result of the game.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该男子就比赛结果押了十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark tħater fuq il-logħba? Lara: Iva, imma ħames ewro biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark bet on the game? Lara: Yes, but only five euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克就这场比赛下注了吗？拉拉：下了，不过只有五欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark tħater fuq il-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Mark tħater fuq il-logħba?
messages.zh: 马克就这场比赛下注了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark bet on the game?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ħames ewro biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ħames ewro biss.
messages.zh: 下了，不过只有五欧元。
messages.en: Yes, but only five euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象比赛开始前把硬币放在预测结果旁：tħater 表示做出下注这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of snatching something away or kidnapping a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品被突然抢走的事件，或将人绑架的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li fih xi ħaġa tittieħed bil-ħeffa jew persuna tittieħed bil-forza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被突然抢走、夺走的过程或事件。
绑架他人的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn it-tħatif ta' oġġett u t-tħatif ta' persuna.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between the snatching of an object and the kidnapping of a person.
formal.zh: 报告区分了物品被抢夺与人员被绑架这两类事件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din l-aħbar dwar it-tħatif ta' persuna? Mark: Le, dwar it-tħatif ta' borża minn fuq mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this news story about a kidnapping? Mark: No, it is about a bag being snatched from a table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条新闻讲的是绑架案吗？马克：不是，是一个包从桌上被抢走的事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-aħbar dwar it-tħatif ta' persuna?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-aħbar dwar it-tħatif ta' persuna?
messages.zh: 这条新闻讲的是绑架案吗？
messages.en: Is this news story about a kidnapping?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dwar it-tħatif ta' borża minn fuq mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dwar it-tħatif ta' borża minn fuq mejda.
messages.zh: 不是，是一个包从桌上被抢走的事。
messages.en: No, it is about a bag being snatched from a table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记义：包突然被夺走、人员被绑走；看到 tħatif 要结合对象判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family relationship established through marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由婚姻建立的亲属关系，即姻亲关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta ta' qrubija bejn persuni jew familji li tinħoloq permezz taż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过婚姻获得的亲属关系；姻亲关系。

collocations.en: a bond of kinship through marriage

collocations.zh: 通过婚姻相联系的家庭

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi r-rabta ta' tħatin bejn iż-żewġ familji.
formal.en: The document describes the relationship through marriage between the two families.
formal.zh: 该文件描述了这两个家庭之间的姻亲关系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif intom qraba tal-familja ta' Mark? Rita: Bit-tħatin; ħija żżewweġ lil oħtu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How are you related to Mark's family? Rita: Through marriage; my brother married his sister.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们和马克家是什么亲戚关系？丽塔：姻亲关系，我哥哥娶了他姐姐。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif intom qraba tal-familja ta' Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Kif intom qraba tal-familja ta' Mark?
messages.zh: 你们和马克家是什么亲戚关系？
messages.en: How are you related to Mark's family?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-tħatin; ħija żżewweġ lil oħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-tħatin; ħija żżewweġ lil oħtu.
messages.zh: 姻亲关系，我哥哥娶了他姐姐。
messages.en: Through marriage; my brother married his sister.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两张家谱用婚戒连起来：连接形成的姻亲关系叫 tħatin，可与表示结亲动作的 tħaten 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of placing bets or gambling on uncertain outcomes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对不确定的结果下注的活动，也指赌博。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha jintlagħbu flus jew affarijiet oħra fuq riżultati mhux ċerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下注；就某个结果押注的活动。
赌博；以金钱或其他财物作赌注的活动。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza t-tħatir fuq il-logħob tal-futbol u l-effetti tiegħu fuq il-baġit tal-familja.
formal.en: The study analyses betting on football matches and its effects on the family budget.
formal.zh: 该研究分析了足球比赛下注活动及其对家庭预算的影响。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tħobb it-tħatir fuq il-futbol? Pawlu: Le, nieħu gost nara l-logħba mingħajr ma nilgħab flus.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you like betting on football? Pawlu: No, I enjoy watching the game without betting money.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你喜欢赌球吗？保罗：不喜欢，我喜欢看比赛，不押钱也很开心。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħobb it-tħatir fuq il-futbol?
messages.mt_standard: Tħobb it-tħatir fuq il-futbol?
messages.zh: 你喜欢赌球吗？
messages.en: Do you like betting on football?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nieħu gost nara l-logħba mingħajr ma nilgħab flus.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nieħu gost nara l-logħba mingħajr ma nilgħab flus.
messages.zh: 不喜欢，我喜欢看比赛，不押钱也很开心。
messages.en: No, I enjoy watching the game without betting money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把下注动作定格成一项活动：tħater 是打赌的动词，tħatir 是下注或赌博的名词。

gloss_zh: 变得具有木质纹理或质地；木质化

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a woody texture or become wood-like in consistency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地逐渐变得像木头，具有木质的硬度或结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikseb konsistenza jew struttura bħal dik tal-injam.

sense_translations.en_definition: to acquire the texture of wood
sense_translations.zh_definition: 获得木头般的质地；变得木质化。

collocations.zh: 随时间推移变得木质化

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ġie nnutat li z-zokk tħattab u sar aktar iebes.
formal.en: During the observation, it was noted that the stem had become woody and harder.
formal.zh: 观察中发现，茎已变得木质化，质地也更硬了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan iz-zokk sar daqshekk iebes? Lara: Tħattab maż-żmien; issa għandu konsistenza bħal tal-injam.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has this stem become so hard? Lara: It became woody over time; now it has a wood-like texture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这根茎怎么变得这么硬？拉拉：它慢慢木质化了，现在质地像木头一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan iz-zokk sar daqshekk iebes?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan iz-zokk sar daqshekk iebes?
messages.zh: 这根茎怎么变得这么硬？
messages.en: Why has this stem become so hard?

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħattab maż-żmien; issa għandu konsistenza bħal tal-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Tħattab maż-żmien; issa għandu konsistenza bħal tal-injam.
messages.zh: 它慢慢木质化了，现在质地像木头一样。
messages.en: It became woody over time; now it has a wood-like texture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根柔嫩的茎逐渐变硬、摸起来像木头，用这个质地变化画面记住 tħattab。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be closed or secured with a seal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被封住，或以封印、封蜡等加以封缄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħalaq jew jiġi assigurat b'siġill.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被封上；被加封或封缄。

formal.mt: L-envelop bid-dokument tħattam bix-xama' qabel intbagħat lir-riċevitur.
formal.en: The envelope containing the document was sealed with wax before being sent to the recipient.
formal.zh: 装有文件的信封先用封蜡封好，随后才寄给收件人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-envelop lest biex jintbagħat? Mark: Iva, tħattam diġà; jonqsu biss il-bolla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the envelope ready to be sent? Mark: Yes, it has already been sealed; it only needs a stamp.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：信封准备好寄出了吗？马克：好了，已经封上了，只差一张邮票。

messages.speaker: Maja (办公室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-envelop lest biex jintbagħat?
messages.mt_standard: L-envelop lest biex jintbagħat?
messages.zh: 信封准备好寄出了吗？
messages.en: Is the envelope ready to be sent?

messages.speaker: Mark (办公室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tħattam diġà; jonqsu biss il-bolla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tħattam diġà; jonqsu biss il-bolla.
messages.zh: 好了，已经封上了，只差一张邮票。
messages.en: Yes, it has already been sealed; it only needs a stamp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象信封封口盖着一块完整封蜡：tħattam 表示信封被封好的动作或结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be struck or beaten with a stick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遭到他人用棍子击打或殴打。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissawwat b'bastun.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be beaten with a stick
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人用棍棒殴打。

collocations.en: was beaten with a stick during an attack
collocations.zh: 在袭击中遭到棍棒殴打

formal.mt: Skont ix-xhieda, ir-raġel tħattar waqt l-attakk u wara ngħata kura fl-isptar.
formal.en: According to the testimony, the man was beaten with a stick during the attack and later received hospital treatment.
formal.zh: 根据证词，该男子在袭击中遭到棍棒殴打，随后在医院接受了治疗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil Pawlu? Mark: Tħattar b'bastun, imma issa qiegħed l-isptar u qed jieħu l-kura.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to Pawlu? Mark: He was beaten with a stick, but he is in hospital now and receiving treatment.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗怎么了？马克：他被人用棍子打了，不过现在已经在医院接受治疗。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lil Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lil Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħattar b'bastun, imma issa qiegħed l-isptar u qed jieħu l-kura.
messages.mt_standard: Tħattar b'bastun, imma issa qiegħed l-isptar u qed jieħu l-kura.
messages.zh: 他被人用棍子打了，不过现在已经在医院接受治疗。
messages.en: He was beaten with a stick, but he is in hospital now and receiving treatment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħattar 与 b'bastun（用棍子）一起记，注意句中主语是遭受棍棒殴打的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become bent or develop a hunched posture, especially in the back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得弯曲，或背部逐渐弯下，呈现弓背的姿态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgħawweġ jew jieħu qagħda b'dahru mgħawweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变弯；变得弯曲。
变得弓背；背部弯下。

collocations.zh: 他随着年纪增长而变得弓背

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, dahar ix-xwejjaħ tħatteb bil-mod matul is-snin.
formal.en: In the story, the old man's back gradually became bent over the years.
formal.zh: 在故事中，老人的背随着岁月流逝逐渐弯了下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-nannu jidher aktar mgħawweġ minn qabel. Mark: Iva, dahru tħatteb xi ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Grandpa looks more stooped than before. Mark: Yes, his back has become a little bent.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：爷爷看起来比以前更弓背了。马克：是啊，他的背有点弯下来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu jidher aktar mgħawweġ minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu jidher aktar mgħawweġ minn qabel.
messages.zh: 爷爷看起来比以前更弓背了。
messages.en: Grandpa looks more stooped than before.

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dahru tħatteb xi ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dahru tħatteb xi ftit.
messages.zh: 是啊，他的背有点弯下来了。
messages.en: Yes, his back has become a little bent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把背部由直变弯的连续画面与 tħatteb 联系起来：重点记住“变弯、变得弓背”这个变化过程。

gloss_zh: 受割礼；因婚姻加入一个家庭

teaching_sense.en_definition: To undergo circumcision, or to become a member of a family through marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受割礼；也可指通过婚姻成为某个家庭的一员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi ċirkonċiż, jew isir membru ta' familja permezz taż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受割礼；接受包皮环切。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become a member of a family by dint of marriage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因婚姻而成为一个家庭的成员。

collocations.en: he underwent circumcision during a ceremony
collocations.zh: 他在仪式中接受了割礼

collocations.en: he became part of the family through marriage
collocations.zh: 他因婚姻成为了这个家庭的一员

formal.mt: Id-dokument jirreġistra li r-raġel tħatten waqt ċerimonja.
formal.en: The document records that the man underwent circumcision during a ceremony.
formal.zh: 这份文件记载，该男子在一次仪式中接受了割礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sar parti mill-familja tagħkom? Mark: Meta żżewweġ lil oħti, tħatten fil-familja tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he become part of your family? Mark: When he married my sister, he joined our family through marriage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他是怎么成为你们家一员的？马克：他娶了我姐姐，就通过婚姻加入了我们家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sar parti mill-familja tagħkom?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sar parti mill-familja tagħkom?
messages.zh: 他是怎么成为你们家一员的？
messages.en: How did he become part of your family?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta żżewweġ lil oħti, tħatten fil-familja tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Meta żżewweġ lil oħti, tħatten fil-familja tagħna.
messages.zh: 他娶了我姐姐，就通过婚姻加入了我们家。
messages.en: When he married my sister, he joined our family through marriage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tħatten 分设两张记忆卡：“接受割礼”和“因婚姻入家”；遇到例句时先判断属于哪一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be drawn, as a line or outline is put onto a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被画出，指线条或轮廓被绘到某个表面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mpinġi fuq wiċċ, bħal linja jew kontorn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被画出；被绘出。

collocations.en: it was drawn on the paper

formal.mt: Il-kontorn tħattet bil-lapes fuq il-karta qabel ma żdied il-kulur.
formal.en: The outline was drawn in pencil on the paper before the colour was added.
formal.zh: 上色之前，先用铅笔在纸上画出了轮廓。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kontorn tħattet bil-pinna? Mark: Le, tħattet bil-lapes, allura nistgħu nħassruh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this outline drawn in pen? Mark: No, it was drawn in pencil, so we can erase it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个轮廓是用钢笔画的吗？马克：不是，是用铅笔画的，所以可以擦掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kontorn tħattet bil-pinna?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kontorn tħattet bil-pinna?
messages.zh: 这个轮廓是用钢笔画的吗？
messages.en: Was this outline drawn in pen?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tħattet bil-lapes, allura nistgħu nħassruh.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tħattet bil-lapes, allura nistgħu nħassruh.
messages.zh: 不是，是用铅笔画的，所以可以擦掉。
messages.en: No, it was drawn in pencil, so we can erase it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象纸上的轮廓已经被画出来，用 tħattet 给这个结果配字幕；记忆焦点放在“被画出”。

gloss_zh: 木质般的僵硬；弯腰或变成驼背的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wood-like stiffness, or the process of becoming bent over or hunch-backed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 木质般僵硬的状态；也指身体逐渐弯下或形成驼背的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ebusija bħal dik tal-injam, jew il-proċess li wieħed jitgħawweġ jew isir ħotbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木质般的僵硬；不灵活的状态。
身体逐渐弯下；变成弯腰姿态的过程。
逐渐形成驼背的过程。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi t-tħattib gradwali tad-dahar tal-karattru hekk kif jgħaddu s-snin.
formal.en: The author describes the gradual bending of the character's back as the years pass.
formal.zh: 作者描写了随着岁月流逝，人物的背部逐渐弯曲的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiddeskrivi t-tħattib f'din is-silta? Mark: Il-bidla fid-dahar tiegħu; sar dejjem aktar mgħawweġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tħattib describe in this passage? Mark: The change in his back; it became more and more bent.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这段文字中的 tħattib 描写的是什么？马克：他背部的变化，变得越来越弯了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiddeskrivi t-tħattib f'din is-silta?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiddeskrivi t-tħattib f'din is-silta?
messages.zh: 这段文字中的 tħattib 描写的是什么？
messages.en: What does tħattib describe in this passage?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bidla fid-dahar tiegħu; sar dejjem aktar mgħawweġ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bidla fid-dahar tiegħu; sar dejjem aktar mgħawweġ.
messages.zh: 他背部的变化，变得越来越弯了。
messages.en: The change in his back; it became more and more bent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tħattib 配三格画面：像木头般僵硬、身体弯下、背部成驼；把它当作状态或过程的名称来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of sealing something, such as closing a letter with a seal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将物件封缄或加封的行为，例如给信件加上封印。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għeluq jew l-immarkar ta' xi ħaġa b'siġill, bħal ittra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封缄；加封；施加封印的行为。

formal.mt: Il-wirja turi l-għodod li kienu jintużaw għat-tħattim tal-ittri bix-xama'.
formal.en: The exhibition displays the tools that were used for sealing letters with wax.
formal.zh: 展览展示了过去用于给信件加盖蜡封的工具。

colloquial.en: Maja: What is this wax for? Mark: For sealing the letter; I'm going to close it with a seal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些蜡是做什么用的？马克：用来封信，我要给它加上封印。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ix-xama' għal xiex hi?
messages.mt_standard: Din ix-xama' għal xiex hi?
messages.zh: 这些蜡是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this wax for?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tħattim tal-ittra; se nagħlaqha b'siġill.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tħattim tal-ittra; se nagħlaqha b'siġill.
messages.zh: 用来封信，我要给它加上封印。
messages.en: For sealing the letter; I'm going to close it with a seal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把蜡滴在信封口，再压下封印；给整个封缄动作贴上 tħattim 的标签，连同“信件加封”一起记。

gloss_zh: 割礼；因婚姻形成的亲属关系

teaching_sense.en_definition: Circumcision, or family relationships established through marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 割礼这一行为；也指由婚姻建立起来的亲属关系，即姻亲关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċ-ċirkonċiżjoni, jew ir-rabtiet ta' familja li jinħolqu permezz taż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 割礼；包皮环切。

sense_translations.en_definition: family relationships acquired by dint of marriage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因婚姻而获得的亲属关系；姻亲关系。

collocations.zh: 因婚姻形成的亲属纽带

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi ċ-ċerimonja tat-tħattin u l-parteċipazzjoni tal-familja fiha.
formal.en: The chapter describes the circumcision ceremony and the family's participation in it.
formal.zh: 这一章描写了割礼仪式以及家人参与仪式的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn ir-rabtiet bejn il-familji ġew miż-żwieġ? Mark: Iva, huma rabtiet ta' tħattin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did these ties between the families come about through marriage? Mark: Yes, they are family ties through marriage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些家庭之间的关系是通过婚姻建立的吗？马克：是的，属于姻亲关系。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn ir-rabtiet bejn il-familji ġew miż-żwieġ?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn ir-rabtiet bejn il-familji ġew miż-żwieġ?
messages.zh: 这些家庭之间的关系是通过婚姻建立的吗？
messages.en: Did these ties between the families come about through marriage?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma rabtiet ta' tħattin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma rabtiet ta' tħattin.
messages.zh: 是的，属于姻亲关系。
messages.en: Yes, they are family ties through marriage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħattin 放进两个名词抽屉：“割礼”和“姻亲关系”；用仪式场景与家庭关系图分别帮助回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The experience of being beaten with a cudgel or stick; in another sense, gambling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遭到短粗棍棒或其他棍子殴打的经历；另一个义项是赌博。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed jissawwat b'ħatar jew b'bastun; f'sens ieħor, il-logħob tal-azzard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭到短粗棍棒殴打。
被棍子打；遭受棍打。
赌博；以财物下注的活动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tħattir tal-vittma b'bastun.
formal.en: The report describes the victim being beaten with a stick.
formal.zh: 报告描述了受害者遭棍打的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tonfoq flusek fit-tħattir? Mark: Le, nippreferi nfaddalhom għal xi ħaġa li għandi bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to spend your money on gambling? Mark: No, I'd rather save it for something I need.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你打算把钱花在赌博上吗？马克：不，我更愿意存起来买需要的东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tonfoq flusek fit-tħattir?
messages.mt_standard: Se tonfoq flusek fit-tħattir?
messages.zh: 你打算把钱花在赌博上吗？
messages.en: Are you going to spend your money on gambling?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nippreferi nfaddalhom għal xi ħaġa li għandi bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nippreferi nfaddalhom għal xi ħaġa li għandi bżonn.
messages.zh: 不，我更愿意存起来买需要的东西。
messages.en: No, I'd rather save it for something I need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tħattir 分别画“挨棍打”和“下注赌博”两张卡；读到棍子或赌资线索时，再选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of drawing lines on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在纸张等表面上绘制线条的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li wieħed ipinġi linji fuq wiċċ, bħal karta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 画线；绘制线条的行为。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jibda bit-tħattit ta' linji dritti u paralleli fuq il-karta.
formal.en: The exercise begins with drawing straight, parallel lines on the paper.
formal.zh: 练习从在纸上绘制笔直且互相平行的线条开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi bżonn riga għal dan it-tħattit? Mark: Iva, biex il-linji joħorġu dritti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I need a ruler for this line drawing? Mark: Yes, so the lines come out straight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：画这些线需要尺子吗？马克：需要，这样线才能画直。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn riga għal dan it-tħattit?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn riga għal dan it-tħattit?
messages.zh: 画这些线需要尺子吗？
messages.en: Do I need a ruler for this line drawing?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biex il-linji joħorġu dritti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biex il-linji joħorġu dritti.
messages.zh: 需要，这样线才能画直。
messages.en: Yes, so the lines come out straight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象铅笔沿着尺子一条条画线，把整项画线活动叫作 tħattit；重点记住它是活动名称这一名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given food by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由别人喂食，得到他人提供的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata l-ikel minn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喂食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħata l-ikel.

formal.mt: Il-fellus tħawsel bl-idejn mill-voluntier.
formal.en: The chick was fed by hand by the volunteer.
formal.zh: 那只小鸡由志愿者用手喂食。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-fellus tħawsel diġà? Luka: Iva, tħawsel bl-idejn dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has the chick been fed yet? Luka: Yes, it was fed by hand this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：小鸡已经喂过了吗？卢卡：喂过了，今天早上用手喂的。

messages.speaker: Marta (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fellus tħawsel diġà?
messages.mt_standard: Il-fellus tħawsel diġà?
messages.zh: 小鸡已经喂过了吗？
messages.en: Has the chick been fed yet?

messages.speaker: Luka (饲养员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tħawsel bl-idejn dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tħawsel bl-idejn dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 喂过了，今天早上用手喂的。
messages.en: Yes, it was fed by hand this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħawsel 和小鸡张嘴接受喂食的画面绑定，记住主语是接受食物的一方。

gloss_zh: 津津有味地吃；大快朵颐

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of eating eagerly and with great enjoyment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 兴致勃勃、十分满足地进食这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiekol b'aptit kbir u b'gost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 津津有味、胃口十足地吃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel b'aptit kbir u b'gost.

collocations.en: eating with gusto at the table
collocations.zh: 在餐桌旁津津有味地吃

formal.mt: It-tħawsil tat-tfal waqt l-ikla wera kemm għoġbithom is-soppa.
formal.en: The children's enthusiastic eating during the meal showed how much they liked the soup.
formal.zh: 孩子们吃饭时津津有味的样子，表明他们十分喜欢这道汤。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tħawsil hemm mal-mejda llum! Mark: Wara dik il-mixja kollha, kulħadd għandu aptit kbir.
colloquial.en: Nina: Everyone's really tucking in at the table today! Mark: After all that walking, everyone has a huge appetite.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今天大家在餐桌旁吃得真香！马克：走了那么多路，大家胃口都特别好。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tħawsil hemm mal-mejda llum!
messages.mt_standard: X'tħawsil hemm mal-mejda llum!
messages.zh: 今天大家在餐桌旁吃得真香！
messages.en: Everyone's really tucking in at the table today!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dik il-mixja kollha, kulħadd għandu aptit kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Wara dik il-mixja kollha, kulħadd għandu aptit kbir.
messages.zh: 走了那么多路，大家胃口都特别好。
messages.en: After all that walking, everyone has a huge appetite.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走完长路后围桌吃得津津有味，用 tħawsil 记住整个吃得很香的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Diligent work or the effort put into completing a task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认真勤奋地做事的态度，或完成任务所付出的努力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bżulija fix-xogħol jew l-isforz biex jitwettaq kompitu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤勉；认真而持续地投入工作的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bżulija u ħidma bir-reqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 努力；为完成某事所付出的精力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sforz biex tinkiseb xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: It-tħawtil tal-ħaddiema għen biex il-proġett jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: The workers' diligence helped the project to be completed on time.
formal.zh: 工人们的勤勉使项目得以按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ġnien jitlob ħafna tħawtil. Pawlu: Veru, imma ftit xogħol kuljum jagħmel differenza.
colloquial.en: Sara: This garden takes a lot of effort. Pawlu: True, but a little work every day makes a difference.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：打理这个花园需要花很多功夫。保罗：确实，不过每天做一点就会有变化。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ġnien jitlob ħafna tħawtil.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ġnien jitlob ħafna tħawtil.
messages.zh: 打理这个花园需要花很多功夫。
messages.en: This garden takes a lot of effort.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, imma ftit xogħol kuljum jagħmel differenza.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, imma ftit xogħol kuljum jagħmel differenza.
messages.zh: 确实，不过每天做一点就会有变化。
messages.en: True, but a little work every day makes a difference.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用每天认真打理花园的画面记 tħawtil：坚持做事体现勤勉，投入精力就是努力。

gloss_zh: 被搅动；被混合；感到困惑

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stirred or mixed, or to become confused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到搅动或混合；也指一个人变得困惑、弄不清楚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mċaqlaq b'mgħarfa jew jitħallat ma' xi ħaġa oħra; jista' wkoll ifisser li wieħed ma jibqax jifhem ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被搅动；受到搅拌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiġi mċaqlaq, pereżempju b'mgħarfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被混合；与其他东西混在一起。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitħallat ma' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到困惑；变得糊涂。
