sense_translations.mt_definition: Wieħed ma jibqax jifhem ċar.

formal.mt: Il-kafè tħawwad b'mgħarfa sakemm iz-zokkor inħall.
formal.en: The coffee was stirred with a spoon until the sugar dissolved.
formal.zh: 咖啡被用勺子搅动，直到糖溶解。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark tħawwad bl-istruzzjonijiet il-ġodda. Lara: Ejja nispjegawhomlu pass pass.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark got confused by the new instructions. Lara: Let's explain them to him step by step.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克被新说明弄糊涂了。拉拉：我们一步一步给他解释吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark tħawwad bl-istruzzjonijiet il-ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Mark tħawwad bl-istruzzjonijiet il-ġodda.
messages.zh: 马克被新说明弄糊涂了。
messages.en: Mark got confused by the new instructions.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nispjegawhomlu pass pass.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nispjegawhomlu pass pass.
messages.zh: 我们一步一步给他解释吧。
messages.en: Let's explain them to him step by step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象咖啡被搅动、配料被混合、人被说明弄糊涂，借三个场景记住 tħawwad 的三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have spices or seasonings added to improve or strengthen the flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被加入香料或调味料，使味道更丰富或更浓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdiedulu ħwawar biex it-togħma tkun aktar qawwija jew aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加入香料调味，使滋味更丰富。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiżdiedulu ħwawar biex jagħtuh aktar togħma.

formal.mt: L-istuffat tħawwar bil-kemmun qabel ma ġie servut.
formal.en: The stew was spiced with cumin before it was served.
formal.zh: 炖菜在上桌前加入了孜然调味。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan ir-ross tħawwar bil-bżar? Rita: Iva, imma ftit biss.
colloquial.en: Mark: Was this rice seasoned with pepper? Rita: Yes, but only a little.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这米饭加了胡椒调味吗？丽塔：加了，不过只有一点。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-ross tħawwar bil-bżar?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-ross tħawwar bil-bżar?
messages.zh: 这米饭加了胡椒调味吗？
messages.en: Was this rice seasoned with pepper?

messages.speaker: Rita (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ftit biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ftit biss.
messages.zh: 加了，不过只有一点。
messages.en: Yes, but only a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象炖菜上桌前撒入孜然，把 tħawwar 记成食物接受香料调味后的状态变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frightened, or to lose body weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到惊吓而害怕；另一个义项是体重减轻、变瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibża' minħabba xi ħaġa; f'tifsira oħra, jonqos fil-piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到惊吓；感到害怕。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibża' minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重减轻；变瘦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jonqos fil-piż.

collocations.zh: 经过饮食控制后体重减轻了

formal.mt: Pawlu tħawwef wara xahar ta' dieta.
formal.en: Pawlu lost weight after a month of dieting.
formal.zh: 保罗经过一个月的饮食控制后体重减轻了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tifel tħawwef bil-ħoss tal-bieb. Nina: Mur ħdejh u għidlu li kollox sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: The boy was scared by the sound of the door. Nina: Go over to him and tell him everything is all right.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那男孩被门的声响吓到了。妮娜：去他身边，告诉他一切都好。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel tħawwef bil-ħoss tal-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel tħawwef bil-ħoss tal-bieb.
messages.zh: 那男孩被门的声响吓到了。
messages.en: The boy was scared by the sound of the door.

messages.speaker: Nina (亲属)
messages.mt_spoken: Mur ħdejh u għidlu li kollox sew.
messages.mt_standard: Mur ħdejh u għidlu li kollox sew.
messages.zh: 去他身边，告诉他一切都好。
messages.en: Go over to him and tell him everything is all right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tħawwef 分别画两张记忆卡：一张是被响声吓到，一张是体重秤数字下降；按语境区分两义。

gloss_zh: 被种植；因碰撞或跌落而被困

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be planted in the ground, or to become trapped as a result of a crash or fall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被栽种到土中；也指因碰撞事故或跌落而陷入受困状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed fl-art biex jikber; f'tifsira oħra, jispiċċa maqbud wara ħabta jew waqgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被种植；被栽入土中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed fl-art biex jikber.

sense_translations.en_definition: to find oneself trapped as a result of a crash or a fall (e.g. after a car crash)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因碰撞事故或跌落而发现自己被困，例如车祸后被困。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jispiċċa maqbud minħabba ħabta jew waqgħa, pereżempju wara ħabta bil-karozza.

collocations.en: became trapped in the car after a crash
collocations.zh: 发生碰撞后被困在车内

formal.mt: Ix-xufier tħawwel fil-karozza wara l-ħabta u nħeles mill-ħaddiema tas-salvataġġ.
formal.en: The driver became trapped in the car after the crash and was freed by rescue workers.
formal.zh: 司机在碰撞后被困车内，随后获救援人员救出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-lumi meta tħawwel fil-ġnien? Toni: Is-sena l-oħra, ħdejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: When was this lemon tree planted in the garden? Toni: Last year, beside the wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这棵柠檬树是什么时候种在花园里的？托尼：去年，种在墙边。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-lumi meta tħawwel fil-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-lumi meta tħawwel fil-ġnien?
messages.zh: 这棵柠檬树是什么时候种在花园里的？
messages.en: When was this lemon tree planted in the garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sena l-oħra, ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sena l-oħra, ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 去年，种在墙边。
messages.en: Last year, beside the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用花园栽树和事故后受困两个独立场景记 tħawwel；看到植物或事故语境时分别提取对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of mixing substances or ingredients together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把不同物质或配料搅拌、混合在一起的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih sustanzi jew ingredjenti jitħalltu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混合；将物质或配料混在一起的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħlit ta' sustanzi jew ingredjenti flimkien.

formal.mt: It-tħawwid tal-ingredjenti għandu jsir bil-mod sakemm it-taħlita tkun lixxa.
formal.en: The ingredients should be mixed slowly until the mixture is smooth.
formal.zh: 应缓慢搅拌配料，直到混合物变得细腻均匀。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tħawwid nagħmlu b'mgħarfa jew bil-mixer? Mark: B'mgħarfa; din it-taħlita trid titħawwad bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we do the mixing with a spoon or a mixer? Mark: With a spoon; this mixture needs to be mixed slowly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们用勺子还是搅拌机来搅拌？马克：用勺子吧，这份混合物需要慢慢搅拌。

messages.speaker: Sara (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tħawwid nagħmlu b'mgħarfa jew bil-mixer?
messages.mt_standard: It-tħawwid nagħmlu b'mgħarfa jew bil-mixer?
messages.zh: 我们用勺子还是搅拌机来搅拌？
messages.en: Shall we do the mixing with a spoon or a mixer?

messages.speaker: Mark (烹饪老师)
messages.mt_spoken: B'mgħarfa; din it-taħlita trid titħawwad bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: B'mgħarfa; din it-taħlita trid titħawwad bil-mod.
messages.zh: 用勺子吧，这份混合物需要慢慢搅拌。
messages.en: With a spoon; this mixture needs to be mixed slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象勺子把碗里的配料慢慢混匀，用 tħawwid 给整个搅拌过程命名，记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decrease in body weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体重下降或减轻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-piż tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重减轻；体重下降。

formal.mt: It-tabella turi tħawwif gradwali matul it-tliet xhur.
formal.en: The chart shows gradual weight loss over the three months.
formal.zh: 图表显示，这三个月内体重逐渐下降。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kien hemm xi bidla fil-piż tiegħek? Mark: Iva, kien hemm tħawwif żgħir dan ix-xahar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has there been any change in your weight? Mark: Yes, there has been a small loss of weight this month.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的体重有什么变化吗？马克：有，这个月体重下降了一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm xi bidla fil-piż tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm xi bidla fil-piż tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的体重有什么变化吗？
messages.en: Has there been any change in your weight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien hemm tħawwif żgħir dan ix-xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien hemm tħawwif żgħir dan ix-xahar.
messages.zh: 有，这个月体重下降了一点。
messages.en: Yes, there has been a small loss of weight this month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和体重秤上逐渐下降的数字一起记，表示体重减轻这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The addition of ingredients to give food flavour, especially spices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为增添食物风味而加入调味料的过程，尤其指加入香料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żieda ta' ingredjenti biex l-ikel jingħata togħma, speċjalment ħwawar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 调味；使食物增添风味。
给食物加入香料，使其更有滋味。

formal.mt: It-tħawwir tal-laħam isir qabel it-tisjir, billi jiżdiedu l-melħ, il-bżar u l-ħwawar.
formal.en: The meat is seasoned before cooking by adding salt, pepper and spices.
formal.zh: 肉在烹饪前用盐、胡椒和香料调味。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif inhu t-tħawwir tas-soppa? Pawlu: Tajjeb ħafna, imma żid ftit bżar.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is the seasoning in the soup? Pawlu: Very good, but add a little pepper.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：汤的调味怎么样？保罗：很好，不过再加一点胡椒吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu t-tħawwir tas-soppa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu t-tħawwir tas-soppa?
messages.zh: 汤的调味怎么样？
messages.en: How is the seasoning in the soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (尝菜的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna, imma żid ftit bżar.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna, imma żid ftit bżar.
messages.zh: 很好，不过再加一点胡椒吧。
messages.en: Very good, but add a little pepper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往汤里撒香料的动作，把这个名词记成调味这一过程；加香料也不一定表示加辣。

gloss_zh: 紧贴；把自己挤在两物之间

teaching_sense.en_definition: To press oneself tightly against someone or something, or to fit tightly between two things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使自己的身体紧紧贴住某人或某物，或紧挤在两样东西之间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħafas sew ma' xi ħadd jew ma' xi ħaġa, jew jidħol magħfus bejn żewġ affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: to press oneself tightly against sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己的身体紧紧贴向某物或某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fit tightly between two things
sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧挤在两样东西之间；挤进狭窄的间隙。

collocations.en: he pressed himself tightly against the wall
he squeezed tightly between two boxes

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tħaxken bejn żewġ kaxxi biex jilħaq il-valv.
formal.en: The worker squeezed tightly between two boxes to reach the valve.
formal.zh: 工人挤进两个箱子之间，伸手去够阀门。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Leo tħaxken mal-ħajt? Toni: Biex iħalli n-nies jgħaddu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Leo press himself against the wall? Toni: To let people pass.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：利奥为什么紧贴着墙？托尼：为了让大家过去。

messages.speaker: Marta (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Leo tħaxken mal-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Leo tħaxken mal-ħajt?
messages.zh: 利奥为什么紧贴着墙？
messages.en: Why did Leo press himself against the wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex iħalli n-nies jgħaddu.
messages.mt_standard: Biex iħalli n-nies jgħaddu.
messages.zh: 为了让大家过去。
messages.en: To let people pass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象狭窄过道里侧身贴墙，或者挤在两个箱子之间；共同画面是身体被挤得紧紧的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of pressing oneself tightly against someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使身体紧紧贴住某人或某物的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed jingħafas sew ma' xi ħadd jew ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: pressing tightly against sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧紧贴靠某物或某人；紧挤相贴的动作。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jinkludi tħaxkin mal-ħajt għal ftit sekondi.
formal.en: The exercise includes pressing tightly against the wall for a few seconds.
formal.zh: 这项练习包括紧贴墙壁几秒钟的动作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kien hemm ħafna nies fuq il-karozza tal-linja? Ben: Iva, u t-tħaxkin ma' xulxin kien skomdu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Were there many people on the bus? Ben: Yes, and being pressed tightly against one another was very uncomfortable.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：公交车上人很多吗？本：是啊，大家紧紧挤在一起，非常不舒服。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna nies fuq il-karozza tal-linja?
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna nies fuq il-karozza tal-linja?
messages.zh: 公交车上人很多吗？
messages.en: Were there many people on the bus?

messages.speaker: Ben (乘车的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u t-tħaxkin ma' xulxin kien skomdu ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u t-tħaxkin ma' xulxin kien skomdu ħafna.
messages.zh: 是啊，大家紧紧挤在一起，非常不舒服。
messages.en: Yes, and being pressed tightly against one another was very uncomfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把拥挤公交车里彼此紧靠的动作定格成一张照片；这个名词指紧贴挤靠这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become messed up, especially of a job or task; also, of grass, to become dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指工作或任务被弄糟；也可指草变干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħawwad jew jitħassar, speċjalment xogħol; meta jingħad għall-ħaxix, jinxef.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be messed up (typically used of a job or task)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄糟；陷入混乱，通常用于工作或任务。
变干；干枯，用于草。

formal.mt: Il-ħaxix tħaxlef wara ġimgħat sħaħ mingħajr xita.
formal.en: The grass became dry after weeks without rain.
formal.zh: 连续数周没有下雨后，草变干了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ix-xogħol tħaxlef? Mark: Użajna l-lista l-qadima bi żball.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did the work get messed up? Mark: We used the old list by mistake.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：工作怎么弄糟了？马克：我们误用了旧清单。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ix-xogħol tħaxlef?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ix-xogħol tħaxlef?
messages.zh: 工作怎么弄糟了？
messages.en: Why did the work get messed up?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Użajna l-lista l-qadima bi żball.
messages.mt_standard: Użajna l-lista l-qadima bi żball.
messages.zh: 我们误用了旧清单。
messages.en: We used the old list by mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅画记忆：桌上的工作被弄得混乱，院里的草因缺雨变干；遇到这个词先看主语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of messing something up, especially a job or task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事情弄糟或搞乱的行为或过程，尤其指工作或任务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa, speċjalment xogħol, titħawwad jew titħassar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄糟；搞乱某事的行为或过程。

collocations.en: the messing up of the work
the messing up of the plan

formal.mt: Struzzjonijiet ċari jgħinu biex jiġi evitat it-tħaxlif tax-xogħol.
formal.en: Clear instructions help prevent the work from being messed up.
formal.zh: 清楚的指示有助于避免把工作弄糟。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kif nistgħu nevitaw it-tħaxlif tax-xogħol din id-darba? Rita: Ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet flimkien qabel nibdew.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: How can we avoid messing up the work this time? Rita: Let's read the instructions together before we start.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这次怎样才能避免把工作弄糟？丽塔：开始前，我们一起读一下说明吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nistgħu nevitaw it-tħaxlif tax-xogħol din id-darba?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nistgħu nevitaw it-tħaxlif tax-xogħol din id-darba?
messages.zh: 这次怎样才能避免把工作弄糟？
messages.en: How can we avoid messing up the work this time?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet flimkien qabel nibdew.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet flimkien qabel nibdew.
messages.zh: 开始前，我们一起读一下说明吧。
messages.en: Let's read the instructions together before we start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把任务步骤和材料全搞乱；这个名词给弄糟这件事命名，可以搭配工作或计划来记。

gloss_zh: 被拨动而沙沙作响；被抖动清理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be rustled, or to be shaken out, as a mattress or straw mat is shaken out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被拨动或扰动而发出沙沙声；也指床垫、草席等被抖动清理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mċaqlaq u jagħmel ħoss ħafif, jew jiġi mfarfar, bħal saqqu jew tapit tat-tiben.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拨动或扰动而沙沙作响。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be shaken out (used of a mattress, a straw mat, etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抖动清理，用于床垫、草席等物品。

collocations.en: the leaves were rustled by the wind
collocations.zh: 树叶被风吹得沙沙作响

formal.mt: It-tapit tat-tiben tħaxwex fil-bitħa biex jitneħħa t-trab.
formal.en: The straw mat was shaken out in the courtyard to remove the dust.
formal.zh: 草席在院子里被抖动，以除去灰尘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss ħdejn it-tieqa? Ben: Il-weraq tħaxwex meta għadda l-qattus.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that sound near the window? Ben: The leaves were rustled when the cat passed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：窗边刚才是什么声音？本：猫经过时，把树叶拨得沙沙响。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak il-ħoss ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak il-ħoss ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 窗边刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound near the window?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-weraq tħaxwex meta għadda l-qattus.
messages.mt_standard: Il-weraq tħaxwex meta għadda l-qattus.
messages.zh: 猫经过时，把树叶拨得沙沙响。
messages.en: The leaves were rustled when the cat passed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个被动场景并排记：树叶被碰动后沙沙响，草席被抖动后落下灰尘；注意动作落在主语身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become thicker, with greater thickness than before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得比原来更厚或更粗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir eħxen milli kien qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变厚；变粗。

formal.mt: Matul dawn l-aħħar snin, iz-zokk tas-siġra tħaxxeb b'mod ċar.
formal.en: Over the past few years, the tree's trunk has become noticeably thicker.
formal.zh: 过去几年间，这棵树的树干明显变粗了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan iz-zokk kien daqshekk oħxon is-sena l-oħra? Pawlu: Le, tħaxxeb ħafna minn dak iż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this trunk this thick last year? Pawlu: No, it has grown much thicker since then.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这根树干去年就有这么粗吗？保罗：没有，从那时起粗了很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan iz-zokk kien daqshekk oħxon is-sena l-oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Dan iz-zokk kien daqshekk oħxon is-sena l-oħra?
messages.zh: 这根树干去年就有这么粗吗？
messages.en: Was this trunk this thick last year?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tħaxxeb ħafna minn dak iż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tħaxxeb ħafna minn dak iż-żmien.
messages.zh: 没有，从那时起粗了很多。
messages.en: No, it has grown much thicker since then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给同一根树干拍前后对比照：轮廓向外扩、树干变粗，就用 tħaxxeb 记住“变厚、变粗”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become bruised after a blow, pressure, or a fall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因撞击、挤压或跌倒而出现瘀伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa tbenġil wara daqqa, pressjoni jew waqgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出现瘀伤；被碰伤而青紫。

formal.mt: Wara l-waqgħa, driegħ ir-raġel tħaxxem.
formal.en: After the fall, the man's arm became bruised.
formal.zh: 摔倒后，这名男子的手臂出现了瘀伤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil driegħek? Mark: Ħbattu mal-bieb u tħaxxem.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to your arm? Mark: I knocked it against the door, and it became bruised.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的手臂怎么了？马克：撞到门上，碰青了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lil driegħek?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lil driegħek?
messages.zh: 你的手臂怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your arm?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħbattu mal-bieb u tħaxxem.
messages.mt_standard: Ħbattu mal-bieb u tħaxxem.
messages.zh: 撞到门上，碰青了。
messages.en: I knocked it against the door, and it became bruised.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħaxxem 配上“手臂撞门后出现青紫”的画面，用碰撞后的瘀伤来记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become fatter by gaining body fat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体脂肪增加，因而变胖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar xaħmi minħabba żieda fix-xaħam tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变胖；长胖。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinnota li l-qattus tħaxxen matul l-aħħar sena.
formal.en: The report notes that the cat became fatter over the past year.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这只猫在过去一年中长胖了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-qattus jidher akbar fir-ritratt il-ġdid. Samwel: Iva, tħaxxen ftit minn meta ħadna r-ritratt l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: The cat looks bigger in the new photo. Samwel: Yes, he has become a little fatter since we took the other photo.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：猫在新照片里看着大了一圈。萨姆韦尔：是啊，拍完上一张照片后，它胖了一点。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus jidher akbar fir-ritratt il-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus jidher akbar fir-ritratt il-ġdid.
messages.zh: 猫在新照片里看着大了一圈。
messages.en: The cat looks bigger in the new photo.

messages.speaker: Samwel (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tħaxxen ftit minn meta ħadna r-ritratt l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tħaxxen ftit minn meta ħadna r-ritratt l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 是啊，拍完上一张照片后，它胖了一点。
messages.en: Yes, he has become a little fatter since we took the other photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用猫咪前后两张照片作联想：身体圆了一圈，就是 tħaxxen“长胖了”；把词义和身体变化一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered with growing grass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因草生长而逐渐被草覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa bil-ħaxix li jikber fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被草覆盖；长满草。

collocations.en: the garden became covered with grass
the path became covered with grass

formal.mt: Il-ġnien tħaxxex wara perjodu twil mingħajr manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The garden became covered with grass after a long period without maintenance.
formal.zh: 花园长期无人维护，后来长满了草。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadna nistgħu ngħaddu mill-ġnien? Ġanni: Iva, imma tħaxxex u l-mogħdija bilkemm tidher.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can we still walk through the garden? Ġanni: Yes, but it has become covered with grass, and the path is barely visible.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们还能穿过花园吗？詹尼：能，不过里面长满了草，小路几乎看不见了。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna nistgħu ngħaddu mill-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Għadna nistgħu ngħaddu mill-ġnien?
messages.zh: 我们还能穿过花园吗？
messages.en: Can we still walk through the garden?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma tħaxxex u l-mogħdija bilkemm tidher.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma tħaxxex u l-mogħdija bilkemm tidher.
messages.zh: 能，不过里面长满了草，小路几乎看不见了。
messages.en: Yes, but it has become covered with grass, and the path is barely visible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花园的小路被绿草慢慢盖住，最后几乎看不见；这个“长满草”的变化就是 tħaxxex。

gloss_zh: 长成梁木般形态的生长过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of growing into a form resembling a beam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生长成类似梁木形态的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' tkabbir f'għamla li tixbah travu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长得像梁木；作为名词，指这种生长过程。

collocations.en: the trunk's growth into a beam-like form
collocations.zh: 树干长成梁木般形态的过程

collocations.en: observation of growth into a beam-like form
collocations.zh: 对梁木般形态生长过程的观察

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni ssemmi t-tħaxxib taz-zokk, jiġifieri t-tkabbir tiegħu f'għamla li tixbah travu.
formal.en: The description mentions the trunk's growth into a beam-like form, meaning its development into a shape resembling a beam.
formal.zh: 这段描述提到树干的梁木状生长，即树干逐渐长成类似梁木的形态。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma tħaxxib hawn? Pawlu: Tfisser it-tkabbir taz-zokk f'għamla li tixbah travu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word tħaxxib mean here? Pawlu: It means the trunk's growth into a shape resembling a beam.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 tħaxxib 是什么意思？保罗：指树干长成类似梁木形态的过程。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma tħaxxib hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma tħaxxib hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 tħaxxib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word tħaxxib mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser it-tkabbir taz-zokk f'għamla li tixbah travu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser it-tkabbir taz-zokk f'għamla li tixbah travu.
messages.zh: 指树干长成类似梁木形态的过程。
messages.en: It means the trunk's growth into a shape resembling a beam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一组树干逐渐呈现梁木形态的连环图，把整个生长过程标为 tħaxxib，记住这里是过程名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of pressing something into a space where it fits tightly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物用力挤进空间，使其紧紧塞住的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għafis ta' xi ħaġa biex tidħol fi spazju fejn toqgħod issikkata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西挤入仅能紧密容纳它的空间；紧塞。

collocations.en: pressing the foam tightly into the box
squeezing the clothes into the tightly packed suitcase
collocations.zh: 把衣服挤进已经很满的行李箱

formal.mt: It-tħaxxim tal-ħwejjeġ f'bagalja żgħira ħafna jagħmilha diffiċli biex tingħalaq.
formal.en: Squeezing clothes into a very small suitcase makes it difficult to close.
formal.zh: 把衣服硬塞进很小的行李箱，会使箱子难以合上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-bagalja ma tingħalaqx? Mark: Minħabba t-tħaxxim tal-ħwejjeġ kollha fiha. Ejja noħorġu ftit minnhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why won't the suitcase close? Mark: Because of squeezing all the clothes into it. Let's take some of them out.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：行李箱怎么合不上？马克：因为把所有衣服都硬塞进去了。我们拿一些出来吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-bagalja ma tingħalaqx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-bagalja ma tingħalaqx?
messages.zh: 行李箱怎么合不上？
messages.en: Why won't the suitcase close?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tħaxxim tal-ħwejjeġ kollha fiha. Ejja noħorġu ftit minnhom.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tħaxxim tal-ħwejjeġ kollha fiha. Ejja noħorġu ftit minnhom.
messages.zh: 因为把所有衣服都硬塞进去了。我们拿一些出来吧。
messages.en: Because of squeezing all the clothes into it. Let's take some of them out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象行李箱已经很满，还用双手把衣服压进去；把这个“往狭窄空间紧塞”的动作记作 tħaxxim。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of feeding a person or animal so that they become fatter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过喂养使人或动物长胖的过程，常可用来指动物育肥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' tmigħ biex persuna jew annimal isir aktar xaħmi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 育肥；通过喂养使其长胖。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tar-razzett jiddeskrivi l-għalf użat għat-tħaxxin tal-ħnieżer.
formal.en: The farm plan describes the feed used for fattening pigs.
formal.zh: 农场计划说明了用于猪育肥的饲料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal xiex hu dan l-għalf? Ġużeppi: Hu għat-tħaxxin tal-ħnieżer f'dik il-parti tar-razzett.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this feed for? Ġużeppi: It is for fattening the pigs in that part of the farm.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些饲料是做什么用的？朱塞佩：给农场那边的猪育肥用的。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex hu dan l-għalf?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex hu dan l-għalf?
messages.zh: 这些饲料是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this feed for?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu għat-tħaxxin tal-ħnieżer f'dik il-parti tar-razzett.
messages.mt_standard: Hu għat-tħaxxin tal-ħnieżer f'dik il-parti tar-razzett.
messages.zh: 给农场那边的猪育肥用的。
messages.en: It is for fattening the pigs in that part of the farm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“饲料送进食槽，动物逐渐长胖”连成一个过程，记作 tħaxxin；名词重点是喂养育肥这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of eating grass as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物吃草、以草为食的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha annimal jiekol il-ħaxix bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃草；以草为食的活动。

formal.mt: Din il-medda ta' art hija riżervata għat-tħaxxix tan-nagħaġ.
formal.en: This stretch of land is reserved for the sheep to feed on grass.
formal.zh: 这片土地专门留给羊吃草。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ħallejt in-nagħaġ f'din l-għalqa? Pawlu: Għat-tħaxxix. Hawn ħafna ħaxix għalihom.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you leave the sheep in this field? Pawlu: To feed on grass. There is plenty of grass here for them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么把羊留在这块地里？保罗：让它们吃草。这里有很多草供它们吃。

messages.speaker: Nina (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallejt in-nagħaġ f'din l-għalqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallejt in-nagħaġ f'din l-għalqa?
messages.zh: 你为什么把羊留在这块地里？
messages.en: Why did you leave the sheep in this field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牧羊人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tħaxxix. Hawn ħafna ħaxix għalihom.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tħaxxix. Hawn ħafna ħaxix għalihom.
messages.zh: 让它们吃草。这里有很多草供它们吃。
messages.en: To feed on grass. There is plenty of grass here for them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象羊群低头一口口吃青草，把整个吃草活动标为 tħaxxix；画面中的主角是正在进食的动物。

gloss_zh: 沙沙声；窸窣声；摩擦或摆动的唰唰声

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft rustling or swishing sound made by things moving or brushing against one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体移动或相互轻擦时发出的沙沙声、窸窣声或唰唰声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ħafif li jagħmlu affarijiet meta jiċċaqilqu jew jitħakku ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙沙声；窸窣声，如树叶或纸张轻动时的声音。
唰唰声；物体摆动或轻擦时发出的声音。

formal.mt: Fis-skiet tal-ġnien, kien jinstema' biss it-tħaxħix tal-weraq niexef.
formal.en: In the quiet garden, only the rustling of dry leaves could be heard.
formal.zh: 寂静的花园里，只听得见干树叶的沙沙声。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak it-tħaxħix? Lara: Id-dublett tiegħi qed jitħakkek mas-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is that swishing sound? Lara: My skirt is brushing against the chair.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那是什么窸窣声？拉拉：是我的裙子在蹭椅子。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak it-tħaxħix?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak it-tħaxħix?
messages.zh: 那是什么窸窣声？
messages.en: What is that swishing sound?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dublett tiegħi qed jitħakkek mas-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dublett tiegħi qed jitħakkek mas-siġġu.
messages.zh: 是我的裙子在蹭椅子。
messages.en: My skirt is brushing against the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用听觉画面记忆：树叶轻动是沙沙声，裙摆擦过椅子是窸窣声，这个名词都能描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be struck with thrown stones, or to become hard like a rock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遭到投掷石块的攻击，或变得像石头一样坚硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintlaqat minn ġebel mitfugħ lejh, jew isir iebes bħall-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人投掷石块攻击。
硬化；变得像石头一样坚硬。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel tħaġġar mill-folla qabel ma waslet l-għajnuna.
formal.en: In the story, the man was stoned by the crowd before help arrived.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子在救援到来前遭到了人群的投石攻击。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nista' nieħu biċċa minn dan il-ħobż? David: Aħjar tieħu l-ieħor; dan tħaġġar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can I have a piece of this bread? David: You'd better take the other one; this one has gone rock-hard.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我能拿一块这个面包吗？戴维：你最好拿另一个，这个已经硬得像石头了。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nieħu biċċa minn dan il-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nieħu biċċa minn dan il-ħobż?
messages.zh: 我能拿一块这个面包吗？
messages.en: Can I have a piece of this bread?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar tieħu l-ieħor; dan tħaġġar.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar tieħu l-ieħor; dan tħaġġar.
messages.zh: 你最好拿另一个，这个已经硬得像石头了。
messages.en: You'd better take the other one; this one has gone rock-hard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个石头画面记忆：石块被扔向人，以及面包变得像石头一样硬，分别对应两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered with a veil, or to grow thick eyebrows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被面纱遮盖，或眉毛生长得浓密。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa b'velu, jew jikbrulu ħuġbejn ħoxnin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被蒙上面纱；被纱遮盖。
长出浓密的眉毛。

collocations.en: grew thick eyebrows as he grew older
collocations.zh: 随着年龄增长而长出浓眉

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-pittura, wiċċ il-mara tħaġġeb b'velu abjad.
formal.en: In the description of the painting, the woman's face became covered with a white veil.
formal.zh: 在对画作的描述中，女子的脸被蒙上了白色面纱。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ara kemm għandu ħuġbejh ħoxnin f'dan ir-ritratt! Pawlu: Iva, tħaġġeb hekk kif kiber.
colloquial.en: Marija: Look how thick his eyebrows are in this photo! Pawlu: Yes, he grew thick eyebrows as he got older.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：看，这张照片里他的眉毛多浓啊！保罗：是啊，他长大以后眉毛变浓了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm għandu ħuġbejh ħoxnin f'dan ir-ritratt!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm għandu ħuġbejh ħoxnin f'dan ir-ritratt!
messages.zh: 看，这张照片里他的眉毛多浓啊！
messages.en: Look how thick his eyebrows are in this photo!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tħaġġeb hekk kif kiber.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tħaġġeb hekk kif kiber.
messages.zh: 是啊，他长大以后眉毛变浓了。
messages.en: Yes, he grew thick eyebrows as he got older.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一张脸分成两幅记忆图：一幅蒙着面纱，一幅长着浓眉，帮助区分所给的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of concealing something or covering it with a veil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或事物遮住、隐藏起来的行为，也指用纱覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li xi ħaġa tinħeba mill-vista jew titgħatta b'velu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遮蔽；使事物不被看见的隐藏行为。
蒙纱；用面纱或薄纱遮盖。

formal.mt: It-tħaġġib tal-wiċċ b'velu huwa element importanti fid-deskrizzjoni tal-kostum.
formal.en: The veiling of the face is an important element in the description of the costume.
formal.zh: 用面纱遮住脸部，是这段服装描述中的一个重要元素。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm drapp fuq l-istatwa? Mark: Għat-tħaġġib tagħha qabel il-kxif ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there a cloth over the statue? Mark: To keep it concealed before tomorrow's unveiling.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么雕像上盖着一块布？马克：为了在明天揭幕前把它遮住。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm drapp fuq l-istatwa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm drapp fuq l-istatwa?
messages.zh: 为什么雕像上盖着一块布？
messages.en: Why is there a cloth over the statue?

messages.speaker: Mark (展览工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tħaġġib tagħha qabel il-kxif ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tħaġġib tagħha qabel il-kxif ta' għada.
messages.zh: 为了在明天揭幕前把它遮住。
messages.en: To keep it concealed before tomorrow's unveiling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块纱布盖住脸或物件，把“遮住这件事”作为名词画面记忆，而不是只记那块布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of throwing stones at someone as an attack or punishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人投掷石块进行攻击或惩罚的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jintefa' ġebel lejn xi ħadd bħala attakk jew kastig.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向人投掷石块的攻击或惩罚行为。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-vittma tat-tħaġġir tingħata l-għajnuna minn persuna li tkun għaddejja.
formal.en: In the story, the victim of the stoning receives help from a passer-by.
formal.zh: 故事中，投石攻击的受害者得到了一名路人的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara lill-karattru f'dan il-kapitlu? Toni: Kien vittma tat-tħaġġir, imma xi ħadd għenu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to the character in this chapter? Toni: He was a victim of stoning, but someone helped him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这一章里，那个人物遭遇了什么？托尼：他遭到了投石攻击，不过有人帮助了他。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lill-karattru f'dan il-kapitlu?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lill-karattru f'dan il-kapitlu?
messages.zh: 这一章里，那个人物遭遇了什么？
messages.en: What happened to the character in this chapter?

messages.speaker: Toni (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien vittma tat-tħaġġir, imma xi ħadd għenu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien vittma tat-tħaġġir, imma xi ħadd għenu.
messages.zh: 他遭到了投石攻击，不过有人帮助了他。
messages.en: He was a victim of stoning, but someone helped him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把书中“投石攻击这一行为”整体框起来，记住这是行为名词，并与“被投石”的动词区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become poor or fall into poverty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经济状况恶化，陷入贫困或变得穷困。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir fqir jew jaqa' fil-faqar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陷入贫困；变得穷困。

collocations.en: became impoverished after losing his job

formal.mt: Ir-raġel tħażar wara li tilef xogħlu u kellu jitlob għajnuna finanzjarja.
formal.en: The man became impoverished after losing his job and had to request financial assistance.
formal.zh: 这名男子失业后陷入贫困，不得不申请经济援助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu Pawlu minn meta għalaq il-ħanut? Mark: Tħażar, u bħalissa qed ngħinuh iħallas il-kera.
colloquial.en: Maja: How has Pawlu been since he closed the shop? Mark: He has fallen into poverty, and we're helping him pay the rent at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗关掉店铺以后过得怎么样？马克：他陷入了贫困，我们目前正在帮他付房租。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu Pawlu minn meta għalaq il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu Pawlu minn meta għalaq il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 保罗关掉店铺以后过得怎么样？
messages.en: How has Pawlu been since he closed the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħażar, u bħalissa qed ngħinuh iħallas il-kera.
messages.mt_standard: Tħażar, u bħalissa qed ngħinuh iħallas il-kera.
messages.zh: 他陷入了贫困，我们目前正在帮他付房租。
messages.en: He has fallen into poverty, and we're helping him pay the rent at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“失业后钱包逐渐空了”的情景连在一起记，重点是经济状况变穷；同时注意它只有一个连续的 ż，区别于表示磨损起毛的 tħażżar。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of grinding something or reducing it to very small pieces by mincing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将材料磨细，或把食材绞碎、切成细小碎块的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess tat-tħin ta' xi ħaġa jew tat-tqattigħ tagħha f'biċċiet żgħar ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 研磨；把材料磨细的过程。
绞碎或切碎；把食材加工成细小碎块的过程。

formal.mt: It-tħażdiq tal-laħam għandu jsir b'tagħmir nadif qabel ma jiżdiedu l-ħwawar.
formal.en: The mincing of the meat should be carried out with clean equipment before the spices are added.
formal.zh: 应使用干净的设备将肉绞碎，然后再加入香料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lestejt it-tħażdiq tal-laħam? Toni: Iva, issa nista' nħalltu mal-basla.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you finished mincing the meat? Toni: Yes, now I can mix it with the onion.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你把肉绞好了吗？托尼：好了，现在可以把它和洋葱拌在一起。

messages.speaker: Lara (同住者)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt it-tħażdiq tal-laħam?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt it-tħażdiq tal-laħam?
messages.zh: 你把肉绞好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished mincing the meat?

messages.speaker: Toni (同住者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nista' nħalltu mal-basla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nista' nħalltu mal-basla.
messages.zh: 好了，现在可以把它和洋葱拌在一起。
messages.en: Yes, now I can mix it with the onion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房里两项加工：香料磨成粉，肉绞成细末。把 tħażdiq 记成这类“加工过程”的名称，同时用食材区分研磨和绞碎两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be reduced to smaller pieces or powder by grinding, pounding, or mincing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过研磨、捣击或绞切而变成碎块、细末或粉状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitnaqqas fi trab jew f'biċċiet żgħar bit-tħin, bid-daqq jew bit-tqattigħ fin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被研磨；被磨成细末或粉状。
被捣碎；受到反复捣击而变碎。
被绞碎或切碎成细小碎块。

collocations.en: the pepper was pounded in the mortar
collocations.zh: 胡椒在研钵中被捣碎了

formal.mt: Il-bżar tħażżaq fil-mehrież qabel ma żdied mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The pepper was pounded in the mortar before being added to the mixture.
formal.zh: 胡椒先在研钵中捣碎，然后加入混合物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-laħam tħażżaq fin biżżejjed? Karl: Iva, lest biex nagħmlu l-pulpetti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was the meat minced finely enough? Karl: Yes, it's ready for us to make the meatballs.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：肉绞得够细了吗？卡尔：够了，可以用来做肉丸了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-laħam tħażżaq fin biżżejjed?
messages.mt_standard: Il-laħam tħażżaq fin biżżejjed?
messages.zh: 肉绞得够细了吗？
messages.en: Was the meat minced finely enough?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lest biex nagħmlu l-pulpetti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lest biex nagħmlu l-pulpetti.
messages.zh: 够了，可以用来做肉丸了。
messages.en: Yes, it's ready for us to make the meatballs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“材料变碎了”串起三个意思：磨盘磨、研钵捣、绞肉机绞。记忆时把注意力放在被加工的材料及其结果上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frayed, with threads loosening or separating through wear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料、绳子等因磨损而起毛，或边缘的线逐渐松散。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitmermer bl-użu u jibdew jinħallu jew jinfirdu l-ħjut tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨损起毛；因线头松散而出现散边。

collocations.en: the rope became frayed through use
collocations.zh: 绳子因使用而磨损起毛

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni ġie nnutat li l-ħabel tħażżar qrib it-tarf.
formal.en: During the inspection, it was noted that the rope had become frayed near the end.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，绳子靠近末端的部位已经磨损起毛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex trid issewwi dan il-kmiem? Rita: It-tarf tħażżar, u qed jinħallu l-ħjut.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you want to mend this sleeve? Rita: The edge has frayed, and the threads are coming loose.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么要补这个袖子？丽塔：袖口边缘磨毛了，线都开始散了。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid issewwi dan il-kmiem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid issewwi dan il-kmiem?
messages.zh: 你为什么要补这个袖子？
messages.en: Why do you want to mend this sleeve?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tarf tħażżar, u qed jinħallu l-ħjut.
messages.mt_standard: It-tarf tħażżar, u qed jinħallu l-ħjut.
messages.zh: 袖口边缘磨毛了，线都开始散了。
messages.en: The edge has frayed, and the threads are coming loose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见词中并排的 żż，就想象布边冒出的两根松线，帮助记住“磨损散线”。这是拼写联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put on or wear a girdle around the waist, or to straighten one's clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在腰间束上腰带或束腰，也可指把自己的衣服整理平整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilbes faxxa jew ċinturin madwar qaddu, jew jirranġa ħwejġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 束上或佩戴腰带、束腰。
整理自己的衣着；把衣服拉正、理平。

collocations.en: put on a sash around his waist

collocations.zh: 进去前整理了一下衣着

formal.mt: L-attur tħażżem b'faxxa ħamra madwar qaddu qabel tela' fuq il-palk.
formal.en: The actor put on a red sash around his waist before going on stage.
formal.zh: 演员登台前在腰间束上了一条红色腰带。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark lest għar-ritratt? Lara: Iva, tħażżem u ġej hawn issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark ready for the photo? Lara: Yes, he has straightened his clothes and is coming over now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克准备好拍照了吗？拉拉：好了，他整理了一下衣服，现在正过来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark lest għar-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Mark lest għar-ritratt?
messages.zh: 马克准备好拍照了吗？
messages.en: Is Mark ready for the photo?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tħażżem u ġej hawn issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tħażżem u ġej hawn issa.
messages.zh: 好了，他整理了一下衣服，现在正过来。
messages.en: Yes, he has straightened his clothes and is coming over now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象登台前的两个动作：先束好腰带，再把衣服拉平。用同一幅穿衣画面分别记住“束腰”和“整理衣着”两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be furnished or supplied, to be stored for later use, or to become bad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被配备家具或所需物品、被存放以备后用，或变坏；具体意义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata l-għamara jew il-provvisti meħtieġa, jitqiegħed f'post biex jintuża aktar tard, jew isir ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被配备家具或所需物品。
被储存；被存放以备后用。
变坏；性质、品行或状况变差。

collocations.en: the storehouse was stocked with supplies
the rice was stored in a dry place

formal.mt: Ir-ross tħażżen f'kontenitur magħluq f'post frisk u niexef.
formal.en: The rice was stored in a sealed container in a cool, dry place.
formal.zh: 大米装在密封容器中，存放于阴凉干燥处。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn tħażżen ir-ross li xtrajna? Pawlu: Fil-kontenitur il-kbir, fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where was the rice we bought stored? Pawlu: In the large container, on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们买的大米放在哪里了？保罗：在架子上的那个大容器里。

messages.speaker: Rita (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn tħażżen ir-ross li xtrajna?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn tħażżen ir-ross li xtrajna?
messages.zh: 我们买的大米放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where was the rice we bought stored?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kontenitur il-kbir, fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kontenitur il-kbir, fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 在架子上的那个大容器里。
messages.en: In the large container, on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为这个多义词准备三张情景卡：房间配好物品、米粮收进容器、孩子行为变坏。每次先看主语和上下文，再选择对应中文意思。

gloss_zh: 被乱写；被画出；被勾画；被涂鸦

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be written or drawn as scribbling, a drawing, a sketch, or a doodle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指文字或图形被潦草写下、画出、勾成草图，或随手涂画。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkiteb jew jitpinġa, kemm bħala kitba mgħaġġla kif ukoll bħala tpinġija, skeċċ jew taħżiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被潦草地写下；被乱写。
被画出；以图画形式呈现。
被勾画成草图；被简略画出。
被随手涂画；被漫不经心地画出。

collocations.en: the message was scribbled on a piece of paper
collocations.zh: 留言被潦草地写在一张纸上

collocations.en: the plan was sketched in pencil
collocations.zh: 方案被用铅笔勾画出来

collocations.en: the flower was doodled in the margin
collocations.zh: 页边被随手画上了一朵花

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-kamra tħażżeż bil-lapes biex juri fejn kellha titqiegħed l-għamara.
formal.en: The room plan was sketched in pencil to show where the furniture was to be placed.
formal.zh: 房间平面图用铅笔勾画出来，以说明家具应摆放的位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-wiċċ tħażżeż waqt il-lezzjoni? Ben: Iva, kont qed npinġi waqt li nisma'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this face doodled during the lesson? Ben: Yes, I was drawing while I listened.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张脸是上课时随手画的吗？本：是啊，我一边听一边画的。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-wiċċ tħażżeż waqt il-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-wiċċ tħażżeż waqt il-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 这张脸是上课时随手画的吗？
messages.en: Was this face doodled during the lesson?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kont qed npinġi waqt li nisma'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kont qed npinġi waqt li nisma'.
messages.zh: 是啊，我一边听一边画的。
messages.en: Yes, I was drawing while I listened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一页笔记上有四种痕迹：潦草留言、普通图画、简略草图和随手涂鸦。用同一张纸串起四义，再按内容判断是“写”还是“画”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or practice of wearing a girdle, sash, or belt around the waist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在腰间佩戴腰带、腰巾或束腰的行为或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ilbies ta' faxxa jew ċinturin madwar il-qadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 束腰；在腰间佩戴腰带或束腰的行为。

collocations.en: wearing a sash around the waist
wearing a belt around the waist

formal.mt: L-għalliem wera lill-atturi kif isir it-tħażżim b'faxxa bħala parti mill-kostum.
formal.en: The teacher showed the actors how to put on a waist sash as part of the costume.
formal.zh: 老师向演员示范了如何束上腰巾，作为穿戴演出服的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' turini kif isir it-tħażżim b'din il-faxxa? Marija: Iva, dawwarha ma' qaddek u orbotha hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you show me how to put on this waist sash? Marija: Yes, wrap it around your waist and tie it here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你能教我怎么束这条腰巾吗？玛丽亚：可以，把它绕在腰上，再在这里系好。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' turini kif isir it-tħażżim b'din il-faxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' turini kif isir it-tħażżim b'din il-faxxa?
messages.zh: 你能教我怎么束这条腰巾吗？
messages.en: Can you show me how to put on this waist sash?

messages.speaker: Marija (服装老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dawwarha ma' qaddek u orbotha hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dawwarha ma' qaddek u orbotha hawn.
messages.zh: 可以，把它绕在腰上，再在这里系好。
messages.en: Yes, wrap it around your waist and tie it here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħażżim 当作“束腰这件事”的名称来记：腰巾绕一圈，再系好。与动词 tħażżem 对照，一个命名行为，一个叙述动作。

gloss_zh: 储存；生活必需品的供应；变坏或腐化的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The keeping of goods or materials in a place for later use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品或材料存放起来，以供日后使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żamma ta' oġġetti jew materjali f'post biex jintużaw aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储存；存放。
供应或备齐生活必需品。

sense_translations.en_definition: the process of becoming bad or corrupt
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变坏、败坏或腐化的过程。

formal.mt: It-tħażżin tal-ikel f'post frisk u niexef jgħin biex tinżamm il-kwalità tiegħu.
formal.en: Storing food in a cool, dry place helps maintain its quality.
formal.zh: 把食物储存在阴凉干燥的地方，有助于保持其品质。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna post għat-tħażżin ta' dawn il-kaxxi? Mark: Iva, nistgħu npoġġuhom fil-kamra ta' wara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have space to store these boxes? Mark: Yes, we can put them in the back room.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们有地方存放这些箱子吗？Mark：有，可以放在后面的房间里。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna post għat-tħażżin ta' dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna post għat-tħażżin ta' dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 我们有地方存放这些箱子吗？
messages.en: Do we have space to store these boxes?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu npoġġuhom fil-kamra ta' wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu npoġġuhom fil-kamra ta' wara.
messages.zh: 有，可以放在后面的房间里。
messages.en: Yes, we can put them in the back room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象把箱子收进储藏室，记住“储存”；再把“供应必需品”和“逐渐变坏”作为两个独立义项记忆，遇到句子先看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of embracing someone or holding someone or something in both arms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥抱某人，或用双臂抱住某人或某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jgħannaq lil xi ħadd jew iżomm lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa b'żewġ dirgħajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥抱的动作。
用双臂抱住某人或某物。

formal.mt: It-tħażżiq tat-tifel minn ommu tah sens ta' sigurtà.
formal.en: The mother's embrace gave the boy a sense of security.
formal.zh: 母亲的拥抱给了男孩安全感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara t-tħażżiq ta' dik l-omm mat-tifla tagħha! Mark: Kemm hi kuntenta t-tifla f'dirgħajha!
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that mother embracing her daughter! Mark: Her daughter looks so happy in her arms!
colloquial.zh: Maja：看那位母亲抱着自己的女儿！Mark：女儿在她怀里多开心啊！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara t-tħażżiq ta' dik l-omm mat-tifla tagħha!
messages.mt_standard: Ara t-tħażżiq ta' dik l-omm mat-tifla tagħha!
messages.zh: 看那位母亲抱着自己的女儿！
messages.en: Look at that mother embracing her daughter!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi kuntenta t-tifla f'dirgħajha!
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi kuntenta t-tifla f'dirgħajha!
messages.zh: 女儿在她怀里多开心啊！
messages.en: Her daughter looks so happy in her arms!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双臂围成一个圈，把孩子抱在怀里；用这个动作画面同时记住“拥抱”和“双臂抱住”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making careless marks or writing in an untidy way that may be difficult to read.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随意涂写，或以凌乱、可能难以辨认的字迹书写。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħmel marki bl-addoċċ jew jikteb b'mod traskurat li jista' jkun diffiċli biex jinqara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 随意涂写；乱涂乱画。
潦草地书写；写出凌乱难认的字迹。

formal.mt: It-tħażżiż fil-marġni għamel xi kliem fit-test diffiċli biex jinqara.
formal.en: The scribbling in the margins made some words in the text difficult to read.
formal.zh: 页边的乱涂乱写使正文中的一些词难以辨认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nistax naqra dan it-tħażżiż. Mark: Skużani, ktibt malajr. Nerġa' nikteb in-nota aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: I can't read this scrawl. Mark: Sorry, I wrote quickly. I'll rewrite the note more clearly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些潦草的字我看不懂。Mark：抱歉，我写得太快了。我把便条重新写清楚些。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax naqra dan it-tħażżiż.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax naqra dan it-tħażżiż.
messages.zh: 这些潦草的字我看不懂。
messages.en: I can't read this scrawl.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, ktibt malajr. Nerġa' nikteb in-nota aktar ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, ktibt malajr. Nerġa' nikteb in-nota aktar ċar.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我写得太快了。我把便条重新写清楚些。
messages.en: Sorry, I wrote quickly. I'll rewrite the note more clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中放一张写满乱线和难认字迹的纸：“乱线”提示乱涂，“难认的字”提示潦草书写。

gloss_zh: 被逼疯；被折磨得失去理智

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be driven mad by something distressing or overwhelming.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因令人痛苦或无法承受的事情而被逼疯、失去理智。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitlef moħħu minħabba xi ħaġa li tnikktu jew li ma jiflaħx għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被逼疯；被折磨得失去理智。

collocations.en: was driven mad by the noise

collocations.zh: 被忧虑折磨得失去了理智

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel tħebbel bl-istorbju kontinwu li ma ħalliehx jorqod.
formal.en: In the story, the man was driven mad by the constant noise that prevented him from sleeping.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个男人被持续不断、让他无法入睡的噪声逼疯了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif spiċċat l-istorja? Mark: Ir-raġel tħebbel b'dak l-istorbju kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the story end? Mark: The man was driven mad by all that noise.
colloquial.zh: Maja：故事最后怎么样了？Mark：那个男人被那些噪声逼疯了。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif spiċċat l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Kif spiċċat l-istorja?
messages.zh: 故事最后怎么样了？
messages.en: How did the story end?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raġel tħebbel b'dak l-istorbju kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raġel tħebbel b'dak l-istorbju kollu.
messages.zh: 那个男人被那些噪声逼疯了。
messages.en: The man was driven mad by all that noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进故事情节记忆：噪声不断，人物终于被逼疯。这个词是动词，用来叙述发生了什么。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or state of being driven mad by a distressing or overwhelming cause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到令人痛苦或无法承受的因素影响，被逼疯的过程或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-istat ta' min jitlef moħħu minħabba xi ħaġa li tnikktu jew li ma jiflaħx għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被逼疯；被折磨得失去理智的过程或状态。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi t-tħebbil tar-raġel minħabba l-biża' u l-istorbju kontinwu.
formal.en: The author describes the man's being driven mad by fear and constant noise.
formal.zh: 作者描写了那个男人因恐惧和持续的噪声而被逼疯的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiddeskrivi dan il-kapitlu? Mark: It-tħebbil tal-protagonist. Il-biża' ma tħallihx jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this chapter describe? Mark: The protagonist's being driven mad. Fear gives him no rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这一章描写了什么？Mark：主人公被逼疯的过程。恐惧让他不得安宁。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiddeskrivi dan il-kapitlu?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiddeskrivi dan il-kapitlu?
messages.zh: 这一章描写了什么？
messages.en: What does this chapter describe?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tħebbil tal-protagonist. Il-biża' ma tħallihx jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: It-tħebbil tal-protagonist. Il-biża' ma tħallihx jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 主人公被逼疯的过程。恐惧让他不得安宁。
messages.en: The protagonist's being driven mad. Fear gives him no rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 与动词 tħebbel 配对记：一个讲“他被逼疯了”，名词 tħebbil 则把“被逼疯的过程”当作讨论对象。

gloss_zh: 变得困倦；开始昏昏欲睡

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin to feel sleepy and less alert.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始感到困倦，精神不再清醒，变得昏昏欲睡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jibda jħoss in-ngħas u jkun inqas attent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得困倦；开始昏昏欲睡。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, ir-raġel tħeddel waqt li kien qed jaqra ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: After the meal, the man became drowsy while reading by the window.
formal.zh: 饭后，那个男人在窗边读书时开始昏昏欲睡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu tħeddel fuq is-sufan. Mark: Ħallih jistrieħ ftit; dalgħodu qam kmieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu has become drowsy on the sofa. Mark: Let him rest a little; he got up early this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 坐在沙发上犯困了。Mark：让他休息一会儿吧，他今天早上起得很早。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu tħeddel fuq is-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu tħeddel fuq is-sufan.
messages.zh: Pawlu 坐在沙发上犯困了。
messages.en: Pawlu has become drowsy on the sofa.

messages.speaker: Mark (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallih jistrieħ ftit; dalgħodu qam kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallih jistrieħ ftit; dalgħodu qam kmieni.
messages.zh: 让他休息一会儿吧，他今天早上起得很早。
messages.en: Let him rest a little; he got up early this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饭后坐在沙发上，眼皮渐渐往下落；抓住“开始变困”的变化感，不要直接记成已经睡着。

gloss_zh: 做好准备；使自己准备妥当

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make oneself ready for an activity, event, or task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某项活动、事件或任务做好自身准备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lilu nnifsu lest għal attività, ġrajja jew biċċa xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己准备好；做好自身准备。

formal.mt: L-istudent tħejja għall-eżami billi qara n-noti u wieġeb mistoqsijiet ta' prova.
formal.en: The student prepared himself for the examination by reading his notes and answering practice questions.
formal.zh: 这名学生通过阅读笔记和回答练习题，为考试做好了准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu lest għall-vjaġġ? Luka: Iva, tħejja minn kmieni u l-bagalja tiegħu lesta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu ready for the trip? Luka: Yes, he prepared himself early, and his suitcase is ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗准备好出门旅行了吗？卢卡：是的，他早早就做好了准备，行李箱也收拾好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu lest għall-vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu lest għall-vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 保罗准备好出门旅行了吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu ready for the trip?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tħejja minn kmieni u l-bagalja tiegħu lesta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tħejja minn kmieni u l-bagalja tiegħu lesta.
messages.zh: 是的，他早早就做好了准备，行李箱也收拾好了。
messages.en: Yes, he prepared himself early, and his suitcase is ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和考前整理笔记、出门收好行李的画面相连，记住重点是“自己做好准备”。

gloss_zh: 遭到攻击；遭到袭击或殴打

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be subjected to an attack or physical assault by another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到他人的攻击或人身袭击，着重表示遭受攻击的一方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun attakkat jew isofri vjolenza fiżika minn persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭到攻击；成为攻击的对象。
遭到人身袭击或殴打。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel tħejjeb minn żewġ persuni waqt li kien sejjer lejn id-dar.
formal.en: According to the report, the man was assaulted by two people while he was walking home.
formal.zh: 据报告，这名男子在步行回家途中遭到两人的袭击。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil Pawlu? Luka: Tħejjeb fit-triq, imma issa jinsab f'post sigur.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to Pawlu? Luka: He was attacked in the street, but he is somewhere safe now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么了？卢卡：他在街上遭到袭击，不过现在已经到了安全的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lil Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lil Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħejjeb fit-triq, imma issa jinsab f'post sigur.
messages.mt_standard: Tħejjeb fit-triq, imma issa jinsab f'post sigur.
messages.zh: 他在街上遭到袭击，不过现在已经到了安全的地方。
messages.en: He was attacked in the street, but he is somewhere safe now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“他遭袭了”这一完整情境记忆，始终把主语放在受害者的位置，避免记成主动攻击别人。

gloss_zh: 遭受攻击；遭受人身袭击

teaching_sense.en_definition: The experience or occurrence of being attacked or physically assaulted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遭到攻击或人身袭击这一经历或事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-esperjenza jew il-ġrajja ta' meta persuna tiġi attakkata jew issofri vjolenza fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭受攻击这件事或这一经历。
遭受人身袭击或殴打这件事或这一经历。

formal.mt: Wara t-tħejjib, il-vittma rċeviet kura medika u appoġġ mill-familja.
formal.en: After being assaulted, the victim received medical care and support from the family.
formal.zh: 遭受袭击后，受害者接受了医疗护理，并得到了家人的支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed iħossu Pawlu wara t-tħejjib? Luka: Għadu mbeżża', imma qed jitkellem mal-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Pawlu feeling after being attacked? Luka: He is still frightened, but he is talking to his family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗遭袭之后感觉怎么样？卢卡：他还是很害怕，不过正在和家人谈这件事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed iħossu Pawlu wara t-tħejjib?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed iħossu Pawlu wara t-tħejjib?
messages.zh: 保罗遭袭之后感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How is Pawlu feeling after being attacked?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mbeżża', imma qed jitkellem mal-familja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mbeżża', imma qed jitkellem mal-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他还是很害怕，不过正在和家人谈这件事。
messages.en: He is still frightened, but he is talking to his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħejjeb 记成“遭袭了”，把 tħejjib 记成“遭袭这件事”；用动作与事件名词的对照帮助区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work or process of getting ready for an activity, event, or task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某项活动、事件或任务做好安排和准备的过程或工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma jew il-proċess biex wieħed ikun lest għal attività, ġrajja jew biċċa xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准备；为将要进行的事情所做的筹备工作。

formal.mt: It-tħejjija għall-eżami tinkludi l-qari tan-noti u t-tweġib ta' mistoqsijiet ta' prova.
formal.en: Preparation for the examination includes reading notes and answering practice questions.
formal.zh: 考试准备包括阅读笔记和回答练习题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejra t-tħejjija għall-festa? Luka: Tajjeb! L-ikel lest u fadlilna biss inżejnu l-kamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the preparation for the party going? Luka: Well! The food is ready, and we only have the room left to decorate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：聚会筹备得怎么样了？卢卡：挺顺利！食物准备好了，只剩布置房间了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejra t-tħejjija għall-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejra t-tħejjija għall-festa?
messages.zh: 聚会筹备得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the preparation for the party going?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! L-ikel lest u fadlilna biss inżejnu l-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! L-ikel lest u fadlilna biss inżejnu l-kamra.
messages.zh: 挺顺利！食物准备好了，只剩布置房间了。
messages.en: Well! The food is ready, and we only have the room left to decorate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着备考、备餐、布置会场的清单，把这些“准备工作”一起归到 tħejjija 这个名词下面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have an outer husk or shell removed, as with grain or nuts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谷物、坚果等的外壳或外皮被去掉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titneħħielu l-qoxra ta' barra, bħal fil-każ tal-qamħ jew tal-lewż.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have the husk or shell removed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 外壳或外皮被去除；被脱壳。

formal.mt: Il-lewż tħellef qabel ma ntuża fit-tħejjija tal-ħelu.
formal.en: The almonds were shelled before being used to prepare the sweets.
formal.zh: 这些杏仁先被去壳，然后用于制作甜食。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-lewż għadu bil-qoxra? Luka: Le, tħellef diġà. Tista' tużah għall-kejk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these almonds still in their shells? Luka: No, they have already been shelled. You can use them for the cake.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些杏仁还带壳吗？卢卡：没有，已经去壳了。你可以拿来做蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Maja (做蛋糕的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-lewż għadu bil-qoxra?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-lewż għadu bil-qoxra?
messages.zh: 这些杏仁还带壳吗？
messages.en: Are these almonds still in their shells?

messages.speaker: Luka (帮忙备料的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tħellef diġà. Tista' tużah għall-kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tħellef diġà. Tista' tużah għall-kejk.
messages.zh: 没有，已经去壳了。你可以拿来做蛋糕。
messages.en: No, they have already been shelled. You can use them for the cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象杏仁从硬壳里露出来，再配一句“杏仁已经被去壳”，用食材发生的变化记住这个动词。

gloss_zh: 获释；在分娩时得到助产帮助

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be released from confinement or restraint; also, to receive assistance during childbirth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从关押或束缚中获得释放；也指在分娩过程中得到助产帮助。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħeles minn priġunerija jew minn restrizzjoni; ukoll, jingħata għajnuna waqt il-ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被释放；从关押或束缚中解脱。
在分娩过程中得到帮助或助产照护。

collocations.en: was assisted during childbirth by the midwife
collocations.zh: 分娩时得到了助产士的帮助

formal.mt: Il-mara tħelset bl-għajnuna tal-qabla, li baqgħet magħha matul il-ħlas.
formal.en: The woman was assisted during childbirth by the midwife, who stayed with her throughout labour.
formal.zh: 这名妇女在分娩时得到了助产士的帮助，助产士在整个产程中一直陪伴着她。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu l-ħabs? Luka: Le, tħelles ilbieraħ u mar lura għand il-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still in prison? Luka: No, he was released yesterday and went back to his family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗还在监狱里吗？卢卡：没有，他昨天获释了，已经回到家人身边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għadu l-ħabs?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għadu l-ħabs?
messages.zh: 保罗还在监狱里吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still in prison?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tħelles ilbieraħ u mar lura għand il-familja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tħelles ilbieraħ u mar lura għand il-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 没有，他昨天获释了，已经回到家人身边。
messages.en: No, he was released yesterday and went back to his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张情境卡记忆：一张是监狱门打开、当事人获释；另一张是产妇得到助产士帮助，分别练习两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of removing outer husks or shells from grain, nuts, or similar materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去除谷物、坚果等外壳或外皮的处理过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitneħħa l-qoxor ta' barra minn qamħ, lewż jew affarijiet simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 去除外壳或外皮；脱壳这一处理过程。

formal.mt: It-tħellif tal-lewż isir qabel ma l-lewż jintuża fil-produzzjoni tal-ħelu.
formal.en: The shelling of almonds takes place before the almonds are used in the production of sweets.
formal.zh: 杏仁用于制作甜食之前，需要先进行去壳处理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tħellif tal-lewż jieħu ħafna ħin? Luka: Jekk nagħmluh bl-idejn, iva. Ejja naħdmu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does shelling the almonds take a long time? Luka: If we do it by hand, yes. Let's work together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：给杏仁去壳很费时间吗？卢卡：如果用手工去壳，是的。咱们一起弄吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (备料的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tħellif tal-lewż jieħu ħafna ħin?
messages.mt_standard: It-tħellif tal-lewż jieħu ħafna ħin?
messages.zh: 给杏仁去壳很费时间吗？
messages.en: Does shelling the almonds take a long time?

messages.speaker: Luka (帮忙备料的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk nagħmluh bl-idejn, iva. Ejja naħdmu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk nagħmluh bl-idejn, iva. Ejja naħdmu flimkien.
messages.zh: 如果用手工去壳，是的。咱们一起弄吧。
messages.en: If we do it by hand, yes. Let's work together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħellef 的“已经被去壳”与 tħellif 的“去壳这道工序”并排记忆，后者可以讨论耗时和处理方法。

gloss_zh: 助产；分娩过程中的帮助

teaching_sense.en_definition: The help or care given to a woman during childbirth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在妇女分娩过程中提供的帮助或照护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għajnuna jew il-kura mogħtija lil mara waqt il-ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 助产；分娩过程中给予产妇的帮助。

collocations.zh: 产程及分娩中的助产帮助

collocations.en: childbirth assistance provided by a midwife
collocations.zh: 由助产士提供的助产照护

formal.mt: It-tħellis minn qabla jinkludi għajnuna u appoġġ lill-mara waqt il-ħlas.
formal.en: Childbirth assistance provided by a midwife includes help and support for the woman during labour.
formal.zh: 助产士提供的助产照护包括在产程中给予产妇帮助和支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għenek waqt il-ħlas? Sara: Il-qabla. It-tħellis u l-appoġġ tagħha kienu ta' għajnuna kbira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who helped you during labour? Sara: The midwife. Her childbirth assistance and support were a great help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：分娩时是谁帮助你的？萨拉：助产士。她的助产照护和支持帮了我很大的忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (探望产妇的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għenek waqt il-ħlas?
messages.mt_standard: Min għenek waqt il-ħlas?
messages.zh: 分娩时是谁帮助你的？
messages.en: Who helped you during labour?

messages.speaker: Sara (刚分娩的母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qabla. It-tħellis u l-appoġġ tagħha kienu ta' għajnuna kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qabla. It-tħellis u l-appoġġ tagħha kienu ta' għajnuna kbira.
messages.zh: 助产士。她的助产照护和支持帮了我很大的忙。
messages.en: The midwife. Her childbirth assistance and support were a great help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象助产士陪伴产妇、给予帮助的场景，把 tħellis 作为“助产照护”这一名词整体记住，并与去壳的 tħellif 区分。

gloss_zh: 沉默下来；变得不愿交谈

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop speaking or become unwilling to communicate with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 停止说话，或变得不愿与别人交流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieqaf jitkellem jew ma jibqax lest jikkomunika ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉默下来；停止说话
变得不愿交谈；不再主动与人交流

formal.mt: Wara l-aħħar mistoqsija, ix-xhud tħemmed u ma ta l-ebda tweġiba oħra.
formal.en: After the final question, the witness fell silent and gave no further answer.
formal.zh: 最后一个问题提出后，证人沉默下来，没有再作回答。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark tħemmed f'daqqa? Lara: Forsi għandu bżonn ftit ħin. Ħallih jitkellem meta jkun lest.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark suddenly go quiet? Lara: Maybe he needs a little time. Let him speak when he is ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么突然不说话了？拉拉：也许他需要一点时间。等他准备好了再让他说吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark tħemmed f'daqqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark tħemmed f'daqqa?
messages.zh: 马克怎么突然不说话了？
messages.en: Why did Mark suddenly go quiet?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi għandu bżonn ftit ħin. Ħallih jitkellem meta jkun lest.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi għandu bżonn ftit ħin. Ħallih jitkellem meta jkun lest.
messages.zh: 也许他需要一点时间。等他准备好了再让他说吧。
messages.en: Maybe he needs a little time. Let him speak when he is ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聊天中的人突然合上嘴，把 tħemmed 记成从说话转为沉默，也可指变得不愿交流。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To undergo fermentation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经历发酵过程；被发酵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi minn proċess ta' fermentazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被发酵；经过发酵

formal.mt: Il-meraq tħemmer fil-kontenitur, u matul il-proċess inbidlu t-togħma u r-riħa tiegħu.
formal.en: The juice fermented in the container, and its taste and smell changed during the process.
formal.zh: 果汁在容器中发酵，期间味道和气味发生了变化。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-meraq tħemmer? Rita: Iva, tħemmer matul il-lejl.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has this juice fermented? Rita: Yes, it fermented overnight.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这果汁发酵了吗？丽塔：是的，夜里发酵了。

messages.speaker: Mark (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-meraq tħemmer?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-meraq tħemmer?
messages.zh: 这果汁发酵了吗？
messages.en: Has this juice fermented?

messages.speaker: Rita (烹饪老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tħemmer matul il-lejl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tħemmer matul il-lejl.
messages.zh: 是的，夜里发酵了。
messages.en: Yes, it fermented overnight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象容器里的果汁正在发酵，用 tħemmer 描述它经历了发酵这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of being unwilling or reluctant to communicate with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不愿或不太愿意与别人交流的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat li fih persuna ma tkunx trid jew ma tkunx lesta tikkomunika ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不愿交流的状态；寡言少语

collocations.zh: 一段不愿与人交流的时期

formal.mt: It-tħemmid tal-parteċipant għamilha diffiċli għall-intervistatur biex jifhem l-opinjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The participant's uncommunicativeness made it difficult for the interviewer to understand his opinion.
formal.zh: 参与者不愿多谈，使访谈者难以了解他的看法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tħemmid ta' Pawlu qed jinkwetani. Mark: Nista' noqgħod miegħu ftit u nara jekk iridx jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Pawlu's unwillingness to talk is worrying me. Mark: I can sit with him for a while and see whether he wants to talk.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗一直不愿说话，我有点担心。马克：我可以陪他坐一会儿，看看他愿不愿意聊聊。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tħemmid ta' Pawlu qed jinkwetani.
messages.mt_standard: It-tħemmid ta' Pawlu qed jinkwetani.
messages.zh: 保罗一直不愿说话，我有点担心。
messages.en: Pawlu's unwillingness to talk is worrying me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' noqgħod miegħu ftit u nara jekk iridx jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' noqgħod miegħu ftit u nara jekk iridx jitkellem.
messages.zh: 我可以陪他坐一会儿，看看他愿不愿意聊聊。
messages.en: I can sit with him for a while and see whether he wants to talk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħemmid 想成对一个人寡言状态的命名：别人问话，他却一直不愿交流。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of placing objects one on top of another to form a stack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品一个放在另一个上面，形成堆叠的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqiegħed oġġetti wieħed fuq l-ieħor biex tifforma munzell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堆叠；把物品逐层码放

formal.mt: It-tħemmil ordnat tal-kaxxi fil-maħżen jiffaċilita l-għadd tagħhom u jħalli aktar spazju għall-mixi.
formal.en: Orderly stacking of the boxes in the storeroom makes them easier to count and leaves more walking space.
formal.zh: 将库房里的箱子整齐码放，便于清点，也能留出更多通行空间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tħemmil tal-kaxxi? Pawlu: Jien. Agħtini l-kaxxi l-kbar l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who will take care of stacking the boxes? Pawlu: I will. Give me the large boxes first.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁来负责把箱子码起来？保罗：我来。先把大箱子给我。

messages.speaker: Nina (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tħemmil tal-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tħemmil tal-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 谁来负责把箱子码起来？
messages.en: Who will take care of stacking the boxes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Agħtini l-kaxxi l-kbar l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Agħtini l-kaxxi l-kbar l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 我来。先把大箱子给我。
messages.en: I will. Give me the large boxes first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象箱子一层层往上码，把 tħemmil 和堆叠动作联系起来，再用箱子搭配反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of fermentation, during which microorganisms change substances in food or drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物或饮料中的物质在微生物作用下发生变化的发酵过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih mikroorganiżmi jibdlu sustanzi fl-ikel jew fix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发酵；发酵过程

formal.mt: Matul it-tħemmir tal-għaġina, il-ħmira tipproduċi gass li jgħin lill-għaġina togħla.
formal.en: During dough fermentation, yeast produces gas that helps the dough rise.
formal.zh: 面团发酵时，酵母产生气体，帮助面团膨起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed inħallu l-għaġina tistrieħ? Rita: Biex nagħtu ħin għat-tħemmir. Ara kif diġà bdiet togħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we leaving the dough to rest? Rita: To allow time for fermentation. Look, it has already started rising.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么要让面团静置？丽塔：给它时间发酵。你看，它已经开始膨起来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (烘焙学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed inħallu l-għaġina tistrieħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed inħallu l-għaġina tistrieħ?
messages.zh: 为什么要让面团静置？
messages.en: Why are we leaving the dough to rest?

messages.speaker: Rita (烘焙老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nagħtu ħin għat-tħemmir. Ara kif diġà bdiet togħla.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nagħtu ħin għat-tħemmir. Ara kif diġà bdiet togħla.
messages.zh: 给它时间发酵。你看，它已经开始膨起来了。
messages.en: To allow time for fermentation. Look, it has already started rising.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到面团慢慢膨起，就想到 tħemmir 是发酵这个过程的名称，可与动词 tħemmer 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be unsteady or shaky, moving instead of remaining firm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于不稳、摇晃的状态，不能保持稳固。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun instabbli jew jitħarrek mingħajr ma jibqa' sod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇晃；不稳

formal.mt: Is-siġġu tħendem taħt it-toqol tal-kaxxa, u għalhekk il-ħaddiem neħħa l-kaxxa minn fuqu.
formal.en: The chair was shaky under the weight of the box, so the worker removed the box from it.
formal.zh: 椅子承受箱子的重量时摇晃不稳，因此工人把箱子搬了下来。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Is-siġġu tħendem meta poġġejt fuqu. Nina: Ħu dan l-ieħor; dan jidher aktar sod.
colloquial.en: Mark: The chair wobbled when I sat on it. Nina: Take this other one; it looks sturdier.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我坐上去时，椅子晃了一下。妮娜：用这另一把吧，看起来更稳。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-siġġu tħendem meta poġġejt fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Is-siġġu tħendem meta poġġejt fuqu.
messages.zh: 我坐上去时，椅子晃了一下。
messages.en: The chair wobbled when I sat on it.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu dan l-ieħor; dan jidher aktar sod.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu dan l-ieħor; dan jidher aktar sod.
messages.zh: 用这另一把吧，看起来更稳。
messages.en: Take this other one; it looks sturdier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐上椅子后它左右摇晃，用 tħendem 记住物体不稳、晃动的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Quaking or shaking, especially repeated trembling or unsteady movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 震颤或摇动，尤指反复的颤动或不稳定的晃动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rogħda jew ċaqliq ripetut li juri li xi ħaġa mhix stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 震颤；震动
摇动；晃动；抖动

formal.mt: L-osservaturi nnutaw tħendim ħafif tal-pjattaforma meta bdiet taħdem il-magna.
formal.en: The observers noted slight shaking of the platform when the machine started running.
formal.zh: 机器开始运转时，观察人员注意到平台出现轻微晃动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħassejt dak it-tħendim tal-mejda? Pawlu: Iva, meta għaddiet il-vettura tqila fit-triq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you feel that shaking of the table? Pawlu: Yes, when the heavy vehicle went past on the road.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你感觉到桌子刚才晃动了吗？保罗：感觉到了，是那辆重型车从路上经过的时候。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt dak it-tħendim tal-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt dak it-tħendim tal-mejda?
messages.zh: 你感觉到桌子刚才晃动了吗？
messages.en: Did you feel that shaking of the table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, meta għaddiet il-vettura tqila fit-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, meta għaddiet il-vettura tqila fit-triq.
messages.zh: 感觉到了，是那辆重型车从路上经过的时候。
messages.en: Yes, when the heavy vehicle went past on the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把桌面反复晃动的画面定格，tħendim 就是这种震颤或摇动本身的名词。

gloss_zh: 含混乱语；不知所云的话

teaching_sense.en_definition: Babbling or speech that is unclear, incoherent, or without understandable meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含混、杂乱的言语，或让人无法理解其意思的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskors imħawwad, mhux ċar jew bla sens li jinftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含混杂乱的说话；咿呀乱语
不知所云的话；无法理解的胡言乱语

formal.mt: Fil-kitba tiegħu, l-awtur uża tħettif bla sens biex juri li l-karattru ma setax jesprimi ħsibijietu b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In his writing, the author used meaningless babbling to show that the character could not express his thoughts clearly.
formal.zh: 作者在作品中使用毫无意义的乱语，表现人物无法清楚表达自己的想法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fhimt xi ħaġa minn dak ir-reġistrazzjoni? Mark: Le, smajt biss tħettif. Ejja nerġgħu nisimgħuha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you understand anything from that recording? Mark: No, I only heard gibberish. Let's listen to it again slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那段录音你听懂什么了吗？马克：没有，我只听到一些不知所云的话。我们放慢再听一遍吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fhimt xi ħaġa minn dak ir-reġistrazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Fhimt xi ħaġa minn dik ir-reġistrazzjoni?
messages.zh: 那段录音你听懂什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand anything from that recording?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, smajt biss tħettif. Ejja nerġgħu nisimgħuha bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Le, smajt biss tħettif. Ejja nerġgħu nisimgħuha bil-mod.
messages.zh: 没有，我只听到一些不知所云的话。我们放慢再听一遍吧。
messages.en: No, I only heard gibberish. Let's listen to it again slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象录音里有人说个不停，却听不出连贯意思，把 tħettif 记成含混乱语或不知所云的话。

gloss_zh: 受到鼓舞；对某事产生热情

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become encouraged or to develop enthusiasm for an activity or subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到鼓励而振作起来，或开始对某项活动、某个主题产生热情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jieħu kuraġġ jew jibda jħoss ħeġġa għal attività jew suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到鼓励；受到鼓舞。

sense_translations.en_definition: to acquire an enthusiasm for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始对某事产生热情。

collocations.en: was encouraged by the teacher's words

formal.mt: L-istudent tħeġġeġ bil-kliem tal-għalliem u ddeċieda li jerġa' jipprova.
formal.en: The student was encouraged by the teacher's words and decided to try again.
formal.zh: 学生受到老师话语的鼓舞，决定再试一次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu tħeġġeġ għall-qari minn meta ġie magħna l-librerija. Mark: Tajjeb! Id-darba li jmiss nagħżlu ktieb flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu has developed enthusiasm for reading since he came to the library with us. Mark: Great! Next time we'll choose a book together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：自从跟我们去了图书馆，Pawlu 就对阅读产生了热情。Mark：太好了！下次我们一起选本书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu tħeġġeġ għall-qari minn meta ġie magħna l-librerija.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu tħeġġeġ għall-qari minn meta ġie magħna l-librerija.
messages.zh: 自从跟我们去了图书馆，Pawlu 就对阅读产生了热情。
messages.en: Pawlu has developed enthusiasm for reading since he came to the library with us.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Id-darba li jmiss nagħżlu ktieb flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Id-darba li jmiss nagħżlu ktieb flimkien.
messages.zh: 太好了！下次我们一起选本书。
messages.en: Great! Next time we'll choose a book together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个连续画面记忆：听到鼓励后振作起来，接着对活动产生兴趣；分别对应“受到鼓舞”和“产生热情”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving someone courage, confidence, or motivation to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某人勇气、信心或行动动力的鼓励。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħti lil xi ħadd kuraġġ, fiduċja jew ħeġġa biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火焰旺盛地燃烧；熊熊燃烧。
鼓励；鼓舞；激励。

formal.mt: Il-kliem ta' tħeġġiġ tal-għalliema għen lill-istudenti jkomplu jaħdmu minkejja d-diffikultajiet.
formal.en: The teacher's words of encouragement helped the students continue working despite the difficulties.
formal.zh: 老师鼓励的话语帮助学生们克服困难，继续努力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi bżonn ftit tħeġġiġ qabel il-preżentazzjoni. Mark: Int ippreparajt sew. Ħu nifs u ibda bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: I need a little encouragement before the presentation. Mark: You've prepared well. Take a breath and start calmly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：做报告前，我需要一点鼓励。Mark：你准备得很充分。深呼吸，然后从容开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn ftit tħeġġiġ qabel il-preżentazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn ftit tħeġġiġ qabel il-preżentazzjoni.
messages.zh: 做报告前，我需要一点鼓励。
messages.en: I need a little encouragement before the presentation.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Int ippreparajt sew. Ħu nifs u ibda bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Int ippreparajt sew. Ħu nifs u ibda bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 你准备得很充分。深呼吸，然后从容开始。
messages.en: You've prepared well. Take a breath and start calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 可把“火焰烧旺”和“受到鼓励后有了干劲”并列成两个记忆画面；这只是学习联想，用来分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Scolding or an expression of blame directed at someone for something they have done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人的行为而对其作出的训斥，或表达不满与责备的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem ta' ċanfir jew ta' ħtija indirizzat lil xi ħadd minħabba dak li jkun għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 责骂；训斥，指用言语批评某人的行为。
责备；指责，表示认为某人做错了事或令人失望。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tħir tal-missier iġiegħel lit-tifel jaħseb dwar l-imġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the father's scolding makes the boy reflect on his behaviour.
formal.zh: 在故事中，父亲的训斥使男孩反思自己的行为。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex int daqshekk kwiet? Pawlu: Wara dak it-tħir kollu, ma tantx għandi aptit nitkellem. Marta: Ħu ftit ħin biex tikkalma.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you so quiet? Pawlu: After all that scolding, I don't really feel like talking. Marta: Take a little time to calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tħir 放进“做错事后挨训”的场景：既可指训斥这个行为，也可指带着责备的话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something left to another person, especially property or possessions passed on as a bequest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 留给另一个人的东西，尤指通过遗赠留给他人的财产或物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li titħalla lil persuna oħra, speċjalment proprjetà jew oġġetti li jingħataw b'wirt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗赠；通过遗嘱或身后安排留给他人的财物。
留给某人的东西；为某人留下的物品。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi t-tħollija ta' dar lin-neputija tal-awtur.
formal.en: The document describes the bequest of a house to the author's granddaughter.
formal.zh: 文件记述了将一所房屋遗赠给作者孙女的安排。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn ġie dan l-arloġġ? Nina: Huwa tħollija tan-nanna għalija. Lara: Mela għandu valur speċjali għalik.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did this watch come from? Nina: It's something Grandma left for me. Lara: Then it must have special value for you.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这块手表是哪儿来的？妮娜：这是奶奶留给我的。劳拉：那它对你一定有特别的意义。
